title: Energy dissipation in linear viscoelasticity
summary: We compare the specific dissipation $Q^{-1}\left( ω\right) $ for the Becker, Lomnitz, and Lambert models in linear viscoelasticity. Graphically, the specific dissipation of these models behaves similarly as $ω\rightarrow 0^{+}$ and $ω\rightarrow +\infty$. Furthermore, we obtain analytic formulas for the asymptotic behavior of $Q^{-1}\left( ω\right) $ in the Becker and Lomnitz models as $ω\rightarrow 0^{+}$ and $ω\rightarrow +\infty$, where the latter limit coincides with the specific dissipation of the Maxwell model. We also derive a novel closed-form expression for the specific dissipation in the generalized Becker model, $Q_{ν}^{-1}\left( ω\right) $, when the parameter $ν\in \left( 0,1\right] $ is rational. When $ν\rightarrow 0$, we recover the specific dissipation of the Maxwell model, whereas when $ν=1$, we recover that of the original Becker model. In addition, we derive two new closed-form expressions for the specific dissipation for the extended Jeffreys--Lomnitz model $Q_{α}^{-1}\left( ω\right) $, the first being valid for $α\in \left( 0,1\right] $, and the second for $α\in \left( -\infty ,1\right] $. When $α\rightarrow 0$, we recover the specific dissipation of the Lomnitz model, whereas when $α=1$, we recover that of the Maxwell model. Finally, we conclude that the asymptotic behavior of $Q_{α}^{-1}\left( ω\right) $ as $ω\rightarrow +\infty $ coincides with the specific dissipation of the Maxwell model. Keywords:

AI.tldr: 本文在线性粘弹性（linear viscoelasticity）框架下，系统比较了Becker、Lomnitz和Lambert模型的比耗散（specific dissipation）Q⁻¹(ω)，推导了Becker与Lomnitz模型在角频率趋于0⁺和+∞时的渐近解析公式，并为广义Becker模型和扩展Jeffreys–Lomnitz模型分别导出了新的闭式表达式。
AI.motivation: 不同粘弹性模型在描述了材料耗散行为时各有差异，但以往缺乏对它们比耗散Q⁻¹(ω)的系统性解析对比。作者旨在揭示这些模型在低频与高频极限下的渐近行为联系，并填补广义模型中精确闭式表达式的空白。
AI.method: 通过图形比较Becker、Lomnitz与Lambert模型的比耗散在ω→0⁺和ω→+∞时的表现；推导Becker及Lomnitz模型的渐近解析公式；利用参数ν∈(0,1]为有理数的条件，构造广义Becker模型的闭式表达式；并针对扩展Jeffreys–Lomnitz模型分别在α∈(0,1]与α∈(-∞,1]两个参数区间推导出两种新的闭式表达式。
AI.result: 三种基本模型的比耗散在ω→0⁺与ω→+∞时的图像行为相似，且后一极限与Maxwell模型的比耗散一致。广义Becker模型在ν→0时还原为Maxwell模型结果，在ν=1时还原为原Becker模型结果；扩展Jeffreys–Lomnitz模型在α→0时还原为Lomnitz模型结果，在α=1时还原为Maxwell模型结果。此外，Q⁻¹_α(ω)在ω→+∞时的渐近行为同样与Maxwell模型比耗散一致。
AI.conclusion: Becker、Lomnitz与Lambert模型在高低频极限下表现出统一的粘弹性耗散渐近行为，且多个广义模型均以Maxwell模型作为高频或极限退化情形，揭示了这些粘弹性本构模型之间的内在联系。

title: Information Loss under Gauge Reduction of Discrete Electromagnetic Fields
summary: We study relative entropy under gauge reduction in Whitney-discretized electromagnetism. The discrete Hodge decomposition separates exact gauge directions from harmonic and coexact physical degrees of freedom. For Gaussian distributions on the auxiliary potential space, relative entropy splits exactly into the relative entropy of the physical marginals and a nonnegative conditional gauge contribution. We express this contribution through Schur complements, conditional means, and physical--gauge correlations, and characterize equality between auxiliary and physical relative entropies. The physical divergence is also shown to be the minimum over all Gaussian auxiliary extensions. At the infinitesimal level, Fisher information admits an analogous decomposition. A two-variable model illustrates how statistically distinct auxiliary potentials may represent identical physical statistics. The construction provides an information-geometric interpretation of discrete gauge reduction without assigning physical significance to the eliminated gauge variables.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Whitney离散化电磁学中规范约化（gauge reduction）下的相对熵（relative entropy）结构。在离散Hodge分解框架下，若将高斯统计量定义在辅助势空间（auxiliary potential space）上，相对熵可精确分解为物理边际分布的相对熵与一个非负的条件规范贡献之和，后者可通过Schur补、条件均值及物理-规范相关性来显式表达。
AI.motivation: 在电磁学与信息几何的交汇处，需要理解离散规范对称性对统计量（如相对熵和Fisher信息）的影响机制。规范自由度在物理上不具观测意义，但其统计影响可能显著，因此需要在数学上严格刻画约化过程中的信息损失结构。
AI.method: 采用Whitney离散化框架下的离散Hodge分解（discrete Hodge decomposition），将精确规范方向与调和及共存（coexact）物理自由度分离。对辅助势空间上的高斯分布，利用Schur补与条件均值的代数工具推导相对熵的精确分解，并在无穷小极限下检验Fisher信息（Fisher information）的对应分解，最后通过二维变量模型进行说明。
AI.result: 证明了辅助空间与物理空间中相对熵相等当且仅当规范部分不携带与物理部分相关的额外信息；物理空间发散（divergence）等于所有高斯辅助扩展中的极小值；Fisher信息的分解在无穷小层面同样成立。二维模型显示不同辅助势可产生相同物理统计量。
AI.conclusion: 该构造为离散规范约化提供了信息几何（information-geometric）诠释，在不赋予被消除的规范变量以物理意义的前提下，阐明了规范约化如何在统计层面保持或损失信息。

title: Distance Energies and Negative Type of Flat Tori
summary: Let \(T_Λ=\mathbb R^d/Λ\), \(d\geq2\), be a flat torus with quotient metric \(ρ_Λ\), and consider the distance energies \(I_α(μ)=\iint ρ_Λ(x,y)^α\,dμ(x)\,dμ(y)\) of Borel probability measures \(μ\). We prove a quantitative Fourier signature of the cut locus: for every Voronoi facet and every \(α>0\), there is a sequence of dual-lattice frequencies approaching the facet normal along which the Fourier coefficients of \(ρ_Λ^α\) are positive, with an explicit leading asymptotic determined by the facet. As direct consequences, Haar measure is not a local maximizer for any positive distance power, even among smooth densities, and every flat torus of dimension at least two has supremal negative type and generalized roundness zero. We then solve the global maximization problem for two classes of flat tori. On an orthogonal rectangular torus, the maximizers undergo a transition at \(α=2\): for \(1\leqα<2\) they are the translated uniform measures on the two-torsion subgroup; at \(α=2\) all balanced couplings on translates of that subgroup are extremal; and for \(α>2\) only equally weighted diametral pairs remain. On the regular hexagonal torus, the maximizers are precisely the uniform measures on translates of a distinguished cyclic subgroup of order three for every \(α\geq1\).

AI.tldr: 本文研究平坦环面（flat torus）上的距离能量泛函I_α，通过傅里叶（Fourier）分析证明了割迹（cut locus）的定量傅里叶特征，并据此解决了正交矩形环面和正则六边形环面上距离能量最大化的全局问题。
AI.motivation: 理解距离能量在紧致流形上的极值结构对几何分析与优化领域有重要意义，但平坦环面上任意正幂距离能量的最大化问题此前未被系统解决。作者希望借助傅里叶方法揭示割迹对能量行为的深层影响，从而确定最大化测度的结构。
AI.method: 作者使用傅里叶分析研究平坦环面T_Λ上的距离能量I_α(μ)。核心方法是对每个Voronoi侧面（Voronoi facet）构造沿对偶晶格（dual lattice）频率的系数序列，推导出由该侧面决定的显式主导渐近，进而得到关于Haar测度非局部极大以及负型（negative type）与广义零半径（generalized roundness）的结论；随后分别在正交矩形环面和正则六边形环面上对全局最大化问题进行完整求解。
AI.result: 对每个Voronoi侧面和任意α>0，存在趋近该侧面法向的对偶晶格频率序列，使ρ_Λ^α的傅里叶系数为正。由此推出：Haar测度不是任意正幂距离能量的局部极大值点（即使限制于光滑密度）；任意d≥2维平坦环面具有上确界负型（supremal negative type）且广义零半径为零。对正交矩形环面，α=2处发生过渡：1≤α<2时极大值为二挠子群（two-torsion subgroup）上的平移均匀测度；α=2时该子群平移上所有平衡耦合均为极值；α>2时仅等权对径点对为极大值。对正则六边形环面，对所有α≥1，极大值恰为阶三循环子群平移上的均匀测度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了平坦环面距离能量的系统傅里叶框架，揭示了割迹几何与极值测度之间的深层联系，并针对两类具体环面给出了完整且结构清晰的最大化刻画，反映了维度d≥2下测度能量极值行为的丰富性与相变现象。

title: An Algebraic Proof of Gauge-Fixing Independence
summary: This paper provides an algebraic proof of the gauge-fixing independence of perturbative asymptotic expansions in a finite-dimensional model of non-Abelian gauge theory. We develop an algebraic framework using the BRST formalism and perturbation theory. Our main theorem shows that under appropriate transversality conditions, normalized expectation values of observables remain unchanged under smooth deformations of the gauge-fixing conditions that preserve these assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个有限维非阿贝尔规范场论（non-Abelian gauge theory）模型中，给出了微扰渐近展开的规范固定（gauge-fixing）无关性的代数证明。
AI.motivation: 规范固定过程在物理上不应影响可观测量的期望值，但这一无关性在微扰展开中需要严格的数学证明。作者旨在为有限维简化模型中这一性质提供代数层面的严格论证。
AI.method: 作者基于BRST形式论（BRST formalism）和微扰论（perturbation theory）构建了一套代数框架，并在适当的横截条件（transversality conditions）假设下进行分析。
AI.result: 主要定理表明：在满足保持假设的规范固定条件的平滑形变（smooth deformations）下，可观测量的归一化期望值（normalized expectation values）保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 该代数证明确立了有限维非阿贝尔规范理论模型中微扰渐近展开对规范固定选择的无关性，为更一般情形下的相关研究提供了理论基础。

title: Measurement of CP Asymmetry Parameters and Polarization Correlations in $Ω^{-}\barΩ^{+}$ Pairs
summary: Using $(2.71 \pm 0.01) \times 10^9$ $ψ(3686)$ events collected with the BESIII detector, a joint full angular distribution analysis is carried out for the process $ψ(3686) \to Ω^-(\toΛK^-) \, \barΩ^{+}(\to \barΛK^+)$. The first simultaneous measurement of the weak decay parameters $φ_{Ω^{-}}$ and $φ_{\barΩ^{+}}$ for $Ω^- \to K^-Λ$ and $\barΩ^+ \to K^+\barΛ$ is performed, yielding the first result for the CP-sensitive observable, $φ_{\rm CP} = (-0.004 \pm 0.055 \pm 0.017)~\text{rad}$, where the first and second uncertainties are statistical and systematic, respectively. This further enables the extraction of the weak and strong phase differences between the $P$- and $D$-wave amplitudes: $(ξ_D - ξ_P) = (-0.15 \pm 2.25 \pm 0.69)~\text{rad}$ and $(δ_D - δ_P) = (-0.97 \pm 0.88 \pm 0.34)~\text{rad}$. Additionally, the polarization correlations between $Ω^{-}$ and $\barΩ^{+}$ are measured.

AI.tldr: 利用BESIII探测器采集的约27.1亿ψ(3686)事例，对ψ(3686)→Ω⁻(→ΛK⁻)Ω̄⁺(→Λ̄K⁺)过程进行了联合全角分布分析，首次同时测量了弱衰变参数φ_{Ω⁻}和φ_{Ω̄⁺}，并给出了CP敏感可观测量φ_CP的首次测量结果。
AI.motivation: 为了精确检验CP对称性破缺（CP violation）以及研究Ω超子衰变中的弱相互作用与强相互作用相位结构，需要同时测量Ω⁻和Ω̄⁺的弱衰变参数，从而获得CP敏感的可观测量。
AI.method: 采用BESIII探测器采集的(2.71±0.01)×10⁹个ψ(3686)事例，对ψ(3686)→Ω⁻(→ΛK⁻)Ω̄⁺(→Λ̄K⁺)衰变链进行联合全角分布（joint full angular distribution）分析，通过同时拟合Ω⁻和Ω̄⁺的衰变角分布提取弱衰变参数及极化关联（polarization correlation）。
AI.result: 首次给出CP敏感可观测量结果φ_CP = (−0.004 ± 0.055 ± 0.017) rad，并由此提取P波与D波振幅之间的弱相位差(ξ_D−ξ_P) = (−0.15 ± 2.25 ± 0.69) rad和强相位差(δ_D−δ_P) = (−0.97 ± 0.88 ± 0.34) rad，同时测量了Ω⁻与Ω̄⁺之间的极化关联。
AI.conclusion: φ_CP的测量结果与零在误差范围内一致，表明在当前统计精度下未观察到CP破坏证据；该工作为理解Ω超子中性弱衰变过程提供了新的实验约束。

title: Cosmology, Cluster Algebras, and $\boldsymbol{u}$
summary: We explore the cluster algebra structures present in the wavefunction and correlators of conformally coupled scalar fields in de Sitter space. To connect cosmological kinematics to cluster variables, we utilize the so-called $u$-variables that appear on both sides. Since $u$-variables parameterize a rigid space, it is natural to identify the ones that appear from cosmological graphs and those that arise from cluster algebras. This provides a mapping between kinematic variables and cluster variables. For $n$-site chain Feynman graphs, this gives a coordinate-invariant relation to $A_{2n-2}$-type cluster algebras, while in the case of $n$-site cycle graph momentum integrands, the relevant cluster algebra is $B_{2n-1}$, as found previously. Since kinematic variables are mapped to nonlinear combinations of cluster variables, cluster compatibility imposes strong conditions on possible symbol entries. We use this notion of compatibility to bootstrap the symbol. In the chain case, both the cosmological wavefunction and products of lower-point functions satisfy cluster compatibility, with the correlator a particular combination, so that the wavefunction and correlator share the same cluster structure. In the cycle case, however, the wavefunction appears to be uniquely selected by the cluster structure, and the correlator does not display the same compatibility as the wavefunction.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索了德西特（de Sitter）空间中保角耦合标量场波函数与关联函数中蕴含的丛代数（cluster algebra）结构，通过$u$-变量将宇宙学运动学变量与丛变量建立起映射关系，并利用丛相容性（cluster compatibility）对符号（symbol）进行引导构建。链状费曼图对应$A_{2n-2}$型丛代数，环状图对应$B_{2n-1}$型丛代数；链状情形下波函数与低阶关联函数的乘积均满足丛相容性，而环状情形下仅波函数被丛结构唯一选定。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在将宇宙学中的运动学变量（kinematic variables）与纯数学中的丛代数（cluster algebra）结构建立联系，从而利用丛代数的相容性条件来约束和引导宇宙学波函数与关联函数中的符号（symbol）结构。这一动机源于此前已发现在$n$-site环图动量积分中蕴含$B_{2n-1}$型丛代数结构，研究者希望进一步将这一数学框架系统性地应用于德西特空间中的标量场计算。
AI.method: 研究利用$u$-变量作为桥梁连接宇宙学图（cosmological graphs）与丛代数，将运动学变量映射为丛变量的非线性组合。针对$n$-site链状费曼图，建立了与$A_{2n-2}$型丛代数的坐标不变关系；针对环状图动量积分，识别出$B_{2n-1}$型丛代数。在此基础上，利用丛相容性条件对符号进行引导构建（bootstrap），检验波函数与关联函数是否满足该相容性约束。
AI.result: 对于链状情形，宇宙学波函数与低阶点函数的乘积均满足丛相容性，关联函作为二者的特定组合，因此波函数与关联函数共享相同的丛结构。而对于环状情形，波函数被丛结构唯一选定，但关联函数不表现出与波函数相同的相容性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，德西特空间中标量场的波函数与关联函数具有深刻的丛代数结构，链状图与环状图分别对应$A_{2n-2}$和$B_{2n-1}$型丛代数。丛相容性可作为强有力的工具来引导波函数的符号结构，尤其在不需依赖关联函数相容性的环状情形中，丛结构能唯一确定波函数。这一发现暗示丛代数可成为研究宇宙学可观测量的新数学框架。

title: Coherent multipath wave response on Reissner-Nordström analogue surface
summary: To uncover how the intrinsic metric of a relativistic compact object governs macroscopic wave phenomena, we establish a theoretical framework mapping the charge dependent spatial geometry of a Reissner-Nordström (RN) black hole onto the coherent response of an analogue curved surface. By solving an exact spatial geodesic boundary value problem on an isometrically embedded equatorial slice, we extract the discrete multi-loop path-length spectrum and convert this geometric backbone into a physical wave field via a finite-path surface Huygens-Fresnel construction. We analytically compute the arbitrary order winding trajectories alongside their high winding accumulation limits, demonstrating that the analogue charge acts as a precise physical dial that reconfigures the event horizon throat and fundamentally reorganizes the discrete path sequence. Furthermore, we find that this underlying geometric deformation uniquely dictates the macroscopic interference, revealing that steady state spatial fringes, spectral resonance combs, and transient temporal echo ladders are intrinsically unified physical projections of a single charge controlled path spectrum. This systematic parameter to response methodology establishes a rigorous theoretical bridge between strong field gravitational lensing and tabletop transformation optics, providing a highly tunable blueprint for future multi domain analogue gravity experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文建立一个理论框架，将Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞的电荷依赖空间几何映射到模拟曲面上的相干响应，通过精确的空间测地线边界值问题提取离散多环路径长度谱，并以Huygens-Fresnel构造将其转化为物理波场，揭示稳态空间条纹、谱共振梳与瞬态时间回波梯级是同一电荷控制路径谱的统一物理投影。
AI.motivation: 揭示相对论致密物体的内蕴度量如何支配宏观波动现象，建立强场引力透镜与桌面变换光学之间的严格理论桥梁。
AI.method: 在等距嵌入的赤道切片上解精确空间测地线边界值问题以提取离散多环路径长度谱，再通过有限路径曲面Huygens-Fresnel构造将路径谱转化为物理波场；解析计算任意阶绕行轨迹及其高绕行累积极限。
AI.result: 证明模拟电荷充当精确物理拨盘，可重构事件视界喉部并根本性地重组离散路径序列；发现几何形变唯一决定宏观干涉，使稳态空间条纹、谱共振梳和瞬态时间回波梯级表现为单一电荷控制路径谱的统一物理投影。
AI.conclusion: 该参数到响应的系统方法论为强场引力透镜与桌面变换光学之间建立了严格的理论联系，为未来多领域模拟引力实验提供了高度可调的设计蓝图。

title: Superdiffusive two-dimensional superconductors
comment: 8 pages, 0 figures, submitted to Physical Review B
summary: We formulate a non-local, field-theoretic description of phase fluctuations and topological transitions in two-dimensional (2D) superconductors by generalizing the local only-phase Popov action to a framework utilizing non-local fractional operators. By replacing the standard spatial Laplacian with the Riesz fractional Laplacian $-(-\nabla^2)^{α/2}$ (where $1<α<2$), we prove that the vortex-antivortex interaction transitions from logarithmic confinement to a stronger power-law confinement of the form $V(r)\propto r^{2-α}$. Through a generalized Kosterlitz-Thouless energetic-entropic analysis, we demonstrate that this non-local confinement strictly suppresses thermal vortex proliferation. Because the non-local operator safely places the system outside the strict domain of validity of the Mermin-Wagner restriction, this power-law confinement natively stabilizes true long-range order at finite temperatures. Finally, by constructing a gauge-invariant fractional action, we formulate a fractional London equation. This approach yields a real-space power-law kernel that maps directly onto the anomalous Pippard limit of superconductors with long coherence lengths, providing a unified phenomenologically motivated framework for non-local electrodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文将局域的仅相位Popov作用推广到基于非局域分数阶算子（fractional operator）的框架，用Riesz分数阶拉普拉斯算子替换标准空间拉普拉斯算子，证明涡旋-反涡旋相互作用从对数限制转变为更强的幂律限制，从而抑制热涡旋增殖、在有限温度下稳定真正的长程有序，并构建分数阶London方程（fractional London equation）以统一描述非局域电动力学。
AI.motivation: 二维超导体中的相位涨落与拓扑相变传统上受限于局域算子框架，且Mermin-Wagner限制禁止有限温度下的长程有序。作者希望建立非局域描述，以打破这一限制并统一处理非局域电动力学。
AI.method: 将局域仅相位Popov作用推广到非局域分数阶算子框架，以Riesz分数阶拉普拉斯算子$-(-\nabla^2)^{\alpha/2}$（$1<\alpha<2$）替代标准空间拉普拉斯算子；利用广义Kosterlitz-Thouless能量-熵分析方法证明涡旋增殖被抑制；并构建规范不变的分数阶作用，推导分数阶London方程。
AI.result: 涡旋-反涡旋相互作用从对数限制转变为幂律限制$V(r)\propto r^{2-\alpha}$；非局域限制严格抑制热涡旋增殖；系统被移出Mermin-Wagner限制的有效域，从而在有限温度下稳定真正长程有序；分数阶London方程产生实空间幂律核，对应长相干长度的反常Pippard极限。
AI.conclusion: 该分数阶框架为二维超导体提供了一种统一的现象学动机模型，将拓扑涨落行为与非局域电动力学（anomalous Pippard regime）相联系，拓展了传统Kosterlitz-Thouless相变理论的适用范围。

title: Renormalization Group on Wiener Space: Spectral Theory and Universality
summary: We develop a rigorous renormalization group (RG) formalism on Wiener space. We introduce an RG operator $\mathcal R$ acting on probability measures over continuous paths, whose fixed point is the Wiener measure. We linearize $\mathcal{R}$ around the Brownian fixed point and analyze the spectral structure of the resulting operator $\mathscr{L}$. Its eigenvectors are too singular to be realized as honest measures on path space, and we therefore develop a generalized spectral theory within the framework of white noise analysis (Hida calculus). The eigenvectors of $\mathscr{L}$ are realized as Hida distributions, satisfying $\mathscr{L} U=λU$ in the weak sense. This analysis yields structural results such as a spectral gap and a diagonal-concentration property of the eigenvectors. Moreover, we identify a family $\{\mathfrak{U}_n\}_{n \geq 0}$ of eigenvectors with eigenvalues $λ_n = 2^{1-n/2}$, consisting of Wick polynomials of white noise formally expressed as $\mathfrak{U}_n = \int_0^1 {:}\dot W(t)^n{:}\, dt$, and rigorously constructed as Hida distributions. We then use this spectral structure to uncover a finer, second layer of universality in the Donsker invariance principle: not only is the convergence of random walks towards the Brownian scaling limit universal, but the entire hierarchy of leading corrections to the Brownian limit is universal as well, governed by the eigenpairs $(λ_n, \mathfrak{U}_n)$. We also show, at a formal level, that the framework developed here extends to Gibbs-type perturbations of the Brownian fixed point, in the spirit of self-interacting quantum field theories. In particular, we recover the standard irrelevant/marginal/relevant classification, usually obtained in the physics literature by power-counting, solely from the spectral analysis of $\mathscr{L}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Wiener空间上建立了严格的重整化群（renormalization group, RG）形式体系，定义了作用于连续路径上概率测度的RG算子R，其不动点为Wiener测度。作者围绕Brownian不动点将其线性化，借助白噪声分析（white noise analysis）框架发展广义谱理论，发现特征向量可实现为Hida分布，并据此揭示了Donkser不变原理中更深层次的普适性结构，即整个Brownian极限的前导修正层级也由该谱结构支配。
AI.motivation: 传统上，重整化群方法在随机过程和量子场论中的应用多为形式化或启发式的，缺乏严格数学基础。作者旨在建立一套严格的RG形式体系，使其既能刻画Brownian路径空间上的谱结构，又能在正式层面推广到自相互作用量子场论的Gibbs型扰动，从而将物理文献中经验性的幂次计数（power-counting）分类还原为严格谱分析的结果。
AI.method: 论文在Wiener空间上构造RG算子R，其作用对象为连续路径上的概率测度。作者将R在Brownian不动点处线性化，得到算子L，并发现其特征向量过于奇异而无法作为路径空间上的常规测度实现。为此，作者在Hida演算（白噪声分析）框架内发展广义谱理论，将特征向量实现为满足弱意义下LU=λU的Hida分布。论文还构造了由白噪声Wick多项式组成的特征向量族{U_n}，其特征值为λ_n=2^{1-n/2}。
AI.result: 谱分析揭示了谱隙（spectral gap）和特征向量的对角集中（diagonal-concentration）性质等结构结果。作者利用特征对(λ_n,U_n)证明Donkser不变原理中不仅随机游走向Brownian标度极限的收敛是普适的，而且整个朝向Brownian极限的前导修正层级也是普适的。此外，在正式层面对Gibbs型扰动的分析中，恢复了物理文献中通常由幂次计数得出的irrelevant/marginal/relevant分类。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为Wiener空间上的重整化群理论奠定了严格基础，将Brownian运动视为RG不动点，其谱结构编码了随机过程中的普适性层级，并为量子场论中相关/无关分类提供了纯数学的严格推导框架。

title: Prospective study of light dark matter search in positron beam mode with DarkSHINE experiment initiative
summary: We perform the prospective study on searching for invisibly decayed dark photons ($A^{\prime}$) in positron-on-fixed-target (POT) scheme with the DarkSHINE experiment simulation setup. In the positron-on-fixed-target scheme, two additional production channels of dark photons via annihilation with extranuclear electrons are present: non-resonant t-channel ($e^+e^-N \to γA^{\prime}N$) and resonant s-channel ($e^+e^-N \to A^{\prime}N$), alongside bremsstrahlung emission similar to electron-on-fixed-target scheme. Based on a Geant4 full detector simulation of an 8 GeV positron beam with $3 \times 10^{14}$ POT events, we developed an analysis strategy using missing energy and momentum signatures across three orthogonal signal regions optimized for these channels. Our results indicate that the additional annihilation channels of dark photon production improve the dark photon invisible decay search sensitivity, improving the exclusion limits by approximately two orders of magnitude compared to existing constraints in the electron-on-fixed target (EOT) scheme, particularly near the center-of-mass energy threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文针对DarkSHINE实验中正电子打固定靶（positron-on-fixed-target, POT）方案，系统研究了不可见衰变暗光子（dark photon, A′）的搜寻前景。通过Geant4全探测器模拟和对湮灭与轫致辐射两种产生渠道的缺失能量/动量分析，发现POT方案相比电子打固定靶方案可将排除极限提升约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有电子打固定靶（electron-on-fixed-target, EOT）方案对不可见衰变暗光子的搜寻灵敏度有限，而正电子打靶方案可引入额外的湮灭产生渠道（t-通道和s-通道），有望显著改善搜寻灵敏度。
AI.method: 基于DarkSHINE实验模拟框架，采用8 GeV正电子束流与3×10^14个打靶事件（POT）的大规模Geant4全探测器模拟；利用缺失能量和缺失动量特征，针对两种湮灭渠道和轫致辐射渠道设计了三个正交信号区域（signal regions）的分析策略。
AI.result: 正电子打固定靶方案中额外的暗光子湮灭产生渠道显著提升了不可见衰变搜寻灵敏度，相比现有EOT方案约束，排除极限（exclusion limits）改善约两个数量级，尤其在质心系能量阈值附近效果最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 正电子打固定靶方案通过利用湮灭产生的附加暗光子渠道，能够大幅超越电子打靶方案目前的实验约束，是未来扩大暗光子不可见衰变搜寻参数空间的有力途径。

title: Matrix Holography on an Optical Lattice
summary: We propose an analog quantum-simulation protocol based on a lattice of atomic ensembles and time-averaged Floquet dynamics to construct the four-body potentials that typically appear in bosonic BFSS-like matrix quantum mechanics. In contrast to gate-based digital implementations requiring deep circuits, our approach generates the target model through a fixed set of control stages per Floquet cycle, keeping the number of consecutive unitaries constant with respect to the matrix size $N$. The principal scaling cost in our construction is given by the frequency range required to control the growing lattice. We show that this cost grows at most as $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$, giving a polynomial scaling route to large$-N$, attractive to experimental implementation. Additionally, we demonstrate that the coupling parameter can be tuned beyond $\mathcal{O}(1)$, enabling the simulation of strong-coupling physics necessary for holographic phases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于原子系综晶格与时均Floquet动力学的模拟量子模拟（analog quantum simulation）协议，用以构造玻色型BFSS类矩阵量子力学中典型的四体势，其扩展至大N所需的频率控制代价以$O(N^3)$多项式方式增长，且耦合参数可调至超过$O(1)$以实现强耦合物理的模拟。
AI.motivation: 基于门电路的数字化实现需要深度量子电路，计算代价随矩阵规模快速增大；因此需要一种更高效的模拟方法，以可扩展的方式构造玻色型BFSS类矩阵量子力学中的四体势，进而为全息相（holographic phase）等强耦合物理提供实验可行的模拟路径。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个以原子系综（atomic ensemble）为基本单元的晶格系统，通过时均Floquet动力学（time-averaged Floquet dynamics）在每个Floquet周期内以固定数量的控制阶段生成目标四体势；该结构中连续酉算子的数目不随矩阵大小$N$变化，主要扩展代价体现在控制日益增长的晶格所需的频率范围上。
AI.result: 该方案的频率控制代价最多以$O(N^3)$增长，为达到大$N$提供了多项式扩展路径，有利于实验实现；同时表明耦合参数可被调谐至超过$O(1)$，从而能够模拟全息相所必需的强耦合物理。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明基于原子系综晶格和Floquet动力学可实现BFSS类矩阵模型的高效模拟量子协议，其多项式扩展代价和强耦合可调性使其具备实际实验实施的潜力。

title: Quantum-gravity-inspired Alcubierre warp-drive geometries
summary: String T-duality, through its correspondence with path-integral duality, endows the low-energy propagator with a zero-point length $l_0=2π\sqrt{α'}$ that softens the short-distance behavior of gravitational fields. Motivated by the regular black-hole construction obtained from the corresponding smeared source, we formulate a T-duality-inspired Alcubierre geometry by identifying the warp profile with the complementary cumulative mass fraction of that source. For the effective one-scale choice $f(r_s)=1-r_s^3/(r_s^2+l^2)^{3/2}$, with $l^2=R^2+l_0^2$, the metric is $C^2$ at the bubble center and smooth elsewhere, while the energy density, its volume integral, and the York expansion are available in closed form. In particular, $E=-(15π/1024)v_s^2 l$ in geometric units and $|ρ_E|$ is bounded by a constant times $v_s^2/l^2$. Within this one-scale family, the model therefore removes the divergence associated with the profile-contraction limit $R\to 0$ at fixed velocity, because $l$ cannot fall below $l_0$. This should not be confused with a regularization of the conventional Alcubierre thin-wall limit at fixed macroscopic bubble radius, in which an independent wall thickness is taken to zero. We emphasize, however, that the construction is an effective ansatz rather than a derivation from string-corrected field equations: $R$ is a macroscopic profile scale, the choice $l^2=R^2+l_0^2$ is an interpolation, and the classical $l_0\to 0$ limit remains a smooth thick-walled profile rather than the distributional Alcubierre top hat. Exotic matter remains necessary, and neither semiclassical stability nor a modified quantum energy inequality is claimed without an explicit renormalized stress-tensor calculation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于弦论T-对偶（T-duality）与路径积分对偶的关系，在低能传播子中引入零点长度$l_0$，构造了一个T-对偶启发的Alcubierre几何，通过选择平滑的空间分布（smeared source）来改变翘曲轮廓，从而在固定速度下消除轮廓收缩极限的发散，但该构造仅为有效拟设（effective ansatz）而非从弦修正场方程推导而来。
AI.motivation: 传统Alcubierre翘曲几何中，将薄壁极限（thin-wall limit）推向零厚度时会遇到发散问题。作者受正则黑洞构造的启发，期望利用T-对偶引入的零点长度$l_0=2π\sqrt{α'}$来软化引力场短距离行为，从而缓解翘曲轮廓收缩时的发散问题。
AI.method: 通过弦T-对偶与路径积分对偶的对应关系，引入零点长度$l_0$；将翘曲轮廓（warp profile）与来源的互补累积质量分数（complementary cumulative mass fraction）相关联，构造T-对偶启发的Alcubierre几何；选用单尺度有效形式$f(r_s)=1-r_s^3/(r_s^2+l^2)^{3/2}$（其中$l^2=R^2+l_0^2$），在闭合形式下计算能量密度、体积积分和York展开。
AI.result: 该度规在气泡中心为$C^2$光滑，其余区域均光滑；能量密度$E=-(15π/1024)v_s^2 l$（几何单位），且$|ρ_E|$受到常数乘以$v_s^2/l^2$的约束。由于$l$不能低于$l_0$，模型在固定速度下消除了轮廓收缩极限$R\to0$的发散，但这不等同于常规Alcubierre薄壁极限的正则化。
AI.conclusion: 该构造是有效的拟设而非从弦修正场方程推导的结果：$R$是宏观轮廓尺度，$l^2=R^2+l_0^2$是一种插值选择，且经典$l_0\to0$极限保持为光滑厚壁轮廓而非分布式的Alcubierre顶帽形式。奇异物质（exotic matter）仍然必要，且未声明半经典稳定性或修正量子能量不等式。

title: The prey-predator motion of the active droplets
summary: We present a generic solution for the relative motion of two diffusiophoretic prey-predator particles of arbitrary chemical activity Ai and radius Ri, where i = 1;2 refers to the predator and prey, respectively. Using the Lorentz reciprocal theorem, we investigate the impact of radius ratios and chemical reaction rates on the interaction between the particles. Our study reveals four distinct regimes of interaction, similar to the findings of Nasouri & Ramin (Phys. Rev. Lett., vol. 124, 2020, pp. 168003) for particles of identical sizes: (i) the prey particle escapes; (ii) two particles reach a stable equilibrium distance; (iii) two particles reach an unstable equilibrium distance where the prey is captured below it and escapes above it; (iv) the prey particle is captured. Unlike previous work, we differentiate between regimes with near-field and far-field interactions, which can be either attractive or repulsive, and find that the boundary between (i, iii) and (ii, iv) represents the transition from the attraction to repulsion in the far field, given by jA1=A2j = (R2=R1)2, while the transition between (i, ii) and (iii, iv) represents the interaction transition for particles in close proximity. We also perform three-dimensional simulations of prey-predator systems, which validate our theoretical predictions. Our study extends the applicability of the Lorentz reciprocal theorem to prey-predator system and quantitatively obtains interaction regime transition curves by distinguishing near-field and far-field interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用洛伦兹互易定理(Lorentz reciprocal theorem)，为任意化学活性和半径的两种趋化泳(diffusiophoretic)捕食者-猎物粒子提供了相对运动的通用解，识别出四种相互作用状态，并首次区分了近场和远场相互作用，通过三维模拟验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 已有研究(如Nasouri & Ramin, 2020)仅针对相同尺寸粒子的趋化泳捕食者-猎物系统进行了分析，但现实中粒子常具有不同化学活性和半径，且近场与远场相互作用的差异尚未被明确区分，因此需要给出更通用的解。
AI.method: 采用洛伦兹互易定理建立通用解析框架，分析不同半径比(Ri)和化学反应速率对粒子间相互作用的影响；在解析理论基础上，进一步区分近场(near-field)与远场(far-field)的吸引/排斥相互作用；最后通过三维模拟(three-dimensional simulations)验证理论预测。
AI.result: 识别出四种截然不同的相互作用状态：(i) 猎物逃脱；(ii) 两粒子到达稳定平衡距离；(iii) 两粒子到达不稳定平衡距离——猎物在此距离以下被捕获、以上可逃脱；(iv) 猎物被捕获。远场吸引到排斥的转变边界由|A1/A2|=(R2/R1)2给出，该边界对应状态(i,iii)与(ii,iv)之间的分界；而状态(i,ii)与(iii,iv)之间的分界则表征近距粒子间的相互作用转变。三维模拟结果验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将洛伦兹互易定理的应用范围扩展到捕食者-猎物系统，通过区分近场与远场相互作用，定量地获得了相互作用状态的转变曲线，为不同尺寸和化学活性的趋化泳粒子系统提供了通用理论框架。

title: Condensation and Collapse in the Mean-Field Limit of Rotating 2D Bose Gases with Two-Body and Three-Body Interactions
summary: We consider a system of $N$ interacting bosons in a rotating harmonic trap in $\mathbb{R}^2$, where the two-body interaction is attractive and scaled as $N^{2α}U(N^αx)$ with $0<α<1/12$, and the three-body interaction is repulsive and scaled as $N^{4β}W(N^βx,N^βy)$ with $0<β<1/24$. In the mean-field limit, the ground state energy is effectively described by a rotating cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger functional. We analyze the collapse regime where the two-body coupling $a$ approaches the critical value $a_*$ and the three-body coupling $b$ tends to zero. The NLS ground states blow up with a universal profile given by the optimizer of the Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality, and the energy satisfies $E^{\mathrm{NLS}} = (1-ζ/4+o(1))\mathcal{Q}{\rm{pot}}\ell_n^2$ with $ζ\geqslant0$ determined by the relative rates of $a_n\to a_*$ and $b_n\searrow0$. From the many-body theory, we rigorously justify this effective description: the quantum ground state energy converges to the NLS energy with the same asymptotic expansion in the collapse regime, and the many-body ground states exhibit complete Bose-Einstein condensation onto the universal blow-up profile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旋转谐振捕获阱中吸引相互作用的玻色子系统的基态能量与波函数。在位力平均场极限下，能量由旋转三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函描述；在双体耦合趋近临界值、三体耦合趋零的坍缩区间，NLS基态以Gagliardo-Nirenberg不等式优化子给出的普适轮廓发生爆破解，且多体量子基态能量收敛至NLS能量，基态展现出完全的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。
AI.motivation: 理解旋转势阱中吸引性玻色子系统的坍缩物理机制，并严格论证平均场有效描述在多体层面的合理性。
AI.method: 在R²中考虑N个相互作用玻色子，双体吸引力按N^{2α}U(N^αx)（0<α<1/12）缩放，三体排斥力按N^{4β}W(...)（0<β<1/24）缩放；分析双体耦合a→a_*与三体耦合b→0的坍缩极限，借助Gagliardo-Nirenberg不等式建立NLS基态爆破解的普适轮廓，并与多体理论结果进行比较。
AI.result: NLS基态能量满足E^{NLS}=(1-ζ/4+o(1))Q^{pot}ℓ_n²的渐近展开，其中ζ≥0由a_n→a_*与b_n↘0的相对速率决定；多体量子基态能量收敛至NLS能量并具有相同渐近展开，多体基态表现出对普适爆破解轮廓的完全玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose-Einstein condensation）。
AI.conclusion: 严格证明了平均场NLS理论在坍缩区间对多体系统基态能量与凝聚性质的有效描述，表明旋转谐振势阱中的吸引玻色子系统在临界耦合附近遵循具有普适爆破解轮廓的NLS标度律。

title: Likelihood-Based Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in CMS Dijet Events
summary:
We present an unsupervised search for anomalous dijet events in proton--proton collision data using neural spline flow density estimation. A normalizing flow model is trained on a high-dimensional feature space comprising jet, dijet, and event-level observables to learn the dominant Standard Model background directly from data, without assuming a specific signal hypothesis. Events assigned low likelihood under the learned density are identified as potential anomalous events.
  Using this approach on a CMS Open Data dijet sample, we investigate extreme events in the tail of the anomaly-score distribution and perform an extensive validation and robustness study. This study includes feature-level statistical comparisons, mass decorrelation tests, permutation-based null tests, and evaluations of training stability. The selected anomalous events exhibit notable departures from the background-only expectation, primarily in jet-substructure observables, while remaining stable under several known sources of bias in unsupervised learning.
  The identified anomalies are distributed across the kinematic phase space and do not exhibit a narrow structure in the dijet invariant-mass spectrum. Instead, they show correlated deviations across multiple observables, consistent with a multivariate difference in jet substructure and event topology rather than a localized resonance. While no claim of new physics is made, this study demonstrates that neural spline flow-based density estimation can be sensitive to rare, structured deviations in collider data and may provide a model-independent exploratory tool for searches for physics beyond the Standard Model at the LHC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经样条流（neural spline flow）密度估计的无监督搜索方法，用于在质子-质子对撞数据中探测反常双喷注事件。该方法在CMS开放数据上训练模型学习标准模型背景分布，识别出与背景存在多变量关联偏差的异常事件，展示了作为无模型依赖的新物理探索工具的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统的对撞机数据搜索往往依赖于特定的信号假设（signal hypothesis），难以探测超出预期理论框架的未知新物理。本文旨在开发一种模型无关（model-independent）的无监督方法，能够直接从数据中学习背景分布并探测稀有、结构化偏差。
AI.method: 利用神经样条流（normalizing flow）在由喷注（jet）、双喷注系统（dijet）及事件级观测量构成的高维特征空间上进行密度估计，直接学习标准模型（Standard Model）背景分布；低似然事件的尾部被识别为潜在异常候选，并通过特征统计比较、质量去关联测试（mass decorrelation test）、置换零检验（permutation-based null test）和训练稳定性评估进行鲁棒性验证。
AI.result: 在CMS开放数据双喷注样本中，选定异常事件与纯背景预期存在显著偏差，主要体现于喷注子结构（jet-substructure）观测量上，并在无监督学习的已知偏差源下保持稳定。异常事件分布在整个运动学相空间，双喷注不变质量谱中未呈现窄结构，而是表现为多个观测量上的关联性偏离。
AI.conclusion: 本研究不声称发现新物理，但证明基于神经样条流的密度估计能对对撞机数据中稀有且结构化的偏差保持敏感，可作为一种探索超出标准模型（physics beyond the Standard Model）的模型无关工具用于大型强子对撞机（LHC）搜索。

title: Equation of State of a Strongly Coupled Perfect Fluid with Spin from Holography
summary: We derive the equation of state of a strongly coupled relativistic perfect fluid with finite spin in $2+1$ dimensions using holography. The dual gravitational description is provided by a spinning black hole in $AdS_4$, whose Hawking temperature, angular velocity, and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy determine the thermodynamic properties of the boundary fluid. We obtain the equation of state and analyze its local thermodynamic stability, finding a critical rotation above which the fluid becomes thermodynamically unstable providing a bound for the rotation of a strongly coupled quark gluon plasma at temperature $T$ and angular velocity $ω$ given by $\frac{4πT}ω> 2.77239$. Remarkably, the same gravitational solution contains a second black hole associated with a second boundary. Although this black hole is non-spinning, its dual fluid rotates and possesses a distinct, ``exotic'' equation of state. Our results provide a holographic equation of state for strongly coupled matter with finite spin and establish a direct connection between black-hole rotation, intrinsic angular momentum, and the thermodynamic stability of relativistic fluids.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全息原理（holography）导出了2+1维强耦合相对论性完美流体在有限自旋（finite spin）条件下的状态方程，其引力对偶为AdS_4中的旋转黑洞。研究发现存在一个临界旋转速度，超过该速度流体将变得热力学不稳定，为玻色子凝聚态的相关旋转给出界限；同一引力解还包含一个非旋转但双流体旋转的第二黑洞，对应一种"奇异"状态方程。
AI.motivation: 强耦合相对论流体的有限自旋性质及其热力学稳定性是尚待澄清的课题，现有全息框架尚未系统给出带自旋流体在2+1维的状态方程。作者希望借助旋转黑洞的引力对偶，填补这一空白并探索自旋与热力学稳定性的内在联系。
AI.method: 采用全息对偶方法，将2+1维强耦合相对论性流体在有限自旋下的热力学性质映射为AdS_4中的旋转黑洞解；利用黑洞的Hawking温度、角速度与Bekenstein-Hawking熵确定边界流体的热力学量，进而导出状态方程并分析其局部热力学稳定性。
AI.result: 获得了有限自旋流体在2+1维的状态方程，并发现当无量纲比值4πT/ω小于约2.77239时，体系失去热力学稳定性，从而给出强耦合夸克-胶子等离子体旋转的上界。此外，同一引力解中还发现第二个非旋转黑洞对应另一个边界，其对偶流体虽不随黑洞自旋却旋转，并表现出截然不同的"奇异"状态方程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为强耦合带自旋物质提供了全息的状态方程，建立起黑洞旋转、内在角动量与相对论流体热力学稳定性之间的直接联系，并对夸克-胶子等离子体可允许的旋转角速度给出明确约束。

title: The Einstein Tensor from UV-regulated Field Correlations
summary: It is known that the spacetime metric can be recovered from quantum-field correlators. We extend this programme by showing that the Einstein tensor can be directly written in terms of UV-regulated field correlations. The same correlation structure also directly determines the Ricci tensor, while higher coincidence derivatives recover the connection and Riemann tensor. We further show that the renormalized stress-energy tensor can be formulated within this framework, up to the standard finite renormalization freedom. These results provide a correlation-based organization of the semiclassical Einstein equations and advance the programme of formulating spacetime geometry in terms of quantum field correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文证明爱因斯坦张量可直接表示为紫外正则化场关联（UV-regulated field correlations）的函数，相关关联结构还能确定里奇张量，高阶重合导数可恢复联络与黎曼张量。研究进一步将重整化应力-能量张量纳入该框架（保留标准有限重整化自由度），从而以量子场关联为基础组织半经典爱因斯坦方程。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明时空度规可从量子场关联子（quantum-field correlators）中恢复，本文旨在将该纲领扩展至更丰富的几何结构，探索直接从场关联出发构造爱因斯坦张量及完整几何量。
AI.method: 通过紫外正则化场关联直接表达爱因斯坦张量，利用相同关联结构确定里奇张量，并采用高阶重合导数（higher coincidence derivatives）恢复联络和黎曼张量；在有限重整化自由度标准框架内表述重整化应力-能量张量。
AI.result: 证明了爱因斯坦张量、里奇张量、联络与黎曼张量均可在统一框架下由量子场关联结构直接确定，且重整化应力-能量张量也可在此框架内构成，仅受标准有限重整化自由度（finite renormalization freedom）约束。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种以量子场关联为基础组织半经典爱因斯坦方程（semiclassical Einstein equations）的方案，推进了以量子场关联表述时空几何这一研究方向。

title: A Reduced-Order Dynamical Model for the Ignition of Diver-Induced Cohesive Silt-Out on Sloping Beds
summary: A downward fin thrust near a cohesive seabed lofts sediment. Whether this cloud settles or organizes into a self-sustaining down-slope current determines if a diver loses visibility briefly or catastrophically. We reduce the layer-averaged balances of fluid mass, sediment mass, and momentum to a temporal slab of fixed thickness in the weakly entraining limit. This yields an autonomous planar vector field in dimensionless near-bed speed and suspended load, governed by three dimensionless groups: drag against settling, erosion strength, and near-bed concentration. The field possesses a quiescent equilibrium at the origin and, above a critical bed slope obtained in closed form as the ratio of near-bed concentration times drag-settling number to erosion-strength number, an interior saddle equilibrium. The saddle's stable manifold partitions the state space into basins of decay and unbounded growth, establishing the exact threshold between self-limiting and igniting disturbances. On a flat bed, the origin attracts globally for all admissible erosion laws. For representative silt, the ignition threshold is near a 17-degree bed angle. The closed-form structure is confirmed numerically to machine precision. A closure study demonstrates the critical slope is robust in existence but closure-dependent in value, identifying the linear erosion law as the conservative choice. The model thus isolates bed slope as the controlling parameter for ignition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究近底向下的推力（downward fin thrust）附近黏性海床（cohesive seabed）扬起沉积物后，悬浮云是沉降还是自发组织成自持续性顺坡流的问题。作者将流体质量、沉积物质量和动量的层平均平衡在弱夹带极限下约化为固定厚度的瞬时段模型，得到一个由三个无量纲数控制的自治平面向量场。该场在原点存在静息平衡态，并在超过临界床面坡度（以闭式给出）时出现内部鞍点平衡态，鞍点的稳定流形将状态空间分割为衰减与无界增长两个盆地，从而精确刻画自限扰动与点火扰动的阈值。代表性粉砂的临界坡度接近17度，模型数值验证到机器精度，闭合方案研究表明临界坡度的存在是稳健的，但数值依赖闭合选择，线性侵蚀律为保守选择。
AI.motivation: 理解近底推力扰动扬起沉积物后，悬浮云是快速沉降恢复（短暂失去能见度）还是演化为自持续顺坡流（灾难性后果），对潜水安全等实际应用至关重要。现有模型未能在弱夹带极限下给出有限的自治平面向量场，也无法精确刻画点火（ignition）与衰减之间的阈值。
AI.method: 将流体质量、沉积物质量与动量的层平均平衡（layer-averaged balance）在弱夹带极限下约化为固定厚度的瞬时段，得到以无量纲近底速度和悬浮载荷为状态变量的自治平面向量场。系统由三个无量纲数支配：阻力-沉降数（drag-settling number）、侵蚀强度数（erosion strength）和近底浓度。通过向量场的定性分析（原点平衡态的稳定性与闭式临界床面坡度）获得分岔条件，并以数值方法验证闭式结果至机器精度。
AI.result: 原点为静息平衡态；当床面坡度超过闭式给出的临界值——近底浓度乘以阻力-沉降数再除以侵蚀强度数——时，系统出现内部鞍点平衡态。鞍点的稳定流形将状态空间划分为衰减盆地与无界增长盆地，给出点火与自限扰动的精确阈值。平坦床面上原点是全局吸引子（对所有允许的侵蚀律成立）。代表性粉砂（silt）的临界床面坡度约为17度。闭式结果在数值上验证至机器精度；闭合方案研究表明临界坡度在存在性上是稳健的，但数值依赖闭合选择，线性侵蚀律为保守选择。
AI.conclusion: 床面坡度被隔离为点火过程的控制参数。该模型提供了顺坡自持续流动起火临界条件的闭式刻画，指出线性侵蚀律为保守设计选择，并强调临界坡度的存在性对闭合方案具有鲁棒性。

title: Novel computational formulas and relations for special numbers and functions: approach to analysis of Debye functions
summary: The first goal of this paper is to give a new family of special function related to the Debye functions. By using these function and generating function method, we derive many novel formulas and relations involving the Debye functions, multiple Hurwitz Lerch zeta function which interpolate the Apostol-Bernoulli numbers of higher order at negative integers. Proof method of theorems in this paper are different from those of theory of analytic numbers. The second goal of this paper is to show that special values and integral presentations of this function are closely related to unification of the Debye functions, the moment generating function for the negative binom distribution, the generating functions for the Apostol-type numbers of higher-order, and the Frobenius-Euler numbers, the Bernoulli numbers, and the Stirling numbers etc. Moreover, we give recurrence relations, Maclaurin's series expansion, and approximation formula for unification of the Debye functions. Finally, we give further remarks, observations and applications in mathematical physics on the results of this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文引入一族与德拜函数（Debye function）相关的新特殊函数，通过生成函数（generating function）方法推导出多个新颖公式，并展示了这些特殊值及积分表达式与德拜函数、负二项分布矩生成函数、高阶Apostol型数、Frobenius-Euler数、Bernoulli数和Stirling数等之间的深刻联系，还给出了递推关系、Maclaurin级数展开及近似公式。
AI.motivation: 论文的首要目标是构造一族与德拜函数相关的新特殊函数，以揭示该函数族与多种数论特殊函数（如多变量Hurwitz-Lerch zeta函数、Apostol-Bernoulli数等）之间的关联。该研究的证明方法不同于解析数论理论的既有路径，旨在为相关领域提供新的分析工具。
AI.method: 通过引入新定义的德拜函数族，采用生成函数方法证明定理。该方法不依赖于解析数论（analytic number theory）的理论框架。文中还推导了该函数族的递推关系、Maclaurin级数展开（Maclaurin series expansion）和近似公式（approximation formula）。
AI.result: 证明该新函数族的特殊值与积分表示与多种已知特殊对象紧密相关，包括德拜函数族的统一、负二项分布（negative binomial distribution）的矩生成函数（moment generating function）、高阶Apostol型数的生成函数、Frobenius-Euler数、Bernoulli数及Stirling数等。
AI.conclusion: 论文最后给出关于结果的进一步注记、观察以及数学物理（mathematical physics）中的应用，表明该新特殊函数族具有跨领域的潜在应用价值。

title: Neutron detector response modeling in NOvA
summary: Neutrons can present a significant challenge for neutrino experiments in which energy reconstruction is critical. With the ability to escape detection completely and with a weak correlation between their kinetic energy and any eventual energy deposition, it is difficult to fully account for neutrons produced in neutrino interactions. This in turn leads to significant model dependence when evaluating neutron-related systematic uncertainties. The NOvA experiment is a long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiment with a high-statistics sample of antineutrino data collected by its near detector. We report an excess relative to data of simulated neutron candidates with low energy depositions when using standard Geant4 physics lists. The simulation excess is traced to an overabundance of secondary photons produced from interactions of neutrons with kinetic energy greater than \SI{20}{\mega\eV}. Improved agreement with data is obtained by applying the data-driven neutron-on-carbon \menate model for neutrons between \SI{20}{\mega\eV} and ${\sim}$\SI{100}{\mega\eV}. With \menate, the residual oversimulation is more uniform across the calorimetric neutron energy spectrum, suggesting possible overproduction of primary neutrons by the GENIE neutrino interaction generator. These results motivate the adoption of \menate-supplemented Geant4 simulation as the nominal simulation in the production of future \nova simulation.

AI.tldr: NOvA实验发现，在反中微子数据分析中，使用标准Geant4物理列表模拟会产生相对数据而言过多的低能量沉积中子候选事件，该过剩源于动能超过20 MeV的中子与探测器材料相互作用产生的次级光子过多。通过采用数据驱动的中子-碳(MENATE)模型对20至~100 MeV动能范围内的中子进行修正，模拟与数据的一致性得到显著改善，残余过度模拟在量热中子能谱上变得更均匀，提示GENIE中微子产生器可能过度产生了初级中子。
AI.motivation: 中子在能量重建中可能完全逃避探测，且其动能与最终能量沉积之间的关联较弱，导致难以完整考虑中微子相互作用中产生的中子影响，进而使中子相关系统不确定性的评估具有显著的模型依赖性。因此需要改进中子模拟的准确性。
AI.method: 利用NOvA实验近探测器收集的高统计量反中微子数据样本，将标准Geant4物理列表的中子模拟结果与实验数据进行比较，并应用数据驱动的中子-碳(MENATE)模型对动能20至~100 MeV区间内的中子相互作用进行修正。
AI.result: 发现标准Geant4模拟相对数据存在低能量沉积的中子候选事件过剩，该过剩源于动能大于20 MeV的中子相互作用产生的次级光子过多。应用MENATE模型后，模拟与数据的吻合度显著改善，残余过度模拟在量热中子能谱上分布更为均匀。
AI.conclusion: 结果提示GENIE中微子相互作用产生器可能存在初级中子过度产生问题，并支持将MENATE补充的Geant4模拟作为未来NOvA模拟生产的标称模拟方案。

title: Birth and Death in Two-color ABJM
summary: We solve exactly the leading quantum deformation of the two-point metric of half-BPS operators in $U(2)\times U(2)$ ABJM theory at finite rank. In the natural coupling-independent Schur frame, its tree-normalized two-loop correction is a Jacobi operator on the chain of two-row Young diagrams. A ground-state transform maps it to a reversible birth--death process whose stationary distribution is the Plancherel measure conditioned on diagrams with at most two rows. Its eigenmodes are Racah polynomials, its large-$n$ limit approaches radial Ornstein--Uhlenbeck dynamics, and an equivalent two-spin description identifies the Jacobi operator with a restricted $SU(2)$ Casimir.

AI.tldr: 本文精确求解了有限秩$U(2)\times U(2)$ ABJM理论中半BPS算符两点度规的前导量子形变。在耦合无关的Schur框架中，其树级归一化的两圈修正表现为两行杨图链上的雅可比算子（Jacobi operator），并通过基态变换映射为可逆生灭过程（birth–death process），其平稳分布为限制在至多两行图上的Plancherel测度。该算子的本征模为Racah多项式，大$n$极限趋近于径向Ornstein–Uhlenbeck动力学，等价两自旋描述将其识别为受限$SU(2)$ Casimir。
AI.motivation: 研究ABJM理论中半BPS算符两点函数在有限秩下的量子修正，特别是前导形变结构的精确求解。
AI.method: 选取自然且耦合无关的Schur框架，通过基态变换将两圈修正对应的雅可比算子映射为可逆生灭过程，并借助Racah多项式刻画其本征模，再利用两自旋描述建立与$SU(2)$ Casimir的联系。
AI.result: 两圈修正算子等价于两行杨图链上的雅可比算子，其平稳分布为受限Plancherel测度；大$n$极限给出径向Ornstein–Uhlenbeck动力学，且该算子可识别为受限$SU(2)$ Casimir。
AI.conclusion: 通过精确的代数映射，ABJM半BPS两点度规的量子修正获得了完整的谱与动力学描述，揭示了其与可积随机过程及李代数表示论之间的深层联系。

title: End state of the experimental black-hole bomb
summary: Rotating black holes can amplify incident waves through superradiant scattering. When these waves are confined, repeated amplification gives rise to the black-hole bomb instability, whose nonlinear evolution remains poorly understood despite its central role in models of bosonic clouds around astrophysical black holes. Here, we reproduce the black-hole bomb mechanism in a laboratory setting using a gravity simulator based on a draining vortex in superfluid helium. Surface waves propagating on the superfluid interface experience an effective rotating spacetime and undergo repeated superradiant amplification within a cylindrical cavity. By tuning the temperature and flow parameters, we achieve exponential growth of a low-frequency resonant mode, followed by the arrest of the instability and the formation of a long-lived non-equilibrium steady state. Using spatially and temporally resolved measurements, we identify nonlinear frequency shifts, harmonic generation, and coherent three- and four-wave mixing that redistribute energy among interacting modes. This novel end state of the experimental black-hole bomb highlights the role of nonlinear wave interactions in quenching the runaway growth expected from linear theory and governing the system's late-time dynamics. Our results establish a laboratory framework for investigating the nonlinear evolution of black-hole bombs, with implications for analogous phenomena involving ultralight bosonic fields around rotating black holes.

AI.tldr: 本文在超流氦中的排水涡旋这一重力模拟器内，首次在实验室复现了黑洞炸弹（black-hole bomb）机制，观察到非线性频率位移、谐波产生以及三波和四波混频等相互作用，使不稳定的指数增长趋于停滞并形成长寿命的非平衡稳态，从而为研究黑洞炸弹的非线性演化提供了实验框架。
AI.motivation: 旋转黑洞可通过超辐射散射（superradiant scattering）放大入射波，而波被约束时反复放大会引发黑洞炸弹不稳定性；尽管这一不稳定性在描述天体物理黑洞周围玻色子云模型中至关重要，但其非线性演化至今未能被深入理解。
AI.method: 研究使用基于超流氦中排水涡旋的重力模拟器构建有效旋转时空；超流体界面上传播的表面波在圆柱腔体内经历反复超辐射放大，并通过调节温度与流动参数来实现不稳定性的产生与调控；结合空间与时间分辨测量，分析非线性波间相互作用。
AI.result: 实验实现了低频共振模式的指数增长，随后不稳定性被抑制并形成长寿命的非平衡稳态；高分辨率测量识别出非线性频率位移、谐波产生以及相干的三波和四波混频，这些过程在相互作用模式之间重新分配能量。
AI.conclusion: 非线性波相互作用在抑制线性理论预期的失控增长以及主导系统后期动力学中起关键作用；该实验结果建立了研究黑洞炸弹非线性演化的实验室框架，并可用于类比旋转黑洞周围超轻玻色子场的类似现象。

title: A Heterogeneous General Model for Neuromorphic-Inspired Computation
summary: In recent years, both academia and industry have focused on the development of computational architectures inspired by the distributed, adaptive, and event-driven characteristics of biological neural systems, with the aim of reducing the computational cost associated with conventional training approaches [1]. However, a major challenge is the lack of general models and design guidelines for emerging computational systems and hardware. This work introduces a general model based on an input-dependent stochastic weight network, referred to as a substrate. The substrate weights evolve through input-triggered stochastic updates, with correlations between weight coefficients described by a matrix-valued covariance kernel. The proposed framework is implemented using quadratic polynomial weight functions, where the input amplitude controls the magnitude of the stochastic perturbation and a substrate-dependent distance determines the correlation structure. Numerical simulations show that correlations in the stochastic weight evolution significantly affect the system response, suggesting a potential mechanism for neuromorphic-inspired computation without conventional weight training. The aim of this work is to provide a general formulation of the model and identify its main properties and characteristics. 1 H. Jaeger, Towards a generalized theory comprising digital, neuromorphic and unconventional computing, Neuromorphic Comput. Eng., vol. 1, no. 1, p. 012002, Sep. 2021

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于输入依赖的随机权重网络（称为"衬底"，substrate）的一般模型，权重通过输入触发的随机更新演化，其相关性由矩阵值协方差核描述。数值模拟表明随机权重演化中的相关性显著影响系统响应，为无需传统权重训练的神经形态启发计算（neuromorphic-inspired computation）提供潜在机制。
AI.motivation: 学术界和工业界近年来关注受生物神经系统分布式、自适应及事件驱动特征启发的计算架构，以降低传统训练方法的计算成本。然而，当前缺乏适用于新兴计算系统和硬件的通用模型与设计准则，这构成了本研究的主要动机。
AI.method: 引入一种基于输入依赖随机权重网络的一般模型，称为衬底。衬底权重通过输入触发的随机更新演化，权重系数间的相关性由矩阵值协方差核（matrix-valued covariance kernel）描述。框架采用二次多项式权重函数实现，其中输入幅度控制随机扰动的量级，衬底依赖的距离决定相关结构。
AI.result: 数值模拟表明，随机权重演化中的相关性对系统响应具有显著影响，提示了一种无需传统权重训练的神经形态启发计算的可能机制。
AI.conclusion: 本工作的目的是提供该模型的一般表述，并识别其主要性质与特征，为新兴计算系统的建模和设计提供理论框架。

title: Commutative Factorization of Nonlinear Second-Order Differential Equations: Theory and Applications
summary: This work presents a generalization of the commutative factorization framework for a broad class of second-order nonlinear ordinary differential equations. The main objective was to extend the commutative factorization procedure in order to use the Riccati-Bernoulli equation and the Bäcklund transformation. This provides a systematic route for constructing both particular and general solutions of the original second-order nonlinear equation. The theoretical development is illustrated through several nonlinear models of physical and mathematical interest, including equations arising in classical mechanics and nonlinear oscillatory systems. The results demonstrate that commutative factorization constitutes an effective analytical tool for solving nonlinear differential equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种交换分解（commutative factorization）框架的推广，将之应用于一大类二阶非线性常微分方程，通过引入Riccati-Bernoulli方程和Bäcklund变换，为构造原方程的特解与通解提供了系统性途径，并以若干经典力学与非线性振动系统模型加以验证。
AI.motivation: 现有交换分解方法适用范围有限，难以直接处理更广泛的二阶非线性常微分方程，本文旨在推广该框架以扩展其可解方程类别。
AI.method: 推广了交换分解程序，引入Riccati-Bernoulli方程与Bäcklund变换作为分解工具，从而系统地构造原二阶非线性方程的特解和通解。
AI.result: 通过多个具有物理与数学意义的非线性模型（包括经典力学和一类非线性振荡系统中的方程）进行示例说明，验证了该方法的有效性与广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，交换分解是求解非线性微分方程的一种有效解析工具，可为相关领域提供新的求解途径。

title: Leakage current evolution in LHCb VELO sensors during Run 1-2 LHC data taking period
summary: Silicon detectors operating in the harsh mixed-hadron radiation environment of modern high-energy physics experiments suffer progressive bulk damage, manifesting macroscopically as a steady rise in leakage current.

AI.tldr: 本文研究硅探测器在强子混合辐射环境中因体损伤（bulk damage）导致的漏电流（leakage current）持续上升问题。
AI.motivation: 现代高能物理实验中的硅探测器工作在严酷的混合强子辐射环境中，承受持续的累积体损伤，宏观表现为漏电流的稳步上升，影响探测器性能。
AI.method: 摘要中未提及具体研究方法。
AI.result: 摘要中未提及具体研究结果。
AI.conclusion: 硅探测器的体损伤在宏观上表现为漏电流的持续上升，是其在恶劣辐射环境中运行面临的关键问题。

title: Searching for Bell-CHSH-Violating Bose Operators
summary: We construct explicit bounded wedge-local observables for Bell inequalities in a relativistic free Bose field using an exact spectral-fibre approach. The construction turns the relevant canonical pair into measurable fibre involutions and provides an operator-algebraic proof of wedge locality, self-adjointness, unitarity, and exact anticommutation. Translation-cell observables yield an explicit Bell violation with a controlled infinite-tail error, while inclusion of reflection branches produces a substantially larger violation. These results demonstrate that simple bounded local observables can expose Bell nonlocality constructively in relativistic quantum field theory and that the translation-cell result is not artifact but a strictly valid lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文在相对论性自由玻色场中，通过精确谱族（spectral fibre）方法构造了用于贝尔不等式（Bell inequalities）的有界楔形局域可观测算符，并以算子代数方式证明了楔形局域性、自伴性、幺正性及精确反正对易关系，最终给出了显式的贝尔不等式违反（Bell violation）证据。
AI.motivation: 在相对论量子场论中，能否用简单且有界的局域可观测算符来构造性地揭示贝尔非局域性（Bell nonlocality），是一个基本的理论问题。此前缺乏显式且严格可验证的构造方案。
AI.method: 采用精确谱族方法，将相关的正则对（canonical pair）转化为可测的纤维对合（fibre involution），构建有界的楔形局域可观测算符。通过平移单胞（translation-cell）可观测算符实现贝尔不等式违反，并同时纳入反射分支（reflection branches）以增强违反幅度。
AI.result: 构造的算符满足楔形局域性、自伴性、幺正性与精确反正对易关系，获得了带受控无穷尾误差的显式贝尔违反；纳入反射分支后违反幅度显著增大，且平移单胞结果被证明是严格有效的下界而非人为产物。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，简单有界的局域可观测算符即可在相对论量子场论中构造性地揭示贝尔非局域性，为量子场论中贝尔不等式的有界算子实现提供了严格基础。

title: A compact time-frequency representation for gravitational-wave data analysis
summary: Time-frequency (wavelet) domain analyses are seeing greater use for gravitational-wave data analysis due to the advantages they have in handling non-stationary noise. A popular choice is the Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer (WDM) wavelet transform, which uses a window function that is very compact in frequency, but more spread out in time. In this work, we consider an alternative window function that is built from a sum of phase-shifted Gaussians. This "Gaussian" window is more symmetric in time-frequency, and consequently more compact. We examine the properties of this window function and the implications it has for gravitational-wave analyses. We calculate the window's time-frequency variance product analytically and verify it numerically. For the symmetric case, where the window has the same form in time and frequency, the construction comes within $\sim2.4\%$ of saturating the Heisenberg-Gabor uncertainty limit. We conjecture that this Gaussian window achieves the minimum time-frequency area of any WD wavelet window.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于相位平移高斯函数叠加构造的窗口函数，替代传统Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer（WDM）小波变换中频率紧凑但时间扩展的窗函数，该高斯窗在时频域上更对称且更紧凑，其时频方差积在对称情形下接近饱和海森堡-加伯不确定极限（偏差约2.4%），作者推测该窗口在所有WD小波窗口中获得最小时频面积。
AI.motivation: 引力波数据分析中，时频（小波）域分析因处理非平稳噪声的优势而日益重要；WDM小波变换虽广为使用，但其窗口函数在频率上紧凑而时间上延展，存在优化空间。
AI.method: 构造一种由多个相位平移高斯函数叠加而成的"高斯"窗口函数，使其在时频平面上更对称、更紧凑；从解析角度计算该窗口的时频方差乘积，并通过数值方法加以验证。
AI.result: 在对称情形下（窗函数在时间与频率上具有相同形式），该构造以约2.4%的偏差接近饱和海森堡-加伯（Heisenberg-Gabor）不确定极限；基于此结果提出猜想，该高斯窗口达到任意WD小波窗口的最小时频面积。
AI.conclusion: 这种时间频率更紧凑的窗口函数有望改善引力波数据分析的时频分辨率，其接近理论极限的性质为WD小波变换性能的进一步提升提供了可能。

title: Tilt control of coverage heterogeneity for hard spherocylinders locked on a sphere
summary: We study hard spherocylinders on a sphere with axes rigidly locked to a tangential director field at fixed angle $\tilt$ to the meridian, necessarily singular at the poles. Three lengths set the problem: the rod length $\Lrod$, the diameter $\Drod$, and the host radius $\Rsph$. Monte Carlo simulations across fifteen geometries and four coverages give two main results for the polar marginal, the azimuthal average of rod-center density. First, the tilt is a continuous handle on the width of the depleted region that packing induces around each singularity. Under meridian locking it is set principally by the rod length; turning the director toward the latitude contracts it substantially, the contraction being spent well before latitude locking. Second, how uniform the polar marginal can be made is limited by geometry, not tilt. The smallest variance on the sampled grid follows a power law in $\Lrod^{2}/(\Rsph\Drod)$, which measures how far a straight rod's ends stand off the curved surface in rod diameters, with an effective exponent between $1.1$ and $1.3$. Long rods on small hosts cannot be made uniform at any sampled tilt; the remedy is geometric, not orientational. The polar marginal is equator-heavy almost everywhere, inverting only at high coverage and tilt; meridian locking is the least uniform choice, and the variance-minimizing tilt usually lies in a sampled band from $31.7^{\circ}$ to $55^{\circ}$. The golden-ratio tilt $\arctan(1/\phigold)$ is one of those angles: a benchmark, not one the model selects. Both results describe the infinitely locked athermal ensemble.

AI.tldr: 论文通过蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）模拟研究球面上刚性锁定向列场中硬球柱体（hard spherocylinders）的堆积行为，考察了十五种几何构型和四种覆盖率，核心发现包括：倾角可连续调控极区边缘（polar marginal）耗尽区域宽度，但其宽度主要由棒长决定；极区边缘的均匀性受几何限制而非倾角限制，最小方差随(Lrod²)/(Rsph·Drod)呈幂律衰减，指数介于1.1到1.3之间。
AI.motivation: 球面上的刚性锁定向列场（director field）在极点必然产生向错奇异性，研究者希望理解棒状粒子堆积对极区附近密度分布的影响机制，以及几何参数和取向参数对密度均匀性的相对贡献，从而解析球面受限液晶系统的结构原理。
AI.method: 研究者将硬球柱体置于球面上，其轴向被刚性锁定在切向向列场中，与子午线的固定倾角为tilt角。通过在十五种不同几何条件和四种覆盖率下进行蒙特卡洛模拟，追踪极区边缘（latitudinal平均的棒心密度）的分布特征，并系统扫描倾角以寻找方差最小化构型。
AI.result: 结果显示：(1) 倾角可连续控制奇点周围堆叠耗尽区域的宽度，在子午线锁定下主要由棒长决定，向纬度方向转动会显著压缩该区域；(2) 极区边缘均匀性受几何而非倾角限制，最小方差随Lrod²/(Rsph·Drod)呈幂律衰减，有效指数介于1.1与1.3之间；(3) 极区边缘几乎全域呈现赤道偏重，仅在覆盖率与倾角均高时反转；子午线锁定是均匀性最差的构型，方差最小化倾角通常落在31.7°至55°区间，黄金比例倾角arctan(1/φ)是其中的基准角度而非模型自发选择。
AI.conclusion: 在无限锁定无热系综（athermal ensemble）下，长棒配小宿主球无法通过调倾角实现密度均匀，补救措施本质上是几何性的而非取向性的；倾角提供的调控自由度受限于几何约束，这为球面向列序中奇点附近的密度控制提供了明确的物理边界。

title: A Note on Extended States on the Bethe Lattice
summary: We give a new proof of the existence of absolutely continuous spectrum for the weakly disordered Anderson model on the Bethe lattice. The argument follows a general cyclicity criterion for Anderson-type Hamiltonians and reduces the problem to showing that the spectral measures of two independent copies of the rooted tree are not mutually singular. This is detected by their Hellinger affinity, and the required weak-disorder estimate follows from a short harmonic and compactness argument. We also formulate an analogous quantitative cyclicity criterion for the Anderson model on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, expressed through the Schur complement of the Poisson transform of a $2\times2$ matrix spectral measure.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了Bethe格子上弱无序Anderson模型（weakly disordered Anderson model）绝对连续谱（absolutely continuous spectrum）存在性的新证明，基于循环性判据（cyclicity criterion）将问题归结为两棵独立根树的谱测度非互异奇性，并由Hellinger亲和度结合调和与紧致性论证给出所需弱无序估计。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在为弱无序Anderson模型在Bethe格子上的绝对连续谱存在性提供一种新的证明途径，以替代或补充现有论证，并进一步推广到更高维度结构。
AI.method: 论证遵循针对Anderson型哈密顿量的通用循环性判据，将问题简化为证明两棵独立有根树的谱测度（spectral measures）不互异奇性（mutually singular）；该性质通过其Hellinger亲和度进行检测，所需的弱无序估计由简洁的调和函数与紧致性论证获得。此外还构建了一个适用于Z^d上Anderson模型的定量循环性判据，该判据通过2×2矩阵谱测度的Poisson变换的Schur补表述。
AI.result: 作者成功给出Bethe格子上弱无序Anderson模型绝对连续谱存在性的新证明，并提出了适用于Z^d情形的类比定量循环性判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了循环性方法结合调和分析工具在Anderson模型谱理论研究中的有效性，并为后续在其泛型中验证定量判据提供了潜在方向。

title: GNN-based track reconstruction for MUonE experiment
summary: A study of a Graph Neural Network-based model for track reconstruction in the context of MUonE experiment is presented, using simulated data corresponding to the test-run MUonE detector setup. The fully three dimensional model successfully addresses both the reconstruction and particle identification challenges essential for achieving the experiment's primary physics goal. It provides significantly faster pattern recognition than classical reconstruction algorithms, while maintaining comparable efficiency and resolution.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于图神经网络（Graph Neural Network, GNN）的模型，用于MUonE实验中径迹重建，在三维空间中同时完成径迹重建与粒子识别任务。该模型在保持与经典重建算法相当的效率和分辨率的同时，极大提升了模式识别速度。
AI.motivation: MUonE实验的主要物理目标需要高效且准确的径迹重建与粒子识别，而经典重建算法虽然可靠但模式识别速度较慢，需要一种更高效的三维解决方案。
AI.method: 采用完全三维的图神经网络（Graph Neural Network, GNN）模型，并在对应测试运行MUonE探测器配置的模拟数据上进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 该模型成功同时解决了径迹重建和粒子识别两大挑战；与传统重建算法相比，模式识别速度显著提高，同时重建效率和分辨率保持在可比水平。
AI.conclusion: 基于图神经网络的径迹重建模型在MUonE实验背景下展现出高效、快速的性能，验证了深度学习方法在该实验场景下的可行性与优势。

title: Landau and cluster structures of one-loop amplitudes in ${\mathcal N}=4$ SYM in dimensional regularization
summary: Generalized unitarity, Landau analysis, and cluster adjacency encode complementary aspects of scattering amplitudes. We use one-loop planar $\mathcal N=4$ SYM amplitudes in dimensional regularization, at arbitrary multiplicity and helicity, to make their interface explicit. The weight-two symbol decomposes into an LS part, in which maximal-cut leading singularities furnish the coefficients and Landau loci associated with nested cuts organize the ordered symbol entries, an algebraic four-mass sector, and residual terms. Cancellations of certain letters contributed by individual box integrals, as well as further simplifications, are explained by the two-mass triangle relations among box coefficients. We prove these relations using a BCFW-like application of the global residue theorem and show that they can be understood geometrically as different dissections of the same region in the tree amplituhedron obtained by projecting the loop geometry of a triple cut. We then prove that the full rational symbol, including its infrared-divergent part, obeys cluster adjacency in the flag cluster algebra $\mathrm{Fl}_{2,4;n}$ for all multiplicities and helicities. Within the sector depending only on momentum-twistor four-brackets, we conjecture a stronger cluster property in $\operatorname{Gr}(4,n)$ for all helicities and prove it for NMHV amplitudes: the amplitude admits a representation in which every pole of each coefficient is compatible with both symbol entries. Finally, we observe that the algebraic four-mass letters, although non-rational, exhibit a suggestive Sklyanin-bracket pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究维度正则化下任意多重数和螺旋度的一圈平面N=4超杨-米尔斯（SYM）散射振幅，系统建立了广义幺正性（generalized unitarity）、Landau分析与簇邻接（cluster adjacency）三种视角之间的明确联系。作者证明了完整的ration符号（含红外发散部分）在所有多重数与螺旋度下满足旗簇代数Fl_{2,4;n}中的簇邻接性质，并进一步对NMHV振幅证明了Gr(4,n)中更强的簇性质。
AI.motivation: 广义幺正性、Landau分析（Landau analysis）与簇邻接分别编码了散射振幅的不同互补方面，但三者之间的相互联系此前尚未被系统阐明。本文旨在以具体的一圈平面N=4 SYM振幅为载体，将这三种视角的界面（interface）显式化，并推导框系数之间满足的两质量三角形关系。
AI.method: 作者使用维度正则化（dimensional regularization）下的任意多重数与螺旋度的一圈平面N=4 SYM振幅。他们将权重二符号（weight-two symbol）分解为LS部分（其中最大割主导奇点提供系数，嵌套割相关的Landau轨形组织有序符号条目）、代数四质量扇区及残差项。两质量三角形关系通过对全局留数定理的BCFW式应用加以证明，并揭示其几何意义在于树级amplituhedron中同一区域的不同剖分（对应三重割的圈几何投影）。
AI.result: 获得了以下主要结果：首先，证明了完整的ration符号（包括红外发散部分）对任意多重数与螺旋度均满足旗簇代数Fl_{2,4;n}中的簇邻接性质；其次，在仅依赖动量旋量四括号的扇区内，对所有螺旋度猜想并在NMHV情形证明了Gr(4,n)中更强的簇性质（每个系数的每个极点均与两个符号条目相容）；最后，观察到代数四质量字母虽非有理，但呈现出暗示性的Sklyanin括号（Sklyanin bracket）模式。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过精确的符号级分析，将广义幺正性、Landau分析和簇邻接三种振幅性质在N=4 SYM振幅中建立了清晰的对应与联系。两质量三角形关系的证明与几何解释，以及全螺旋度下簇邻接性质的建立，为更深层理解散射振幅数学结构（包括非有理四质量扇区的代数结构）奠定了基础。

title: Effective Field Theory of Gravity in Relativistic Media
summary: We develop an effective field theory of gravity in relativistic media. Integrating out the medium leaves vacuum gravity with updated Feynman rules: a graviton propagator dressed by the stress-energy two-point function of the environment, medium-induced bulk graviton vertices from higher correlators, and generalized worldline couplings encoded in matched Wilson coefficients. The diagram topologies are unchanged from vacuum, so different media (perfect fluids, collisionless matter, coherent scalar fields such as wave dark matter) are not different theories but different correlators inserted into the same diagrams. We derive the in-medium rules for a relativistic fluid and obtain the full 1PN Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann potential, the 1PN Stokes drag, the gravitational self-energy and a generalized Christodoulou memory whose new tensor structure records the direction of the surrounding flow, turning the permanent strain into an $\textit{astrophysical weathervane}$. The same rules activate phenomena forbidden in vacuum: the sound pole converts the symmetry-protected, non-running black-hole Love number into a resonant, running one, and opens the channel $h\to hh$ in a moving medium, yielding a closed-form decay rate and a birefringent $\textit{gravitational opacity}$ set by the local flow geometry. We assess observational prospects, from dephasing and tidal resonances within reach of the Einstein Telescope and LISA to proof-of-principle memory and opacity signatures.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一套适用于相对论性介质中的引力有效场论（effective field theory），通过将介质自由度积掉，将真空引力更新为带有介质修饰的费曼规则，包括被介质应力-能量两点函数修饰的引力子传播子、介质诱导的体引力顶点以及由匹配威尔逊系数（matched Wilson coefficients）编码的广义世界线耦合。不同介质只是同一套图拓扑中插入的不同关联函数，而非不同的理论。作者对相对论流体进行了详细推导，获得完整的1PN爱因斯坦-因费尔德-霍夫曼（Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann）势、1PN斯托克斯阻力（Stokes drag）、引力自能以及广义的克里斯托杜卢记忆效应（Christodoulou memory），该记忆张量的新结构记录了周围流动方向，使永久应变成为“天体物理学风向标”。同一套规则还激活了真空中被禁止的现象：声学极点（sound pole）将对称性保护的、非演化的黑洞潮汐数（Love number）转变为共振演化的量，并在运动介质中开启 h→hh 衰变通道，获得闭式衰变率和由局域流几何决定的双折射“引力不透明度”（gravitational opacity）。作者评估了从爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope）和LISA可达的失相与潮汐共振到记忆和消散特征的原理论证观测前景。
AI.motivation: 真空中建立起来的引力理论在处理被介质（如完美流体、无碰撞物质、相干标量场——如波暗物质）包围的天体和物理过程时缺乏统一的系统框架；不同介质环境中引力现象（潮汐、记忆效应、引力波传播）需要一种能同时处理介质对引力作用的影响以及介质中激发不同于真空的引力现象的理论工具。
AI.method: 采用有效场论方法，积掉介质自由度后保留真空引力的图拓扑结构，将介质影响编码为：引力子传播子上插入环境应力-能量两点函数、来自更高阶关联函数的介质诱导体引力顶点，以及由匹配的威尔逊系数概括的广义世界线耦合。针对相对论流体推导具体的介质费曼规则。
AI.result: 获得完整的1PN爱因斯坦-因费尔德-霍夫曼势和斯托克斯阻力，计算了引力自能和广义克里斯托杜卢记忆效应（其新的张量结构可用于指示周围流动方向）；发现声学极点使黑洞潮汐数从对称性保护、非演化的性质转变为共振演化的性质，并在运动介质中打开了真空中禁戒的引力子分裂通道 h→hh，获得了闭式衰变率和由局域流几何决定的双折射引力不透明度。
AI.conclusion: 介质中的引力现象与真空引力并非来自于不同理论，而是通过关联函数的替换即可统一描述；声学介质可以激活真空中受对称性保护而被禁戒的过程，并通过潮汐共振、记忆效应和不透明度等信号为爱因斯坦望远镜和LISA等下一代引力波探测器提供新的观测窗口。

title: Electrospun Fields: 3D Nano-Fiber Material Computation as Design Method
comment: 15 pages, 10 figures. Published in Proceedings of the ACM on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques (SIGGRAPH 2026). Open-source hardware and toolpath code: https://github.com/Critical-Matter-MIT-Media-Lab/Custom-3D-Electrospinning
summary:
We present a robotic electrospinning platform and design method for depositing nanofiber membranes onto non-planar, three-dimensional conductive geometries. Conventional electrospinning relies on fixed emitters and planar grounded collectors, which restricts deposition to flat substrates: on concave geometries, field shielding prevents fibers from reaching recessed regions, and material bridges across elevated features instead. We address this with a custom end-effector integrated with a six-axis UR20 arm. The tool carries a localized stepper-driven syringe pump that maintains consistent polymer flow independent of orientation, and routes high-voltage DC (up to 25 kV) directly to a robot-mounted needle, turning the arm into a mobile emitter with full kinematic control over position, orientation, working distance, and traversal velocity. Toolpaths that continuously reorient the emitter along surface normals give access to concave topologies unreachable by fixed-axis systems.
  We characterize the resulting deposition behavior in two parts. A catalog of four bio-compatible polymer systems (PEO, PVA, keratin-PEO, silk-PEO) establishes the operating envelope, reporting deposition speed, jet stability, fiber size, alignment, and durability for each. A taxonomy of 3D-printed conductive scaffolds spanning geometric primitives, hybrid compositions, and square, triangular, and hexagonal lattices links collector geometry to fiber alignment, density, and cross-void bridging. We also demonstrate programmable grounding, in which selectively energized pins in an array steer deposition without changing physical geometry. Assembly instructions and toolpath-generation code are released as an open-source repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种机器人静电纺丝（robotic electrospinning）平台与设计方法，能够将纳米纤维膜沉积到非平面的三维导电几何体上。该平台将微型步进驱动注射泵与六轴UR20机械臂集成，使发射器可沿表面法线连续重新定向，从而覆盖固定轴系统无法触及的凹形拓扑结构。研究还表征了四种生物相容性聚合物的沉积行为，建立了三维打印导电支架的几何分类体系，并展示了可编程接地技术。
AI.motivation: 传统静电纺丝（electrospinning）依赖固定发射器和平面接地收集器，只能将纤维沉积在平坦基底上；对于凹形几何体，场屏蔽效应使纤维无法到达凹陷区域，而在凸起特征上则会出现材料桥接问题。作者旨在解决这些限制，实现纳米纤维膜在非平面三维导电几何体上的可控沉积。
AI.method: 方法的核心是定制末端执行器与六轴UR20机械臂的集成：该工具携带一个由步进电机驱动的局部注射泵，可在任意方位保持聚合物流动的一致性，并将高压直流电（最高25 kV）直接输送到机械臂安装的针头，使机械臂成为具有完整运动学控制能力的移动发射器。工具路径可使发射器沿表面法线连续重新定向，从而接触到固定轴系统无法达到的凹形拓扑构型。
AI.result: 研究分两部分表征沉积行为：其一，建立了四种生物相容性聚合物体系（PEO、PVA、角蛋白-PEO、丝素-PEO）的操作包络，报告了各自的沉积速度、射流稳定性、纤维尺寸、取向性和耐久性；其二，建立了涵盖几何基元、混合组合以及正方形、三角形和六边形晶格的三维打印导电支架分类体系，用以关联收集器几何形状与纤维取向、密度和跨空隙桥接的关系。此外还展示了可编程接地技术，即选择性通电的阵列引脚可在不改变物理几何形状的情况下引导沉积。
AI.conclusion: 该平台通过机器人运动控制突破了平面静电纺丝的限制，使纳米纤维膜沉积延伸至复杂三维几何表面。装配说明和工具路径生成代码已作为开源仓库发布，支持学术界的进一步使用与扩展。

title: Renormalization group bounds on Araki relative entropy
summary: This paper derives a multiscale Bakry-Émery criterion for an upper bound on the Araki relative entropy of perturbations of an equilibrium state in relativistic QFT. Using stochastic positivity, affiliated perturbations of the relativistic bosonic field can be put in correspondence with perturbations of the massive Euclidean free field. This gives a Feynman-Kac formula, which in turns is used to derive a probabilistic expression for the Araki relative entropy. The description of the massive Euclidean free field as an abstract Wiener space provides the infinite-dimensional framework to derive a Polchinski equation. Extending the methods of Bauerschmidt, Bodineau, and Dagallier to this context yields a probabilistic bound on the Araki relative entropy, which can be formulated entirely in operator-algebraic terms. Using the criterion, it is shown that the Lorentzian massive Sine-Gordon model in the ultraviolet finite regime satisfies the relative entropy bound.

AI.tldr: 本文推导出一个多尺度Bakry-Émery判据，用于约束相对论量子场论中平衡态扰动的Araki相对熵上界，并将其应用于洛伦兹型大规模sine-Gordon模型在紫外有限区域中的验证。
AI.motivation: 在相对论量子场论中，需要对平衡态扰动的Araki相对熵给出可计算的上界，但目前缺乏系统性的多尺度判据。
AI.method: 利用随机正性（stochastic positivity）将相对论玻色场的伴随扰动与大规模欧氏自由场的扰动建立对应，进而获得Feynman-Kac公式以得到相对熵的概率表达式；通过将大规模欧氏自由场描述为抽象Wiener空间（abstract Wiener space），推导出Polchinski方程，并扩展Bauerschmidt、Bodineau和Dagallier的方法，得到纯粹算子代数形式表述的相对熵概率界。
AI.result: 成功推导出多尺度Bakry-Émery判据，并证明该判据可完全以算子代数（operator-algebraic）术语表述；利用该判据证明了洛伦兹型大规模sine-Gordon模型在紫外有限区域满足相对熵界。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个将概率方法与算子代数方法结合的框架，为相对论量子场论中相对熵的约束提供了新工具。

title: Reducing simulation-related emissions in rare-event searches through optimised event biasing
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Submitted as proceedings for Sustainable HEP 2026
summary: Rare-event search experiments continue to extend their sensitivities to unprecedented levels. This requires increasingly small backgrounds, and shielding schemes that can suppress external backgrounds by several orders of magnitude. Moreover, detailed simulations are required to attain a good understanding of these experimental backgrounds. Studies have suggested, however, that simulations and computing-related tasks contribute approximately 10\% to the average particle physicist's carbon footprint. With backgrounds frequently below 0.01 counts per kg of target per keV of energy, simulations require more computing resources; growing a rare-event researcher's computing-related carbon footprint. Event biasing is often applied in shielding simulations as a remedy, yet there is a lack of systematic guidance on how to maximally benefit from them. An optimisation study for the importance-splitting biasing technique is discussed, focused on balancing statistical precision with simulation CPU-time, and how this can benefit the average researcher's carbon footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文针对稀有事件搜索实验中屏蔽模拟的碳排放问题，探讨了重要性分裂偏置技术（importance-splitting biasing）的系统优化方法，旨在平衡统计精度与模拟CPU时间，从而降低研究者的计算相关碳足迹。
AI.motivation: 稀有事件搜索实验不断追求极低本底，需要大量计算资源进行高精度模拟，而模拟约占粒子物理学家平均碳足迹的10%，且随着本底要求提高该比例还在增长。虽然事件偏置（event biasing）常被用于屏蔽模拟中，但缺乏如何最大化利用偏置技术的系统性指导。
AI.method: 本文对重要性分裂偏置技术进行了优化研究，重点在于平衡统计精度（statistical precision）与模拟CPU时间（CPU-time）之间的关系，并考察该优化对研究者的平均碳足迹的影响。
AI.result: 研究提供了关于重要性分裂偏置技术参数选择的系统优化方案，展示了在保持统计精度的前提下减少模拟CPU时间从而降低计算相关碳排放的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对偏置技术的系统优化，可以显著降低稀有事件研究者的计算相关碳足迹，同时维持实验模拟所需的统计精度——将计算效率与可持续发展目标有机结合。

title: Non-critical M-Theory and the Resolved Conifold: Refinement and Nonperturbative Completion
summary: We extend the Hořava--Keeler correspondence between finite-temperature non-critical M-theory and the resolved-conifold A-model to the refined theory. The grand potential of the stationary rotating non-critical M-theory vacuum reproduces the refined Gopakumar--Vafa expansion, with the angular chemical potential deforming the $Ω$-background away from the self-dual locus $\eps_1=-\eps_2$. At finite thermal radius, we establish an exact match with the nonperturbative conifold completions proposed by Hattab--Palti and by Chuang in the unrefined and refined cases, respectively. Both the one-particle Schwinger integrand and its integration cycle arise from the non-critical M-theory spectrum and resolvent, providing a microscopic spectral realization of these completions. The correspondence fixes the nonconstant BPS sector and the cubic local contribution, while the remaining polynomial ambiguity and the modulus-independent constant-map sector require separate normalization. We explain why the single primitive spinless multiplet of the resolved conifold makes this identification possible, and discuss what additional charge- and spin-dependent microscopic data would be needed for an extension to more general local Calabi--Yau geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文将Hořava–Keeler对偶（即有限温度非临界M理论与resolved-conifold A模型的对应）推广到refined理论。研究表明，静止旋转非临界M理论真空的grand potential可复现refined Gopakumar–Vafa展开式，并在有限热半径下与Hattab–Palti和Chuang提出的非微扰conifold完备化精确匹配。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在将Hořava–Keeler对应关系从unrefined情形扩展到refined理论，为resolved-conifold A模型提供微观谱学实现，并解决非微扰完备化中存在的未定参数问题。
AI.method: 通过引入角向化学势（angular chemical potential）将Ω背景从自对偶点（ε₁=−ε₂）偏离，利用非临界M理论谱与resolvent构造单粒子Schwinger被积函数及其积分环，从而实现对非微扰完备化的微观实现。
AI.result: 在有限热半径下，grand potential与Hattab–Palti和Chuang分别在unrefined和refined情形下提出的非微扰conifold完备化精确匹配；对应关系确定了非恒定BPS扇区和三次局域贡献，但多项式歧义与模不依赖的常数映射扇区仍需单独归一化。
AI.conclusion: resolved-conifold单一原初无自旋多重态（primitive spinless multiplet）是此识别可行的关键；推广到更一般的局部Calabi–Yau几何需补充依赖于荷（charge）与自旋（spin）的额外微观数据。

title: Fermionic Casimir memory from an anisotropic gravitational pulse
summary: We investigate the late-time energy deposited by a weak, spatially homogeneous anisotropic gravitational pulse in a massless Dirac field confined between two static parallel plates. The field satisfies MIT bag boundary conditions, while the prescribed geometry approaches Minkowski spacetime in both asymptotic time regions. Using a tetrad formulation, we show that the linear spin-connection contribution cancels for the traceless anisotropy, leaving a coupling to the shear component of the Dirac stress tensor. The pulse produces real fermion--antifermion pairs, whose deposited energy is evaluated through the corresponding Bogoliubov coefficients. Subtracting the production in unbounded space isolates a finite boundary-dependent contribution governed by the pulse duration relative to the characteristic spectral timescale set by the MIT gap. This contribution is negative in the adiabatic regime, where confinement suppresses excitations relative to the continuous free spectrum, and approaches zero from above in the impulsive limit. The resulting pressure correction is nonmonotonic and exhibits two sign changes, alternately reinforcing and reducing the ordinary attractive Casimir force. Unlike the bosonic vacuum-polarization memory previously obtained for the same class of backgrounds, the present effect is a dissipative fermionic memory carried by gravitationally created pairs. Here, memory denotes the persistent late-time modification of the quantum state after the pulse has vanished.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两个静态平行板之间无质量狄拉克场（massless Dirac field）在弱、空间均匀的各向异性引力脉冲作用下的晚期能量沉积。通过tetrad表述证明线性自旋联络项对无迹各向异性为零，留下与狄拉克应力张量剪切分量的耦合。脉冲产生真实费米-反费米对，扣除无界空间中的产生后，得到有限且依赖于边界的贡献，该贡献在绝热区为负、在脉冲极限下从上方趋于零，修正后的压力呈现非单调且两次变号的行为。与玻色子真空极化记忆不同，该效应是由引力产生的粒子携带的耗散费米子记忆。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在理解引力脉冲（gravitational pulse）对受限量子场——具体为位于平行板间、满足MIT袋边界条件（MIT bag boundary conditions）的无质量狄拉克场——产生的持续物理效应，并揭示费米子记忆效应（fermionic memory）与先前研究的玻色子情况之间的本质差异。
AI.method: 采用tetrad表述（tetrad formulation）处理受引力背景扰动时的旋量场；通过线性自旋联络（spin-connection）的逐项分析与无迹各向异性对称性结合，识别出与狄拉克应力张量剪切分量的有效耦合；通过Bogoliubov系数（Bogoliubov coefficients）定量评估脉冲产生的费米子对的能量；并通过扣除无界空间中对应的产生过程来提取边界依赖的有限贡献。
AI.result: 边界依赖的能量贡献由脉冲持续时间与MIT能隙（MIT gap）对应的特征谱时间尺度之比决定；在绝热（adiabatic）区该贡献为负——受限效应抑制了相较于连续自由谱的激发；在脉冲（impulsive）极限下则从上方趋于零；由此得到的压力修正非单调，经历两次符号变化，交替增强和减弱普通的吸引性Casimir力（Casimir force）。
AI.conclusion: 该效应是一种由引力产生的粒子携带的耗散性费米子记忆，其中"记忆"指脉冲消失后量子态持续的晚期修正；与同一类背景下的玻色子真空极化记忆在性质和机制上根本不同。

title: Beyond Crease Geometry: Multistability in Origami-Inspired Structures through Local Fold Architectures
summary: Origami-inspired tubular structures provide a versatile platform for shape morphing, with multistability achieved predominantly through crease-network geometry. Expanding the range of morphing behaviors can therefore require increasingly intricate crease patterns that become more difficult to model and fabricate, ultimately constraining the realizable morphing landscape. Here, we expand the design space of origami-inspired structures beyond geometry by introducing localized instabilities within the crease network, thereby creating compliant multistable structures whose local fold architectures govern global deformation and stability through both constitutive mechanics and geometric constraints. To relate local fold architectures to global multistability, we develop and experimentally validate a modeling framework in which compliant folds are represented as continuous fields that capture spatially varying bistable mechanics. Force- and displacement-controlled design maps demonstrate that global deformation and stability can be programmed through the fold architecture's local parameters. Redistributing bistability within a fixed crease-network topology shifts the global response between compliant, spatially distributed deformation in semi-bistable architectures and discrete transitions within a hierarchically organized space of stable configurations in fully bistable architectures. These results establish a local-to-global design principle for programming both the stable configurations of a structure and the transition pathways connecting them, expanding the design space for multistable metamaterials, adaptive morphing structures, and soft robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过引入折痕网络内的局部失稳机制，将仿折纸管状结构的设计空间从纯几何拓展到包含本构力学与几何约束的范畴，提出并实验验证了将柔性折痕表示为连续场的建模框架，揭示了局部折叠架构与全局多稳态形变之间的映射规律。
AI.motivation: 传统仿折纸结构主要依赖折痕网络的几何构型实现多稳态（multistability），但进一步拓展形变行为需要日益复杂的折痕图案，增加了建模与制造难度，限制了可实现形变形态的空间。
AI.method: 在折痕网络中引入局部失稳（localized instabilities）构建柔性多稳态结构；开发并将柔性折痕建模为连续场（continuous fields）以捕捉空间变化的双稳态力学；通过力控与位移控设计图谱（design maps）关联局部折叠架构参数与全局形变及稳定性；并进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在固定折痕网络拓扑下重新分配双稳态特性，可切换全局响应：半双稳架构（semi-bistable architectures）呈现柔顺、空间分布的形变，而全双稳架构（fully bistable architectures）则呈现层级组织稳定构型空间内的离散跃迁。
AI.conclusion: 建立了从局部到全局的设计原则（local-to-global design principle），可编程结构的稳定构型及其连接转换路径，拓展了多稳态超材料（metamaterials）、自适应形变结构与软体机器人系统的设计空间。

title: Big Crunch on Julia and Anti-Julia Sets in the Integrable Limit
summary: The Julia set is defined by the closure of repelling periodic points in chaotic systems. Why does this structure not appear in integrable systems? In this paper, we address this question by demonstrating the existence of the closure of divergences of the periodic equations, which we designate as the "anti-Julia set." We also call the sets before taking the closures the pre-Julia and pre-anti-Julia sets, respectively. We illustrate the transition mechanism by considering a complex map that interpolates between integrable and non-integrable dynamics, by introducing a real deformation parameter $a$. For $0<a\le 1/2$, we show that the Julia set and the anti-Julia set coincide in the complex plane, although the pre-Julia and pre-anti-Julia sets remain completely disjoint. At the integrable limit $a\to 0$, these two dual structures undergo a critical collision and subsequent annihilation, reminiscent of a cosmological Big Crunch. When $1/2<a<1$, on the other hand, the boundary of the pre-anti-Julia set includes the Julia set. We analytically characterize these phenomena, focusing in particular on the asymptotic behavior of the pre-anti-Julia set as it approaches the integrable limit, and provide numerical visualizations that elucidate the underlying mechanisms of this Big Crunch phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在混沌系统与可积系统之间引入实形变参数 $a$ 的复映射，发现并定义了"反Julia集"（anti-Julia set）及其对应的前驱集合（pre-Julia/pre-anti-Julia set），揭示了系统从不可积过渡到可积极限时两种对偶结构发生临界碰撞并相互湮灭的机制，该现象被类比为宇宙学中的大挤压（Big Crunch）。
AI.motivation: Julia集作为混沌系统中排斥周期点的闭包普遍存在，但其为何在可积系统中不出现，这一根本问题尚未得到解释。作者通过定义反Julia集——即周期方程发散点的闭包，试图从对偶结构角度阐明混沌与可积动力学之间的过渡机制。
AI.method: 引入一个带实形变参数 $a$ 的复映射，以插值可积与不可积动力学。在 $0<a\le 1/2$ 区间分析Julia集与反Julia集在复平面上的重合关系及前驱集合的不相交性；在 $1/2<a<1$ 区间考察反Julia集前驱边界对Julia集的包含关系。通过解析方法刻画前反Julia集在趋近可积极限时的渐近行为，并结合数值可视化展示大挤压现象的演化过程。
AI.result: 在 $0<a\le 1/2$ 时，Julia集与反Julia集在复平面上重合，但pre-Julia集与pre-anti-Julia集完全不相交；在可积极限 $a\to 0$ 时，两种对偶结构发生临界碰撞并相互湮灭，类似于宇宙学中的大挤压；当 $1/2<a<1$ 时，pre-anti-Julia集的边界包含Julia集。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过解析与数值证据表明，反Julia集及其前驱集合能够在可积极限处通过临界碰撞与湮灭机制解释Julia集在可积系统中消失的现象，为混沌-可积转变提供了新的几何图景。

title: Response of a nitrogen-filled spherical proportional counter to mono-energetic neutrons
summary: Neutron spectroscopy is an invaluable tool for a wide range of scientific and industrial applications, however, current approaches suffer from limitations that restrict their field of applicability. A safe and inexpensive alternative approach to neutron detection and spectroscopy is the use of a nitrogen-filled spherical proportional counter that exploits the $^{14}\rm{N(n,p)}^{14}\rm{C}$ and $^{14}\rm{N(n},α)^{11}\rm{B}$ reactions. The neutron spectroscopy capabilities of the detector are demonstrated using beams of mono-energetic neutrons. A nitrogen-filled spherical proportional counter, operating at a pressure of $1$ bar, is exposed to neutrons with energies from $0.75$ MeV to $2.75$ MeV at the Tandem accelerator of the National Centre for Scientific Research ``Demokritos'' in Athens. A linear energy response is observed, within the statistical precision of the measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了利用充氮球形正比计数器（nitrogen-filled spherical proportional counter）进行中子探测与谱学（neutron spectroscopy）的能力，该探测器利用$^{14}$N(n,p)$^{14}$C和$^{14}$N(n,α)$^{11}$B核反应，在1个大气压下以0.75至2.75 MeV单能中子束进行测试，观察到统计精度范围内的线性能量响应。
AI.motivation: 中子谱学是科学和工业领域广泛应用的重要工具，但现有方法存在多种限制，制约了其适用范围。因此需要探索一种安全且低成本的中子探测与谱学替代方案，以扩展该领域的技术能力。
