To enhance immersion, we have developed G4VR, a virtual reality (VR) application that extends Geant4 with VR capabilities, providing a more intuitive and comprehensive way to understand these interactions. The user running G4VR in a headset can get detailed information about individual tracks, interactions, and energy depositions by selecting them with the hand controllers. G4VR also allows the user to examine the chronology of interactions, and includes animations of entire events as immersive movies. G4VR includes built-in event displays of several types that allow a first-time user to easily explore its various functionalities. To interface with Geant4, we have developed a new visualization driver called G4XR that allows direct integration with the Geant4 source code. This enables any Geant4 experiment to be loaded and experienced in VR seamlessly.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 G4VR，一个为 Geant4 粒子输运模拟工具扩展虚拟现实（virtual reality）能力的应用。通过开发新的可视化驱动 G4XR，G4VR 使用户能在头戴式显示器中沉浸式地查看单个径迹、相互作用、能量沉积及事件时间序列，并支持动画回放，从而增强对粒子相互作用过程的理解。
AI.motivation: Geant4 是广泛应用于粒子物理、核物理、医学成像和天体物理等领域的粒子相互作用模拟工具，但其可视化通常局限于传统二维显示器。为了提升用户对粒子相互作用过程的理解的直观性和沉浸感，需要引入虚拟现实能力。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为 G4VR 的虚拟现实应用，并设计了一种新的可视化驱动 G4XR，该驱动可直接集成于 Geant4 源代码，实现无缝加载任意 Geant4 实验。用户可在头戴式设备中通过手部控制器选择并查看单个径迹、相互作用和能量沉积信息，还可检查相互作用的时序并播放整体事件的沉浸式动画。应用内置多种事件显示类型，便于新用户探索其功能。
AI.result: G4VR 成功实现了 Geant4 与虚拟现实的直接集成，任何 Geant4 实验场景均可被无缝加载并在 VR 中体验；用户可获取详细的径迹、相互作用和能量沉积信息，并支持按时间顺序检查相互作用及整事件沉浸式动画。
AI.conclusion: G4VR 通过新开发的可视化驱动 G4XR，为 Geant4 用户提供了一种更加直观和沉浸式的三维可视化交互方式，有望提升对粒子相互作用过程的理解效率。

title: (Anti-)De Sitter null strings and Carroll-Weyl symmetry
summary: We construct a $dS_d$ null string in a novel way by lifting the standard tensionless string to $R^{1,d}$. Gauging worldsheet scale symmetry introduces terms in the action breaking translation invariance, but preserving the $dS_d$ symmetry $SO(1,d)$. Choosing a De Sitter symmetric gauge fixing of the scale symmetry yields a $d$ dimensional theory which we show has all the expected properties of $dS_d$ tensionless strings. The action happens to be the intriguing Carrol-Weyl symmetric string action in $R^{1,d}$, now with a clear target space interpretation in $d$ dimensions. That it does not, as recently claimed, represent a ($d+1$)-dimensional string in flat ($d+1$)-dimensional Minkowski space settles an apparent issue with the Carrol-Weyl string model. Furthermore, while there are clear obstacles for similar formulations of tensile strings in (A)dS backgrounds, our new insights are easily modified to the formulation of Anti-De Sitter tensionless strings. That our construction generates a curved geometry purely algebraically may have even wider applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将标准无张力弦（tensionless string）提升到R^{1,d}空间并规范固定世界sheet尺度对称性，以一种全新方式构造了d维De Sitter空间弦（dS_d null string），证明所得到的理论具有dS_d无张力弦的所有预期性质，并澄清了Carrol-Weyl对称弦模型的相关争议。
AI.motivation: 已有的Carrol-Weyl对称弦作用模型的物理诠释存在模糊性，特别是其是否真正代表更高维平直时空中的弦理论尚不清楚；同时，在(反)de Sitter背景下构建无张力弦系统的规范方式也缺乏系统构造。本文旨在通过新的构造路线解决这些概念问题。
AI.method: 将标准无张力弦提升至R^{1,d}空间，通过在作用量中耦合格化世界sheet尺度对称性来引入破坏平移不变性、但保持SO(1,d)对称性的项；随后选择De Sitter对称的尺度规范固定条件，得到d维理论，并将结果与Carrol-Weyl对称弦作用进行对照分析。
AI.result: 所得理论具有dS_d无张力弦的全部预期性质；得到的正是Carrol-Weyl对称弦作用，但其正确诠释是d维dS空间中的弦，而非以前所声称的(d+1)维平直闵可夫斯基时空中的弦；此外，构造可自然地推广至反de Sitter（Anti-De Sitter）无张力弦情况。
AI.conclusion: 本文澄清了Carrol-Weyl弦模型的维度与时空诠释，确立了其在d维dS空间中的物理对应关系；同时指出拉伸弦（tensile string）在(A)dS背景中面临构造障碍，而反de Sitter无张力弦的类似表述易于实现；这种纯代数方式生成弯曲几何的方案可能具有更广泛的应用前景。

title: Distinguishing lensing and precessional modulation in binary black-hole inspiral waveforms
summary: Binary black holes (BBHs) emit gravitational waves (GWs) as they inspiral towards merger. These GWs can be gravitationally lensed by large-scale structure along the line of sight, potentially creating multiple images of the same source with fixed time delays determined by the lensing geometry. As the BBHs inspiral, the GW frequency increases, leading to successive constructive and destructive interference between the multiple images. BBHs also have spins $\mathbf{S}_i$ that may be misaligned with their orbital angular momentum $\mathbf{L}$. As the BBHs inspiral, these misaligned spins cause $\mathbf{L}$ to precess about the total angular momentum $\mathbf{J}$, modulating the GW emission similar to pulsar emission resulting from a misaligned jet rotating in and out of the line of sight. We investigate the ability of a single L-shaped GW detector to distinguish between these two sources of modulation. We find that precessional modulation can mimic the lensing modulation between two images with comparable magnifications when the time delay between the images is short enough that fewer than three interference fringes occur during the time the GW signal spends in the sensitivity band of the detector. As strong lensing is rare for GW sources at moderate redshift while misaligned spins are common for BBHs produced in certain formation channels, ruling out precessional modulation is essential to identifying genuinely lensed systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了如何区分双黑洞（BBH）引力波信号中由引力透镜（gravitational lensing）效应引起的干涉调制与由自旋进动引起的调制，发现当日延迟时间较短（少于三个干涉条纹）时，进动调制可模仿透镜调制，这两者的区分对识别真正的透镜系统至关重要。
AI.motivation: 双黑洞合并产生的引力波可能被大尺度结构引力透镜化而产生多重影像，但其自旋与轨道角动量不对齐引起的进动也会调制引力波发射，两种效应可能造成混淆。由于强透镜事件在中等红移处罕见而错向自旋在特定形成通道产生的双黑洞中常见，区分这两种机制对识别真正被透镜化的系统十分必要。
AI.method: 研究考察单个L形引力波探测器的探测能力，构建包含透镜干涉调制与自旋进动调制的信号模型，并分析在不同时间延迟和放大率条件下两种调制方式的鉴别能力，具体比较在灵敏度频带内干涉条纹数量与预cession调制特征的关系。
AI.result: 发现在两个影像放大率相近且时间延迟足够短（使引力波信号在探测器灵敏度频带内产生的干涉条纹少于三个）的条件下，precession调制可以模仿透镜产生的时间延迟调制效应。
AI.conclusion: 由于强透镜事件在中红移处罕见而错向自旋的双黑洞较为常见，排除precession调制是识别真正透镜系统不可或缺的步骤。

title: Gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch sums for general multiorbital Hofstadter models
summary: We formulate a unified treatment of the Hofstadter problem for general two-dimensional multiorbital Peierls tight-binding Hamiltonians using a gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch-sum basis. The construction retains the full Bravais geometry, arbitrary intracell orbital positions, and the original hopping table, so lattice geometry, orbital embedding, hopping range, and orbital content can all be handled within the same framework. At rational flux $Φ/Φ_0=p/q$, commuting magnetic translations reduce the Peierls Hamiltonian to minimal $qN_{\rm orb}\times qN_{\rm orb}$ blocks. Their dimension depends only on the flux through the primitive cell, even when the fractional orbital coordinates are irrational. Electromagnetic gauge transformations act by unitary conjugation within the construction and do not alter the required magnetic supercell. We derive an explicit sparse matrix in an oblique Landau gauge and establish the associated band counting, spectral redundancy, Chern-number formulation, magnetic spatial constraints, and flux periodicity. Numerical examples include elementary lattices, topological and flat-band models, and a spinful 22-band Wannier Hamiltonian of monolayer $\mathrm{MoS}_2$, demonstrating a direct interface with first-principles electronic-structure calculations. As a complementary representation, we also derive exact generalized Harper equations from the same hopping data and relate them to the finite magnetic-Bloch blocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种规范协变的磁布洛赫求和基（gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch-sum basis），用于统一处理一般二维多轨道Peierls紧束缚哈密顿量的Hofstadter问题，将磁平移对称性约化为最小qN_orb×qN_orb分块，并给出了显式的稀疏矩阵形式及能带拓扑性质的完整刻画。
AI.motivation: 传统Hofstadter问题处理方法难以同时保持完整的布拉维几何、任意轨道内位置及原始跃迁表。本文旨在构建一个统一框架，使晶格几何、轨道嵌入、跃迁范围和轨道内容能在同一构架下处理，并实现与第一性原理电子结构计算的直接对接。
AI.method: 采用规范协变的磁布洛赫求和基构造Peierls紧束缚哈密顿量，在通量Φ/Φ_0=p/q时利用对易磁平移将哈密顿量约化为qN_orb×qN_orb的最小分块；在斜朗道规范下推导显式稀疏矩阵，并建立能带计数、谱冗余、陈数公式、磁空间约束与通量周期性等性质；同时从相同跃迁数据导出广义Harper方程。
AI.result: 分块维度仅取决于元胞通量，即使轨道分式坐标为无理数亦然；电磁规范变换在该框架内以幺正共轭作用且不改变所需磁超胞。数值示例覆盖基本晶格、拓扑与平带模型，以及单层MoS_2的自旋22带Wannier哈密顿量，验证了与第一性原理计算的直接接口。
AI.conclusion: 该统一处理方法为多轨道Hofstadter问题提供了完整而通用的解决方案，其显式稀疏矩阵形式和广义Harper方程的互补表示，为该类系统的能带结构、拓扑不变量及第一性原理物性计算建立了统一工具框架。

title: The phase coordinates transformation in Moyal noncommutative framework 2-dimensional harmonic oscillator and Painlevé second equation
summary:
This work aims to explore the physical application of Moyal noncom- mutative formalism with the the presentation of new transformations which connect the old canonical coordinates to purly noncommuting phase coordi- nates through the parameters describe the Moyal noncommutative deforma- tion. These transformations are consistent with the Moyal noncommunica- tive brackets and build sixteen components traceless anti-symmetric tensor. This formalism incorporates space-space and space-momentum noncommu- taivity rather then noncommutativity (Heisenberg quantum commutation ) only for the canonical coordinates. The transformations imply to construct noncommutative analogs of 2-dimensional harmonic oscillator with
  its superintegrability and Painlevé second equation. The associated deformed Hamiltonians additionally involve some extra symmetries and reveal a deep physical understanding of about the additional symmetries with noncommunicative structure. The Painlevé second noncommutative coordinates transformation are also efficiently applied to generate the first Yablonskii Vorobev polynomial with Painlevé second parameter transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文探索Moyal非对易形式主义的物理应用，通过新变换将经典正则坐标映射到纯非对易相坐标，构建十六分量无迹反对称张量，并推广至包括空间-空间与空间-动量非对易性，进而构造二维谐振子的非对易类比、超可积性及Painlevé第二方程，并生成第一类Yablonskii-Vorobev多项式。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索Moyal非对易（Moyal noncommutative）形式主义的物理应用，扩展传统海森堡量子对易关系所仅有坐标非对易的限制，建立包含空间-空间及空间-动量非对易性的更一般化描述。
AI.method: 本文提出将旧正则坐标连接到纯非对易相坐标的新变换，这些变换由描述Moyal非对易形变的参数所刻画，并与Moyal非对易括号保持一致，构造出十六个分量的无迹反对称张量。
AI.result: 该形式化构建了二维谐振子的非对易类比及其超可积性（superintegrability），并与Painlevé第二方程相关联；变形哈密顿量包含额外对称性，揭示了非对易结构中附加对称性的深层物理含义。Painlevé第二非对易坐标变换被应用于生成第一Yablonskii-Vorobev多项式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明Moyal非对易变形下构造的新变换不仅统一了坐标与动量层面的非对易性，还通过变形哈密顿量的对称性及Painlevé结构与多项式生成，展示了非对易几何在物理系统建模中的深层价值。

title: Sensitivity of neutrino oscillations to the Earth's interior properties
summary: Understanding the Earth s internal structure remains a major challenge, as traditional geophysical methods face ambiguities in linking seismic observations to temperature, composition, or mass density variations. Atmospheric neutrinos offer a complementary probe: while traversing the Earth, they undergo flavor oscillations that depend on the local electron density, which reflects both mass density and composition.

AI.tldr: 本篇论文提出利用大气中微子（atmospheric neutrinos）穿过地球时发生的味振荡（flavor oscillations）作为探测地球内部结构的补充手段。中微子振荡依赖局部电子密度，而电子密度同时反映地球的质量密度与物质组成，从而弥补传统地球物理方法在连接地震观测与温度、成分或质量密度变化时的歧义性。
AI.motivation: 地球内部结构的认识仍是重大挑战，传统地球物理方法在地震观测与温度、成分或质量密度变化之间建立关联时存在歧义，亟需互补性的探测途径。
AI.method: 利用大气中微子作为穿透地球的探针；中微子在地球内部的传播过程中发生味振荡，其振荡行为依赖于所经路径上的局部电子密度。
AI.result: 文中提出电子密度与质量密度及物质组成之间存在对应关系，表明中微子振荡可作为地球物理参数的敏感信息来源。
AI.conclusion: 大气中微子振荡为地球内部结构研究提供了互补于传统地球物理手段的探测方案。

title: Eikonal Scattering of Two D0-branes with Graviton Emission
summary: We study the emission of a massless closed-string state in the scattering of two D0-branes using the boundary-state formalism. We compute the corresponding five-point amplitudes for graviton and dilaton emission in bosonic string theory and in type II superstring theory, and analyze their field-theory limit. For nonzero impact parameter, the resulting amplitudes are reproduced by an independent calculation in the worldline formulation of the corresponding low-energy theory.

AI.tldr: 该论文使用边界态形式（boundary-state formalism）研究两个D0-膜散射中无质量闭弦态的发射，在玻色弦理论和II型超弦理论中计算了引力子和膨胀子发射的五点振幅，并通过世界线公式（worldline formulation）在非零碰撞参数下独立验证了低能场论极限的结果。
AI.motivation: D0-膜散射过程中的无质量闭弦发射是弦理论中涉及开弦-闭弦耦合的重要物理过程，需要构造边界态并计算相应的多点振幅来理解其低能有效理论的对应关系。
AI.method: 采用边界态形式体系（boundary-state formalism）来计算两个D0-膜散射中发射无质量闭弦态（引力子与膨胀子）的五点振幅（five-point amplitudes），分别针对玻色弦理论（bosonic string theory）与II型超弦理论（type II superstring theory）进行推导，并分析其场论极限（field-theory limit）。
AI.result: 对于非零碰撞参数（impact parameter）的情形，弦理论中得到的散射振幅可由对应低能理论的世界线公式（worldline formulation）独立计算给出完全一致的复现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了弦理论计算与低能有效理论（low-energy theory）之间的自洽性，表明D0-膜散射中引力子和膨胀子发射的五点振幅在非零碰撞参数下可被世界线公式精确重现，为弦散射振幅与场论描述的对偶性提供了实证支持。

title: Cycles Without End: An Ekpyrotic Braneworld Bounce with a Kinetically Coupled Entropic Mechanism
summary: Cyclic cosmologies replace inflation's single creation event with an eternal sequence of smooth turnarounds, but three problems have historically stood in their way: singular bounces, the blue tilt generic to single-field ekpyrotic contraction, and Tolman's observation that entropy production should make successive cycles longer and larger without bound. We resolve all three within one explicit model. A Randall-Sundrum brane with a timelike extra dimension regularizes the bounce without violating the null energy condition, and a single scalar field's potential carries the universe from a thawing dark-energy plateau through a sign-changing turnaround into a BKL-safe ekpyrotic contraction and back. We show that no correction internal to the brane's Friedmann equation, and no straight two-field trajectory, can rescue the spectral index from the generic ekpyrotic result $n_s\approx3$. We then build the minimal completion that can: a kinetically coupled entropy field, following the general mechanism of Ijjas, Lehners, and Steinhardt, whose coupling steepness has a closed-form, exact-scale-invariance value for this model's ekpyrotic potential, with only a percent-level offset needed to match the measured tilt $n_s=0.9649$. This fixes the local non-Gaussianity ($f_{\rm NL}\approx-0.02$) and tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r\approx7.6\times10^{-26}$). Matching the observed amplitude fixes the conversion coupling and brane tension to unremarkable values ($λ\approx5.7\times10^{-3}$, $ρ_c^{1/4}=10^{13}\,$GeV). Finally, because the brane construction is spatially flat, Tolman's entropy argument does not bound the number of cycles here: we derive $N_{\rm DE}\sim70$-80 e-folds of accelerated expansion needed each cycle to dilute the entropy produced back to a negligible density before the next contraction.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个显式的循环宇宙学（cyclic cosmology）模型，在一个统一框架内解决了三个历史难题：奇异反弹（singular bounce）、单场ekpyrotic收缩固有的蓝移（blue tilt）谱指数问题，以及Tolman熵增导致循环无限膨胀的问题。模型采用带有类时额外维度的Randall-Sundrum膜来正则化反弹，并通过单个标量场的势设计实现从解冻暗能量（thawing dark energy）平台经变号转向到BKL安全的ekpyrotic收缩的完整循环，再辅以动力学耦合熵场将谱指数修正到观测值。
AI.motivation: 循环宇宙学以永恒的光滑转向序列替代暴胀（inflation）的单次创生事件，但其发展一直受制于三个历史难题：奇异反弹、单场ekpyrotic收缩固有的蓝移谱，以及Tolman指出的熵产生应使循环无限变长变大的问题。作者旨在构建一个单一显式模型，同时解决这三个问题，并使其标量扰动谱与普朗克观测相符。
AI.method: 模型采用具有类时额外维度的Randall-Sundrum膜，在不违反零能量条件（null energy condition）的情况下使反弹正则化。单个标量场的势能驱动宇宙经历解冻暗能量平台、变号转向、BKL安全的ekpyrotic收缩到反弹的完整演化。作者首先证明膜内Friedmann方程的任何内部修正以及任何直线两场轨迹都无法将谱指数从通用的ekpyrotic结果n_s≈3中挽救出来，然后引入动力学耦合熵场（遵循Ijjas-Lehners-Steinhardt机制）作为最小补全方案，其耦合陡度在封闭形式下具有精确尺度不变值，仅需百分之一量级的偏移即可匹配实测谱指数倾斜。匹配观测振幅还固定了转换耦合与膜张力等参数，并推导了每个循环所需的暗能量e-fold数以稀释熵密度。
AI.result: 模型成功将谱指数调整为n_s=0.9649，同时固定了局部非高斯性f_NL≈-0.02和原张标量比r≈7.6×10^{-26}。匹配观测振幅给出转换耦合λ≈5.7×10^{-3}和膜张力尺度ρ_c^{1/4}=10^13 GeV，均为不引人注目的数值。由于膜构造是空间平坦的，Tolman熵论证不限制循环次数；推导得出每个循环需要约70-80个e-fold的加速膨胀（N_DE）来将熵产生稀释到下一次收缩前可忽略的密度。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在单一显式框架内同时解决了奇异反弹、蓝移谱指数和Tolman熵问题三大历史障碍，产生了与观测一致的标量谱指数、非高斯性和张标量比，且所需参数取值自然而无须精细调节。空间平坦的构造规避了Tolman限制，使得循环可以在时间上无限延续。

title: Distribution of currents in a system of active particles with biased hops and Ising interactions
summary: We consider an ensemble of particles performing a biased random walk on a two-dimensional lattice. Due to the adhesion between particles (nearest-neighbor Ising interactions), the probability of hopping depends on the number of neighbors and the strength of adhesive interaction. The asymmetry in the hopping directions leads to a macroscopic current of particles through the system. We theoretically compute the distribution of currents and verify the results in stochastic particle simulations. To make theoretical progress, one has to determine the probabilities of various particle configurations such as single particles, pairs, and different configurations of three-particle clusters. These probabilities are theoretically derived by formulating rate equations for the concentrations of various structures resembling Becker-Döring cluster equations. One intriguing finding is that the concentration of left-handed triplets is not equal to the concentration of right-handed triplets for non-zero asymmetry of hops and non-zero interaction between particles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维格点上具有最近邻伊辛相互作用（Ising interactions）的偏向性随机行走粒子系综，理论推导了系统中宏观粒子流的分布，并通过随机粒子模拟进行验证。一个重要发现是：当跳跃不对称性和粒子间相互作用均非零时，左手三元组与右手三元组的浓度不相等。
AI.motivation: 理解粒子间黏附相互作用与偏向性跳跃如何共同影响粒子流的统计性质，并揭示粒子构型浓度中可能存在的对称性破缺现象。
AI.method: 粒子在二维格点上执行偏向性随机行走（biased random walk），跳跃概率由最近邻伊辛相互作用以及黏附强度决定。通过建立类似于Becker-Döring团簇方程（Becker-Döring cluster equations）的速率方程，推导单粒子、双粒子及不同三元组构型的浓度，并据此解析计算电流分布，最后通过随机粒子模拟（stochastic particle simulations）验证理论结果。
AI.result: 理论推导的电流分布与随机粒子模拟结果一致。此外揭示了一个非直观现象：当跳跃不对称性与粒子间相互作用同时非零时，左手三元组的浓度与右手三元组的浓度不相等，表明构型浓度可能存在手性选择性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在相互作用粒子的偏向性输运系统中，粒子流的统计性质可通过类团簇速率方程精确刻画，并可能伴随手性相关的构型不对称现象。

title: On spatial decoherence in many-body systems
summary: We study the dynamics of a many-body quantum system strongly interacting with a bosonic reservoir. The coupling is given by a potential operator for the system and it is linear in the field. We show that in the limit of infinite coupling strength the system undergoes instantaneous spatial decoherence. To resolve the decoherence process in time we consider large coupling strengths $λ$ and short times scaling as $t\propto λ^{-α}$, with $α\ge0$, in the limit $λ\rightarrow\infty$. On short time scales $α>1$ the dynamics is trivial while on longer ones $0\leα<1$ the decoherence is instantaneous. We show that the decoherence process is resolved exactly for $α=1$, defining the fine-grained time scale $τ=λt$. We construct an approximate effective evolution map of the many-body system with controlled error estimates. Generically, the effective dynamics is markovian, but not given by a dynamical semigroup. As a physical application we give a rigorous description of the phenomenon of localization of macroscopic quantum objects in position space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一个多体量子系统与玻色子储库（bosonic reservoir）强耦合的动力学行为。在无限耦合强度极限下，系统经历瞬时的空间退相干（spatial decoherence）。通过设定耦合强度λ趋于无穷大且时间按t∝λ^{-α}（α≥0）标度，作者发现α=1的精细时间尺度（fine-grained time scale）τ=λt能够精确分辨退相干过程，并构造了带可控误差估计的近似有效演化映射。该有效动力学一般是马尔可夫的（markovian），但并非动力学半群（dynamical semigroup）。作为物理应用，文中给出了宏观量子物体在位置空间中局域化现象的严格描述。
AI.motivation: 理解量子系统与周围环境强耦合时的退相干动力学是量子理论基础问题之一，尤其是在强耦合极限下系统是否发生瞬时空间退相干、以及如何随时间解析该过程尚缺乏严格的理论刻画。
AI.method: 作者设定耦合强度λ趋于无穷大，引入短时间标度t∝λ^{-α}（α≥0），区分不同时间尺度区域：α>1时动力学平凡，0≤α<1时退相干瞬时发生，而α=1定义精细时间尺度τ=λt并精确分辨退相干过程。在该标度下，建立多体系统的近似有效演化映射（approximate effective evolution map），并给出可控误差估计（controlled error estimates）。
AI.result: 研究表明，在强耦合极限下系统经历瞬时空间退相干；当α=1时退相干过程可被精确解析，其有效动力学一般是马尔可夫的，但不由动力学半群给出。作者据此为宏观量子物体在位置空间中的局域化（localization）现象提供了严格的定量描述。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了多体开放量子系统在强耦合极限下退相干动力学的严格框架，明确了精细节时间尺度的存在性及有效演化的结构，并成功将理论应用于宏观量子物体位置局域化现象的严格刻画。

title: The Colors of Jet Quenching
summary: We combine inclusive jet nuclear modification factors with energy-energy correlators to perform a data-driven extraction of the quark and gluon quenching factors and the medium resolution scale from the small-angle region. Taking coherent energy loss as a null hypothesis, we find jet quenching factors incompatible with Casimir scaling. Incorporating color decoherence through antenna energy loss improves the description of the data and restores Casimir scaling, providing evidence that the quark-gluon plasma partially resolves the internal structure of jets in heavy-ion collisions.

AI.tldr: 本文结合包含性射流核修正因子（inclusive jet nuclear modification factors）与能量-能量关联子（energy-energy correlators），在小角度区域对夸克与胶子的淬灭因子（quenching factors）以及介质分辨率尺度（medium resolution scale）进行了数据驱动的提取。
AI.motivation: 在重离子碰撞中，检验喷注淬灭（jet quenching）是否遵循卡西米尔标度（Casimir scaling），并探究夸克-胶子等离子体（quark-gluon plasma）能否在喷注内部结构尺度上分辨其组分色结构。
AI.method: 以相干能量损失（coherent energy loss）作为零假设，结合喷注核修正因子与能量-能量关联子数据，采用数据驱动方式提取夸克和胶子的淬灭因子及介质分辨率尺度；随后引入色退相干（color decoherence）机制，通过天线能量损失（antenna energy loss）模型重新检验数据描述。
AI.result: 在相干能量损失假设下，提取的喷注淬灭因子与卡西米尔标度不相容；引入色退相干后，模型能更好描述数据并恢复卡西米尔标度。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了证据，表明夸克-胶子等离子体在重离子碰撞中能够部分分辨喷注的内部结构。

title: Logarithmic correction to the entropy of near-extremal higher-curvature black holes
summary: The spherically symmetric sector of broad classes of $D$-dimensional gravitational theories can be effectively described by general two-dimensional Horndeski theories. Exploiting this correspondence, we study the low-temperature dynamics of near-extremal black hole solutions of the parent theories by deriving a universal near-horizon effective description in terms of Jackiw--Teitelboim (JT) gravity. We explicitly show that the logarithmic quantum correction to the entropy, $S_{\rm JT}=\frac{3}{2}\log \left(T/T_{\rm breakdown} \right)$, previously derived for near-extremal black holes in Einstein gravity coupled to matter from the one-loop exact JT partition function, is universal across all models admitting an effective two-dimensional Horndeski description. We determine the general form of the scale at which this correction becomes dominant, $T_{\rm breakdown}$, in terms of the data of the $D$-dimensional theories. We illustrate our general results with charged black holes in Lovelock gravities and regular black holes in Quasitopological gravities.

AI.tldr: 本文利用广义二维Horndeski理论（two-dimensional Horndeski theories）与D维引力理论球对称扇区（spherically symmetric sector）之间的对应关系，证明近极端黑洞（near-extremal black holes）的低温动力学可由Jackiw–Teitelboim（JT）引力统一描述，并论证熵的对数量子修正项$S_{\rm JT}=\frac{3}{2}\log(T/T_{\rm breakdown})$在各类可约化为二维Horndeski描述的模型中具有普适性。
AI.motivation: 近极端黑洞的低温行为蕴含丰富的量子引力信息，但此前仅针对爱因斯坦引力（Einstein gravity）耦合物质的模型导出了精确的一圈JT配分函数及对数量子修正。作者希望探究该修正是否在更广泛的引力理论类别中保持普适性，并确定其失效或主导的能标具体形式。
AI.method: 通过建立D维引力理论球对称扇区与一般二维Horndeski理论间的有效对应，推导出普适的近地平线（near-horizon）有效描述，将其约化为JT引力模型。基于该对应关系及此前的一圈精确JT配分函数结果，系统推导熵的对数修正及主导能标T_breakdown的表达形式，并以Lovelock引力和拟拓扑引力（Quasitopological gravities）中的带电黑洞与正则黑洞为例验证。
AI.result: 证明了对数量子熵修正$S_{\rm JT}=\frac{3}{2}\log(T/T_{\rm breakdown})$在所有可有效描述为二维Horndeski理论的D维引力模型中成立，即该修正具有跨模型普适性。同时给出了在此修正变得主导的能标$T_{\rm breakdown}$以D维理论数据表示的一般形式。
AI.conclusion: 近极端黑洞低温动力学中的对数量子熵修正并非爱因斯坦引力的特例，而是广泛D维引力理论共有的普适特征；$T_{\rm breakdown}$的确定形式为在不同引力框架中预测量子修正的生效尺度提供了具体判别依据。Lovelock引力和拟拓扑引力中的例子进一步验证了该一般结论。

title: Semilinear wave equations on the Witten bubble spacetime
summary: We initiate the study of nonlinear wave equations on the Witten bubble spacetime (also known as the "bubble of nothing"), which is an $\mathrm{SO}(3,1)\times \mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric solution to the Einstein vacuum equations in $(4 + 1)$ dimensions. This spacetime was introduced by Witten to model the semiclassical instability of the Kaluza--Klein spacetime $\mathbf{R}^{3+1}\times S^1$ (which is classically stable by work of Huneau--Stingo--Wyatt (arXiv:2307.15267)). We prove a small-data global existence result without symmetry assumptions and an improved decay result for $\mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric solutions to a class of semilinear equations satisfying a version of the null condition. Key to the proof are novel estimates for the linear wave equation, which has been studied in the physics literature by Bhawal and Viveshwara and in the mathematics literature by Bachelot (arXiv:1601.03682).

AI.tldr: 本文首次研究威腾气泡时空（Witten bubble spacetime）上的非线性波动方程，证明了无对称假设下的小数据全局存在性，以及对满足零条件（null condition）的半线性方程在U(1)对称情形下的改进衰减结果。
AI.motivation: 威腾气泡时空是爱因斯坦真空方程的一个SO(3,1)×U(1)对称解，用于模拟Kaluza–Klein时空的半经典不稳定性。此前该时空上的线性波方程虽已在物理学和数学文献中有所研究，但非线性波动方程的动力学性质尚未被探讨过。
AI.method: 研究一类半线性波动方程在该时空背景上的柯西问题；小数据全局存在性不依赖任何对称假设，同时对满足某种零条件版本的方程在U(1)对称解类中证明改进的衰减估计。证明的核心在于为该时空上的线性波动方程发展新颖的估计。
AI.result: 在无对称假设下证明了小数据全局存在性结果；对于满足零条件版本条件的半线性方程，获得了U(1)对称解的改进衰减结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将非线性波方程的分析推广到威腾气泡时空这一非标准的几何背景下，揭示了该时空上非线性色散行为的可解性，并且所建立的线性波方程估计为后续更深入的动力学研究提供了基础工具。

title: From agent-based dynamics to a kinetic theory of jellyfish swarms
summary: Massive jellyfish swarms observed at sea can extend over tens of kilometres and contain millions of individuals, yet the mechanisms governing their formation and large-scale dynamics remain poorly understood. Agent-based models provide a framework for describing this dynamics based on jellyfish responses to ocean currents and environmental cues, but become computationally prohibitive when extended to large populations and spatial scales relevant to ocean circulation. Here we derive a continuous kinetic theory from an active-particle model of jellyfish motion. The resulting Fokker-Planck framework incorporates transport by prescribed currents, stochastic reorientation, direct interactions and stimulated steering, allowing chemical signalling to be represented through a coupled field. We further derive a hydrodynamic closure for large swarms by exploiting the separation between fast orientational and slow spatial dynamics, yielding a reduced density equation suitable for implementation in ocean-current models. This framework provides a route from individual behavioural mechanisms to continuum descriptions of jellyfish populations and establishes a basis for constraining model parameters using observations and in-situ measurements. This approach offers a theoretical foundation for future numerical prediction of large jellyfish swarm formation and evolution in realistic ocean flows.

AI.tldr: 本文从水母运动的主动粒子模型（active-particle model）出发，推导出连续的动力学理论框架，即Fokker-Planck方程，并通过对快速取向与慢速空间动力学的尺度分离，进一步推导出适用于大洋环流模型的大规模水母群水动力闭合（hydrodynamic closure）方程，为水母种群从个体行为机制到连续描述的搭建了桥梁。
AI.motivation: 海上观测到的大规模水母群可绵延数十公里并包含数百万个体，但其形成机制和大尺度动力学尚不清楚；基于个体的水母运动模型（agent-based model）虽有解释潜力，但在扩展到与海洋环流相关的大种群和空间尺度时计算上不可行。
AI.method: 从水母运动的主动粒子模型推导连续动力学理论，得到Fokker-Planck框架，该框架纳入预设洋流输运、随机重定向、直接相互作用和受刺激转向等过程，并通过耦合场表示化学信号；随后利用快速取向动力学与慢速空间动力学之间分离的时间尺度，推导大规模水母群的流体动力学闭合方程，得到可嵌入海洋流模型的降阶密度方程。
AI.result: 得到一个可用于海洋环流模型的约化密度方程，使得从个体行为机制到水母种群连续描述的转换成为可能，同时建立了利用观测和原位测量约束模型参数的框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在真实海洋流场中数值预测大规模水母群的形成与演化提供了理论基础。

title: The inverse problem of time-dependent density functional theory on the torus
summary: We prove that, for any given sufficiently regular one-particle density, there exists a unique external potential for which the solution to the many-body Schrödinger equation has this prescribed density. This implies in particular that one can exactly reproduce the time-dependent density of an interacting system using non-interacting electrons, which is at the heart of time-dependent density functional theory. Our result covers the Coulomb interaction and densities arising from extended nuclei.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对任意给定足够规则的单粒子密度（one-particle density），存在唯一的外势（external potential），使得多体薛定谔方程（many-body Schrödinger equation）的解具有该预设密度。
AI.motivation: 该结果的核心意义在于证明了可以通过无相互作用电子精确复现相互作用系统的时间依赖密度，而这正是含时密度泛函理论（time-dependent density functional theory）的基石。
AI.method: 研究采用数学严格证明的方法，面向任意给定足够规则的单粒子密度构造唯一的外部势；证明适用范围包含库仑相互作用（Coulomb interaction）以及由伸展核（extended nuclei）产生的密度情形。
AI.result: 研究证明了外势存在且唯一，并覆盖了库仑相互作用与伸展核密度等重要物理情形。
AI.conclusion: 这一唯一性结果为正则多体系统的密度-势映射提供了严格的数学基础，从而支撑含时密度泛函理论中的可表示性（representability）结论。

title: Agnostic search for a vector-like top partner at a lepton collider via the recoil mass technique
comment: v1: 15 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Comments welcome!
summary: A study of the single production of a vector-like top partner $T$ at a $\sqrt{s}=3$ TeV $e^{+}e^{-}$ collider is presented, using a decay-mode and mass-agnostic event selection built around the recoil mass observable. The analysis relies on fully simulated samples processed through a common reconstruction and event selection chain. The baseline selection is validated without beam polarization or initial-state radiation (ISR). The impact of more realistic running conditions, including ISR together with an $e^{-}$ beam polarization of $-80\%$, is then evaluated and the discovery reach is mapped as a function of the top partner mass $m_{T}$ and coupling strength $κ_{T}$. In the baseline scan, the estimated statistical significance rises above $3σ$ for the lowest benchmark masses once $κ_{T}$ exceeds approximately 0.3.

AI.tldr: 本研究在质心能量为3 TeV的e⁺e⁻对撞机上，利用基于反冲质量（recoil mass）可观测量的衰变模式和粒子质量无关的事件选择方法，研究了类矢量顶夸克伴侣（vector-like top partner）T的单产生过程，并绘制了不同质量与耦合强度参数下的发现可达性（discovery reach）。
AI.motivation: 类矢量夸克（vector-like quarks）是新物理模型中的常见预言粒子，尤其是顶夸克伴侣T。在e⁺e⁻对撞机环境下系统评估其对撞产生信号的可发现性，对于未来高能对撞机实验的物理规划具有重要意义。摘要隐含的动机是探索一种不依赖具体衰变模式的通用探测策略，以适应未知的新物理衰变拓扑。
AI.method: 分析基于完全模拟样本（fully simulated samples），通过统一的径迹重建与事件选择链进行处理。核心方法是构建围绕反冲质量可观测量的衰变模式和粒子质量无关（decay-mode and mass-agnostic）选择方案；首先在无束流极化（beam polarization）和无初态辐射（initial-state radiation, ISR）条件下验证基线选择，随后评估包含ISR及-80%电子束极化的更现实运行条件的影响。
AI.result: 根据摘要，在最基准的扫描（baseline scan）中，对于较低的基准质量点（benchmark masses），当耦合强度κ_T超过约0.3时，估计的统计显著性（statistical significance）上升至超过3σ。此外，论文给出了发现可达性作为顶夸克伴侣质量m_T与耦合强度κ_T函数的映射关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在3 TeV e⁺e⁻对撞机上利用反冲质量方法探测类矢量顶夸克伴侣T的可行性，并定量给出了在特定耦合强度和质量范围内达到3σ显著性以上信号的条件，为该类新物理搜索的实验设计提供了参考依据。

title: SolutionsX: supergravity theories/solutions as code, with an agentic workflow for machine-verifiable physics
summary: A supergravity solution in the literature is an artifact that cannot be verified without re-deriving it: conventions might not be clearly stated, papers have typos, algebra is tedious. SolutionsX is a Mathematica package that turns an xAct environment, whatever physics it may describe, into a stored, machine-verifiable record: code that replays in a fresh kernel, carries its own verification, and can later be fetched for re-use or extension. The shipped examples are supergravity theories and their solutions, but the scope is anything xAct reaches: abstract tensors, differential forms, spinors in any dimension. We follow one published solution through the entire workflow, benchmark the package's component engine against xAct's, and report on three blind runs of an agentic workflow in which an AI coding agent, given the package and a small toolkit, correctly codified a recent paper in under three hours. A database of such records is useful to researchers today and gives agents worked examples to learn from. The package acts as an internal verifier during the thought process of an agent: a claim is checked in the kernel before it is made.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SolutionsX，一个基于 Mathematica 的软件包，可将 xAct 环境中的物理计算转化为机器可验证的存储记录，具备可重放、自带验证、便于复用或扩展的特点。该包涵盖超引力（supergravity）等各类在 xAct 可达范围内的物理内容，并展示了 AI 编码代理在数小时内正确编码最新论文的能力。
AI.motivation: 文献中的超引力（supergravity）解属于难以验证的产物，因为约定可能未明确说明、论文存在笔误、代数过程繁琐乏味，导致无法在不重新推导的前提下加以核实。研究旨在解决这一可验证性与可复现性问题。
AI.method: 作者开发了 SolutionsX 这一 Mathematica 包，将任何 xAct 所描述的物理内容转化为存储的、机器可验证的记录形式：代码可在全新内核（fresh kernel）中重放、自带验证机制，并可被检索以供复用或扩展。论文跟随一个已发表的解走完整工作流，将包的组件引擎（component engine）与 xAct 的性能进行基准对比，并报告了三轮基于代理的无监督（agentic）工作流盲测。
AI.result: 基准测试结果表明 SolutionsX 的组件引擎性能可与 xAct 相媲美；三盲测试中，AI 编码代理在给定包和小型工具集后，能在三小时内正确编码一篇近期论文。此外，该类记录构成的数据库对当今研究者具有实用价值。
AI.conclusion: SolutionsX 不仅可作为研究者复用和扩展的计算记录仓库，还能在 AI 代理的思考过程中充当内部验证器，使任何主张在被提出之前先在计算内核中得到验证，从而为代理提供工作示例以供学习。

title: Shadows and Thin-Disk Images of Kerr-Newman Black Holes in a Bertotti-Robinson Magnetic Field
summary: In this paper, we investigate the optical properties of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson (KN-BR) black holes. We use the separability of null geodesics to analyze unstable spherical photon orbits and determine the radial extent of the photon shell. Because the spacetime is not asymptotically flat, we construct the critical curve on the screen of a finite-distance zero-angular-momentum observer. We then perform backward ray tracing for a geometrically thin and optically thin disk that extends from the outer region to the event horizon, and examine the resulting images, intensity profiles, critical-curve areas, and inner-shadow areas. We find that the genuine neutral Kerr-BR$_0$ and specially charged Kerr-BR$_s$ configurations have nearly identical optical appearances. It is remarkable that for the KN-BR black holes increasing the electric charge reduces the characteristic image size in the Kerr-Newman limit but enlarges it in the magnetized configurations considered here. We also find that the external magnetic field strongly increases the apparent image scale, while the observer inclination affects the inner-shadow area more significantly than the critical-curve area. These results may provide useful theoretical insight for future observations aimed at identifying such exotic magnetized black holes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson（KN-BR）黑洞的光学性质，利用零测地线可分性分析不稳定球形光子轨道及光子壳的径向范围，并对有限距离零角动量观测者屏幕上的临界曲线进行后向光线追踪，比较了电荷和外部磁场对成像特征的影响。
AI.motivation: KN-BR黑洞作为非渐近平坦的奇异磁化黑洞构型，其光学观测特征尚未被充分理解，研究其成像特性可为未来识别此类天体提供理论依据。
AI.method: 利用零测地线的可分性（separability）分析不稳定球形光子轨道并确定光子壳（photon shell）的径向范围；由于时空非渐近平坦，在有限距离零角动量观测者屏幕上构造临界曲线（critical curve）；对从外部区域延伸到事件视界的几何薄且光学薄吸积盘执行后向光线追踪（backward ray tracing），分析图像、强度分布和临界曲线面积。
AI.result: 中性Kerr-BR₀与带电Kerr-BRₛ构型的光学外观几乎相同；对KN-BR黑洞而言，在Kerr-Newman极限下增加电荷使特征图像尺寸减小，但在所考察的磁化构型中则使其增大；外部磁场显著放大表观图像尺度，观测者倾角对内部阴影面积的影响大于对临界曲线面积的影响。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果可为未来识别此类奇异磁化黑洞的观测提供有价值的理论参考。

title: A magneto-mechanical gyroscope with spintronic readout
summary: Gyroscopes are essential elements in navigation, consumer electronics, robotics, and aerospace applications. Most micro electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) implementations rely on capacitive sensing mechanisms, which limit the dimensional scaling to the micrometer scale. In this work, we introduce a MEMS-like two-degree-of-freedom (2-DOF) gyroscope that exploits the rectification functionality of magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) as its readout mechanism and as the transducer of the mechanical dynamics. Experimentally characterized MTJs have been used to calibrate and perform an experiment-informed design of the magneto-mechanical model combining micromagnetic theory with 2-DOF mechanical equations. We demonstrated that the output is linear with angular rate, and that the proposed device is able to extract the angular rate in dynamic cases exploiting a homodyne demodulation approach. The results open a path towards a compact, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS)-compatible readout pathway that relaxes reliance on tight capacitive gaps and motivates multi-physics designs of the device.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于磁隧道结（magnetic tunnel junctions, MTJs）整流功能作为读出机制的类MEMS二自由度陀螺仪，结合微磁学理论与二自由度力学方程进行实验知情的磁-机械模型设计，并采用零差解调（homodyne demodulation）方法实现在动态工况下对角速度的线性提取，开辟了紧凑型、兼容互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）工艺的读出路径。
AI.motivation: 大多数微机电系统（MEMS）陀螺仪依赖电容式传感机制，其尺度缩放受限于微米量级，无法进一步小型化。因此需要探索替代现有电容读出机理的新型传感方案，以突破尺寸限制并提高集成度。
AI.method: 作者引入一个类MEMS的二自由度（2-DOF）陀螺仪，利用磁隧道结的整流（rectification）功能作为读出机制和机械动力学的换能器，采用实验表征的MTJs进行校准，并基于实验数据对结合微磁学（micromagnetic）理论与二自由度力学方程的磁-机械模型进行设计优化，最后通过零差解调方法提取角速度。
AI.result: 实验证明该装置的输出与角速度呈线性关系，并能在动态工况下通过零差解调方法成功提取角速度信号。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为紧凑型、与CMOS工艺兼容的读出路径开辟了道路，降低了对严苛电容间隙的依赖，并推动了器件的多物理场（multi-physics）协同设计。

title: The double sphere solution in the liquid drop model
summary:
We consider the problem of finding critical domains $Ω\subset{\mathbb R}^3$ for the energy functional
  $$
  \mathcal E (Ω) = {\rm Per}\,(Ω) + \frac 12 \iint_{Ω\times Ω} \frac{dx\,dy}{|x-y|}
  $$
  under the volume constraint $|Ω|=V$.
  We look for smooth, embedded, compact surfaces $\partialΩ$ that solve this problem. We construct an axially symmetric, non-minimizing solution that, for a sufficiently small $V>0$, resembles the union of two balls with volume $V/2$ connected by a tiny, approximately catenoidal neck with a width of the order $V^{\frac 43}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三维空间中能量泛函在体积约束下的临界域存在性问题，构造了一个轴对称为非最小、嵌入光滑解，该解在小体积情形下类似两个等体积小球通过一个宽度约为V^(4/3)的微小近悬链面形（catenoidal）颈部连接而成。
AI.motivation: 研究带体积约束的能量泛函的临界域（critical domain）问题，即求某体积下使表面积与长程相互作用势能之和取驻值的光滑嵌入紧致曲面。该问题在液体表面与位相分离（phase separation）等物理背景下有重要意义。
AI.method: 在三维欧氏空间R^3中，考虑具有给定体积V的临界域问题，采用轴向对称构型构造解，并针对充分小的V进行渐近分析，构造由两个体积各为V/2的小球经细颈连接的曲面结构，颈部宽度量级为V^(4/3)。
AI.result: 构造了轴向对称、非极小（non-minimizing）的光滑嵌入解。当V>0充分小时，该解在几何上表现为两个体积各为V/2的小球，由一个量级为V^(4/3)宽度的近似悬链面形细颈连接。
AI.conclusion: 该轴向对称解表明，在体积足够小的情形下，上述能量泛函存在非极小的临界情形，其形态呈现"双球+细颈"结构。该结果对理解泛函的临界点性质及几何结构具有理论意义。

title: AI in Particle Physics Education: Research Problems and Foundational Skills
summary: Generative AI can produce perfect solutions to standard physics homework, weakening the connection between submitted work and knowledge a student can use independently. We report a redesign of the introductory nuclear and particle physics course at Ruhr University Bochum, in which AI was permitted and encouraged alongside traditional tools on unusually difficult, research-shaped assignments. We found that most students remained engaged with the assignments throughout the course and produced ambitious work, while the course did not reliably secure its foundational objective. We offer this mixed experience as a reference point for discussion.

AI.tldr: 本研究报告了鲁尔大学波鸿分校（Ruhr University Bochum）对本科核物理与粒子物理导论课程的重设计，在该课程中人工智能（AI）被允许并鼓励与传统工具并用，用于完成异常困难、具有研究形态的作业。结果显示大多数学生在整个课程中保持参与并产出宏大的工作，但课程未能可靠地实现其基础教学目标，作者将此混杂经验作为讨论参考点。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能（generative AI）能够完美解决标准物理作业，削弱了提交作业与学生能独立运用的知识之间的联系，因此亟需重新设计课程作业以维护教学评估的有效性。
AI.method: 对鲁尔大学波鸿分校的核物理与粒子物理导论课程进行教学重设计，允许并鼓励学生在异常困难、呈研究形态（research-shaped）的作业中同时使用AI与传统工具完成学习任务。
AI.result: 大多数学生在整个课程期间始终保持对作业的投入，并产出了有雄心（ambitious）的成果；但该课程未能可靠地确保其基础性教学目标（foundational objective）的实现。
AI.conclusion: 作者将这一兼具正面与顾虑的教学经验作为课程设计参考点提出，供学界进一步讨论AI在物理教育中的角色与边界。

title: Unitary quantum conformal Bondi-Metzner-Sachs field theories
summary: We impose unitarity constraints on two-dimensional field theories whose symmetries form the quantum conformal Bondi-Metzner-Sachs algebra, which combines conformal symmetries with asymptotic symmetries of asymptotically flat spacetimes. Positivity constraints put bounds on the central charge, 0<c<2.053. Positivity of the associated vertex algebra allows only four central charges, c = 1, 3/2, 13/7, 2. Thus, only four candidates for unitary field theories remain. We calculate their spectra of primaries and show that they are compatible with BPS-like and holographic inequalities.

AI.tldr: 本文对具有量子共形Bondi-Metzner-Sachs代数对称性的二维场论施加幺正性约束，通过正定性条件将中心荷限定为四个候选值（c = 1, 3/2, 13/7, 2），并验证这些理论的初级场谱与BPS型及全息不等式相容。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在探索同时具有共形对称性与渐近平坦时空渐近对称性的二维场论中，哪些理论能够满足幺正性（unitarity）要求，从而筛选出物理上可接受的候选理论。
AI.method: 对对称性由量子共形Bondi-Metzner-Sachs代数（quantum conformal Bondi-Metzner-Sachs algebra）描述的二维场论施加幺正性约束，利用正定性（positivity）条件约束中心荷（central charge）的取值范围，并通过顶点代数（vertex algebra）的正定性进一步筛选离散的中心荷候选值。
AI.result: 正定性约束将中心荷限制在0 < c < 2.053的范围内；顶点代数的正定性进一步将中心荷限定为四个数值：c = 1, 3/2, 13/7, 2，从而仅保留四个幺正场论候选。计算这些理论的初级场谱后，确认其与BPS型不等式（BPS-like inequalities）及全息不等式（holographic inequalities）相容。
AI.conclusion: 在量子共形Bondi-Metzner-Sachs对称性框架下，仅存在四个满足幺正性的二维场论候选，其中心荷为c = 1, 3/2, 13/7, 2，这些理论的谱满足BPS型与全息约束。

title: Physics-based phenomenological modeling of binary black hole hierarchical formation 2: Autodifferentiable functional inference of hierarchical compact-binary populations
summary: The gravitational-wave (GW) census contains mass and spin structure consistent with contributions from black holes assembled through repeated mergers in dense environments. Connecting that structure to formation physics requires models that are both physically interpretable and tractable within population inference. We construct an autodifferentiable, physics-based phenomenological model in which each dense environment is represented by a coagulation response and a population of such environments produces an observable merger-rate density. Embedded in the gwkokab Poisson-likelihood framework, this model enables joint inference of natal-population and interaction parameters from the GW census. Applied to GWTC-5.0, the framework shows why simple pairwise coagulation models struggle to reproduce the observed high-mass, comparable-mass population and tests alternative interaction structures against the data, while retaining an explicitly modeled natal component.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于自动微分的物理可解释现象学模型（phenomenological model）用于引力波（gravitational-wave, GW）事件普查中黑洞群体结构的形成物理学推断。该模型将每个致密环境表示为凝聚响应（coagulation response），嵌入gwkokab泊松似然框架中，实现了从GW事件目录中对初始群体和相互作用参数的联合推断，并应用于GWTC-5.0数据以检验不同相互作用结构。
AI.motivation: 引力波事件普查中观测到的质量与自旋结构表明黑洞可能通过在致密环境中反复并合（repeated mergers）形成，但将这种结构与具体形成物理联系起来需要既具备物理可解释性、又能在群体推断（population inference）中保持可处理性的模型，而简单的两两凝聚模型难以再现观测到的高质量、近等质量（comparable-mass）群体。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个基于自动微分（autodifferentiable）的物理学可解释现象学模型，其中每个致密环境由一个凝聚响应表示，多个此类环境群体共同产生可观测的并合率密度（merger-rate density）。该模型嵌入gwkokab泊松似然（Poisson-likelihood）框架中，能够对源于初始群体（natal population）的参数与相互作用参数进行联合推断。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于GWTC-5.0数据集后，研究展示了简单两两凝聚（pairwise coagulation）模型为何难以再现观测到的高质量、近等质量黑洞群体，并通过数据检验了替代性的相互作用结构，同时明确保留了可显式建模的初始形成分量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种兼具物理可解释性与推断可处理性的建模路径，能够连接观测到的黑洞质量-自旋结构与致密环境中的并合形成物理，为检验不同的凝聚相互作用假设提供了数据驱动的框架。

title: Spectroscopy With Intelligent Feature Tracking for automated characterization of excited-state structure in semiconductor quantum dot devices
summary: The characterization of excited-state structure in semiconductor quantum dot (QD) devices is an important component of tuning them for spin-qubit operation. We present Spectroscopy With Intelligent Feature Tracking (SWIFT), a framework that combines machine-learning (ML)-assisted feature identification with physics-informed geometric processing to extract energy-level splittings from pulsed-gate spectroscopy data. SWIFT isolates the relevant spectral features and exploits their characteristic geometry to reduce the two-dimensional spectroscopy analysis to a one-dimensional peak-detection problem. It further combines an ensemble-based confidence metric with sequential accumulation of rapid, low-SNR scans, allowing the inferred spectrum to be reevaluated as experimental evidence accumulates. Using Si/SiGe QD devices, we demonstrate SWIFT both offline and in real time, including automated tracking of QD excited states and lead resonances. Benchmarking on 255 manually labeled scans shows that SWIFT reduces the median splitting error to 0.05 mV from 0.11 mV for a classical baseline, with the largest improvement on lower-quality measurements. These results provide a path toward incorporating excited-state spectroscopy into autonomous QD characterization, tuning, and optimization, which will be essential in large-scale quantum dot devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SWIFT（Spectroscopy With Intelligent Feature Tracking）的框架，将机器学习辅助特征识别与物理信息几何处理相结合，用于从脉冲门控光谱数据中提取半导体量子点（quantum dot）器件的能级劈裂。该方法在Si/SiGe量子点器件上实现了离线和实时演示，并通过255个手动标注扫描的基准测试表明其将中位劈裂误差从经典基线的0.11 mV降至0.05 mV。
AI.motivation: 半导体量子点器件中激发态结构的表征是调控自旋量子比特（spin-qubit）操作的重要环节，而现有方法在处理大量低信噪比光谱数据时精度有限，难以满足大规模量子点器件对自主表征与调优的需求。
AI.method: SWIFT框架首先利用机器学习辅助的特征识别将相关光谱特征分离出来，然后借助这些特征特有的几何结构，将二维光谱分析降维为一维峰值检测问题。此外，该方法结合了基于集成模型的置信度指标，并通过对快速低信噪比扫描的序列累积允许推断谱随实验证据积累而被重新评估。
AI.result: 在Si/SiGe量子点器件上，SWIFT在离线和实时两种模式下均得到验证，能够自动跟踪量子点激发态及铅共振（lead resonances）。对255个手动标注的扫描进行基准测试显示，SWIFT将中位劈裂误差从经典基线的0.11 mV降至0.05 mV，且在低质量测量数据上改善最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为将激发态光谱学整合到自主量子点表征、调谐和优化流程中提供了可行路径，这对未来大规模量子点器件的开发至关重要。

title: Remarks on Fixed- and Variable-Order Fractional-Laplacian Closures for TurbulentDissipation
summary: Two independent attempts, separated by two decades, to encode turbulent dissipation with a fractional Laplacian both converge on the operator order as the signature of the fully developedinertial range: the additive, fixed order model, and the dynamically deforming operator of the Adaptive Fractional Navier Stokes. We show that, despite sharing this fixed point, the two constructions belongto distinct universality classes: Chen operator is a superposition of two fixed order kernels whose relative weight drifts with scale, while AFNS posits a single operator whose order itself flows continuously with the local Reynolds number. We derive a scale resolved observable, the effective spectral order, whose logarithmic anomaly term discriminates between these two mechanisms in principle, and then obtain a sharper, purely analytic verdict from the two dimensional, enstrophy conserving limit: the generative mechanism matching a stable process index to the empirical pair dispersion law has no solution once vortex stretching is kinematically switched off. Whether this dichotomy leaves a residual signature in real quasi two dimensional flows is left as an open experimental challenge.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了两种用分数阶拉普拉斯算子（fractional Laplacian）刻画湍流耗散（turbulent dissipation）的独立模型——固定阶加性模型与自适应分数阶纳维-斯托克斯（Adaptive Fractional Navier-Stokes, AFNS）模型，指出二者虽共享算子阶这一不动点（fixed point），却属于不同的普适类（universality class）。通过二维涡度守恒极限下的解析分析，作者证明当涡旋拉伸（vortex stretching）被运动学关闭时，匹配稳定过程指数与经验对扩散定律的生成机制无解，从而在原则上给出了二者的判别准则。
AI.motivation: 湍流耗散的分数阶算子表示中存在两种独立、间隔二十年的构建方案，均收敛到相同的算子阶作为全展开惯性区（fully developed inertial range）的标志，但其深层机制关系尚未被厘清，需要判定二者是否属于同一物理类别。
AI.method: 作者首先指出Chen算子是将两个固定阶核（fixed order kernels）进行叠加，其相对权重随尺度漂移；而AFNS则主张单个算子，其阶数本身随局部雷诺数（local Reynolds number）连续流动。随后推导了尺度分辨可观测量"有效谱阶"（effective spectral order），利用其对数反常（logarithmic anomaly）项在原理上区分两种机制，并进一步在二维保涡度极限下进行纯解析判定。
AI.result: 所得的解析结论表明：当涡旋拉伸被运动学关闭（即二维情形）时，将稳定过程指数（stable process index）匹配到经验对扩散（pair dispersion）定律的生成机制不存在解，这为两种模型的普适类区分提供了更明确的解析证据。是否在真实准二维流动中残留可观测差异，则留作开放的实验问题。
AI.conclusion: 尽管两种模型共享算子阶不动点，但它们分别属于不同的普适类，可通过尺度分辨的有效谱阶及其对数反常项在原则上加以判别，并获得二维极限下更严格的解析区分。实验验证仍是未来挑战。

authors: Yury Melikyan for the ALICE Collaboration
title: Long-term performance of non-ALD MCP-PMTs in the high-radiation environment of ALICE
comment: Material of the 12th International workshop on Ring Imaging Cherenkov Detectors (RICH2025)
summary: The Fast Interaction Trigger detector of the ALICE apparatus at the LHC includes a Cherenkov subsystem utilizing 52 Planacon XP85002/FIT-Q microchannel plate-based photomultiplier tubes. It is a precise trigger, multiplicity and luminosity detector located in the forward region, where the flux of collision products is the largest. The photon load reaches up to 2*10^8 photoelectrons / cm^2 / s for the innermost photosensors, corresponding to 0.4 μA / cm^2 average anode current density. The lifetime-extended version of the Planacon MCP-PMT with atomic layer deposition cannot handle such a large anode current. We therefore use the non-ALD version of the Planacons that, on the other hand, suffer from a limited lifetime in terms of the integrated anode charge. Here we present the long-term performance trends of the non-ALD Planacons up to the integrated anode charge of 2 C / cm^2. We demonstrate that the low-gain operation strategy allows to maintain excellent time resolution in multiphoton mode unchanged up to that large integrated charge. While the majority of the equally illuminated MCP-PMTs feature almost identical ageing speed, two outliers suffering from a faster ageing coincide with the outliers in the noise characteristics measured prior to the irradiation. Moreover, we report that the effective ageing speed is partially suppressed by the self-recovery of the response of aged MCP-PMTs newly observed by our group during months-long no-beam periods.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了ALICE装置中Fast Interaction Trigger探测器的Cherenkov子系统所使用52只非ALD版本Planacon XP85002/FIT-Q MCP-PMT在累计阳极电荷达2 C/cm²条件下的长期性能趋势，证明低增益运行策略可在该大累计电荷下维持多光子模式中优良的时间分辨率，同时观察到多数探测器老化速度几乎一致，而两个加速老化的异常探测器与其辐照前的噪声特征异常一致；此外还报告了在无束流数月的停机期间，老化MCP-PMT响应出现部分自恢复现象。
AI.motivation: ALICE的Fast Interaction Trigger探测器位于前向区域，其最内圈光电传感器面临高达2×10^8 光电子/cm²/s的光子负载（对应0.4 μA/cm²平均阳极电流密度）。由于具备原子层沉积（atomic layer deposition）寿命延长版本的Planacon MCP-PMT无法承受如此大的阳极电流，必须改用非ALD版本，但后者以累计阳极电荷衡量的寿命有限，因此需要评估其长期运行性能。
AI.method: 对LHC中ALICE装置Fast Interaction Trigger探测器内52只非ALD版Planacon XP85002/FIT-Q微通道板光电倍增管（MCP-PMT）进行了长期运行监测，跟踪其性能随累计阳极电荷（最高达2 C/cm²）的变化趋势，并对比了不同探测器在同等光照条件下的老化速度及其辐照前的噪声特征。
AI.result: 低增益运行策略使得MCP-PMT在多光子模式下的优异时间分辨率在累计阳极电荷达2 C/cm²时保持不变；多数接受同等光照的MCP-PMT老化速度几乎一致，但两个老化更快的异常探测器与其辐照前测量的噪声特征异常吻合；此外发现老化MCP-PMT的响应在数月无束流停机期间出现了部分自恢复，从而部分抑制了有效老化速度。
AI.conclusion: 非ALD版本Planacon MCP-PMT通过低增益策略可在LHC前向高辐照环境中保持稳定时间性能以满足触发需求，其老化行为具有均匀性且存在可预测性的个体差异（可通过辐照前噪声特征鉴别），同时自恢复现象表明停机间隙对延长探测器寿命具有正面作用。

title: Diffeomorphism-invariant Approach to Asymptotically Safe Quantum Gravity
summary: We provide a novel diffeomorphism-invariant approach to asymptotically safe metric quantum gravity. It is based on physics-informed renormalisation group flows with a renormalisation group kernel that guarantees diffeomorphism invariance at each renormalisation group step. Importantly, it also allows us to control and maintain the relevance counting of operators in metric quantum gravity. The resulting effective action is quantum diffeomorphism-invariant and background-independent. As a first non-trivial application, we compute the Reuter fixed point in a manifestly diffeomorphism-invariant way. This computation is augmented with a detailed discussion of regularisation dependence and a systematic estimate of the errors arising from approximations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的微分同胚不变（diffeomorphism-invariant）方法来研究渐近安全（asymptotically safe）度规量子引力，基于物理信息重整化群流（physics-informed renormalisation group flows），并通过重整化群核保证每一步的微分同胚不变性，从而维持算子相关性计数。作为首次非平凡应用，以显式微分同胚不变方式计算了Reuter不动点（Reuter fixed point），并详细讨论了正则化依赖性与近似误差估计。
AI.motivation: 传统渐近安全度规量子引力研究中，如何保持重整化群流程中的微分同胚不变性及其算子相关性计数的一致性是一个核心理论挑战，本文旨在提供一种克服该困难的系统性方案。
AI.method: 提出基于物理信息重整化群流的微分同胚不变新方法，通过设计专门的重整化群核（renormalisation group kernel），确保每个重整化群步骤均保持微分同胚不变性，并可控地维持算子在度规量子引力中的相关性计数；所得有效作用量（effective action）具有量子微分同胚不变性与背景无关性（background-independence）。
AI.result: 以显式微分同胚不变方式计算了Reuter不动点，并辅以正则化依赖性的详细讨论以及由近似引入的系统性误差估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为渐近安全度规量子引力提供了可保持微分同胚不变性与背景无关性的重整化群框架，并通过Reuter不动点的计算验证了其可行性，同时给出了对正则化与近似误差的定量认识。

title: Dissection of a merger-ringdown waveform in the small-mass-ratio limit
summary: Work over the past two decades has unveiled the rich phenomenology of black hole binary mergers and subsequent ringdowns, involving a tapestry of quasinormal modes (QNMs), nonlinearities, tails, transients, and secular effects including gravitational memory. Here we develop a framework for analyzing nonlinear merger-ringdown features in the small-mass-ratio limit, where individual effects can be cleanly isolated. Specializing to the case of a quasicircular, nonspinning black hole binary, we find the waveform sharply divides into a pre-merger extended inspiral phase, a merger phase lasting roughly half a cycle, and a post-merger ringdown dominated by QNMs. We show quadratic QNMs dominate over linear overtones in the ringdown phase for comparable-to-intermediate mass ratios, and we highlight nonlinear effects of gravitational-wave memory, including cubic wave-zone phenomena analogous to horizon absorption effects.

AI.tldr: 本文在小质量比极限（small-mass-ratio limit）下建立了一个分析黑洞并合与衰减振荡（ringdown）非线性结构的框架，发现波形可清晰划分为极早期旋近（inspiral）、约半个周期的并合段以及以准正则模（quasinormal modes, QNMs）为主的后期衰减。研究显示在可比至中等质量比下，二次准正则模在线性泛音中占主导，并强调了引力波记忆（gravitational-wave memory）的非线性效应。
AI.motivation: 过去二十年的研究揭示了黑洞双星并合及其后续振铃的丰富现象学，涉及准正则模、非线性效应、尾部、瞬态和包括引力记忆在内的长期效应；需要一个框架来分离和孤立分析这些效应，以便深入理解其物理机制。
AI.method: 在小质量比极限下建立分析非线性并合-振铃特征的框架，在该极限下各独立效应可以被清晰分离。具体研究场景为近圆（quasicircular）、无自旋（nonspinning）黑洞双星，通过波形时间结构划分不同并合阶段并分析各阶段的模贡献。
AI.result: 发现波形可明确分为三阶段：并合前的延伸旋近相、持续约半个循环周期的并合相、以及由准正则模主导的并合后振铃相。在可比至中等质量比条件下，二次准正则模（quadratic QNMs）在振铃相中超越线性泛音（linear overtones）占据主导，还发现了包括三次波区（cubic wave-zone）现象在内的与视界吸收（horizon absorption）类比的新非线性引力记忆效应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在小质量比极限下系统隔离并分析并合-振铃过程中的各类非线性效应，揭示了二次准正则模的主导地位以及引力波记忆的新型非线性特征，为深入理解黑洞双星并合波形提供了新的分析工具。

title: Hidden amplitude and dynamical information in phase-separation spectra
summary: Framewise variance normalization removes fluctuation amplitude from an observation, but not from the dynamics that generate later patterns. The current normalized spectrum therefore need not determine its own future. We study this effect in three two-dimensional phase-separation models that change transport, add active driving, or suppress large-scale separation. For paired initial fields, their normalized spectra evolve identically in the linear regime. The restoring model provides an exact example: damping does not directly change how the normalized spectrum evolves when both equations are applied to the same field. It nevertheless changes the hidden amplitude, which alters the later nonlinear shape. An exact comparison separates the immediate effect of changing the equation from the effect of reaching a different state through earlier evolution. It also reveals strong cancellation between these effects in the mobility and active models. As a practical test, spectral histories improve classification by about 4-6 percentage points at several later observation windows, although the gain depends on quench depth and spectral construction. Temporal spectra can therefore reveal dynamical consequences of information absent from every individual normalized frame.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在二维相分离模型中，逐帧归一化（framewise variance normalization）会剔除观测幅值信息但无法剔除动力学中的幅值信息，从而使归一化谱无法决定其自身未来。作者通过三种模型对比、精确解析比较和实际分类测试，证明了时间序列谱（temporal spectra）可以揭示单帧归一化谱中缺失的动力学信息。
AI.motivation: 逐帧方差归一化可以消除观测的涨落幅度，但无法消除生成后续图案的动力学中所携带的幅度信息。本文旨在厘清一个核心问题：当前的归一化谱本身是否足以决定其自身的未来演化，并探索归一化后是否仍可通过时间序列数据探测到动力学信息的传递。
AI.method: 作者在二维相分离（phase separation）框架下考察了三种模型：改变输运机制（mobility）、加入活性驱动（active driving）、以及抑制大尺度分离（restoring）。对配对的初始场比较其归一化谱在线性区间的演化；利用restoring模型构造精确可解例子，将"改变方程本身的即时效应"与"经由不同历史演化到达不同状态的效应"分离；最后以谱历史（spectral history）作为特征进行实际分类测试。
AI.result: 在线性区间，配对的初始场归一化谱演化保持一致。restoring模型精确证明：阻尼并不直接改变同一场上的归一化谱演化方程，但会改变隐藏幅值，从而显著影响后续非线性阶段的形状；精确比较显示mobility和活性模型中上述两种效应之间存在强烈抵消。分类实验中，谱历史在多个后期观测窗口将分类准确率提升约4–6个百分点，增益取决于淬火深度（quench depth）和谱构造方式。
AI.conclusion: 归一化并未消除动力学中的幅度信息，时间维度的谱演化和谱历史能够揭示每帧归一化观测中缺失的动力学信息。这一发现对依赖逐帧归一化的时间序列分析具有实际指导意义。

title: Symmetry Promotion in Electromagnetism
summary: A symmetric distribution of charges or currents typically produces an electromagnetic field having the same symmetry group. However, under special circumstances we show that a discrete symmetry of the source distribution leads to a larger continuous symmetry for the resulting field in restricted regions. The conditions for this promotion from discrete to continuous symmetry are that the fields be affine linear and the symmetry of the source distribution act irreducibly on the ambient space. We illustrate this effect with many examples. This phenomenon is pedagogically interesting both as a source of inspiration in electro- and magnetostatics and as an accessible example of group representation theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电磁场中的对称性提升现象：在源分布具有离散对称性且场满足仿射线性条件时，受限区域内的电磁场可获得更大的连续对称性，并通过多个实例加以验证。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在揭示一个反直觉的物理现象——源的离散对称性在特定条件下可"升级"为场的连续对称性，这一现象对静电磁学教学和群表示论示例均有重要价值。
AI.method: 作者通过理论分析给出对称性从离散提升为连续的两个充分条件：场必须为仿射线性（affine linear），且源分布的对称性需在环境空间上不可约作用（irreducibly act）。随后用大量实例进行演示说明。
AI.result: 研究表明，在满足上述两个条件的特殊情形下，离散对称的电荷或电流分布可在受限区域内产生具有更大连续对称群的电磁场。
AI.conclusion: 该现象在静电学与静磁学中具有教学启发性，同时可作为群表示论（group representation theory）的一个易于理解的实例。

title: Simulation Study of the Design and Spatial Resolution of a Novel AC-coupled Cross Strip LGAD
summary: AC-coupled Low Gain Avalanche Diode (AC-LGAD), evolved from the standard LGAD technology, are silicon detectors characterized by exceptional temporal and spatial resolutions. This work proposes a novel sensor named AC-coupled Cross Strip LGAD (CS-LGAD) structure with dual-layered overlapping strip electrodes. It can achieve two-dimensional particle position measurement with low readout density while also inheriting the high temporal resolution of the LGAD. The sensor structure, doping and current-voltage (I-V) characteristics of the sensor were investigated through TCAD simulations. Additionally, Monte Carlo simulations were employed to simulate the signal response of CS-LGAD to minimum ionizing particles (MIPs). The response of MIPs hitting different positions was simulated, and the reconstruction of particle coordinates (x and y) was achieved based on the sharing of charges on the dual-layer electrodes. The spatial resolution might reach 3.6% and 5.5% of the pitch size in the x and y directions, respectively, according to the simulation. The proposed CS-LGAD is a promising 4D detector with low mass and low readout density.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为交流耦合交叉条带LGAD（AC-coupled Cross Strip LGAD, CS-LGAD）的新型硅探测器结构，采用双层重叠条带电极实现二维粒子位置测量，并继承LGAD的高时间分辨能力。通过TCAD和蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）模拟验证了其结构、掺杂、I-V特性及对最小电离粒子（MIP）的信号响应，结果显示空间分辨率分别可达x方向pitch尺寸的3.6%和y方向的5.5%，是一种有前景的低质量、低读出密度的四维探测器。
AI.motivation: 标准低增益雪崩二极管（LGAD）技术虽具备优异的时间分辨率，但通常需要密集读出才能实现二维位置测量。本文旨在提出一种新结构，在保持高时间分辨率的同时，以低读出密度实现二维粒子位置测量，从而满足未来粒子物理实验对高性能四维（4D）探测器的需求。
AI.method: 本研究提出了CS-LGAD传感器结构，该结构由交流耦合低增益雪崩二极管（AC-LGAD）演化而来，采用双层重叠条带电极设计。作者通过TCAD仿真研究传感器的结构、掺杂和电流-电压（I-V）特性，并利用蒙特卡洛模拟仿真CS-LGAD对最小电离粒子（MIP）的信号响应；通过模拟MIP入射不同位置时双层电极上的电荷分配，实现了粒子坐标（x和y）的重建。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，该探测器在x和y方向的空间分辨率分别可达pitch尺寸的3.6%和5.5%，验证了基于双层电极上电荷共享机制进行粒子坐标重建的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CS-LGAD是一种有前景的四维探测器方案，兼具低质量和低读出密度的优势，可同时实现高时间分辨率和二维位置测量能力。

title: Truncated Polyakov bootstrap for BCFTs: Neumann-Dirichlet flow and Ising special transition
summary: We extend the recently proposed truncated Polyakov bootstrap to boundary conformal field theories (BCFTs). The formalism uses the analytic functional framework to find approximate solutions of BCFT crossing. We show that a generic nonperturbative solution can be identified by relating it to a family of deformations around generalized free fields (GFF) with a fixed boundary condition. We show this by tracking the flow of BCFT data from GFF with Neumann boundary condition to that with Dirichlet. The same method is then used for the 3d Ising special transition, using the perturbative Wilson-Fisher description as the deformation to identify it. The BCFT data obtained are in remarkable agreement with existing lattice results where available, and are otherwise new.

AI.tldr: 本文将截断Polyakov自举（truncated Polyakov bootstrap）方法推广到边界共形场论（BCFT），通过解析泛函框架近似求解BCFT交叉方程。研究发现，通解可被视为围绕固定边界条件的广义自由场（GFF）的一族形变，并据此追踪了从Neumann边界条件到Dirichlet边界条件的数据流动；该方法还被用于3维Ising特殊跃迁，得到的BCFT数据与已有格点结果高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是将近期提出的截断Polyakov自举方法扩展到边界共形场论，以克服精确求解BCFT交叉方程的困难，为这类理论提供一种非微扰的近似求解工具。
AI.method: 采用解析泛函框架求解BCFT交叉方程的近似解；将一般非微扰解通过与围绕固定边界条件的广义自由场形变族相关联来加以识别；通过追踪BCFT数据从Neumann边界条件的广义自由场到Dirichlet边界条件的流动来实现这一过程；随后利用微扰Wilson-Fisher描述作为形变来识别3维Ising特殊跃迁。
AI.result: 成功用该方法识别出同时包含Neumann与Dirichlet边界条件广义自由场BCFT解及其数据集；在3维Ising特殊跃迁的应用中获得的BCFT数据与已有的格点（lattice）计算结果表现出显著的一致性，在没有格点结果的场合则提供了新的预测。
AI.conclusion: 截断Polyakov自举方法能够有效推广至BCFT，并可借助广义自由场周围的形变来系统地定位和识别非微扰BCFT解；该方法在3维Ising特殊跃迁中的成功验证表明其具有可靠性，且能提供全新的BCFT数据结果。

title: The Dynamical Instability of Rotating Boson Stars
summary: We investigate the dynamical instability of rotating boson stars described by the Gross--Pitaevskii--Poisson equations with contact self-interactions. Through three-dimensional simulations, we confirm that the rotating boson star undergoes a quasiperiodic conversion between ring-like and twin-star-like density configurations in the early nonlinear stage. We develop a systematic linear stability analysis to identify the modes driving this instability and show that repulsive self-interactions could significantly increase the lifetime of the rotating boson stars. We further construct a three-mode Hamiltonian to describe the early nonlinear stage, which explains the quasiperiodic conversion. This analytical framework agrees reasonably well with the simulation results and provides a clear picture to understand the dynamics of rotating boson stars.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三维模拟和线性稳定性分析，研究了具有接触自相互作用的Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson方程所描述的旋转玻色星（rotating boson star）的动力学不稳定性，发现其在早期非线性阶段呈现环状与双星状密度构型之间的准周期转换，并构建了一个三模哈密顿量（three-mode Hamiltonian）框架来解释该现象。
AI.motivation: 旋转玻色星是天体物理和暗物质研究中的重要对象，但其动力学不稳定性机制尚不清楚，尤其是早期非线性阶段的演化行为缺乏系统性理解。
AI.method: 采用三维数值模拟观察旋转玻色星的早期非线性演化；发展系统的线性稳定性分析（linear stability analysis）以识别驱动不稳定性的模式；并构建三模哈密顿量解析框架以描述早期非线性阶段的准周期转换。
AI.result: 模拟确认旋转玻色星在早期非线性阶段于环状与双星状密度构型之间发生准周期转换；线性分析识别出驱动不稳定性的模式，并表明排斥性自相互作用（repulsive self-interactions）可显著延长旋转玻色星的寿命。
AI.conclusion: 三模哈密顿量框架与模拟结果相符，为理解旋转玻色星的动力学提供了清晰的图像。

title: Bridging simulation length scales with cellular automata
summary: Multiscale simulation requires coupling physics models that operate at different characteristic length and time scales, because no single method spans the range needed for most problems of interest. Moving to a coarser-grained representation unlocks longer length and time scales, but it discards the microscopic interactions that build morphology. A fine-grained model can be initialized from an arbitrary packing and left to self-assemble into a physically meaningful structure; a lower-resolution model cannot, and must inherit its starting configuration from a higher-fidelity simulation. The length scales accessible to the coarse-grained model are therefore set not by the coarse-grained method itself, but by the largest fine-grained configuration that can be affordably equilibrated. A representative example is the scale-up from particle-based molecular dynamics (MD) to a lattice-based representation such as kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC). In this work, we present a cellular automata (CA) approach for generating arbitrarily large lattice starting configurations. CA is a natural fit for this task: short-ranged local rules drive the evolution of a lattice, and their repeated application gives rise to emergent long-range order, thematically mirroring how short-ranged interactions in MD produce self-assembled morphology. We use a configuration from a higher-fidelity simulation as a training set and learn the CA rules from it via logistic regression. As a proof of principle, we develop these rules for a hydrated anion exchange membrane (AEM), generate new starting configurations, and benchmark their performance in mesoscale kMC simulations against an MD-derived "ground truth." We then demonstrate the ability to generate substantially larger lattices and show that their behavior in kMC is consistent with that of the smaller CA benchmark configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于元胞自动机（cellular automata, CA）的方法，用以生成任意大小的晶格起始构型，从而实现从细粒度模拟（如分子动力学，MD）到粗粒度模拟（如动力学蒙特卡洛，kMC）的尺度升级。作者从高保真MD模拟的构型中通过逻辑回归学习CA规则，以水合阴离子交换膜为载体进行验证，生成的更大晶格在kMC中的表现与较小基准构型一致。
AI.motivation: 多尺度模拟需耦合不同特征长度与时间尺度的物理模型，但细粒度模型无法达到粗粒度模拟所需的大尺度；粗粒度模型虽能解锁更长尺度，却无法自组装形成有意义的微观结构，必须继承高保真模拟的起始构型。
AI.method: 作者利用元胞自动机（CA）生成任意大小的晶格起始构型：由于CA的短程局部规则反复应用可涌现长程有序，与MD中短程相互作用产生自组装形貌的机制在主题上对应。具体做法是将高保真模拟产生的构型作为训练集，通过逻辑回归（logistic regression）学习CA演化规则，并以水合阴离子交换膜（AEM）作为概念验证对象。
AI.result: 作者为水合阴离子交换膜（AEM）学习了CA规则并生成了新的起始构型，在介观尺度kMC模拟中将其性能与MD衍生的“基准真值”进行了对比；随后展示了生成显著更大晶格的能力，并验证了大晶格在kMC中的行为与小尺度CA基准构型一致。
AI.conclusion: CA方法能够以数据驱动方式学习粗粒度模型缺失的结构信息，使粗粒度模拟的起始构型不再受限于高保真模拟可承受的平衡尺度，从而扩展粗粒度模型可触及的长度与时间尺度。

title: Go Fishing with Alice: Compatible Carrollian and Poisson Structures
summary: We introduce, motivated by noncommutative Carrollian geometry, the notion of a Carrollian--Poisson bundle understood as a Carrollian manifold with a compatible Poisson structure. Compatibility is expressed as the inclusion of the Carroll distribution in the image of the Poisson anchor. We explore the geometric consequences of this compatibility and present several simple examples of Carrollian--Poisson bundles, including the (outer) Kerr horizon, the BTZ horizon, and future null infinity. Furthermore, we establish that every Carrollian--Poisson bundle can be equipped with a Vaisman (contravariant) connection that is both metric-compatible and clock-compatible, and thus geometric kinematics can be defined and studied.

AI.tldr: 本文受非交换Carrollian几何（noncommutative Carrollian geometry）启发，引入"Carrollian–Poisson 丛"（Carrollian–Poisson bundle）概念，定义为带有相容泊松结构（Poisson structure）的Carrollian流形。相容性表现为Carroll分布在泊松锚（Poisson anchor）的像中。作者探讨了该相容性的几何后果，给出了若干实例（包括Kerr地平线、BTZ地平线和未来零无穷远），并证明每个Carrollian–Poisson丛都可配备度量相容且时钟相容的Vaisman（逆变）联络，从而可定义并研究几何运动学（geometric kinematics）。
AI.motivation: 受非交换Carrollian几何启发，意在建立一类将Carrollian结构与泊松结构相融合的几何对象，以期为相关物理背景（如黑洞视界）提供统一的几何框架。
AI.method: 作者形式化定义了Carrollian–Poisson丛，以Carroll分布包含于泊松锚的像中这一条件表达两个结构之间的相容性，并进一步引入Vaisman（逆变）联络以刻画几何运动学。
AI.result: 相容性条件导致了一系列几何后果，作者给出了多个具体实例，包括（外）Kerr视界、BTZ视界和未来零无穷远；并证明任一Carrollian–Poisson丛均可配备度量相容且时钟相容的Vaisman联络。
AI.conclusion: Carrollian–Poisson丛提供了一个统一框架，使得在其上可定义度量相容与时钟相容的逆变联络，从而能够系统地研究几何运动学。

title: Inelastic dark matter and baryon flavor symmetry in light of LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment
summary: We present a novel model for inelastic dark matter in a simple extension of the Standard Model (SM) with a local $U(1)'$ baryon flavor symmetry, such as $U(1)_{B_i-B_j}$ with $i\neq j$. In this framework, we realize a realistic flavor structure for the mixing Yukawa couplings due to higher dimensional operators or renormalizable couplings between the SM quarks and extra vector-like quarks that are anomaly-free by themselves. We regard a Dirac singlet fermion as being dark matter and obtaining a small mass splitting for inelastic dark matter, only after the $U(1)'$ symmetry is broken spontaneously. In particular, in the scenarios of heavy dark matter of $1\,{\rm TeV}$ mass, we show that there is a consistent parameter space for explaining both the LZ nuclear recoil event and the correct relic density for dark matter and the existing collider and indirect detection bounds are satisfied at the same time. In this case, we predict a relatively light $Z'$ boson with $10-20\,{\rm GeV}$ mass and a weak gauge coupling, suggesting a dedicated search at colliders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于标准模型（Standard Model, SM）的简单扩展模型中的无弹性暗物质（inelastic dark matter）新模型，利用局部U(1)'重子味对称性（baryon flavor symmetry）实现暗物质质量劈裂。在该框架下，1 TeV重暗物质场景能够同时解释LZ实验核反冲事件与正确的暗物质遗迹密度（relic density），并满足现有的对撞机与间接探测约束，同时预言了10–20 GeV的轻Z'玻色子。
AI.motivation: 现有暗物质模型难以同时解释LZ实验观察到的核反冲事件与暗物质遗迹密度，且需要满足对撞机和间接探测的多重约束。作者旨在构建一个理论上自洽的SM扩展模型，通过无弹性暗物质机制在现有实验数据与理论框架之间取得一致。
AI.method: 作者在SM基础上引入带局部U(1)'重子味对称性（如U(1)_{B_i-B_j}，i≠j）的扩展模型，通过高维算子或SM夸克与无反常额外矢量型夸克（vector-like quarks）之间的可重整化耦合实现可行的味道混合Yukawa结构。暗物质由Dirac单态费米子承担，仅在U(1)'对称性自发破缺后获得小质量劈裂，从而形成无弹性暗物质。
AI.result: 在1 TeV量级的重暗物质情形下，模型存在一致的参数空间，可以同时解释LZ核反冲事件和正确的暗物质遗迹密度，并满足现有的对撞机及间接探测约束。模型预言了质量约10–20 GeV的轻Z'玻色子与弱规范耦合强度。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为解释LZ实验信号提供了一条理论可行的无弹性暗物质路径，并给出可在对撞机上搜寻的轻Z'玻色子预言，为该模型的可检验性提供了明确的实验指向。

title: Scattering of Null strings - Flipped Vacuum & CHY
summary: We investigate the scattering of null tensionless strings. Classical null strings, given by the ILST action, give rise to three distinct quantum theories built on different vacua and representations of the underlying 2d Conformal Carroll algebra (CCA) which form the residual gauge symmetries on the null worldsheet. In this paper, we are interested in the quantum theory built out of the so-called ``flipped'' vacuum which realises the highest weight representation of the 2d CCA. By considering a novel class of vertex operators, intimately connected to the compactified null string, we build scattering amplitudes of the theory. We show that one naturally obtains the Cachazo-He-Yuan (CHY) formulae when one considers scattering of massless states in the null ``flipped'' string.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零张力弦（null tensionless string）的散射。经典零弦（由ILST作用量描述）可在三种不同真空和相关表示下构建出三种量子理论，这些理论共享底层的二维共形 Carroll 代数（2d CCA）作为残留规范对称性。作者聚焦于基于“翻转”真空（flipped vacuum）的量子理论，该真空实现了2d CCA的最高权表示。通过引入与紧致化零弦密切相关的新型顶点算子，构建了该理论的散射振幅，并证明在零“翻转”弦中散射零质量态时自然得到 CHY（Cachazo-He-Yuan）公式。
AI.motivation: 零张力弦的量子理论具有多种可能的真空构造，需厘清不同理论间的物理联系与散射特性。作者旨在研究在“翻转”真空下构建的量子零弦理论，探索其散射振幅是否与已知的 CHY 振幅公式相联系。
AI.method: 基于 ILST（Isberg-Lindström-Sundborg-Theodoridis）作用量描述经典零弦，识别其量子化后形成三种不同真空下的量子理论；选取实现二维共形 Carroll 代数（2d CCA）最高权表示的“翻转”真空理论，通过定义与紧致化零弦相关的一类新型顶点算子来构建散射振幅。
AI.result: 在零“翻转”弦中散射零质量态时，可自然导出 CHY（Cachazo-He-Yuan）公式，表明该量子零弦理论与著名的振幅构造之间存在直接对应关系。
AI.conclusion: “翻转”真空下的量子零弦理论提供了 CHY 公式的一种弦论实现，揭示了零张力弦散射与无质量振幅构造之间的深层联系。

title: A New Window for Testing the PPN in the Strong-Field Regime: Stellar Rotation of S301
summary: The recently discovered S301 star, with an orbital period of 8.7 years and eccentricity $e = 0.982$, reaches a pericenter of just $140\,R_{\mathrm{s}}$ --- approximately nine times closer than S2's $\sim 1200R_{\mathrm{s}}$ --- offering an unprecedented laboratory for testing strong-field gravity. We demonstrate that S301's stellar spin precession provides a novel probe of the PPN parameter $γ$, scaling as $(2γ_{\mathrm{PPN}} + 1)/3$ relative to general relativity (GR). For maximum projected velocity shifts of $46.1~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$, next-generation spectrographs could constrain $γ_{\mathrm{PPN}}$ to $\sim 10\%$ precision. When combined with S301's orbital precession --- a substantial $\sim 1.95^\circ$ pericenter advance per orbit (GR prediction), approximately an order of magnitude larger than S2's $\sim 0.2^\circ$, constraining $(2β_{\mathrm{PPN}} + 2γ_{\mathrm{PPN}} - 1)/3$ --- the spin measurement breaks the $β$-$γ$ degeneracy. A MCMC analysis of projected S2 and S301 observations yields $σ_β\approx 2.3 \times 10^{-4}$, with the $γ$ precision limited by the spin precession measurement to $σ_γ\approx 0.1$. While the spin precession provides an independent consistency check, its true significance lies in probing gravity at $φ/c^2 \sim 10^{-4}$ and $v/c \sim 0.08$ --- four orders of magnitude stronger than Solar System tests and an order of magnitude stronger than current S-star constraints. This complementary approach opens a new window for testing the PPN framework in the strong-field regime and demonstrates the power of combining multiple stellar probes at the Galactic Center.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过银心（Galactic Center）新发现恒星S301的运动分析，提出利用其恒星自转进动（stellar spin precession）作为广义相对论框架外参数化后牛顿（PPN）参数γ的新型检验手段，并证实通过结合S301的轨道进动测量可打破β–γ简并。基于MCMC预测分析，S2与S301联合观测可将β约束至σ_β≈2.3×10⁻⁴、γ约束至σ_γ≈0.1。该方案在φ/c²～10⁻⁴和v/c～0.08的强场区域测试引力理论，比太阳系测试强约四个数量级，为在强场区域检验PPN框架开辟了新窗口。
AI.motivation: 近年发现的恒星S301轨道周期为8.7年、偏心率为e=0.982，其最近心距仅140R_s，比S2的最近心距约近9倍，提供了前所未有的强场引力测试平台。该研究旨在利用S301的自转进动和轨道进动作为新型探针，在强场区域约束PPN参数γ和β，弥补现有测试的不足。
AI.method: 理论推导S301自转进动对PPN参数γ的敏感度，其缩放关系为相对广义相对论的(2γ_PPN+1)/3倍；同时利用S301单圈近心点进动约1.95°（比S2大一个数量级）来约束(2β_PPN+2γ_PPN−1)/3组合。对S2与S301的预期观测数据开展马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）分析，并评估下一代光谱仪的速度位移测量能力。
AI.result: 对于最大投影速度位移为46.1 km s⁻¹的测量，下一代光谱仪可将γ_PPN约束到约10%精度。MCMC分析显示σ_β≈2.3×10⁻⁴，γ精度受自转进动测量限制为σ_γ≈0.1。自转进动独立于轨道进动，作为一致性检验可打破β–γ简并。
AI.conclusion: 自转进动的真正意义在于可在φ/c²～10⁻⁴和v/c～0.08水平上检验引力，比太阳系测试强约四个数量级，比现有S星约束强约一个数量级。该互补方法为强场区域检验PPN框架打开了新窗口，展示了在银心联合多种恒星探针的优势。

title: Generating quantum error correcting codes from topological pre-thermal scars
summary: Quantum many-body scars are rare nonthermal states embedded within otherwise thermalizing spectra, making them promising candidates for storing and manipulating quantum information. However, a general framework that can both identify such states without prior knowledge of their microscopic scarring mechanism and determine when they enable a quantum error correcting code has remained elusive. Here, we develop an end-to-end framework connecting nonthermal-state discovery to certifiable quantum error correction using a many-body spectral localizer. By searching for states jointly localized in energy and a diagnostic observable in systems with a many-body grading symmetry, the spectral localizer identifies candidate scars within dense many-body spectra in tandem with a topological index whose shifts determine their graded subspace. For suitable pairs of same-graded scars, the grading renders grading-odd errors exactly detectable, while their localization can suppress the logical action of sufficiently local grading-even error products, yielding an approximate Knill--Laflamme condition and an operator-algebra quantum error-correction structure. We demonstrate the scar-identification framework in one- and two-dimensional density-difference-dependent bosonic models and in the PXP model, and explicitly construct the resulting approximate quantum code in the one-dimensional bosonic system. Our results establish a systematic route from identifying nonthermal many-body states to exploiting them for protecting quantum information, and position pseudospectral methods as a broadly applicable tool for discovering useful behaviors in interacting quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个端到端框架，利用多体谱局部子（many-body spectral localizer）同时实现非热态（nonthermal state）的发现与可认证的量子纠错能力判定，并在多个模型中验证了这一方法。
AI.motivation: 量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）是嵌入在热化谱中的罕见非热态，具有量子信息存储与操控的潜力，但此前缺乏一个既能无需先验微观机制自动识别疤痕、又能判断其是否支持量子纠错码（quantum error correcting code）的统一框架。
AI.method: 本文发展了一个基于多体谱局部子的端到端框架：通过在具有多体分级对称性（many-body grading symmetry）的系统中搜索在能量与诊断可观测量上联合局域（jointly localized）的态，谱局部子可识别候选疤痕，并借助拓扑指标（topological index）的移动确定其所在的分级子空间。对于同分级（same-graded）的疤痕对，分级结构使分级奇偶错误可精确检测，而疤痕的局域性可抑制足够局域的分级偶错误乘积的逻辑作用，从而获得近似的Knill–Laflamme条件与算子代数量子纠错（operator-algebra quantum error correction）结构。
AI.result: 该疤痕识别框架在一维和二维密度差依赖的玻色子模型以及PXP模型中均得到验证，并在二维…一维玻色子系统中显式构造了近似的量子码，证明了方法在多个具体系统中的有效性与可推广性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了从识别非热多体态到利用它们保护量子信息的系统性路径，并将赝谱方法（pseudospectral methods）定位为在相互作用量子系统中发现有用行为的广泛应用工具。

title: Microscopic study of baryon stopping in low-energy heavy-ion collisions within UrQMD model
comment: 16 pages, 13 figures, accepted in Phys. Rev. C
summary: In low-energy heavy-ion collisions, baryon stopping is an important process, in which protons from the initial colliding nuclei are stopped at mid-rapidity region. Quantifying such stopping can reveal information on the properties of the nuclear medium, such as net-baryon density. Though experimental measurement of net-proton rapidity spectra provides constraints, microscopic origin of such protons is not fully accessible. Transport model studies can therefore provide deeper insight into the microscopic origin of protons transported from initial nuclei, complementing experimental measurements. This article presents an investigation of baryon stopping in minimum-bias Au+Au collisions over a wide range of beam energies, $\sqrt{s_{NN}} = 2.4-17.3$ GeV ($E_{\rm lab} = 1.23A-158A$ GeV). Final-state protons are classified based on their origin by analyzing their interaction history in the UrQMD model. A significant fraction of transported protons at mid-rapidity originates from initial neutrons rather than initial protons, referred to as \textit{isospin-converted} protons, and their contribution as a function of collision energy and centrality is quantified. Anisotropic flow coefficients of different proton categories are estimated and compared with experimental measurements. Furthermore, a comparison between the $π^{-}/π^{+}$ ratio and \textit{isospin conversion} rate is performed. The latter is further compared with the $α$ parameters of the Kitazawa-Asakawa formalism, revealing a significant deviation from the chemical equilibrium assumption $α_N = α_π$ below $\sqrt{s_{NN}} \lesssim$ 10~GeV. Finally, the saturation of the isospin conversion rate is found to coincide with the onset of nuclear transparency, demonstrating that isospin randomization and baryon stopping are coupled phenomena in hadronic transport across the NICA/FAIR energy range.

AI.tldr: 本文利用 UrQMD 输运模型研究了低能重离子碰撞中的重子阻止（baryon stopping）现象，对 $\sqrt{s_{NN}}$ = 2.4–17.3 GeV 能量范围内的最小偏置 Au+Au 碰撞中，通过粒子相互作用历史追踪将末态质子按来源分类，发现中快度区域存在大量来自初始中子的同位旋转换（isospin-converted）质子，并量化了其随碰撞能量和中心度的变化，进而与实验测量的各向异性流、π⁻/π⁺比及 Kitazawa-Asakawa 形式中的化学平衡假设进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 重子阻止是低能重离子碰撞中的关键过程，其定量研究有助于揭示核介质性质（如净重子密度），但实验测量的净质子快度谱无法完全揭示这些质子的微观起源，因此需要输运模型提供补充性深入理解。
AI.method: 在 UrQMD 输运模型框架下，通过分析质子的相互作用历史，将末态质子按其来源分类（初始质子 vs 初始中子经同位旋转换而来），并计算其随碰撞能量和中心度的贡献比例；进一步估算不同质子类别的各向异性流系数，并将其与实验测量、π⁻/π⁺比及 Kitazawa-Asakawa 形式中的 α 参数进行比较。
AI.result: 研究发现中快度区有显著比例的输运质子源自初始中子而非初始质子（即同位旋转换质子）；在 $\sqrt{s_{NN}} \lesssim$ 10 GeV 以下，同位旋转换率与 Kitazawa-Asakawa 形式的 α 参数比较显示其显著偏离化学平衡假设 α_N = α_π；同位旋转换率在 NICA/FAIR 能量范围出现饱和，且该饱和与核透明（nuclear transparency）的出现相一致。
AI.conclusion: 同位旋随机化（isospin randomization）与重子阻止是强子输运中相互耦合的现象，这一发现跨越 NICA/FAIR 能量范围得到验证，为理解低能重离子碰撞中质子的微观起源及其与核介质性质的关联提供了新的视角。

title: Double Copy from the Flipped Null String
summary: We study the double-copy structure of tree amplitudes of the bosonic null string in the flipped vacuum. We show that its level-one vector correlator supplies the Cachazo-He-Yuan (CHY) kinematic half-integrand of the higher-derivative $(DF)^2$ gauge theory, while distinguished compact momentum-winding sectors generate the complementary Parke-Taylor factor. For factorized level-two states, the same Carrollian world-sheet produces two kinematic half-integrands and hence the symmetric double copy to the six-derivative Weyl-cubed graviton sector. Lattice sectors with common external momenta reproduce the Bern-Carrasco-Johansson (BCJ) ordering relation and the corresponding field-theory Kawai-Lewellen-Tye (KLT) representation. These results provide a direct Carrollian world-sheet origin of the double copy and point toward a current-algebra realization of the emergent color sector compatible with the $O(d,d)$ structure of the compact lattice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了翻转真空（flipped vacuum）中玻色子零弦（bosonic null string）树级振幅的双拷贝（double copy）结构，表明其卡罗尔（Carrollian）世界面上的层次一矢量子关联函数可为高导数规范理论提供运动学半积分（kinematic half-integrand），层次二因子化态则为双拷贝提供两种运动学半积分；同时晶格扇区复现了BCJ排序关系和KLT表示，为双拷贝提供了直接的世界面起源。
AI.motivation: 双拷贝结构在规范理论/引力理论对应（gauge/gravity correspondence）中具有核心地位，但此前缺乏明确的弦论世界面（world-sheet）实现。本文旨在通过翻转真空中的玻色子零弦，寻找双拷贝的直接卡罗尔世界面起源，并将涌现色扇区与当前代数（current algebra）实现及O(d,d)晶格结构相联系。
AI.method: 作者在翻转真空中研究玻色子零弦的树级振幅，分析其层次一（level-one）矢量子关联函数并展示其可充当Cachazo-He-Yuan（CHY）运动学半积分，用于构造高导数(DF)²规范理论；在区分的紧致动量-缠绕（momentum-winding）扇区中生成互补的Parke-Taylor因子。对于因子化层次二（level-two）态，同一卡罗尔世界面产生两个运动学半积分，并通过对称双拷贝构造六导数的Weyl立方引力扇区。此外，作者检验了具有共同外动量的晶格扇区，以提取BCJ排序关系和相应场论的KLT表示。
AI.result: 结果显示：零弦在翻转真空下的层次一矢量子关联函数构成(DF)²规范理论的CHY运动学半积分，而紧致动量-缠绕扇区补充Parke-Taylor因子；因子化层次二态以对称双拷贝方式给出六导数Weyl³引力扇区；晶格扇区成功复现了场论中的BCJ排序关系和KLT表示。
AI.conclusion: 本工作在卡罗尔世界面框架下为双拷贝提供了直接起源，并指出涌现色扇区可能以某种当前代数方式实现，且与紧致晶格的O(d,d)结构相容，为进一步研究双拷贝的代数根基提供了新的方向。

title: The (in)stability on total transmission modes with small bumps
summary: Total transmission modes (TTMs) are a class of reflectionless solutions to black hole perturbation equations, closely related to quasinormal modes (QNMs), and can exhibit significant sensitivity to weak environmental perturbations. In this work, we investigate the spectrum (in)stability of TTMs of Tangherlini black holes by introducing a localized Pöschl-Teller bump perturbation into the effective potential, and employ a modified Chebyshev-Lobatto grid to improve the numerical accuracy of the localized perturbation. For $d=14$, $\ell=2$, and $s=2$, the purely imaginary TTM exhibits relatively strong spectrum stability, whereas the genuine complex TTMs undergo significant migrations even for small perturbations, consistent with the spectrum stability revealed by previous pseudospectrum analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在Tangherlini黑洞的等效势中引入局域Pöschl-Teller凸起扰动，研究全透射模式（TTM）频谱的（不）稳定性。数值结果表明，在d=14、ℓ=2、s=2时，纯虚TTM表现出较强的频谱稳定性，而真实的复TTM即使在微小扰动下也发生显著迁移，这与先前赝谱（pseudospectrum）分析揭示的频谱稳定性结论一致。
AI.motivation: 全透射模式是一类黑洞扰动方程的无反射解，与准正规模（quasinormal modes, QNMs）密切相关，且可能对弱环境扰动表现出显著敏感性。研究的动机在于探究TTM频谱是否具有与QNM类似的不稳定性特征，为理解黑洞扰动谱在现实环境中的可靠性提供依据。
AI.method: 在Tangherlini黑洞的等效势能中引入一个局域的Pöschl-Teller凸起函数作为微扰，并采用经过修正的Chebyshev-Lobatto网格以提升局域扰动情形下的数值精度，从而计算不同参数条件下TTM频谱的变化。
AI.result: 在d=14、ℓ=2、s=2的条件下，纯虚TTM对局域扰动表现出相对较强的频谱稳定性；而真实的复TTM即便在微小扰动下也会发生显著的谱迁移，说明不同类型的TTM对扰动的响应存在差异。
AI.conclusion: TTM频谱的（不）稳定性与之前赝谱分析所揭示的行为一致：复TTM的不稳定性源于赝谱结构，而纯虚TTM的相对稳定为理解黑洞扰动谱提供了补充视角，该研究有助于深入认识黑洞环境扰动对谱的定量影响。

title: FPBench: Application-Oriented Error Decomposition for Foundation Potentials
summary: Foundation potentials (FPs) have emerged as a new basis for atomistic modeling. While their evaluation using average energy and force errors often indicates near-DFT accuracy, their performance in practical computational studies remains inconsistent. Here, we present FPBench, an application-oriented benchmark that evaluates FPs on representative computational tasks. Multiple state-of-the-art FPs are assessed on three fundamental tasks: force prediction for atomistic simulations, energy ranking for substitutional and vacancy orderings, and ion/vacancy migration. Benchmarking these FPs shows that average force and energy errors often fail to predict task performance, revealing substantial differences in practical reliability. FPBench introduces application-oriented error decomposition through metrics that resolve performance according to the physically consequential quantities and configurations governing computational tasks, including the fractions of highly accurate and large-force-error atoms, far-from-equilibrium atoms, relative phase-stability and convex-hull agreement, and along-path errors in ion migration. These error-decomposition metrics identify where FP errors arise within specific computational tasks, providing targeted guidance for model development. FPBench provides an open benchmark, evaluation code, and a public leaderboard for rigorous FP assessment and development.
