AI.conclusion: KBR 时空在解析延拓下暴露出无遮蔽奇点，构成对弱宇宙监督猜想的潜在反例；其腔体结构能够通过超辐射放大与势垒捕获机制放大扰动，产生不稳定模式与回波信号，表明该时空在标量场扰动下不稳定。单纯基于抽象区域延拓的讨论不足以规避这些物理后果，需要结合全局结构与场论微扰系统分析。

title: The electromagnetic stress tensor in cubic crystals and amorphous solids
summary:
The electromagnetic vacuum stress tensor in a system consisting of classical point-like atoms on a cubic lattice is derived directly from the electric field and, alternatively, using the known more phenomenological formula involving the (usually unknown) derivative of the dielectric tensor. The results agree. The stress tensor contains a nontrivial constant and therefore cannot be obtained from macroscopic electrodynamics alone.
  A system consisting of a mosaic of randomly oriented grains of a cubic crystal is used as a model of an amorphous solid. The electromagnetic stress tensor in this system is deduced by averaging the corresponding quantity in a cubic crystal over all orientations. Two components remain: the component in the direction of the electric field and the component perpendicular to it. The transverse component agrees with the analogous quantity for liquids derived by Peierls in an entirely different way.

AI.tldr: 该论文直接从电场出发推导了立方晶格上经典点状原子体系中的电磁真空应力张量（electromagnetic vacuum stress tensor），并与基于介电张量导数的唯象公式结果一致，发现其中包含的非平凡常数无法仅由宏观电动力学（macroscopic electrodynamics）获得。同时以随机取向立方晶粒镶嵌体系作为非晶固体（amorphous solid）模型，通过对取向平均得到应力张量仅剩电场方向及其垂直两个分量，其中横向分量与Peierls以完全不同方法推导的液体结果一致。
AI.motivation: 电磁真空应力张量的精确表达在凝聚态与材料物理中至关重要，但宏观电动力学中的常用唯象公式通常依赖未知的介电张量导数，其有效性缺乏微观层面的直接验证。论文旨在通过点状原子晶格的显微推导检验这一公式，并为非晶固体中的电磁应力建立微观基础。
AI.method: 首先在立方晶格上由经典点状原子（classical point-like atoms）体系出发，直接从电场推导电磁真空应力张量；同时采用包含介电张量（dielectric tensor）导数的唯象公式进行推导并比较两者结果。随后以随机取向立方晶体晶粒的马赛克体系模拟非晶固体，通过对立方晶体中相应量的全取向平均来推导应力张量。
AI.result: 两种推导方法得到的应力张量结果一致，且张量含有一个非平凡常数项，表明其无法仅由宏观电动力学推出。在非晶体系中经取向平均后，应力张量仅剩沿电场方向与垂直于电场方向两个分量；其中横向分量与Peierls基于完全不同方法推导的液体对应量相符。
AI.conclusion: 研究工作验证了唯象公式的可靠性，同时揭示电磁应力张量包含超出宏观电动力学范围的微观常数贡献。取向平均方法成功将晶体结果推广至非晶体系，且横向分量的跨体系一致性表明其在无序介质中具有普遍的物理意义。

title: Measurement-Based Feedback of Open Quantum Systems: A Control-Theoretic Review and Tutorial
summary: This review develops a control-theoretic perspective on measurement-based feedback for continuously monitored open quantum systems, with the main analysis focused on finite-dimensional systems governed by diffusive stochastic master equations. We introduce the relevant state-space, invariant-subspace, and quantum non-demolition structures, interpret quantum filtering as nonlinear observer dynamics, and review open-loop asymptotics, filter stability, state-feedback stabilization, robustness, and reduced-order observer-based control. Particular emphasis is placed on a recurrence--contraction framework, in which Hamiltonian feedback removes non-target invariant obstructions while measurement-induced dynamics provide local exponential contraction. Although the detailed analysis is developed for finite-dimensional diffusive models, the underlying measurement--estimation--feedback architecture is relevant across a broad range of quantum platforms. We further discuss implementation challenges and open problems involving scalable estimation, sampling and delay, adaptation, hybrid and non-Markovian dynamics, practical stability, optimal control, and learning-based design. By organizing these developments around invariance, estimation, recurrence, and contraction, the review provides a tutorial bridge between measurement-based quantum feedback and nonlinear stochastic control.

AI.tldr: 本文以控制理论视角综述了连续监测开放量子系统中的测量反馈控制，聚焦于由扩散型随机主方程（diffusive stochastic master equations）描述的有限维系统，并围绕不变性（invariance）、估计（estimation）、循环（recurrence）与收缩（contraction）四个核心概念搭建了连接量子反馈与非线性随机控制的教程性桥梁。
AI.motivation: 测量反馈是量子控制的核心机制之一，但相关文献分散且缺乏统一的分析框架，作者希望从控制理论视角出发，为连续监测的开放量子系统的反馈控制提供一个系统化的综述与教学梳理。
AI.method: 文章引入状态空间（state-space）、不变子空间（invariant-subspace）和量子非破坏（quantum non-demolition）结构，将量子滤波（quantum filtering）诠释为非线性观测器动力学；随后评述开环渐近行为、滤波器稳定性、状态反馈镇定、鲁棒性及基于降阶观测器的控制；核心框架为“循环-收缩”（recurrence-contraction）机制：哈密顿反馈消除非目标的阻碍性不变性障碍，而测量诱导动力学提供局部指数收缩。
AI.result: 论文确认了循环-收缩框架在有限维扩散模型中成立，并论证了“测量-估计-反馈”架构在更广泛的量子平台中具有普适性；同时识别出若干实施中的关键挑战，包括可扩展估计、采样与延迟、自适应、混合与非马尔可夫动力学、实际稳定性、最优控制及基于学习的设计等问题。
AI.conclusion: 该综述将有关量子反馈的分散成果围绕不变性、估计、循环与收缩进行组织化整理，为测量型量子反馈与非线性随机控制之间提供了教程性衔接；同时指出了未来实现与应用所需克服的开放性难题。

title: Inclusive electron-nucleus cross section models from domain adaptation
summary: We apply transfer learning (TL) to construct data-driven models of inclusive electron-nucleus cross sections. Starting from an ensemble of deep neural networks pretrained on \(^{12}\)C data, we fine-tune the models separately for \(^{3}\)He, \(^{6}\)Li, \(^{16}\)O, \(^{27}\)Al, \(^{40}\)Ca, and \(^{56}\)Fe. The resulting models improve for all targets, marginally so for oxygen, where the carbon baseline is already adequate, although their predictive robustness depends on the amount, coverage, and precision of the available target data. We systematically study how model performance depends on the number of fine-tuned layers, on the fraction and selection of the training data, and on the overlap between the source and target kinematic domains. The layer-wise analysis shows that oxygen requires only shallow adaptation, whereas helium, calcium, and iron require substantially deeper fine-tuning. Lithium represents the least robust case because of its limited dataset, while aluminum demonstrates a strong sensitivity to a small subset of highly constraining measurements. For selected kinematic configurations outside the coverage of the carbon training data, the adapted models remain consistent with the measurements within their estimated uncertainties. Finally, we compare the resulting predictions with those of the phenomenological F1F2 model.

AI.tldr: 本文应用迁移学习（transfer learning）技术构建电子-原子核（electron-nucleus）内容全截面（inclusive cross section）的数据驱动模型。通过在12C数据上预训练的深度神经网络（deep neural networks）集成，分别针对6种不同靶核进行微调，系统研究了模型性能与微调层数、训练数据比例、选择方式及运动学域重叠之间的关系，并与唯象F1F2模型进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过迁移学习利用已有核（如12C）的丰富数据，为其他数据相对有限的靶核构建更可靠、更精确的电子-核散射截面预测模型，以克服单一靶核数据不足带来的建模困难。
AI.method: 研究采用预训练后的深度神经网络集成作为基础模型（在12C数据上训练），随后分别针对3He、6Li、16O、27Al、40Ca和56Fe等靶核的数据进行微调（fine-tuning）。系统分析了模型性能对微调层数、训练数据比例与选取方式、以及源域与目标域运动学区间重叠度的依赖，并进行了逐层（layer-wise）适应性分析。
AI.result: 所有靶核的模型预测均有改善，其中氧的改善幅度最小（因碳基线已足够）；微调深度因靶核而异——氧仅需浅层适应，而氦、钙和铁需要深层微调。锂因数据有限成为最不稳健的情况，铝则对少数高约束测量表现出强敏感性。在超出碳训练数据覆盖范围的选定运动学构型中，适应后模型与测量在估计不确定度内保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习能够有效借助12C模型能力推广至其他靶核，其预测稳健性取决于目标数据的数量、覆盖范围与精度。最终将迁移学习模型的预测结果与唯象F1F2模型进行了对比评估。

title: Symplectic Chern-Simons theories dual to Abelian rank-$0$ theories
summary: We propose that the 3d symplectic Chern-Simons theory $USp(2n)$ at level $k=n+\frac12+\ell$ with a single chiral multiplet in the fundamental representation is dual, for every pair of positive integers $(n,\ell)$, to the Abelian rank-$0$ theory $\mathcal{T}_{\ell,n}$ of Creutzig, Garner and Kim. The fundamental is pseudo-real, so the level is half-integral, there is no non-Abelian flavor symmetry, and the supersymmetry is enhanced to $\mathcal{N}=4$. Both sides have vanishing Higgs and Coulomb branches. We match the counting of supersymmetric vacua under real mass deformations for all $(n,\ell)$, and the supersymmetric indices in a number of cases. We then study in detail the case $\ell=1$, the minimal $USp(2n)$ Chern-Simons theory at level $n+\frac32$, whose dual is a $U(1)^{n}$ theory with a tadpole level matrix and a bare monopole superpotential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三维辛Chern-Simons理论USp(2n)在level k=n+1/2+ℓ下与Creutzig-Garner-Kim定义的阿贝尔秩0理论T_{ℓ,n}对偶，验证了实质量形变下超对称真空计数及多种情形下的超对称指标，并详细研究了ℓ=1的最小情形。
AI.motivation: 探索三维辛Chern-Simons理论与阿贝尔理论之间的新型对偶关系，特别是涉及半整数量子化、无非阿贝尔味对称性与N=4超对称增强的情形，以扩展对Chern-Simons物质理论的整体理解。
AI.method: 通过匹配双方在实质量形变（real mass deformations）下的超对称真空计数以及超对称指标（supersymmetric indices）来建立对偶；对ℓ=1的特例进行详细分析，将USp(2n)在level n+3/2的理论对偶到U(1)^n带tadpole level matrix和裸磁单极超势的理论。
AI.result: 对于所有正整数对(n,ℓ)，证明了三维辛Chern-Simons理论USp(2n)与阿贝尔秩0理论T_{ℓ,n}对偶；双方均具有消失的Higgs和Coulomb分支；在多种情况下匹配了超对称指标；并给出了ℓ=1情况下上指标的详细匹配。
AI.conclusion: 验证了三维奇异辛规范理论（因基本表示伪实而半整数量子化）与无真空模空间（vanishing Higgs and Coulomb branches）的阿贝尔理论之间存在系统的对偶谱，进一步丰富了三维Chern-Simons对偶的图景。

title: The generalized second law for Kerr-Taub-NUT black holes perturbed by test field
summary: We evaluate the variations in the area and the entropy of Kerr-Taub-NUT black holes perturbed by bosonic and fermionic test fields. We demonstrate that the critical frequency for a test field at which the variation of the area vanishes is strictly larger than the superradiance limit for Kerr-Taub-NUT black holes. Therefore both bosonic fields in the relevant range and fermionic fields which do not exhibit superradiant scattering can induce a decrease in the area of a Kerr-Taub-NUT black hole. However, the entropy is not directly proportional to the area for Kerr-Taub-NUT black holes. Only fermionic fields with frequencies below the superradiance limit can induce an entropy decrease. The simultaneous loss of entropy by the black hole and the environment identifies a generic violation of the Generalized Second Law (GSL) for fermionic perturbations that fail to satisfy the Null Energy Condition (NEC). For bosonic perturbations that satisfy the NEC, we evaluate the limiting case, where a nearly extremal black hole is perturbed by a scalar field with frequency slightly above the superradiance limit. Our analysis reveals that the minimum increase in the black hole entropy compensates for the entropy loss of the environment, when one assigns Von Neumann entropy to the test field. The GSL remains valid for perturbations satisfying the NEC.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了玻色子与费米子测试场扰动Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞时面积与熵的变化，发现费米子扰动可导致黑洞与环境的熵同时损失，从而违反广义第二定律（GSL）；而满足零能量条件（NEC）的玻色子扰动在极限情况下保持GSL有效。
AI.motivation: 探索Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞在外部场扰动下的面积与熵行为，并检验广义第二定律（Generalized Second Law, GSL）在黑洞物理中的普适性。
AI.method: 解析分析Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞受玻色子和费米子测试场微扰后面积与熵的变化，考察临界频率与超辐射极限（superradiance limit）的关系，并根据测试场是否满足零能量条件（Null Energy Condition, NEC）分类讨论GSL的有效性。
AI.result: 面积变化为零的临界频率严格大于Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞的超辐射极限；费米子场在低于超辐射极限的频率下可同时降低黑洞与环境的熵，导致GSL失效；满足NEC的玻色子扰动在近极端黑洞被略高于超辐射极限频率的标量场扰动时，最小熵增量可补偿环境熵损失，GSL仍然成立。
AI.conclusion: 对于Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞，熵并不与面积成正比；GSL的失效与费米子扰动违反NEC相关联，而对满足NEC的扰动，当赋予测试场冯·诺依曼熵（Von Neumann entropy）时GSL维持有效。

title: Reusable Operators for Irreducible Cartesian Tensor Decomposition and Coupling
summary: Molecular and material properties, from the polarizability to the elastic constants, are described by tensors. Their behavior under rotations is made explicit when a tensor is decomposed into irreducible parts that transform independently. In Cartesian form these parts are the symmetric and traceless irreducible Cartesian tensors (ICTs), whose decomposition and coupling underlie selection rules, orientational averages, and the use of symmetry. The decomposition is a textbook result at rank two, but higher rank and the intrinsic symmetry of physical tensors make it nontrivial. What has been lacking, unlike in the well-established spherical formalism, is a general construction for a given intrinsic symmetry, together with reusable operators that extract the ICTs and rebuild the original tensor exactly. Here, we develop such a construction and obtain these operators explicitly. These operators depend on rank and symmetry alone, and therefore each need only be built once and then applied to any tensor of that class. Building on them, we further obtain the Cartesian harmonics of a vector and the operators that couple two ICTs into a third, both central to equivariant machine learning. The construction is demonstrated on the elastic tensor, in both its second-order form of rank four and its third-order form of rank six. The ICTs of the rank-4 tensor also define a rotation- and scale-invariant measure of anisotropy, which we evaluate across the first-principles elastic tensors of crystalline materials from the Materials Project. The construction is implemented in the open-source package natto, which produces the operators in both exact symbolic and numerical form.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对具有内禀对称性的张量的一般性不可约笛卡尔张量（ICTs）构造方案，明确导出了可复用算子用于提取与重构ICTs，并进一步获得笛卡尔球谐函数与ICTs耦合算子，为等变机器学习提供了基础工具。该构造在弹性张量（四阶与六阶）上得到验证，并在Materials Project的从头算弹性张量数据上评估了各向异性度量，实现于开源软件包natto。
AI.motivation: 高阶张量的不可约笛卡尔分解在球谐形式下已有成熟理论，但笛卡尔形式的一般构造（针对给定内禀对称性）一直缺失；现有结果仅限于二阶张量，无法满足高阶物理张量（如弹性张量）分解与耦合的需求。
AI.method: 作者针对给定内禀对称性构建了一般性的不可约笛卡尔张量分解方案，明确获得可复用算子，这些算子仅依赖于张量的秩与对称性，可用于精确提取和重建ICTs；在此基础上进一步推导笛卡尔球谐函数以及两个ICTs耦合为第三个ICTs的算子。
AI.result: 该构造在四阶（二阶弹性张量）和六阶（三阶弹性张量）上得到验证；四阶张量的ICTs定义了旋转与标度不变的各向异性度量，并在Materials Project中晶体材料的从头算弹性张量上进行了评估；全部实现已开源在natto软件包中，支持精确符号与数值两种输出形式。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了笛卡尔形式下一般不可约张量分解构造的空白，所得算子因仅依赖秩与对称性而具有通用性，并为等变机器学习与弹性各向异性分析提供了统一、可复用的工具。

title: Modified scattering for semiclassical Bose-Fermi mixtures
summary: The Vlasov-Hartree system models a mixture of bosons and fermions interacting via Coulomb forces in which the bosons are described quantum-mechanically, while the fermions are described classically. For small initial data, we prove that the system exhibits modified scattering, i.e. the bosonic and fermionic subsystems each converge to solutions of the free Schrödinger and Vlasov equations respectively, but with coupled logarithmic corrections owing to the long-range nature of Coulomb interactions. We use a mixed Lagrangian and Fourier-based approach to derive explicit descriptions of the asymptotic dynamics of the solution and associated fields and Lagrangian trajectories. Notably, due to our purely Lagrangian analysis on the Vlasov side, we require no derivatives on the initial fermion density, the asymptotic fermionic profile is as regular as the initial data, and convergence occurs in almost the same space as the initial data.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Vlasov-Hartree系统在小初值条件下的长期动力学行为，证明了该系统表现出修正散射（modified scattering）现象，即玻色子和费米子子系统分别收敛到自由薛定谔方程和Vlasov方程的解，但因库仑相互作用的长程特性而带有耦合的对数修正。作者采用混合拉格朗日（Lagrangian）与傅里叶（Fourier）方法，给出了解的渐近动力学显式描述。
AI.motivation: Vlasov-Hartree系统刻画了通过库仑力相互作用的玻色子与费米子混合物，其中玻色子用量子力学描述而费米子用经典描述。理解该系统在小初值条件下的长时间渐近行为是动力学分析的核心问题，尤其需要厘清长程库仑相互作用如何导致与自由演化不同的修正散射行为。
AI.method: 论文采用混合拉格朗日与傅里叶相结合的途径，对解、相关场及拉格朗日轨迹的渐近动力学进行显式刻画。在Vlasov端采用纯拉格朗日分析，从而避免了对初始费米子密度施加导数条件。
AI.result: 证明了对于小初值，Vlasov-Hartree系统表现出修正散射：玻色子与费米子子系统分别收敛到自由薛定谔方程和Vlasov方程的解，但带有因库仑相互作用长程性而产生的耦合对数修正。渐近费米子分布的正则性与初值相同，且收敛发生在与初值几乎相同的空间中。
AI.conclusion: 该结果表明，Vlasov-Hartree系统的整体渐近结构可以被精确描述，且所提出的方法在正则性要求上具有优越性——无需对初始费米子密度施加额外导数条件，实现了优化的一致性收敛框架。

authors: Antoni Marcinek for the NA61/SHINE Collaboration
title: News from NA61/SHINE
comment: Proceedings of the 22nd International Conference on Strangeness in Quark Matter (SQM2026)
summary: NA61/SHINE is a multi-purpose, fixed-target hadron spectrometer at the CERN SPS. Its research program includes studies of strong interactions, as well as reference measurements for neutrino and cosmic-ray physics. A significant advantage of NA61/SHINE over collider experiments is its extended coverage of phase space available for particle production. This contribution summarizes recent selected results from our strong interaction program. These include rapidity spectra of $K^+$ and $π^-$ mesons in Xe+La reactions compared to other collision systems, energy dependence of the scaled $π^-$ total yield (the `kink` plot) in Xe+La compared to other collision systems and models, $φ$(1020) rapidity spectra in Ar+Sc collisions compared to models, $Λ$ transverse polarization in p+p reactions, energy dependence of intensive quantities of net-electric charge distribution in Ar+Sc collisions compared to p+p results, as well as an update on the evidence of large violation of isospin symmetry in kaon production --- the excess of charged over neutral kaons.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了NA61/SHINE实验在强相互作用（strong interaction）项目中最近的选择性结果，涵盖多种碰撞体系下的介子产额、超子极化、电荷分布及同位旋对称性破缺等物理量测量。
AI.motivation: NA61/SHINE作为CERN SPS上的固定靶强子谱仪，相比于对撞机（collider）实验具有更广的相空间（phase space）覆盖范围。该研究的目的是通过多种碰撞体系的系统测量，加深对强相互作用及其相关参考测量的理解。
AI.method: 利用NA61/SHINE固定靶实验装置进行多种碰撞体系（如Xe+La、Ar+Sc、p+p）的粒子产生测量，通过比较不同碰撞系统及理论模型的预期，系统研究各类观测量的能量与系统尺寸依赖性。
AI.result: 报告了Xe+La中K⁺和π⁻介子的快度谱（rapidity spectra）、π⁻约化总产额的能量依赖（"拐点"图，kink plot）、Ar+Sc中φ(1020)介子快度谱、p+p反应中Λ超子横向极化、Ar+Sc中净电荷分布强度量的能量依赖，以及带电K介子相对于中性K介子过量所指示的强同位旋对称性破缺（isospin symmetry violation）的最新证据。
AI.conclusion: 这些测量结果与其他碰撞系统和模型计算的系统比较，为强相互作用的进一步理解提供了重要实验约束，尤其是关于同位旋对称性破缺在K介子产生中可能存在的显著效应。

title: Mass for Particles from Extra Dimensions
summary: We investigate a geometric mechanism for mass generation in a codimension-two hedgehog braneworld. A massless particle propagating in the bulk acquires an effective four-dimensional mass through its motion along the compact angular extra dimension, yielding a dynamically determined Kaluza-Klein spectrum after canonical quantization. While the bosonic sector exhibits no radial confinement, extending the analysis to N = 1, 2 spinning-particle models shows that the spin-curvature coupling modifies the effective potential and introduces a level-dependent localization pattern for the Kaluza-Klein modes. The results establish a particle-mechanics realization of geometric mass generation in flux-supported codimension-two braneworlds and highlight the interplay between bulk geometry, spin, and the effective four-dimensional mass spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究余维为二（codimension-two）的 hedgehog 膜世界（braneworld）中一种几何质量产生机制。无质量粒子在体空间（bulk）中沿紧致角向额外维度运动，经正则量子化后动态确定出卡鲁扎-克莱因（Kaluza-Klein）谱。
AI.motivation: 探索在通量支撑的余维二膜世界中实现几何质量产生的粒子力学机制，并揭示体积几何、自旋与有效四维质量谱之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 在余维二 hedgehog 膜世界几何中考察无质量粒子的传播，通过其沿紧致角向额外维度的运动利用正则量子化获得有效四维质量谱；随后将分析扩展至自旋为 N = 1 与 N = 2 的自旋粒子模型，引入自旋-曲率耦合以修正有效势。
AI.result: 玻色子扇区（bosonic sector）未表现出径向束缚；而对于 N = 1, 2 的自旋粒子模型，自旋-曲率耦合改变了有效势，并导致卡鲁扎-克莱因模式出现能级依赖的局域化图景（level-dependent localization pattern）。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了通量支撑的余维二膜世界中几何质量产生的粒子力学实现，凸显了体积几何、自旋与有效四维质量谱之间的协同作用。

title: Coherent Selection of Critical Kasner Response
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table; Supplemental Material with 8 tables
summary: A coherent wave component with extremely small initial self-energy can substantially change the first response of a contracting spacetime. We demonstrate this effect in Einstein--Maxwell--scalar theory with two commuting spacelike Killing fields. Along a critical family motivated by scalarized black-hole interiors, the estimated magnetic delay leaves time for longitudinal propagation to redistribute the incident field. Increasing a low-frequency component at fixed initial electromagnetic energy enhances the scalar response on one background and suppresses it on another. A calculation that propagates the field and its momentum, then their quadratic scalar and geometric sources, predicts this reversal before nonlinear evolution. At the first suppression comparison, the coherent profile error is $0.38\%$, against $46.9\%$ when cross terms are omitted. The selected response develops into a magnetic pulse with electric and scalar exchange. The critical geometry thus preserves incident coherence as information that predicts its first departure from a Kasner epoch.

AI.tldr: 该研究在爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量场（Einstein-Maxwell-scalar）理论中，通过两个对易的空间类Killing场，证明一个初始自能极小的相干波分量能够显著改变收缩时空的初响应。沿由标量化黑洞内部激发的临界族，该效应可使标量响应在一个背景上增强、在另一背景上被抑制，且传播其二次标量和几何源的线性化计算可在非线性演化前预测这一反转。
AI.motivation: 探究具有极小初始自能的相干波分量如何影响收缩时空的第一响应，并验证一种传播场及其动量、再传播其二次源的计算方法能否在非线性演化前准确预测标量响应的增强或抑制反转。
AI.method: 采用爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量理论，在含两个对易空间类Killing场的设定下，沿由标量化黑洞内部激发的临界族（critical family）构建背景；先进行一种传播场及其动量、随后传播其二次标量源与几何源的前向计算，并与非线性演化结果进行对比；同时比较是否省略交叉项（cross terms）对预测精度的影响。
AI.result: 在固定初始电磁能量下增加低频分量，可在一个背景上增强标量响应而在另一背景上抑制之；线性化前向计算能在非线性演化前预测该反转。首次抑制对比中，保留完整相干轮廓的预测误差为0.38%，而省略交叉项时误差升至46.9%。所选响应最终发展为携带电与标量交换的磁脉冲（magnetic pulse）。
AI.conclusion: 临界几何在经历其离开Kasner纪元的首次偏离时，将入射相干性（coherence）作为可预测信息加以保留；极小自能的相干波分量即可显著重排收缩时空的早期动力学。

title: In situ local learning of dynamic network materials
summary: Functional materials realize functionalities through pre-designed structures, whereas physical neural networks are trained by prescribing input-output behavior. Unifying these views would allow materials to acquire functions directly from dynamical tasks. Here we introduce an in situ local learning framework for dynamic network materials. A forward drive and a time-reversed adjoint error drive are applied to the same mechanical network, enabling the material to compute gradients of a time-domain loss through its own dynamics. The resulting update rules are local, compatible with the principle of physical learning. Each bond or node requires only co-located forward and adjoint fields. The method trains spring constants, nodal masses, bond damping coefficients and nodal damping coefficients, and programs dynamical functions including broadband wave cloaking, evanescent-wave imaging, passive transient output enhancement and vowel classification. These examples involve distinct physical mechanisms, such as wave scattering, near-field information transfer, dissipative non-normal dynamics and machine learning, but are obtained by simply changing the loss function, rather than leveraging expert knowledge. Therefore, dynamic network materials can act both as programmable matter and as physical neural networks, providing a route to material systems that learn temporal responses in situ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对动态网络材料（dynamic network materials）的原位局部学习框架，通过在相同的力学网络上施加前向驱动与时间反演伴随误差驱动，使材料能够利用自身动力学计算时域损失函数的梯度，从而直接通过动力学任务训练材料获取功能，无需依赖专家知识设计。
AI.motivation: 功能材料（functional materials）通过预先设计结构实现功能，而物理神经网络（physical neural networks）则通过规定输入-输出行为进行训练。作者希望统一这两种视角，使材料能够直接从动力学任务中自主学习功能，而非依赖人工先验设计。
AI.method: 引入原位的局部学习框架，同时施加前向驱动（forward drive）和时间反演伴随误差驱动（time-reversed adjoint error drive），让力学网络通过自身动力学计算时域损失函数的梯度。更新规则是局部的，与物理学习（physical learning）原则相容；每个键或节点仅需共定位的前向场与伴随场信息，可训练弹簧常数、节点质量、键阻尼系数和节点阻尼系数。
AI.result: 该框架成功编程了多种动力学功能，包括宽带波隐身（broadband wave cloaking）、倏逝波成像（evanescent-wave imaging）、被动瞬态输出增强（passive transient output enhancement）以及元音分类（vowel classification）。这些例子涉及截然不同的物理机制（波散射、近场信息传递、耗散非正规动力学及机器学习），仅通过更换损失函数即可实现。
AI.conclusion: 动态网络材料可同时作为可编程物质（programmable matter）和物理神经网络发挥作用，为材料系统原位学习时域响应提供了一条可行路径。

title: Quantifying Nonstabilizerness of Quantum Codes by Removing the Inert Background
summary: Nonstabilizerness (magic) is the quantum resource that, together with stabilizer operations, makes universal quantum computation possible. It appears in fault-tolerant codes and topological order. However, quantifying nonstabilizerness is difficult. The standard measure sums over exponentially many Pauli operators, and for quantum codes no quantitative theory has been available. We resolve this by a structural observation: the Clifford sector carries no magic and can be removed by a Clifford transformation, leaving an order-three object whose magic is an exactly evaluable fourth moment. Removing this inert background yields closed forms for several code families: a formula for all Dicke states, reducing a 100-qubit case from $4^{100}$ terms to a short binomial sum; a bound for cubic-phase codes (twisted quantum doubles and non-Abelian topological order), saturated only by the $D_4$ code; and a cyclic/zero criterion for group multiplication states. Together these results reduce the computation of nonstabilizerness for a broad class of codes to finite classical counting problems, and identify the maximally magical codes among them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构观察发现，Clifford扇区不携带magic资源，可通过Clifford变换消除，从而将非stabilizer性（nonstabilizerness）的计算简化为有限经典计数问题，并为Dicke态、三次相位码（cubic-phase codes）等多类量子码给出了闭合形式的magic量化公式。
AI.motivation: 非stabilizer性（nonstabilizerness）是使通用量子计算成为可能的量子资源，出现在容错码和拓扑序中，但其量化极为困难——标准测度需要对指数多的Pauli算符求和，且对量子码尚缺乏定量理论。
AI.method: 核心方法基于一个结构观察：Clifford扇区不携带magic，可通过Clifford变换将其移除，剩余一个三阶对象，其magic恰为可精确计算的第四矩（fourth moment）；在此基础上将研究转化为有限经典计数问题。
AI.result: 获得了多类码族的闭合形式结果：给出了所有Dicke态的公式（将100量子比特情形从4的100次方项缩减为短二项式求和）；给出了三次相位码（包括扭曲量子双体和阿贝尔拓扑序）的界，该界仅由D4码饱和；并给出了群乘法态的循环/零判据。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将广泛量子码类的nonstabilizerness计算简化为有限经典计数问题，并从中识别出magic最大的码。

title: Kinematic Control and Dephasing Dynamics of Quantum Resources in $e^{+}e^{-}\toτ^{+}τ^{-}$
summary: We characterize several quantum resources carried by the spins of the $τ^{+}τ^{-}$ pair produced in $e^{+}e^{-}$ annihilation. At the Belle-II energy, $\sqrt{s}=10.579\,\mathrm{GeV}$, Bell nonlocality, steerability, entanglement of formation, and coherence are governed by the production angle and are largest for transverse emission, $\vartheta=π/2$. Their common kinematic origin is exposed by expressing the spin state as a velocity and angle-dependent mixture of a separable contribution and a maximally entangled component. Within the physical production domain, this representation connects the weakly correlated threshold state at $\sqrt{s}=2m_τ$ to the Bell-state limit approached at ultrarelativistic energies. We then propagate the two-spin state through a phenomenological correlated-dephasing channel to determine how environmental memory and inter-channel classical correlations affect the available resources. Memory effects generate collapses and revivals that are absent from the monotonic Markovian evolution. The analysis therefore separates the kinematic mechanism that creates the spin correlations from the noise properties that control their subsequent survival.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统地刻画了e⁺e⁻湮灭过程中产生的τ⁺τ⁻自旋对所携带的多种量子资源，发现Bell非局域性、可操控性、纠缠形成和相干性均受产生角度控制并在横向发射角ϑ=π/2时达到最大，并通过将自旋态表述为可分离成分与最大纠缠成分的速度和角度依赖性混合来揭示其共同的运动学起源，同时分析了环境记忆和信道间经典关联对量子资源存活的影响。
AI.motivation: 在高能正负电子湮灭过程中产生的τ轻子对携带丰富的量子信息，需要在Belle-II能量下系统量化这些量子资源并理解其与运动学参数之间的关系，同时考察真实环境噪声对资源存活的影响。
AI.method: 在√s=10.579 GeV的Belle-II能量下，将τ⁺τ⁻对的自旋态表示为具有速度（velocity）和角度（angle）依赖性的可分离贡献与最大纠缠成分的混合；随后将双自旋态通过一个现象学关联退相（correlated-dephasing）信道传播，以研究环境记忆效应和信道间经典关联的作用。
AI.result: Bell非局域性（Bell nonlocality）、可操控性（steerability）、纠缠形成（entanglement of formation）和相干性（coherence）均由产生角度决定，且在横向发射（ϑ=π/2）时最大；该表示在物理产生域内将弱关联的阈值态（√s=2m_τ）与超相对论能量下逼近的Bell态极限联系起来，并发现记忆效应产生的塌缩-恢复（collapses and revivals）现象在单调的Markov演化中不存在。
AI.conclusion: 该分析将产生自旋关联的运动学机制与控制其后续存活的环境噪声特性分离开来，揭示了量子资源的产生与退化的不同物理来源。

title: Splitting Dynamics of Multiply Quantized Vortices in Holographic Superfluid of Finite Temperature
summary: We study the splitting dynamics of multiply quantized vortices with winding numbers $n=5,6,7$ and $8$ in a two-dimensional holographic superfluid at finite temperature, by combining linear perturbation analysis of quasinormal modes with fully nonlinear real-time numerical simulations. Three new physical phenomena are revealed. First, the number of unstable modes no longer strictly follows the $2n-3$ formula as $n$ increases. For the vortex with $n=8$, the unstable mode with $p=2(n-1)$ is absent throughout the entire temperature range, so that only $2n-4$ unstable modes exist. Second, the transition of the dominant unstable mode with increasing temperature exhibits new characteristics. For vortices with $n\le 6$, the dominant mode changes sequentially as $p=2,3,\dots,n$, whereas for $n\ge 7$ jump-like transitions occur-for instance, for $n=7$ the dominant mode jumps from $p=2$ to $p=4$ at $T=0.325T_c$ and then directly to $p=7$ at $T=0.359T_c$, and for $n=8$ it jumps directly from $p=2$ to $p=8$ at $T=0.302T_c$. Third, a single splitting pattern of high-winding-number vortices can contain multiple sub-splitting patterns with distinct topological structures, as exemplified by the $l=4$ pattern of the $n=8$ vortex, which exhibits three sub-patterns at low, intermediate and high temperatures. The nonlinear simulations confirm the predictions of the linear stability analysis, and the implications of our results for cold-atom experiments are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文在二维全息超流体（holographic superfluid）中，通过线性扰动与全非线性实时数值模拟相结合，系统研究了高绕数（winding number）涡旋（n=5–8）在有限温度下的分裂动力学，揭示了三项新的物理现象：不稳定模数目不再严格遵循 2n−3 公式、支配不稳定模随温度转变出现跳变特征，以及高绕数涡旋的单一分裂形态可包含多种拓扑结构不同子分裂模式。
AI.motivation: 多重量子化涡旋（multiply quantized vortex）在高绕数下的分裂动力学此前尚缺乏深入研究，特别是线性稳定性分析与非线性演化之间的对应关系、以及温度升高过程中支配不稳定模式的转变规律均未完全明确。
AI.method: 将准正规模（quasinormal mode）的线性扰动分析与全非线性实时间数值模拟相结合，在二维全息超流体中以有限温度为背景，对绕数为 n=5,6,7,8 的涡旋进行分裂动力学研究。
AI.result: 第一，n=8 涡旋在整个温度范围内缺少 p=2(n−1) 的不稳定模，导致仅有 2n−4 个不稳定模存在，偏离了 2n−3 公式。第二，支配不稳定模随温度升高的转变呈现新规律：对 n≤6 涡旋模式按 p=2,3,…,n 顺序转换，而对 n≥7 涡旋则出现跳跃式转变——例如 n=7 涡旋在 T=0.325Tc 从 p=2 跳至 p=4，在 T=0.359Tc 直接跳至 p=7；n=8 涡旋在 T=0.302Tc 直接从 p=2 跳至 p=8。第三，高绕数涡旋的一个分裂形态可包含多个具有不同拓扑结构的子分裂模式，如 n=8 涡旋的 l=4 形态在低、中、高温度下分别展现出三种子模式。非线性模拟证实了线性稳定性分析的预测。
AI.conclusion: 线性稳定性分析与非线性模拟的一致性验证了方法的可靠性；文中指出上述结果对冷原子实验（cold-atom experiments）具有潜在意义，但摘要中未给出具体实验建议的细节。

title: Scalar field with nonminimal couplings to metric-affine geometry
summary: We study a scalar field nonminimally coupled to metric-affine gravity within actions linear in the affine curvature and containing all independent parity-even and parity-odd terms quadratic in torsion and nonmetricity, including mixed contractions. We also include Nieh-Yan-like derivative couplings between the scalar-field derivative and the four torsion and nonmetricity vectors. We derive the connection, metric, and scalar-field equations and, since the connection equation is algebraic, eliminate the independent connection on the generic nondegenerate branch to obtain an equivalent metric scalar-tensor theory in which the non-Riemannian interactions are encoded in an effective kinetic function. We classify several sectors and find that the pure quadratic nonmetricity and pure quadratic torsion sectors separately leave the Einstein-frame kinetic function unchanged relative to the simplest metric-affine scalar-tensor model, whereas their simultaneous presence, the derivative couplings, and generic mixed torsion-nonmetricity interactions can modify it. In the derivative-coupling sector, projective consistency imposes a relation among the couplings. We then consider polynomial coupling functions and study the resulting canonical field redefinition and Einstein-frame potentials. In particular, we illustrate how derivative and mixed torsion--nonmetricity couplings reshape quadratic and quartic potentials in canonical-field space, and show that a quadratic Jordan-frame potential can be mapped, for a suitable choice of derivative and nonminimal couplings, into a natural-inflation potential after canonical normalization. Finally, we separately impose the cosmological principle, determine the reduced combinations of quadratic couplings and the scalar field hypermomentum, and obtain the corresponding modified cosmological equations in the simplest sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究标量场与度规-仿射引力（metric-affine gravity）的非最小耦合，在含线性仿射曲率以及扭率（torsion）和非度规性（nonmetricity）所有独立二次项（含宇称偶和宇称奇项）的作用量框架下，推导了连接场、度规场和标量场方程，并在通常非退化分支上消去独立连接，得到等价的度规标量-张量理论。文中分类了不同扇区，考察了导数耦合及混合扭率-非度规性相互作用对爱因斯坦框架动能函数的影响，并通过标度场重定义展示了不同势函数间的映射关系，最后在宇宙学原理下推导了修正的宇宙学方程。
AI.motivation: 度规-仿射引力（metric-affine gravity）框架包含了更一般的几何结构（扭率与非度规性），但完整分析含所有二次不变量及导数耦合的标量-张量理论尚属空白。作者旨在系统研究该框架下非黎曼相互作用对标量场理论结构的影响，特别是对爱因斯坦框架动能函数和势的修正机制。
AI.method: 作者从含线性仿射曲率、所有宇称偶/奇二次扭率-非度规性项（含混合缩并）以及Nieh-Yan类导数耦合的作用量出发，推导连接场、度规场和标量场方程。由于连接场方程为代数形式，在一般非退化分支上将其消去，得到等效的度规标量-张量理论，其中非黎曼相互作用由有效动能函数编码。随后将二次耦合项按不同扇区分类，分析各扇区对动能函数的影响。对于多项式耦合函数，进一步研究标准场重定义（canonical field redefinition）下的势函数变换。最后在宇宙学原理（cosmological principle）下约化耦合组合，推导修正宇宙学方程。
AI.result: 研究发现：纯二次非度规性扇区和纯二次扭率扇区分别不会改变爱因斯坦框架动能函数，但两者的同时存在、导数耦合以及一般混合扭率-非度规性相互作用可以改变该函数。在导数耦合扇区中，射影一致性（projective consistency）对各耦合常数施加约束关系。通过适当的导数耦合与非最小耦合选择，二次约尔当框架势可在标准归一化后映射为自然膨胀（natural inflation）势。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了度规-仿射引力框架中扭率与非度规性相互作用能够非平凡地修改标量场的动力学结构，但在特定扇区（纯二次扭率或纯二次非度规性）中保持动能函数不变。导数耦合和混合相互作用可能重塑势函数，为理论宇宙学建模提供了新的自由度。

title: Static and Ensemble-Dependent Thermodynamics of the Strain-Induced Parity Anomaly in Gapped Graphene
summary: A static deformation of graphene can act on its Dirac electrons as a valley-odd magnetic field. In sublattice-gapped graphene this field makes the two valleys add in the parity-odd response rather than cancel. We derive the equilibrium thermodynamics of this effect and separate it from the finite-frequency transport response. At fixed electrochemical potential, reversing the pseudomagnetic field removes every nonzero pseudo-Landau level in the continuum theory. The remaining grand-potential difference is fixed by the spectrally asymmetric zeroth level. The static charge response is a thermally broadened plateau confined to the gap and has no metallic $m/|μ|$ tail. Near a band edge, pseudofield reversal transfers $\mathrm{B}\ln2$ of entropy per unsplit zero-mode state in the low-temperature window. The fixed-$μ$ heat capacity has two side lobes per edge and a universal peak $0.439229\,D_B k_{\mathrm B}$. We then formulate a definite constant-gate-voltage circuit and show that the measured sheet heat capacity depends on the electrical boundary condition. The full massive-Dirac density of states and an exact finite-field pseudo-Landau-level calculation give the same gate crossover in their common limit. At fixed carrier number, the low-temperature edge value is $-2(\ln2)^2 D_B k_{\mathrm B}$, rather than a node. A finite geometric capacitance gives a continuous and experimentally tunable interpolation. Finally, we give a trace-free triaxial strain geometry, a disorder--interaction window, and realistic calorimetric and quantum-capacitance scales. The field-reversal protocol isolates an equilibrium electromechanical anomaly without a real magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在亚晶格间隙（sublattice-gapped）石墨烯中，赝磁场（pseudomagnetic field）反转导致的谷奇宇称（valley-odd）热力学响应，推导了平衡态热力学并明确了与有限频率输运响应的区分。
AI.motivation: 静态形变可对石墨烯狄拉克电子产生谷奇宇称磁场的等效作用；间隙石墨烯中该磁场使两谷在宇称奇响应（parity-odd response）中相加而非相消，因此需要构建完整的平衡态热力学以定量描述该效应。
AI.method: 从连续理论出发推导固定电化学势/固定载流子数条件下的赝场反转热力学框架；利用完整的大质量狄拉克态密度和精确的有限场赝朗道能级计算交叉验证；引入恒栅压电路模型并计入有限几何电容以描述门控交叉行为；给出无迹三轴应变几何及其他实验参数尺度。
AI.result: 固定电化学势下赝场反转消除所有非零赝朗道能级（pseudo-Landau level），巨势差由谱不对称的零级能级决定；静态电荷响应为限制于能隙内的热展宽平台，无金属m/|μ|尾部；近能带边缘的熵转移为B ln2，固定μ热容具有边缘侧瓣和普适峰0.439229 D_B k_B；固定载流子数时低温边缘值为−2(ln2)²D_B k_B而非节点。
AI.conclusion: 该场反转协议可在无需真实磁场的条件下隔离出一个平衡电机械异常（equilibrium electromechanical anomaly），并且测量的薄层热容依赖电学边界条件，有限几何电容提供了实验上可调的连续内插。

title: On Bäcklund transformations preserving the Darboux integrability of hyperbolic equations
summary: This paper deals with two kinds of Bäcklund transformations for scalar hyperbolic partial differential equations. We prove that both these types of transformations map solutions of a Darboux integrable equation into solutions of, generally speaking, another but also Darboux integrable equation. The latter fact can be used to roughly check the completeness of a list of Darboux integrable equations. To illustrate this, we apply the above transformations to several equations from a well-known list of Darboux integrable equations and, as a result, obtain a Darboux integrable equation which is absent in this list, but is already known at present. As a generalization of the last equation, we construct a family of Darboux integrable equations that is parametrized by three arbitrary functions, each of which depends on two arguments. This family is probably new.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两类针对标量双曲偏微分方程的Bäcklund变换，证明它们将Darboux可积方程的解映射为另一个（通常不同的）Darboux可积方程的解，并以此构建了一个由三个二元任意函数参数化的新的Darboux可积方程族。
AI.motivation: 作者希望利用Bäcklund变换在不同Darboux可积方程之间建立映射关系，进而检验已有Darboux可积方程列表的完备性，并探索构造新的Darboux可积方程的可能性。
AI.method: 论文对两类Bäcklund变换（Bäcklund transformations）进行了理论证明，表明它们能将Darboux可积方程的解映射到另一Darboux可积方程的解；随后将上述变换应用于已知Darboux可积方程列表中的若干方程，验证变换的有效性并生成新方程。
AI.result: 通过对已知列表中若干方程施加变换，获得了一个不在该列表中但现已为人所知的Darboux可积方程；进一步将其推广，构造出一个由三个任意函数参数化的Darboux可积方程族，每个函数依赖两个自变量，该族可能为新结果。
AI.conclusion: Bäcklund变换可作为Darboux可积方程列表完备性的粗略检验工具，同时能够系统性地生成新的Darboux可积方程和方程族，为相关分类问题的研究提供新路径。

title: A Vector-Like Lepton Interpretation of the High-Energy Nuclear Recoil Candidate in LUX-ZEPLIN
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, lots of fun. Comments welcome!
summary: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment has recently reported a nuclear-recoil candidate at $E_R=248\pm23_{\rm stat}\pm23_{\rm sys}\,{\rm keV}$ in an exposure of $2.84\,{\rm tonne\,yr}$. At this unusually high recoil energy, the spin-independent (SI) xenon response is strongly suppressed, motivating dark matter interactions with a harder recoil spectrum. We show that elastic spin-dependent (SD) scattering through the nonrelativistic operator $\mathcal O_4=\mathbf S_{\rm DM}\cdot\mathbf S_N$ provides a simple realization of such a spectrum. We consider singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter, for which a diagonal $Z$ coupling generates the required SD interaction. The accompanying Higgs-mediated SI interaction would generically produce too many low-energy recoils, but can be suppressed along a Higgs blind spot while retaining a nonzero $Z$ coupling. We find a region of the Higgs blind spot that simultaneously predicts an $\mathcal O(1)$ event rate in the LZ high-recoil window and reproduces the observed thermal relic abundance. The same SD interaction leads to solar capture, allowing this region to be tested independently with solar-neutrino searches. Current IceCube limits already probe part of the LZ-compatible thermal parameter space, while a viable region remains. Additional xenon exposure and improved solar-neutrino searches can therefore provide complementary tests of this interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LZ实验在约2.84吨·年曝光中观测到的高核反冲候选事件（248 keV），提出弹性自旋相关（SD）散射通过非相对论算符O4可自然解释该硬反冲谱。作者在单态-双重态马约拉纳暗物质框架下建立模型，利用对角Z耦合产生SD相互作用，并通过希格斯盲点抑制自旋无关（SI）相互作用，找到了既能预测LZ高反冲窗口内约O(1)事件率、又能复现观测热遗迹丰度的参数区域。
AI.motivation: LZ实验在异常高的反冲能量（248 keV）探测到候选事件，而该能量下传统的自旋无关（SI）氙响应被强烈抑制，这强烈暗示暗物质可能具有更硬的反冲谱，从而需要寻找新的散射机制来解释这一信号。
AI.method: 作者考虑通过非相对论算符O4（即S_DM·S_N）实现的弹性自旋相关（SD）散射，在单态-双重态马约拉纳暗物质框架中构建模型，利用对角Z耦合生成所需的SD相互作用，同时沿希格斯盲点（Higgs blind spot）抑制伴生的Higgs介导SI相互作用，并检验参数区域是否能同时满足LZ事件率和热遗迹丰度。
AI.result: 找到了希格斯盲点中的一个区域，可同时预测LZ高反冲窗口内约O(1)的事件率并复现观测到的热遗迹丰度；该区域还可通过太阳捕获与太阳中微子搜索进行独立检验，现有IceCube限制已覆盖部分与LZ兼容的热参数空间，但仍留有可行区域。
AI.conclusion: LZ高反冲候选事件可通过弹性SD散射在O4算符框架下自洽地解释；增加氙曝光量并改进太阳中微子搜索可为该解释提供互补性的验证途径。

title: Covariant Phase Space and Carroll-Weyl $χ$ Symmetry of Carroll Non-BPS D$_p$-branes
summary: We analyze the covariant phase space of Klusoň's canonical Carroll non-BPS D\(_p\)-brane actions. The Carroll limit is formulated as a contraction of the canonical phase space: the canonical one-form is invariant under the scaling of conjugate pairs, while the leading Hamiltonian constraint differs between the electric-like and magnetic-like sectors. This difference controls the weak closure of the electric-like constraint algebra and the stronger closure of the magnetic-like Hamiltonian brackets. We separate the generic non-BPS sector, which carries \(D-1\) local phase-space degrees of freedom, from the tachyon-vacuum sector, which carries \(D-2\) only after imposing second-class background conditions. We also identify the rank condition for the generic electric-like sector and its strengthening in the vacuum sector. Finally, we show that the Carroll--Weyl \(χ\) transformation preserves the symplectic form and admits a charge, but is obstructed by the constraints and cannot be promoted to a first-class gauge generator except in a highly restricted global vacuum sector. This contrasts with null string theory, where a restricted \(χ\)-symmetry can be completed to an additional first-class constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Klusoň的规范Carroll非BPS D\(_p\)-膜作用量的协变相空间，揭示了电类与磁类扇区在哈密顿约束闭包上的差异，分离了携带不同局域相空间自由度的两个扇区，并证明Carroll–Weyl χ变换虽保持辛形式并存在荷，但受约束阻碍无法提升为第一类规范生成元，仅在高度受限的全局真空扇区中例外，这与空弦理论中χ对称性的完全开闭形成对比。
AI.motivation: 理解Carroll极限下非BPS D\(_p\)-膜理论相空间的规范结构与约束代数，特别是电类与磁类扇区之间约束闭包的差异及其对Carroll–Weyl χ对称性的影响。
AI.method: 将Carroll极限表述为规范相空间的收缩过程，利用协变相空间方法分析电类与磁类扇区的哈密顿约束结构，通过弱闭包条件考察约束代数的闭包性质，并分离一般非BPS扇区与快子真空扇区分别分析自由度和等级条件，最后检验Carroll–Weyl χ变换对辛形式和约束的相容性。
AI.result: 电类约束代数呈弱闭包而磁类哈密顿括号呈更强闭包；一般非BPS扇区承载D−1个局域相空间自由度，而快子真空扇区在施加第二类背景条件后仅承载D−2个自由度；识别出一般电类扇区的等级条件及其在真空扇区中的强化；Carroll–Weyl χ变换保持辛形式并存在相关荷，但受到约束的阻碍，除全局真空扇区的极端受限情形外无法提升为第一类规范生成元。
AI.conclusion: Carroll非BPS D\(_p\)-膜的χ对称性与空弦理论存在本质差异：前者受约束阻碍不能成为第一类规范生成元，而后者受限的χ对称性可补全为额外的第一类约束，说明两类理论在Carroll极限下的规范结构具有截然不同的特征。

title: NRSur7dq4v2: A multi-domain precessing surrogate model with improved accuracy
summary: Numerical relativity simulations provide the most accurate waveforms for binary black hole coalescences, but are prohibitively expensive for direct use in gravitational-wave data analysis. Surrogate models overcome this cost, and NRSur7dq4 is commonly used in parameter estimation for this reason. However, there is evidence in the literature that NRSur7dq4's accuracy could be improved in the merger-ringdown portion of the waveform, which is particularly important for the analysis of high-mass binary black hole events. Motivated by these observations, we construct NRSur7dq4v2, a multi-domain extension of NRSur7dq4 in which overlapping temporal subdomains allow tighter, independent error control over the inspiral and merger-ringdown portions of the waveform before they are smoothly combined. To assess the new model's performance in the merger-ringdown regime, we infer the mass and spin of the remnant black hole from quasi-normal fits to the ringdown portion of the surrogate waveform. We find that NRSur7dq4v2 produces significantly improved remnant mass and spin estimates, with gains of roughly factors of $3$ to $10$ over NRSur7dq4. Compared to NRSur7dq4, NRSur7dq4v2 also includes modes up to $\ell=5$, includes more accurate modeling of certain subdominant modes, and introduces a runtime model-complexity feature that gives users direct control over the tradeoff between evaluation cost and accuracy. Finally, alongside the model development, we have optimized the gwsurrogate package to achieve a fourfold speedup for precessing surrogates. The resulting precessing surrogates called through gwsurrogate are now slightly faster than their LALSimulation counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了NRSur7dq4v2，一个NRSur7dq4的多域扩展版本（multi-domain extension），通过重叠时间子域实现对啁啾（inspiral）与并合-振铃（merger-ringdown）阶段波形的独立误差控制，显著提升了残留黑洞（remnant black hole）质量与自旋的估计精度（改善约3至10倍），并将gwsurrogate软件包的运行速度提升了四倍。
AI.motivation: 数值相对论（numerical relativity）模拟能提供双黑洞并合（binary black hole coalescence）最精确的波形，但直接用于引力波数据分析成本过高。替代模型（surrogate models）中NRSur7dq4虽被广泛用于参数估计，但文献证据表明其在merger-ringdown阶段的精度有提升空间，而该阶段对高质双黑洞事件的分析尤为关键。
AI.method: 构建NRSur7dq4v2作为NRSur7dq4的多域扩展，利用重叠的时间子域（overlapping temporal subdomains）对inspiral与merger-ringdown阶段波形分别进行更紧密、独立的误差控制后再平滑合并。模型还加入了最高ℓ=5的模（modes），改进了若干次要模（subdominant modes）的建模精度，并引入运行时模型复杂度（runtime model-complexity）特性以讓用户权衡评估成本与精度。
AI.result: 通过拟正规拟合（quasi-normal fits）推断并合后残留在黑洞的质量与自旋，发现NRSur7dq4v2相比NRSur7dq4在残留质量与自旋估计上获得约3至10倍的显著改善。此外，gwsurrogate软件包经优化后，用于进动（precessing）系统的替代模型速度提升四倍，甚至略快于对应的LALSimulation实现。
AI.conclusion: NRSur7dq4v2在merger-ringdown阶段的波形精度明显优于NRSur7dq4，可提供更可靠的剩余黑洞参数估计，同时通过gwsurrogate优化在运行效率上也实现突破，有望改进高质双黑洞事件的引力波参数估计分析。

title: Controlling pair dynamics of rotating magnetic microparticles through radial and transverse interactions
summary: Rotating magnetic microparticles are building blocks for field-driven assembly and microrobotic control. As the elementary interaction rule for larger assemblies, pair motion in these systems is governed not only by magnetic forcing, but also by hydrodynamic coupling and other long-range interactions. Here we develop a reduced framework for two synchronized rotating magnetic particles by resolving the interactions into radial components that change the interparticle distance and transverse components that rotate the line of centers. The competition between magnetic dipolar interaction, additional radial repulsion, and rotation-induced transverse coupling selects three pair-motion modes: rigid-body rotation, contact-separation rotation, and irreversible separation. We derive transition criteria for the rigid-body state, reversed orbital motion, and the separation boundary, and obtain an asymptotic solution for the separation dynamics. Lattice Boltzmann simulations of particles rotating near a wall provide a hydrodynamic realization of the model, in which inertial secondary flow generates radial repulsion and rotational flow produces transverse coupling. The resulting phase diagram in the physical $(\mathrm{Re},C_m)$ plane is consistent with the reduced-model predictions. These results provide design rules for programming elementary pair interactions in rotating magnetic-particle systems and may help guide the control of microrobotic assemblies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对两个同步旋转磁性微粒（magnetic microparticles）构建了一个简化理论框架，将相互作用分解为改变粒子间距的径向分量与旋转粒子连线的横向分量，据此区分出刚性体旋转、接触-分离旋转与不可逆分离三种对运动模式，并通过晶格玻尔兹曼（Lattice Boltzmann）仿真在物理参数平面中验证了模型预测。
AI.motivation: 旋转磁性微粒是场驱动组装和微型机器人（microrobotic）控制的基本构成单元，而成对粒子运动作为大型组装的基元相互作用规则，不仅受磁力驱动，还受流体动力学耦合（hydrodynamic coupling）及其他长程相互作用影响，现有理论尚缺乏对配对运动模式的系统刻画。
AI.method: 作者将两粒子相互作用分解为改变粒子间距的径向分量与旋转连线方向的横向分量，建立简化运动框架；据此推导刚性体状态的转捩判据、反向轨道运动判据及分离边界，并获得分离动力学的渐近解。随后利用靠近壁面旋转粒子的晶格玻尔兹曼仿真提供模型的流体动力学实现。
AI.result: 模型揭示磁偶极相互作用、附加径向排斥与旋转诱导横向耦合之间的竞争可产生三种对运动模式：刚性体旋转、接触-分离旋转与不可逆分离；获得了各模式间的转捩判据与分离渐近解。仿真表明惯性次级流动（inertial secondary flow）产生径向排斥、旋转流动产生横向耦合，据此构建的物理（Re，Cm）参数相图与简化模型预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为编程旋转磁性粒子系统中的基本成对相互作用提供了设计规则，有助于指导微型机器人组装的运动控制。

title: Tropicalization of Fock's inverse spectral transform
summary: The dimer spectral transform gives algebro-geometric action-angle coordinates for cluster integrable systems. Fock gave an explicit formula for its inverse. We study Fock's inverse map in the tropical limit where Harnack spectral curves degenerate to nodal curves. We determine the leading order asymptotics of the classical objects appearing in Fock's formula and show that they are governed by their tropical counterparts. This yields a tropical inverse spectral transform on tropical spectral data. We show that Fock's inverse spectral transform commutes with tropicalization, and also derive a tropical version of Fay's trisecant identity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Fock的二聚体谱变换（dimer spectral transform）逆映射在热带极限（tropical limit）下的行为，证明其与热带化（tropicalization）过程可交换，并推导出Fay三割线恒等式（Fay's trisecant identity）的热带版本。
AI.motivation: 二聚体谱变换为簇可积系统（cluster integrable systems）提供了代数几何意义下的作用-角坐标，Fock给出了其逆映射的显式公式。作者希望在Harnack谱曲线退化为节点曲线（nodal curves）的热带极限下理解Fock逆映射的渐近行为。
AI.method: 在谱曲线退化为节点曲线的热带极限框架下，确定Fock公式中经典对象的领头阶渐近行为，并证明它们由相应的热带对应物（tropical counterparts）所支配。
AI.result: 建立了热带谱数据上的热带逆谱变换，证明了Fock的逆谱变换与热带化过程可交换，并导出了Fay三割线恒等式的一个热带版本。
AI.conclusion: Fock的逆谱变换与热带化在两个范畴之间建立了一致性对应，为热带簇可积系统提供了严格的形式基础。

title: Neutron disappearance and the LZ nuclear recoil event
summary: The LZ experiment reported a nuclear recoil with anomalous energy $E_R=248$ keV, around the typical neutron motion in xenon. This motivates interpreting the event as the disappearance of a bound neutron, either through spontaneous decay or a dark-matter-induced reaction. If the energy released is large, the predicted recoil spectrum is broad around the observed value; only $\sim10\%$ of xenon events avoid extra nuclear activity; the disappearance rate is target-independent and mildly constrained by oxygen experiments. In the special case of near-threshold DM-induced neutron disappearance, it can be open in xenon and closed in oxygen, the quiet fraction rises to $\sim30\%$, the recoil spectrum turns into lines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LZ（LUX-ZEPLIN）实验中观测到的一个异常核反冲事件（能量为248 keV），提出将其解释为束缚中子消失的假设，并系统对比了自发衰变与暗物质（dark matter）诱发反应两种机制下，氙靶与氧靶实验对反冲谱和"安静事件"占比的预测差异。
AI.motivation: LZ实验报告的核反冲能量（248 keV）接近氙中典型中子运动的能量范围，这一异常事件难以用常规背景解释，因此需要提出新的物理机制来理解其来源，并检验其是否与暗物质相互作用或中子不稳定衰变有关。
AI.method: 该研究将该事件解释为束缚中子的消失（bound neutron disappearance），并区分两种物理路径：自发衰变（spontaneous decay）与暗物质诱发反应（dark-matter-induced reaction）。作者进一步分析了大能量释放的常规情形与近阈值（near-threshold）暗物质诱发中子消失的特殊情形，比较了氙（xenon）与氧（oxygen）两种靶实验的约束能力。
AI.result: 在大能量释放情形下，预测的反冲谱在观测值附近呈较宽分布；仅约10%的氙事件能避免额外的核活动；中子消失率与靶材料无关，但受到氧实验的温和约束。在近阈值暗物质诱发中子消失的特殊情形下，该过程在氙中可开启而在氧中被关闭，安静事件占比升至约30%，反冲谱退化为谱线（line）结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分常规与近阈值两种中子消失情形，该研究为LZ异常事件提供了可检验的理论框架，指出氙与氧靶实验的结合可作为判别中子消失机制与暗物质模型的灵敏度探针。

title: Quantum spacetime and gravity from the IKKT matrix model: an invitation
summary: This is a concise and compact introduction to a framework for spacetime, gravity, and fundamental physics based on the IKKT matrix model, focusing on conceptual and structural aspects. The approach rests on nontrivial vacua or matrix backgrounds, which serve as 3+1-dimensional noncommutative spacetime. We discuss a specific class of backgrounds describing expanding homogeneous and isotropic FLRW spacetime, which provide a solution of the one-loop effective action with finitely many dof per volume. Perturbations of the background give rise to fields propagating on spacetime governed by a weakly-coupled gauge theory, as well as a nonstandard description of (quantum) gravity leading to some IR modifications. Maximal supersymmetry of the model is essential to ensure effective locality.

AI.tldr: 本文基于IKKT矩阵模型（IKKT matrix model）框架，对时空、引力及基础物理进行了简明扼要的导论性介绍，核心思路是以非平凡真空或矩阵背景作为3+1维非交换时空（noncommutative spacetime）的微观描述，并讨论了一类能产生膨胀、均匀且各向同性的FLRW时空（FLRW spacetime）的特定背景及其物理解释。
AI.motivation: 旨在为基于IKKT矩阵模型理解时空、引力与基础物理提供一个凝练且结构清晰的框架性导论，聚焦于概念与结构层面而非繁复的技术细节。
AI.method: 采用IKKT矩阵模型框架，将非平凡真空态或矩阵背景作为3+1维非交换时空的物理实现；考虑描述膨胀、均匀各向同性FLRW时空的一类特定背景，并验证其为单圈有效作用量（one-loop effective action）的解，且每个体积内具有有限自由度（finitely many degrees of freedom）。背景扰动生成立场及其弱耦合规范理论（weakly-coupled gauge theory）描述，并给出非标准形式的（量子）引力图像，伴随一定的红外（IR）修正。
AI.result: 展示了模型中的最大超对称性（maximal supersymmetry）对确保有效局域性（effective locality）至关重要；背景解的扰动自然导出在时空中传播的场以及弱耦合规范理论，同时对（量子）引力给出带红外修正的非标准描述。
AI.conclusion: IKKT矩阵模型可通过特定矩阵背景为时空几何与引力提供统一的生成机制，其中最大超对称性与背景解的构造共同保证了理论的局域性与自洽性。

title: Nonradial oscillations of realistic anisotropic neutron stars: Polar modes
summary: In this work, we study the polar perturbations of static, spherically symmetric neutron stars with anisotropic pressure in full general relativity, including linear-order perturbations of both the metric and the fluid. We calculate the $f$-mode frequencies and the corresponding damping times using a consistent treatment of the perturbation of the radial vector $k^α$. In particular, its Lagrangian perturbation $Δk^α$ is determined by the metric perturbations and the fluid Lagrangian displacement and is constrained to the $(\tilde{u},\tilde{k})$ plane, where $\tilde{u}^α$ is the normalized fluid four-velocity. This constraint introduces an additional dynamical degree of freedom into the perturbation equations. Considering three equations of state and the Horvat and Bowers-Liang prescriptions for pressure anisotropy, we find that the $f$-mode frequency increases with stellar mass, ranging from $1$ to $3$~kHz, while the damping time decreases, ranging from $0.5$ to $1.25$~s. Increasing anisotropy, in the sense of tangential pressure exceeding radial pressure, generally lowers the oscillation frequency, while its effect on the damping time depends on the anisotropy prescription: the damping time decreases with increasing anisotropy for the Horvat model but increases with increasing anisotropy for the Bowers-Liang model. We further find quasi-universal relations between the real and imaginary parts of the $f$-mode frequency, $Mω_R$ and $Mω_I$, and the stellar compactness $\mathcal{C}=M/R$, which are largely insensitive to the equation of state. Polynomial fits to these relations achieve an accuracy better than $10\%$, providing a simple phenomenological framework for constraining neutron-star pressure anisotropy through future asteroseismology observations.

AI.tldr: 本文在完全广义相对论框架下研究了具有各向异性压力的静态球对称中子星的极向扰动，包括度规和流体的线性阶扰动。作者计算了f模频率及相应阻尼时间，发现f模频率随星体质量增加而升高（1-3 kHz），阻尼时间随质量增加而减小（0.5-1.25 s）；同时还发现了f模频率实部与虚部同星体紧致度之间与物态方程基本无关的准普适关系。
AI.motivation: 研究中子星的压力各向异性如何影响其引力波特征振荡模式，为未来通过星震学（asteroseismology）观测约束中子星内部各向异性压力提供理论基础。
AI.method: 在完整广义相对论下对静态球对称各向异性压力中子星施加极向扰动，同时对度规和流体做线性阶处理；对径向矢量k^α的拉格朗日扰动Δk^α进行自洽处理，将其约束在(u~,k~)平面内，引入额外的动力学自由度。采用三种物态方程及Horvat和Bowers-Liang两种压力各向异性方案进行计算。
AI.result: f模频率随星体质量增加而升高（1-3 kHz），阻尼时间随质量增加而减小（0.5-1.25 s）。增大切向压力超过径向压力的各向异性程度通常会降低振荡频率，但对阻尼时间的影响取决于各向异性方案：Horvat模型中阻尼时间随各向异性增大而减小，Bowers-Liang模型中则随各向异性增大而增大。f模频率实虚部与紧致度之间存在与物态方程基本无关的准普适关系，多项式拟合精度优于10%。
AI.conclusion: 通过准普适关系的多项式拟合，为未来星震学观测提供了一种简单的唯象学框架，可用于约束中子星的压力各向异性。

title: Microscopic calculation of coherence lengths and magnetic penetration depth in multiband superconductors
summary: We present an extended Ginzburg-Landau (GL) method for calculating the superconducting coherence length and magnetic penetration depth at temperatures well below the transition temperature $T_{\mathrm c}$. In contrast to conventional GL theory, which expands the free energy in both the order parameters and their gradients, our method applies a perturbative expansion only to the covariant-gradient terms, while retaining the full dependence on the superconducting order parameters. The coefficients of these terms are determined from finite differences of microscopic free energies evaluated at small imposed pair momenta. The method applies to both single-band and multiband superconductors and therefore provides a framework for incorporating more realistic electronic structures. For the models examined here, the extended GL method agrees well with real-space Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) calculations over a wide temperature range, while requiring substantially less computational effort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩展的金兹堡-朗道（Ginzburg-Landau, GL）方法，用于在远低于转变温度的条件下计算超导相干长度（coherence length）和磁穿透深度（magnetic penetration depth）。该方法仅对协变梯度项进行微扰展开，保留对超导序参量的完整依赖，并通过对微小成对动量下的微观自由能做有限差分来确定展开系数。
AI.motivation: 传统GL理论在远低于转变温度时因自由能展开的限制而难以准确计算超导相干长度与磁穿透深度，需要一种在低温区间仍有效且适用于多能带超导体的计算方法。
AI.method: 与传统GL理论同时在序参量及其梯度上展开自由能不同，本方法引入扩展GL形式：仅对协变梯度项做微扰展开，保留对超导序参量的完整非线性依赖；展开系数由小成对动量下微观自由能的有限差分确定，并适用于单带与多带超导体。
AI.result: 在文中考察的模型上，扩展GL方法在宽广温度范围内与实空间Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）计算的结果高度一致，同时所需的计算开销显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为在低温区域高效且准确地求解超导响应参数提供了可行框架，并能够纳入更真实电子结构（更真实的电子结构）的影响，弥补传统GL理论的局限。

title: A model of a multiphase medium based on the closure of moment chains for the Vlasov-Poisson equations
summary: We propose a method for closing moment chains for the Vlasov-Poisson kinetic system (the Landau fluid model), which yields a hyperbolic system of equations at each subsequent step. This system is interpreted as a multicomponent medium, where each component has its own density, velocity, and pressure. The coupling between the components is mediated by an electric field. The principle of closing moment chains is that the final component of the fluid is assumed to be pressureless.

AI.tldr: 针对 Vlasov-Poisson 动力学系统（Landau 流体模型）提出了一种封闭矩链（moment chains）的方法，每一步均得到双曲型方程系统，并将该系统解释为具有各自密度、速度和压力的多组分介质，通过电场实现分量间耦合，闭合原则是假设最终流体分量无压（pressureless）。
AI.motivation: Vlasov-Poisson 动力学系统在求解过程中存在矩链截断问题，需要一种有效的方法对矩链进行封闭，以便获得可解且物理上可解释的简化模型。
AI.method: 提出封闭矩链的截断原则，即在闭合时将最终流体分量假设为无压状态；由此得到的每一步方程系统均为双曲型（hyperbolic）方程组，并将其重新诠释为一种多组分介质（multicomponent medium）模型，每个组分拥有各自的密度、速度和压力，组分间通过电场耦合。
AI.result: 该封闭方法使得 Vlasov-Poisson 系统在每一级截断后均产生双曲型方程系统，从而保证方程结构的适定性与可求解性；该多组分介质解释为该模型提供了清晰的物理图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过无压假设封闭矩链，可将 Vlasov-Poisson 动力学系统转化为兼具双曲性结构与多组分流体物理解释的 Landau 流体模型。

title: Bottomonium suppression with a machine-learning-informed Debye mass
summary: Motivated by recent progress in data-driven approaches, we introduce a machine-learning (ML)-informed Debye mass, extracted from lattice-informed inputs, exclusively in the complex-valued heavy-quark Kent State University (KSU) potential. The resulting complex potential is used to solve the real-time Schrödinger equation within the quantum trajectories (QTraj) framework for the evolution of bottomonium in the quark-gluon plasma. We then compute the nuclear modification factors and double ratios for bottomonium $Υ(1S)$, $Υ(2S)$, and $Υ(3S)$ states in Pb-Pb collisions at $\sqrt{s_{NN}} = 5.02$ TeV. We compare our ML-induced results with those from the original KSU model and with experimental measurements from ALICE, ATLAS, and CMS collaborations. We find that the machine-learned Debye mass leads to improved agreement with data, particularly for excited states, highlighting the utility of machine learning in modeling in-medium QCD effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究将机器学习（machine learning, ML）方法引入德拜质量（Debye mass）的提取，用于构建复值重夸克势（complex-valued heavy-quark potential），并在量子轨迹（quantum trajectories, QTraj）框架下求解含时薛定谔方程，模拟底偶素（bottomonium）在夸克-胶子等离子体（quark-gluon plasma）中的演化，最终计算了粲偶素核修正因子并与实验数据对比。
AI.motivation: 受近期数据驱动方法进展的启发，作者希望将机器学习技术应用于强相互作用物质中QCD效应（in-medium QCD effects）的建模，以改进传统的唯象模型在底偶素抑制现象上的描述能力。
AI.method: 从晶格QCD（lattice-informed）输入中提取ML学习的德拜质量，将其嵌入肯特州立大学（Kent State University, KSU）复值重夸克势中；随后在量子轨迹框架下求解实时薛定谔方程，模拟Pb-Pb碰撞中Υ(1S)、Υ(2S)和Υ(3S)态的演化，并计算核修正因子与双重比。
AI.result: 将ML诱导的结果与原始KSU模型及ALICE、ATLAS、CMS实验数据进行对比后发现，机器学习得出的德拜质量改善了与实验数据的吻合度，尤其在激发态方面表现更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明机器学习在模拟介质中（in-medium）QCD效应方面具有实用价值，可有效提升底偶素在夸克-胶子等离子体中抑制现象的唯象建模精度。

title: 5d SCFT fixtures
summary: In the context of the atomic classification of 5d SCFTs building blocks with non-simply laced global symmetries are lacking. In this work we fill this gap by introducing a new class of 5d UV fixed points (the 5d SCFT "fixtures"). Physically, 5d SCFTs fixtures are the result of a Higgs branch RG flow, realized geometrically by M-theory on singular threefolds which we identify explicitly. In particular, this enables the construction of 5d conformal matter SCFTs with non-simply laced flavor symmetry. Along the way, we discuss their circle reduction in relation to 4d theories of class-S type.

AI.tldr: 本文填补了5d SCFT构件中非单李（non-simply laced）全局对称性缺失的空白，提出了一类新的5d UV不动点，并命名为"5d SCFT fixtures"，其物理本质是Higgs分支RG流的结果。
AI.motivation: 在5d SCFT的原子分类中，具有非单李全局对称性的构件（building blocks）一直缺失，该工作旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过M理论（M-theory）在奇异三维簇（singular threefolds）上的几何实现来构造5d SCFT fixtures，并明确识别对应的几何结构；同时讨论其圆约化（circle reduction）与4d class-S型理论的关系。
AI.result: 作者成功识别并构造了一类新的5d UV不动点（fixtures），实现了具有非单李味对称性（flavor symmetry）的5d共形物质（conformal matter）SCFT的构建。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了5d SCFT分类中非单李全局对称性构件缺失的空白，同时揭示了fixtures与class-S型4d理论之间通过圆约化建立的关联。

title: Scalarized Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg black holes at the approach to extremality
summary: We investigate extremal black holes with scalar hair in the generic Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH)-scalar theory with two scalar couplings to the Maxwell term. One is an exponential coupling with coupling constant $α$ and the other is its polynomial coupling. We first construct scalarized black holes on the cold (C)-horizon of EEH black holes described by mass $M$ and magnetic charge $P$ both at the linear level, through the existence curves $α_n(q)$ with $q=P/M$, and as fully backreaction solutions. As extremality ($q=q_e$) is approached, all existence curves accumulate, following $α_n-α_c\sim 1/\ln^2(q_e-q)$, at the critical branch $α_c$ fixed by the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound for the near-horizon (AdS$_2\times S^2$) throat. We obtain scalarized extremal black hole (SEBH) with constant secondary hair and it is recovered exactly from the entropy function approach working on the near-horizon throat. Its entropy is an attractor invariant, being independent of the asymptotic modulus, so the scalar hair remains secondary. Exploiting this constant scalar, we seek further SEBHs with scalar hair keeping its charge $Q_s$ for the zero asymptotic scalar ($φ_\infty=0$). In the $(q,α)$ plane, we observe that these extremal solutions occupy $q\ge q_e$. Hence, the existence curves $α_n(q)$ existing for $q\le q_e$ and the extremal branches bound the scalarized domain from opposite sides and they meet only at $q=q_e$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡（EEH）标量理论中带标量毛发（scalar hair）的极端黑洞（extremal black holes），发现其存在曲线在趋近极端极限时按 $1/\ln^2(q_e-q)$ 的方式累积到由布里登洛纳-弗里德曼（Breitenlohner-Freedman）界确定的临界分支；此类解可通过熵函数（entropy function）方法精确恢复，且标量毛发属于次级性质（secondary hair），熵为吸引子不变量。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在理解标量化（scalarization）机制在极端黑洞情形下的行为，特别是当存在两个耦合到麦克斯韦项（Maxwell term）的标量耦合（指数型与多项式型）时，标量毛发如何影响极端黑洞的解空间结构及其与近地平线几何的关联。
AI.method: 采用解析与数值结合的方法：在线性层次通过存在曲线 $\alpha_n(q)$（其中 $q=P/M$ 为磁荷-质量比）构造标量化的冷（C）视界 EEH 黑洞；进一步给出完全背景反作用（fully backreaction）解，并在近极端极限下分析存在曲线的累积行为；最后采用熵函数（entropy function）方法在近地平线 $AdS_2\times S^2$ 喉（throat）上精确重构极端标量化解。
AI.result: 发现所有存在曲线在趋近极端值 $q_e$ 时满足标度律 $\alpha_n-\alpha_c\sim 1/\ln^2(q_e-q)$，累积到由 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界确定的临界分支 $\alpha_c$。获得的标量化极端黑洞具有恒定次级标量毛发，其熵为吸引子不变量，独立于渐近模量。在 $(q,\alpha)$ 平面中，这些极端解占据 $q\geq q_e$ 区域，与存在于 $q\leq q_e$ 的曲线共同界定标量化区域，并仅在 $q=q_e$ 处交汇。
AI.conclusion: 极端标量化黑洞的标量毛发保持次级性质，其熵可由近地平线喉上的熵函数方法精确重现；极端分支与线性存在曲线在参数平面中对偶地界定了标量化域，揭示出极端极限（extremality）对标量化机制的根本约束作用。

title: Oxidation of Tantalum Nano-Film by Microwave Exposure
summary: Oxidation and ablation of 200 nm tantalum films were carried out by three routes: (i) femtosecond (fs-)laser direct write, (ii) high-temperature annealing (HTA) in a tube furnace, and (iii) annealing in a 2.45 GHz microwave cavity. Complete conversion of the 200 nm Ta layer into 409 nm of Ta2O5 required one hour at 600 C in the furnace, but only minutes at ~ 50 W of microwave power. Fs-laser (515 nm/200 fs) oxidation of the Ta nano-film set in at an average single-pulse fluence of ~ 0.1 J/cm2 under strong pulse-to-pulse overlap (900 pulses per focal spot), i.e. within a narrow window bounded from above by the onset of ablation. Under microwave annealing, both the cavity resonance frequency and the quality factor Q changed markedly at the metal-to-oxide transition, reflecting the collapse of the real and imaginary parts of the permittivity at 2.45 GHz. This dielectric contrast turns the cavity into a sensor: the oxidation can be followed in real time from the shift of the cavity resonance, providing a non-invasive, in-situ diagnostic tool.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了三种氧化200 nm钽薄膜的方法：飞秒激光直写、管式炉高温退火和2.45 GHz微波腔退火，并揭示了微波退火过程中腔体谐振频率和品质因数的变化可作为金属-氧化物转变的原位非侵入式传感诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 探索钽纳米薄膜氧化与消融的高效途径，并寻求一种能够在氧化过程进行时实时、非侵入式监测金属-氧化物转变的方法。
AI.method: 分别采用飞秒激光直写（515 nm/200 fs）、600°C管式炉高温退火以及约50 W微波功率的2.45 GHz微波腔退火三种途径对200 nm钽薄膜进行氧化，并监测微波腔谐振频率和品质因数Q在转变过程中的变化。
AI.result: 炉内600°C需1小时将200 nm Ta完全转化为409 nm Ta2O5，而微波退火仅需数分钟；飞秒激光氧化在约0.1 J/cm2的平均单脉冲注量下发生，其上界受消融起限约束；微波退火中谐振频率和Q因子在金属-氧化物转变时发生显著改变。
AI.conclusion: 钽在2.45 GHz下金属态与氧化物态介电常数的实部和虚部差异显著，使得微波腔可充当实时传感装置，通过谐振频移对氧化过程进行原位非侵入式监测。

title: Cohomology theory of Novikov algebras and applications
summary:
In this paper, first we give a new characterization of the cohomology of pre-Lie algebras using the Chevalley-Eilenberg cohomology associated to a morphism from the operad of Lie algebras to Hadamard product of the operad of pre-Lie algebras and its Koszul dual operad. Then we apply the same approach to study the cohomology of Novikov algebras, and give the cochain complex explicitly. The cochain complex of the underlying pre-Lie algebra is shown to be isomorphic to
  the quotient of the cochain complex of a Novikov algebra. Consequently, there is a long exact sequence connecting the cohomologies of a Novikov algebra and the underlying pre-Lie algebra. The cohomology of a Novikov algebra with coefficients in a representation is introduced using pseudo-tensor categories. As applications, we show that infinitesimal deformations and abelian extensions are classified by the second cohomology groups with different coefficients. Various examples are given to illustrate the difference between the cohomology of a Novikov algebra and that of the underlying pre-Lie algebra.

AI.tldr: 本文利用李代数算子（operad of Lie algebras）到前李代数和Koszul对偶算子哈达玛积（Hadamard product）之间的态射所关联的Chevalley-Eilenberg上同调，给出了前李代数（pre-Lie algebra）上同调的新刻画，并将其推广到Novikov代数（Novikov algebra）的上同调研究，显式给出其链复形，建立了与底层前李代数上同调的长正合序列（long exact sequence），并以第二上同调群分类描述了无穷小形变与阿贝尔扩张。
AI.motivation: 前李代数和Novikov代数在数学物理及可积系统中具有重要地位，但它们的上同调理论缺乏统一且明确的刻画方法。作者旨在通过算子（operad）框架与Chevalley-Eilenberg上同调建立前李代数上同调的新表征，并以此方法系统研究Novikov代数上同调及其与底层前李代数上同调的关系。
AI.method: 作者首先基于从李代数算子到前李代数算子与其Koszul对偶算子的哈达玛积之间的态射，对前李代数上同调给出新的刻画；随后将同样的算子方法应用于Novikov代数，显式构造其链复形（cochain complex），证明Novikov代数链复形商空间同构于底层前李代数的链复形，并利用伪张量范畴（pseudo-tensor categories）引入带系数于表示的Novikov代数上同调。
AI.result: 研究表明，支撑前李代数的链复形同构于Novikov代数链复形的商，从而得到连接两者上同调的长正合序列。进一步，作者证明了Novikov代数的无穷小形变（infinitesimal deformations）和阿贝尔扩张（abelian extensions）可由不同系数的第二上同调群予以分类，并通过多个例子阐明Novikov代数上同调与底层前李代数上同调之间的区别。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的算子范畴方法为前李代数与Novikov代数上同调提供了统一的刻画框架，并揭示了Novikov代数上同调超越其底层前李代数上同调所包含的额外信息。该工作为Novikov代数形变理论与扩张分类提供了系统的上同调工具。

title: M5 Instantons in ABJM
summary: We study the existence of supersymmetric M5-brane instantons in asymptotically AdS$_4 \times S^7/\mathbf{Z}_k$ geometries of M-theory, dual to the ABJM theory. The supersymmetric embeddings of these instantons are determined by the M5-brane $κ$-symmetry, which forces them to localise to the equivariant fixed points in the asymptotically AdS$_4$ geometry, and wrap $(S^3\times S^3)/\mathbf{Z}_k $. At the quantum level we find that the one-loop partition function of these instantons vanishes, suggesting that the bulk partition function is instead to be expanded in terms of supergravity modes and M2-brane instantons, in line with known results for the $S^3$ partition function of the dual ABJM theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了M理论渐近AdS₄×S⁷/Zₖ几何中超对称M5膜瞬子（M5-brane instanton）的存在性，发现这些瞬子的κ-对称性（κ-symmetry）将其限制在等变不动点处并包裹(S³×S³)/Zₖ，其单圈配分函数为零，表明体配分函数应改用超引力模式与M2膜瞬子展开。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在理解与ABJM理论对偶的M理论渐近AdS₄×S⁷/Zₖ几何中M5膜瞬子对配分函数的贡献，检验体配分函数在强耦合下的结构是否与已知的边界S³配分函数结果一致。
AI.method: 利用M5膜的κ-对称性（M5-brane κ-symmetry）确定超对称嵌入的条件，将瞬子定位于渐近AdS₄几何的等变不动点（equivariant fixed point），并计算其量子层面的单圈配分函数（one-loop partition function）。
AI.result: 超对称M5膜瞬子被限制在等变不动点处并包裹(S³×S³)/Zₖ子流形；在量子层面，这些瞬子的单圈配分函数为零。
AI.conclusion: 由于M5膜瞬子的单圈配分函数为零，体的配分函数应改由超引力模式（supergravity modes）与M2膜瞬子（M2-brane instantons）展开，这与对偶ABJM理论的S³配分函数已知结果一致。

title: Cosmological extra dimensions can mimic dark energy
summary: We present a simple model of a higher dimensional spacetime in which the 4d submanifold is a FLRW metric, while the extra dimensions are compactified to a hypersphere. We calculate the Friedmann equations of this model finding that the extra dimensions interact in a non-trivial way with the 4d submanifold evolution. We prove that what is observed as Dark Energy could be explained only as an effect due to the Gaussian curvature and the expansion rate of the extra dimensions. We calculate the luminosity distance in this model and derive the acceleration parameter q. We find that Ωm and q are in some sense dressed by terms coming from the extra dimensions, thus a Universe filled only with matter (both luminous and dark) and with extra dimensions can explain the observational data. We find that the extra dimensions do not affect the CMB spectrum, but this is not a solution to the Hubble tension. We fit our model to SNe data and find evidence for the presence of 3-4 extra dimensions which are presently contracting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个高维时空模型：4维子流形为FLRW度规，额外维度紧致化为超球面。研究发现暗能量效应可以完全由额外维度的高斯曲率与膨胀速率解释；宇宙中仅含物质（包括普通物质与暗物质）加收缩的额外维度即可匹配观测数据，且拟合超新星数据表明存在3–4个当前正在收缩的额外维度。
AI.motivation: 试图在无需引入真空能或标量场等暗能量机制的前提下，通过额外维度（extra dimensions）的几何效应来解释当前宇宙加速膨胀的观测现象。
AI.method: 构建一个高维时空模型，其中4维子流形采用FLRW（Friedmann–Lemaître–Robertson–Walker）度规，额外维度紧致化为超球面；推导该模型的Friedmann方程，计算光度距离（luminosity distance）与减速参数（deceleration parameter）q，并用超新星（SNe）数据进行拟合。
AI.result: 额外维度与4维子流形的演化存在非平凡耦合；观测到的暗能量仅可归因于额外维度的高斯曲率及其膨胀速率。Ωm与q受到额外维度项的“修饰”（dressed），使得仅含物质与额外维度的宇宙即可解释观测数据。额外维度不影响CMB谱，但无法解决哈勃张力（Hubble tension）；数据拟合支持存在3–4个当前处于收缩状态的额外维度。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一种纯几何学解释暗能量的途径，即无需暗能量组分，仅依托额外维度的曲率与动力学即可产生等效的加速膨胀效应，但尚不能解决哈勃张力问题。

title: Elucidating Guest-Host Mechanisms in ZIF-L for Tuneable Highly Luminescent 2D Materials
summary: 3D metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are well known effective hosts for luminescent guests that improve tuneability, photostability and material fabricability. 2D guest@MOF systems, while less explored, offer competitive advantages over 3D guest@MOF systems due to their optical transparency, inter-layer spacing, and vertical thinness. This work examines luminescent organic dyes@ZIF-L to establish the underlying mechanisms of guest incorporation in ZIF-L and demonstrate the advantages of the 2D ZIF-L architecture for the material's functional luminescence. Analysing a case study system, fluorescein@ZIF-L (F@ZIF-L), using nanoscale FTIR, diffraction, and topology mapping, confirmed that fluorescein (F) resided in the ZIF-L framework cavities. Supported by surface energy simulations, the extent of guest incorporation was found to be indicated by a morphological continuum, from the characteristic leaf-shaped ZIF-L to rectangular F@ZIF-L. By modifying synthesis temperature and solvent ratios, the luminescent properties of F@ZIF-L could be rationally tuned in terms of guest loading (% mol) and arrangement (i.e. guest monomer to aggregate ratio). When optimised, F@ZIF-L exhibited tuneable emission chromaticity, 99.7% photoluminescent quantum yield, minimal guest leaching in solution over 12 months, and high photostability. Perylene@ZIF-L exhibited unique white light emitting properties, with CIE coordinates (0.33, 0.34) arising from a combination of yellow alpha-phase excimer and blue monomeric perylene emission. Finally, oriented luminescent thin films of guest@ZIF-L materials were grown on malleable Zn foils, demonstrating an in situ fabrication technique. Together, the work highlights the potential for luminescent dye@ZIF-L systems in developing tuneable and resilient luminescent components of next-generation optoelectronics, sensors, and lighting systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统考察了荧光有机染料掺入二维金属有机框架（ZIF-L）的机制与优势。以荧光素@ZIF-L（F@ZIF-L）为案例，结合纳米级红外光谱（nano-FTIR）、衍射和拓扑分析确认染料位于框架空腔内，并通过表面能模拟揭示形貌连续体可用于指示客体掺入程度。通过调控合成温度与溶剂比例，可实现发光特性的理性调控，优化后F@ZIF-L获得99.7%的光致发光量子产率（PLQY）、高光稳定性及12个月内极低的客体浸出。此外，苝@ZIF-L表现出CIE坐标为(0.33, 0.34)的白色发光特性，并开发了在锌箔上原位生长取向发光薄膜的制备技术。
AI.motivation: 三维（3D）金属有机框架（metal-organic frameworks, MOFs）已被广泛用作发光客体的有效宿主，但二维（2D）guest@MOF体系因光学透明性、层间距和垂直厚度优势而被认为更具竞争力，然而其客体掺入机制尚不清晰，2D架构对功能发光的具体贡献也未被充分探索。本研究旨在揭示ZIF-L中客体掺入的基本机制并验证2D ZIF-L架构在功能性发光材料中的优越性。
AI.method: 选取荧光素@ZIF-L（F@ZIF-L）作为案例系统，综合运用纳米级傅里叶变换红外光谱（nano-FTIR）、X射线衍射（diffraction）及拓扑映射（topology mapping）确认客体位置与化学环境，并结合表面能（surface energy）模拟阐释掺入过程。通过调节合成温度与溶剂比例系统控制客体负载量（% mol）及单体/聚集体的排列比例，进而调节发光性能；同时发展了在可延展锌箔上原位生长取向发光薄膜的制备方法。
AI.result: 实验证明荧光素位于ZIF-L框架空腔内，掺入程度可通过从叶状ZIF-L到矩形F@ZIF-L的形貌连续体加以指示。优化后的F@ZIF-L展现出可调发射色度、高达99.7%的光致发光量子产率（photoluminescent quantum yield, PLQY）、溶液中12个月内极低的客体浸出以及高光稳定性。苝@ZIF-L由黄色α相准分子（alpha-phase excimer）与蓝色单体苝发射组合产生CIE坐标为(0.33, 0.34)的独特白光发射。锌箔上成功生长了取向发光薄膜，验证了原位制造可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了染料@ZIF-L体系中客体掺入的形貌学判据与热力学机制，证实了2D ZIF-L架构在光学透明性、层间约束与可制造性方面相较于3D体系的竞争优势。研究者指出这类体系在下一代光电子器件、传感器和照明系统中具有开发可调且高稳定性发光组件的广阔潜力。

title: An Inverse Problem for Determining the Piston Speed from a Given Lipschitz Leading Shock
summary: We analyze an inverse problem for determining the piston speed and the associated flow field from a prescribed leading shock and the initial data in a shock tube. The gas flow is described by the isentropic Euler equations (i.e., the $p$-system), while the trajectory of the leading shock is prescribed as a given Lipschitz curve. Under an Oleĭnik-type entropy condition on the leading shock, we develop a modified wavefront tracking scheme to construct the flow field behind the shock. This construction enables us to determine the corresponding piston speed and the associated flow field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究激波管中的一个反问题：给定前导激波轨迹和初始数据，逆向确定活塞速度及对应流场。系统采用等熵欧拉方程组（p-系统）描述，在激波满足Oleĭnik型熵条件的前提下，通过修正波前追踪方法构造激波后的流场，从而反解活塞速度。
AI.motivation: 激波管的逆问题在气体动力学中具有理论与应用价值，目标是利用可观测的前导激波轨迹反推驱动活塞的运动参数，为实验设计与数值验证提供依据。
AI.method: 采用等熵欧拉方程组（即p-系统）描述气体流动，将前导激波轨迹预设为给定Lipschitz曲线；在前导激波上的Oleĭnik型熵条件下，发展一种修正的波前追踪（wavefront tracking）格式来构造激波后的流场。
AI.result: 通过所构造的激波后流场，能够成功确定对应的活塞速度及其相关的流场分布，实现了从激波轨迹到活塞运动的逆向求解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在合理的熵条件约束下，利用波前追踪方法可以有效求解激波管中确定活塞速度的逆问题，为正问题反演提供了可行的构造性途径。

title: A Generalized Class of Taub-NUT-Scalar Metrics
summary: We consider a class of three-parameter metrics that was introduced in \cite{azizallahi2024three}. The class of metrics contain Zipoy-Voorhees (ZV) and Fisher-Janis-Newman- Winicour (FJNW) spacetimes at certain values of the parameters. We build an axially symmetric and asymptotically flat spacetime with gravitomagnetic effects by introducing a Newman- Unti-Tamburino (NUT) charge into this class of metrics via the Ehlers transformation. We investigate the physical features of this class of Taub-NUT-scalar (TNS) metrics including gravitational lensing, quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra, and test particle motion. Our results provide fresh insight on how mass, multipole moments, and gravitomagnetic fields behave in the presence of a scalar field and show the effect of the NUT charge on stability of orbits in this class of metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究一类三参数度量族，通过 Ehlers 变换引入 NUT 荷，构造了具有引力磁性效应的轴对称渐近平直时空（Taub-NUT-scalar 度量），并系统分析了其引力透镜、准正规模式和测试粒子运动等物理特征。
AI.motivation: 已有研究引入了一类包含 Zipoy-Voorhees 和 Fisher-Janis-Newman-Winicour 时空的三参数度量族，但该族缺乏引力磁性效应（gravitomagnetic effects）。本文旨在通过引入 NUT 荷扩展这一度量族，以探索标量场、质量、多极矩与引力磁场之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 以文献中提出的三参数度量族为基础，利用 Ehlers 变换（Ehlers transformation）将 NUT 荷引入该度量类，从而构建具有轴对称性与渐近平坦性的 Taub-NUT-scalar（TNS）时空。
AI.result: 系统分析了 TNS 度量的物理特征，包括引力透镜（gravitational lensing）、准正规模式（quasinormal mode）谱和测试粒子运动；揭示了在标量场存在下质量、多极矩和引力磁性场的表现，并展示了 NUT 荷对该类度量中轨道稳定性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现 NUT 荷显著影响此类时空中粒子轨道的稳定性，且标量场背景下质量、多极矩与引力磁性效应的联合行为为理解该时空类提供了新视角。

title: Kerr-referenced analytical parametrization of rotating black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity
summary: Rotating black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity are known nonperturbatively mainly through numerical solutions, which limits their direct use in strong-field applications. We construct a Kerr-referenced analytical parametrization of the near-general-relativistic numerical branch using a compact radial coordinate, low-order angular multipoles, and continued fractions. The resulting two-parameter family accurately reproduces the numerical metric throughout the validated weak-coupling and moderate-spin domain. Independent off-grid solutions confirm that the parametrization retains its accuracy away from the calibration set. We further assess the model through equatorial light rings, critical impact parameters, and full two-dimensional null-geodesic ray tracing without assuming separability. The resulting shadow observables closely match those obtained from the numerical geometries. This parametrization therefore provides a practical analytical metric for geodesic and strong-field calculations without relying on a slow-rotation expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文为动力学陈-西蒙斯引力（dynamical Chern-Simons gravity）中的旋转黑洞构建了一种以克尔解（Kerr solution）为参照的解析参数化方案，利用紧致径向坐标、低阶角向多极矩和连分数（continued fractions）表示，精确再现近广义相对论数值分支的度规。该双参数模型在弱耦合、中等自旋域内准确复现数值结果，且通过非均匀样本验证了其外推精度。基于该模型计算的光环阴影（shadow observables）等强场可观测量与数值几何高度一致，无需依赖慢旋展开。
AI.motivation: 动力学陈-西蒙斯引力中的旋转黑洞主要通过数值解获得，非微扰形式限制了其在强场问题中的直接应用，因此需要一种可解析使用的度规近似。
AI.method: 采用紧致径向坐标（compact radial coordinate）、低阶角向多极矩（angular multipoles）与连分数展开，以克尔度规为参照系，构建包含两个参数的解析家族用于拟合近广义相对论数值解。
AI.result: 该参数化在弱耦合与中等自旋区域内准确再现数值度规；独立的非网格样本确认其在校准集之外的精度。通过赤道光环、临界碰撞参数（critical impact parameters）以及不假设可分离性的二维零测地线光线追踪评估后，阴影可观测量与数值几何结果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该参数化提供了一种实用的解析度规形式，可直接用于测地线与强场计算，无需依赖慢旋展开（slow-rotation expansion）。

title: One-dimensional quasicrystals with tensor-network finite-state automata
comment: 17 pages (8 main text, 9 appendix), 5 figures (3 main text, 2 appendix). Submission to Physical Review B
summary: Quasicrystals occupy a distinctive position between the translational order of crystals and the disordered amorphous matter. Simulating this physics has remained challenging, since quasiperiodic structures lack the translational symmetry exploited for crystals and generally require costly diagonalization of large finite approximants. Quasicrystalline order admits two equivalent descriptions, a cut-and-project scheme from a higher-dimensional periodic crystal, and a discrete set of substitution rules acting on a finite alphabet. We show that the latter, written in a numeration system adapted to the substitution, defines a deterministic finite automaton with output, the digits of a site index are fed, and the automaton returns the letter occupying that site. We further exploit another equivalence to a different construction, the transition matrices are exactly the tensors of a matrix product state, whose bond dimension is the number of automaton states and is independent of system size. This allows efficient representation of extremely large tight-binding Hamiltonians in the tensor-train language, thereby yielding an exact matrix product operator for the quasicrystal Hamiltonian at any system size. We show how this framework works for two families of one-dimensional quasicrystals, the metallic-mean and $k$-bonacci families and we explicitly construct the Fibonacci, silver-mean, and Tribonacci quasicrystals. By leveraging efficient tensor-network compression and the kernel polynomial method, we compute spectral densities for chains with more than $10^9$ sites and directly resolve the hierarchical structure of the spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用代换规则与自动机理论将准晶（quasicrystal）哈密顿量精确表示为矩阵乘积算符（matrix product operator）的方法，并演示了在一维金属平均族和k-bonacci族准晶上的应用。
AI.motivation: 准晶位于晶体平移有序与无序非晶之间的独特位置，但其准周期结构缺乏晶体的平移对称性，传统上需要对角化大型有限近似结构，计算代价高昂。
AI.method: 利用准晶序的两种等价描述——从高维周期晶体的切割投影（cut-and-project）方案与作用于有限字母表上的代换规则（substitution rules）——将后者写成适于代换的数系，定义为带输出的确定性有限自动机（deterministic finite automaton with output）；进一步利用与矩阵乘积态（matrix product state）的等价性，将转移矩阵映射为张量，从而在张量列（tensor-train）格式下精确表示任意系统尺寸的准晶哈密顿量。
AI.result: 在金属平均（metallic-mean）族与k-bonacci族两类一维准晶上验证了该框架，显式构造了Fibonacci、银平均（silver-mean）与Tribonacci准晶；结合张量网络压缩与核多项式方法（kernel polynomial method），计算了超过10^9个格点的链的谱密度，直接分辨出谱的分层次结构。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种精确、高效表示任意系统尺度准晶哈密顿量的张量网络方案，其键维（bond dimension）由自动机状态数决定且与系统尺寸无关，可用于大规模谱学计算。

title: Generalized Whiting transform and Flux Estimates for Wave Equations in Subextremal Kerr
summary:
All recent advances
  \cite{DRS}, \cite{S-Rita1}, \cite{S-Rita2}, \cite{Millet}, \cite{MaS}, \cite{MaS2} on the boundedness and decay for wave equations on subextremal Kerr spacetimes $\KK(a,m)$,
  with non-small angular rotation, rely in an essential way on Whiting's groundbreaking discovery of a powerful
  integro-differential transformation with the help of which he ruled out exponentially growing modes in \cite{W} (see also \cite{Yacov}, \cite{AMPW} and \cite{Rita} for further developments). We give a purely \textit{physical space}, generalized version, of the transformation which takes general solutions of {spin-$\sk$} wave equations in $\KK=\KK(a,m)$ to solutions of a secondary wave equation on a new metric manifold $\KKt=\KKt(a,m)$ with two stationary, asymptotically flat, ends. Moreover, for a certain subdomain $\DDt\subset\DDt_-$, which can be identified as the exterior of a black hole region, the new metric $\gt$ of $\KKt(a, m)$ is Lorentzian and the time translation $\T $ is timelike. Using the geometric properties of the two ends one can then deduce, by classical asymptotic Fourier analysis techniques, the desired bound for the flux of $ψ$ at the future event horizon.
  This estimate played a crucial role in our companion paper \cite{He-K1}.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了一种纯物理空间意义下的广义奇廷变换（Whiting transformation），将亚极值克尔时空中的自旋-σ波方程解映射到具有两个渐近平直末端的辅助流形上的二级波方程解，并利用该流形的几何性质推导出未来事件视界处ψ通量的所需界估计。
AI.motivation: 已有关于克尔时空（Kerr spacetimes）波方程有界性和衰减的研究均依赖于Whiting开创性的可积微分变换，但这些工作主要基于频率空间框架。该文旨在将这一变换推广到纯粹的物理空间形式，为后续稳定性分析提供更直接的几何工具。
AI.method: 构造一个物理空间版本的广义可积-微分变换，将亚极值克尔时空中自旋-σ波方程（spin-σ wave equations）的一般解映射到新度量流形上次级波方程的解。通过分析该流形具有两个驻定渐近平直末端（asymptotically flat ends）的几何结构，并运用经典渐近傅里叶分析（asymptotic Fourier analysis）技术推导通量界。
AI.result: 在新的度量流形上，存在一个子区域可被识别为黑洞区域的外部，该区域中度量是洛伦兹型（Lorentzian）且时间平移矢量是类时的。利用双末端几何性质，通过经典渐近傅里叶分析技巧，在波的未来事件视界（future event horizon）处推导出ψ通量所需的界估计，该估计在伴随论文中起到关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 该物理空间广义Whiting变换提供了独立于频率分析框架的工具，其推导出的通量界估计在伴随论文中发挥了关键作用，为克尔时空波方程稳定性研究提供了新的技术途径。

title: An Affine Semigroup from Orbifold Boundary Conditions: cut, phylogenetic and hierarchical models in the unit-weight sector, and weighted configurations beyond them
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Companion to Part IX-A, "The Alphabet of Orbifold Boundary Conditions", which determines the alphabet whose relations are computed here: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22254861 . This note's record, with every ancillary script and its archived receipt: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22254863
summary: The equivalence classes of boundary conditions of a gauge theory on a two-dimensional orbifold are the fibres of a marginal map, indexed by an affine semigroup: one generator per alphabet label, graded by weight, embedded by its local data at the fixed points. This note identifies that semigroup.
