Without weights the configuration has a name and a literature, whose results about our cases are attributed here: over $\mathbb{Z}_2$ it is the cut configuration of an explicit graph in the sense of Sturmfels-Sullivant --- the four-cycle for $T^2/\mathbb{Z}_2$, the wheel $W_4$ for $S^1/\mathbb{Z}_2\times S^1/\mathbb{Z}_2$ --- verified as an equality of configurations; over $\mathbb{Z}_m$ with equal cone orders, the group-based phylogenetic model on a claw tree; with unequal orders, a mixed-order variant we do not find in the literature; for higher products, the binary hierarchical model of a cross-polytope boundary complex. The product orbifold's ring is a row of a 2008 table --- codimension, degree, minimal generators, normality --- every invariant of which our machinery reproduced without knowing of it. What none of the three covers is the alphabet with weights, which arise from induction to higher-dimensional irreducibles of a non-abelian space group and from conjugate-pair recombination over real or quaternionic ground. That sector is adjacent to, but not identified with, the non-abelian direction Sturmfels and Sullivant raised in 2005, and is where our contributions sit: gluing trees for the weighted alphabets and the orthogonal and symplectic columns, and the group-based model on the tripod, a complete intersection exactly when the finite abelian group has order at most three. The first group beyond $\mathbb{Z}_3$ separates local from global: the $\mathbb{Z}_4$ tripod is a complete intersection on the Zariski-open set the phylogenetics literature works in, and not globally.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了二维轨道流形（orbifold）上规范理论边界条件的等价类所索引的仿射半群（affine semigroup），将其与若干已知代数几何和系统发育学模型对应起来，并刻画了带权字母表（weighted alphabet）这一新结构及其在三角架（tripod）上的群基系统发育模型（group-based phylogenetic model）性质。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在识别规范理论在二维轨道上边界条件等价类所对应的仿射半群结构，因为此前该半群虽被证明存在却未被明确刻画，其与代数统计学中已知配置之间的关系也未得到系统厘清。
AI.method: 通过将不同边界条件等价类与已知配置（如Sturmfels-Sullivant图中的割配置、群基系统发育模型、二元分层模型等）逐一比对并验证为配置相等，同时对带权字母表情形引入胶合树（gluing tree）工具，并利用完全交（complete intersection）条件分析三角架模型。
AI.result: 在不加权的情形下，$\mathbb{Z}_2$对应图割配置（四环与车轮$W_4$），$\mathbb{Z}_m$等锥阶对应爪树上的群基系统发育模型，不等阶对应文献中未见的新变体，高次乘积对应交叉多面体边界复形的二元分层模型。带权字母表情形通过胶合树构造处理，$\mathbb{Z}_4$三角架仅在Zariski开集上为完全交而非全局。
AI.conclusion: 该半群从不加权情形看完全落入已知代数统计学文献框架，但带权字母表构成独立于Sturmfels-Sullivant 2005年非阿贝尔方向的贡献领域，且$\mathbb{Z}_3$与$\mathbb{Z}_4$的差别首次在三角架模型上揭示了局部与全局性质的分离。

title: Particle Dynamics and Thermodynamics of a Charged-Like Hairy Black Hole in Extended Gravitational Decoupling
summary: This work focuses on the analysis of particle dynamics and the thermodynamic properties associated with a particular branch of hairy black hole solutions. These solutions are obtained by using extended geometric deformation gravitational decoupling on the seed solution of the Schwarzschild solution. This resulting geometry satisfies the dominant energy condition and the condition $Q^{2}=2χ\ell M$. We analyze the motion of massive particles and photons in this geometry and the thermodynamics of this solution. In particular, for massless particles, we study the effective potential and determine the radii of the photon sphere and the shadow of the black hole. For massive particles, we calculate the specific energy and angular momentum of circular orbits, the ISCO, the radiative efficiency of an accretion disk, and representative particle trajectories. Finally, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of this hairy black hole geometry, including the Hawking temperature, the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, and the heat capacity in the fixed-$(Q,\ell)$ ensemble.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类特定分支的有毛黑洞（hairy black hole）解，该解通过对史瓦西解（Schwarzschild solution）应用扩展几何形变引力解耦（extended geometric deformation gravitational decoupling）获得，满足主导能量条件及Q²=2χℓM的条件。论文系统分析了该几何中有质量粒子和光子的运动、黑洞阴影与光子球半径、ISCO、吸积盘辐射效率，以及定(Q,ℓ)系综中的热力学性质。
AI.motivation: 有毛黑洞解是检验无毛定理（no-hair theorem）及引力理论修正的重要对象。通过对史瓦西种子解进行引力解耦，获得满足主导能量条件的精确有毛黑洞解后，有必要系统研究其粒子动力学与热力学性质，以理解该几何的物理特征与天体物理可观测效应。
AI.method: 利用扩展几何形变方法对史瓦西解进行引力解耦，构造有毛黑洞几何。在该几何中，采用测地线方程分析方法研究两类粒子动力学：对无质量光子，分析有效势并计算光子球半径与黑洞阴影；对有质量粒子，计算圆轨道的比能量与角动量、ISCO位置、吸积盘辐射效率及代表性粒子轨迹。热力学方面，在定(Q,ℓ)系综中推导霍金温度（Hawking temperature）、贝肯斯坦-霍金熵（Bekenstein-Hawking entropy）与热容量。
AI.result: 该有毛黑洞几何满足主导能量条件和Q²=2χℓM关系。无质量粒子的有效势分析给出了光子球半径与黑洞阴影；有质量粒子的分析得到了圆轨道性质、ISCO、辐射效率及代表性轨迹。热力学部分给出了该几何在定(Q,ℓ)系综下的霍金温度、贝肯斯坦-霍金熵及热容量的表达式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一类满足物理能量条件的、由引力解耦导出的有毛黑洞解的完整粒子动力学与热力学图像，为其与真空间格或可观测黑洞阴影等天体物理信号的比较提供了理论依据。

title: Momentum-Resolved Electronic Structure for Quasicrystals: Full-Band Spectra and Chern Number
summary: Quasicrystals lack the translational symmetry that underlies Bloch decomposition and Brillouin-zone integration, making full-band momentum-resolved electronic structure difficult to formulate and compute. We develop a systematically convergent reciprocal-space tight-binding framework for a broad class of quasicrystals. The method combines two systematically refinable components: a Fourier-module scattering-channel Hamiltonian that yields local spectral and current-current correlation quantities at each physical momentum, and an expanding hierarchy of pseudo-Brillouin zones that converts the resulting local quantities into bulk thermodynamic observables through an exact local-to-global relation. Applied to the Penrose and Ammann-Beenker models, the framework uncovers full-band momentum-resolved quasibands and a multichannel mechanism for pseudogap formation, both beyond the scope of low-energy effective models. It further resolves Zeeman-driven gap closings and reopenings, quantized Chern plateaus, and the phason invariance of bulk spectral and topological observables. This framework provides a unified reciprocal-space route to full-band spectral and topological properties of quasicrystals.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个系统收敛的倒空间（reciprocal space）紧束缚框架，用于研究准晶体（quasicrystals）的全能带动量分辨电子结构，并将其应用于Penrose和Ammann-Beenker模型，揭示了准能带、赝隙形成的多通道机制、自旋-塞曼效应驱动的能隙开合、量子化的陈平台以及phason不变性等性质。
AI.motivation: 准晶体缺乏平移对称性（translational symmetry），这使布洛赫分解（Bloch decomposition）和布里渊区积分（Brillouin-zone integration）失效，导致全能带动量分辨电子结构难以公式化和计算。因此需要发展一种适用于准晶体的系统化倒空间方法来描述其电子结构和拓扑性质。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个系统可精化的组成部分：一是傅里叶模散射通道哈密顿量（Fourier-module scattering-channel Hamiltonian），用于在每个物理动量处获得局部谱和流-流关联量；二是不断扩张的赝布里渊区（pseudo-Brillouin zones）层级，通过精确的局域-全局关系将局部量转化为体积热力学可观测量。
AI.result: 将框架应用于Penrose和Ammann-Beenker模型后，发现了全能带的动量分辨准能带（quasibands）以及赝隙（pseudogap）形成的多通道机制；还解析了塞曼效应（Zeeman effect）驱动的能隙关闭与重新打开、量子化的陈平台（Chern plateaus）以及体态谱和拓扑观测量的phason不变性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为准晶体的全能带谱学与拓扑性质提供了一个统一的倒空间研究途径，能够处理超出低能有效模型（low-energy effective models）范围的物理现象。

title: A complete classification of left-invariant Einstein metrics on $S^3\times S^3$
summary: We complete the classification of compact simply connected homogeneous Einstein manifolds in dimension six by resolving the remaining cases for left-invariant Einstein metrics on $G=\mathrm{SU}(2)\times\mathrm{SU}(2)\cong S^3\times S^3$. Previous work leaves two cases for the isotropy group $K$, namely $K=\{e\}$ and $K\cong\mathbb Z_2$. We first rule out $K=\{e\}$. Then we show that any $\mathbb Z_2$ symmetry generated by an inner involution $σ$ with $\trσ=-2$ necessarily extends to a $\mathbb Z_2\times\mathbb Z_2$ symmetry. Together with the previously known classification results, these theorems imply that every left-invariant Einstein metric on $G$ is, up to homothety and isometry, either the standard product metric $g_{\rm can}$ or the Jensen nearly Kähler metric $g_{\rm NK}$.

AI.tldr: 本文完成了六维紧致单连通齐次爱因斯坦流形（homogeneous Einstein manifolds）分类的最后步骤，通过排除了K={e}情形并证明Z₂对称性必然扩展为Z₂×Z₂对称性，最终得出G=SU(2)×SU(2)≅S³×S³上所有左不变爱因斯坦度量（left-invariant Einstein metrics）在等距与位似意义下仅有标准乘积度量g_can和Jensen近凯勒度量（nearly Kähler metric）g_NK两种。
AI.motivation: 此前对六维紧致单连通齐次爱因斯坦流形的分类研究在G=SU(2)×SU(2)上遗留了两个待解决的各向同性群（isotropy group）情形，即K={e}与K≅Z₂，本文旨在彻底解决这些残余情形以完成整个分类。
AI.method: 首先利用相关论证排除了K={e}情形的存在性；随后证明由内自同构（inner involution）σ（满足迹tr σ=-2）生成的任意Z₂对称性必然可扩展为Z₂×Z₂对称性，从而将该情形归结为已有分类结果。
AI.result: 定理表明G上所有左不变爱因斯坦度量在等距同构（isometry）与位似变换（homothety）意义下仅等价于两种已知度量：标准乘积度量g_can或Jensen近凯勒度量g_NK，从而完成了该流形类别的完整分类。
AI.conclusion: 本文最终补全了六维紧致单连通齐次爱因斯坦流形的分类工作，确认了该空间中两类极简度量解的完备性，为相关几何分类理论提供了终局性结论。

title: Dynamical systems in quadratic teleparallel cosmology
comment: 10 pages, no figures; invited contribution to the proceedings of the Sixth Zeldovich Meeting, Pescara, Italy, 2026
summary: We discuss the cosmological dynamics of general teleparallel quadratic gravity. Using a suitable set of variables, we write the cosmological field equations as a homogeneous dynamical system. We find that this system generically features projective fixed points, where the dynamics can be solved analytically, and exhibits finite time singularities as well as an asymptotically vanishing cosmological expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了广义平行引力二次理论（general teleparallel quadratic gravity）的宇宙学动力学，通过适当的变量变换将宇宙学场方程写成齐次动力学系统，发现该系统一般具有射影不动点（projective fixed points），其动力学可解析求解，并表现出有限时间奇点以及渐近消失的宇宙膨胀。
AI.motivation: 理解修正引力理论（modified gravity theories）的宇宙学演化是当前宇宙学研究的重要课题，平行引力（teleparallel gravity）及其二次推广作为一种替代引力框架，其宇宙学动力学尚未被充分解析刻画。
AI.method: 选取合适的动力学变量，将广义平行引力二次理论中的宇宙学场方程改写为齐次动力学系统（homogeneous dynamical system），进而对系统的不动点结构及其演化行为进行分析。
AI.result: 该动力学系统一般性地具有射影不动点，在这些不动点处系统动力学可解析求解；系统同时呈现出有限时间奇点（finite time singularities）以及渐近趋于零的宇宙膨胀行为。
AI.conclusion: 广义平行引力的二次理论的宇宙学动力学可以通过齐次动力学系统框架加以完备描述，其演化包含射影不动点、有限时间奇点及渐近膨胀消失等丰富的动力学特征，为理解该引力理论下的宇宙演化提供了解析层面的洞察。

title: Multiplicity of surface polariton configurations in bi-isotropic media with anomalous Hall current
summary: In this work, we investigate surface polaritons (SPs) arising at the interface between a simple dielectric and a bi-isotropic medium, in the lossless regime and in the presence of small losses. For the former, non-Dyakonov surface polaritons can arise for positive permittivities and magnetoelectric parameters. General restrictions on the permittivities and bi-isotropic parameter (existence conditions) are derived. For the latter, the effect of small losses is considered, and the characteristic surface plasmon-polariton lengths are discussed. The propagation length can exhibit a local maximum for specific values of the magnetoelectric parameter, an unusual new behavior that can be regarded as a signature of these chiral surface polaritons. Surface waves in an interface involving a bi- isotropic medium with an anomalous Hall effect (AHE) are also examined. Multiple configurations for their occurrence are obtained, revealing a richer scenario with distinct regimes of propagation and coexistence in the parameter space. The presence of a non-null AHE contribution creates a magnetoelectric range for which the surface wave propagation is forbidden, providing an additional signature of surface-polariton propagation in bi-isotropic media with an AHE contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了出现在简单介电体与双各向同性（bi-isotropic）介质界面上的表面极化激元（surface polaritons, SPs），涵盖无损耗情形下非Dyakonov表面极化激元的产生条件、小损耗情形下的传播长度特性，以及含有反常霍尔效应（anomalous Hall effect, AHE）贡献的双各向同性介质界面中的表面波行为。
AI.motivation: 探索双各向同性介质界面上表面极化激元的传播特性，揭示手性（chiral）表面极化激元的新颖行为及其与反常霍尔效应耦合时的丰富物理场景，为表面波的识别与调控提供理论依据。
AI.method: 在无损耗条件下推导介电常数与双各向同性参数满足的存在条件（existence conditions），给出非Dyakonov表面极化激元出现的参数限制；在小损耗条件下分析表面等离激元-极化激元（surface plasmon-polariton）的特征传播长度，并考察磁电参数对传播长度的影响；进一步研究含反常霍尔效应贡献的双各向同性介质界面中的表面波，获取多种构型的出现条件及其在参数空间中的共存区域。
AI.result: 无损耗条件下，正介电常数与磁电参数可实现非Dyakonov表面极化激元，并推导出一般性的存在条件；小损耗条件下，传播长度随磁电参数变化可出现局部极大值，构成新颖行为并可作为手性表面极化激元的特征信号；含反常霍尔效应时获得了多种表面波构型及不同的传播与共存机制，且非零AHE贡献会产生一个禁止表面波传播的磁电参数区间，可作为额外识别信号。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了双各向同性介质界面上表面极化激元的多种传播机制，传播长度局部极大值与AHE导致的禁带区间均可作为该类手性表面极化激元的特征标识，为实验探测与器件设计提供了理论基础。

title: Exact Analytic Solution for the Time-Fractional Hunter-Saxton Equation with Caputo derivative
summary: A time fractional extension of the Hunter Saxton equation is examined, in which the temporal derivative of u_x is replaced by a Caputo derivative of order 0 < alpha <= 1. This modification introduces memory effects into a model traditionally associated with director field dynamics in nematic liquid crystals. By employing a fractional separation of variables strategy together with the exponential spatial profile phi(x) = exp(b+x), which cancels the nonlinear structure exactly, the governing nonlinear partial differential equation is reduced to a fractional relaxation ODE, whose closed form solution is the one-parameter Mittag Leffler function. The exact analytic solution is derived algebraically from the separation process. This appears to be the first exact closed form solution of the Caputo time fractional Hunter Saxton equation. The result is validated symbolically using the MathHandbook computer-algebra system. Quantitative analysis in both the fractional (0 < alpha < 1) and classical (alpha -> 1) limits demonstrates how fractional-order memory slows temporal relaxation relative to the exponential baseline. The solution provides a reliable benchmark for numerical schemes and clarifies how fractional dynamics influence nonlinear wave propagation in orientationally ordered fluids.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Hunter–Saxton方程的时间分数阶推广形式，将u_x的时间导数替换为Caputo导数（阶数0<α≤1），通过分数阶分离变量方法与指数空间剖面exp(b+x)将非线性偏微分方程约化为分数阶松弛常微分方程，首次获得其单参数Mittag-Leffler函数的精确闭式解，并用符号计算验证，表明分数阶记忆效应减缓了时间松弛过程。
AI.motivation: Hunter–Saxton方程传统上与向列型液晶中的指向矢场动力学相关，其中引入分数阶时间导数可以刻画此前未能描述的记忆效应（memory effects），从而更真实地反映该物理系统的演化特性。此外，此前尚无Caputo时间分数阶Hunter–Saxton方程的精确闭式解的报道，该研究填补了这一空白。
AI.method: 采用分数阶分离变量策略（fractional separation of variables），并引入指数空间剖面φ(x)=exp(b+x)，该剖面精确地消除了原始方程中的非线性结构。由此，将控制性非线性偏微分方程约化为一个分数阶松弛常微分方程（fractional relaxation ODE），其闭式解由单参数Mittag-Leffler函数给出，求解过程完全代数值化。
AI.result: 获得了Caputo时间分数阶Hunter–Saxton方程的首个精确闭式解析解，并通过MathHandbook计算机代数系统进行了符号验证。定量分析显示，在分数阶情形（0<α<1）下时间松弛较经典极限（α→1）下的指数基线更慢，分数阶记忆效应显著减缓了系统的演化。
AI.conclusion: 该精确解可为数值格式提供可靠的基准（benchmark），并阐明了分数阶动力学如何影响取向有序流体中的非线性波传播行为。研究同时揭示了分数阶记忆效应的物理意义，即减缓非线性波动的时间演化，深化了对该类系统动力学本质的理解。

title: Quantum information spreading via higher-order operator correlators
summary: We provide a perspective into measuring the quantum information spreading by introducing N-operator correlators. Leveraging the idea from N-point correlation function from cosmology, we formulate a generalized Out-of-Time-Ordered Correlator (OTOC), called N-Operator Correlator (NOC). Such formulation can reduce the effect of restricted analysis associated with selecting only two operators for OTOC. NOC can take into account a larger set of measurement probes in measuring the degree of quantum information spreading. We demonstrate these concepts with two analytically tractable toy systems with computing thermal averages of operator time evolutions at a finite temperature: a single qubit in longitudinal field and XYZ two-qubit system. Our perspective serves as a basic introduction to generalized operator correlators in quantum mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种推广的时序外关联子（N-Operator Correlator, NOC），通过引入N算子关联子来测量量子信息的扩散程度，以克服传统外时序关联子（OTOC）仅选取两个算子的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统的外时序关联子（OTOC）仅涉及两个算子的选取，这种限制性分析方法可能无法全面捕捉量子信息扩散的完整图景，因此需要更广义的测量框架。
AI.method: 借鉴宇宙学中N点关联函数的思想，将传统OTOC推广为N算子关联子（NOC），使其能够纳入更大数量的测量探针。利用两个可解析求解的玩具系统（纵场中的单量子比特及XYZ双量子比特系统），在有限温度下计算算子时间演化的热平均值来验证该框架。
AI.result: 两个可解析玩具系统的计算结果成功演示了NOC框架的有效性，表明该推广能够在测量量子信息扩散程度时涵盖更大集合的测量探针。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为量子力学中广义算子关联子提供了基础性导论，并为更全面地量化量子信息扩散提供了新的视角和工具。

title: Picard Iteration for the Characteristic Initial Value Problem in Einstein Equations
summary: We present an iteration algorithm for vacuum and Einstein scalar-field equations in double-null gauge, which transform the non-linear PDE into systems of ODE. The numerical realization combines characteristic constraint solves, LGL spectral elements, pole-free spherical operators, Galerkin projection, and independent first-order residual and consistency checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于双零规范（double-null gauge）下真空与爱因斯坦标量场方程的迭代算法，将非线性偏微分方程（PDE）转化为常微分方程（ODE）系统。
AI.motivation: 求解爱因斯坦场方程（Einstein field equations）涉及非线性偏微分方程，数值求解困难，需要将其转化为更易于处理的常微分方程系统。
AI.method: 迭代算法结合了多种数值技术，包括特征约束求解（characteristic constraint solves）、勒让德-高斯-洛巴托谱元法（LGL spectral elements）、无极点球面算子（pole-free spherical operators）、伽辽金投影（Galerkin projection），以及独立的一阶残差和一致性检验。
AI.result: 该算法成功将双零规范下的真空与爱因斯坦标量场非线性偏微分方程转化为常微分方程系统，并通过独立的残差与一致性检验保证了数值结果的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种可靠且有效的途径来数值求解爱因斯坦标量场方程，通过多种数值技术的综合运用实现了对非线性PDE的系统化处理。

title: Coupled self-charging and self-propulsion of evaporating sessile droplets
summary: Evaporating sessile water droplets universally deposit surface charges while simultaneously becoming self-charged---a phenomenon that remains under-appreciated despite its potentially important consequences. Here, we investigate one such consequence: droplet self-propulsion driven by self-charging. This self-propulsion arises spontaneously in the absence of external stimuli and produces self-avoiding trajectories that can displace droplets by many times their own diameter. Our results have important practical implications for processes requiring spatial precision, such as inkjet printing. The coupling between self-charging and self-propulsion produces mosaic surface charge patterns characterized by alternating polarities, which we explain with a physical model based on properties of the electric double layer.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了一种此前未受充分重视的物理现象：蒸发中的悬浮水滴在沉积表面电荷的同时自身也会带电，进而引发自发性的液滴自推进运动。该自推进无需外部刺激即可发生，产生可绕过自身尺寸多倍的自回避轨迹，对喷墨打印等需要空间精确性的工艺具有重要实际意义。
AI.motivation: 蒸发中的水滴在沉积表面电荷并同时自身带电的现象（self-charging）虽然在自然界普遍存在且可能具有重要后果，但长期以来未得到充分认识。作者旨在系统研究该现象的一个具体后果——由自身带电驱动的液滴自推进（droplet self-propulsion），并理解其物理机制。
AI.method: 作者通过实验观测蒸发水滴的自发自推进行为，记录其自回避轨迹（self-avoiding trajectories）；同时利用物理模型（physical model），基于双电层（electric double layer）的性质来解释观测到的马赛克状表面电荷图案（mosaic surface charge patterns），该图案以极性交替为特征。
AI.result: 研究发现，蒸发水滴的自推进在无外部刺激条件下自发产生，并形成自回避轨迹，可将液滴位移至其自身直径的数倍距离。自身带电与自推进之间的耦合产生了具有交替极性的马赛克状表面电荷图案，并可通过基于双电层性质的物理模型加以解释。
AI.conclusion: 该发现对喷墨打印（inkjet printing）等要求空间精确性的工艺具有重要实际启示，表明需将液滴因自充电引发的自推进效应纳入相关工程设计的考量。

title: Convex optimization on moment polytopes: Hadamard mirror descent and efficient algorithms for quantum functionals and other tensor parameters
summary:
Convex optimization on polytopes arises in many areas of science. When the polytope is given implicitly or has exponentially many vertices and facets, standard methods may not apply or be ineffective. This is the case for moment polytopes, such as the entanglement polytopes, which play a foundational role in quantum information and algebraic complexity. They give rise to important entanglement measures and tensor parameters such as the quantum functionals, yet general effective methods for computing these quantities have been elusive.
  In this paper we address this challenge. We develop a first-order framework called Hadamard mirror descent to optimize suitable convex functions over moment polytopes and, more generally, the gradient sets of geodesically convex functions. It operates locally and does not rely on any explicit description of the polytope. Our framework extends mirror descent, an effective and widely used framework for convex optimization, from the Euclidean setting to Hadamard manifolds, and is motivated by a recent work by Hirai, which we interpret as a Hadamard version of mirror flow. Applying the framework to entanglement polytopes yields the first efficient first-order algorithms to compute the quantum functionals, the symmetric quantum functional, and the G-stable ranks, as well as a new direct algorithm for the non-commutative rank.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Hadamard镜像下降（Hadamard mirror descent）的一阶优化框架，用于在矩多面体（moment polytope）及更一般的测地凸函数梯度集上优化合适的凸函数。该框架将欧几里得空间中的镜像下降（mirror descent）扩展到Hadamard流形，无需多面体的显式描述即可局部运作。将其应用于纠缠多面体（entanglement polytope），首次得到计算量子泛函（quantum functionals）、对称量子泛函和G-稳定秩的高效一阶算法，以及非交换秩的直接算法。
AI.motivation: 多面体上的凸优化在多个科学领域中出现，但当多面体是隐式给定的或具有指数级顶点与面时，标准方法可能失效。矩多面体（如纠缠多面体）在量子信息和代数复杂性中具有基础性作用，衍生出量子泛函等重要张量参数，但缺少通用有效的计算方法。
AI.method: 开发了第一阶框架Hadamard镜像下降，将经典镜像下降从欧几里得（Euclidean）设置推广到Hadamard流形（Hadamard manifold），用于优化在矩多面体及测地凸函数的梯度集上的凸函数。该框架局部运作，不依赖多面体的任何显式描述，其动机源于Hirai的近期工作，后者被解读为Hadamard版本的镜像流（mirror flow）。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于纠缠多面体，首次获得了计算量子泛函、对称量子泛函（symmetric quantum functional）和G-稳定秩（G-stable ranks）的高效一阶算法，并给出了计算非交换秩（non-commutative rank）的新直接算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了矩多面体相关量子信息量与张量参数计算中缺乏通用有效方法的空白，为解决此类隐式多面体上的凸优化问题提供了新的理论工具和算法途径。

title: Can a Local Quantum-Mechanical Description of Physical Reality Be Considered Complete?
summary: In a complete quantum theory, one would construct it based on what we can observe in a system and operationally define in our universe. This philosophy goes back to some of the original ideals of quantum theory defined by W. Heisenberg, N. Bohr, and others as part of the Copenhagen school of thought. We argue in this letter that that if one wishes to construct a complete quantum field theory, that it is most natural to construct it based on a nonlocal theory of observable principles. If this interpretation is valid, then the one-particle nonrelativistic limit that recovers quantum mechanics would as well be nonlocal. In this interpretation we derive the nonlocal Schrödinger equation. We will as well demonstrate that the canonical position--momentum commutator and the Heisenberg uncertainty principle emerge from translation covariance.

AI.tldr: 本文依据哥本哈根学派的可观测性哲学观，提出若需构造完整的量子场论（quantum field theory），最自然的途径是基于非局域（nonlocal）的可观测原理体系；并由此推导出非局域的薛定谔方程（Schrödinger equation），证明位置-动量对易子与海森堡不确定性原理（Heisenberg uncertainty principle）可从平移协变性中涌现。
AI.motivation: 量子理论早期的理想（由海森堡、玻尔等哥本哈根学派提出）强调理论应基于系统内可观测且可操作定义的内容构建。作者认为，若以此哲学为指导，构造完备的量子场论应基于非局域的可观测原理框架。
AI.method: 作者采取论证性推导方法：首先论证完备量子场论应基于非局域可观测原理构建，继而在此解释框架下推导非局域的薛定谔方程，并通过平移协变性（translation covariance）演绎出正则位置-动量对易子（canonical position–momentum commutator）及海森堡不确定性原理。
AI.result: 论文推导出非局域薛定谔方程，并证明单粒子非相对论极限可恢复量子力学（quantum mechanics），且该极限同样具有非局域性；此外，正则位置-动量对易子与海森堡不确定性原理被证明可从平移协变性中自然涌现。
AI.conclusion: 若该非局域可观测原理的解释成立，则量子场论的构造应以非局域原理为根基，而非局域性在向量子力学的非相对论约化过程中依然保持，揭示了不确定性关系与平移对称性之间的深层关联。

title: Black holes with torsion hair in cubic Holst-type Poincaré gauge gravity: from singular to regular geometries
summary: Motivated by the singularity theorems of Poincaré Gauge (PG) theory, we investigate extensions of the Holst quadratic model by introducing cubic order invariants constructed from the curvature and torsion tensors into the gravitational action. Such models are characterised by a kinetic structure that is governed by a pseudoscalar mode, whereas the remaining irreducible modes of torsion contribute through nonlinear interactions that can have important implications for the space-time geometry. In particular, in line with other well-known models of PG theory, the Birkhoff theorem does not hold in general, allowing for new exact static and spherically symmetric black hole solutions with dynamical torsion. Across the different torsion sectors, corresponding to the irreducible modes and parity components of the torsion field involved in the analysis, we find both singular and regular configurations. Among the singular solutions, we obtain Kiselev-like and Boulware-Deser-like geometries, as well as new geometries with distinct algebraic and Lambert $W$ metric corrections. In addition, we find regular black holes with both primary and secondary torsion hair, which evade the singularity theorems through violations of the causal convergence conditions induced by the nonlinear torsion interactions. Therefore, we show that Holst-type PG models can support a rich variety of black hole geometries, while providing explicit mechanisms for evading the singularity theorems of PG theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了霍尔斯二次模型（Holst quadratic model）的扩展，通过在引力作用量中引入由曲率和挠率张量构造的三次阶不变量，发现此类模型可支持丰富的黑洞几何结构，包括奇异和规则配置，并通过非线性挠率相互作用违反因果收敛条件来规避庞加莱规范（Poincaré Gauge, PG）理论的奇异性定理。
AI.motivation: 受庞加莱规范理论中奇异性定理（singularity theorems）的驱动，旨在探索能够规避这些定理的扩展引力模型，并考察新精确黑洞解的多样性。
AI.method: 在霍尔斯二次模型中引入由曲率和挠率张量构造的三次阶（cubic order）不变式；模型动力学结构由赝标量（pseudoscalar）模式主导，其余不可约挠率模式通过非线性相互作用耦合；通过分析不同挠率扇区获得精确的静态球对称黑洞解。
AI.result: 在奇异解中获得了类似基谢列夫（Kiselev-like）和类似布洛-德塞尔（Boulware-Deser-like）几何，以及具有不同代数和兰伯特W（Lambert W）度量修正的新几何；同时发现具有一次和二次挠率毛（torsion hair）的规则黑洞，这些黑洞通过非线性挠率相互作用引起的因果收敛条件（causal convergence conditions）违背来规避奇异性定理。
AI.conclusion: 霍尔斯型PG模型能够支持丰富多样的黑洞几何结构，并为规避PG理论的奇异性定理提供了明确机制；同时指出比克霍夫定理（Birkhoff theorem）在该类模型中一般不成立，允许具有动力学位移的静态精确黑洞解的存在。

title: Nanothermodynamics: stable thermal equilibrium and nanoscale fluctuations
summary: Nanothermodynamics describes the process where large systems subdivide into equilibrium distributions of small subsystems. A key ingredient is Hill's subdivision potential (E) that ensures adherence to the 1st and 2nd laws of thermodynamics in systems of any size. In this review and reassessment, it is emphasized that nanothermodynamics gives new insight into many measurements, theories, and simulations. Measurements establishing the need for nanothermodynamics show thermodynamic heterogeneity from multiple effective temperatures (T_i) inside most types of materials. One theoretical result that requires E=0 is the stable solution of Ising's original model for finite chains of interacting spins, a solution Ising could not have found 40 years before Hill's work. Another result is a novel solution to Gibbs' paradox that makes the entropy of the semiclassical ideal gas exactly extensive. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal how a standard fluctuation relation is modified when local degrees of freedom fluctuate faster than their coupling to the heat bath, consistent with the measured thermodynamic heterogeneity. Simulations of a Creutz-like model, comprised of Ising spins coupled to an explicit heat bath of Einstein oscillators, are used to study the 2nd law. It is found that maximizing the total entropy (S_t) requires an intrinsically irreversible step, providing a counterexample to the usual claim that statistical mechanics emerges from reversible dynamics. Furthermore, fluctuations of this model are best described by Einstein's reversal of Boltzmann's relation and the 2nd-law, not by recent fluctuation theorems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾与重新评估了纳米热力学（nanothermodynamics），强调Hill的细分势（subdivision potential）是确保任意尺寸系统中热力学第一、第二定律成立的关键要素，并通过测量、理论结果和分子动力学模拟等证据展示了纳米热力学对许多测量、理论及模拟的研究提供了新见解。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在综述并重新评估纳米热力学框架，指出该理论为理解材料内部的热力学不均匀性（thermodynamic heterogeneity）以及多种此前难以解释的测量、理论与模拟结果提供了统一且新颖的视角。
AI.method: 本文采用综述与再评估方法，从实验测量、理论推导与数值模拟三类证据入手：测量揭示多数材料内部存在多个有效温度（effective temperature, T_i）；理论层面分析了Ising原始模型有限自旋链解的稳定性条件，以及利用E=0给出半经典理想气体熵的系统性解法以解决Gibbs悖论；此外，通过分子动力学模拟检验标准涨落关系（fluctuation relation）的修正，并通过对Creutz类模型（含与爱因斯坦振子热库耦合的Ising自旋）进行模拟以研究第二定律。
AI.result: 结果表明，稳定Ising模型有限链解要求细分势E=0；半经典理想气体的熵依此可做到精确的广延性（extensivity），从而提供了Gibbs悖论的新解法。模拟发现，当局域自由度的涨落快于其与热浴的耦合时，标准涨落关系被修正，与测量的热力学不均匀性一致。Creutz类模型模拟进一步显示，最大化总熵（total entropy, S_t）需要一个本质上不可逆的步骤，这对"统计力学源自可逆动力学"的常见论断构成了反例；该模型的涨落最适合用爱因斯坦对玻尔兹曼关系和第二定律的反转式描述来解释。
AI.conclusion: 纳米热力学为联结宏观热力学与微观统计行为提供了更一般的框架，其核心概念细分势E在理论和模拟中均具关键作用；同时，研究结果对从可逆动力学导出统计力学的传统观念提出了挑战。

title: Global Strong Solutions for Maxwell-Stefan Diffusion with Additive Friction Coefficients
summary: We study Maxwell-Stefan diffusion with additive friction coefficients $f_{ij}=g_i+g_j$. In mass fractions, the system isolates the constrained pair-friction block; in mole fractions, it is the classical ideal isothermal/isobaric Maxwell-Stefan system at constant total molar concentration. Additivity makes the constrained pair-friction dissipation species-diagonal; conversely, species-diagonality on one interior barycentric constraint space forces a pair-sum representation. At operator level, the positive constrained relaxation operator is a scalar shift of a compression of $G=diag[g_1,\ldots,g_N]$. Its scalar resolvent yields both an explicit constrained inverse and interlacing spectral roots, which form global real-analytic coordinates on the open simplex and whose differentials are left eigen-covectors. In root coordinates the principal part is diagonal, no self-square gradient term occurs, and scalar comparison yields invariant rectangles and separation from the simplex boundary. For regularity we introduce entropy-stabilized one-sided multi-EPD truncations: Euler-Poisson-Darboux entropies cancel mixed quadratic production, while for $N\ge4$ a truncation-weighted mixing-entropy correction supplies transverse coercivity. Caccioppoli and logarithmic estimates, shrinking, and critical mass yield Hölder continuity up to the Neumann boundary. The mixing entropy also symmetrizes the moment system; frozen conormal estimates give spatial Lipschitz bounds. Together with time Hölder control and short-interval maximal regularity, this yields global strong solvability on bounded $C^{2+α}$ domains with $0<α<1$, for each $N\ge2$, $d\ge2$, and $p>d+2$, for all uniformly positive, compatible initial concentrations in the natural trace class. Solutions become classical for positive times and converge exponentially to equilibrium in relative entropy, $L^2$, and $C^1(\barΩ)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究的是具有加性摩擦系数 \(f_{ij}=g_i+g_j\) 的 Maxwell-Stefan 扩散系统。在全部分子分数和分子分数两种坐标系下分别将其化归为经典模型；作者在算子层面证明其约束松弛算子为对角缩放矩阵的纯量平移与压缩；通过特征根建立全局实解析坐标，在此基础上将主部分对角化；进而引入熵稳定的单边多EPD截断以获得正则性，最终在有界 \(C^{2+\alpha}\) 域上（\(\alpha\in(0,1)\)，\(d\ge2\)，\(p>d+2\)）对所有 \(N\ge2\) 的可容许初始浓度建立了全局强可解性，并证明解在正时间后成为经典解且以指数速率收敛至平衡态。
AI.motivation: Maxwell-Stefan 扩散系统描述多组分气体或液体中的互扩散现象，其解析与正则性理论（尤其对于一般摩擦系数）长期以来复杂而具有挑战性。本文聚焦加性摩擦系数的特殊结构，试图揭示该结构带来的算子简化与全局解的机制。
AI.method: 作者在质量分数和分子分数两种视角下对系统进行坐标变换与隔离，将约束对摩擦块对角化；在算子层面将正约束松弛算子表示为对角阵 \(G=\mathrm{diag}[g_1,\ldots,g_N]\) 的压缩的纯量平移；利用矩阵谱的交错性构造全局实解析根坐标，其微分为左特征余向量；通过引入熵稳定的单边多EPD截断（Euler-Poisson-Darboux 熵）及截断加权混合熵校正来建立正则性框架；结合 Caccioppoli 不等式、对数估计、收缩性、临界质量论证以及冻结 conormal 估计与时 Hölder 控制，建立全局强解的存在性。
AI.result: 在对角化的根坐标下系统主部分为对角的，不出现自平方梯度项；标量比较给出不变矩形并阻止解趋近单纯形边界。作者证明了 Hölder 连续性直至 Neumann 边界，并在有界 \(C^{2+\alpha}\) 域（\(0<\alpha<1\)）、\(N\ge2\)、\(d\ge2\)、\(p>d+2\) 的条件下对所有一致正、相容的初始浓度建立了全局强可解性；解在正时间后为经典解，并在相对熵、\(L^2\) 和 \(C^1(\bar\Omega)\) 范数下指数收敛到平衡态。
AI.conclusion: 具有加性摩擦系数的 Maxwell-Stefan 系统建立了完整的全局解析理论，包括坐标对角化、谱结构刻画、正则性提升与指数收敛性，为该类系统提供了统一的强可解性框架。

title: A Gauge Theory of Turbulence:
summary: We formalize the gauge structure of the Navier--Stokes equation for incompressible fluids, interpreting $\nabla\cdot\mathbf{v}=0$ as a gauge fixing analogous to the Coulomb gauge in electromagnetism. We construct the Martin--Siggia--Rose action and its full BRST symmetry, introducing BRST doublets for the Gribov parameter $γ$ and the monodromy phase $θ$. Through a Higgs mechanism, $γ$ acquires a vacuum expectation value $γ_{0}$, generating a mass scale for the vorticity and the ghosts; we compute the one-loop effective potential and analyze vacuum stability. Intermittency --- measured by the exponents $ζ_{n}$ --- is described by fluctuations of the Higgs field $σ$ around the condensate, via a Gribov-inspired log-Poisson hierarchy that satisfies exactly $ζ_{3}=1$ (Kolmogorov's four-fifths law). Fits to DNS data favor filamentary vorticity structures, with $D_{f}\approx1$ (one parameter) or $D_{f}\approx2.1$, $Δ\approx0.44$ (two parameters). The one-loop anomalous dimension in $d=3$, $Δ_σ\approx0.50$, supports the identification $D_{f}=2Δ_σ$. The formalism unifies classical hydrodynamics with gauge theory and spontaneous symmetry breaking, opening the study of turbulence and intermittency to quantum field theory methods.

AI.tldr: 本文对不可压缩流体的纳维-斯托克斯方程（Navier-Stokes equation）进行了规范结构（gauge structure）的形式化，将不可压缩条件视为类似电磁学中库仑规范的规范固定；通过构建马丁-西吉亚-罗斯作用量（Martin-Siggia-Rose action）及完整的BRST对称性，引入希格斯机制（Higgs mechanism）使涡量获得质量标度，并用Higgs场的涨落通过log-Poisson分层描述间歇性（intermittency），从而将经典流体力学与规范理论和自发对称破缺统一起来。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在将湍流和间歇性现象纳入量子场论（QFT）和规范理论的方法框架，揭示流体力学中的数学结构与规范理论之间的深层联系，特别是通过对称性和破缺机制来理解湍流的统计性质。
AI.method: 作者将不可压缩条件∇·v=0解释为类似库仑规范的规范固定，构造Martin-Siggia-Rose作用量及其完整BRST对称性，引入Gribov参数γ和单值相θ的BRST双重态；通过希格斯机制使γ获得真空期望值γ₀，生成涡量和鬼场的质量尺度；计算单圈有效势并分析真空稳定性；用Higgs场σ围绕凝聚态的涨落通过Gribov启发的log-Poisson层次描述间歇性。
AI.result: 所构建的log-Poisson层次精确满足ζ₃=1（柯尔莫哥洛夫四分之五定律）；对直接数值模拟（DNS）数据的拟合倾向于丝状涡量结构，单参数情形给出Df≈1，双参数情形给出Df≈2.1、Δ≈0.44；三维中的单圈反常维度Δ_σ≈0.50支持Df=2Δ_σ的识别。
AI.conclusion: 该形式体系将经典流体力学与规范理论和自发对称破缺统一起来，为运用量子场论方法研究湍流和间歇性开辟了途径。

title: Persistence of measurement-induced nonlocality in uniformly accelerating Unruh-DeWitt detectors
summary: Uniform acceleration induces a thermal response to the Minkowski vacuum and can thereby modify quantum correlations. For measurement-induced nonlocality (MIN), a form of nonclassical correlation distinct from entanglement, previous field-mode analyses of bosonic fields found that it decreases with increasing acceleration and vanishes in the infinite-acceleration limit. This raises the question of whether the disappearance of MIN is a generic consequence of the Unruh effect or depends on the physical description of the accelerated quantum system. To address this question, we study two uniformly accelerating Unruh-DeWitt detectors interacting with a massless scalar field. We find that the response of MIN to the Unruh temperature depends sensitively on the initial detector state: it can decrease monotonically, vanish at an intermediate temperature and subsequently recover, or increase monotonically. Moreover, for a broad class of initial states, MIN approaches a nonzero value in the high-temperature limit. These results show that the suppression of MIN under strong acceleration is not universal. Instead, Unruh-induced detector dynamics gives rise to a state-dependent response in which measurement-induced nonlocality can be suppressed, restored, or enhanced.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究两个均匀加速的Unruh-DeWitt探测器与无质量标量场（massless scalar field）的相互作用，发现测量诱导非局域性（measurement-induced nonlocality, MIN）对Unruh温度的响应高度依赖于初始探测器态：可以单调下降、在中间温度消失后恢复、或单调增加；且对一大类初始态，MIN在高温极限下趋于非零值。由此证明强加速下MIN的抑制并非普遍规律。
AI.motivation: 此前对玻色场（bosonic field）的场模分析表明，MIN随加速度增加而减少并在无限加速度极限下消失。这引发了一个问题：MIN的消失是否为Unruh效应的普遍结果，还是取决于加速量子系统的物理描述。本文旨在通过探测器模型回答这一问题。
AI.method: 论文采用两个均匀加速的Unruh-DeWitt探测器与无质量标量场耦合的物理模型，系统地分析探测器初始态对MIN在Unruh温度下行为的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现MIN对Unruh温度的响应敏感地依赖于初始探测器态：它可以单调减小、在某一中间温度消失后随后恢复、或单调增加。此外，对一大类初始态，MIN在高温极限下趋近于非零值。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明强加速下MIN的抑制并非普遍规律；Unruh诱导的探测器动力学（Unruh-induced detector dynamics）产生依赖初态的响应，其中测量诱导非局域性可以被抑制、恢复甚至增强。

title: Altermagnetism from the viewpoint of chemistry
summary: Magnetism has been a central theme of research in chemistry, physics, and materials science, with chemical composition and bonding playing key roles in determining magnetic behavior. Altermagnets are a newly identified class of magnetic materials that combine features of conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets, arising from specific symmetry and electronic structure motifs. In this review, we present a chemistry-driven viewpoint on altermagnetism, highlighting how crystal chemistry, bonding, and electronic structure enable this unconventional magnetic order. We begin by introducing the fundamental concepts required to understand altermagnets, with an emphasis on symmetry considerations, orbital character, and electronic structure signatures. We then survey the diverse material families in which altermagnetism has been identified, drawing attention to coordination environments and structure-property relationships that favor altermagnetic order. We subsequently present experimental approaches which are useful for the characterization of altermagnetic materials. We examine ab initio materials discovery as a promising strategy for identifying new altermagnets, emphasizing how chemical constraints, such as symmetry and bonding, can guide computational searches. Other than their intrinsic importance, altermagnets provide interesting possibilities for technology. For this reason, we highlight possible applications that may be enabled through altermagnetic materials, along with their coupling with existing orders such as ferroelectricity and superconductivity. In conclusion, we point out some challenges and prospects, where chemically-based design guidelines can play an important role towards advancing altermagnetism research. In summary, this review offers an account of recent developments in altermagnetism, from basic concepts to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇以化学视角综述交替磁体（altermagnet）的评述性文章，系统覆盖了交替磁性的基本概念、材料家族、实验表征、计算发现策略及应用前景，并提出了基于化学的设计准则对推动该领域发展的展望。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体作为一类新发现的磁性材料，兼具传统铁磁体和反铁磁体的特征，其产生源于特定的对称性与电子结构构型。作者旨在从化学驱动的视角系统梳理交替磁性研究的最新进展，强调晶体化学、成键和电子结构如何促成这种非常规磁性有序。
AI.method: 文章采用综述性方法组织内容：首先介绍理解交替磁体所需的基础概念，着重于对称性考量、轨道特征和电子结构标记；随后调查已发现交替磁性的多种材料家族，关注配位环境和结构-性质关系；接着呈现适用于表征交替磁体材料的实验方法；并考察基于第一性原理计算的材料发现（ab initio materials discovery）作为识别新型交替磁体的可行策略。
AI.result: 综述指出化学约束（如对称性和成键）可有效指导计算搜索发现新的交替磁体；同时概述了交替磁体在技术应用方面的潜在可能，包括与铁电性和超导电性等已有有序态的耦合。
AI.conclusion: 文章指出了交替磁性研究面临的一些挑战和前景，强调基于化学的设计准则可在推进交替磁性研究方面发挥重要作用。

title: Random walk and Weber-Schafheitlin integral: generalizations and discussion
summary: This paper presents a study of the Weber-Schafheitlin integral and its connections to random walk theory. The Weber-Schafheitlin integral, defined as the improper integral of a product of Bessel functions, arises naturally in the evaluation of probability distributions for multidimensional random walks. This work bridges pure special function theory with applied probability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究韦伯-沙夫海特林积分（Weber-Schafheitlin integral）及其与随机游走理论（random walk theory）之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 韦伯-沙夫海特林积分在多维随机游走的概率分布（probability distributions）求解中自然出现，作者希望将纯特殊函数理论与应用概率学联系起来。
AI.method: 研究定义为贝塞尔函数（Bessel functions）乘积反常积分（improper integral）的韦伯-沙夫海特林积分，并分析其与多维随机游走概率分布计算之间的数学联系。
AI.result: 建立了特殊函数理论与随机游走理论之间的桥梁，揭示了韦伯-沙夫海特林积分在多维随机游走概率评价中的核心作用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了纯特殊函数理论与应用概率之间的学科鸿沟，表明纯数学积分工具可为随机游走等多种应用领域提供有效的数学框架。

title: Static spherically symmetric electroweak models with fermions and gravity
comment: Comments welcome! Solver code available at codeberg.org/msobak/SphSymSM.git
summary: In this article we provide a systematic reduction to static spherical symmetry for (classical) gauge theoretic models with structure group SU(2) x U(1), coupled to gravity. In particular, we derive the most general static spherically symmetric ansatz for the Einstein-Yang- Mills-Higgs-Dirac-Yukawa equation system. This model is reminiscent of the lepton sector of the Standard Model coupled to gravity. The resulting total system of ordinary differential equations is rather large, so that finding global solutions is non-trivial. For this reason, an open-source interactive solver GUI written in C++ is provided together with the article.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地推导了具有SU(2)×U(1)结构群的经典规范理论模型（耦合引力）在静态球对称（static spherical symmetry）约化下的完整形式，得到了爱因斯坦-杨-米尔斯-希格斯-狄拉克-汤川方程系统（Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs-Dirac-Yukawa system）最一般的静态球对称ansatz，并附带提供了一套开源C++交互式数值求解器。
AI.motivation: 该规范场模型类似于与引力耦合的标准模型轻子区（lepton sector of the Standard Model），对其静态球对称约化的系统研究尚未完成。所得到的常微分方程组规模庞大，使得寻找全局解具有非平凡性，需要系统化约化框架及数值工具支持。
AI.method: 通过构造结构群为SU(2)×U(1)的经典规范理论在引力背景下的静态球对称约化，推导出完整爱因斯坦-杨-米尔斯-希格斯-狄拉克-汤川方程组最一般的静态球对称ansatz。同时提供了一套用C++编写的开源交互式求解器图形用户界面（GUI），用于处理由此产生的大型常微分方程组。
AI.result: 成功导出了该理论模型在静态球对称条件下的最一般约化方程组（常微分方程组），并交付了配套的开源交互式求解器GUI以便进行数值分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为探索SU(2)×U(1)规范理论耦合引力这一类似标准模型轻子区的体系提供了系统的对称约化框架和可供社区使用的数值求解工具。

title: A Transport Framework for Evaluating Nanoscale Interconnect Materials
summary: As CMOS technology continues to scale, metallic interconnects increasingly limit circuit performance through rising resistivity, self-heating, and reliability degradation. Although several alternative metals have been proposed, a quantitative framework for evaluating their transport performance under nanoscale confinement remains unavailable. Here, we establish a transport framework by combining independently measured thermal and electrical conductivities with normalized and unnormalized transport figures of merit. We apply this framework to Cu, Ru, W, Co, Ir, and Mo thin films using new steady-state thermoreflectance measurements of Mo, Co, and Ir together with previously reported Cu, Ru, and W data. While Cu exhibits the highest intrinsic transport performance, its effective performance is substantially reduced by thickness scaling and Ta liner resistance. In contrast, Ru and Mo maintain favorable transport properties while enabling barrierless integration, identifying them as promising candidates for next-generation CMOS interconnects

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一种结合热电导率和传输品质因子的定量框架，用于评估纳米尺度约束下金属互连线的输运性能。通过新测量的Mo、Co、Ir薄膜数据与已有Cu、Ru、W数据对比，发现Cu本征性能最优但受厚度缩放和Ta阻隔层削弱，而Ru和Mo可在无阻隔层集成的同时保持良好输运性能，成为下一代CMOS互连线的有力候选。
AI.motivation: 随着CMOS技术持续微缩，金属互连线因电阻率上升、自热和可靠性劣化日益限制电路性能。尽管提出了多种替代金属，但尚缺乏在纳米尺度约束下评估其输运性能的定量框架。
AI.method: 将独立测量的热导率与电导率相结合，并引入归一化与非归一化的输运品质因数（figures of merit），建立输运性能评估框架。将该框架应用于Cu、Ru、W、Co、Ir和Mo薄膜，其中Mo、Co、Ir数据来自新的稳态热反射（steady-state thermoreflectance）测量，Cu、Ru、W数据取自已有文献。
AI.result: Cu具有最高的本征输运性能，但其有效性能因厚度缩放效应和Ta阻隔层电阻而显著降低。相反，Ru和Mo在保持良好输运性能的同时可实现无阻隔层（barrierless）集成。
AI.conclusion: Ru和Mo被识别为下一代CMOS互连线的有前景候选材料，因为它们能在纳米尺寸下兼顾输运性能与无阻隔层集成的工艺可行性。

title: Uniqueness for DLR equations of $\mathsf{Sine}_β$
summary: We prove that, for all $β>0$, the Dobrushin-Lanford-Ruelle (DLR) equations for the unit-intensity $\mathsf{Sine}_β$ point process have a unique stationary solution under a particular finite electric energy condition. Uniqueness fails if this condition is dropped. This answers a question of Dereudre-Hardy-Leblé-Maïda and gives a canonical statistical physics characterisation of $\mathsf{Sine}_β$. The main technical ingredient is a relative entropy estimate which allows us to compare the conditional distribution in a finite box of a DLR solution to a corresponding circular $β$ ensemble.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对所有β>0，单位强度Sine_β点过程的Dobrushin-Lanford-Ruelle（DLR）方程在特定有限电场能量条件下具有唯一的平稳解；若取消该条件则唯一性失效。这回答了Dereudre-Hardy-Leblé-Maïda提出的问题，并为Sine_β过程提供了规范的统计物理刻画。关键技术手段是一个相对熵估计，用于比较DLR解在有限盒中的条件分布与相应的圆β系综。
AI.motivation: 此前Sine_β点过程的统计物理表征尚未确立，Dereudre-Hardy-Leblé-Maïda提出了关于DLR方程解的唯一性问题，本文旨在回答该问题并为Sine_β提供规范的统计物理刻画。
AI.method: 作者证明了在所有β>0时，单位强度Sine_β点过程的DLR方程在有限电场能量条件下有唯一平稳解，并构造了相对熵估计这一核心技术工具，用以比较DLR解在有限盒内的条件分布与相应的圆β系综（circular β ensemble）。
AI.result: 证明了在指定有限电场能量条件下和DLR方程的平稳解唯一，且该条件不可或缺——一旦撤销唯一性即失效。
AI.conclusion: 该结果给出了Sine_β点过程的规范性统计物理学（statistical physics）表征，并解决了Dereudre-Hardy-Leblé-Maïda提出的公开问题。

title: Neutral scalar particle in a charged wormhole background
comment: The manuscript has 20 pages and 5 figures
summary: We investigate the dynamics of a neutral scalar particle in a charged traversable wormhole background, considering harmonic and modified harmonic oscillator couplings. By solving the Klein--Gordon equation, the radial problem is reduced to a generalized Heun equation, whose polynomial truncation yields the bound-state energy spectrum and quantized oscillator frequencies. Although the particle is electrically neutral, the energy spectrum depends indirectly on the wormhole charge through the geometric deformation of spacetime. We also analyze the dependence of the oscillator frequency on the angular momentum, throat parameter, electric charge, and the additional interaction parameter $V_{0}$. The appropriate limits recover the corresponding results for the uncharged wormhole and the standard harmonic oscillator.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带电可穿越虫洞（charged traversable wormhole）背景中中性标量粒子（neutral scalar particle）在谐振子（harmonic oscillator）及修正谐振子耦合下的动力学。通过求解克莱因-戈尔登方程（Klein–Gordon equation），径向问题被约化为广义Heun方程（generalized Heun equation），其多项式截断给出了束缚态能谱与量子化谐振子频率；尽管粒子电中性，能谱仍通过时空几何形变间接依赖于虫洞电荷。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在理解带电虫洞背景中物质粒子在该扭曲时空几何下的动力学行为，特别是中性粒子能否以及如何间接感受到虫洞电磁荷的效应。通过比较带电与不带电虫洞情形以及标准谐振子情形，探究几何形变对束缚态能谱和量子化频率的调控作用。
AI.method: 作者在带电可穿越虫洞背景下，对满足谐振子及修正谐振子耦合的中性标量粒子写出克莱因–戈尔登方程，将径向分离方程约化为一类广义Heun方程；随后利用多项式截断条件（polynomial truncation）确定束缚态能谱和量子化的谐振子频率，并系统考查振荡频率对角动量（angular momentum）、喉半径（throat）参数、电荷及额外相互作用参数V0的依赖关系。
AI.result: 求解得到束缚态能谱与量子化谐振子频率的解析表达式；揭示能谱在粒子电中性的前提下仍对虫洞电荷敏感——该影响经由时空几何形变间接传导。振荡频率随角动量、喉参数、电荷及参数V0的变化行为均被显式分析，且在相应极限下恢复不带电虫洞与标准谐振子的已有结果。
AI.conclusion: 带电虫洞的几何形变构成了控制中性粒子束缚态的关键机制，使得电中性粒子可通过纯粹引力/几何途径感知背景电磁荷。所得结果表明该框架在恰当极限下自然回归未充电虫洞与标准谐振子理论，验证了模型的自洽性与普适性。

title: Zonal dislocations in Laves phases: A coupled synchro-shear slip mechanism
summary: Synchro-shear is the primary plastic deformation mechanism in Laves phases at elevated temperatures, mediated by synchro-Shockley partial dislocations-zonal dislocations that proceed via localized events such as kink-pair nucleation and propagation. Using atomistic simulations, we identified a novel slip mechanism in Laves phases, namely coupled synchro-shear slip, involving the synchronized glide of two synchro-Shockley partial dislocations on adjacent slip planes, leading to the formation of extrinsic stacking faults. High-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy revealed the extended core structures consistent with coupled synchro-Shockley partial dislocations bounded by extrinsic stacking faults in C15 NbCr2 and their involvement in twinning. These results highlight the critical role of coupled synchro-shear slip in enabling phase transformations between Laves polytypes and in governing twinning behavior, providing new atomistic insight into the kinetic nature of plasticity in topologically close-packed intermetallic phases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过原子模拟（atomistic simulations）与高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）研究，在Laves相中识别出一种新型滑移机制——耦合同步剪切滑移（coupled synchro-shear slip），该机制由相邻滑移面上两个同步Shockley不全位错的协同滑移驱动，形成外禀层错（extrinsic stacking faults），并在相变与孪生行为中发挥关键作用。
AI.motivation: Laves相在高温下的主要塑性变形机制是同步剪切（synchro-shear），由同步Shockley不全位错介导，但其微观动力学细节尚不清晰。理解这一机制对于揭示拓扑密堆积（topologically close-packed）金属间化合物塑性的原子本质具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用原子模拟方法识别Laves相中的新型滑移机制；结合高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（high-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy）在C15 NbCr2中对扩展位错核结构进行实验表征，验证所提出的耦合同步滑移模型及其与孪生的关联。
AI.result: 发现耦合同步剪切滑移由两个同步Shockley不全位错在相邻滑移面上同步滑移所驱动，从而形成外禀层错；实验证实C15 NbCr2中由外禀层错约束的耦合同步Shockley不全位错扩展核结构，并观察到其参与孪生过程。
AI.conclusion: 耦合同步剪切滑移在Laves多型体（polytypes）之间的相变以及孪生行为调控中起关键作用，为理解拓扑密堆积金属间化合物塑性的动力学本质提供了新的原子尺度见解。

title: PPIM: Pennes Physics-Informed Mamba for Heat-Source-Conditioned 3D Bioheat Simulation
summary: Three-dimensional bioheat simulation aims to predict transient temperature distributions in biological tissue and is commonly modeled using the Pennes bioheat equation, which combines thermal diffusion, perfusion-mediated heat loss, and external heat generation. In this study, we consider a controlled 3D Pennes bioheat simulation under a localized heat-source condition inspired by microwave ablation (MWA). To evaluate neural approximation performance, we compare three neural partial differential equation (PDE) solvers under the same controlled simulation: a spatial Fourier-feature physics-informed neural network (PINN), a generic PINNMamba temporal subsequence model, and Pennes Physics-Informed Mamba (PPIM). PPIM builds on the temporal subsequence model by incorporating conditioned heat-source input and Pennes-aware state-space model (SSM) decay initialization. All three neural models are trained under the same conditions with the same Pennes residual, and an explicit finite-difference method (FDM) solution is used only as the numerical reference. In a representative 600~s run, PPIM achieved the lowest MAE, relative $L_1$ error, and relative $L_2$ error among the evaluated neural solvers. Error maps further showed that the remaining PPIM errors were more concentrated near the heat-source region than across the rest of the domain. These results indicate that PPIM is effective for approximating the FDM reference final temperature field in this controlled simulation. The source code is available at https://github.com/muvYun/PPIM.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控的三维（3D）Pennes生物热方程（bioheat equation）模拟场景下，比较了三种神经偏微分方程求解器，提出了一种名为Pennes物理信息Mamba（PPIM）的模型。PPIM通过在时间子序列模型基础上引入条件化热源输入和Pennes感知的状态空间模型（SSM）衰减初始化，在600秒代表性运行中取得了最低的平均绝对误差（MAE）、相对L1误差和相对L2误差。
AI.motivation: 三维生物热模拟旨在预测生物组织中的瞬态温度分布，通常基于Pennes生物热方程建模；本研究希望在受控微波消融（MWA）热源条件下评估不同神经偏微分方程（PDE）求解器的近似性能，以识别更有效的神经网络求解方案。
AI.method: 在相同的受控模拟条件下，比较三种神经PDE求解器：基于空间Fourier特征（Fourier-feature）的物理信息神经网络（PINN）、通用PINNMamba时间子序列模型，以及所提出的PPIM。PPIM在时间子序列模型的基础上引入条件化热源输入与Pennes感知的状态空间模型衰减初始化；所有模型均使用相同的Pennes残差进行训练，并以显式有限差分法（FDM）解作为数值参考。
AI.result: 在代表性600秒运行中，PPIM在平均绝对误差、相对L1误差和相对L2误差三项指标上均优于其他两种神经求解器。误差图显示PPIM的残余误差主要集中在热源附近区域，而非整个计算域内均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: PPIM在该受控模拟中能有效逼近FDM参考的最终温度场，表明其作为三维修模生物热PDE神经求解器的有效性。源代码已公开在https://github.com/muvYun/PPIM。

title: Can the Universe Change Signature When Gravity is Dynamical?
comment: 15 pages; accepted for publication in Journal of Mathematical Physics (JMP)
summary:
Can a universe undergo a regular Euclidean-Lorentzian signature transition when the gravitational coupling itself is dynamical? We address this question in scalar-tensor gravity with nonminimal coupling $F(φ)R$. Although the spatially flat Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) sector can be mapped to the Einstein frame for $F>0$ and a nondegenerate scalar redefinition, not all transition properties are frame independent. For a finite, positive, and sufficiently regular conformal factor, the existence and transverse character of the type change are preserved, whereas the extrinsic geometry is not. We therefore use the Einstein frame as a solution-generating representation and impose total geodesy in the physical Jordan frame. We construct two exactly integrable classes of solutions. In the oscillator-ghost-oscillator branch, the scalar field is stationary at the transition and Jordan-frame total geodesy follows under suitable regularity assumptions on the conformal factor. In the critical exponential-potential branch, the scalar is generically nonstationary and total geodesy instead requires \begin{equation*} H_E\big|_Σ=
\frac12 \left( \frac{d\ln F}{dψ} \right)_Σ\dotψ_Σ. \end{equation*} We also distinguish this condition from the stronger smoothness requirements of a Kossowski-Kriele-type transverse metric. Finally, while the canonical Einstein-frame scalar does not allow effective phantom evolution, the dynamical nonminimal coupling can generate a locally superaccelerating Jordan-frame regime near the transition when $\left(\frac{d\ln F}{dψ}\right)_Σ>0$ for the chosen oscillator branch. Thus signature change persists beyond Einstein gravity, with regularity and effective cosmological behavior remaining intrinsically frame sensitive.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在引力耦合常数本身是动力学量（标量-张量引力，含非最小耦合 F(φ)R）时，宇宙能否经历正则的欧几里得-洛伦兹号型转变（signature transition）。作者利用爱因斯坦框架（Einstein frame）生成解，并在物理的约当框架（Jordan frame）中施加全测地性条件，构造了两类精确可积解族，证明号型转变在爱因斯坦引力之外依然成立，但其正则性和有效宇宙学行为本质上依赖于框架选择。
AI.motivation: 在广义相对论框架下号型转变已被广泛研究，但当引力耦合本身成为动力学变量时，转变的性质是否保持、以及不同框架下的描述是否一致，是尚未澄清的关键问题。
AI.method: 在非最小耦合标量-张量引力 F(φ)R 的框架下，将空间平直的 FLRW 扇区映射至爱因斯坦框架求解，再变换回约当框架并在物理框架中施加全测地性（total geodesy）条件，构造振荡子-幽灵-振荡子（oscillator-ghost-oscillator）与临界指数势（critical exponential potential）两类精确可积解族。
AI.result: 对于有限、正且足够正则的共形因子，号型转变的存在性与横截性在框架变换下保持，但外在几何不保持；约当框架的全测地性在振荡子分支依赖标量场在转变处静止，在临界指数势分支则要求 H_E|_Σ = ½(dlnF/dψ)_Σ ψ̇_Σ；当 (dlnF/dψ)_Σ>0 时，动力学非最小耦合可在转变附近产生局域超加速（superaccelerating）的约当框架演化，即使爱因斯坦框架标量不允许有效的幽灵行为。
AI.conclusion: 号型转变的存在超越了爱因斯坦引力本身，但转变的正则性要求与有效宇宙学行为（如是否出现超加速相）本质上是框架敏感的，需在与物理度规对应的约当框架中判定。

title: Purely Electric-Field Control of Topological Magnetism in Two-Dimensional Magnets
summary: Electrical control of topological magnetism is central to realizing energy-efficient topological spintronics. Yet most electric-field approaches modify the competing magnetic interactions through a nonselective rearrangement of low-energy electronic states, yielding coarse magnetic phase control that often requires external magnetic fields to stabilize topological quasiparticles, while few schemes solely based on electric fields are restricted to specific conducting materials. Here, we establish a general approach for purely electric-field control of topological magnetism, in which an applied electric field electrostatically dopes a selected orbital-angular-momentum-polarized band edge of a two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnetic semiconductor via proximity to an adjacent nonmagnetic vdW metal. We show that the resulting electrostatic doping predominantly tunes magnetic anisotropy of the 2D magnet, while leaving exchange interaction and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction nearly unchanged, thereby reversibly driving the system through ferromagnetic, skyrmion, spiral, and bimeron phases. We demonstrate this mechanism for CrBr3/graphene and Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2 vdW heterostructures hosting electron and hole pockets of different orbital characters. These results establish a broadly applicable strategy for purely electric-field control in topological spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过邻近非磁性范德华（vdW）金属对二维范德华磁性半导体的轨道角动量极化带边进行静电掺杂，从而实现对拓扑磁性进行纯电场控制的普适方法。该方法主要调制磁各向异性（magnetic anisotropy），在保持交换相互作用和Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用几乎不变的前提下，可逆地驱动系统在铁磁、斯格明子（skyrmion）、螺旋和双斯格明子（bimeron）相之间切换，并在CrBr3/graphene和Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2异质结构中得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 现有电场调控拓扑磁性的方案多通过对低能电子态的非选择重构来改变竞争性磁相互作用，导致磁相控制粗糙且常需外部磁场稳定拓扑准粒子；少数纯电场方案则局限于特定导电材料。因此，亟需建立一种普适且无需外磁场的纯电场控制方法。
AI.method: 作者利用邻近非磁性vdW金属，在二维vdW磁性半导体中通过静电掺杂精准调控具有特定轨道角动量极化的带边。外加电场导致静电掺杂主要改变磁各向异性，而对交换相互作用（exchange interaction）和Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用几乎无影响。该方法在CrBr3/graphene和Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2两种分别承载电子与空穴口袋且轨道特征不同的vdW异质结构中进行了验证。
AI.result: 结果表明，通过纯电场静电掺杂可选择性调控磁各向异性，可逆地驱动系统在铁磁（ferromagnetic）、斯格明子（skyrmion）、螺旋（spiral）与双斯格明子（bimeron）等多种磁相之间转变，且无需外部磁场辅助。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了纯电场调控拓扑磁性的通用策略，无需依赖外部磁场，适用于多种携带不同轨道特征电荷口袋的vdW异质结构，为拓扑自旋电子学（topological spintronics）中的低能耗器件提供了广阔的应用前景。

title: $q$-deformed polyanalytic Ginibre point processes:construction and central limit theorems for linear statistics
summary: Based on the representation theory of the $q$-CCR algebra, we develop a representation-theoretic construction of the $q$-deformed polyanalytic Fock spaces, their reproducing kernels, and the associated $q$-deformed polyanalytic Bargmann transforms. The associated determinantal point processes provide $q$-deformations of the pure and full polyanalytic Ginibre ensembles. Moreover, we determine their limiting density and establish central limit theorems for the fluctuations of their linear statistics as the number of particles tends to infinity and the deformation parameter $q$ tends to 1 simultaneously. Remarkably, although the $q$-deformation changes the macroscopic density and the size of the droplet, the limiting covariance structures coincide, after spatial rescaling, with those of the classical polyanalytic Ginibre ensembles.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 q-CCR 代数的表示论，构建了 q-形变多解析 Fock 空间及其再生核与 Bargmann 变换的表示论构造，并研究了对应的行列式点过程，推导出宏观密度与随机游走下线性统计量的中心极限定理。关键发现是：尽管 q-形变改变了宏观密度与液滴尺寸，在空间重新标度后，极限协方差结构与经典多解析 Ginibre 系综一致。
AI.motivation: 将经典的纯与全多解析 Ginibre 系综推广到 q-形变情形，并研究该形变对相应行列式点过程极限行为的影响，特别是验证 q-形变是否破坏经典极限协方差结构是一个自然且富有理论意义的问题。
AI.method: 利用 q-CCR 代数的表示论（representation theory）来构造 q-形变的多解析 Fock 空间、再生核（reproducing kernels）以及相应的多解析 Bargmann 变换，并通过行列式点过程（determinantal point processes）刻画相关的系综；随后在粒子数与形变参数 q 同步趋于极限的情形下分析宏观密度与线性统计量的涨落。
AI.result: 所得的确定性点过程提供了纯与全多解析 Ginibre 系综的 q-形变；推导出极限宏观密度，并证明了线性统计量涨落满足的中心极限定理（central limit theorem）。数值上，q-形变改变了宏观密度与液滴（droplet）尺寸，但空间重新标度后极限协方差结构与经典系综完全一致。
AI.conclusion: q-形变对多解析 Ginibre 系综的宏观性质（密度与液滴尺寸）产生显著影响，但其微观涨落的协方差结构对形变保持稳健，暗示了该类系综具有某种普适性（universality）。

title: Effective kinetic theory description of the magnetic field-induced anisotropic gluon pressure during pre-equilibrium in heavy-ion collisions
summary: We develop an effective kinetic description for the interaction of gluons and magnetic fields during the pre-equilibrium stage of relativistic heavy-ion collisions. For this purpose, we formulate the Boltzmann-Vlasov equation with the interaction term modeled by the effect of the magnetic field on the elements of an electrically charged and colored dipole originating from the quantum fluctuation of gluons into quark-antiquark pairs. We find the numerical solution of the collisionless Boltzmann-Vlasov equation with a time-dependent magnetic field profile to determine the time evolution of the directional pressures. The presence of the magnetic field tames the growth of the transverse to longitudinal pressure ratio compared with the case in the absence of the magnetic field; however, the system does not isotropize since collisions are not included. We study the cases of initial gluon distributions with longitudinal anisotropies, as well as the case of an initial isotropic gluon distribution. In both cases, we find that the magnetic field produces a non-monotonic early-time response for large values of the initial magnetic field strength.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种有效动力学描述（effective kinetic description），用于研究相对论重离子碰撞预平衡阶段中胶子（gluon）与磁场（magnetic field）的相互作用，通过求解含时磁场下的无碰撞Boltzmann-Vlasov方程，考察了方向压强的演化，发现磁场抑制了横向与纵向压强比率的增长但系统并未各向同性化。
AI.motivation: 相对论重离子碰撞的预平衡阶段物理尚需深入理解，特别是磁场对电荷粒子和色偶极子（colored dipole）动力学的影响。作者旨在建立胶子与磁场相互作用的动力学框架，以刻画该阶段系统压强各向异性的时间演化。
AI.method: 作者构建了Boltzmann-Vlasov方程，其中的相互作用项通过磁场对带电且带色的偶极子元的影响来建模，该偶极子源于胶子量子涨落为夸克-反夸克对的效应。随后求解含时磁场轮廓下的无碰撞Boltzmann-Vlasov方程的数值解，以确定方向压强的时间演化。研究考虑了具有纵向各向异性的初始胶子分布以及初始各向同性胶子分布两种情况。
AI.result: 磁场的存在抑制了横向与纵向压强比的增长（相较于无磁场情形），但由于未包含碰撞项，系统未实现各向同性化。在两种初始分布条件下，当初始磁场强度较大时，磁场均导致了早期时间的非单调响应。
AI.conclusion: 磁场调节预平衡阶段胶子系统的压强演化和各向异性程度，但单纯依靠碰撞项缺失的动力学无法使系统各向同性化；较大初始磁场强度会引发非单调的早期动力学行为。

title: TARTARUS: A High-Performance Python Code for Ray Tracing in Curved Spacetimes
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Published in Revista eSPECTRA 4(2), 2026. Available at https://espectra.astronomiaoan.co/
summary: The recent observations of the supermassive black holes M87* and Sagittarius A* by the Event Horizon Telescope collaboration (EHT) have shown the need for robust, efficient, and accessible numerical tools to model light propagation in strongly curved spacetimes. Comparing theoretical accretion models with observational data relies heavily on ray-tracing algorithms that calculate the trajectories of photons traveling from a source plasma to a distant observer. In this paper, we present TARTARUS (Tracer for Astrophysical Ray Trajectories Around Relativistic Ultra-compact Sources), a new, highly modular, and extensible Python-based framework for computing null geodesics around compact objects. By leveraging Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation via Numba, TARTARUS bridges the gap between Python's high-level accessibility and the execution speed of compiled languages like C++ or FORTRAN. The code supports multiple native solvers (including adaptive embedded Runge-Kutta pairs, a Bulirsch-Stoer extrapolator, and a Verlet scheme), event-detection mechanics for handling structural intersections (e.g. event horizons and accretion disks), and support for both analytical and numerically generated background metrics. We demonstrate the code's physical accuracy and computational efficiency through some tests, including the evaluation of the Hamiltonian constraint conservation and ray-tracing of the shadow and the Novikov-Thorne thin accretion disks around a Kerr black hole.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 TARTARUS——一个基于 Python 的高度模块化、可扩展的光线追踪（ray-tracing）框架，用于计算紧致天体附近的零测地线（null geodesics）。通过利用 Numba 的即时编译（JIT compilation），该代码在保持 Python 高可访问性的同时实现了接近编译语言的执行速度，并通过物理精度与计算效率测试验证了其性能。
AI.motivation: 事件视界望远镜（EHT）对超大质量黑洞 M87* 和人马座 A*（Sagittarius A*）的观测揭示了在强弯曲时空中模拟光传播需要稳健、高效且易用的数值工具。理论吸积模型与观测数据的比较高度依赖光线追踪算法，而现有工具在可访问性和计算性能之间存在差距。
AI.method: TARTARUS 通过 Numba 实现 Just-In-Time（JIT）编译，弥补了 Python 高层次可访问性与 C++/FORTRAN 等编译语言执行速度之间的鸿沟。代码支持多种原生求解器（自适应嵌入 Runge-Kutta 对、Bulirsch-Stoer 外推器和 Verlet 格式）、结构交会检测机制（如事件视界和吸积盘），并支持解析和数值生成的背景度规（background metrics）。
AI.result: 通过若干测试验证了代码的物理精度与计算效率，包括哈密顿约束守恒（Hamiltonian constraint conservation）的评估，以及在 Kerr 黑洞周围对黑洞阴影和 Novikov-Thorne 薄吸积盘进行光线追踪的结果。
AI.conclusion: TARTARUS 作为一个高度模块化、可扩展且高效的 Python 光线追踪框架，能够为强引力场下的理论吸积模型与 EHT 观测数据的对比提供可靠的计算支持。

title: Effect of non-homogeneous non-magnetic Impurities in Superconductors: A comparison between Microscopic and Macroscopic theories
summary: Non-homogeneous, non-magnetic impurities in superconductivity have recently gained traction as a promising approach to reduce surface resistance and increase the superheating field. We aim to deepen the understanding of impurities' role from a theoretical perspective by utilizing Eilenberger's equation, and to investigate the validity of a more phenomenological approach based on London's equation for determining the magnetic field profile within the superconductor. We show that the microscopic and macroscopic theories produce identical electromagnetic field distributions for any spatial distributions of impurities inside the superconductors. However, the two approaches provide different magnetic field-related quantities. The macroscopic model only gives the Bean-Livingston barrier, while the microscopic theory provides the experimentally-relevant superheating field. Based on the microscopic formalism, we determine a family of impurity profiles that make the superheating field $H_{\rm{sh}}$ equal to the critical field $H_c$, which is the maximum achievable.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了超导体中非均匀非磁性杂质的作用，比较了基于Eilenberger方程的微观方法与基于London方程的唯象方法，发现两种方法在电磁场分布上给出相同结果，但其磁相关物理量不同；微观理论进一步确定了使超热场（superheating field）达到临界场最大值的杂质分布族。
AI.motivation: 超导中非均匀非磁性杂质近年来被视为降低表面电阻并提升超热场（superheating field）的有前景途径，但其理论机制尚需深入理解。
AI.method: 利用Eilenberger方程（Eilenberger's equation）进行微观描述，并将其与基于London方程（London's equation）的唯象方法进行对比，考察超导体内部磁场分布及相关物理量的差异。
AI.result: 微观理论与宏观理论对超导体内部任意杂质空间分布均给出完全一致的电磁场分布；但在磁场相关物理量上两者存在分歧——宏观模型僅给出Bean-Livingston势垒，微观理论则提供实验上相关的超热场。基于微观形式，确定了使超热场H_sh等于临界场H_c（理论上可达到的最大值）的一族杂质分布。
AI.conclusion: 微观Eilenberger方法较唯象London方法更完善，能给出实验中可观测的超热场；通过对杂质分布的优化设计，理论上可使超热场达到临界场的最大值，为提升超导性能提供了理论依据。

title: A purely mechanical system realizing a Coulomb-like interaction
summary: We solve in closed form a one-dimensional relativistic system: two masses interacting only through elastic collisions with a massless mediator bouncing between them. Momenta, times, and positions are hyperbolic functions of the collision index. The mediator energy, interpreted as the pair's effective potential, obeys an exact discrete Coulomb law, $V\propto 1/r$, with a Lorentz-invariant action as coupling. A massive Newtonian mediator instead transmits a $1/r^{3}$ force; one adiabatic invariant traces both laws to the mediator's dispersion relation. Continued to negative mediator energy, the closed forms turn trigonometric, binding a one-dimensional mechanical analog of the Coulomb atom.

AI.tldr: 一维相对论碰撞系统以解析闭式求解，无质量中介给出离散库仑 1/r 力律，质量中介给出 1/r³ 力律，绝热不变量将二者统一在色散关系下；继续外推可得到库仑原子的力学类比。
AI.motivation: 旨在研究一维相对论系统中介导碰撞相互作用的闭式可解模型，理解不同质量性质的中介粒子所传递的力律，并为库仑作用的一维力学类比提供解析基础。
AI.method: 采用解析闭式求解方法，将无质量中介粒子来回碰撞的弹道运动参数化为碰撞序号的函数，推导出双曲函数形式的解；对有质量中介（牛顿型）情形进行对照分析，并通过绝热不变量（adiabatic invariant）建立两种力律与中介色散关系（dispersion relation）之间的联系。
AI.result: 无质量中介情形下中介能量满足精确的离散库仑定律 V∝1/r，耦合为洛伦兹不变作用量；有质量（牛顿型）中介则传递 1/r³ 力；将中介能量续延（continuation）至负值时，闭式解由双曲转为三角形式，从而束缚出一维库仑原子的力学类比。
AI.conclusion: 该可解模型揭示了中介粒子色散关系与所传递力律之间的深层联系，并提供了一个一维相对论库仑束缚态的力学类比，为相关量子或多体推广提供了可解析参照。

title: Second-order Teukolsky calculations for nonspinning, quasicircular binaries
summary: Currently, the only second-order gravitational self-force calculations have been based on directly solving the perturbative Einstein equations in the Lorenz gauge. That method relied on the complete separability of the Einstein equations in a Schwarzschild background. In this paper, we present a new scheme based on the second-order Teukolsky equation. Crucially, this method promises to extend (reasonably straightforwardly) to the more realistic case of a Kerr background. Here we implement the scheme in the simplest setting of quasicircular orbits around a Schwarzschild black hole. In addition to working with the Teukolsky equation, our scheme incorporates several other advances over previous second-order self-force calculations: compactified hyperboloidal slicing, transformation to a Bondi-Sachs gauge, and a combination of spectral and variation-of-parameters methods. We also use these tools to re-examine the infrared divergences that arise in second-order Lorenz-gauge calculations, showing they are less pronounced in the Teukolsky case and completely eliminated in the Bondi-Sachs gauge. We conclude by calculating the asymptotic energy fluxes and benchmarking them against previous Lorenz-gauge calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于二阶Teukolsky方程的新方案来计算引力自作用力（gravitational self-force），该方案有望扩展到更实际的Kerr背景，并在Schwarzschild黑洞的准圆轨道上实现了该方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的唯一二阶引力自作用力计算依赖于在Lorenz规范（Lorenz gauge）下直接求解微扰Einstein方程，该方法依赖Einstein方程在Schwarzschild背景上的完全可分离性，难以推广到更实际的Kerr背景。因此需要发展新方法。
AI.method: 该方案基于二阶Teukolsky方程，并整合了多项技术改进：紧致化类光超曲面切片（compactified hyperboloidal slicing）、转换到Bondi-Sachs规范（Bondi-Sachs gauge），以及谱方法与参数变易法（variation-of-parameters）的结合。方案在Schwarzschild黑洞周围的准圆轨道（quasicircular orbits）这一最简单情形下实现。
AI.result: 研究重新检验了二阶Lorenz规范计算中出现的红外发散（infrared divergences），发现它们在Teukolsky情形中较弱，且在Bondi-Sachs规范下被完全消除。最后计算了渐近能量通量（asymptotic energy fluxes），并与先前的Lorenz规范计算结果进行了基准对比。
AI.conclusion: 该Teukolsky-based方案提供了超越现有Lorenz规范计算的新途径，不仅有望较直接地扩展到Kerr背景这一更现实的情形，而且在处理红外发散和规范选择方面展现出显著优势。

title: Magnetization processes and spin dynamics across field-induced phase transitions in the quasi-two-dimensional quantum magnet Cu$_2$(OH)$_3$Br
summary: We present magnetic-field-dependent evolution of magnetization and spin dynamics in the quasi-two-dimensional spin-$1/2$ magnet $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_3Br}$, consisting of alternately coupled ferromagnetic Cu1 and antiferromagnetic Cu2 spin chains. Terahertz spectroscopy reveals a pronounced field-direction dependence of the low-energy magnetic excitation spectrum. For magnetic fields applied perpendicular to the spin chains, $B\parallel a$ and $B\parallel c^*$, the spectra undergo abrupt reconstructions at the spin-flop transitions identified independently by high-field magnetization measurements. For $B\parallel b$, by contrast, no spin-flop occurs; instead, the excitation spectrum evolves continuously with field and exhibits a strong terahertz radiation polarization dependence as the ferromagnetic Cu1 subsystem becomes progressively polarized. At higher fields, the complex low-field spectrum is replaced by a reduced set of broad excitations, consistent with a weakening of the coupling between the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic chain subsystems. Complementary Raman spectroscopy resolves magnon and spinon excitations alongside several phonon modes and traces the characteristic temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent evolution of the magnetic excitations. The combined spectroscopic and magnetization results map out how a magnetic field reorganizes the coupled ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic subsystems in $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_3Br}$ across field-induced phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过太赫兹光谱、拉曼光谱和高场磁化测量，系统研究了准二维自旋1/2磁体Cu₂(OH)₃Br在外加磁场下的磁化演化与自旋动力学，揭示了磁场方向依赖性极强的低能磁激发谱重构，以及铁磁与反铁磁自旋链子系统间的耦合随场减弱的过程。
AI.motivation: 了解耦合的铁磁与反铁磁自旋链子系统在磁场下的重组行为是理解准二维量子磁体的关键，但此前对Cu₂(OH)₃Br这类同时包含铁磁（Cu1）和反铁磁（Cu2）交替自旋链的体系中磁场诱导相变的微观机制缺乏系统的光谱学认识。
AI.method: 结合太赫兹光谱（terahertz spectroscopy）、拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）与高场磁化测量，对Cu₂(OH)₃Br在沿不同晶轴方向（B∥a、B∥c*、B∥b）施加磁场时的低能磁激发谱和磁化强度演化进行了系统的场向依赖研究。
AI.result: 当磁场垂直于自旋链（B∥a和B∥c*）时，光谱在自旋翻转（spin-flop）跃迁处发生突变性重构；当B∥b时无自旋翻转，而是随铁磁Cu1子系统的逐步极化呈现连续演化并表现出显著的太赫兹辐射偏振依赖性。更高场下低场复杂光谱被简化的宽激发取代，表明铁磁与反铁磁链子系统间耦合减弱。拉曼光谱同时解析出磁振子（magnon）和自旋子（spinon）激发及多个声子模式。
AI.conclusion: 综合光谱与磁化测量结果，揭示了磁场如何通过场致相变在Cu₂(OH)₃Br中重塑耦合的铁磁与反铁磁子系统的整体图景，阐明了各磁场方向下相变与激发谱重构的对应关系。

title: Models for dagger $(\infty,1)$-categories II: Dagger complete Segal spaces and the Joyal--Tierney equivalence
summary: Building on the dagger Bergner and dagger Joyal models constructed in Part I, we develop simplicial-space models for dagger $(\infty,1)$-categories. We first construct a homotopically constant resolution model and a model structure for unitarily complete dagger Segal spaces. A change-of-index adjunction compares the two presentations of dagger simplicial spaces. We then prove a dagger analogue of the Joyal--Tierney Quillen equivalence. Together with Part I, these results give a chain of Quillen equivalences between the dagger Bergner, dagger Joyal, and dagger Rezk models.

AI.tldr: 本文在第一部分构建的 dagger Bergner 与 dagger Joyal 模型基础上，为 dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴建立了单纯空间（simplicial space）模型，包括一个同伦常数化解模型和单位完全 dagger Segal 空间上的模型结构，并通过指标变换伴随比较两种单纯空间表示，最终证明了 Joyal–Tierney Quillen 等价的 dagger 版本，从而在 dagger Bergner、dagger Joyal 与 dagger Rezk 模型之间建立了 Quillen 等价链。
AI.motivation: 在 dagger 范畴（dagger category）的高阶推广中，已有的 dagger Bergner 和 dagger Joyal 模型仅覆盖了特定视角，尚未建立 dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴的单纯空间（simplicial space）描述；本文旨在填补这一空白，提供 dagger Rezk 风格的模型并统一各种模型结构。
AI.method: 本文首先构造一个同伦常数化解（homotopically constant resolution）模型，并在单位完全 dagger Segal 空间（unitarily complete dagger Segal spaces）上建立模型结构；随后利用指标变换伴随（change-of-index adjunction）比较 dagger 单纯空间（dagger simplicial spaces）的两种表示；最后证明 Joyal–Tierney Quillen 等价的 dagger 版本。
AI.result: 成功建立了 dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴的单纯空间模型，并将其与第一部分所构建的 dagger Bergner 和 dagger Joyal 模型串联，形成一个由 Quillen 等价构成的链条，连接 dagger Bergner、dagger Joyal 与 dagger Rezk 三个模型。
AI.conclusion: 结合本文与第一部分的成果，dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴的多种（Bergner、Joyal、Rezk）模型在 Quillen 等价意义下是等价的，从而确立了同一高阶范畴结构的不同模型间的一致性。

title: Quantum geometric signatures in neutrino dynamics around a holonomy black hole
comment: 20 pages in a two-column format and 13 figures. Comments and suggestions (regarding its content and references) are welcome
summary: We investigate three flavor neutrino phenomena in an effective holonomy corrected Schwarzschild geometry. We derive the weak-deflection angle through second post-Minkowskian order, obtain the semiclassical phases along radial and nonradial trajectories, and formulate the two-image flavor probability by including magnifications, Fermat phases, and wave packet overlap. The cross path phase acquires a logarithmic holonomy contribution and can retain information about the absolute neutrino mass scale. We also characterize flavor mode correlations and trajectory-flavor entanglement through the balance among path predictability, interference visibility, and I-concurrence. Neutrino-antineutrino annihilation outside an effective neutrinosphere is examined, with holonomy entering the integrated power through the radial proper volume measure. For a solar mass lens and $10\,\mathrm{MeV}$ neutrinos, the numerical results show displaced oscillation fringes and a geometry dependent redistribution among the electron, muon, and tau channels. The electron-neutrino trajectory-flavor concurrence reaches approximately $0.23$, with an entropy near $0.10$ bit, while remaining weakly sensitive to the mass ordering in the selected configuration. By contrast, the annihilation power increases monotonically, reaching an increase of approximately $39.3\%$ relative to Schwarzschild spacetime (for a particular configuration, i.e., $λ=2$ and $M/R_ν=1/3$). Furthermore, at fixed source parameters and $M/R_ν=1/3$, an assumed maximum excess of $10\%$ in the integrated annihilation power relative to Schwarzschild yields the conditional bounds $a/(2M)\leq0.2879$ and $|λ|\leq0.6358$.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个有效的全息修正（holonomy-corrected）史瓦西几何中研究三味中微子现象，推导了弱偏转角、半经典相位和双像中微子味道概率，并考察了中微子-反中微子湮灭功率及其对全息参数和量子引力（quantum gravity）参数的约束。
AI.motivation: 研究量子引力效应对中微子传播和味道振荡的影响，探索全息修正几何中可观测的中微子信号。
AI.method: 在有效全息修正史瓦西度规中，推导至第二后闵可夫斯基（post-Minkowskian）阶的弱偏转角，求解径向与非径向轨迹的半经典相位，并纳入放大率、费马相位和波包重叠来构造双像味道概率。
AI.result: 交叉路径相位获得对数型全息贡献，可保留绝对中微子质量标度信息。对太阳质量透镜和10 MeV中微子，数值结果呈位移振荡条纹及味道通道间几何依赖的再分配；电子中微子轨迹-味道并发（concurrence）约0.23、熵约0.10 bit。湮灭功率相对史瓦西时空增加约39.3%（λ=2, M/Rν=1/3），并给出a/(2M)≤0.2879与|λ|≤0.6358的条件约束。
AI.conclusion: 全息修正几何为中微子味道振荡和湮灭过程提供了可区分的量子引力印记，为未来利用中微子天文学约束圈量子引力参数提供可能性。

title: Exploring causal relationships in elastomeric fracture
summary: The conventional interpretation of elastomeric fracture treats the tearing energy G as an output determined by tear speed, taken to equal crack velocity vc, concluding that higher vc produced greater viscoelastic dissipation to increase G. Based on spatially and temporally resolved polarized optical microscopic (str-POM) measurements of tip stress tip stress, we use prenotched pure shear experiments to clarify the causality: Local crack-tip stress determines the network lifetime, making vc the passive kinetic output. In the elastic limit that can be readily achieved for a well crosslinked elastomer in a wide range of temperatures, Rivlin-Thomas scaling holds, and vc depends only on the applied strain, independent of stretch rate, indicating one-to-one correspondence between vc and tip stress. In a highly stretchable elastomer made with reduced crosslink density, vc no longer correlates well with the far-field load as rate-dependent viscoelastic processes emerge to affect network lifetime. Because of the rheological effects on how chain tension builds in the elastomeric network, vc is higher at a common nominal strain when it is imposed with higher stretch rate. confirm that different stretch rates produce different levels of tip stress. The same tip stress still produces the same vc. With str-POM measurements we are also able to elucidate the nature of temperature dependence: at a given tip stress,, crack growth is slower at lower temperatures; conversely it requires higher tip stress to produce the same vc at lower temperatures.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过时空分辨偏振光学显微术（spatio-temporally resolved polarized optical microscopy, str-POM）对预切口纯剪切实验中弹性体裂纹尖端应力进行测量，揭示撕裂能量（tearing energy, G）与裂纹速度（crack velocity, vc）之间的因果关系：局部尖端应力决定网络寿命，vc为被动的动力学输出，而非传统理解中的决定性输入变量。
AI.motivation: 传统弹性体断裂理论将撕裂能量G视为由撕裂速度（即裂纹速度vc）决定的输出量，认为更高的vc会产生更大的黏弹性耗散从而增大G。本文旨在通过尖端应力的直接测量，厘清尖端应力、网络寿命与vc之间的因果关系，质疑并修正这一传统理解。
AI.method: 采用预切口纯剪切实验结合时空分辨偏振光学显微术（str-POM）对裂纹尖端应力进行空间和时间分辨的原位测量。通过调节交联密度和温度，分别在弹性极限与高延伸性体系条件下系统考察尖端应力、施加应变、拉伸速率与vc之间的关系。
AI.result: 结果发现：在广泛温度范围内，良好交联的弹性体可在弹性极限下遵守Rivlin-Thomas标度关系，vc仅取决于施加应变而与拉伸速率无关，表明vc与尖端应力存在一一对应关系；而在低交联密度的高延伸性弹性体中，速率依赖的黏弹性过程会影响网络寿命，导致同一标称应变下较高拉伸速率产生较高vc，但相同的尖端应力仍然对应相同的vc；温度依赖性方面，同一尖端应力下低温使裂纹增长更慢，低温下需要更高的尖端应力才能产生相同的vc。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了裂纹尖端局部应力作为主因、vc作为被动输出的因果框架，揭示了网络链张力构建方式（受流变学影响）如何调节vc与标称应变的对应关系，并通过流变学（rheology）视角解释了vc的温度依赖性。

title: Trace-class spectra of irreducible Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups
summary: We determine the spectrum of the predual generator of an irreducible Gaussian quantum Markov semigroup on the trace-class operators over a finite-mode bosonic Fock space in the stable, strictly unstable, and periodic critical drift regimes. For stable drift, irreducibility is equivalent to the existence of a unique faithful normal invariant state. The spectrum and approximate point spectrum are the closed left half-plane, whereas the point spectrum is the open left half-plane together with zero. Thus the polynomial eigenvalues generated by the drift matrix do not exhaust the trace-class point spectrum. If the drift has an eigenvalue with strictly positive real part, the spectrum is again the closed left half-plane, but the point spectrum is empty and the open left half-plane together with zero belongs to the residual spectrum. For periodic critical drift, we obtain an explicit spectral formula that includes the displacement parameter and yields horizontal half-lines or parabolic regions. The proofs use characteristic functions, Gaussian diffusion semigroups, and bounded eigenoperators of the dual semigroup. The nonperiodic critical drift case remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了有限模玻色子福克空间（bosonic Fock space）上不可约高斯量子马尔可夫半群（Gaussian quantum Markov semigroup）的前对偶生成元在稳定、严格不稳定及周期临界漂移三种条件下的谱结构，得到了显式谱公式与谱分类结果。
AI.motivation: 量子马尔可夫半群的谱性质是理解其收敛行为和时间渐近态的关键。高斯量子马尔可夫半群作为一类重要的无穷维量子动力学系统，其前对偶生成元的谱尚未在不可约情形下得到完整刻画，本研究旨在系统化地确定不同漂移区域下的谱结构。
AI.method: 采用特征函数（characteristic functions）方法、高斯扩散半群（Gaussian diffusion semigroups）理论以及对偶半群的有界特征算子（bounded eigenoperators）分析，分别处理稳定、严格不稳定和周期临界漂移三种情形下的谱问题。
AI.result: 稳定漂移情形下，不可约性等价于存在唯一的忠实正规不变态；谱和近似点谱为闭左半平面，而点谱为开左半平面加零点，漂移矩阵生成的多项式特征值并未穷尽迹类点谱。当漂移具有正实部特征值时，谱仍为闭左半平面，但点谱为空，开左半平面加零点属于剩余谱。周期临界漂移下得到包含位移参数的显式谱公式，产生水平半直线或抛物型区域。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了稳定、严格不稳定和周期临界漂移三种情形下高斯量子马尔可夫半群前对偶生成元的谱；非周期临界漂移情形仍悬而未决。

title: Breaking binary formation mechanism degeneracies with gravitational wave clustering
summary: Thanks to the almost 400 gravitational wave events detected, we are currently able to grasp the fundamental features of black hole mass, spin, and distance distributions. However, such a fast increase in the precision of the measurements does not necessarily correspond to a better theoretical understanding of gravitational wave sources, especially in current scenarios where the number of free parameters is significantly larger than the number of inferred properties of the black hole population. In this work, we showcase how the landscape of theoretical models can be chipped away by complementary data-analysis strategies, in particular by studying the statistical properties of gravitational wave anisotropic distribution. Specifically, we show how gravitational wave clustering is sensitive to two unique features of each binary formation mechanism: the time-delay distribution and the properties of the binary hosts. First, we consider a model-agnostic scenario and show the impact that different time-delay distributions have on the gravitational wave bias. Then, we consider a realistic scenario where gravitational wave events are sourced either by isolated binary evolution or dynamical processes in globular clusters, and study how the gravitational wave bias is unique sensitive to the specific properties of the environment. In both scenarios, we show how the cross-correlation between galaxy and gravitational wave catalogs is able to distinguish between models with different time delays or with different binary sub-populations originated in specific formation channels.

AI.tldr: 本文利用近400个引力波（gravitational wave）事件，通过分析引力波各向异性分布的统计特性及其与星系目录的互相关（cross-correlation），展示如何区分不同的双星形成机制（含不同时延分布和宿主环境），从而在理论模型参数过多的情况下筛选可行的天体物理模型。
AI.motivation: 尽管引力波事件探测数目快速增长，测量精度提升并不自动带来对引力波源理论理解的深入，尤其在当前自由参数数量远多于黑洞群体推断属性的理论场景下，亟需补充性数据分析策略来筛选理论模型空间。
AI.method: 研究引力波聚簇（clustering）对双星形成机制两个独特特征的敏感性：时延分布（time-delay distribution）与双星宿主性质。首先在模型无关（model-agnostic）场景中考察不同时延分布对引力波偏置（gravitational wave bias）的影响；随后在现实场景中，区分孤立双星演化（isolated binary evolution）与球状星团（globular cluster）内动力学过程两类源，研究引力波偏置对环境特性的唯一敏感性。两种场景下均采用星系与引力波目录的互相关作为判别工具。
AI.result: 研究发现引力波聚簇对双星形成机制的时延分布与宿主环境属性具有独特敏感性。在模型无关和现实两种场景下，星系与引力波目录的互相关分析均能够区分具有不同时延的模型，以及区分源自特定形成通道的不同双星子群体。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性统计分析可作为系统性剔除理论模型的互补工具，帮助在参数空间过大的情形下缩小理论模型的地景（landscape），为引力波源形成机制的识别提供新的观测途径。

title: Chemical and interface confinement effects in promoting plastic co-deformation in high-strength nano-scale eutectics
summary: Eutectics offer a route to overcome plastic incompatibility in disparate-phase heterostructures by coupling microstructural refinement with phase-specific chemical and crystallographic hierarchy. Here, we investigate laser-rapid-solidified Al-(Si,Ge) eutectic composites designed along the univariant ternary eutectic path, solidifying with an Al-rich face-centered cubic (fcc) matrix and (Si,Ge)-rich diamond-cubic (dc) fibers as constituent eutectic phases with faceted interfaces. The microstructure was hierarchical in nature with finer structures within eutectic phases: nanoscale (Si,Ge) clusters in the Al phase and growth twins within the (Si,Ge) fibers with some Al retention. Although increasing Ge content coarsens the eutectic spacing, the yield strength is slightly enhanced compared to the relatively finer Al-Si, and tensile ductility of Al-(Si,Ge) is higher than that of Al-Si. In situ SEM micromechanical testing combined with post-mortem STEM and TEM showed that in the Al-rich phase, Ge segregated to the deformation-induced sub-grain boundaries that confined glide dislocations. Simultaneously, the (Si,Ge)-rich fibers remain crack-resistant at large plastic strain and exhibit deformation-induced planar faults, consistent with localized partial-dislocation activity at highly stressed interfaces and twin boundaries. These coupled mechanisms due to interface confinement and hard phase chemistry enable co-deformation of the metallic and covalent phases, providing a pathway for designing high-tensile-strength and ductile hierarchical eutectics beyond conventional length-scale-controlled strengthening.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过激光快速凝固沿单变三元共晶路径设计了Al-(Si,Ge)共晶复合材料，该材料具有Al基体与(Si,Ge)纤维相的分层微观结构，Ge的加入使层间距粗化但轻微提升了屈服强度并改善了延展性，其内在机制涉及Al相中Ge偏析对位错运动的限制以及(Si,Ge)相在界面和孪晶边界处的局域部分位错活动，实现了金属相与共价相的共同变形。
AI.motivation: 不同相之间的塑性不相容性（plastic incompatibility）是异质结构材料的一大挑战，共晶结构通过微观组织细化与相特异性的化学和晶体学层级耦合提供了一条解决途径。作者旨在探索利用三元共晶路径设计可同时获得高强度和高延展性的分层共晶复合材料。
AI.method: 采用激光快速凝固技术沿单变三元共晶路径制备Al-(Si,Ge)共晶复合材料，其由富含Al的面心立方（face-centered cubic, fcc）基体和富含(Si,Ge)的金刚石立方（diamond-cubic, dc）纤维组成，具有小平面化界面。采用原位SEM微力学测试结合事后STEM与TEM表征，分析了变形过程中的微观机制。
