AI.result: 微观结构呈层级特征：Al相中含有纳米尺度(Si,Ge)团簇，(Si,Ge)纤维内存在生长孪晶并保留少量Al。增加Ge含量使共晶间距粗化，但屈服强度相比Al-Si略有提高，且Al-(Si,Ge)的拉伸延展性优于Al-Si。机制分析表明，Al相中Ge偏析至变形诱导的亚晶界并限制滑移位错；(Si,Ge)富集纤维在大塑性应变下保持抗裂性，出现变形诱导平面层错，与高度应力化界面和孪晶边界的局域部分位错活动一致。
AI.conclusion: 界面约束与硬质相化学协同作用使金属相与共价相能够共同变形，为超越传统尺度控制强化路线设计高强度、高延展性的分层共晶材料提供了新途径。

title: Equivalence of Fixed-Rank and Rank-One Even-Order Symmetric Tensor Factorization
summary: In the recent work of Barbier, Ko, and the second present author on sublinear-rank symmetric matrix factorization [Math. Stat. Learn. 9 (2026), 1-68], a key result is that, in the Bayes-optimal setting, the large-size limit of the free entropy of the finite-rank spiked Wigner model is the same as in the rank-one case when the signal has centered i.i.d. entries. In this paper, we show that this rank-one equivalence result extends to the case of finite-rank, even-order, symmetric tensor factorization. Moreover, we give a natural reformulation of a hypothesis that was stated in the aforementioned work to be necessary for this result. As in the matrix case, we use information-theoretic identities and replica symmetry to reduce a known multi-dimensional variational formula for the limiting free entropy to its one-dimensional analog. The novelty stems from the fact that said formula involves a replica symmetric potential containing Hadamard (entrywise) powers, rather than squares, of the matrix-valued variational parameter, so the eigenvalue-based approach used in the matrix case must be adjusted.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在贝叶斯最优（Bayes-optimal）设定下，有限秩、偶阶对称张量分解的大规模极限自由熵与秩一情形相同，从而将此前在有限秩对称矩阵分解中建立的秩一等价（rank-one equivalence）结果推广至张量情形。
AI.motivation: Barbier, Ko 及第二作者此前的工作在子线性秩对称矩阵分解中证明了秩一等价结果。本文的目标是将该结果推广至有限秩、偶阶对称张量分解，并对原工作中作为必要条件的假设给出自然的重述。
AI.method: 沿用矩阵情形的信息论恒等式与复制对称（replica symmetry）方法，将已知的多维变分公式约化为一维对应公式。由于该公式中的复制对称势包含变分参数的 Hadamard（逐元素）幂而非平方，需对原矩阵情形中基于特征值的方法进行调整。
AI.result: 展示了秩一等价结果在有限秩偶阶对称张量分解情形下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 秩一等价现象不仅限于矩阵情形，也适用于更一般的对称张量分解，提示该结构可能具有更广泛的普适性。

title: NRHJSur3dq8: a spectral numerical-relativity surrogate family for non-eccentric aligned-spin binary-black-hole waveforms
summary: We present NRHJSur3dq8, a family of numerical-relativity (NR) surrogates for non-eccentric aligned-spin binary-black-hole waveforms inspired by an action-angle parameterization. The model provides both the dynamics: the Hamiltonian values, azimuthal action $J_φ(Φ)$, the orbital clock $τ(Φ)$ as functions of its phasing, and the radiative pieces: the waveforms, their near-analytic derivatives, and modeling errors associated with each. The surrogated variables are conditioned into pieces that vary slowly on the radiation-reaction timescale, represented on shared $hp$-adaptive Chebyshev elements, and regressed across the intrinsic parameters with a Gaussian-process model. A time-parameterized merger-ringdown set of elements is attached where the adiabatic description breaks down. Leave-one-out validation of the central NRHJSur3dq8_AA flavor against NR reaches a $(2,2)$ unweighted mismatch of $1.3^{+32}_{-1.2}\times10^{-6}$ and an all-mode mismatch of $2.3^{+59}_{-2.2}\times10^{-6}$ over the full inspiral-merger-ringdown span. Sky-averaged and SNR-weighted over $32$ orientations per simulation, the released model's full-IMR in-sample mismatch against the NR simulations used for training is $8.9\times10^{-7}$ to $2.8\times10^{-5}$ across total masses $40$-$120\,M_\odot$. Waveforms are hybridized using post-Newtonian waveforms. Beyond accuracy, NRHJSur3dq8 provides two capabilities uncommon in NR surrogates: nearly analytic derivatives of the strain with respect to the physical parameters, and a calibrated Gaussian-process predictive uncertainty of the model. A full non-hybridized inspiral-merger-ringdown waveform evaluates in $12$ ms on a single CPU call. Batched evaluation amortizes this to $0.39$ ms per waveform at a batch of $4096$, measured at a starting frequency of $20$ Hz.

AI.tldr: NRHJSur3dq8 是一族基于作用-角参数化（action-angle parameterization）的数值相对论（numerical-relativity, NR）替代模型，用于非偏心对准自旋双黑洞（binary black hole）波形的快速且高精度生成。模型同时输出动力学量（Hamiltonian值、方位作用$J_\phi(\Phi)$、轨道时钟$\tau(\Phi)$）和辐射量（波形及近解析导数与建模误差），在全爆发-合并-振铃（inspiral-merger-ringdown, IMR）范围内达到约$10^{-6}$量级的失配（mismatch），单次CPU调用12毫秒内即可评估一个完整波形。
AI.motivation: 数值相对论模拟计算成本高昂，难以直接用于参数估计与大规模模板库构建。现有替代模型通常缺乏解析导数和对模型不确定性的量化，因此需要一种兼具高精度、高效率及额外分析能力（导数与不确定性）的波形替代方案。
AI.method: 基于作用-角参数化构造替代变量，将依赖于辐射反应时标的量（Hamiltonian值、方位作用、轨道时钟）在共享的自适应hp-Chebyshev单元上表示，并用高斯过程（Gaussian-process）模型对内在参数进行回归。在绝热描述失效处附加时间参数化的合并-振铃（merger-ringdown）单元片段，波形通过后牛顿（post-Newtonian）波形进行混合（hybridization），由此构建NRHJSur3dq8族替代模型。
AI.result: 中心版本NRHJSur3dq8_AA通过留一法验证（leave-one-out validation）达到$(2,2)$非加权失配$1.3^{+32}_{-1.2}\times10^{-6}$和全模式失配$2.3^{+59}_{-2.2}\times10^{-6}$。对训练用NR模拟样本，天空平均与信噪比加权后在$40$–$120\,M_\odot$总质量范围内全IMR失配为$8.9\times10^{-7}$至$2.8\times10^{-5}$。单个完整IMR波形评估耗时12 ms，批量4096时的摊销代价仅为每波形0.39 ms（起始频率20 Hz）。
AI.conclusion: NRHJSur3dq8在保持高度准确性的同时，提供了应变对各物理参数近解析导数及经校准的高斯过程预测不确定性这两项NR替代模型中罕见的能力，为引力波数据分析和参数估计提供了兼具精度、速度与分析深度的波形生成工具。

title: First Principles Thermodynamics of Zr B Segregation at Grain Boundaries in Recycled Nd2Fe14B
summary: Grain-boundary chemistry is central to the coercivity and thermal stability of Nd2Fe14B permanent magnets, particularly in recycled magnets where recovery of the hard-magnetic phase does not by itself restore the intergranular microstructure. Our recent experimental study showed that nanoscale ZrB2 precipitates can emerge at grain boundaries and triple junctions during recycling despite an overall Zr concentration of only about 0.1 at.%, where they are associated with boundary stabilization and suppression of grain coarsening. Here we use spin-polarized density-functional theory with a Hubbard correction (DFT+U) to determine the atomistic thermodynamics underlying this preferential localization. A systematic set of composition-matched bulk/grain-boundary DFT+U supercells provides a common correlated-electron description across boundary chemistries. We compare B, Zr, Dy, and ZrB2-like local configurations in bulk and grain-boundary environments of Nd2Fe14B. Excess B is strongly stabilized at the boundary, while Zr also shows an independent thermodynamic preference for the interfacial region. When Zr and B are combined in a ZrB2-like configuration, the boundary preference is retained, indicating that the interface remains favorable as Zr-B coordination develops. These results establish a thermodynamic pathway for the co-localization of Zr and B prior to ZrB2 formation. Magnetic-state analysis further shows that all compared structures remain within the same high-moment Fe-sublattice regime, and boundary-localized defects generally perturb the normalized magnetization less than their matrix counterparts. The calculations therefore provide a first-principles explanation for why Zr-B chemistry concentrates at intergranular regions and how such boundary-localized states can support the microstructural stability required for high-coercivity recycled Nd-Fe-B magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用自旋极化密度泛函理论加Hubbard修正（DFT+U）计算方法，系统研究了Nd2Fe14B永磁材料中Zr和B在晶界中的热力学偏好性，揭示了ZrB2在晶界和三相节点优先析出的第一性原理热力学机制，为回收Nd-Fe-B磁体的高矫顽力微观结构稳定性提供了理论解释。
AI.motivation: 晶界化学对Nd2Fe14B永磁体的矫顽力和热稳定性至关重要，尤其在回收磁体中，恢复硬磁相本身并不能重建晶间微观结构；尽管整体Zr浓度仅约0.1 at.%，纳米级ZrB2析出物仍可在回收过程中于晶界和三相节点出现并与边界稳定化和抑制晶粒粗化相关，但其优先局域的原子尺度热力学机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用自旋极化DFT+U方法构建成分匹配的整体/晶界超胞模型，提供跨边界化学环境的统一关联电子描述；系统比较B、Zr、Dy及类ZrB2局域构型在Nd2Fe14B整体和晶界环境中的热力学行为，并结合磁性状态分析评估各结构对Fe亚晶格磁矩和归一化磁化强度的扰动。
AI.result: 多余B在晶界中显著稳定化，Zr在界面区也表现出独立的热力学偏好；当Zr与B以ZrB2类构型组合时，边界偏好依然保持，表明界面对Zr-B配位的发展始终有利；所有比较结构均处于相同的高磁矩Fe亚晶格格区，且边界局域缺陷对归一化磁化强度的扰动普遍小于其在基体中的对应缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 计算结果建立了Zr和B在ZrB2形成之前共局域于界面的热力学路径，从第一性原理角度解释了Zr-B化学为何集中于晶间区域，并表明这类边界局域态能够支撑高矫顽力回收Nd-Fe-B磁体所需的微观结构稳定性。

title: Bott connection in the mapping cone case
summary: We generalize the concept of Bott connection to the de Rham mapping cone situation. As the main results, when the given closed smooth manifold is foliated, we have the mapping cone version of the Bott vanishing theorem and an adiabatic limit of a family of mapping cone connections on the orthogonal complement of the foliation. The second result shows the necessity of a refined metric if we want to see more interactions between geometry and topology in the mapping cone situation.

AI.tldr: 本文将Bott连接（Bott connection）的概念推广到de Rham映射锥（de Rham mapping cone）情形，在给定光滑闭流形（closed smooth manifold）被叶状化（foliated）时，证明了映射锥版本的Bott消没定理（Bott vanishing theorem），并通过一族映射锥连接在叶状结构正交补上的绝热极限（adiabatic limit）揭示了精化度量（refined metric）在此框架下的必要性。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在将经典的Bott连接及其相关几何拓扑结果推广到更一般的de Rham映射锥框架中，探索在该新框架下几何与拓扑之间的深层相互作用。
AI.method: 方法上，作者将Bott连接的概念推广至de Rham映射锥结构，并利用叶状化流形上的映射锥连接族，通过绝热极限分析与其相关的不变量和几何性质。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 映射锥版本的Bott消没定理，即Bott连接消没性质在映射锥框架下的对应结论；(2) 一族定义在叶状结构正交补上的映射锥连接的绝热极限。第二个结果表明，若希望在映射锥情形中观察到更多几何与拓扑的相互作用，则需要引入精化度量。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论表明，将Bott连接推广到de Rham映射锥情形是合理且富有成效的；同时指出精化度量是观察映射锥框架下几何与拓扑更深层交互所必需的条件。

title: Contact order governs the onset of entanglement cascades
summary: Entangling rates describe a direct entangling channel, but give no information when that channel is forbidden. For finite-dimensional analytic pure-state dynamics, we show that the onset of genuine $(n+1)$-partite entanglement is determined by the contact order $m_\star$ between the physical trajectory and the $S|E$ product manifold. It is the first Taylor order that cannot be reproduced by any product curve, or equivalently the first nonvanishing order of the Fubini--Study distance from the product manifold. We derive a time-ordered recursion that removes curvature-induced kinematic terms and computes $m_\star$ from the Taylor coefficients of $H(t)$. This provides a geometric description of an entanglement cascade, in which new subsystems can join multipartite entanglement only after one or more interaction steps. A symmetry-protected three-qubit model realizes $m_\star=2$, and a three-mode bosonic example shows that genuine tripartite entanglement can arise even when the two newly formed reduced pairs remain separable.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对有限维解析纯态动力学系统，证明了多体纠缠（genuine multipartite entanglement）的起始由物理轨迹与S|E乘积流形之间的接触阶（contact order）$m_\star$决定，并提出一种时间有序递归方法，从哈密顿量$H(t)$的泰勒系数计算$m_\star$，从而将纠缠级联过程几何化描述。
AI.motivation: 纠缠率（entangling rates）仅能描述直接纠缠通道的信息，但当该通道被禁止时无法给出任何信息。作者旨在寻找一种更普适的判据来刻画多体纠缠的起始时刻，而不依赖于直接纠缠通道的存在与否。
AI.method: 作者证明了对于有限维解析纯态动力学，真正$(n+1)$部分纠缠的起始由物理轨迹与$S|E$乘积流形之间的接触阶$m_\star$决定；这是任何乘积曲线都无法重现的首个泰勒阶次，等价于从乘积流形的Fubini–Study距离的首次非零阶。作者进一步推导了一种时间有序递归公式，用以去除曲率导致的运动学项，从而从$H(t)$的泰勒系数计算$m_\star$。
AI.result: 推导出的形式化框架给出了纠缠级联（entanglement cascade）的几何描述：新子系统只有在一次或多次相互作用步之后才能加入多体纠缠。文中以对称性保护的三比特模型实现了$m_\star=2$的情形；三模玻色子例子则表明，即使两个新形成的约化对仍保持可分离，真正的三部分纠缠也能出现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，纠缠的起始可由接触阶$m_\star$从几何上精确刻画，且当直接纠缠通道被禁止时，纠缠仍可能通过级联的相互作用步逐步涌现。该框架为理解多体纠缠的动力学生成机制提供了统一的几何视角。

title: "It's getting away from us!" - Black Hole Horizons and Relative Speed
summary: Black holes hold considerable fascination for the general public and students alike, and are commonly included in general-science courses on astronomy or modern physics. But teaching about the basics of black holes poses a considerable challenge: Any rigorous description requires concepts and techniques from general relativity, Einstein's theory of geometry and gravitation. And any half-way rigorous introduction to that theory, including the required mathematical tools, is significantly beyond the level of general-science courses. Inevitably, accounts of relativistic physics at the introductory undergraduate level make use of analogies, approximations and simplified models to teach about topics like black holes, gravitational waves, gravitational lensing, or cosmology. The purpose of this article is to given an account of one particular set of analogies for teaching about black holes, all of which are based on modelling the motions of observers in the vicinity of the black hole and rely on the concept of (relative) speed to describe properties of the black hole. While most elements of what I am about to describe can be found in the existing literature, I am not aware of any text that attempts to pull them together into a unified picture at a suitable level of presentation for undergraduate-level teaching; that is the goal of the present text.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在为本科生通识教育中讲授黑洞基本概念提供一套基于类比的教学方法，这些类比通过对黑洞附近观察者运动的建模及（相对）速度概念，将广义相对论中的抽象内容转化为入门级学生可理解的形式。
AI.motivation: 黑洞的概念广受大众与学生关注，但严格的黑洞描述需要广义相对论（general relativity）及相应的数学工具，远超通识课程的教学水平。因此，有必要寻找适合本科低年级教学的简化模型与类比资源。
AI.method: 文章以建模黑洞附近观察者运动为核心，借助（相对）速度概念来描述黑洞的性质，并提出一组相互关联的类比教学框架。其目标是将散见现有文献中的相关类比元素整合为统一的、适合本科教学水平的叙述体系。
AI.result: 文章汇集了一套基于速度概念和观察者运动模型的黑洞教学类比，并形成了适用于本科生一般科学课程（general-science courses）层面的统一呈现形式。
AI.conclusion: 这类类比方法可以在本科入门教学中有效传达黑洞的基础概念，弥补严格广义相对论表述在通识层级难以直接讲授的不足；将已有类比整合为统一框架是该文的独特贡献。

title: Single Dirac Fermions on a Lattice: A Unified View of Chiral and Parity Anomalies in Condensed Matter
summary: Quantum anomalies are usually formulated in continuum field theory, where regularization may violate a classical symmetry. In a crystal, the compact Brillouin zone and the high-energy bands make that ultraviolet completion physical. This Perspective develops a unified lattice view of chiral and parity anomalies through the problem of realizing a single massless Dirac fermion. The central motif is a finite low-energy region in which the relevant symmetry is restored, embedded in a high-energy sector that breaks the symmetry and completes the lattice theory. In $1+1$ and $3+1$ dimensions, the quantized chiral response is protected by local chiral symmetry near the Fermi surface. In $2+1$ dimensions, the half-integer Hall response belongs to a single massless Dirac band with mirror symmetry, not to a generic massive Dirac insulator that breaks the symmetry explicitly. In both cases the lattice perspective reveals how the low-energy symmetry emerges from the high-energy sector and protects the anomalous and quantized response. Recent experimental progress in quantum materials is discussed in light of this unified view.

AI.tldr: 本文从晶格视角提出一种统一理解手征反常与宇称反常的理论框架。其核心思想是：在有限低能区域中恢复相关对称性，并将其嵌入一个破缺该对称性并完成晶格理论的高能扇区。在1+1维和3+1维中，定量化的手征响应由费米面附近的局域手征对称性保护；在2+1维中，半个整数量子的霍尔响应归属于单个具有镜面反射对称性的无质量狄拉克带，而非显式破缺该对称性的一般有质量狄拉克绝缘体。这一统一视角揭示了低能对称性如何从高能扇区涌现，并保护反常的、定量化的响应。
AI.motivation: 量子反常通常在连续场论中表述，其正规化（regularization）可能破坏经典对称性。然而在晶体中，紧凑的布里渊区（Brillouin zone）和高能带使得紫外完备化（ultraviolet completion）是物理真实的。作者试图通过实现单个无质量狄拉克费米子这一问题，在晶格体系中统一理解手征反常与宇称反常。
AI.method: 本文采取"观点综述"（Perspective）的方式，构建一个统一的晶格理论框架。其中心结构是：一个有限低能区域中对称性被恢复，嵌入于一个破缺对称性并完成晶格理论的高能扇区。作者分别分析了1+1维、3+1维和2+1维情形下反常响应的来源与保护机制。
AI.result: 在1+1维和3+1维中，定量化的手征响应（quantized chiral response）由费米面附近的局域手征对称性保护。在2+1维中，半个整数（half-integer）霍尔响应归属于单个具有镜面反射对称性的无质量狄拉克带，而非显式破缺该对称性的一般有质量狄拉克绝缘体。两种情形均显示低能对称性从高能扇区涌现，从而保护反常且定量化的响应。
AI.conclusion: 晶格视角揭示了低能对称性如何从高能扇区中出现并保护量子化反常响应。作者结合这一统一观点，讨论了量子材料领域近期的实验进展。

title: Structure-Preserving Data-Driven Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Differential-Algebraic Systems
summary: We present a data-driven approach to identifying linear index-1 differential-algebraic pH systems (pH-DAEs) based on input-output measurements. In comparison to the identification of port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems, the algebraic constraint and the index condition pose additional challenges. First, we establish a structure-preserving formulation of the considered pH-DAE class and derive an implicit midpoint discretization that preserves the algebraic constraints and discrete dissipation inequality. We formulate the identification problem as a regularized least-squares minimization problem subject to the pH-DAE dynamics. Exploiting the index-1 structure, we reduce the constrained problem to an unconstrained optimization problem over the system parameters while preserving the port-Hamiltonian structure. Next, we derive an adjoint-based formulation to efficiently evaluate the gradient of the resulting reduced cost functional. This enables us to use gradient-based optimization methods for parameter estimation. Under suitable assumptions on the admissible parameter set, the existence of a minimizer is established. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach can identify surrogate pH-DAE systems that accurately reproduce the input-output behavior of reference systems. Further investigations show the approach's potential for identifying reduced-order surrogate models. Cross-validation with independent input signals confirms the predictive capability of the identified models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于输入-输出测量的数据驱动方法，用于识别线性指标-1微分代数端口-哈密顿系统（pH-DAE），通过结构保持的离散化、约束化简为无约束最优化以及伴随法梯度计算，实现了对参考系统输入-输出行为的准确复现与预测。
AI.motivation: 针对端口-哈密顿（port-Hamiltonian）系统的辨识已有研究，但微分代数（differential-algebraic）结构中的代数约束与指标条件带来了额外挑战，现有方法难以直接适用。
AI.method: 首先建立所考虑pH-DAE类的结构保持表述，并推导保持代数约束与离散耗散不等式的隐式中点离散化；将辨识问题表述为受pH-DAE动力学约束的正则化最小二乘最小化问题；利用指标-1结构将该约束问题化简为关于系统参数的无约束优化问题；进一步推导基于伴随（adjoint）的梯度高效求值公式，从而可采用基于梯度的优化方法进行参数估计。
AI.result: 在可行参数集的适当假设下，证明了最小化器（minimizer）的存在性。数值实验表明该方法能辨识出准确复现参考系统输入-输出行为的替代pH-DAE系统，并具有识别降阶替代模型的潜力；独立输入信号的交叉验证证实了辨识模型的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据驱动方法能够有效辨识输入-输出行为准确的pH-DAE替代模型，并具备降阶建模与跨信号预测的潜力。

title: Ginzburg-Landau Theory for Non-Invertible Symmetry-Breaking Transitions
summary: Recently, a generalized Landau paradigm has been proposed, in which a broad class of "unconventional" phase transitions lying beyond the original symmetry-breaking framework of Landau are understood as the symmetry-breaking transitions of generalized symmetries. In particular, in (1+1)D, such "topological" or "deconfined" transitions can be mapped to the symmetry-breaking transitions of non-invertible symmetries. How to extract the universal dynamical properties of the transitions from this understanding? In this paper, we follow the Ginzburg-Landau philosophy and develop a field-theoretic description of such critical points in terms of the fluctuations of local order parameters, now of non-invertible symmetries. The Symmetry Topological Field Theory formalism plays a central role in our analysis, allowing us to identify the algebra of local order parameters from the Lagrangian algebra of a (2+1)D topological order. We illustrate the key ideas and the full steps of this generalized Ginzburg-Landau procedure using the transitions between gapped phases with a simple non-invertible symmetry --- the Rep($S_3$) symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文在广义Landau范式框架下，提出一种基于非可逆（non-invertible）对称性的场论描述方法，利用对称拓扑场论（Symmetry Topological Field Theory）从（2+1）维拓扑序的Lagrangian代数中提取局域序参量代数，并以Rep(S3)对称为例展示了广义Ginzburg-Landau过程的完整步骤。
AI.motivation: 近期提出的广义Landau范式将超越原始对称破缺框架的"非常规"相变理解为广义对称性的对称破缺相变，但如何从这一理解中提取相变的普适动力学性质仍是未解问题。作者旨在填补这一空白，为这类临界点建立场论描述。
AI.method: 遵循Ginzburg-Landau哲学，以非可逆对称性的局域序参量涨落为核心建立临界点的场论描述。对称拓扑场论形式在其中起核心作用，用于从（2+1）维拓扑序的Lagrangian代数中识别局域序参量的代数结构。作者以具有简单非可逆对称性Rep(S3)的带隙相之间的相变为例，演示该广义Ginzburg-Landau方法的关键思想与完整步骤。
AI.result: 作者发展了一套广义Ginzburg-Landau程序，通过对称拓扑场论形式从拓扑数据中系统地构造非可逆对称破缺临界点的场论描述，并以Rep(S3)对称性下的相变过程为例完整展示了这一方法的实施路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将Ginzburg-Landau思想推广到非可逆对称性的对称性破缺相变，为理解"非常规"相变的普适动力学性质提供了场论框架，并以Rep(S3)具体演示了方法的可行性。

title: The accuracy of merger times in hierarchical black hole triples
summary: Orbit-averaged equations are widely used to model the gravitational-wave-driven evolution of compact binaries. Their validity relies on the radiation-reaction timescale being much longer than the orbital period, an assumption that can break down for highly eccentric systems. In this work, we investigate the impact of orbit averaging on merger-time estimates by comparing orbit-averaged and non-orbit-averaged prescriptions. We apply our analysis to two different astrophysically motivated populations of black hole binaries in hierarchical triple systems, where von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai oscillations can drive the inner binary eccentricities close to unity. We find that merger-time estimates obtained with orbit-averaged equations remain remarkably accurate across a wide range of eccentricities, even when the orbital timescale exceeds the radiation-reaction timescale. Significant discrepancies arise only for the most extreme and compact binaries, simultaneously characterized by very high eccentricities and small semi-latus recta. In this regime, the merger time becomes strongly dependent on the initial orbital phase, with different phases yielding predictions that can differ by several orders of magnitude. We also compare our results with an orbit-averaged merger-time prescription specifically developed for hierarchical triple systems and find substantial differences between this prescription and both the generic orbit-averaged and non-orbit-averaged calculations in the high-eccentricity regime. While these results demonstrate the robustness of orbit-averaged merger-time estimates for most systems, they also highlight the potential importance of non-orbit-averaged effects when merger times are used to infer compact-binary delay-time distributions and formation channels.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了轨道平均（orbit-averaged）与非轨道平均方法对致密双星并合时间估算的影响，发现在绝大多数情况下轨道平均方程的并合时间估算依然高度准确，仅在极高偏心率与小半正焦弦距同时出现的极端紧凑双星系统中产生显著偏差，且此时并合时间强烈依赖初始轨道相位。
AI.motivation: 轨道平均方程广泛用于模拟引力波驱动下的致密双星演化，但其有效性依赖于辐射反作用时标远长于轨道周期，这一假设在高度偏心的系统中可能失效。已有研究缺乏对此失效程度及其对并合时间估算影响的系统评估。
AI.method: 对比轨道平均与非轨道平均两种模型对并合时间估计的差异，并应用于分层三星系统（hierarchical triple systems）中由von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai振荡驱动的两类天体物理黑洞双星种群，覆盖从低到极高偏心率的参数范围。
AI.result: 轨道平均方程在广泛的偏心率范围内仍能给出高度准确的并合时间估计，即使轨道时标已超过辐射反作用时标。仅在最极端且紧凑的双星系统中（同时具有极高偏心率和小半正焦弦距）出现显著偏差，此时初始轨道相位决定的并合时间预测可相差数个数量级。此外，专为分层三星系统开发的轨道平均并合时间公式与通用轨道平均及非轨道平均计算在高偏心率区存在实质性差异。
AI.conclusion: 轨道平均方法对大多数系统的并合时间估计具有鲁棒性，但当利用并合时间推断致密双星延迟时间分布和形成通道时，非轨道平均效应可能具有重要影响。

title: Barrierless Water Dissociation on Rare-Earth Sesquioxide Surfaces from First Principles
summary: Water dissociation on metal oxide surfaces is a key elementary step in heterogeneous catalysis, photocatalysis, and radiation chemistry, yet its mechanistic details on rare-earth (RE) sesquioxides remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate water dissociation on the (110) surfaces of three cubic bixbyite oxides, Sc$_2$O$_3$, Y$_2$O$_3$, and Lu$_2$O$_3$, using molecular dynamics combining ab initio calculations with on-the-fly machine-learning force field acceleration. By sampling 25 independent trajectories per material, we obtain an unbiased picture of the reaction landscape inaccessible to conventional static calculations. Two distinct dissociation pathways are identified: a conventional proximal mechanism with a small but finite barrier of $\sim$0.1 eV, and a previously unreported distal mechanism that is effectively barrierless and energetically preferred at both the adsorption and dissociation stages. The low barriers are consistent with the periodic array of inherently undercoordinated RE$^{3+}$ sites in the bixbyite lattice, suggesting that ordered intrinsic coordination defects play a role analogous to stochastic oxygen vacancies in conventional oxides.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用结合从头算（ab initio）计算与在线机器学习力场（machine-learning force field）加速的分子动力学模拟，系统考察了三种立方方铁石结构（bixbyite）稀土倍半氧化物（Sc₂O₃、Y₂O₃和Lu₂O₃）(110)表面的水分子解离行为。研究发现两条截然不同的解离路径：传统近端机制（proximal mechanism）具有微小势垒（约0.1 eV），以及此前未见报道的远端机制（distal mechanism），后者实质上无势垒且在吸附和解离阶段均在能量上优先。低势垒源于方铁石晶格中周期性排布的内在欠配位RE³⁺位点。
AI.motivation: 金属氧化物表面的水分子解离是异相催化（heterogeneous catalysis）、光催化（photocatalysis）和辐射化学中的关键基元步骤，但稀土倍半氧化物表面的解离机理细节仍未被充分理解。传统静态计算难以获得无偏见的反应景观（reaction landscape），亟需更全面的动态采样手段。
AI.method: 对立方方铁石结构的Sc₂O₃、Y₂O₃和Lu₂O₃的(110)表面，采用结合从头算计算与在线机器学习力场加速的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟方法。每种材料采集25条独立轨迹，以获得无偏见的反应景观采样。
AI.result: 识别出两条截然不同的解离路径：具小但有限势垒（约0.1 eV）的传统近端机制，以及此前未报道的、实质无势垒且能量上优先的远端机制。低势垒与方铁石晶格中周期性排布的内在欠配位RE³⁺位点一致。
AI.conclusion: 有序内在配位缺陷在稀土倍半氧化物表面水分子解离中发挥着类似于传统氧化物中随机氧空位的角色。远端机制的存在及其无势垒特性要求重新审视此类材料表面水分子的反应模型。

title: Finite-rank multiplicative perturbations of rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrices
summary: We study finite-rank multiplicative deformations of rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrices. More precisely, we consider models of the form $\mathbf{A}(\mathbf{I}+\mathbf{T})$, where $\mathbf{A}$ is a large rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrix, $\mathbf{T}$ is a finite-rank normal perturbation, and $\mathbf{I}$ denotes the identity matrix. We characterize the emergence of outlier eigenvalues, their fluctuations, and the associated eigenvector overlaps. Our results provide a multiplicative non-Hermitian counterpart to the classical Baik--Ben Arous--Péché framework.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旋转不变非厄米随机矩阵（rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrices）的有限秩乘法微扰，模型形式为 A(I+T)，刻画了离群特征值（outlier eigenvalues）的出现条件、涨落规律以及相应的特征向量重叠（eigenvector overlaps），为经典Baik–Ben Arous–Péché（BBP）框架提供了乘法非厄米对应物。
AI.motivation: 在随机矩阵理论中，有限秩微扰对谱的影响具有重要理论意义，而现有主要成果集中于加法或厄米情形。作者旨在将经典BBP框架推广至乘法非厄米设置，填补该方向的理论空白。
AI.method: 研究模型 A(I+T)，其中A为大型旋转不变非厄米随机矩阵，T为有限秩正规（normal）微扰，I为单位矩阵。通过分析该乘法结构下的谱性质，系统刻画离群特征值出现条件、涨落行为及特征向量重叠的极限分布。
AI.result: 论文完整表征了乘法非厄米微扰下离群特征值的产生条件及其涨落规律，并给出了相应特征向量重叠的理论刻画，建立了与加法BBP框架平行的乘法非厄米对应理论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非厄米随机矩阵的有限秩乘法微扰提供了系统的理论框架，拓展了BBP相变现象（phase transition）的适用范围，为随机矩阵理论在非厄米及乘法扰动情境下的进一步研究奠定基础。

title: Solar Capture Tests of Inelastic Dark Matter after the LZ High-Recoil Event
comment: 33 pages, 13 figures and 3 tables. Comments are welcome
summary: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Collaboration has reported a $248$ keV nuclear-recoil candidate for which endothermic dark matter (DM) gives some of the largest local significances. We study Solar-capture constraints on three simple interpretations: a thermal Higgsino, a thermal pseudo-Dirac fermion with off-diagonal vector interactions, and neutron-philic endothermic spin-dependent scattering through $\mathcal{O}_4$. The canonical full-density thermal Higgsino is excluded: its LZ-preferred splitting near $0.38,\mathrm{MeV}$ lies below the IceCube requirement, $δ\gtrsim0.51$--$0.56,\mathrm{MeV}$. For the pseudo-Dirac benchmark we find $C_\odot=1.48\times10^{20},\mathrm{s}^{-1}$, but two-state kinetics strongly suppresses annihilation. Including thermally assisted $χ_1\toχ_2$ re-excitation gives a maximum $Γ_A\simeq4.1\times10^{14},\mathrm{s}^{-1}$, about $1.8\times10^5$ below the adopted IceCube $b\bar b$ limit. For neutron-philic $\mathcal{O}_4$ scattering at $m_χ=1$ TeV and $δ=300$ keV, finite-temperature capture gives $C_\odot=3.98\times10^{17},\mathrm{s}^{-1}$, with spin-response range $(1.77$--$9.72)\times10^{17},\mathrm{s}^{-1}$. Even in equilibrium, the upper edge remains about a factor $154$ below the adopted $b\bar b$ limit, while an aggressive no-finite-$q$ suppression plus upper-spin stress test still leaves a factor about $19$. The $b\bar b$ mapping is used as a representative hadronic template for the two non-Higgsino benchmarks. Solar capture therefore excludes the thermal-Higgsino interpretation but does not generically exclude endothermic explanations of the LZ candidate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过太阳俘获（Solar capture）约束研究LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）合作组报告的248 keV核反冲候选事件，检验了三种暗物质（dark matter, DM）内能解释模型：热Higgsino、具有对角矢量相互作用的赝Dirac费米子，以及经由算符O4的中子亲和内能自旋相关散射。结果表明太阳俘获约束排除了热Higgsino解释，但并未普遍排除LZ候选事件的内能解释。
AI.motivation: LZ合作组报告了一个248 keV核反冲候选事件，内能暗物质（endothermic DM）模型为其提供了最大的局部显著性。作者旨在利用太阳俘获约束来检验这一候选事件是否可能由三种简单暗物质模型解释。
AI.method: 作者对三种模型分别计算太阳俘获率（solar capture rate, C_⊙），并与IceCube观测到的中微子信号上限进行比较。对于赝Dirac费米子，作者考虑了双态动力学对湮灭的抑制效应以及热辅助再激发过程；对于O4散射模型，计算了有限温俘获率并考虑了自旋响应范围及多种应力测试（stress test）情形。b\bar b衰变通道被用作两种非Higgsino基准模型的代表性强子模板。
AI.result: 典型全密度热Higgsino被排除：其LZ偏好的质量劈裂（约0.38 MeV）低于IceCube要求的下限δ≳0.51–0.56 MeV。赝Dirac基准模型的C_⊙=1.48×10^20 s^-1，但双态动力学强烈抑制湮灭，即便考虑热辅助再激发，最大湮灭率Γ_A约为4.1×10^14 s^-1，仍比IceCube b\bar b极限低约1.8×10^5倍。对O4散射模型（m_χ=1 TeV，δ=300 keV），有限温俘获给出C_⊙=3.98×10^17 s^-1，即使处于平衡态，其上边界仍比b\bar b极限低约154倍；即便采用最激进的应力测试情形，仍低约19倍。
AI.conclusion: 太阳俘获约束排除了热Higgsino对内能暗物质候选事件的解释，但并未普遍排除内能机制解释LZ候选事件的可能性。

title: An HLLD Implementation for General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamics in AthenaK
summary: We present an implementation of an HLLD approximate Riemann solver for the AthenaK astrophysics code with support for full general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics via a tetrad frame transformation. Our implementation uses an initial guess for the HLLD iterative solve which eliminates the need for an additional conserved-to-primitive inversion, which greatly accelerates performance without affecting accuracy. Additionally, by coupling the method with a first-order flux correction, we are able to use the method reliably even when the magnetization exceeds $10^4$, which we achieve in a SANE accretion disk. Our SANE disk shows that HLLD leads to a more strongly magnetized funnel and more accurate horizon fluxes when compared with HLLE. We further apply the new HLLD implementation to an equal-mass binary neutron star merger. For our long-lived remnant, HLLD enhances the magnetic shear stresses in the outer layers and leads to weaker differential rotation. However, due to weaker gravitational wave emissions in the post-merger phase, the remnant is consistently less compact while producing more dynamical ejecta and a more massive disk. The cost of this new solver is relatively modest thanks to the improved initial guess: our accretion disk tests are only ${\sim}10-25\%$ slower than HLLE, and for our binary neutron star runs with a microphysical equation of state, we find that HLLD is only ${\sim}3\%$ slower than HLLE across all runs.

AI.tldr: 本文在AthenaK天体物理代码中实现了HLLD近似黎曼求解器（HLLD approximate Riemann solver），通过四矢面变换支持完全广义相对论磁流体力学（general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics），并利用改进的初始猜测消除了额外的守恒量到原始量（conserved-to-primitive）反演需求，从而显著加速计算而不损失精度。
AI.motivation: 在强磁化区域和高动态过程中，传统HLLE求解器缺乏足够的精度，需要一种更精确的黎曼求解器（HLLD）但面临计算成本和数值稳定性的挑战。
AI.method: 在AthenaK代码中实现HLLD求解器，支持通过四矢面（tetrad frame）变换处理完全广义相对论磁流体力学；采用改进的初始猜测以避免额外的守恒量到原始量反演，并与一阶通量修正（first-order flux correction）耦合以在极高磁化强度（>10^4）下保持数值可靠性。
AI.result: 在SANE吸积盘中，HLLD产生更强的磁化喷流漏斗和更精确的视界通量（horizon fluxes）；在等质量双中子星并合中，HLLD增强了外层磁剪切应力并减弱了差旋，但导致更弱的后并合引力波辐射、更不致密的残骸、更多的动力学抛射物和更质量的盘；计算开销相对适中，吸积盘测试仅比HLLE慢约10–25%，双中子星运行仅慢约3%。
AI.conclusion: HLLD求解器在高磁化吸积流和双中子星并合等强磁环境中比HLLE提供更精确的物理结果，且计算成本增量可控，使其成为可广泛应用于各类相对论MHD模拟的有效替代方案。

title: Continuum Limit of Nonlocal Electrostatics in Random Media
summary: We derive a two-scale continuum limit for the electrostatic energy of random charge density fields that are stationary and ergodic under lattice translations. Each microscopic cell is charge neutral in every realization, while its dipole moment may fluctuate and have a nonzero mean. Under assumptions on the stationary microscopic potential and the finite-volume fields, the local and nonlocal energies converge almost surely to deterministic limits. The local limit consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy and a cell-depolarization term, whereas the effective polarization determines the nonlocal limit. The cell-depolarization terms cancel in the total energy, which consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic cell energy and the macroscopic electrostatic field energy. The deterministic specialization recovers the periodic two-scale limit. For an independent-cell random-displacement model, we verify the assumptions of the continuum-limit theorem and show that centered microscopic fluctuations can change the local energy without changing the effective polarization or the nonlocal energy.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了在晶格平移下平稳且遍历（stationary and ergodic）的随机电荷密度场静电能的双尺度连续极限。局部与非局部能量几乎必然收敛到确定性极限，总能量由系综平均的微观胞能量和宏观静电场能量组成。
AI.motivation: 随机电荷密度场的静电能描述需要严格的连续介质极限，以建立微观随机涨落与宏观静电响应之间的理论联系，现有工作缺乏对局部和局部非能量项的严格分析。
AI.method: 对每个微观胞元施加任意实现下电荷中性条件，允许偶极矩波动且具有非零均值。在平稳微观势和有限体积场假设下，分别建立局部能量与非局部能量的几乎必然收敛极限，并通过独立胞随机位移模型验证定理假设。
AI.result: 局部极限包含系综平均的微观库仑能量与胞退极化项，有效极化（effective polarization）决定非局部极限；胞退极化项在总能量中相互抵消。确定性特化情形恢复周期双尺度极限。独立胞随机位移模型显示，中心化微观涨落可改变局部能量而不改变有效极化或非局部能量。
AI.conclusion: 随机电荷体系的静电能可严格划分为微观胞尺度的局部能量与由有效极化控制的宏观非局部能量，总能量表达简洁且具有确定性极限，为随机介质中的静电连续化提供了统一的数学框架。

title: Spectral Criterion for Disorder-Free Localization of Quantum Walks on Hypercube: QBN Approach
comment: 17 pages, 2 tables. Any comments are welcome
summary: We study disorder-free localization in a spin-coupled quantum walk on the hypercube within the quantum Bernoulli noises framework. We derive a general criterion for disorder-free localization: it occurs if and only if some spectral subspace of a reduced unitary evolution contains a vector whose position marginal probability is non-uniform. For the Grover walk with distance-dependent coupling \(φ_σ=|σ|π/(n+1)\) in dimension \(d=4\), we explicitly construct a non-uniform fixed point in the all \(+1\) spin configuration. This implies that disorder-free localization occurs in our model.

AI.tldr: 在量子伯努利噪声框架下，研究超立方体上自旋耦合量子行走中的无缺陷局域化现象，推导出其发生判据，并在Grover行走特定耦合条件下构建非均匀不动点，从而证明该模型中无缺陷局域化的存在。
AI.motivation: 探究量子行走系统中在不存在无序势（disorder）的情况下，能否由纯粹的量子相干与自旋耦合机制引发态局域化现象（无缺陷局域化，disorder-free localization），并给出严格的判据与显式构造。
AI.method: 基于量子伯努利噪声框架建立超立方体上的自旋耦合量子行走模型，推导无缺陷局域化的充分必要条件——约化幺正演化某谱子空间存在位置边缘概率非均匀的向量；随后对维度d=4、距离相关耦合φ_σ=|σ|π/(n+1)的Grover行走，在全部+1自旋配置下显式构造非均匀不动点。
AI.result: 成功推导出无缺陷局域化的一般性判据（当且仅当约化幺正演化的某谱子空间中存在位置边缘概率非均匀的向量），并在d=4的Grover行走模型中通过显式构造证明了非均匀不动点的存在，从而确认该模型发生无缺陷局域化。
AI.conclusion: 在量子伯努利噪声框架下，超立方体上带距离相关自旋耦合的Grover量子行走模型确实可实现无缺陷局域化，为该现象的理论研究提供了新的可解模型与严格证明。

title: Algorithmic Randomness and Physical Typicality
comment: Accepted version, forthcoming in The Proceedings of The 2026 Meeting of the Philosophy of Science Association
summary: Appeals to typicality are common in physics, but it is often unclear what it means for a physical state to be typical relative to a probability measure, and correspondingly unclear what a law that appeals to typicality asserts. Here we consider how one might characterize physical typicality using ideas from the theory of algorithmic randomness. As a concrete example, we show how taking a physical state to be typical relative to a computable measure when it is Martin-Löf random allows one to formulate the distribution postulate in Bohmian mechanics as a statistical constraining law of the theory. Using a toy model, we show how this constraint guarantees the standard Born statistics for computable experimental protocols. Algorithmic Bohmian mechanics (aBM) thus illustrates how algorithmic randomness may be used to provide precise content to a statistical law.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何利用算法随机性（algorithmic randomness）理论中的马丁-洛夫随机性（Martin-Löf randomness）来为物理学中的典型性（typicality）概念提供精确的含义，并以玻姆力学（Bohmian mechanics）中的分布公设（distribution postulate）为例论证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 物理学中频繁援引典型性论证，但相对于概率测度而言何谓物理状态的典型性往往不明确，依赖典型性的规律也因此缺乏精确断言内容。
AI.method: 借鉴算法随机性理论，将相对于可计算测度（computable measure）的马丁-洛夫随机状态视为典型物理状态，据此将玻姆力学中的分布公设形式化为一种统计约束律，并借助玩具模型检验其推论。
AI.result: 在玩具模型中，该统计约束保证了对可计算实验协议（computable experimental protocols）的标准玻恩统计（Born statistics）成立，由此构造出算法玻姆力学（algorithmic Bohmian mechanics, aBM）。
AI.conclusion: 算法玻姆力学表明，算法随机性可以为统计律提供精确的内容表达，从而为典型性在物理学定律中的使用奠定更严格的基础。

title: First-Principles Study of Magnetism, Electronic Structure, and Bonding in Nb-Mn-Ge Kagome Compounds
summary: In this work, we systematically investigate the magnetic ground states, electronic structures, and bonding characteristics of the computationally predicted stable NbMn6Ge6, NbMn6Ge5, and NbMn6Ge4 using first-principles calculations. Our results show that structurally stable NbMn6Ge6 has a collinear antiferromagnetic configuration, while the metastable rhombohedral NbMn6Ge5 and NbMn6Ge4 favor ferromagnetic ground states. Magnetic moments on Mn atoms are nearly localized, suggesting the applicability of a generalized spin Hamiltonian. Magnetic anisotropy in AFM NbMn6Ge6 and FM NbMn6Ge5 has uniaxial behavior, while FM NbMn6Ge4 has in-plane anisotropy. Charge density difference and electron localization function analyses further show charge redistribution and bonding features within the Mn-Ge Kagome network and between adjacent structural layers. Electronic structures near the Fermi level show no features suitable for topological magnetism studies. Experimental synthesis, structural characterization, and magnetic measurements are required to verify our predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）系统研究了三个预测稳定的铌锰锗化合物（NbMn6Ge6、NbMn6Ge5、NbMn6Ge4）的磁性基态、电子结构与成键特性，发现NbMn6Ge6呈共线反铁磁（AFM）基态，后两者呈铁磁（FM）基态，且Mn原子磁矩近局域化，各向异性类型随材料结构不同而异。
AI.motivation: 探究计算预测稳定的Nb-Mn-Ge系列化合物（NbMn6Ge6、NbMn6Ge5、NbMn6Ge4）的磁性基态与电子结构特征，评估其是否具备拓扑磁性研究潜力，并为后续实验合成与表征提供理论指导。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）系统考察三种化合物的磁性基态、电子结构和成键特性；利用电荷密度差（charge density difference）与电子局域化函数（electron localization function）分析Mn-Ge Kagome网络内部及相邻结构层间的电荷再分布与成键特征；并通过广义自旋哈密顿量（generalized spin Hamiltonian）框架评估Mn原子磁矩的局域化程度。
AI.result: 结构稳定的NbMn6Ge6呈现共线反铁磁（collinear antiferromagnetic）构型，亚稳态的菱面体（rhombohedral）NbMn6Ge5与NbMn6Ge4则倾向铁磁（ferromagnetic）基态。三种化合物中Mn原子磁矩均近局域化，暗示广义自旋哈密顿量适用；AFM NbMn6Ge6与FM NbMn6Ge5表现为单轴磁各向异性（uniaxial anisotropy），而FM NbMn6Ge4为面内各向异性（in-plane anisotropy）。费米能级附近的电子结构不具备拓扑磁性研究所需的特征。
AI.conclusion: 三种Mn基Kagome化合物在磁性基态、各向异性及电子结构上各有差异，但其费米能级附近电子结构不适用于拓扑磁性（topological magnetism）研究；需要通过实验合成、结构表征与磁性测量来验证这些理论预测。

title: Christoffel transform and symplectic skew Howe duality
summary:
For a symmetric weight $w(x)$ on a finite discrete lattice and its Christoffel transforms $x^{2}w(x),x^{2}(x^{2}w(x)),\dots$, we prove that, at each Christoffel step, the conjugated projection associated with the transformed Christoffel--Darboux kernel differs from the original orthogonal projection by a rank-one operator on the subspace of functions vanishing at the origin. This provides a general mechanism for transferring local asymptotic results from an orthogonal polynomial ensemble to its Christoffel-transformed counterpart as the lattice size tends to infinity.
  As a main application, we study local fluctuations of random Young diagrams arising from skew $(\mathrm{Sp}_{2n},\mathrm{Sp}_{2k})$ Howe duality. The corresponding particle ensemble is obtained from the Krawtchouk orthogonal polynomial ensemble on a quadratic lattice by a Christoffel transform. We identify four asymptotic regimes of local fluctuations in the limit $n,k\to\infty$ with $n/k\to c\in(0,\infty)$. Besides the universal bulk fluctuations governed by the discrete sine kernel and universal Airy fluctuations at the right edge of the limit shape, we obtain the discrete Hermite kernel in the critical regime $(k-n)/\sqrt{n+k}\longrightarrow r\in\mathbb{R}$, and the discrete hard-wall sine kernel at the left corner.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了对有限离散格点上的对称权函数进行Christoffel变换时，变换后的Christoffel–Darboux核所对应的共轭投影与原始正交投影之间相差一个在原点消失的函数子空间上的秩一算子，为将正交多项式系综的局部渐近结果推广至其Christoffel变换对应物提供了通用机制；作为主要应用，论文研究了由斜(Sp_{2n},Sp_{2k}) Howe对偶产生的随机Young图的局部涨落，识别出四种渐近区域。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在建立将正交多项式系综（orthogonal polynomial ensemble）的局部渐近结果转移到其Christoffel变换（Christoffel transform）对应系的通用数学机制，并以此为基础对与Howe对偶相关的随机Young图模型进行局部涨落分析。
AI.method: 作者在对称权函数的Christoffel变换序列上证明了一个投影算子间的秩一修正结构：每个Christoffel步骤中变换后核的共轭投影与原投影在原点消失函数子空间上相差一个秩一算子；随后将这一框架应用于由斜(Sp_{2n},Sp_{2k}) Howe对偶导出的粒子系综——该系综由二次格点上的Krawtchouk正交多项式系综经Christoffel变换获得，并利用格点尺寸趋于无穷的条件分析其局部涨落。
AI.result: 在n,k→∞且n/k→c∈(0,∞)的极限下识别出四种局部涨落渐近区域：由离散sine核主导的普适体相（bulk）涨落；在极限形状右缘的普适Airy核涨落；在临界区域(k−n)/√(n+k)→r∈ℝ中得到的离散Hermite核；以及左角处的离散硬壁sine核（discrete hard-wall sine kernel）。
AI.conclusion: 通过秩一算子的机制，论文建立了正交多项式系综与其Christoffel变换间局部渐近性质的传递关系，并据此完整刻画了该随机Young图模型的四种渐近涨落谱，涵盖普适与非普适区域。

title: Reggeization of quarks from next-to-eikonal high-energy QCD
summary: We develop a comprehensive Wilson-line formulation of quark Reggeization in QCD. Starting from a next-to-eikonal operator built from a semi-infinite Wilson line and a background-quark insertion, we identify an interpolating operator for the Reggeized quark and derive its nonlinear rapidity evolution using the background-field method. In the dilute regime, its positive-signature component exhibits Regge-pole evolution governed by the quark Regge trajectory, whereas the negative-signature sector displays mixing between quark and gluon degrees of freedom, in accordance with its known Regge-cut structure. In the planar limit, this mixing is suppressed, and Reggeization emerges without an explicit signature projection, recovering signature degeneracy. We illustrate the universality of the construction by extracting the same Reggeized-quark operator from a more general Wilson-line operator describing a gluon-to-quark transition. Furthermore, we extend the formalism to massive quarks, deriving a coordinate-space evolution kernel whose Fourier transform reproduces the massive-quark Regge trajectory. Finally, from the leading operator-mixing structure of the evolution equation and signature arguments, we show that the Reggeized-quark interpolating operator is expected to remain an eigenstate of the rapidity evolution up to next-to-leading logarithmic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文在量子色动力学（Quantum Chromodynamics, QCD）中发展了夸克Regge化（quark Reggeization）的完整Wilson线（Wilson line）表述，构造了Regge化夸克的插值算符并推导其非线性快度演化方程，验证了其在稀释极限下的Regge极点与Regge切割结构，并将形式推广至胶子到夸克跃迁及大质量夸克情形。
AI.motivation: 夸克Regge化是理解高能QCD散射中Regge极与Regge切割结构的关键，但目前缺乏一个统一的Wilson线算符层面的系统表述。作者旨在构建一个完整且普适的算符构造框架，以便系统地处理Regge化夸克及其演化。
AI.method: 从半无限Wilson线与背景夸克插入构成的次eikonal（next-to-eikonal）算符出发，识别出Regge化夸克的插值算符，并利用背景场方法（background-field method）推导其非线性快度（rapidity）演化方程。通过区分正负符号（signature）部分分析Regge极点与切割结构，并检查平面极限下的行为；随后将此构造推广至更一般的胶子-夸克跃迁Wilson线算符以及大质量夸克情形。
AI.result: 在稀释极限中，正符号分量表现出由夸克Regge轨迹（Regge trajectory）控制的Regge极点演化；负符号部分则显示夸克与胶子自由度的混合，对应已知的Regge切割（Regge cut）结构。在平面极限下该混合被抑制，无需显式符号投影即可实现Regge化并恢复符号简并（signature degeneracy）。从更一般的胶子到夸克跃迁Wilson线算符中可提取同一Regge化夸克算符，体现构造的普适性。大质量情形下导出的坐标空间演化核，其傅里叶变换重现大质量夸克Regge轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过符号论证与演化方程中领先的算符混合结构分析，作者表明Regge化夸克插值算符预计在次领对数（next-to-leading logarithmic, NLL）精度下仍保持为快度演化的本征态。

title: Autonomous Chaotic Time Series Prediction using Physical Neuromorphic Networks
summary: Physical reservoir computing (PRC) with neuromorphic networks offers a promising approach to brain-inspired information processing, exploiting emergent nonlinear dynamics of physical neural networks as a computational resource. This study demonstrates fully autonomous closed-loop prediction of the Mackey--Glass (MG) chaotic time series using a simulated neuromorphic nanowire network as the physical reservoir. Two strategies are evaluated: the virtual node (VN) method, which expands the feature space by temporal multiplexing of reservoir states, and a non-VN approach that uses all physical node readouts directly without temporal multiplexing. Results are reported for two values of the MG time delay parameter, $τ= 18$ and $τ= 21$, the latter representing a more complex chaotic regime not previously evaluated for this class of physical reservoir. Over a short prediction horizon of $T = 100$ timesteps, the VN approach achieves autonomous prediction accuracies of $90.4$% and $89.7$% at $τ= 18$ and $τ= 21$, respectively, while the non-VN approach achieves $81.5$% and $76.2$%. Long-horizon analysis over $T = 500$ timesteps shows that both approaches reproduce the qualitative attractor structure and dominant spectral content of the true MG signal, with trajectories remaining bounded throughout. These results suggest that the intrinsic dynamics of neuromorphic nanowire networks are sufficient to support meaningful autonomous chaotic time series prediction without virtual node augmentation, and that performance may improve further as physical network sizes scale to the millions of nodes achievable in hardware. As this study uses simulated networks, extrapolation to physically fabricated large-scale arrays remains to be validated experimentally.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用模拟的神经形态纳米线网络（neuromorphic nanowire network）作为物理储层（physical reservoir），实现了对Mackey–Glass混沌时间序列的全自主闭环预测。虚拟节点（VN）方法在时延参数τ=18和21时分别达到90.4%和89.7%的预测精度，优于非VN方法（81.5%和76.2%），且两种方法在长时程预测中都能再现真实的吸引子结构与主导频谱特征。
AI.motivation: 物理储层计算（physical reservoir computing, PRC）利用物理神经网络的内在非线性动力学作为计算资源，为类脑信息处理提供了一条有前景的路径；本研究旨在检验神经形态纳米线网络的内在动力学无需虚拟节点增强即可支持自主混沌时间序列预测的能力。
AI.method: 采用模拟的神经形态纳米线网络作为物理储层，比较两种策略：虚拟节点（virtual node, VN）方法通过时间复用扩展特征空间，以及非VN方法直接使用全部物理节点读出。在Mackey–Glass时间延迟参数τ=18和τ=21两种设置下进行评估，后者代表更复杂的混沌状态。
AI.result: 在T=100时间步的预测时域内，VN方法在τ=18和τ=21时分别实现90.4%与89.7%的自主预测精度，而非VN方法分别为81.5%和76.2%；在T=500时间步的长时程分析中，两种方法均再现了真实MG信号的定性吸引子结构与主导频谱内容，且轨迹保持有界。
AI.conclusion: 神经形态纳米线网络的内在动力学足以在没有虚拟节点增强的情况下支持有意义的自主混沌时间序列预测，且随物理网络规模扩展至百万节点级别性能可能进一步提升；但由于本研究基于模拟网络，对物理制备的大规模阵列的外推仍需实验验证。

title: Multi-copy and Catalytic Superactivation of Genuine Multipartite Nonlocality
summary: Genuine multipartite Bell nonlocality (GMNL) aims at capturing correlations between many distant observers that are globally Bell nonlocal. A commonly used definition for GMNL is based on biseparable models constructed from non-signalling correlations. Here we uncover an effect of superactivation of GMNL in this framework. Specifically, by locally wiring together two copies of a biseparable correlation, i.e. not GMNL, one can obtain another correlation that is GMNL. We show that this is possible for any number of parties, and for quantum-realizable correlations. Finally, we show that superactivation of GMNL is also possible at the single-copy level, via a catalytic protocol involving only local wirings. These results question the operational meaning of this definition of GMNL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多体量子关联中的格林伯格-霍恩-蔡林格…（GMNL）的超级激活效应——两个可分体相关（biseparable correlation）副本不能构成GMNL，但通过局部布线组合后可以整体激活为GMNL。该效应对任意参与方数和量子可实现相关均成立，且通过催化协议可在单副本层面实现，从而质疑了现行GMNL定义的操作意义。
AI.motivation: GMNL旨在刻画多个远距观测者之间全局贝尔非局域的相关性，但其常用定义基于可分体模型，尚无关于其操作鲁棒性的系统检验。本文尝试探究在非信号相关框架下GMNL是否具备超级激活（superactivation）的涌现性质，进而检验该定义的合理性与操作意义。
AI.method: 采用局域布线的理论构造方法：将两个不属于GMNL的可分体相关通过局域连线方式组合，证明所得全局相关在非信号可分体模型意义下成为GMNL；同时引入单副本层面的催化协议，仅利用局域布线实现超级激活，并推广至任意参与方数与量子可实现相关系。
AI.result: 发现并证明GMNL的超级激活效应存在且适用于任意参与方数；该效应在量子可实现相关的场景中同样成立；进一步证明即使在不复制、单副本层面，也可通过包含局域布线的催化协议实现超级激活。
AI.conclusion: GMNL的超级激活揭示了当前定义下可分体与非可分体之间的边界具有相当的操作脆弱性，即原本被判定为非GMNL的相关可能在新颖组合后表现全局贝尔非局域性，这直接质疑了该定义所携带的操作意义。

title: Constraining the Equation of State of Neutron Stars with third-generation Gravitational Wave detectors
summary: We investigated the impact of the number of binary neutron star merger events and neutron star (NS) mass distributions on constraining the equation of state (EoS), tidal deformability and radius of NSs, as well as the nuclear parameters, using binary neutron star inspiral gravitational wave signals with third-generation detectors. We generate simulated gravitational wave signals and compute the Fisher information matrix for each event after the number of events and mass distribution models are given. The covariance of EoS parameters is obtained by holding the non-EoS waveform parameters fixed at their injected values and accumulating the Fisher matrix over all events. Finally, the posterior samples of EoS, tidal deformability, radius and nuclear parameters are generated based on this covariance matrix. We find that larger number of events lead to tighter constraints due to more observed events and data accumulation, as expected given the increased number of detections. Meanwhile, we note that the mass distribution plays a more important role in constraining the EoS. We compare a realistic bimodal Gaussian distribution, a uniform distribution and another uniform including sub-solar mass NSs. The results show that the uniform distribution yields tighter constraints than bimodal models because it includes more low-mass and massive NSs. This also implies that events near $1.4\,\Msun$ provide partly redundant information about the EoS. Additionally, including sub-solar mass NSs can further improve the constraints by significantly reducing the EoS uncertainties at sub-saturation densities and inner-crust, highlighting the importance of sub-saturation density EoS.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用第三代引力波探测器模拟双中子星并合事件，系统评估了事件数量和中子星质量分布对约束核物质状态方程（EoS）、潮汐形变度、半径及核参数的影响。结果发现，均匀质量分布比双峰高斯分布提供更紧致的约束，而纳入亚太阳质量中子星可进一步降低低于饱和密度区域的EoS不确定性。
AI.motivation: 中子星的物态方程（equation of state, EoS）是核天体物理中的核心问题，而未来第三代引力波探测器将提供大量双中子星并合引力波事件。然而，有多少观测事件以及中子星质量分布如何影响EoS参数的约束能力尚需系统评估。
AI.method: 研究者利用零惯性系波形模型生成模拟引力波信号，对每个事件计算Fisher信息矩阵（Fisher information matrix）。持有非EoS波形参数固定于注入值后，将所有事件的Fisher矩阵累加得到EoS参数的协方差矩阵，进而由该协方差生成EoS、潮汐形变度、半径和核参数的后验样本。质量分布模型包括双峰高斯分布、均匀分布以及包含亚太阳质量中子星的均匀分布三种情形。
AI.result: 事件数越多，约束越紧致，符合检测数量增加导致信息累积的预期。更关键的是，质量分布对EoS约束的影响更大：均匀分布优于双峰高斯分布，因其包含更多低质量和高质量中子星；同时，约1.4倍太阳质量附近的事件对EoS提供部分冗余信息。此外，纳入亚太阳质量中子星可显著降低次饱和密度（sub-saturation densities）区域及内壳层（inner-crust）的EoS不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调，单纯增加事件数量对EoS约束的提升有限，而质量分布的选择（尤其是包含低质量和亚太阳质量中子星的样本）对约束效果起决定性作用。这凸显了次饱和密度区域EoS的重要性，对未来第三代探测器时代的观测策略具有指导意义。

title: Signatures of spin-wave dynamics in quasiparticle interference
summary: We investigate momentum-resolved quasiparticle interference (QPI) in a localized-itinerant antiferromagnet, where ordered local moments are exchange coupled to conduction electrons. Static antiferromagnetic order reconstructs the electronic bands, while one-magnon processes further dress the quasiparticles through a momentum- and frequency-dependent self-energy. Incorporating this dynamical renormalization directly into the Born impurity scattering, we find a characteristic crossover in the QPI spectrum. Below the lower magnon-emission edge, the modification is predominantly dispersive and governed by the real part of the self-energy, whereas above this scale its imaginary part produces pronounced broadening and redistribution of the scattering intensity. The dynamical response persists beyond the upper magnon energy and is strongly asymmetric in tunneling bias for a particle--hole-asymmetric band. These results show that Fourier-transform tunneling spectroscopy can distinguish static magnetic reconstruction from dynamical spin-wave renormalization.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用动量分辨的准粒子干涉（QPI）谱学，系统分析了局域-巡游反铁磁体系中静态磁序重建与自旋波（spin-wave）动力学重整化对电子学性质的可区分性影响，发现傅里叶变换隧穿谱学能够有效鉴别这两类磁序效应。
AI.motivation: 局域-巡游反铁磁体中，静态反铁磁序和单磁子（one-magnon）动力学过程都会影响电子能带与准粒子性质，但现有方法难以区分这两种贡献。研究旨在利用QPI谱的特征性交叉行为，为实验上甄别静态磁重构与动力学自旋波重整化提供判据。
AI.method: 作者在局域-巡游反铁磁模型中将有序局域磁矩与传导电子进行交换耦合，考虑静态反铁磁序引起的能带重构，并通过动量与频率依赖的自能（self-energy）引入单磁子过程的动力学重整化。随后将这一动力学重整化直接纳入Born杂质散射框架，计算动量分辨的QPI谱。
AI.result: QPI谱中出现特征性交叉行为：在低磁子发射（magnon-emission）能量边以下，谱的修正以自能实部主导的色散性变化为主；超过该能量尺度的区间，自能虚部导致散射强度的显著展宽与重新分布。动力学响应能延伸至磁子能量上限之上，且对粒子-空穴不对称能带而言在隧穿偏压（tunneling bias）方向上呈现强烈不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，傅里叶变换隧穿谱学（Fourier-transform tunneling spectroscopy）能够区分静态磁序重建与动力学自旋波重整化对电子结构的影响，为相关实验测量提供明确的理论依据。

title: Discrete Dirac equation on quantum graphs: A model of a Dirac particle in a branched lattice
summary: We study the one-dimensional time-independent discrete Dirac equation on graphs with discrete edges. Both continuous and discrete formulations of the graphs are considered, with particular focus on star graphs with three edges as a simple example. Exact solutions for eigenstates and spectra are derived and compared with the continuum case, showing good agreement in tabulated results. This approach offers a systematic framework for analyzing relativistic quantum transport on branched structures relevant to nanostructures and quantum device design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一维与时间无关的离散狄拉克方程（discrete Dirac equation）在离散边图结构上的性质，重点考察了具有三条边的星形图（star graph），推导出精确的本征态与谱解，并与连续情形对照，结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 为纳米结构与量子器件中带电粒子的相对论性量子输运提供系统性分析框架，特别是针对分支化结构。
AI.method: 考虑图结构的连续与离散两种表述形式，以三支星形图作为典型示例，求解一维时不变离散狄拉克方程，推导本征态与本征谱的精确解。
AI.result: 得到的精确解与连续情形的计算结果进行了比较，表格结果显示二者具有良好的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分析分支结构上相对论性量子输运提供了一种系统化方法，可应用于纳米结构与量子器件设计。

title: A Dark-Dimension Origin of Geometric Inelastic Dark Matter: The LUX-ZEPLIN High-Recoil Event and Multi-Target Tests
summary: The extended nuclear-recoil analysis of LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) has reported one event compatible with a recoil energy near $248$ keV, motivating endothermic dark-matter scenarios with support at large recoil energy. We study a pseudo-Dirac electroweak-doublet dark-matter model embedded in a five-dimensional Dark-Dimension framework. The Standard Model and the vectorlike electroweak doublets are localized on the visible brane, while dark-number violation is communicated through a neutral bulk state. The resulting mass splitting is exponentially suppressed, $δ=δ_{\rm UV}e^{-2πMR}$, providing a geometric origin for the few-hundred-keV scale relevant to inelastic scattering. The neutral weak current is dominantly off diagonal, fixing the neutron-scale normalization at $σ_{χn}^{Z}\simeq1.86\times10^{-39}\,\mathrm{cm^2}$. Using a two-bin Poisson diagnostic of the extended LZ recoil window, we find a shallow minimum near $(m_χ,δ)\simeq(1.35~\TeV,366~\keV)$, while the thermally motivated point $(1.1~\TeV,360~\keV)$ lies only $Δχ^2\simeq0.21$ higher. The same benchmark is kinematically inaccessible to light targets but remains open for xenon and tungsten, providing a characteristic multi-target test of the model. For CaWO$_4$ we obtain an integrated tungsten rate of $3.15\times10^{-2}$ events kg$^{-1}$ yr$^{-1}$ in the $95$--$150$ keV interval. These results connect the geometric origin of the pseudo-Dirac splitting with high-recoil direct-detection phenomenology.

AI.tldr: 该论文在五维暗维度（dark dimension）框架下研究一种伪狄拉克（pseudo-Dirac）电弱双重态暗物质模型，用以解释LUX-ZEPLIN实验中观测到的一个约248 keV高反冲能事件。模型通过几何起源产生指数压低的暗数破缺质量劈裂，预测的散射截面与热产生基准点与实验数据吻合，并在氙和钨等多个靶材料上提供可检验的预言。
AI.motivation: LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）扩展核反冲分析报告了一个反冲能约248 keV的事件，这与大反冲能区域存在的吸热型暗物质（endothermic dark-matter）场景相吻合，亟需理论模型解释这一异常信号。
AI.method: 该工作将标准模型和矢量型（vectorlike）电弱双重态定域在可见膜上，通过中性体空间态（bulk state）介导暗数守恒破缺，使质量劈裂呈指数压低形式δ=δ_UV e^{-2πMR}，由此从几何机制自然产生几百keV量级的质量差。作者采用扩展LZ反冲窗口的两子箱泊松（two-bin Poisson）诊断方法进行参数拟合，并对不同靶材料计算反冲速率。
AI.result: 中性弱流主要呈非对角主导，固定了中子尺度归一化截面σ_{χn}^Z≈1.86×10^-39 cm²。两子箱泊松分析发现浅最小位于(m_χ,δ)≈(1.35 TeV, 366 keV)，而热产生基准点(1.1 TeV, 360 keV)仅比最佳点高出Δχ²≈0.21。该基准点对轻靶材料在运动学上不可达，但对氙和钨靶开放；对CaWO₄靶在95–150 keV区间的集成钨反冲率为3.15×10^-2 events kg^-1 yr^-1。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将伪狄拉克质量劈裂的几何起源与高反冲直接探测现象学联系起来，为解释LZ的大反冲能事件提供了具有多种靶材料可检验预言的暗物质理论框架。

title: Detectability of bulk viscosity effects on post-merger gravitational wave signals from binary neutron star mergers
summary: We investigate bulk viscosity (BV) effects on post-merger gravitational wave (PMGW) signals from binary neutron star (BNS) mergers and their detectability using realistic equation of state (EoS) posteriors constrained by recent progress in gravitational-wave (GW) and X-ray observations, as well as neutron skin thickness measurements. A linear fitting formula based on recent BNS simulations with BV is used to estimate the peak frequency shift of the PMGWs caused by BV effects. Subsequently, we evaluate this peak frequency shift for our set of EoS posterior samples. We use the Fisher information matrix and the dataset of simulated observable events from the ET and CE detector network in an optimistic scenario to estimate the measurement accuracy of the peak frequency. We find that BV effects on PMGWs may be detectable only for EoS models with large values of the symmetry energy slope ($L_{\rm sym}$), as favored by neutron-skin thickness measurements. Thus, the detection of BV effects on PMGWs itself can provide abundant information about the symmetry energy and its slope. However, BV effects on PMGWs are generally weak and may be observed only in some extreme and optimistic cases. Therefore, observations of PMGWs and their analyses may not be able to provide very accurate measurements of the symmetry energy through BV effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了双中子星（BNS）并合后引力波（PMGW）信号中的体黏度（BV）效应，并利用近期引力波、X射线及中子皮厚度观测所约束的真实物态方程（EoS）后验样本，结合Fisher信息矩阵和ET/CE探测器网络的模拟事件，评估了BV效应引起峰频移的可探测性。研究发现BV效应仅在对称能斜率（L_sym）较大的EoS模型中可能被探测到，且仅在极端乐观情形下成立。
AI.motivation: 体黏度效应是影响双中子星并合后引力波信号的重要物理机制之一，但其可探测性及对核物质对称能约束的能力尚不明确。作者旨在利用当前引力波、X射线和中子皮厚度观测约束下的现实EoS后验分布，评估在第二代和第三代引力波探测器网络中BV效应对PMWG信号的可探测性。
AI.method: 作者采用基于近期含BV效应的BNS模拟得到的线性拟合公式来估计BV效应导致的PMWG峰频移量，随后将该公式应用于一组由最新观测（引力波、X射线及中子皮厚度测量）约束的EoS后验样本上。可探测性评估使用Fisher信息矩阵（Fisher information matrix），并结合ET和CE探测器网络在乐观情形下的模拟观测事件数据集来计算峰频测量精度。
AI.result: 研究发现BV效应对PMGW信号的影响仅在具有较大对称能斜率L_sym值的EoS模型中可能被探测到，这与中子皮厚度测量所偏好的EoS相一致；然而BV效应总体较弱，仅在部分极端和乐观情形下可观测。
AI.conclusion: 对PMGW中BV效应的探测本身可提供关于核物质对称能及其斜率的信息，但由于BV效应通常较弱，PMGW观测及其分析可能无法通过BV效应给出非常精确的对称能测量值。

title: Statistical mechanical evaluation of a spread-spectrum watermarking model with image restoration II AT stability of a hybrid system with message decoding and image
summary: In the previous paper (arxiv.org/abs/1209.4772), we proposed a spread-spectrum watermarking model with image restoration based on Bayes estimation assuming several prior probabilities and adopting the Gaussian channel model to represent attacks from unauthorized users. When an image is generated from the infinite range Ising model, we analyzed the model using the statistical mechanical method, the replica method, and derived the replica symmetric (RS) solution and performed Markov chain Monte Carlo simulations. The theoretical results of the RS solution and the simulation results were in good agreement except for some range of parameters. We treated the informed case where only the original image is known and the blind case where both the original message and the original image are unknown and found that the difference between these cases was small as long as the embedding and attack rates were small. In this paper, we treat the blind case and investigate the de Almeida-Thouless (AT) stability of the RS solution and reveal that the AT stability is broken in the range of parameters where theoretical and simulation results do not agree.

AI.tldr: 本文是作者前序工作（arXiv:1209.4772）的后续研究，针对基于贝叶斯估计的扩频水印（spread-spectrum watermarking）模型，在盲情形（blind case）下对无限范围伊辛模型（infinite range Ising model）生成的图像进行统计力学分析，检验了复制对称（replica symmetric, RS）解的 AT 稳定性，并揭示理论结果与模拟结果不一致的参数范围内 AT 稳定性确实被破坏。
AI.motivation: 针对前续论文中在高斯信道模型下利用复制方法推导的 RS 解，其理论结果与马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov chain Monte Carlo）模拟在某些参数范围内不一致，需要解释导致分歧的根本原因。
AI.method: 采用 d'Athouless-Toulouse（AT）稳定性方法，在盲情形下考察 RS 解的局部稳定性条件，系统检查导致复制对称破缺（replica symmetry breaking）的参数区域。
AI.result: 发现在理论结果与模拟结果不一致的参数范围内，RS 解的 AT 稳定性确实被破坏，说明原有复制对称近似在该区域失效。
AI.conclusion: RS 解在这些参数区域失效的原因在于复制对称性自发破缺，需要在后续工作中采用更高级的复制对称破缺方案或修改退火近似以获得精确的理论预测。

title: Topology Obstructs Pure Foundation Neural Quantum States
summary: Foundation models for ground states in spin-1/2 systems are a promising method for problems ranging from quantum chemistry to identifying new phase diagrams. Nearly all such models are currently pure-states that condition on the Hamiltonian's parameters, whose Monte Carlo samples give energy estimates according to the variational principle. In this contribution, we show that this representation is topologically obstructed. For any gapped Hamiltonian family whose ground-state bundle is non-trivial, every continuous normalized state-vector model has zero fidelity with the ground state at some parameter value in the Hamiltonian family. For that value, the energy is at least one spectral gap, $Δ$, with an $O(Δ)$ gap in an open-neighbourhood of that point. We show that this is a sufficient no-go also in the case of degenerate ground-state manifolds, time dynamics, and periodic systems with mixed space-time topology, demonstrating these obstructions on one- and two-qubit systems. We discuss how this causes a spike in the fidelity susceptibility, giving a numerical signature of a phase-transition where there is none. We then show that operator-valued models canonically avoid these obstructions and preserve topological information, implying a structural necessity in representation for foundation neural quantum states.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了自旋1/2系统基态的基础模型（foundation model）若使用连续的归一化态矢量表示，在拓扑非平凡（topologically non-trivial）的哈密顿量族中必然在某个参数点与真实的基态保真度为零，能量至少偏离一个谱间隙Δ。作者指出算子值模型（operator-valued models）能规范地规避此类拓扑障碍并保留拓扑信息，从而暗示了基础神经量子态在表示上的结构性需求。
AI.motivation: 自旋1/2系统基态的基础模型在量子化学到相图识别等领域具有广阔应用前景，但几乎所有现有模型都是纯态条件表示（依赖于哈密顿量参数），其有效性尚未经过严格的拓扑检验，本研究旨在揭示这种表示的固有局限性。
AI.method: 作者从拓扑学角度分析基于哈密顿量参数的连续归一化态矢量模型：针对基态丛（ground-state bundle）非平凡的有能隙哈密顿量族，证明存在参数值使模型与基态保真度为零，并推广到简并基态流形、时间动力学以及具有混合时空拓扑的周期系统中，在单量子位和双量子位系统上给出具体演示。
AI.result: 对于基态丛非平凡的任何有能隙哈密顿量族，任意连续归一化态矢量模型在某一参数点与真实基态的保真度为零，该点能量至少偏离一个谱间隙Δ，且其邻域内存在O(Δ)的能隙。该no-go结论在简并基态、时间动力学及混合时空拓扑的周期系统中依然成立。这种拓扑障碍会导致保真度磁化率（fidelity susceptibility）出现尖峰，从而产生虚假的相变数值信号。
AI.conclusion: 算子值模型（operator-valued models）能够规范地规避这些拓扑障碍并保留拓扑信息，这表明对于基础神经量子态而言，算子值表示是一种结构性必然，而非可选的设计方案。

title: CoportSL: A Contribution-constrained Hybrid Slow-light Framework for Time-dependent Polarized GRMHD Imaging
summary: Fast-light approximations neglect fluid evolution along rays, whereas slow-light modeling is indispensable for recovering the true magnetohydrodynamic state. However, full slow-light radiative transfer for extended general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) sources requires simultaneous access to many fluid snapshots and is memory-intensive. We introduce CoportSL, the first contribution-constrained hybrid slow-light framework for time-dependent full-Stokes imaging. It uses emission, absorption, and Faraday contributions to identify where fluid evolution must be retained, applies fast light elsewhere, and loads only snapshots spanning the relevant delays. Tests with M87*-like magnetically arrested disk GRMHD data show that the contribution-based region and delay-based snapshot restrictions each keep normalized full-image Stokes differences below $4\times10^{-3}$ relative to the corresponding complete calculation. At this accuracy, CoportSL requires 75.3% and 44.7% fewer snapshot layers for near-horizon and jet images, respectively; its per-frame slow-light transfer time remains comparable to fast light. For the two configurations, source-code estimates place the capacities of the principal data structures at 255-657 GiB for a fixed public ipole version and 20.2-37.3GiB for CoportSL, bringing both configurations within workstation-scale memory. Fast--slow comparisons further show close agreement in near-horizon variability, whereas jet variability follows similar overall trends but differs in local peaks and amplitudes; in both cases, fast light misses substantial full-Stokes spatial structure. As the next-generation Event Horizon Telescope (ngEHT) advances toward dynamical imaging and spatially resolved polarimetry, CoportSL provides a computationally practical way to model full-Stokes finite-light-travel-time signatures in extended black hole systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoportSL——首个基于贡献约束的混合慢光（slow-light）框架，用于时变全斯托克斯参数（full-Stokes）成像。它通过发射、吸收和法拉第贡献判定流体演化必须保留的区域，在其他区域使用快光（fast-light）近似，并仅加载覆盖相关时间延迟的快照。在 M87* 类磁化停滞盘 GRMHD 数据测试中，该方法将图像差异控制在 4×10⁻³ 以下，同时显著减少快照层需求（减少 75.3% 和 44.7%），并将内存需求从数百 GiB 降至工作站规模（20-37 GiB），近地平线和喷流图像的慢光传输时间与快光相当。
AI.motivation: 快光近似（fast-light approximation）忽略流体沿光线传播过程中的演化，而慢光建模（slow-light modeling）对于恢复真实的磁流体动力学（magnetohydrodynamic, MHD）状态不可或缺。然而，针对扩展广义相对论磁流体动力学（GRMHD）源的完整慢光辐射转移需要同时访问大量流体快照，导致内存开销巨大，这一问题限制了慢光方法在时变全斯托克斯成像中的应用。
AI.method: CoportSL 框架首先利用发射（emission）、吸收（absorption）和法拉第（Faraday）贡献识别流体演化必须被保留的空间区域，其余区域采用快光近似；随后仅加载跨越相关时间延迟所需的流体快照子集。该方法通过贡献约束和延迟约束的双重限制来近似完整慢光辐射转移计算。
AI.result: 在 M87* 类磁化停滞盘（magnetically arrested disk）GRMHD 数据测试中，贡献约束区域和延迟约束快照筛选均使归一化全斯托克斯图像差异保持在 4×10⁻³ 以下。近地平线和喷流图像分别减少 75.3% 和 44.7% 的快照层需求；每帧慢光传输时间与快光可比。主数据结构容量从固定 ipole 版本的 255-657 GiB 降至 CoportSL 的 20.2-37.3 GiB，达到工作站级内存标准。快-慢光对比显示近地平线变率高度一致，而喷流变率总体趋势相近但局部峰值和振幅存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 在下一代事件视界望远镜（ngEHT）向动力学成像和空间分辨偏振测量发展的背景下，CoportSL 为扩展黑洞系统中全斯托克斯有限光传播时间（finite-light-travel-time）信号建模提供了计算上实用的方案，兼顾了准确性与可及性。

title: Near-Field Spin Seebeck Effect
summary: The conventional spin Seebeck effect generates spin currents through interfacial thermal conduction. In this Letter, we establish a photon-mediated spin Seebeck effect driven by near-field thermal radiation. Using a monolayer transition metal dichalcogenide separated from a thermal emitter by a vacuum gap, we demonstrate Rashba spin-orbit coupling can convert optical orbital excitations into an electron spin polarization. This occurs via two complementary mechanisms: the direct transfer of angular momentum from chiral thermal photons, and the rectification of unpolarized thermal fluctuations by a magnetized two-dimensional electron gas. These findings unveil a radiative pathway for nanoscale electron spin manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一种由光子介导的自旋塞贝克效应（photon-mediated spin Seebeck effect），利用近场热辐射驱动自旋电流产生，不同于传统通过界面热传导实现的自旋塞贝克效应。
AI.motivation: 传统的自旋塞贝克效应依赖界面热传导来产生自旋电流，作者希望探索一种全新的辐射途径，通过近场热辐射实现纳米尺度的电子自旋操控。
AI.method: 采用单层过渡金属二硫化物（transition metal dichalcogenide）作为体系，与热发射体之间以真空间隙分离，利用拉什巴自旋轨道耦合（Rashba spin-orbit coupling）将光学轨道激发转化为电子自旋极化，并分析了两种互补机制：手性热光子直接传递角动量，以及磁化二维电子气对非偏振热涨落的整流作用。
AI.result: 证明了近场热辐射可以驱动光子介导的自旋塞贝克效应，通过两种互补机制产生电子自旋极化。
AI.conclusion: 发现了一条用于纳米级电子自旋操控的辐射途径（radiative pathway），为自旋电子学提供了新的物理机制。

title: On the stationary measures of the critical Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process
summary: We study linear and symmetric diffusion processes on $\mathbb{R}^{\mathbb{Z}^d}$ that can be seen as the Langevin dynamics of the (inhomogeneous) harmonic crystal for given conductances, with a particular focus on their stationary distributions. Despite the linearity of the interaction, we exhibit a rich variety of behaviours, depending on the disorder encoded by the conductances. Our main results provide essentially sharp criteria on the conductances ensuring that every stationary measure is reversible. We also provide examples for which these criteria fail and where either no stationary measures exist or reversible and non-reversible stationary measures coexist. Additionally, we show that the linear system can even exhibit non-trivial time-periodic behaviour and provide a spectral characterisation of the occurrence of such oscillations. The case of deterministic conductances is complemented by a study of the case of random conductances under quite general moment assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究以非齐次调和晶体（harmonic crystal）的朗之万动力学（Langevin dynamics）为背景的线性对称扩散过程，给出了平稳测度为可逆测度的几乎精确的判定准则，并展示了非可逆平稳测度共存、不存在平稳测度以及非平凡时间周期震荡等丰富行为。
AI.motivation: 尽管相互作用是线性的，但由电导（conductance）所编码的无序性可能导致系统行为的高度复杂性，因此需要系统刻画哪些条件下平稳测量是可逆的，并理解偏离这些条件的后果。
AI.method: 研究对象为定义在\mathbb{R}^{\mathbb{Z}^d}上的线性对称扩散过程，其可视为给定电导下非齐次调和晶体的朗之万动力学。作者从平稳分布出发，推导了保证所有平稳测度为可逆测度的电导判定准则，并在此基础上构造反例以检验准则的尖锐性；对确定性电导情形辅以随机电导在一般矩假设下的研究，并给出时间周期性振荡的谱刻画（spectral characterisation）。
AI.result: 获得了关于电导条件的本质尖锐判定准则，确保所有平稳测量均为可逆的；同时构造了准则失效的例子，其中要么不存在平稳测度，要么可逆与非可逆的平稳测度共存。此外还证明系统能表现出非平凡的随时间周期震荡行为，并给出了此类震荡发生的谱特征化。
AI.conclusion: 线性扩散系统中，即使在相互作用为线性的情况下，电导所编码的无序也足以引致从唯一可逆平稳态到非可逆平稳态共存乃至周期震荡的丰富动力学行为谱系；所得判定准则几乎尖锐，对确定性与随机电导（在一般矩假设下）均适用。

title: $β-(Al_{0.19} Ga_{0.81})_2 O_3/Ga_2 O_3$ Modulation-Doped Field-Effect Transistors with $>$ 6 kV Breakdown
summary: $β-(Al_{0.19} Ga_{0.81})_2 O_3/Ga_2 O_3$ modulation-doped field-effect transistors (MODFETs) incorporating a high-quality Al2O3 gate dielectric and SiNx passivation are demonstrated for high-voltage operation. The devices exhibited a maximum drain current of 54 mA/mm, an on-resistance of 149 Ohm.mm, a minimum subthreshold slope of 94 mV/dec, and an ION/IOFF ratio exceeding $10^8$. Three-terminal breakdown measurements performed in Flourinert demonstrated a breakdown voltage that increased with gate-drain spacing, reaching 6.6 kV for a device with LGD = 28 microns. The corresponding average lateral electric field approached 2.4 MV/cm, while a power figure of merit of 222 MW/cm2 was achieved. To the best of the authors knowledge, the demonstrated breakdown voltage represents the highest reported value for a $β-(Al_x Ga_{1-x})_2 O_3/Ga_2 O_3$ MODFET and highlights the potential of modulation-doped $β$-Ga2O3 heterostructures for next-generation multi-kV power devices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了集成高质量Al₂O₃栅介质与SiNx钝化的β-(Al₀.₁₉Ga₀.₈₁)₂O₃/Ga₂O₃调制掺杂场效应晶体管（MODFET），实现了6.6 kV的击穿电压，为同类器件中的最高报告值，展示了其在下一代多千伏级功率器件中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 氧化镓材料因其超宽带隙特性在高功率电子器件中具有前景，但β-(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃/Ga₂O₃调制掺杂异质结构在高压应用中的击穿能力尚未得到充分验证，需要实验证明其潜力。
AI.method: 制备了包含Al₂O₃栅介质和SiNx钝化层的β-(Al₀.₁₉Ga₀.₈₁)₂O₃/Ga₂O₃调制掺杂场效应晶体管，并在Flourinert环境中进行三端击穿测量，以不同栅漏间距（LGD）考察击穿电压的变化。
AI.result: 器件实现了最大漏极电流54 mA/mm、导通电阻149 Ω·mm、最小亚阈值摆幅94 mV/dec以及超过10⁸的开关电流比。在栅漏间距为28微米时获得6.6 kV击穿电压，平均横向电场接近2.4 MV/cm，功率优值（power figure of merit）达222 MW/cm²。
AI.conclusion: 该6.6 kV击穿电压是β-(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃/Ga₂O₃ MODFET中报道的最高值，强调了调制掺杂β-Ga₂O₃异质结构在下一代多千伏功率器件中的潜力。

title: Local gradient neural operator
comment: 29 pages, 11 figures. Code available at https://github.com/baiming-zhang/LGNO
summary: Field temporal prediction and source identification constitute canonical problems in dynamical systems. Conventional approaches to these problems depend on a thorough understanding of the governing partial differential equations (PDEs). Recently, deep learning, as represented by neural operators, has provided a data-driven paradigm for addressing such tasks. However, most existing global neural operators for PDEs require large training datasets and many learnable parameters, with limited interpretability and generalization. We propose the local gradient neural operator (LGNO) as a lightweight and interpretable alternative for field temporal evolution prediction and source identification in typical mechanical problems. The method builds on priors from nonlinear gradient discretization and uses multilayer perceptron convolutional layers to learn translation-invariant local kernels that resemble discrete stencils. A zero consistent stencil factorization separates coefficient learning from field reconstruction, rendering the learned operators more transparent. For problems with symmetries, network folding shares equivalent components and reduces parameter counts. We evaluate the method on PDE benchmarks covering linear and nonlinear, static and dynamic, and low and high dimensional cases. Results show that LGNO maintains accuracy, parameter efficiency, and rollout stability across these tasks, and further exhibits wide applicability to mechanical problems including diffusion, flow, and quantum phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出局部梯度神经算子（local gradient neural operator, LGNO），一种轻量级且可解释的深度学习框架，用于预测偏微分方程（PDE）所描述的时空演化并进行源识别。该方法基于非线性梯度离散化的先验知识，采用多层感知机卷积层学习类似离散模板的可平移局部核，通过零一致性模板分解提升算子透明度，并在对称性存在时通过网络折叠减少参数。实验覆盖线性和非线性、静态和动态、低维和高维等多种PDE基准，表明LGNO在精度、参数效率和推演稳定性方面均表现优异，并适用于扩散、流动和量子力学等多种力学问题。
AI.motivation: 传统场时空预测与源识别问题依赖对控制偏微分方程（PDE）的深入理解，而现有全局神经算子（neural operators）虽提供数据驱动替代方案，但普遍需要大规模训练数据和大量可学习参数，且可解释性与泛化能力有限。
AI.method: LGNO基于非线性梯度离散化的先验信息，使用多层感知机卷积层学习具有平移不变性的局部核（local kernels），该核结构类似于离散差分模板（discrete stencils）。方法进一步引入零一致性模板分解（zero consistent stencil factorization），将系数学习与场重构分离，增强算子的可解释性；对于具有对称性的问题，网络折叠（network folding）共享等效组件以减少参数数量。
AI.result: 在涵盖线性和非线性、静态和动态、低维和高维PDE基准上的评估显示，LGNO在精度、参数效率和推演稳定性方面均能保持良好性能；该方法的广泛适用性还体现在扩散（diffusion）、流动（flow）和量子现象（quantum phenomena）等一系列典型力学问题中。
AI.conclusion: LGNO为场时空演化预测与源识别提供了一种轻量、可解释且在多种力学问题上具有广泛适用性的新范式，相较于现有的全局神经算子更具参数效率和透明度。

title: Connecting Regge factorization and Collins-Soper evolution
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Proceedings of the 33rd International Workshop on Deep Inelastic Scattering and Related Subjects (DIS2026), 4-8 May 2026, Bologna, Italy
summary: The relationship between Regge factorization of amplitudes and the Collins-Soper-Sterman factorization of hadronic cross sections is explored. Seeking a unified description of rapidity divergences in high-energy scattering and transverse-momentum-dependent factorization, a connection emerges between the Collins-Soper kernel and the Regge trajectory. This provides a framework for bridging high-energy and low-transverse-momentum resummation and for future extensions of $k_T$-factorization beyond leading-logarithmic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了振幅的Regge因子化（Regge factorization）与强子截面的Collins-Soper-Sterman（CSS）因子化之间的关系，指出Collins-Soper核与Regge轨迹（trajectory）之间存在联系，为统一定义高能散射与横向动量依赖因子化中的快度发散（rapidity divergences）提供了框架，并可推动$k_T$因子化向超出领头对数精度扩展。
AI.motivation: 高能散射中的快度发散与横向动量依赖（transverse-momentum-dependent, TMD）因子化分别由不同理论框架描述，两者之间缺少统一的联系。
AI.method: 通过探索Regge因子化与Collins-Soper-Sterman因子化之间的深层关系，建立起Collins-Soper核（kernel）与Regge轨迹之间的概念性关联。
AI.result: 发现Collins-Soper核与Regge轨迹之间存在一种联系，为桥接高能与低横向动量区域的重求和（resummation）提供了统一的框架基础。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅统一了高能与低$k_T$区域的描述，还为未来将$k_T$因子化推广至超越领头对数（leading-logarithmic）精度提供了路径。

title: Fractional Bose-Einstein Condensate Dark Matter Cores: Numerical GPP Solutions and SPARC Rotation Curves
summary: We investigate a fractional Bose Einstein condensate dark matter scenario in which an ultralight bosonic component forms a self gravitating core embedded in a predominantly cold dark matter halo. The stationary GPP system solved numerically beyond the TF approximation leads to energetically bound equilibrium configurations and good phenomenological fits to the selected rotation curves from 30 SPARC galaxies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种分数阶玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚暗物质（fractional Bose-Einstein condensate dark matter）模型，其中超轻玻色组分在主要由冷暗物质构成的晕中形成自引力核心。作者在超越托马斯—费米近似（Thomas-Fermi approximation）的数值解下求解了定态格罗斯—皮塔耶夫斯基—泊松（Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson，GPP）方程组，得到能量上有界的平衡构型，并对30个SPARC星系的旋转曲线给出了良好的唯象拟合。
AI.motivation: 探究分数阶玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚暗物质模型的可行性，考察介于纯凝聚模型与冷暗物质模型之间的混合情形能否更好地解释星系旋转曲线观测数据。
AI.method: 构建包含超轻玻色组分的分数阶BEC暗物质模型，其自引力核心嵌入于冷暗物质晕中；数值求解稳态GPP方程组，并超越托马斯—费米近似以获得准确的平衡解；选取30个SPARC星系旋转曲线进行拟合验证。
AI.result: 数值求解获得能量上有界的平衡构型；模型对所选30个SPARC星系的旋转曲线呈现出良好的唯象拟合效果（phenomenological fits）。
AI.conclusion: 该分数阶BEC暗物质与冷暗物质混合模型能够产生自洽的平衡构型，并有效再现SPARC星系旋转曲线的观测特征，为该类混合暗物质场景提供了观测支持的证据。

title: Machine learning for the design and prediction of soft-magnetic electromagnetic shielding FeCo-based alloys in laser cladding
summary: Electromagnetic shielding materials play a pivotal role in both aerospace applications and daily life. However, their design and manufacturing still face persistent challenges. Machine learning demonstrates significant potential in accelerating material development and compositions optimization. Furthermore, laser additive manufacturing provides powerful technical support for fabricating multi-component, multifunctional electromagnetic shielding materials with tailored properties. In this study, the multiple machine learning strategies have been proposed, based on experimental derivation and soft magnetic material databases, to accelerate the design of multifunctional FeCo-based alloys for electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding within an almost infinite compositional space. This work presents a novel approach for the rapid and automated discovery of multifunctional alloys with optimized EMI shielding effectiveness, as well as enhanced magnetic and electrical properties.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于实验推导和软磁材料数据库的多种机器学习（machine learning）策略，用于在近乎无限的成分空间中加速设计面向电磁干扰（electromagnetic interference, EMI）屏蔽的多功能铁钴（FeCo）基合金。
AI.motivation: 电磁屏蔽材料在航空航天和日常生活中均发挥关键作用，但其设计与制造仍面临持续性挑战。
AI.method: 结合机器学习策略与激光增材制造（laser additive manufacturing）技术，基于实验推导和软磁材料数据库，在广阔成分空间中筛选多功能FeCo基合金。
AI.result: 实现了对具备优化EMI屏蔽效能以及增强磁性和电性能的多功能合金的快速、自动化发现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多功能合金的快速自动化发现提供了一种新方法，兼顾EMI屏蔽效能与磁电性能的综合优化。

title: Weighted isoperimetry implies percolation
summary:
Consider an infinite edge-weighted graph satisfying an isoperimetric inequality of the type $\|\partial A\|\geq C|A|^α$ for some $α,C>0$, where $\|\partial A\|$ denotes the weighted size of the edge boundary of $A$. We prove that, for $C$ large enough depending on $α$, if each edge is open independently with probability given by its weight, then any vertex is connected to infinity with positive probability. The result also holds under weaker isoperimetric assumptions and on finite graphs.
  The proof brings a new perspective on the recent proof of the Benjamini--Schramm conjecture concerning the same problem with homogeneous weights. The crucial novelty in our proof is that, rather than simply counting cutsets, we introduce a new Peierls argument which takes into account internal and external connectivity costs in addition to the cost of the blocking surface.
  We provide two applications for the above result. First, we show that every non-summable long-range percolation on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, $d\geq 2$, admits a percolating truncation, solving a conjecture of Sidoravicius, Surgailis and Vares and its generalization by Friedli and de Lima. Secondly, we show that there exists a universal constant $C < \infty$ such that $p_{\mathrm{c}} \leq C/Δ$ for every transitive graph of superlinear growth and vertex degree $Δ$, thus proving a conjecture of Easo and Hutchcroft.

AI.tldr: 本文研究满足等周不等式（isoperimetric inequality）的无穷边权图上的伯努利边渗流（Bernoulli percolation），证明当等周常数足够大时，顶点连通到无穷的概率为正。该证明引入了一种新的 Peierls 论证（Peierls argument），同时考虑阻塞表面的成本及内部和外部的连通成本。作为应用，解决了 Sidoravicius–Surgailis–Vares 猜想（任意不可和的长程渗流存在渗流截断）以及 Easo–Hutchcroft 猜想（超线性增长传递图的临界概率上界）。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在推广 Benjamini–Schramm 猜想（homogeneous weights 情形）的近期证明，处理非齐次权重的渗流问题，证明在满足一定等周不等式的图上，边以权重为概率独立开放时，能以正概率实现无穷连通。
AI.method: 核心方法是一种新的 Peierls 论证。与以往仅对割集（cutset）进行计数不同，该论证在计算阻塞曲面成本之外，还显式计入内部连通成本（internal connectivity cost）与外部连通成本（external connectivity cost），从而实现对非齐次权重情形下渗流相变（percolation transition）的判定。
AI.result: 证明了对满足等周不等式 $\|\partial A\|\geq C|A|^\alpha$ 的无穷边权图，当常数 $C$ 足够大（依赖 $\alpha$）时，任意顶点以正概率连通到无穷；该结果在更弱的等周假设及有限图上也成立。应用一：证明 $\mathbb{Z}^d$（$d\geq 2$）上每个不可和（non-summable）的长程渗流都存在渗流截断（percolating truncation），解决 Sidoravicius、Surgailis 与 Vares 的猜想及其由 Friedli 和 de Lima 提出的推广。应用二：证明存在普适常数 $C<\infty$，使得所有超线性增长（superlinear growth）的传递图（transitive graph）满足 $p_c\leq C/\Delta$（$\Delta$ 为顶点度数），从而证明 Easo 与 Hutchcroft 的猜想。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入计入内外连通成本的新的 Peierls 论证，本文建立了一个关于非齐次权重渗流的统一框架，并据此解决了两类重要猜想，展示了该方法的广泛适用性。

title: Stationary states for a particle in a box with slanted walls
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in Revista Brasileira de Ensino de Física
summary: The quantum mechanical problem of a particle in a infinite potential well with slanted walls is studied. The energy eigenvalues are determined by a transcendental equation involving the Airy function of the first kind. Two limiting cases are discussed. Next, the allowed energies are found by graphical and numerical methods. The graphical analysis hints that for large quantum numbers the consecutive energy levels get arbitrarily close together. This asymptotic behavior of the energy spectrum actually holds, as shown by means of an intuitive argument and confirmed by resorting to basic properties of Airy functions. In a sense, Bohr's correspondence principle is more accurately fulfilled than in the cases of the standard particle in a box or the harmonic oscillator. A state is regarded the more confined the less the probability of finding the particle in the classically forbidden region. For some stationary states the confinement degree is calculated and a comparison is made with the harmonic oscillator, for which the ground state is the least confined of all stationary states. In the symmetric case --- right and left walls of equal slope --- something unexpected happens: beyond a certain critical slope the ground state is no longer the least confined eigenstate. Over and above its interesting physical features, this problem provides students with the opportunity to get acquainted with Airy functions, which do not belong to the standard mathematical repertoire of physics undergraduates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种具有倾斜壁面的无限深势阱中粒子的量子力学问题，系统分析了其能谱特性、能量本征值的求解方法、束缚（confinement）性质以及玻尔对应原理（Bohr's correspondence principle）的满足情况。研究发现该系统的能级渐近行为优于标准粒子盒和谐振子，并在对称倾斜壁情况下出现了基态不再是最弱束缚态的意外结果。
AI.motivation: 标准量子力学教材多聚焦于无限深势阱（infinite potential well）与谐振子（harmonic oscillator）等经典模型，但学生对斜壁势阱中所涉及的艾里函数（Airy function）缺乏认识，且该系统的能谱与束缚性质呈现独特的物理特征，值得作为教学与理论研究的新案例。
AI.method: 通过求解含有第一类艾里函数（Airy function of the first kind）的超越方程（transcendental equation）来确定能量本征值，结合图形法与数值方法求解允许能级；利用艾里函数的基本性质给出高量子数极限下能级间距趋于零的严格证明；针对对称斜壁情形计算不同驻态的束缚程度并同谐振子进行比较。
AI.result: 图形分析提示高量子数下相邻能级间距趋于任意接近，该渐近行为经直觉论证并借助艾里函数基本性质得到确认；对称情况下，超过某一临界斜率后基态不再是束缚程度最弱的本征态；在束缚程度方面，该系统的对应原理满足程度比标准粒子盒与谐振子更为精确。
AI.conclusion: 斜壁势阱提供了比标准粒子盒与谐振子更精确满足玻尔对应原理的量子力学示例，并在对称斜壁情形下展现了基态束缚性质反转的意外现象。该问题兼具物理趣味与教学价值，能使本科生接触艾里函数这一非常规的数学工具，以扩充标准物理学课程之外的教学素材。

title: Conformally Interacting Dark Energy with Early and Late-Time Measurements
summary: The conformal interacting dark energy (CIDE) model is investigated by introducing a scalar field representing dark energy (DE) coupled to dark matter (DM) via a conformal transformation, thereby yielding a class of scalar-tensor theories. The interaction term ${Q}$, that indicts the flow of energy between the dark sectors is proportional to the trace of the energy momentum tensor of the DM fluid, $T^{\mathrm{DM}}_{μν}$, as ${Q}=\frac{C'(φ)}{2C(φ)}g^{μν}T^{\mathrm{DM}}_{μν}$, where $C(φ)$ is the conformal function of a scalar potential (coupling) field. We assume the power-law parametrization $C(φ)\propto (1+φ)^m$, with $m$ a coupling parameter, and determine the direction and magnitude of the energy flow between the DM and DE components. The dynamical nature of DE is modeled by the two conformal interacting scenarios, CIDE and $w$CIDE, with $w$ the DE equation of state parameter.
