To test the viability of each model, we constrain them using a combination of early- and late-time cosmological data, namely: CMB measurements from the South Pole Telescope, Planck 2018, and the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (DR6) (\texttt{CMB SPA}); BAO data from the Dark Energy Survey (\texttt{DESI DR2 BAO}); and Supernova Type Ia distance compilations (\texttt{PantheonPlus, PantheonPlus + SH0ES, Union3}, and \texttt{DES Dovekie}). Parameter inference is performed with Monte Carlo Markov Chain (\texttt{MCMC}) simulations using \texttt{COBAYA} and a modified \texttt{CLASS}. Further statistical analysis using the Akaike information criterion (AIC) and the Bayesian information criterion (BIC) is summarized to assess the viability of the model in comparison with the standard cosmological model, investigating the model's potential to alleviate the $H_0$ and $S_8$ tensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并检验了共形相互作用暗能量（CIDE）模型及其推广形式wCIDE，该模型通过共形变换引入标量场实现暗能量与暗物质之间的能量交换。利用CMB、BAO和超新星等多种观测数据，通过MCMC参数推断和AIC/BIC统计比较，评估该模型相对于标准宇宙学模型的可行性及其缓解H₀和S₈张力的潜力。
AI.motivation: 标准宇宙学模型在解释H₀和S₈张力方面面临挑战，暗能量与暗物质之间可能的相互作用为修改动力学提供了新途径。通过共形变换构造标量-张量理论，可系统探索暗物质与暗能量之间的能量流方向与大小，进而检验相互作用模型能否缓解当前的宇宙学张力。
AI.method: 引入满足共形变换的标量场和共形函数C(φ)，取幂律参数化C(φ)∝(1+φ)^m，从而构造CIDE和wCIDE两种模型，其中相互作用项Q正比于暗物质能动量张量的迹。联合CMB（SPT、Planck 2018、ACT DR6）、DESI DR2 BAO以及多种超新星数据集（PantheonPlus、SH0ES、Union3、DES Dovekie），利用修改的CLASS和COBAYA框架执行MCMC参数推断，并用AIC和BIC进行统计模型比较。
AI.result: 通过多数据集联合约束获得了CIDE和wCIDE模型中耦合参数m及暗能量状态方程参数w的参数后验分布，确定了暗物质与暗能量之间能量流的符号与大小。AIC与BIC统计量被用于量化两种模型相对于标准宇宙学模型的优劣，并考察了模型在缓解H₀与S₈张力方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: 共形相互作用暗能量模型为暗能量动力学及暗扇区相互作用提供了一般性理论框架，观测数据的联合约束与信息准则比较揭示了该模型相较于标准宇宙学模型的统计可行性，并评估了其在缓解H₀及S₈张力方面的实际潜力。

title: $^{139}$La nuclear quadrupole resonance studies of pressurized La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$
summary: Density-wave (DW) orders are considered as competing orders to unconventional superconductivity and are commonly seen in a variety of superconductors including but not limited to the recently discovered Ruddlesden-Popper-phase nickelates. By utilizing $^{139}$La nuclear quadrupole resonance, we systematically investigate into the nature of DW orders and their evolution under pressure in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. Spin and charge DW orders are found to be intertwined in this material, which is in stark contrast to those in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. Short-range DW orders are observed near 150 K, well above the development of long-range DW orders at around 139 K. Upon applying a hydrostatic pressure of 2.3 GPa, the transition temperatures of the short-range and long-range orders decrease at rates of 1 K/GPa and 10 K/GPa, respectively. Our results thus affirm that both spin density wave and charge density wave as competing orders with the superconducting state in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$, and provide new insights into the interplay between DW orders and unconventional superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用$^{139}$La核四极共振（nuclear quadrupole resonance, NQR）技术，系统研究了La₄Ni₃O₁₀中密度波（density-wave, DW）序的性质及其在压力下的演化。研究发现该材料中自旋密度波（spin density wave）与电荷密度波（charge density wave）相互交织，短程有序出现在约150 K，远高于约139 K出现的远程有序转变温度。在2.3 GPa静水压力下，短程与长程序的转变温度分别以1 K/GPa和10 K/GPa的速率降低。结果表明自旋密度波与电荷密度波是La₄Ni₃O₁₀中超导态的竞争序，为理解密度波序与非常规超导（unconventional superconductivity）之间的相互作用提供了新见解。
AI.motivation: 密度波（density-wave, DW）序被视为非常规超导（unconventional superconductivity）的竞争序，广泛存在于多种超导材料中，包括近期发现的Ruddlesden-Popper相镍酸盐（nickelates）。本研究旨在系统地探究La₄Ni₃O₁₀中密度波序的本质及其在压力下的演化行为。
AI.method: 采用$^{139}$La核四极共振（nuclear quadrupole resonance, NQR）技术，对La₄Ni₃O₁₀样品进行系统性测量，考察密度波序的性质及其随外施静水压力（hydrostatic pressure）的演化。
AI.result: 发现La₄Ni₃O₁₀中自旋密度波与电荷密度波相互交织（intertwined），与La₃Ni₂O₇中的行为形成鲜明对比。短程密度波序约在150 K出现，远高于约139 K的远程有序转变温度。在2.3 GPa压力下，短程与长程序的转变温度分别以1 K/GPa和10 K/GPa的速率下降。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证实自旋密度波与电荷密度波在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中作为超导态的竞争序存在，为密度波序与非常规超导之间相互作用的研究提供了新的启示。

title: The Dirichlet problem for a non-commutative elliptic operator in the ball
summary: In this paper we establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the solvability of the Dirichlet problem in the unit ball $\mathbb{B}$ for the second order system $\partial_{\underline{x}} f\partial_{\underline{x}}=0$, where $\partial_{\underline{x}}$ stands for the Clifford-algebra valued Dirac operator in $\mathbb{R}^m$. We prove that the problem admits a solution whenever the boundary data belong to $C^1(\partial\mathbb{B})$. Conversely, we construct explicit counterexamples showing that solvability may fail if this smoothness assumption on the boundary is not satisfied. Moreover, in contrast with the standard commutative setting, we show how that solutions exhibit a regularity one order less than the boundary data, when the latter belong to $C^{k,ν}(\partial\mathbb{B})$.

AI.tldr: 本文针对单位球内二阶Clifford代数值Dirac算子方程的Dirichlet问题，建立了可解性的充要条件，证明了边界数据属于C¹时问题有解，并构造反例说明光滑性不足时可解性失效。
AI.motivation: 在Clifford代数非交换框架下研究二阶Dirac算子型偏微分方程的边值问题可解性，并探讨与经典交换情形的本质差异。
AI.method: 利用Clifford代数值的Dirac算子∂_x构建二阶系统，通过正则性分析建立可解性的充要条件，并构造显式反例验证光滑性假设的必要性。
AI.result: 证明了边界数据属于C¹(∂B)时Dirichlet问题存在解；构造了当该光滑性假设不满足时可解性失效的显式反例；发现与标准交换情形不同，当边界数据属于C^{k,ν}(∂B)时，解的规律性比边界数据低一阶。
AI.conclusion: Clifford代数框架下二阶Dirac系统的Dirichlet问题可解性依赖于边界数据的光滑条件，且其解的规律性与交换情形存在本质差异，解的规律性较边界条件低一阶。

title: Timing Gravity with Pulsars in the Strong Field
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Matches version published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters
summary: We propose a novel approach for the timing of pulsars orbiting a supermassive black hole, which implements the fully relativistic calculations of the photon travel time into a robust timing model. We generate realistic mock catalogues of pulsar times-of-arrival for several putative pulsars on tight orbits around the Galactic Center supermassive black hole, Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*). Then, we perform a proof-of-concept sensitivity analysis to forecast the accuracy that future observational facilities, like the Squared Kilometer Array, will achieve in the characterization of the parameters of our timing model. Our analysis shows how the observation of pulsars at the Galactic Center will open an incredibly promising avenue for the characterization of the physical properties of Sgr A*, which can improve by at least three orders of magnitude the current constraints on the black hole's mass achieved with the S-stars and event-horizon scale observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对环绕超大质量黑洞公转的脉冲星（pulsar）计时（timing）新方法，将光子传播时间的完全相对论计算纳入稳健的计时模型，并通过生成银河系中心人马座A*（Sgr A*）周围脉冲星到达时间的模拟星表，开展概念验证敏感性分析，预测未来观测设施（如平方公里阵列）对计时模型参数的刻划精度。结果表明，银河系中心脉冲星观测可将黑洞质量的现有约束提高至少三个数量级。
AI.motivation: 当前对银河系中心超大质量黑洞Sgr A*物理性质的约束主要依赖S星（S-stars）和事件视界尺度的观测，需要开辟新的探测途径以大幅提升对黑洞参数（尤其是质量）的测量精度。
AI.method: 提出一种新的脉冲星计时方法，将光子传播时间的完全相对论性计算整合进稳健的计时模型；针对若干假设位于Sgr A*紧密轨道上的脉冲星，生成逼真的到达时间（times-of-arrival）模拟星表；随后开展概念验证型敏感性分析，以评估未来观测设施（如平方公里阵列，Square Kilometer Array）对计时模型参数的刻划精度。
AI.result: 分析显示，观测银河系中心的脉冲星为Sgr A*物理特性的刻划开辟了极有前景的途径，其对黑洞质量的约束能力可比当前基于S星与事件视界尺度观测的结果至少提高三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲星计时有望成为表征银河系中心超大质量黑洞性质的全新而强有力的工具，显著超越现有观测手段的精度水平。

title: NMR evidence of pressure-induced structural transition and enhanced spin fluctuations up to 14~GPa in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$
summary: The Shastry-Sutherland compound SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ has attracted considerable interest as a platform for exploring quantum phases and quantum phase transitions driven by magnetic frustration. The pressure-induced structural and magnetic phase transitions in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$, however, remain controversial. To address this issue, we performed high-pressure $^{11}$B nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements on SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ up to 14~GPa. The NMR spectra reveal two pressure-induced monoclinic phases. With pressure above 4~GPa and with temperature below 10~K, the rapid broadening of the NMR spectrum and the power-law behavior in the spin-lattice relaxation rate $1/T_1$ provide clear evidence for a gapless 3D antiferromagnetic (AFM) phase in the monoclinic phase. At an intermediate temperature range around 20~K, the emergence of the field-dependent NMR line splits resolves a two-dimensional, short-range ordered AFM phase; at temperature above 30~K, the sublinear power-law behavior of $1/T_1$ identifies an extended correlated paramagnetic regime.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过高压¹¹B核磁共振（NMR）测量，在高达14 GPa的压力下对SrCu₂(BO₃)₂进行了研究，揭示了两个压力诱导的单斜相，并鉴别出无隙三维反铁磁（AFM）相、二维短程有序反铁磁相以及扩展关联顺磁态等不同量子相区域。
AI.motivation: SrCu₂(BO₃)₂作为一个由磁阻挫（magnetic frustration）驱动的量子相与量子相变研究平台备受关注，但其压力诱导的结构与磁相变机制仍存在争议，亟需通过实验手段加以澄清。
AI.method: 作者对SrCu₂(BO₃)₂进行了高达14 GPa的高压¹¹B核磁共振（nuclear magnetic resonance, NMR）测量，通过分析NMR谱线展宽、自旋-晶格弛豫率1/T₁的温度依赖与幂率（power-law）行为以及场依赖的NMR线劈裂来表征不同的磁相。
AI.result: NMR谱揭示出两个压力诱导的单斜相；在4 GPa以上且温度低于10 K时，NMR谱线的快速展宽及1/T₁的幂率行为清晰表明单斜相中存在无隙（gapless）三维反铁磁（antiferromagnetic, AFM）相；在约20 K的中间温区，场依赖的NMR线劈裂表征了二维短程有序反铁磁相；在30 K以上温区，1/T₁的次线性幂率行为识别出一个扩展关联的顺磁（paramagnetic）区间。
AI.conclusion: 本工作通过高压NMR实验系统刻画了SrCu₂(BO₃)₂在压力下的多个磁相区域，为解决该体系中压力诱导结构与磁相变长期存在的争议提供了直接的微观证据。

title: Efficient computation of the asymptotics of extensive-rank HCIZ integrals
summary: We study the high-dimensional asymptotics of Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) integrals in the extensive-rank regime. The limit of these integrals is governed by a one-dimensional boundary-value hydrodynamical problem originally derived by Matytsin (1994) and rigorously proved by Guionnet and Zeitouni (2002). Despite its wide-ranging applications, explicit solutions to this problem are known only in a few specific cases. In this work, we introduce an efficient numerical scheme based on a particle discretization and prove its convergence to the continuous boundary-value problem for generic boundary densities. We validate our approach against known analytical solutions and apply it to generic densities, uncovering interesting dynamical phenomena. The high-dimensional limit of HCIZ integrals appears in various contexts, from the large deviations of random matrix spectra to the limiting free energy of disordered systems, high-dimensional statistics, and machine learning. As such, our contribution opens the way towards the numerical exploration of a wide range of high-dimensional models that were previously intractable.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber（HCIZ）积分在广度秩（extensive-rank）区域的高维渐近行为展开研究，提出了一种基于粒子离散化的高效数值方案，并证明了其对一般边界密度的连续边值问题的收敛性，从而为多种此前难以处理的高维模型提供了数值探索的途径。
AI.motivation: HCIZ积分的高维极限由Matytsin（1994）推导、Guionnet和Zeitouni（2002）严格证明的一维边值水动力学问题所控制，但该问题的显式解仅在少数特定情形下已知。由于缺乏一般性的求解手段，阻碍了该积分在多个高维应用场景中的进一步数值探索。
AI.method: 作者引入一种基于粒子离散化（particle discretization）的有效数值方案，对一般边界密度下的一维边值问题进行求解，并严格证明了该数值方案的收敛性。
AI.result: 所提数值方案在已知解析解的案例中得到了验证，并进一步应用于一般密度的情形，揭示了有趣的动力学现象。
AI.conclusion: HCIZ积分的高维极限广泛应用于随机矩阵谱的大偏差、无序体系的极限自由能、高维统计学及机器学习等领域。本文的工作为一大批此前无法处理的（previously intractable）高维模型的数值探索开辟了道路。

title: Dynamical signatures of Hardcore-Boson Supersolid on the Triangular Lattice
summary: We investigate the dynamical signatures of the supersolid phase in the triangular-lattice hardcore Bose-Hubbard model via large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations and linear spin-wave theory. We reveal a distinct momentum-space separation in the spectral weights. The transverse spectrum shows gapless Goldstone modes at the $Γ$ and $K$ points, while the longitudinal spectrum features a gapless mode at $K$ and a roton-like minimum at $M$. Directly in the imaginary-time domain, the supersolid is unambiguously characterized by the coexistence of transverse spectral lines at $Γ$ and $K$. Furthermore, we show that strong quantum fluctuations induce a breakdown of the sharp quasiparticle picture, leading to asymmetric line shapes and broad continua. Our work establishes the definitive dynamical signatures of the hardcore-boson supersolid, providing key insights into analogous spin supersolids in triangular quantum magnets.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模量子蒙特卡洛（quantum Monte Carlo）模拟和线性自旋波理论（linear spin-wave theory），研究了三角晶格硬核玻色-哈伯德模型中超固态（supersolid）的动力学特征，揭示了谱权重的动量空间分离、无隙戈德斯通模（Goldstone modes）及强量子涨落导致的准粒子图像失效等关键现象。
AI.motivation: 超固态是一种同时具备超流序和晶格序的奇特量子态，其动力学特征此前尚缺乏系统的鉴别标准。作者希望通过数值模拟和解析理论阐明硬核玻色子超固态的谱学标志，并为三角晶格量子磁体中类似的超固态候选材料提供理论判据。
AI.method: 作者采用大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟与线性自旋波理论相结合的方法，分别计算了横（transverse）与纵（longitudinal）光谱权重，并直接在虚时（imaginary-time）域中分析谱结构。
AI.result: 横光谱在Γ点和K点呈现无隙的戈德斯通模；纵光谱在K点存在无隙模并在M点出现类旋子（roton-like）极小值。虚时域中Γ与K点横光谱线的共存是超固体的明确特征。此外，强量子涨落导致尖锐准粒子图像崩溃，表现为不对称线形和宽连续谱。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了硬核玻色子超固态的决定性动力学特征，为三角量子磁体中自旋超固态的研究提供关键理论见解与实验判据。

title: Sector-Resolved Flow Sampling for Topologically Frozen Lattice Gauge Theories
summary: Topological fluctuations are essential to nonperturbative gauge theories but become increasingly difficult to sample toward the continuum limit, where Markov chains can freeze in sectors of fixed topological charge. We introduce a generative sampler, a mixture of sector-resolved samplers (MSRS) that explicitly resolves these sectors and exploits a key advantage of generative models, the ability to directly evaluate the domain-restricted partition function and thereby determine the relative weights of disconnected sectors. We train a generative model in a reference topological sector combined with a bijective topological shift that deterministically maps its samples to other sectors. We demonstrate the method in two-dimensional compact U (1) lattice gauge theory, where it reproduces the topological-charge distribution and yields an unbiased susceptibility in a regime where hybrid Monte Carlo is frozen and overrelaxation gives inaccurate estimates. Our approach also outperforms existing flow-based samplers by orders of magnitude. These results demonstrate that explicit sector resolution provides a promising route to overcoming topological barriers in lattice gauge theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合扇区解析采样器（MSRS），将生成模型与双射拓扑平移相结合，显式解析不同拓扑扇区并直接评估受限配分函数，从而在格点规范理论（lattice gauge theory）中克服拓扑冻结等采样障碍，在二维紧致U(1)规范理论中比流式采样器快数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 在非微扰规范理论中，拓扑涨落至关重要，但向连续极限逼近时，马尔可夫链可能冻结在固定拓扑荷的扇区中，导致采样困难。现有方法（如混合蒙特卡罗和过松弛法）在此区域失效或不准确。
AI.method: 引入由多个扇区解析采样器（sector-resolved samplers）混合组成的生成式采样器（MSRS），显式解析拓扑扇区；利用生成模型可直接评估受限配分函数（domain-restricted partition function）的优势，从而确定不连通扇区之间的相对权重。训练一个参考拓扑扇区中的生成模型，并结合一个双射拓扑平移（bijective topological shift），将该模型的样本确定性地映射到其他扇区。
AI.result: 在二维紧致U(1)格点规范理论中，该方法成功重现了拓扑荷分布，并在混合蒙特卡罗（hybrid Monte Carlo）冻结、过松弛法（overrelaxation）给出不准确估计的参数区间内产生了无偏的拓扑磁化率。该方法还比现有的基于流的采样器（flow-based samplers）快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 显式扇区解析为克服格点规范理论中的拓扑势垒提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Exact fermionic dual of the Bose-Hubbard model
summary: Recent developments have established exact bosonization and fermionization with a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry as dualities through gauging. In this work, we apply fermionic gauging, which realizes generalized Jordan-Wigner transformations, to the Bose-Hubbard (BH) model with a global $U(1)$ symmetry and derive an exact dual description in terms of fermionic composites, built from bosons and fermions. In 1D, this duality generalizes the exact mapping between the extended hard-core BH model and the spinless Fermi-Hubbard model to now cover soft-core interactions. At low energies, the mapping reduces to the well-known equivalence between the sine-Gordon model and the Thirring model. The oscillation wave vector of the fermionic composite correlation function in the gapless phase is fixed by their density, providing a novel manifestation of Luttinger's theorem. We verify the exact duality using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations and demonstrate that the gapless phase and the phase transition are governed by the compact boson conformal field theory. Our construction naturally extends to generic bosonic systems and higher dimensions, opening new avenues for studying Bose-Fermi mixtures in optical lattices and other strongly correlated quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对具有全局U(1)对称性的Bose-Hubbard模型实施费米子规范（fermionic gauging），实现了广义Jordan-Wigner变换，导出了该模型的精确对偶描述——由玻色子和费米子构成的费米子复合粒子描述。该对偶在低能极限下对应sine-Gordon模型与Thirring模型的等价关系，并由密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）数值计算验证。
AI.motivation: 近年研究表明，具有Z₂对称性的精确玻色化与费米化可通过对偶关系通过规范变换实现，但此类方法尚未系统应用于具有连续U(1)对称性的玻色体系。作者希望将广义Jordan-Wigner变换推广到Bose-Hubbard（BH）模型，以覆盖软核（soft-core）相互作用情形，并为强关联量子系统的研究提供新的理论工具。
AI.method: 本文采用费米子规范方法实现广义Jordan-Wigner变换，将Bose-Hubbard模型映射为玻色子与费米子构成的费米子复合粒子模型。在一维情形下，该对偶将扩展硬核BH模型与自旋less Fermi-Hubbard模型的精确映射推广至软核相互作用。在低能极限下通过有效场论验证对偶等价于sine-Gordon与Thirring模型间的已知关系，并使用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）进行数值验证。
AI.result: 研究发现，在无隙（gapless）相中，费米子复合粒子关联函数的振荡波矢由其密度唯一定定，这为Luttinger定理提供了新的表现方式。DMRG数值计算证实了精确对偶的正确性，并表明无隙相及其相变由紧致玻色子共形场论（compact boson conformal field theory）所支配。
AI.conclusion: 该构造自然地推广到一般的玻色系统和更高维度，为在光晶格中研究Bose-Fermi混合体系及其他强关联量子系统开辟了新的途径。

title: Riemannian optimization for linear optical problems
summary: Many applications of linear optics in quantum science involve searching for some optimal configuration of a multiport interferometer. For example, to find heralded state preparations, one can optimize the interferometer to maximize the fidelity and success probability of the state preparation. In this paper, we derive a closed analytical formula for the Riemannian gradient of any differentiable function defined over the interferometer unitaries. We use this gradient in Riemannian optimization algorithms, such as gradient descent or BFGS, to find the optimal setup of the interferometer. As an interesting use case, we search for linear optical state preparations, improving some of the success probabilities reported in the literature for NOON or photon catalysis preparations. Finally, we show that our optimizer is orders of magnitude faster than other methods in the literature, opening the door for solving linear optical problems involving more modes and photons.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了定义在干涉仪幺正矩阵（interferometer unitaries）上的任意可微函数的黎曼梯度（Riemannian gradient）闭式解析公式，并将其应用于黎曼优化算法中以搜索最优光学多端口干涉仪配置，从而改进态制备方案并显著提升求解速度。
AI.motivation: 线性光学（linear optics）中的许多量子科学应用需要搜索多端口干涉仪（multiport interferometer）的最优配置，例如在预示性态制备（heralded state preparation）中优化干涉仪以最大化保真度（fidelity）和成功概率。现有方法在模式数和光子数较多时效率不足，亟需更高效的优化工具。
AI.method: 作者推导了定义在干涉仪幺正矩阵上的任意可微函数黎曼梯度的闭式解析公式，并将其集成到黎曼优化算法（Riemannian optimization algorithms）中，包括梯度下降（gradient descent）和BFGS方法，用于自动搜索干涉仪的最优配置。
AI.result: 将该优化器应用于线性光学态制备搜索，改进了文献中报告的部分NOON态和光子催化（photon catalysis）制备方案的成功概率。此外，所提出的优化器比其他方法快数个数量级，使得包含更多模式和光子的线性光学问题变得可解。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的黎曼梯度闭式公式配合黎曼优化算法，为线性光学态制备等涉及干涉仪配置优化的问题提供了一种高效且可扩展的求解途径，有望拓展该类问题的可解规模。

title: Improving constraints on the Yukawa correction at the Galactic Center with multiple stellar orbits
summary:
We investigate the presence of a Yukawa-like correction ($\propto \, αe^{- r/λ}$) to Newtonian gravity at the Galactic Center, using a multi-star fitting code, including the newly discovered star S$301$, to improve the constraints obtained using S$2$ orbit alone.
  We perform a Markov Chain Monte Carlo analysis using the astrometric and spectroscopic data of stars S$2$, S$55$, S$29$, S$38$ and S$301$ collected by GRAVITY, GRAVITY$^+$, NACO and SINFONI instruments, covering the period from $1992$ to $2025$.
  Compared to GRAVITY Collaboration 2025 (Paper I), in which only S$2$ was fitted, the tightest bound on the Yukawa coupling is again reached at $λ= 3\cdot10^{13}\,\rm m\ (\sim 200\,AU)$, where we find $|α| < 6 \cdot10^{-4}$, an improvement of roughly a factor five. The addition of S$301$ extends the constraint to short ranges that were inaccessible to S$2$, yielding $|α| < 0.004$ at $λ=10^{12}\,\rm m$ and $|α| < 0.006$ at $λ=5\cdot 10^{11}\,\rm m$, while S$29$, with its larger apoapsis, gives $|α| < 0.1$ at $λ\sim 2\cdot10^{15}\,\rm m$. The latter two represent the tightest limits at these scale lengths on a Yukawa correction obtained to date around a supermassive black hole.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用多恒星拟合代码（multi-star fitting code），基于麦哲伦-牛顿（Yukawa 型）修正项对银河系中心（Galactic Center）牛顿引力进行约束，通过纳入新发现的 S301 星等数据，将 Yukawa 耦合系数 α 的约束范围显著扩展：在 λ=3×10^{13} m（约200 AU）处限制改进至 |α|<6×10^{-4}（较仅用 S2 星时改进约5倍），并首次获得短程（λ=10^{12} m 及以下）与长程（λ~2×10^{15} m）的新最紧限制。
AI.motivation: 传统上仅通过 S2 单轨数据约束银河系中心的新顿引力修正，样本有限导致对 Yukawa 型修正参数（耦合系数 α 与标度长度 λ）的约束存在较大不确定性；引入更多轨道恒星（特别是新发现的 S301）有望大幅改善约束精度并扩展参数空间覆盖范围。
AI.method: 采用包含多颗恒星的拟合代码，对 S2、S55、S29、S38 与 S301 的测量与光谱数据（GRAVITY、GRAVITY+、NACO 和 SINFONI 仪器，1992–2025 年）进行 Markov Chain Monte Carlo（马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗）分析，检验含指数型 Yukawa 修正（∝αe^{-r/λ}）的引力模型。
AI.result: 在 λ=3×10^{13} m（约200 AU）处获得最紧约束 |α|<6×10^{-4}，较 GRAVITY Collaboration 2025（仅拟合 S2）改进约5倍；S301 的加入补充了 S2 无法约束的短程区间，得到 |α|<0.004（λ=10^{12} m）与 |α|<0.006（λ=5×10^{11} m）；S29 因较大的远心距（apoapsis）提供 |α|<0.1（λ~2×10^{15} m），后两者为相应尺度上围绕超大质量黑洞（supermassive black hole）的 Yukawa 修正迄今最紧的限制。
AI.conclusion: 多恒星联合拟合显著提升了银河系中心对 Yukawa 型引力修正的约束能力，不仅强化了在中等尺度上的既有界限，还首次将有效约束扩展至更短的尺度，为在超大质量黑洞环境中检验修正引力理论提供了更严格的观测基准。

title: Superfluidity in active quantum flocks
summary: Active quantum matter has very recently emerged at the intersection between bio- and quantum many-body physics, combining the self-organization of living systems with the coherence of the quantum world. Active quantum systems have been shown to exhibit flocking - a collective phenomenon with no precedent in equilibrium quantum physics. In this work we uncover an unexpected layer of quantum order in active quantum flocks: they can become superfluid. We show that, in addition to the symmetry breaking associated with their directed motion, these flocks can also break an additional U(1) symmetry, giving rise to off-diagonal long-range order. For a microscopic model of active hard-core bosons governed by Lindblad dynamics, we derive an effective long-wavelength description of the single-particle density matrix and demonstrate that the flocking phase develops an instability toward off-diagonal long-range order characteristic of superfluid behavior. Our findings reveal active quantum matter as a promising research direction for discovering exotic nonequilibrium phases of quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示活性量子群（active quantum flocks）可以表现出超流（superfluid）行为，即除了与定向运动相关的对称破缺外，还可破坏额外的U(1)对称性，产生非对角长程序（off-diagonal long-range order）。通过Lindblad动力学描述活性硬核玻色子的微观模型，作者推导了单粒子密度矩阵的长波有效描述，表明群聚相（flocking phase）对超流特征的非对角长程序存在失稳。
AI.motivation: 活性量子物质（active quantum matter）是介于生物与量子多体物理交叉的新兴领域，此前已知活性量子系统可展现群聚现象，但群聚的量子序层面尚未被充分探索。作者旨在揭示活性量子群中是否存在超越已知对称破缺模式的额外量子序。
AI.method: 基于活性硬核玻色子（active hard-core bosons）的微观模型，采用Lindblad动力学（Lindblad dynamics）描述系统的耗散演化；推导单粒子密度矩阵的有效长波长（长波）描述，并分析其非线性有效动力学的稳定性。
AI.result: 活性量子群聚相除了定向运动相关的对称破缺外，还可破坏额外的U(1)对称性，产生非对角长程序；该序失稳是超流行为的特征，表明活性量子群可以变得超流。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现活性量子物质是探索奇异非平衡量子相（nonequilibrium quantum phases）的有前景研究方向，为理解非平衡系统中量子序的产生提供了新途径。

title: Interacting fluid cosmologies from the metric-affine framework
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures. Comments welcome, data and code available upon reasonable request
summary: Metric-affine gravity provides a natural geometric framework in which spacetime curvature, torsion, and non-metricity are treated as independent degrees of freedom, leading to novel cosmological dynamics beyond General Relativity. A generic consequence of such theories is the emergence of effective interactions among the cosmological fluids, even in the absence of explicit phenomenological couplings. Interestingly, the above happens while the Standard Model of Particle physics remains unmodified. In this work, we investigate interacting cosmological models that arise from metric-affine gravity and analyze their implications for the background evolution of the Universe. We derive the modified continuity equations governing the matter, radiation, and dark-energy components, highlighting the geometric origin of energy exchange in the dark sector. We discuss how these interactions modify the expansion history and can effectively mimic evolving dark-energy behavior. The resulting cosmological scenarios are confronted with the most recent observational data from Type Ia Supernovae (Pantheon+), Cosmic Chronometers, and Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (DESI DR2). Moreover, using model selection criteria, e.g., Akaike Information Criterion, Bayesian Information Criterion and the Bayesian Evidence, we compare the aforementioned models against the standard $Λ$CDM model. We find that the proposed framework performs slightly better than $ΛCDM$, in the light of the data sets considered here. Our analysis demonstrates that metric-affine-induced interactions constitute a viable and theoretically motivated alternative for the description of the Universe.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了度规-仿射引力（metric-affine gravity）框架下由几何结构自发引致的宇宙学流体间有效相互作用，推导了物质、辐射和暗能量分量的修正连续性方程，并利用类型Ia超新星（Pantheon+）、宇宙学时钟（Cosmic Chronometers）和重子声学振荡（DESI DR2）数据对模型进行观测约束。模型选择准则表明该框架略优于标准ΛCDM模型，构成一个有理论动机的可行替代方案。
AI.motivation: 标准广义相对论（General Relativity, GR）框架下的宇宙学模型（尤其ΛCDM）虽与观测高度吻合，但暗能量本质尚未阐明。度规-仿射引力将时空曲率、挠率（torsion）和非度量性（non-metricity）视为独立自由度，可在不改动粒子物理标准模型的前提下，自然产生暗区流体间的有效能量交换。作者旨在探索这一几何起源的相互作用如何影响宇宙背景演化，并评估其与最新观测数据的兼容性。
AI.method: 作者从度规-仿射引力理论出发，推导了描述物质、辐射与暗能量各分量演化的修正连续性方程，揭示暗区能量交换的几何起源。随后将所得相互作用宇宙学模型与三类最新观测数据集（Pantheon+超新星数据、宇宙学时钟数据和DESI DR2重子声学振荡数据）进行联合约束，并采用多种模型选择准则——包括赤池信息准则（Akaike Information Criterion）、贝叶斯信息准则（Bayesian Information Criterion）和贝叶斯证据（Bayesian Evidence）——与标准ΛCDM模型进行统计比较。
AI.result: 分析表明，度规-仿射引力引致的相互作用模型在所考虑的数据集下表现略优于标准ΛCDM模型。这些几何起源的相互作用能够有效模拟演化型暗能量（evolving dark-energy）行为并修改宇宙膨胀历史，同时粒子物理标准模型保持无需修改。
AI.conclusion: 度规-仿射引力中由几何结构产生的宇宙学流体相互作用构成一个在理论上自洽且具备观测竞争力的ΛCDM替代方案，为宇宙背景演化的描述提供了可行路径。

title: Bridging the Population Synthesis of Supermassive Binary Black Holes and the Gravitational Wave Background
summary: Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) constrain population properties of supermassive binary black holes (SMBHBs) through the observation of the gravitational wave background (GWB). Unlike other approaches that interpolate population-synthesis libraries or only consider the mean of the strain spectrum, here we capture its full strain probability density directly from semi-analytic population models. We apply our new method to the semi-analytic SMBHB population model, independently reproducing the parameter estimation for this model performed by the NANOGrav Collaboration with their 15-yr data. We also show the extent to which discrete SMBHB contributions to the GWB resolve degeneracies in the population parameter space. Finally, using the source-count intensity as the intermediate product in our calculation, we map PTA observations, as a proof of principle, to the SMBHB model based on the galaxy merger prescriptions from numerical hydrodynamical simulations "Illustris". We find the effect of delay times $τ$ between kiloparsec and subparsec SMBHB separations following galaxy mergers, finding $h_{\rm c}$ spanning $(1$-$6)\times10^{-16}$ and $N_{\rm c}$ spanning $(0.3$-$7.1)\times10^{-3}$ for $τ$ up to 8 Gyr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种直接从半解析种群模型（semi-analytic population model）捕获超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）引力波背景（GWB）完整应变概率密度的方法，并用于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）观测分析，不仅独立复现了NANOGrav 15年数据的参数估计结果，还将观测映射到Illustris数值流体模拟的星系并合框架中。
AI.motivation: 现有的PTA分析方法要么对内插种群合成库（population-synthesis libraries）进行插值，要么仅考虑应变谱（strain spectrum）的均值，无法充分捕捉模型完整的概率信息。摘要指出这些方法存在局限，因此需要一种能够从半解析种群模型直接获取完整应变概率密度的新途径。
AI.method: 方法的核心是直接从半解析SMBHB种群模型中计算GWB完整应变概率密度（strain probability density），而非仅使用其均值。计算中以源计数强度（source-count intensity）作为中间产物，从而将PTA观测数据映射到基于数值流体动力学模拟Illustris的星系并合处方中。
AI.result: 该方法在NANOGrav 15年数据上独立复现了该合作组对此半解析模型所做的参数估计结果；并展示了GWB中离散SMBHB贡献在种群参数空间解决简并（degeneracies）的程度。作为原理验证，将PTA观测映射到Illustris星系并合模型，发现延迟时间（delay time）τ介于千秒差距与亚秒差距SMBHB间距之间时，特征应变振幅h_c的范围为(1–6)×10⁻¹⁶，源计数N_c范围为(0.3–7.1)×10⁻³（对应τ可达8 Gyr）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够在不依赖插值或均值近似的前提下，将PTA观测与半解析及模拟的SMBHB种群模型直接关联，并可用于评估离散源贡献对参数简并的破解作用，以及约束星系并合后的延迟时间对引力波背景特征的影响。

title: Emergent Chiral Metal Phase in Compressible Quantum Hall Fluids
summary: We report transmitted conductance measurements between a source and reflection-less contacts connected to a compressible quantum Hall fluid with filling fraction $ν$. We observe that total sum of transmitted conductances universally approaches Hall conductance $ν(e^2/h)$. The universality of this sum rule is established experimentally across integer and fractional quantum Hall regimes, remaining invariant under variation in temperatures, sample geometries, material qualities and quasi-particle interactions. Chiral transport in compressible quantum Hall fluids, characterized by suppressed dissipative transport with a distinct handedness, is confirmed by floating contact measurements. Consequently, this sum rule emerges as a conduction law of the chiral metal phase. Theoretically, we argue that time-reversal-symmetry breaking under a strong magnetic field within this chiral metal gives rise unidirectional trajectories of carriers in a nearly flat potential landscape with point-like disorder potentials, a regime realized when the screening length is smaller than the magnetic length. Within this chiral framework, longitudinal resistance does not originate from bulk dissipation but primarily from the equilibration of electrochemical potentials at the contacts. Our study introduces a new paradigm of chiral transport across a broad class of gapless two-dimensional systems characterized by short-range screening and broken time-reversal symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文通过源与反射无损耗接触（reflection-less contacts）之间的传输电导测量，实验验证了可压缩量子霍尔流体（compressible quantum Hall fluid）中总传输电导之和普遍趋近于霍尔电导ν(e²/h)的求和规则，并据此提出该求和规则作为手性金属（chiral metal）相的导电定律，同时从理论上论证了强磁场打破时间反演对称性下短程屏蔽导致的单向载流子输运机制。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在揭示可压缩量子霍尔流体中手性输运（chiral transport）的基本规律。已有理论尚未明确手性金属相中电导行为的普适规则，尤其缺乏跨越整数与分数量子霍尔区（quantum Hall regime）的系统性实验验证，因此需要建立统一的导电定律并阐明其物理起源。
AI.method: 实验上采用浮动接触（floating contact）测量方法，在源与反射无损耗接触之间进行传输电导测量，系统改变温度、样品几何结构、材料质量和准粒子相互作用等条件，跨越整数与分数量子霍尔区加以验证。理论上通过分析强磁场下时间反演对称性破缺所引发的手性金属内载流子沿准平坦势景观（nearly flat potential landscape）单向运行的微观图像——其中点状无序势（point-like disorder potentials）出现于屏蔽长度小于磁长度（magnetic length）的区间——来阐释实验结果的物理机制。
AI.result: 实验表明，总传输电导之和在整数及分数量子霍尔区均普遍趋近霍尔电导ν(e²/h)，且该求和规则的普适性不受温度、样品几何结构、材料质量和准粒子相互作用变化的影响。浮动接触测量证实了可压缩量子霍尔流体内被抑制的耗散输运（suppressed dissipative transport）具有明确的手性（handedness）特征。该求和规则由此可作为手性金属相的导电定律。
AI.conclusion: 在该手性框架下，纵向电阻并非源于体内耗散，而主要来自接触处电化学势的均衡（equilibration of electrochemical potentials）。本研究为具有短程屏蔽（short-range screening）与时间反演对称性破缺的宽泛无间隙二维系统确立了手性输运的新范式。

title: A counterexample to Kenig's conjecture for the Laplace double-layer operator
summary: Layer potentials provide a classical approach to boundary value problems for Laplace's equation on Lipschitz domains. Kenig's 1994 spectral-radius conjecture for the double-layer operator would ensure operator-norm convergence of the associated Neumann series on mean-zero $L^2$ densities when the boundary is connected. We disprove this conjecture by constructing a bounded simply connected planar Lipschitz domain whose double-layer operator on arclength $L^2$ has essential spectral radius strictly greater than $1/2$. More precisely, for every $t>1/2$ sufficiently close to $1/2$, we obtain such a domain with $\pm i t$ in its Fredholm essential spectrum. The construction starts from smooth graphs whose shapes repeat under translation. In the limit of separated scales, refinement makes solutions of adjoint resolvent equations grow with fixed forcing. The graph slopes remain uniformly bounded. A computer-assisted certificate proves this growth through an inequality for Hermitian $2\times2$ matrices. Its strict margin at $- i/2$ persists at nearby spectral parameters. Normalisation and a Floquet transform then give compactly supported densities with small residuals on the full graphs. We insert rescaled segments of successive graphs into one bounded boundary, where these densities form a weakly null sequence of approximate eigenvectors. The same spectral conclusion holds on a single periodic Lipschitz graph. The certificate combines continuous estimates, exact rational arithmetic and rigorous interval enclosures.

AI.tldr: 本文否证了Kenig 1994年关于Lipschitz域上双层算子（double-layer operator）的谱半径猜想，通过构造一个有界单连通平面Lipschitz域，其双层算子在弧长L²空间的本质谱半径严格大于1/2。构造基于平移重复的光滑图，结合计算机辅助证明验证解析行列式和谱参数附近的增长。
AI.motivation: Kenig于1994年提出的谱半径猜想认为，当边界连通时，双层算子的Neumann级数（Neumann series）在零均值L²密度上具有算子范数收敛性。否定这一猜想对于理解Lipschitz域上Laplace方程边值问题（boundary value problems）的经典层位势（layer potentials）方法的收敛性边界具有重要意义。
AI.method: 构造从周期重复的平移光滑图开始，在分离尺度极限下，通过共轭预解方程（adjoint resolvent equations）的增长分析实现构造。利用Hermitian 2×2矩阵不等式进行计算机辅助证明验证增长，结合连续估计、精确有理运算与严格区间包络（interval enclosures）作为证书，再通过归一化和Floquet变换（Floquet transform）构造紧支撑密度并插入有界边界形成弱零序列近似特征向量。
AI.result: 对每个足够接近1/2的t>1/2，成功构造了本质Fredholm谱（Fredholm essential spectrum）中包含±it的有界单连通平面Lipschitz域，从而证明其双层算子的本质谱半径严格大于1/2，否证了Kenig猜想。同样的谱结论也在单个周期Lipschitz图上成立。
AI.conclusion: Kenig谱半径猜想被证明不成立。该反例表明在连通边界的Lipschitz域上，双层算子Neumann级数的算子范数收敛性不总成立，其本质谱半径可以突破1/2的界限，这对利用经典Neumann级数方法求解边值问题的适用范围提出了新的限制。

title: Search for Long-Transient Gravitational Waves from Supernova SN2023ixf using GFH-v2 Pipeline
summary: We present a directed search for long-transient gravitational waves from the possible newborn magnetar remnant of SN2023ixf, a nearby Type II core-collapse supernova in the M101 galaxy. The analysis uses LIGO Hanford and Livingston data from Engineering Run 15, using coincident data lying within the on-source window associated with the supernova. We target signals from a rapidly rotating, non-axisymmetric neutron star whose spin-down is dominated by gravitational-wave emission, producing a power-law decrease in frequency and a corresponding decrease in strain amplitude. The search is performed with the GFH-v2 pipeline, based on the Generalized Frequency Hough transform. No candidate survives the coincidence and follow-up analysis. We therefore set upper limits on the maximum detectable distance as a function of initial frequency and ellipticity. For the highest ellipticity interval, the 90% upper limits reach distances of about 1-2.5~Mpc across most of the analysed band. Although these limits are below the distance to M101, the search provides the first application of GFH-v2 to a nearby core-collapse supernova and characterizes its performance on real detector data.

AI.tldr: 本文对SN2023ixf（M101星系中的近邻II型核坍缩超新星）可能产生的新生磁星（magnetar）遗迹所发出的长持续时间引力波（long-transient gravitational waves）进行了定向搜索，采用基于广义频率Hough变换的GFH-v2流水线分析LIGO工程运行15数据。未发现候选事件，并在初始频率和椭率（ellipticity）空间中给出了最大可探测距离的上限。
AI.motivation: 新生磁星作为核坍缩超新星的残余物，其快速旋转和非轴对称形变可能发射可探测的引力波信号，对近邻超新星SN2023ixf进行定向搜索可检验此类天体物理信号模型。
AI.method: 利用LIGO Hanford和Livingston探测器在工程运行15（Engineering Run 15）中与SN2023ixf相关的on-source时间窗口内的重合数据，使用基于广义频率Hough变换（Generalized Frequency Hough transform）的GFH-v2流水线进行搜索，针对自旋减慢主导自引力波发射、频率呈幂律下降的快速旋转非轴对称中子星信号。
AI.result: 搜索未发现任何通过重合和后续分析的候选事件；在最高椭率区间内，90%置信度上限所覆盖的最大可探测距离约为1-2.5 Mpc，涵盖分析频带的大部分范围，但该距离低于M101星系的距离。
AI.conclusion: 该搜索首次将GFH-v2流水线应用于近邻核坍缩超新星，并在真实探测器数据上验证了其性能；尽管所设上限尚未达到探测M101距离处信号的能力，但为后续搜索提供了方法学基础。

title: Three-Dimensional Fermiology and Thickness-Tuned Magnetotransport in Single-Crystalline Antimony Flakes
summary: The extreme magnetoresistance of compensated semimetals is governed by both the Fermi-surface geometry and carrier relaxation, but these contributions are difficult to disentangle in finite-size structures. Here, we combine longitudinal and Hall magnetotransport measurements with temperature- and angle-dependent Shubnikov--de Haas oscillations in single-crystalline Sb flakes grown by chemical vapor deposition (CVD), with thicknesses ranging from 110 to 783 nm. As thickness increases, the non-saturating MR at 2 K and 14 T rises nearly 30-fold, reaching $7.13\times10^{5}\%$, while the primary frequency $F_α$ remains approximately 99 T without any systematic shift. A joint three-channel analysis of $ρ_{xx}(B)$ and $ρ_{xy}(B)$ reveals that this evolution is driven by an increase in the mobility of a nearly compensated electron--hole pair, rather than by a reconstruction of the primary pockets. Angle-dependent measurements confirm the existence of a closed three-dimensional $α$ pocket, and a reproducible high-frequency sector (335-377 T) is consistent with the electron $β$ orbit of the $L$-point pockets in bulk Sb. Together, the transport and quantum-oscillation results show that thickness tunes extreme MR through dimension-dependent scattering while preserving bulk-like fermiology.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过化学气相沉积（chemical vapor deposition, CVD）生长的单晶锑（Sb）薄膜，结合纵/霍尔输运测量与随温度和角度变化的Shubnikov–de Haas振荡，揭示了厚度从110 nm增至783 nm时，极端磁电阻（extreme magnetoresistance）近30倍增强的机制源于近补偿电子-空穴对迁移率的提升，而非费米面重构；厚度通过维度相关的散射调谐极端磁电阻，同时保持了块体式的费米面拓扑。
AI.motivation: 补偿半金属的极端磁电阻同时受费米面几何与载流子弛豫控制，但这两者在有限尺寸结构中难以区分，因此需要一种系统的方法将它们解耦，以理解厚度对极端磁电阻的影响机制。
AI.method: 作者对CVD生长的单晶Sb薄片（厚度110–783 nm）开展纵向与霍尔磁输运测量，并结合温度与角度依赖的Shubnikov–de Haas振荡数据，进行$ρ_{xx}(B)$和$ρ_{xy}(B)$的三通道联合分析。
AI.result: 厚度增加使2 K、14 T下的非饱和磁电阻几乎增长30倍，达$7.13\times10^{5}\%$，而主频率$F_α$稳定在约99 T；三通道分析表明该演化归因于近补偿电子-空穴对迁移率的增加而非主口袋重构；角度依赖确认存在闭合三维α口袋，并观测到与块体Sb中L点电子β轨道一致的高频区段（335–377 T）。
AI.conclusion: 输运与量子振荡结果共同表明，厚度通过维度相关的散射调谐极端磁电阻，同时保留了块体式的费米面拓扑结构，从而解耦了散射与费米面几何对极端磁电阻的贡献。

title: New Symbolic Procedures in the Study of Dynamical Systems
comment: 104 pages. English translation of the author's 1995 doctoral thesis ("Noi procedee simbolice in studiul sistemelor dinamice", "Gheorghe Asachi" Technical University of Iasi, Romania), presented as an audited, historically conforming LaTeX reconstruction; an editorial note documents the provenance and the precise limits of the 2026 intervention
summary: The thesis develops symbolic representations of dynamical systems in finite-dimensional commutative real algebras. The algebraic framework (orthogonal idempotents, zero divisors, and the structure of finite-order algebras) supports algebra-valued Fourier and Laplace transforms and Walsh-function-based system identification. The methods yield exact, coordinate-free vectorial solutions for motion in non-inertial reference frames, including a generalized Larmor theorem, the Foucault pendulum, motion in central positional-force fields, and the two-body problem in arbitrarily rotating reference frames. This English edition is an audited LaTeX reconstruction of the 1995 original, with an editorial note documenting provenance.

AI.tldr: 论文在有限维交换实代数框架下发展动力系统的符号表示方法，借助正交幂等元、零因子及有限阶代数结构支撑代数值的傅里叶变换与拉普拉斯变换，并基于沃尔什函数的系统辨识方法，实现了非惯性参考系中运动问题的精确无坐标矢量化求解。
AI.motivation: 为动力系统建立一种基于有限维交换实代数的符号表示框架，从而在非惯性参考系中以坐标无关的精确矢量化方式求解运动学问题，克服传统方法依赖坐标系的局限。
AI.method: 利用有限维交换实代数中的正交幂等元（orthogonal idempotents）、零因子（zero divisors）以及有限阶代数结构作为基础，构造代数取值（algebra-valued）的傅里叶变换与拉普拉斯变换，并引入基于沃尔什函数（Walsh function）的系统辨识方法进行系统化分析。
AI.result: 方法成功给出了非惯性参考系中运动的精确无坐标矢量解，涵盖广义拉莫尔定理（generalized Larmor theorem）、傅科摆（Foucault pendulum）、中心位置力场中的运动以及任意旋转参考系中的二体问题（two-body problem）。
AI.conclusion: 本文是1995年原始论文的经审核LaTeX重建英文版，并附有说明文献来源的编辑注记（editorial note），验证了代数符号方法在动力系统分析中的有效性与可复现性。

title: How to choose a good rational basis for elliptic Feynman integrals?
summary: Representing multi-loop scattering amplitudes as linear combinations of multivalued transcendental functions with process-dependent rational coefficients has long been understood to be advantageous. In general, these transcendental functions satisfy a system of differential equations with coupled homogeneous blocks. When these coupled blocks can be removed through algebraic basis transformations, the relation between the rational and algebraic bases is universal and minimal. Here, we ask whether an analogous universal and minimal relation exists when decoupling requires transformations involving complete elliptic integrals. We elaborate on the method proposed in ref. arXiv:2504.20897, in which we suggested that a basis constructed using an elliptic generalization of leading singularities may provide an answer to this question. We extend this analysis to the off-diagonal blocks of the rational differential equations satisfied by the bases obtained through this construction. We find that the $ε$ dependence of these blocks can be organized into a universal structure that is preserved under the decoupling transformation used to express the solutions in terms of iterated integrals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多圈散射振幅（multi-loop scattering amplitudes）中超越函数微分方程组的退耦问题，重点探讨当退耦需涉及完全椭圆积分（complete elliptic integrals）变换时，是否存在类似有理基情形中的普遍且极简关系。作者扩展了arXiv提出的基于椭圆推广的领头奇异性（leading singularities）构造方法，分析了其非对角块结构，发现这些块的ε依赖具有在退耦变换下保持不变的普遍结构。
AI.motivation: 已有长时间的认识表明，将多圈散射振幅表示为多值超越函数（multivalued transcendental functions）的线性组合并辅以与过程相关的有理系数是有利的。当耦合块可通过代数基变换移除时，有理基与代数基之间存在普遍且极简的关系；本文旨在探讨当退耦需要涉及完全椭圆积分的变换时，是否仍存在类似的普遍且极简关系。
AI.method: 基于此前论文（arXiv:2504.20897）提出的方法展开，该方法建议利用椭圆推广的领头奇异性构造基函数。作者将该分析扩展到由该构造所得基函数满足的有理微分方程的非对角块（off-diagonal blocks）上。
AI.result: 作者发现这些非对角块的ε依赖可以被组织为一种普遍结构，且该结构在用于以迭代积分（iterated integrals）表达解的退耦变换下保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 该结果提示，即使在涉及完全椭圆积分的退耦情形中，基函数构造与退耦变换之间仍可能存在普遍且极简的关系，其具体形式由非对角块中ε依赖结构的普适性所体现。

title: Coupling and decoupling between translational and rotational dynamics in a tetrahedral molecular liquid
summary: The translational dynamics usually decouples earlier than the rotational in supercooled liquids as the temperature decreases, whereas the inverted scenario remains scarce reported. In this work, starting from the coarse-grained ortho-terphenyl model, we build a rigid tetrahedral structure model. It exhibits an earlier decoupling in rotation than in translation. The Stokes-Einstein-Debye relation breaks down while the Stokes-Einstein relation remains intact. The decoupling happens at approximately 2Tg similar as that observed in supercooled water. The rotation shows more heterogeneous dynamics than the translation at all temperatures. Our results suggest that the steric hindrance plays an important role in determining the decoupling between the translational and rotational dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于粗粒化邻三联苯（ortho-terphenyl）模型构建了刚性四面体结构模型，观察到过冷液体中旋转弛豫先于平移去耦合（rotation-translation decoupling）的罕见现象，表明立体位阻（steric hindrance）在决定平移与旋转动力学去耦合中起关键作用。
AI.motivation: 过冷液体中通常随温度降低，平移动力学比旋转动力学更早发生去耦合，而相反情景鲜少报道。本文旨在构建一种模型系统，探索旋转先于平移去耦合的物理机制。
AI.method: 从粗粒化邻三联苯模型出发，构建一个刚性四面体结构模型，并通过该模型系统研究平移与旋转动力学的去耦合行为及其温度依赖性。
AI.result: 该模型表现出旋转先于平移的早期去耦合现象：Stokes-Einstein-Debye关系破坏，而Stokes-Einstein关系仍然保持有效。去耦合发生在约2Tg处，与过冷水中观察到的行为类似。在所有温度下，旋转动力学表现出比平移动力学更强的异质性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明立体位阻在决定平移与旋转动力学去耦合过程中扮演重要角色，为理解过冷液体中异常动力学行为提供结构层面的解释。

title: GridapGeosciences.jl: A Julia finite element package for partial differential equations on general manifolds
summary: We present GridapGeosciences.jl, a new parallel distributed-memory Julia package for the numerical approximation of partial differential equations on general manifolds. Our abstract approach to generating discrete manifold domains relies on mesh refinement in general, and is implemented within the Gridap finite element library, whose high-level interface enables seamless definition of both intrinsic and extrinsic variational formulations. GridapGeosciences.jl features the cubed sphere manifold, which is used in this study to showcase the functionality of GridapGeosciences.jl in different applications. The first application involves scalar transport where we develop intrinsic formulations of common stabilisation terms, which are shown to be equivalent to well-known extrinsic stabilisation formalisations. Such stabilisation terms are used to develop an intrinsic formulation of the two-dimensional thermal shallow water equations that includes upwinded numerical fluxes. The final application is a linearisation of the Boussinesq equations where we demonstrate the capacity of GridapGeosciences.jl to capture both surface and vertical dynamics on a three-dimensional manifold.

AI.tldr: GridapGeosciences.jl 是一个基于 Julia 语言、面向分布式内存并行的新软件包，用于在一般流形（manifold）上数值求解偏微分方程（PDE）。该包通过网格细化生成离散流形域，基于 Gridap 有限元库实现，支持内蕴（intrinsic）与外蕴（extrinsic）变分公式。文中以立方体球面（cubed sphere manifold）为例，展示了标量输运、二维热浅水方程以及 Boussinesq 方程线性化等应用。
AI.motivation: 地质与地球物理建模中常需要在球面或更一般的流形上求解偏微分方程，而现有有限元工具对一般流形上的数值离散支持有限；作者旨在提供一个兼具易用性和并行可扩展性的 Julia 软件包，使研究者能以统一且抽象的方式定义内蕴与外蕴变分问题。
AI.method: 方法基于网格细化（mesh refinement）以抽象方式生成离散流形域，并集成于 Gridap 有限元库的高层接口中，从而无缝支持内蕴与外蕴变分公式；包内实现了立方体球面流形，并用于三个典型应用场景的数值验证。
AI.result: 在标量输运应用中，作者构造了常见稳定化项（stabilisation terms）的内蕴公式，并与已知外蕴稳定化形式证明等价；基于此发展了包含迎风数值通量（upwinded numerical fluxes）的二维热浅水方程（thermal shallow water equations）内蕴公式；在最后一个应用中，通过对 Boussinesq 方程线性化，展示了该包在三流形上同时捕捉表面与垂直动力学特征的能力。
AI.conclusion: GridapGeosciences.jl 在一般流形上对 PDE 数值求解方面具有通用性与有效性，能够覆盖从标量输运到浅水动力学再到三维地层流动的多种地球科学应用场景，为相关领域提供了一套高度抽象、开放可扩展的并行计算工具。

title: Relativistic spatial distributions of transverse angular momentum
summary: In our previous work [C. Lorcé et al., Phys. Lett. B 868 (2025) 139792], we investigated the 2D spatial distributions of transverse total angular momentum, including orbital angular momentum and intrinsic spin, relative to the canonical center (or center of spin). In the present work, we extend this analysis in two directions. First, we study the corresponding transverse boost distributions relative to the canonical center. Second, since the definition of generalized angular momentum density depends crucially on the choice of pivot, we analyze how the spatial distributions of transverse total angular momentum and boost are modified when they are defined relative to different relativistic centers, viz.~the relativistic centers of mass, energy, and spin. Considering spin-1/2 targets, we derive the corresponding 2D spatial distributions in the transverse plane, and further investigate how the spatial patterns evolve under longitudinal Lorentz boosts. Additionally, we provide the corresponding light-front distributions in the transverse plane, establishing a clear connection between the instant-form and light-front descriptions of transverse angular momentum and boost.

AI.tldr: 该研究将先前关于横向总角动量（transverse total angular momentum）二维空间分布的工作推广至两类新方向：一是研究相对正则中心（canonical center）的横向助推（transverse boost）分布，二是分析总角动量与助推空间分布在不同相对论中心（质心、能量中心、自旋中心）下的变化。针对自旋1/2靶粒子，推导了横向平面内的二维空间分布，并考察了纵向洛伦兹助推（longitudinal Lorentz boost）下的空间图形演化，同时建立了瞬时形式（instant-form）与光前描述（light-front description）之间的对应联系。
AI.motivation: 推广先前工作中关于横向总角动量二维空间分布的讨论，并因广义角动量密度依赖枢轴（pivot）选择的特性，比较不同相对论中心定义下的空间分布差异。
AI.method: 以自旋1/2靶粒子为对象，分别相对于正则中心、相对论质心、能量中心和自旋中心定义横向角动量与助推密度，推导对应的横向平面二维空间分布，并分析其在纵向洛伦兹助推下的演化；进一步给出横向平面的光前分布。
AI.result: 得到了各相对论中心下自旋1/2粒子的横向总角动量与助推二维空间分布表达式，揭示了空间图形随纵向洛伦兹助推的演化规律，并通过横向平面的光前分布建立了瞬时形式与光前描述之间的明晰联系。
AI.conclusion: 横向角动量与助推的空间分布强烈依赖于所选枢轴，且不同相对论中心的定义会系统性改变分布形态；该研究为连接瞬时形式与光前形式下横转角动量与助推的描述提供了统一框架。

title: Structure and dynamics of interface around a quenched impurity in a colloidal liquid film
summary: The interfacial structure and dynamics around a quenched impurity is far from understood till date. Here we explore the structural and dynamical properties of interface between colloidal fluid film and a quenched impurity by using computer simulation. We tune the size($σ_{imp}$) of a quenched pinned impurity and observe that the impurity surface is wetted by a fluid layer, giving rise to a finite-width interfacial region for sufficiently large impurities. Beyond this interfacial region, the host fluid exhibits quasi-long ranged orientational order(QLRO) due to the fluid- crystal phase coexistence. We find that the mean diffusivity becomes very low in the QLRO phase where the self van Hove function shows an exponential tail, signature of dynamic heterogeneity within the system. In the presence of second impurity the orientational order is suppressed if the fluid layers around the impurity particles overlap.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计算机模拟研究了淬灭杂质（quenched impurity）周围胶体流体膜的界面结构与动力学，发现足够大的杂质表面会被流体润湿形成有限宽界面区域，而其外的主体流体因流体-晶体相共存表现出准长程取向序（quasi-long ranged orientational order, QLRO），在该区域平均扩散率极低且自范霍夫函数呈指数尾部，暗示系统存在动态异质性（dynamic heterogeneity）。
AI.motivation: 淬灭杂质周围的界面结构及动力学至今尚未被充分理解，本文旨在通过计算机模拟系统性地探讨这一问题。
AI.method: 采用计算机模拟方法，调控淬灭钉扎杂质的尺寸（σ_imp），研究胶体流体膜与淬灭杂质之间的界面结构及动力学性质；同时引入第二个杂质考察其对取向序的影响。
AI.result: 足够大的杂质表面被流体层润湿并形成有限宽度的界面区域；界面区域之外的主体流体由于流体-晶体相共存而呈现准长程取向序（QLRO）。在QLRO相中平均扩散率极低，自范霍夫函数（self van Hove function）表现出指数尾部，是动态异质性的标志。当第二个杂质颗粒周围流体层与第一杂质周围流体层重叠时，取向序被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 淬灭杂质尺寸是控制界面润湿及主体流体取向序的关键参数；主体流体的QLRO与动态异质性相关联，而杂质间流体层的重叠会破坏取向有序性，为理解胶体体系中杂质诱导的界面行为提供了模拟依据。

title: Spectral Sign Implication for Quantum Logic
summary: We study the spectral sign implication for quantum logic, defined by the nonnegative spectral projection of the operator obtained by subtracting the antecedent projection from the consequent projection. The construction agrees with classical material implication on commuting projections and compares arbitrary pairs of projections through the spectral structure of their difference. It satisfies Hardegree's four minimal implicative conditions, his law of contraposition, and a falsity condition. It differs from the standard polynomial implications in that its value need not belong to the ortholattice generated by its arguments. Within a uniform class of Borel constructions for pairs of projections, the operations satisfying entailment, contraposition, and the falsity condition correspond exactly to measurable choices of spectral branch. In the continuous subclass, these three conditions determine the spectral sign implication uniquely. In finite dimensions, the operation is also the largest among the acceptance projections of optimal projective tests for Helstrom discrimination between subspace states with priors proportional to rank. These results connect quantum implication with the operator theory of two projections and binary quantum discrimination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向量子逻辑的“谱符号蕴含”（spectral sign implication），其构造由时滞投影减去前件投影所得算子的非负谱投影定义。该构造与经典实质蕴含在可交换投影上一致，满足 Hardegree 的四条最小蕴含条件、逆否律及虚假性条件，并在若干条件下被唯一确定。它还与二进制量子判别问题中的 Helstrom 判别最优投影测试建立了联系。
AI.motivation: 旨在为量子逻辑（quantum logic）中的蕴含运算提供一种与算子谱结构（spectral structure）直接相关的构造方案，以弥补现有多项式蕴含（polynomial implication）在满足经典蕴含性质与推广到任意投影对方面的不足，同时沟通量子蕴含与两投影算子理论及量子判别理论之间的深层关联。
AI.method: 构造定义为后件投影减去前件投影所得算子的非负谱投影（nonnegative spectral projection），从而将一对投影的蕴含结果建立在二者差算子的谱分解之上。作者在可交换投影情形下验证其与经典实质蕴含的一致性，并对其所属的均匀一族 Borel 构造进行公理刻画，检验其在连续子类中的唯一性。
AI.result: 该蕴含算子满足 Hardegree 的四条最小蕴含条件、逆否律（law of contraposition）及一条虚假性条件，但其取值不需要属于由两个自变量生成的正交格（ortholattice）。在均匀的 Borel 构造类中，满足蕴含性、逆否律及虚假性条件的操作恰好对应谱分支的可测选择；而在连续子类中，这三个条件唯一确定谱符号蕴含。在有限维情形下，该操作还是以按秩比例为先验的 Helstrom 判别中子空间态最优投影测试中接受投影的最大者。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，谱符号蕴含既在公理层面由蕴含性、逆否律与虚假性条件联合唯一确定于连续谱分支选择类中，又在有限维量子判别中具有最优性解释。由此，量子蕴含与两投影算子理论以及二进制量子判别（binary quantum discrimination）之间建立了系统性联系。

title: Discovery of Superconductivity in a Bulk Moire Superlattice Material
summary: Moire materials provide a versatile platform realizing emergent electronic states arising from enhanced correlation due to flat bands. A variety of phenomena including superconductivity, low dimensional ferromagnetism, Mott insulating phase, topological phenomena have been reported in such systems. To date, moire phenomena have been predominantly explored in artificially assembled low-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures, where relative twist and lattice alignment are controlled during device fabrication. Recently, intrinsically grown bulk moire crystals have emerged as a complementary materials platform, in which lattice mismatch between constituent layers generates a coherent moire superlattice throughout the bulk crystal. Here we report the evidence of bulk superconductivity in single crystals of a recently reported bulk Moire materials (Sr6TaS8)1+x(TaS2)8 under ambient pressure conditions. The material exhibits a superconducting transition at Tc = 2.5 K, evidenced consistently by electrical transport, magnetic susceptibility, and heat-capacity measurements on single-crystal and polycrystalline samples. Transport measurements reveal a pronounced anomaly near 270 K, suggestive of a charge-density-wave transition in this moire system. The observation of bulk superconductivity establishes superconductivity as an emergent phase in this intrinsically synthesized moire material and highlights bulk moire crystals as a promising platform for investigating correlated quantum phenomena beyond artificially assembled two-dimensional heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在本征生长的块体莫尔晶体（bulk moiré crystal）材料(Sr6TaS8)1+x(TaS2)8中首次发现的环境压力下的块体超导电性，其超导转变温度Tc = 2.5 K，由电输运、磁化率和比热测量一致证实，并观察到约270 K处的电荷密度波异常。
AI.motivation: 摩尔材料（moiré materials）因平带导致的增强关联效应可产生多样的涌现电子态，但此前此类现象主要局限于人工组装的低维范德华异质结中。研究者旨在探索本征生长的块体莫尔晶体这一新型材料平台是否也能承载超导等关联量子现象，以拓展莫尔物理的研究边界。
AI.method: 研究采用单晶和多晶样品，通过电输运（electrical transport）、磁化率（magnetic susceptibility）和比热（heat-capacity）测量等实验手段，在环境压力条件下系统表征了(Sr6TaS8)1+x(TaS2)8材料中超导转变及可能的电荷密度波（charge-density-wave）转变特征。
AI.result: 该材料在Tc = 2.5 K处表现出块体超导转变，三种独立测量手段结果一致；此外，输运测量在约270 K处检测到显著异常，提示该莫尔体系中存在电荷密度波转变。
AI.conclusion: 块体超导电性的观测确立了超导态是这一本征合成莫尔材料的涌现相之一，并表明块体莫尔晶体是研究超越人工组装二维异质结构的相关量子现象的有前景平台。

title: Two-Loop Anomalous Dimension for Non-Global and Clustering Logarithms
summary: We derive the two-loop anomalous dimension relevant for the resummation of subleading non-global and, for the first time, also clustering logarithms within the framework of effective field theory. Special emphasis is put on the choice of the renormalization scheme. We show that the modified minimal subtraction scheme is problematic since it requires extra dimensions to set up the parton shower to perform the resummation. We discuss a set of modified dipole subtraction schemes which are free from this complication and can be used to obtain a frame-independent result for the renormalization-group evolution. We implement the leading-color limit of our result in the Marzili framework and numerically verify the scheme independence for gap-between-jets cross sections.

AI.tldr: 本文在有效场论（effective field theory）框架下推导了与次领头阶非全局（subleading non-global）以及首次实现的聚类（clustering）对数重求和相关的两圈反常维度（two-loop anomalous dimension），并重点探讨了重整化方案（renormalization scheme）的选择问题。
AI.motivation: 非全局与聚类对数的高阶重求和是精确描述喷注间能隙（gap-between-jets）等可观测量所必需的，而恰当的重整化方案选择对于获得自洽且与参照系无关的重整化群（renormalization group）演化结果至关重要。
AI.method: 在有效场论框架中推导两圈反常维度；分析修正最小减除（modified minimal subtraction）方案的缺陷，即其要求额外维度来构建部分子簇射（parton shower）以完成重求和；提出一组修正偶极子减除（modified dipole subtraction）方案以规避该问题；并将结果的领头色（leading-color）极限在Marzili框架中实现。
AI.result: 研究表明修正最小减除方案存在问题，而所提出的修正偶极子减除方案可避免该复杂性，从而获得与参照系无关的重整化群演化结果；数值验证表明该方案对喷注间能隙截面的结果具有方案独立性（scheme independence）。
AI.conclusion: 修正偶极子减除方案可作为可靠的重整化方案，用于进行非全局与聚类对数的重求和，并拓展至领头色极限下的数值应用。

title: First-principles-based Prediction of Phase Fields: Part I. Binary and Ternary Refractory Alloys
summary: Multiple principal element alloys (MPEAs) exhibit complex phase equilibria involving multinary solid solutions and intermetallics, which makes it challenging to predict their temperature-composition phase diagrams. Their vast compositional space makes first principles methods prohibitively expensive, while CALPHAD is limited by scarce experimental data. Here, we present a computationally efficient framework to predict the solvus phase boundaries, and hence, phase fields, in refractory MPEAs composed of Cr, Hf, Mo, Nb, Ta, Ti, V, W, and Zr. The approach combines DFT calculated binary mixing enthalpies with sub regular solution models to construct phase diagrams without fitting higher order interactions, enabling efficient scaling across composition space. Validation against 36 binary and 15 ternary phase diagrams demonstrates good agreement, with both experimental results and CALPHAD calculations. We find that the prediction accuracy is enhanced by incorporating lattice dependent energetics through sub regular solution models and including temperature-dependent elemental phase transitions. The framework captures miscibility gaps, solid solution stability, and intermetallic formation, with predicted miscible temperatures typically within 300 K of experimental values. Overall, this work establishes a scalable, first principles based route for highthroughput prediction of phase diagrams in refractory MPEAs. A publicly accessible web interface has also been developed to allow interactive exploration of the predicted phase diagrams, available at https://raptor.engr.wustl.edu.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算高效的计算框架，将DFT计算的二元混合焓与次正则溶液模型（sub regular solution model）相结合，在不拟合高阶相互作用的情况下预测由Cr、Hf、Mo、Nb、Ta、Ti、V、W和Zr组成的难熔多主元合金（MPEAs）的固溶线相界和相场。通过与36个二元和15个三元相图对比验证，该方法与实验及CALPHAD计算结果均表现良好，预测混溶温度误差通常在300K以内，并提供了公开的交互式网页界面。
AI.motivation: 多主元合金（multiple principal element alloys, MPEAs）涉及多组分固溶体和金属间化合物的复杂相平衡，导致其温度-成分相图难以预测。巨大的成分空间使第一性原理方法计算成本过高，而CALPHAD方法又受限于稀缺的实验数据，亟需一种兼具物理精度与计算效率的相图预测途径。
AI.method: 该框架将密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的二元混合焓与次正则溶液模型相结合来构建相图，无需拟合高阶相互作用项，从而可在成分空间内高效扩展。方法中纳入晶格相关能量以及随温度变化的元素相变以提升预测精度。
AI.result: 框架在36个二元和15个三元相图上与实验结果及CALPHAD计算结果均高度吻合，能够捕捉混溶间隙（miscibility gap）、固溶体稳定性及金属间化合物的形成，预测混溶温度通常在实验值的300K误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一条可扩展的、基于第一性原理的高通量相图预测路线，适用于难熔多主元合金，并提供了公开可访问的交互式网页界面供用户探索预测相图。

title: Negative contacts in genus one: a comparison of punctured and root stack Gromov-Witten theories
summary: Let $D$ be a smooth divisor in a smooth projective complex variety $X$. For connected curves of arithmetic genus one with prescribed signed contact orders, we prove that the refined punctured cycle of Battistella--Nabijou--Ranganathan and the negative-contact cycle of Fan--Wu--You agree after pushforward to the common moduli space of stable maps with divisor evaluations. Thus the pushed-forward refined punctured cycle is the constant coefficient of the pushed-forward root-stack virtual class, normalized by one power of the root order for each negative contact. The key step is a comparison for the universal target. After restricting to finite-type open substacks determined by the fixed pair $(X,D)$ and numerical data $Γ$, we prove that the positive BNR space maps finitely and with generic degree one onto Crumplin's main component. Using Crumplin's genus-one component description and degree formulas, we identify this component's fundamental cycle with the constant coefficient of the universal orbifold virtual class under comparison of root orders. Refined zero-section pullback recovers the negative contacts, and compatible virtual pullbacks and root-forgetting pushforwards transfer the resulting identity to $(X,D)$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在具有除子赋值（divisor evaluations）的稳定映射（stable maps）公共模空间上，Battistella–Nabijou–Ranganathan 的细化打洞循环（refined punctured cycle）与 Fan–Wu–You 的负接触循环（negative-contact cycle）在推前（pushforward）后一致，并建立了两者与根栈虚拟类（root-stack virtual class）常数系数之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 在光滑射影复簇中带除子的算术亏格一曲线理论中，存在多种由不同方法构造的模空间与循环类，它们的等价性问题尚待澄清。本文旨在证明细化打洞循环与负接触循环在推前后的一致性，从而统一两种独立构造。
AI.method: 关键在于对通用目标（universal target）进行比较。作者先将问题限制到由固定配对 (X, D) 和数值数据 Γ 所确定的有限型开子层（finite-type open substacks）上，证明正 BNR 空间以有限且一般次数为一的方式覆盖 Crumplin 的主分量（main component）。利用 Crumplin 的亏格一分量描述与次数公式，作者在比较根阶（root orders）后，将该分量的基本循环等同为普适轨道虚拟类（universal orbifold virtual class）的常数系数。通过细化的零截面拉回恢复负接触项，并借助兼容的虚拟拉回与遗忘根映射的推前来将等式转移到原目标 (X, D) 上。
AI.result: 证明了推前后的细化打洞循环等于根栈虚拟类的常数系数（对每个负接触归一化一个根阶幂）。该结果以严格的代数几何论证统一了两种先前独立构造的循环类，并刻画了其与根栈虚拟类之间的精确数值关系。
AI.conclusion: 细化打洞循环与负接触循环在推前意义下等价，并具有明确的根栈虚拟类解释。这一结果建立了不同模空间构造间的一致性，为算术亏格一曲线的除子接触理论提供了统一的框架。

title: Hydrodynamic attractors
comment: 57 pages, 11 figures. Invited chapter for Encyclopedia of Nuclear Physics. Comments welcome!
summary: Attractors are effective low-dimensional structures, defined in a chosen set of observables, that trajectories from different initial states approach; hydrodynamic attractors are those on which the late-time evolution is governed by hydrodynamic constitutive relations. Motivated by nuclear collisions and ultracold atomic gases, this chapter distinguishes attractorization (the loss of sensitivity to some directions in the space of initial states) from hydrodynamization (the onset of validity of hydrodynamic constitutive relations). Using mainly conformal, boost-invariant Bjorken flow, we compare Müller-Israel-Stewart-type theories, kinetic theory, holography, and classical Yang-Mills fields. Forward attraction, produced by the decay of non-hydrodynamic modes, is distinguished from pullback attraction, which can select a unique regular solution, and from expansion-driven attraction, which can suppress initial-state sensitivity before microscopic relaxation, with or without a subsequent fluid regime. Divergent gradient expansions and their transseries completions, the state-space picture, and adiabatic hydrodynamization provide complementary descriptions. Applications to nuclear collisions include particle production, transverse energy and flow, the initialization of and linear response around attracting backgrounds, jet quenching, and attractor-informed modifications of hydrodynamic models. For ultracold Fermi gases, we review theoretical proposals for bulk-channel attractors under scattering-length drives and distinguish them from recent measurements of short-time contact and momentum-distribution dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本章综述了吸引子（attractor）在非平衡强相互作用体系中的概念与作用，系统区分了吸引子化与流体化两种过程，并基于共形boost不变量Bjorken流对比了多种理论框架，讨论了其在核碰撞与超冷费米气体中的物理应用。
AI.motivation: 核碰撞与超冷原子气体的实验需求挑战了非平衡演化的传统图像，作者希望厘清吸引子化（attractorization）与流体化（hydrodynamization）这两个密切相关但概念上可分离的过程，从而为中高能核物理提供统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 文章以共形、boost不变（boost-invariant）的Bjorken流为主要载体，系统比较了Müller-Israel-Stewart型理论、动力学理论（kinetic theory）、全息对偶（holography）以及经典Yang-Mills场；将吸引子划分为前向吸引、回拉吸引与膨胀驱动吸引三种类型，并借助发散梯度展开（gradient expansion）及其transseries补全、相空间图像和“绝热流体化”等方案给出互补性描述。
AI.result: 文章识别出吸引子的不同起源机制，包括非流体模衰减产生的“前向吸引”、可选取唯一规则解的“回拉吸引”，以及可在微观弛豫之前抑制初态敏感性的“膨胀驱动吸引”。在应用层面，综述涉及粒子产生、横能（transverse energy）与流、吸引态背景上的初始化与线性响应、射流淬火（jet quenching）以及对流体力学模型的修改；对于超冷费米气体，则区分了散射长度驱动下体通道吸引子的理论方案与近期短时间接触及动量分布动力学的实验测量。
AI.conclusion: 吸引子概念为理解从初始态敏感度丧失到流体力学描述有效的整段非平衡演化提供了统一框架；不同理论框架下吸引子的机制与表现存在系统差异，其对核碰撞与超冷原子实验的预言有待进一步的理论与实验对照验证。

title: Evidence of Haldane-Chain Physics in an Fe-Dehydroindigo Coordination Polymer
summary: We investigate whether an Fe--dehydroindigo spin-crossover coordination polymer can support Haldane-chain physics in its intrinsic, substrate-free limit. Spin-orbit-coupled density-functional-theory calculations and magnetic energy mapping yield a nearly isotropic antiferromagnetic coupling, $J_{\mathrm H}=32.206$~meV, together with much weaker single-ion anisotropy. Using these parameters, exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group calculations give a nondegenerate ground state separated from the lowest triplet-derived excitations by a gap of about $13$--$14$~meV, on the scale expected for the spin-1 Haldane gap. The anisotropy produces only a small splitting of the low-energy modes. The dynamical spin structure factor places the lowest spectral weight near the antiferromagnetic wave vector $q=π$. These results identify the isolated cis-dehydroindigo chain as a material-specific coordination-polymer platform whose microscopic interactions place it in a gapped regime consistent with Haldane-chain physics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自旋-轨道耦合的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和磁能映射，研究了Fe-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在无衬底条件下是否支持Haldane链物理。结果表明该体系具有近各向同性的反铁磁耦合（$J_H=32.206$ meV）和较弱单离子各向异性，精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算给出约13–14 meV的能隙，与自旋1 Haldane能隙量级一致，确认该孤立顺式脱氢靛蓝链为Haldane链物理的配位聚合物平台。
AI.motivation: 探究一种Fe-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉（spin-crossover）配位聚合物在其固有、无衬底极限下能否支持Haldane链（Haldane-chain）物理，以寻找材料特异的自旋-1量子磁性平台。
AI.method: 采用自旋-轨道耦合的密度泛函理论（spin-orbit-coupled density-functional theory）计算并结合磁能映射（magnetic energy mapping）提取交换参数；随后利用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）和密度矩阵重整化群（density-matrix renormalization group）方法计算基态与低能激发谱，并计算动力学自旋结构因子（dynamical spin structure factor）。
AI.result: 得到近各向同性的反铁磁耦合 $J_H=32.206$ meV 以及较弱的单离子各向异性；基态非简并，最低三重态激发能隙约为13–14 meV，与自旋1 Haldane能隙量级一致；各向异性仅导致低能模小幅分裂；动力学自旋结构因子的最低谱权重位于反铁磁波矢 $q=\pi$ 附近。
AI.conclusion: 孤立顺式脱氢靛蓝（cis-dehydroindigo）链的微观相互作用使其处于与Haldane链物理一致的能隙区，可作为材料特异的配位聚合物平台用于研究Haldane链物理。

title: On overlap concentration in the Curie-Weiss Random Field model
summary: We show that the overlaps of two independent replicas drawn from the Gibbs measure of the Curie--Weiss model with random field (CWRF) exhibit sub-Gaussian tails when the inverse temperature $ β< 1$ and the random field is drawn from a Gaussian distribution that makes the expected magnetization of the CWRF equal to its expected overlap in the thermodynamic limit. To show this, we prove finite-moment concentration via a rigorous Laplace approximation for a certain random rate function, and ``bootstrap'' it to a uniform bound for the moment-generating function of the squared overlap deviations using a sharp analysis of the associated rate function.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在特定条件下（逆温度 β<1 且随机场为高斯分布，使得热力学极限中期望磁化等于期望交叠），Curie–Weiss 随机场模型中两个独立副本的交叠量具有亚高斯尾部。
AI.motivation: 理解随机系统（random system）中交叠量（overlap）的波动性对刻画 Gibbs 测度的统计性质至关重要，尤其是偏离典型值的大偏差行为。Curie–Weiss 随机场（CWRF）模型作为平均场自旋玻璃的经典原型，其副本交叠的尾部行为此前尚缺乏精确刻画。
AI.method: 作者通过严格的 Laplace 近似（Laplace approximation）对特定的随机率函数（random rate function）建立有限矩集中性；随后借助对该率函数的精细分析，将矩界“自举”为交叠平方偏差的矩母函数（moment-generating function）的一致上界，最终推导出亚高斯（sub-Gaussian）尾界。
AI.result: 在逆温度 β<1 且随机场服从高斯分布的设定下（该分布使期望磁化与期望交叠在热力学极限中相等），两个独立副本的交叠量偏离量呈现出亚高斯尾部，即极大偏差的概率衰减速度快于高斯尺度所允许的程度。
AI.conclusion: 该结果表明在特定参数区间内，CWRF 模型的副本交叠波动受到强约束，与亚高斯尾部预测一致，为进一步理解平均场随机系统的涨落与集中性提供理论基础。

title: Electronic correlations and fluctuating lattice distortions in vanadium dioxide
summary: Metal-insulator transitions in correlated materials are often accompanied by a change of crystal structure. They are commonly described within a coherent lattice approximation, which combines a correlated treatment of the electrons with a lattice represented by one or a few classical distortion coordinates fixed by minimizing an energy. The structural degrees of freedom then carry no entropy of their own, even though the partition of the transition entropy between electrons and lattice is often what decides the transition temperature. Here we develop a stochastic semiclassical extension of dynamical mean-field theory in which correlated electrons and fluctuating lattice distortions are evolved together, extending previous formulations from linear to nonlinear electron-phonon interactions and from a single to several coupled lattice modes. The resulting non-conservative Langevin equations have deterministic forces, damping, and correlated noise generated self-consistently by the interacting electronic subsystem. Applying the approach to a minimal two-orbital model containing the two symmetry-distinct distortions of the monoclinic phase of vanadium dioxide, we find that the two distortions melt at well separated temperatures, giving an insulating, an intermediate metallic, and a high-symmetry phase. The two transitions have different origins: the melting of the dimerization is driven by the coupling to the correlated electrons and is captured already within the coherent lattice approximation, whereas the restoration of the undistorted structure requires the entropy of the fluctuating lattice. Since the electronic subsystem is treated within nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory, the framework can be extended in future work to photoexcited systems with nonthermal electronic distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种随机半经典动力学平均场理论（dynamical mean-field theory）扩展方法，将关联电子与涨落晶格畸变协同演化，并应用于二氧化钒（VO₂）的双轨道模型。研究发现两种晶格畸变在不同温度下融化，产生绝缘体、中间金属和高对称相三个相，且两种相变具有不同的物理起源。
AI.motivation: 关联材料中的金属-绝缘体相变（metal-insulator transitions）常伴随晶体结构变化，而现有相干晶格近似（coherent lattice approximation）忽略了晶格自由度自身的熵，但过渡熵在电子与晶格间的分配往往决定转变温度，因此需要一种能够同时处理关联电子与涨落晶格的框架。
AI.method: 发展了动力学平均场理论的随机半经典扩展，将关联电子与涨落晶格畸变同步演化；将此前方法从线性电子-声子相互作用推广到非线性情形，从单一晶格模式扩展到多个耦合模式。所得非守恒朗之万方程（Langevin equations）中的确定性力、阻尼和关联噪声均由相互作用电子子体系自洽产生。电子子体系采用非平衡动力学平均场理论（nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory）处理。
AI.result: 对包含二氧化钒单斜相两种对称性不同畸变的最简双轨道模型的应用显示：两种畸变在远分离的温度下融化，产生绝缘相、中间金属相和高对称相；二聚化畸变的融化由关联电子耦合驱动，可直接由相干晶格近似捕获，而无畸变高对称结构的恢复则需要涨落晶格的熵贡献。
AI.conclusion: 两种相变具有不同起源，其中一步需要涨落晶格熵的贡献，这在传统相干晶格近似中无法描述。由于电子子体系在非平衡动力学平均场理论框架内处理，该方法未来可推广到具有非热电子分布的光激发体系。

title: Finite-Modal Realization and Operator-Norm Convergence of a Source-to-Observation Electromagnetic Scattering Green Operator
summary: Source-to-observation operators provide reusable environment-level descriptions for multi-query electromagnetic (EM) prediction and communication-mode analysis. However, in practical multiple-scattering models, these operators are represented with finitely many angular modes, and agreement for selected excitations or between successive truncation orders does not establish uniform accuracy of the full map or reliability of its singular channels. To close this gap, we formulate the environment-induced response as a scattering Green operator on fixed continuous source and observation spaces and derive an exact trace-space factorization that reconstructs the Maxwell scattered field. For fixed, pairwise-disjoint enclosing trace spheres and a well-posed collective problem, nested vector spherical wave function (VSWF) realizations converge in operator norm. A structural bound separates external modal tails from collective-resolvent sensitivity, and operator-norm convergence guarantees uniform convergence of the singular values. We further construct a finite metric core that preserves the nonzero singular values of each finite-order operator and reconstructs matched orthonormal source--field channels without introducing external-support discretization degrees of freedom (DoF) into the spectral problem. Full-wave benchmarks verify the finite-order implementation. A controlled near-resonant two-sphere study shows that adjacent-order agreement can precede resolution of the dominant high-order collective direction. It further shows that only part of the internal amplification appears in externally accessible gains and that resonance promotes a distinct high-order channel pair above an otherwise preserved low-order family. The resulting framework provides a convergent, metric-consistent finite-modal representation of multiple-scattering source-to-observation operators and their accessible channels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将多体散射源-观测算子（source-to-observation operator）的有限模态表示建立在收敛的算子范数框架之上的方法。通过将环境响应表述为固定连续源与观测空间上的散射格林算子（scattering Green operator），并推导精确的迹空间分解（trace-space factorization），作者证明了嵌套矢量球面波函数（VSWF）实现在算子范数下收敛，并构建了保持奇异值谱的有限度量核（finite metric core），从而为有限模态表示提供了严格的收敛性与谱可靠性保证。
AI.motivation: 在多查询电磁预测和通信模式分析中，源到观测算子提供了可复用的环境级描述，但实际多散射模型中这些算子仅以有限数量的角模态表示。既有问题在于：对选定激励或相邻截断阶之间的一致性，并不能确立整幅映射的均匀精度或其奇异通道的可靠性。因此需要闭合这一理论缺口，为有限模态表示提供保证。
AI.method: 本文将环境诱导响应形式化为固定连续源与观测空间上的散射格林算子，推导出精确的迹空间分解以重构麦克斯韦散射场。对于固定的成对不相交包围迹球（trace sphere）以及适定集体问题，嵌套矢量球面波函数实现被证明在算子范数下收敛；结构界将外部模态尾部与集体预解灵敏度分离。进一步构造了一个有限度量核，保留各有限阶算子的非零奇异值并重构匹配的正交源-场通道，且不引入外部支撑离散化自由度（DoF）进入谱问题。
AI.result: 全波基准验证了有限阶实现的正确性。受控的近共振两球体研究表明：相邻阶一致性可能先于主导高阶集体方向的分辨而出现；内部放大只有部分反映在外部可及增益中；共振会提升一个独特的高阶通道对，同时保留原有的低阶族。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多体散射源到观测算子及其可及通道提供了一种收敛且度量一致的有限模态表示，从理论上弥合了有限模态逼近与实际算子谱性质之间的鸿沟。

title: Activity enhances heterogenous dynamics in 2D granular glasses
summary: We study the effect of self-propulsion in the approach to the glassy regime of 2D bidisperse mixtures of frictional discs, confined to a horizontal plane, and fluidized by vertical vibrations. The discs are designed either to be passive, that is, exhibiting isotropic motion in the plane, or active, with a preferred polar mobility. When dynamics in mixtures of large active and small passive discs are compared to mixtures of large and small passive discs, the active system shows faster dynamics at equal area fractions. To explore whether activity merely speeds up motion, we select active and passive mixtures with the same relaxation time and compare their dynamics. Many indicators show that dynamical heterogeneity is much greater in the active glass with longer-ranged spatial velocity correlations, larger temporal variations in displacement, and higher amplitude of the four-point correlator. In this very crowded regime, despite frequent collisions, the activity directions of the discs remain persistent. However, the activity direction of the discs remains spatially uncorrelated, and furthermore, the particle displacements are not aligned with the activity direction, thus presenting a puzzle as to how activity leads to such strong heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维摩擦圆盘双分散混合物在玻璃态转变过程中自推进（self-propulsion）的影响。通过对比主动（active）与被动（passive）圆盘混合物的动力学，发现在相同松弛时间下，主动系统表现出更强的动力学异质性（dynamical heterogeneity）、更长程的速度空间关联与更高的四点关联函数幅值，尽管主动方向保持空间不相关且粒子位移与主动方向不一致。
AI.motivation: 理解主动粒子（active particles）在致密玻璃态（glassy regime）中的动力学行为，特别是自推进效应如何影响系统的弛豫与异质性，这一机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 研究二维水平面内由垂直振动流化的摩擦圆盘双分散混合物，系统包含主动（具有偏好极性迁移性）与被动（各向同性运动）两类圆盘。通过控制面积分数比较主动/被动混合物的弛豫时间，并利用四点关联函数（four-point correlator）、速度空间关联与位移时间变化等指标评估动力学异质性。
AI.result: 在相同面积分数下，含大主动与小被动圆盘的混合物比大小均为被动的混合物弛豫更快。在等松弛时间比较中，主动玻璃表现出显著更大幅度的动力学异质性，包括更长程的速度空间关联、更大的位移时间涨落和更高的四点关联函数峰值。尽管碰撞频繁，圆盘的主动方向保持持久（persistent），但其空间分布无关联，且粒子位移并不沿主动方向对齐。
AI.conclusion: 主动系统虽未通过方向性平移直接驱动粒子运动，却显著增强了动力学异质性，这对理解活动性如何诱导强异质性提出了待解之谜（puzzle），表明需进一步研究其潜在的非平凡微观机制。

title: Subcritical limits of a 1D KPZ growth surface with finite moments
summary: We consider the one-dimensional random growth surface introduced by Adhikari and Chatterjee [AC24], where the height function is defined recursively via the heights at two neighboring sites and an independent noise term at each space-time point. In the subcritical regime, assuming uniformly bounded eighth moments of the noise variables and appropriate regularity of the driving function, we establish convergence in law of the suitably rescaled height function to the solution of the additive stochastic heat equation. Our approach employs a direct recursive renormalization scheme. A central component is a graph representation of the renormalization terms, which enables the derivation of the high-moment bounds essential to the renormalization procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Adhikari和Chatterjee提出的二维（一维空间加一维时间）随机增长曲面模型，在次临界区间内，假设噪声变量的八阶矩一致有界且驱动函数满足适当正则性条件，证明了适当缩放的高度函数在分布上收敛到加性随机热方程（additive stochastic heat equation）的解。文中采用直接递归重整化（renormalization）方案，其中图表示是推导高矩界的关键工具。
AI.motivation: 随机增长曲面是概率论与统计物理交叉领域的重要研究对象，此前Adhikari和Chatterjee[AC24]提出了一个通过相邻两站点高度与独立噪声项递归定义的高度函数模型。该模型的收敛性质尚待严格建立，尤其是缩放后的高度函数在分布上的极限行为是否由加性随机热方程刻画，这一问题需要系统的数学证明。
AI.method: 本文采用直接递归重整化（direct recursive renormalization）方案来证明收敛性。方法的核心包括两个要素：其一，设定噪声变量的八阶矩一致有界以及驱动函数满足适当正则性条件；其二，引入重整化项的图表示（graph representation），借助该表示推导重整化过程所需的高矩界（high-moment bounds）。
AI.result: 在次临界区间（subcritical regime）内，在所述矩条件与正则性假设下，本文建立了适当缩放后的高度函数在分布上收敛到加性随机热方程解的定律收敛（convergence in law）结果。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将Adhikari–Chatterjee模型的动力学极限行为与加性随机热方程建立了严格联系，并展示了递归重整化结合图表示方法在分析此类随机增长模型中的有效性。

title: Near-Horizon Tidal Disruption Events
summary: Tidal disruption events (TDEs) offer a unique dynamical probe of the spacetime geometry around supermassive black holes (SMBHs). While conventional TDEs occur around SMBHs of $M_\bullet \sim 10^6 - 10^7 M_\odot$, where stars are disrupted far from the event horizon, here we identify a special class of TDEs around rapidly spinning SMBHs with masses $M_\bullet \gtrsim 10^8 M_\odot$, where the tidal-disruption radius approaches the gravitational radius. We term these events "near-horizon TDEs" and, by calculating geodesics in Kerr spacetime, investigate how the proximity of the horizon modifies the debris evolution and subsequent fallback. We find that for stars encountering the SMBH on parabolic orbits, up to $\sim (90 \%-95 \%)$ of the stellar debris either plunges directly into the SMBH or escapes the system. Bound orbits, by contrast, retain a substantially larger fraction of the debris. Using the resulting debris distribution, we calculate the fallback rates and find that bound orbits produce intrinsically higher peak fallback rates and shorter decay timescales, by factors of $\sim 10^3$ relative to parabolic orbits. However, when the stellar orbital angular momentum is particularly low, the peak fallback rate can be substantially suppressed by debris lost to plunge orbits. This combination of rapid fallback and a mass deficit naturally explains overluminous TDEs such as ASASSN-15lh, which standard TDE models have struggled to reproduce. Our work establishes near-horizon TDEs as a new probe of strong-field gravity and a promising tool for identifying massive, rapidly spinning SMBHs.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了一类围绕大质量快速自旋超大质量黑洞（supermassive black hole, SMBH）发生的特殊潮汐瓦解事件（tidal disruption event, TDE），称之为"近视界潮汐瓦解事件"（near-horizon TDEs），并通过计算Kerr时空中的测地线揭示了视界邻近性对碎片演化和回落（fallback）动力学的影响，为强引力场探针和大质量快速自旋黑洞的识别提供了新工具。
AI.motivation: 传统TDE发生在质量约为 $10^6-10^7 M_\odot$ 的黑洞周围，恒星在远离事件视界（event horizon）处被瓦解。本文旨在探索一种特殊情形——潮汐瓦解半径逼近引力半径时，视界邻近性如何改变碎片演化与回落过程，从而建立对强引力场的新探测途径。
AI.method: 作者识别质量 $M_\bullet \gtrsim 10^8 M_\odot$ 且快速自旋的SMBH周围、潮汐瓦解半径接近引力半径的事件为"近视界TDE"，并在Kerr时空中计算测地线（geodesics），以研究视界邻近性对恒星碎片演化和后续回落的影响。基于所得碎片分布计算不同轨道类型的回落率。
AI.result: 对抛物线（parabolic）轨道相遇的恒星，约90%-95%的碎片要么直接坠入SMBH要么逃逸系统；而束缚（bound）轨道能保留更大比例的碎片。束缚轨道产生的峰值回落率比抛物线轨道高出约三个数量级，且衰减时标更短。但当恒星轨道角动量特别低时，因碎片坠入而导致的峰值回落率会被大幅抑制。快速回落与质量亏缺的结合可自然解释如ASASSN-15lh等超亮TDE现象。
AI.conclusion: 本工作将"近视界TDE"确立为强引力场（strong-field gravity）的新探针，并作为识别大质量、快速自旋SMBH的有效工具。落入和逃逸碎片的巨大比例体现并利用了极端时空弯曲效应，为现有标准TDE模型无法解释的超亮事件提供了新的物理解释途径。

title: Revealing the origin of ionic conduction in silver-iodide-doped silver phosphate glass
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Supplemental Information available on request
summary: Fast ionic transport is a defining feature of many solid electrolytes, yet its microscopic origin is not fully understood. In the absence of microscopic insights, the development of next-generation solid-state batteries remains largely empirical. Most existing measurements access either the low-frequency transport response or the high-frequency bound polarization, yet the intermediate mesoscopic frequency regime is where ionic transport emerges. By varying the $\mathrm{AgI}$ concentration ($x$) and performing time-domain terahertz spectroscopy (TDTS) in a prototypical glassy electrolyte $\left(\mathrm{AgI}\right)_{x}\left(\mathrm{AgPO_3}\right)_{(1-x)}$, we reveal this intermediate frequency regime and identify a crossover from bound-current-dominated conduction to conductivity arising from short-range dispersive ionic transport. We find that bound polarization associated with the bond-bending motion of the $\mathrm{P{-}O^- -Ag^+}$ motif is present across compositions but is insufficient to produce ionic transport on its own. Transport emerges only when this polarization is embedded in a sufficiently soft $\mathrm{AgPO_3}$ glassy matrix and accompanied by a high carrier density. These ingredients together take the system from a vibrationally bound response to short-range dispersive motion.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过改变AgI浓度并使用时间域太赫兹光谱（TDTS）研究原型玻璃态电解质(AgI)_x(AgPO_3)_(1-x)，揭示了介于低频输运与高频束缚极化之间的介观频率区间，识别出从束缚电流主导的传导到短程色散离子输运的交叉行为，进而阐明了快速离子输运的微观起源条件。
AI.motivation: 快速离子输运是许多固体电解质的标志性特征，但其微观起源尚未完全理解。缺乏微观层面的认识使得下一代固态电池的开发大多停留在经验层面，因此亟需揭示离子输运涌现的介观机制。
AI.method: 通过系统地改变AgI浓度x，在原型玻璃态电解质(AgI)_x(AgPO_3)_(1-x)上实施时间域太赫兹光谱（TDTS）测量，以探测此前未充分覆盖的中间介观频率区间。
AI.result: 研究发现了一个从束缚电流主导的传导到由短程色散离子输运产生的电导率之间的交叉。与P-O^- -Ag^+基团的键弯曲运动相关的束缚极化在所有组分中均存在，但单独不足以产生离子输运。
AI.conclusion: 离子输运的涌现需要三个条件的协同：束缚极化必须嵌入足够软的AgPO_3玻璃基质中，并伴随高的载流子密度。这些要素共同将体系从振动束缚响应转变为短程色散运动。

title: A finite-strain logarithmic viscoelastic model for Antarctic ice shelves based on an additive split
summary: Ice shelves lose mass primarily by calving, a process controlled by the near-front stress field on timescales that span elastic flexure and viscous creep. We formulate a finite-strain Maxwell model for glacier ice in logarithmic strain space. The Hencky strain of a fixed reference configuration is split additively at the level of rates into elastic and viscous parts; the spring is isotropic Hencky elasticity and the dashpot is a Glen-type power law written on the logarithmic strain rate and its work-conjugate stress. At infinitesimal strain the dashpot coincides with Glen's flow law; the elastic strains in the ice-shelf configurations of this paper remain in that regime. The model is integrated with a midpoint evaluation and a backward-Euler correction of the trial dual, and implemented in a finite-element setting. After a viscoelastic column benchmark, the formulation is applied to an idealised ice tongue, including depth-dependent density and moduli, temperature-dependent fluidity, and cliff geometries with a frontal foot or basal undercutting. The resulting stress fields show how viscoelasticity and front morphology control tension near the terminus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于对数应变空间的有限应变麦克斯韦（Maxwell）粘弹性模型，用于描述冰川冰在冰架前缘附近受弹性弯曲和粘性蠕变共同控制的应力场，并通过有限元实现应用于理想化冰舌以揭示粘弹性和前缘形态对末端张力的影响。
AI.motivation: 冰架主要以前缘崩解（calving）方式损失质量，而崩解受前缘附近应力场控制，该应力场的时间尺度跨越弹性弯曲与粘性蠕变。因此需要一个能够同时捕捉这两种机制的粘弹性本构模型来分析前端形态对应力场的影响。
AI.method: 在数值上，模型采用中点半隐式（midpoint evaluation）评估与后向欧拉（backward-Euler）校正试算对偶量，并在有限元框架中实现。在校准粘弹性柱状基准测试后，模型应用于理想化冰舌，其中包含随深度变化的密度和模量、随温度变化的流动性（fluidity），以及带前脚（frontal foot）或底部底切（basal undercutting）的悬崖几何结构。
AI.result: 所得到的应力场展示了粘弹性与前缘形态如何共同控制冰舌末端的张力（tension）分布。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在无穷小应变极限下与格伦流动律（Glen's flow law）一致，本文涉及的冰架构型中的弹性应变保持在无穷小应变范围内，验证了该公式在本问题中的适用性。

title: Collective Excitonic Structure Governs Anomalously Weak Thermal Optical Dephasing in Conjugated Polymers
