summary: Conjugated polymer aggregates exhibit optical decoherence in the presence of strong vibronic coupling and substantial diversity in chemical structure, solid-state organization, and excitonic character. Here, we use coherence-detected and population-detected two-dimensional electronic spectroscopies to examine the temperature dependence of the homogeneous optical linewidth across a series of semiconducting polymers. Despite substantial differences in molecular architecture and solid-state organization, all polymers studied exhibit remarkably weak thermal linewidth scaling over the measured temperature range. Comparison between complementary detection modalities further shows that, while this weak temperature dependence is obust, the absolute homogeneous linewidth depends on the measured observable. This behavior reflects the different ways in which coherence- and population-detected measurements project population relaxation and pure dephasing onto the spectroscopic response. These results establish the weak thermal scaling of optical decoherence across a diverse series of conjugated polymers and show that its experimental manifestation must be interpreted in the context of the detection observable.

AI.tldr: 本文利用相干检测和布居检测的二维电子光谱法，系统研究了多种半导体共轭聚合物的光学线宽随温度的变化，发现尽管分子结构和固态组织差异显著，所有聚合物均展现出异常微弱的热线宽缩放行为；但均匀线宽的绝对值依赖于检测观测量，反映了两种检测方式对布居弛豫与纯退相位的不同投影方式。
AI.motivation: 共轭聚合物（conjugated polymers）聚集体在强振动耦合、化学结构多样性、固态组织差异及激子特性变化下表现出光学退相干（optical decoherence），但其温度依赖性的普遍规律尚不清楚，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 采用相干检测（coherence-detected）和布居检测（population-detected）两种互补的二维电子光谱法（two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy，2DES），在一系列半导体聚合物上测量均匀光学线宽（homogeneous optical linewidth）的温度依赖关系。
AI.result: 在所有研究的聚合物中，尽管分子架构和固态组织差异显著，均匀线宽均表现出异常微弱的温度缩放（thermal linewidth scaling）；同时，冷却检测和布居检测两种方式得到的谱线表现出弱温度依赖性是稳健的，但绝对均匀线宽数值依赖于所测量的观测量。
AI.conclusion: 该行为反映了相干检测和布居检测以不同方式将布居弛豫（population relaxation）和纯退相位（pure dephasing）投影到光谱响应上；研究确立了多种共轭聚合物光学退相干具有微弱热缩放这一普遍规律，并指出其实验表现需结合检测观测量进行解读。

title: A Content-Addressed Workflow for Reproducible DANTE Gravitational-Wave Anomaly Analysis
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Reproducibility artifacts and tagged workflow release: https://github.com/lucacirfeta/dante-gravi-signal-ml/tree/dante-workflow-productization-v1
summary: Unsupervised analysis of gravitational-wave detector data combines expensive scientific stages with data acquisition, provenance checks, statistical calibration, follow-up products, and reporting. Reproducing such an analysis requires more than preserving model weights or a final candidate table: the execution graph, scientific contracts, retry semantics, and verification boundary must also be explicit. We present a local workflow layer for the Domain-Adaptive Network for Transient Evaluation (DANTE) that represents a corrected O4a analysis as a content-addressed, 15-stage directed acyclic graph. The architecture separates immutable stage evidence from mutable operational progress, binds command-line and browser interfaces to the same run identity, and resumes only work compatible with the frozen contract. The tagged v1 release records all 15 stages as verified in a machine-readable receipt and passed a documented human usability gate. The release verifies adopted scientific artifacts rather than recomputing them, and therefore makes no new claim of global significance, astrophysical discovery, or public real-time operation. This paper describes the architecture, its fail-closed controls, and the bounded evidence supporting reproducible local use.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个为瞬态探测自适应域网络（Domain-Adaptive Network for Transient Evaluation，DANTE）设计的本地工作流层，将修正后的O4a分析表示为内容寻址、15阶段的有向无环图（DAG），以支持可复现的引力波探测器数据分析。
AI.motivation: 引力波探测器数据的无监督分析涉及昂贵的科学阶段与数据采集、溯源校验、统计标定、后续产品及报告等环节。复现此类分析不能仅靠保存模型权重或最终候选表，执行图、科学契约、重试语义和验证边界也必须显式化。
AI.method: 该架构将不可变的阶段证据与可变的操作进度分离，并将命令行与浏览器接口绑定到同一运行身份（run identity），仅恢复与冻结契约兼容的工作。工作流以内容寻址方式表示15个阶段的DAG，并配备fail-closed控制机制。
AI.result: v1标记版本以机器可读的回执记录全部15个阶段已验证，并通过了文档化的人类可用性门控。发布验证了采纳的科学产物而非重新计算，未对全局显著性、天体物理发现或公开实时运行提出新主张。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流架构提供了有界证据，支持可复现的本地使用，通过冻结契约与内容寻址机制确保在验证边界内实现可靠的分析重放。

title: Quantized transport of two-dimensional multifrequency solitons
summary: We consider Thouless pumping of two-dimensional quadratic solitons composed from coherently interacting fundamental frequency (FF) and second harmonic (SH) components propagating in a periodic $χ^{(2)}$ material. The pumping is induced by two mutually sliding two-dimensional lattices defined by shallow transverse and longitudinal periodic refractive index modulation. Focusing on solitons in the semi-infinite gap, we find three distinct pumping scenarios: the absence of transport for small-amplitude solitons, non-quantized transport in a transient regime at intermediate amplitudes, and stable quantized transport for solitons with relatively large amplitudes. Different directions of the sliding velocity were investigated resulting in different trajectories of soliton center. The transition to the regime of quantized transport is found to depend strongly on phase mismatch between FF and SH waves that also influences stability properties of two-dimensional $χ^{(2)}$ lattice solitons. We also show that pumping with longitudinal periods in the x and y directions, whose ratio approximates an irrational number, induces quantized transport whose direction rapidly converges, with increase of the accuracy of the approximation, to a limiting pumping direction determined by this irrational number and corresponding to truly incommensurate longitudinal periods.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了二维二阶光学非线性（$χ^{(2)}$）材料中由基频（FF）与二次谐波（SH）分量组成的相干相互作用太极限孤子（quadratic soliton）的 Thouless 泵浦行为，发现三种不同的输运场景，并表明输运的量子化程度取决于孤子幅度、相位失配以及纵向周期比是否近似无理数。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索周期性光子晶格中非线性拓扑孤子输运的新机制，特别是通过双向滑动二维晶格实现的 Thouless 泵浦是否存在量子化输运，以及其与孤子参数和晶格几何构型之间的关联。
AI.method: 考虑浅横向与纵向周期性折射率调制的两个相互滑动的二维晶格，用于诱导$χ^{(2)}$介质中FF与SH分量相干作用的二次孤子实现 Thouless 泵浦；分析半无限带隙中的孤子输运，系统扫描孤子振幅、滑动速度方向、相位失配及纵向周期比等参数。
AI.result: 发现了三种输运场景：小幅值孤子无输运、中等幅值伴随瞬态非量子化输运、较大幅值孤子实现稳定量子化输运；量子化输运转变强烈依赖于FF与SH波之间的相位失配，且影响孤子稳定性；当x与y方向纵向周期比近似无理数时，泵浦方向快速收敛到由该无理数决定的极限泵浦方向。
AI.conclusion: 二维$χ^{(2)}$晶格孤子的Thouless泵浦量子化行为同时受孤子幅值、相位失配和纵向周期不可通约性（incommensurability）调控，显示了在非线性光子系统中实现可控量子化输运的新途径。

title: Dirac eigenvalues and spacetime mean curvature estimates for DEC spin fill-ins
summary: We establish spacetime counterparts of fill-in inequalities for spin initial data sets satisfying the dominant energy condition in dimensions three through seven, controlling the minimum and the integral of the norm of the spacetime mean curvature vector by intrinsic boundary data. The proof relies on a Reilly--MIT estimate for complete spin manifolds with compact boundary. As further consequences, under suitable nonnegativity assumptions, Gromov's hyperspherical-radius fill-in inequality and Bär's recent total mean-curvature estimate extend to complete, possibly noncompact spin manifolds with compact boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文在维度3至7中建立了满足优势能量条件（dominant energy condition）的自旋（spin）初始数据集关于填充不等式（fill-in inequalities）的时空对应版本，通过内在边界数据控制时空平均曲率向量的最小值和积分范数。
AI.motivation: 已有填充不等式主要用于约束黎曼流形的内在几何性质，本文旨在建立其在满足优势能量条件的自旋初始数据集上的时空（spacetime）推广版本。
AI.method: 证明依赖于对具有紧致边界的完备自旋流形（complete spin manifolds with compact boundary）建立的Reilly–MIT估计。
AI.result: 在适当的非负性假设下，Gromov的超球面半径填充不等式（hyperspherical-radius fill-in inequality）和Bär最近的全平均曲率估计（total mean-curvature estimate）均被推广至具有紧致边界的完备、可能非紧自旋流形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将经典填充不等式从黎曼几何扩展至广义相对论相关的自旋初始数据集框架，并覆盖了非紧流形情形。

title: Symmetry-selective field-induced triplet superconductivity in Ising-superconductor monolayer NbSe$_2$
summary: We investigate superconductivity in monolayer NbSe$_2$, an Ising superconductor, under an in-plane Zeeman field $h_x$, focusing on the emergence of symmetry selected equal-spin triplet pairing. Using a self-consistent Bogoliubov--de Gennes approach with realistic hopping parameters for monolayer NbSe$_2$ on a triangular lattice, we determine the energetically favored singlet pairing states in a range of chemical potentials $μ$ for onsite, nearest-neighbor, and next-nearest-neighbor pairing channels, and map the resulting phase diagram in $(h_x,μ)$ plane. A momentum-resolved analysis reveals distinct dominant contributions in order parameters arise from the surroundings of $Γ$, $K$, and $K'$ points of the Brillouin zone. We find that an in-plane magnetic field helps to induce a triplet pairing whose symmetry is determined by the parent singlet state, upon opening the triplet interaction channel. For the nonlocal pairing channels, chiral-$d$ pairing is energetically favored and it induces chiral-$p$ equal-spin triplet component with opposite chirality. We further find that Rashba spin-orbit coupling, relevant to substrate coupling and electrostatic gating, suppresses the superconducting orders and reduces the critical field. Our results establish a direct link between the symmetry of the parent singlet condensate and the emergent triplet superconductivity, highlighting monolayer NbSe$_2$ as a promising platform for field-tunable mixed-parity superconducting states.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过自洽Bogoliubov–de Gennes方法研究单层NbSe₂（一种Ising超导体）在面内塞曼场（in-plane Zeeman field）下的超导行为，发现面内磁场可诱导对称性由母态单重态配对决定的自旋三重态配对，其中手性d波配对会诱发相反手性的手性p波等自旋三重态分量，而Rashba自旋轨道耦合会抑制超导序并降低临界场。
AI.motivation: 研究Ising超导体单层NbSe₂中由面内磁场诱导的对称性选择等自旋三重态配对的涌现，旨在理解母态单重态凝聚体与涌现三重态超导电性之间的直接关联。
AI.method: 采用具有真实跳跃参数的自洽Bogoliubov–de Gennes（BdG）方法，在三角晶格上对单层NbSe₂展开研究；考察若干化学势μ下在中心（onset）、最近邻和次近邻配对通道的能学上最有利的单重态配对态，并映射(h_x, μ)平面上的相图；同时进行动量分辨分析以考察布里渊区Γ、K和K'点周围的序参量贡献，并检验Rashba自旋轨道耦合的影响。
AI.result: 面内磁场在开启三重态相互作用通道后能诱导对称性由母态单重态决定的三重态配对；非局域配对通道中手性d波配对在能学上最有利，并诱导出相反手性的手性p波等自旋三重态分量；调低（调节）的动量分辨分析表明序参量的主要贡献来自布里渊区Γ、K和K'点附近；Rashba自旋轨道耦合抑制超导序并降低临界场。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了母态单重态凝聚体对称性与涌现三重态超导电性之间的直接联系，凸显单层NbSe₂作为场可调混合宇称（mixed-parity）超导态潜在平台的潜力。

title: Full Characterisation of the Polarisation Primary Beam of the GRAO 32-m Telescope
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables, accepted to RASTI
summary: Direction-dependent instrumental polarisation is a major systematic limitation in high-fidelity single-dish radio polarimetry, yet a unified characterisation of beam leakage and the conditioning of polarisation recovery is lacking for the Ghana Radio Astronomy Observatory (GRAO) 32-m telescope. We aim to establish a quantitative, direction-dependent polarimetric beam model at 5.0 and 6.7 GHz. High-resolution \texttt{GRASP} electromagnetic simulations of the nominal telescope configuration are used to derive the full complex Jones response and corresponding Mueller matrices, from which beam shape, beam squint, instrumental Stokes leakage, and intrinsic cross-polarisation ratio (IXR) are evaluated across the primary beam. The Stokes $I$ beams have half-power beam widths of $396.4$ and $295.3$ arcsec at 5.0 and 6.7 GHz, respectively, with main-beam efficiencies of $56.4$ and $55.6$ per cent. At 5.0 GHz, the circular-polarisation beam squint is $9.96$ arcsec ($2.5$ per cent of the HPBW), whereas no statistically significant squint is detected at 6.7 GHz. Leakage from Stokes $I$ into linear polarisation remains below $0.1$ per cent within the half-power beam but increases substantially towards the sidelobes. IXR reaches approximately $80$ dB on axis and decreases with angular offset. These results establish the intrinsic electromagnetic polarimetric response of the GRAO 32-m telescope and provide a quantitative baseline for direction-dependent calibration and subsequent observational validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对加纳射电天文台（GRAO）32米望远镜，使用GRASP电磁仿真在5.0和6.7 GHz频率下建立了随方向变化的极化波束（polarimetric beam）模型，定量表征了波束形状、波束偏差（beam squint）、斯托克斯泄漏和本征交叉极化比（IXR），为该望远镜的方向相关校准提供了基线。
AI.motivation: 单碟射电偏振测量中，与方向相关的仪器偏振是限制高保真度观测的主要系统性误差来源，但GRAO 32米望远镜尚缺乏对波束泄漏和偏振恢复条件的统一表征。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率GRASP电磁仿真模拟标称望远镜构型，推导完整的复琼斯响应（Jones response）及相应的穆勒矩阵（Mueller matrix），进而评估初级波束内的波束形状、波束偏差、仪器斯托克斯泄漏及本征交叉极化比。
AI.result: 5.0和6.7 GHz下半功率波束宽度分别为396.4和295.3角秒，主波束效率为56.4%和55.6%；5.0 GHz下圆极化波束偏差为9.96角秒（占HPBW的2.5%），而6.7 GHz未检测到显著偏差；斯托克斯I向线偏振的泄漏在半功率波束内低于0.1%，但向旁瓣方向显著增大；IXR在轴向上约达80 dB并随角度偏移而下降。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果确立了GRAO 32米望远镜本征电磁偏振响应，为方向相关校准及后续观测验证提供了定量基线。

title: Enabling new sampling strategies for continuous-wave analyses by integrating Bilby into PyFstat
summary: Continuous-wave searches for rotating neutron stars usually cover wide parameter spaces and produce a large number of candidate signals. Stochastic sampling methods therefore play an important role in candidate follow-up and parameter estimation. We present the integration of the Bayesian inference library BILBY into the open-source continuous-wave analysis package PyFstat, enabling access to the broad range of stochastic samplers available through BILBY while preserving the existing PyFstat analysis infrastructure. The implementation is validated through injection studies in Gaussian noise for two representative single-stage follow-up configurations: candidates from a directed search and candidates from an all-sky search. Using the nested sampler DYNESTY, we obtain detection efficiencies consistent with the theoretical sensitivity predictions. In this setup, DYNESTY performs comparably to the existing PTEMCEE-based implementation of PyFstat for the directed case, and also provides an effective single-stage approach for the all-sky candidate follow-up considered here, where we did not identify a PTEMCEE setup with similar recovery performance. Percentile-percentile tests for DYNESTY further show well-calibrated credible intervals, demonstrating reliable parameter estimation. While a full exploration of DYNESTY settings, multi-stage setups, and other samplers is left for future work, these results demonstrate that this flexible and publicly available framework opens useful new possibilities for Bayesian continuous-wave analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文将贝叶斯推断库BILBY集成到开源连续重力波分析软件包PyFstat中，使后者能够访问BILBY所提供的多种随机采样器。通过在两类代表性单阶段后续跟进配置（定向搜索与全天搜索候选信号）中进行注入研究验证，确认了嵌套采样器DYNESTY的检测效率与理论灵敏度预测一致，并在全天搜索场景中提供了有效的单阶段后续方式。
AI.motivation: 连续波（continuous-wave）搜索通常覆盖巨大的参数空间并产生大量候选信号，随机采样方法在候选后续跟进与参数估计中扮演重要角色，因此有必要扩展现有分析框架PyFstat可用的贝叶斯采样器范围。
AI.method: 将贝叶斯推断库（Bayesian inference library）BILBY集成到开源连续波分析包PyFstat中，保留现有分析基础设施并接入BILBY所支持的多种随机采样器，随后通过在高斯噪声中的注入研究（injection study）对实施进行验证，采用嵌套采样器（nested sampler）DYNESTY测试两类代表性配置。
AI.result: DYNESTY获得的检测效率与理论灵敏度预测一致；在定向搜索案例中其性能与PyFstat现有的PTEMCEE实现相当，在所选全天搜索案例中则提供了有效的单阶段后续方式，而未找到恢复性能相近的PTEMCEE配置。百分位数检验显示DYNESTY的置信区间校准良好，表明其参数估计可靠。
AI.conclusion: 这一灵活且公开可用的框架为贝叶斯连续波分析开辟了新的实用可能性；对DYNESTY设置的全面探索、多阶段后续配置以及其他采样器的评估留待未来工作。

title: Improved mean squared displacement analysis for anomalous single particle trajectories
summary: The mean squared displacement (MSD) is a cornerstone in the analysis of diffusion processes in complex media. When the system is heterogeneous and, in particular, when single-particle trajectories are short, it is essential to extract maximal information from each measured trajectory. This is typically done by time-averaging squared increments and examining the scaling of the time-averaged MSD in log-log space. However, classical regression methods perform poorly in this setting because time-averaging introduces correlations aggravated by those inherent to anomalous diffusion. We tackle these limitations by applying a generalized least squares framework, which substantially reduces variance and bias in diffusion parameter estimates, especially for short (around 100 points) and ultra-short (around 10 points) trajectories. The method is fully automated and requires no supervision. Furthermore, it enables prediction of estimation error probability density, which is asymptotically Gaussian, for both classical and enhanced approaches. Leveraging this prediction, we introduce a specialized deconvolution algorithm that reconstructs the underlying particle ensemble structure from experimental data.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对复杂介质中异质扩散过程的分析问题，提出基于广义最小二乘（generalized least squares）框架的参数估计方法，在短和超短单粒子轨迹条件下显著降低方差与偏差，并进一步引入反卷积算法重建粒子系综结构。
AI.motivation: 当介质异质且单粒子轨迹较短时，传统回归方法在双对数空间中估计时间平均均方位移（time-averaged MSD）的标度关系表现不佳，因为时间平均引入的相关性被反常扩散（anomalous diffusion）固有的相关性进一步加剧。
AI.method: 采用广义最小二乘框架替代经典回归方法，该框架通过考虑时间平均引入的相关性来降低扩散参数估计的方差与偏差。方法完全自动化且无需监督，并能够预测估计误差的概率密度分布。基于该预测，开发了一种专门的反卷积算法，用于从实验数据中重建粒子系综的底层结构。
AI.result: 该方法在短轨迹（约100个数据点）和超短轨迹（约10个数据点）条件下均能显著降低扩散参数估计的方差和偏差。估计误差的概率密度被证明是渐近高斯（asymptotically Gaussian）的，适用于经典与增强两类方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法不仅为短轨迹扩散参数估计提供了更精确且完全自动化的工具，还通过误差密度预测支持了对实验数据中粒子系综结构的反卷积重建，扩展了复杂介质扩散分析的理论与实用性。

title: Dynamical and stationary non-equilibrium fluctuations for a boundary-driven exclusion process with energy
summary: We consider the exclusion process with energy, a model with mass and energy conservation, and we put it in a boundary-driven setting. We are interested in its hydrodynamic and hydrostatic limits, together with the associated dynamical and stationary fluctuations. We provide a new proof for the derivation of dynamical fluctuations that does not require explicit estimates on the two-point correlation functions. While the hydrodynamic limit is given by two uncoupled heat equations, the dynamical fluctuations are described by a system of coupled generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一个同时守恒质量和能量的一维排斥过程（exclusion process with energy），并将其置于边界驱动设定下，考察其流体力学极限（hydrodynamic limit）、流体静力学极限（hydrostatic limit）以及相应的动力学和静态涨落，并提出一种不依赖两点关联函数显式估计的新证明方法。
AI.motivation: 已有研究在推导该模型的动力学涨落时往往需要显式的两点关联函数（two-point correlation function）估计，这一要求在实际求解中可能难以实现，因此作者试图发展一种新的证明途径。
AI.method: 论文对带有边界驱动的排斥过程，在同时守恒质量与能量的系统上建立流体力学极限与流体静力学极限，并给出一种不依赖两点关联函数显式估计的新方法来推导动力学涨落的极限行为。
AI.result: 流体力学极限由两个不耦合的热方程（heat equations）给出；而动力学涨落则由一组耦合的广义奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程（generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes）来描述。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为含有耗散边界条件的多守恒量格气模型提供了新的涨落分析框架，证明了在无需显式两点关联估计的前提下仍可严格推导动力学涨落。

title: A Novel Nb-Based Eutectic Superalloy with Exceptional Ultrahigh-Temperature Mechanical Properties
summary: Refractory alloys operating above 1300 °C, beyond the limit of Ni-based superalloys, must balance high-temperature strength, thermal stability, low density, low cost, and room-temperature tensile ductility, a combination that existing refractory alloys have yet to achieve. Here we report a castable Nb-based eutectic superalloy, Nb-10Mo-9.5C (at. %, NMC-1), comprising a uniform lamellar structure of Nb-Mo solid solution and Nb2C carbide phases. NMC-1 achieves 0.2% yield strengths of ~300 MPa and ~200 MPa at 1300 °C and 1500 °C, respectively, among the highest reported for Nb-based alloys, with pronounced strain hardening, non-zero room-temperature tensile ductility, and no observed microstructural coarsening after 100 h at 1400 °C. Its low density (8.65 g/cc) and cost (~$85/kg) yield a specific-strength-per-cost merit index that far surpasses commercial Nb, Mo, Ta, and W alloys, establishing a new design paradigm for ultrahigh-temperature structural materials.

AI.tldr: 本研究报道了一种可铸造的Nb基共晶超合金Nb-10Mo-9.5C（NMC-1），具有均匀的Nb-Mo固溶体与Nb2C碳化物层状结构。该材料在1300°C和1500°C下分别实现约300 MPa和200 MPa的0.2%屈服强度，同时具备应变硬化、室温拉伸延展性和高温微观结构稳定性，低密度（8.65 g/cc）与低成本（约85美元/kg）使其比强度-成本综合指标远超商业Nb、Mo、Ta和W合金，为超高温结构材料建立了新的设计范式。
AI.motivation: Ni基高温合金的工作温度上限约为1300°C，而在此温度以上服役的难熔合金需要在高温强度、热稳定性、低密度、低成本与室温拉伸延展性之间取得平衡，但现有难熔合金尚未实现这种性能组合。作者旨在开发一种能够在超高温（>1300°C）下综合满足这些苛刻要求的新型合金材料。
AI.method: 设计并合成了一种可铸造的Nb基共晶超合金NMC-1（Nb-10Mo-9.5C，原子百分比），依靠共晶反应形成由Nb-Mo固溶体与Nb2C碳化物组成的均匀层状（lamellar）微观结构。分别进行高温力学性能测试（1300°C和1500°C下的0.2%屈服强度测量）、室温拉伸测试、1400°C长时热处理（100 h）以评估微观结构粗化行为，以及密度和成本的综合评估。
AI.result: NMC-1在1300°C和1500°C下分别达到约300 MPa和约200 MPa的0.2%屈服强度，为Nb基合金中报道的最高水平之一；同时表现出显著的应变硬化（strain hardening）以及非零的室温拉伸延展性；经1400°C高温处理100小时后未观察到微观结构粗化。其密度8.65 g/cc、成本约85美元/kg，所得比强度-成本综合优值指数（specific-strength-per-cost merit index）大幅超越商业Nb、Mo、Ta和W合金。
AI.conclusion: NMC-1成为首个同时满足超高温强度、热稳定性、低密度、低成本与室温延展性组合要求的难熔合金，为超高温结构材料的设计建立了新的范式（design paradigm），有望在Ni基超合金无法胜任的1300°C以上服役场景中发挥作用。

title: Asymptotics of a planar isoperimetric problem with a white-noise volume term
summary: In this work we study the maximal ratio $I$ between the white noise integrated over a set and the perimeter of the set, which can be seen as a random isoperimetric problem, and appears in the random-field Ising model (Ding-Wirth) and min-max optimal matching (Leighton-Shor). In the planar case considered here, such a ratio is scale-invariant and therefore the problem is critical. As such it requires an ultraviolet cutoff, which we impose by restricting to polygonal sets with side-length at least 1 contained in the ball $B_L$. Our main result establishes the leading-order asymptotics $\mathbb{E}I\approx i\ln^{3/4}L$ for some $i\in(0,\infty)$ and superconcentration at scale $O(\ln^{-1/4}L)$. This is done by relating to a simpler $(1+1)$-dimensional action, studied by the last two authors and C. Wagner. Such a connection is found by a classical geometric linearization of the perimeter to the Dirichlet energy, justified by Ried-Wagner large-scale regularity theory, and allows a coarse-graining and scale-by-scale iteration argument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究白噪声积分与集合周长的最大比值$I$（可视为随机等周问题），在平面情形中该比值具有尺度不变性（scale-invariance），因而属于临界问题，需要引入短距截断。作者建立主要结果：$\mathbb{E}I\approx i\ln^{3/4}L$（对某个$i\in(0,\infty)$），并证明在$O(\ln^{-1/4}L)$尺度上存在超集中（superconcentration）现象。
AI.motivation: 该随机等周量出现在随机场伊辛模型（random-field Ising model）和极小极大最优匹配（min-max optimal matching）等经典问题中，理解其增长行为具有广泛的数学物理意义。由于问题处于临界状态，精确刻画其前导渐近行为是一个关键且非平凡的挑战。
AI.method: 作者通过将周长线性化为狄利克雷能量（Dirichlet energy），将原问题与一个更简单的$(1+1)$维作用量建立联系；该线性化由Ried-Wagner大尺度正则性理论（large-scale regularity theory）保证。进一步采用粗粒化（coarse-graining）配合逐尺度迭代论证得出前导阶渐近。
AI.result: 建立了主结果$\mathbb{E}I\approx i\ln^{3/4}L$（$i\in(0,\infty)$为常数），并证明该量在尺度$O(\ln^{-1/4}L)$上呈现超集中现象。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何线性化与迭代粗粒化技术，论文给出了该临界随机等周问题的前导渐近与涨落尺度，揭示了与$(1+1)$维作用量之间的结构联系，为后续深入研究提供了新途径。

title: Small-Scale Clustering of Primordial Black Holes: The Little Red Dot Mass Function and the High-Redshift Galaxy Tension
summary: Supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in "little red dots" (LRDs) discovered the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) may result from runaway mergers of primordial black holes (PBHs) in clusters---through long--short mode coupling on small scales in the early Universe. In this framework, we derive the SMBH mass function, together with the compactness and overmassive features of LRDs. We also estimate that the dense gas residing in PBH clusters is consistent with LRD observations. In addition, SMBHs formed from PBH clusters can help accelerate galaxy formation at high redshifts, thus alleviating tension with $Λ$CDM cosmology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）发现的"小红点"（little red dots, LRDs）中的超大质量黑洞（supermassive black holes, SMBHs）可能源于早期宇宙小尺度上通过长-短模式耦合（long-short mode coupling）形成的原初黑洞（primordial black holes, PBHs）星团中的失控并合（runaway mergers）。在此框架下，作者推导了SMBH质量函数，并解释了LRD的致密性与超大质量特征，同时估计PBH星团中致密气体与LRD观测一致，且有助于加速高红移星系形成，从而缓解与ΛCDM宇宙学的张力。
AI.motivation: JWST发现的LRD中SMBH的存在及其致密、超大质量特征对标准宇宙学模型构成挑战，理解其形成机制具有重要意义。摘要旨在提出一种基于早期宇宙PBH星团失控并合的产生渠道，以解释这些观测特征。
AI.method: 作者构建PBH星团驱动的SMBH形成理论框架，利用早期宇宙小尺度上的长-短模式耦合描述PBH形成与聚类过程，并基于此推导SMBH质量函数、LRD的致密性和超大质量特征，评估星团内致密气体对观测的一致性。
AI.result: 推导出的SMBH质量函数与LRD的致密性和超大质量特征相符合；PBH星团中的致密气体估计与LRD观测一致；由PBH星团形成的SMBH能加速高红移星系形成，有助于缓解与ΛCDM宇宙学的张力。
AI.conclusion: PBH星团中的失控并合可能为JWST观测到的LRD内SMBH提供可行的形成路径，同时该机制对超出标准ΛCDM模型的观测效应具有解释力。

title: Magneto-spin-orbit graphene: Chern topology and photoinduced Hall response
summary: Magneto-spin-orbit graphene can host Chern phases due to proximity interactions, but in realistic heterostructures these depend on substrate chemistry, local stacking registry and may be altered by buried-interface reconstruction. Investigation of these effects requires special efforts to take into account the long-range moire patterns that often arise for these heterostructures. We address this question using first-principles calculations and effective four-band models for four out-of-plane magnetized Gr/(Au, Pt)/(Co, Mn) heterostructures in commensurate (2 x 2) and moire (9 x 9) supercells where the latter include misfit dislocations for the Co-based interfaces. The commensurate cells overestimate charge transfer and exaggerate valley asymmetry, whereas moire averaging strongly reduces both effects while preserving sizable spin splittings. The Pt spacer mediates stronger proximity interactions than Au, while replacing Co by Mn substantially changes the balance of the effective exchange interactions in a spacer-dependent manner. Introduction of misfit dislocations into the Co-based structures is selective and tunes the Dirac gap in Gr/Au/Co or spin splittings in Gr/Pt/Co. Graphene in Gr/Pt/Co exhibits effective ferromagnetic Chern phase with C = 2 in all studied supercells. By contrast, the moire models of the other three compositions are ferrimagnetic and topologically trivial, with C = 0. Nevertheless, they exhibit helicity-dependent photoinduced Hall responses, which are strongly enhanced by misfit-dislocation reconstruction in Gr/Au/Co. This work demonstrates that moire-scale stacking controls the effective Chern phase and Hall conductivity, whereas buried-interface defects tune the photoinduced Hall response without changing the topology.

AI.tldr: 本文利用第一性原理计算和有效四带模型，系统研究了四种Gr/(Au, Pt)/(Co, Mn)异质结构的磁性拓扑性质，揭示moiré尺度堆叠控制有效陈相（Chern phase）和霍尔电导，而埋藏界面位错在不改变拓扑的情况下调控光诱导霍尔响应。
AI.motivation: 磁自旋轨道石墨烯异质结构可因邻近效应（proximity interactions）承载陈相，但在实际异质结构中这些性质依赖衬底化学、局部堆叠配准并可能被埋藏界面的重构所改变。长程moiré超结构的出现使得对上述效应的准确研究需要特殊方法，这正是本工作的研究动机。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）与有效四带模型（effective four-band models），在共格(2×2)和moiré(9×9)超胞中研究四种面外磁化的Gr/(Au, Pt)/(Co, Mn)异质结构，其中Co基界面的moiré超胞包含了失配位错（misfit dislocations）。
AI.result: 共格超胞高估了电荷转移并夸大了谷不对称性；moiré平均显著削弱这两者但保留可观的自旋劈裂。Pt间隔层比Au产生更强邻近相互作用，而Mn替代Co会依赖于间隔层改变有效交换相互作用的平衡。Gr/Pt/Co中石墨烯在所有研究的超胞中均呈现有效铁磁陈相（C=2），其余三种moiré模型为亚铁磁且拓扑平庸（C=0），但仍表现出螺旋性依赖的光诱导霍尔响应，并在Gr/Au/Co中被失配位错重构显著增强。
AI.conclusion: moiré尺度堆叠决定有效陈相和霍尔电导，而埋藏界面缺陷可在不改变拓扑的情况下调控光诱导霍尔响应，为实际石墨烯异质结构的拓扑工程设计提供指导。

title: MIT bag model and infinite mass limit in non-smooth domains
summary: The work is devoted to the study of Dirac operators with MIT bag boundary conditions in Euclidean domains with compact Lipschitz boundaries in arbitrary dimensions. It is shown that such operators are self-adjoint on suitable definition domains and can be recovered as the norm-resolvent limits of Dirac operators in the whole space with a large mass term outside the domain, under the assumption that an associated Robin-Laplacian eigenvalue has a prescribed asymptotic behavior with respect to a parameter in the boundary condition. This assumption is shown to hold for a class of non-smooth domains, which includes convex domains and, more generally, domains that can be "locally convexified" by suitable diffeomorphisms. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first infinite mass interpretation for the MIT bag model in the sense of resolvent convergence for non-smooth domains. Most results are extended to the generalized MIT bag boundary conditions with the help of the recently established congruence transform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了任意维度具有紧致Lipschitz边界的欧几里得域上带MIT袋边界条件的Dirac算子，证明了其在适当定义域上的自伴性，并指出这类算子可被解释为全空间中大质量项（infinite mass）外域Dirac算子的范数-预解极限。该结果在非光滑域类（含凸域及可"局部凸化"的域）中首次为MIT袋模型提供了预解收敛意义下的C∞解释，并借助最近建立的同余变换（congruence transform）推广至广义MIT袋边界条件。
AI.motivation: MIT袋（MIT bag）模型常被理解为通过外部大质量项在物理上实现粒子约束，但此前其无限质量（infinite mass）诠释在预解收敛（resolvent convergence）意义上仅限于光滑域。本文旨在将这一诠释推广至包含Lipschitz边界在内的非光滑域情形，填补该领域的空白。
AI.method: 作者在合适定义域上构造MIT袋边界条件的Dirac算子并证明其自伴性（self-adjointness）。其核心策略是将该算子恢复为全空间带有大质量项（large mass term）Dirac算子的范数-预解极限（norm-resolvent limit），前提是关联的Robin-Laplace特征值关于边界条件中的参数具有预设的渐近行为。这一条件被证明对包括凸域及可通过微分同胚"局部凸化"（locally convexified）的域在内的一类非光滑域成立。此外，借助最近建立的同余变换（congruence transform），将大部分结果推广至广义MIT袋边界条件。
AI.result: 研究表明，在Robin-Laplace特征值满足所要求的渐近行为这一充分条件下，带MIT袋边界条件的Dirac算子是自伴的，并可作为大质量项Dirac算子的范数-预解极限恢复。该条件对凸域和可"局部凸化"等非光滑域成立。据作者所知，这是首次在非光滑域上给出MIT袋模型在预解收敛意义上的无限质量诠释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为MIT袋边界条件Dirac算子在非光滑域（包括Lipschitz域、凸域及其局部凸化推广）上的自伴性与质量近似提供了完整理论框架，并通过同余变换将结论延伸至广义MIT袋边界条件。此结果拓展了MIT袋模型的数学基础，具有潜在的物理与几何分析意义。

title: Hierarchical Inference of the Supermassive Black Hole Binary Merger Rates from Joint Searches using Pulsar Timing Arrays
summary: Gravitational-wave searches do more than identify individual sources - they provide a way to infer the underlying astrophysical populations that produce them. Currently, Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) constrain the supermassive black-hole binary (SMBHB) merger-rate density through both the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) and searches for individual SMBHB signals. The latter implies converting source upper limits into rate upper limits using detection efficiencies estimated empirically. We instead develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework that places the SMBHB merger-rate density model directly inside the PTA likelihood. The unknown catalog of individual SMBHB merger signals is modeled as a Poisson point process on source-parameter space, so that the number of merger signals is inferred from the data rather than imposed by a detection threshold. We describe two computational routes: a catalog-marginal likelihood based on analyses with fixed numbers of candidate sources, and an explicit transdimensional sampling approach that jointly samples population hyperparameters, latent merger signals, and noise. We validate the method with a toy merger-only population model and then apply it to an astrophysical SMBHB merger-rate density model that jointly predicts the SGWB amplitude and the expected merger-catalog size. In simulations, an individual merger signal adds complementary information to the SGWB and can tighten constraints on the merger-rate population.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个层级贝叶斯框架（hierarchical Bayesian framework），将超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）并合率密度模型直接嵌入脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）似然中，通过将未知并合信号目录建模为源参数空间上的泊松点过程（Poisson point process），从数据中推断并合信号数量而非依赖探测阈值。方法在模拟中验证了单个并合信号能对随机引力波背景（SGWB）提供补充信息并改善并合率群体的约束。
AI.motivation: 现有引力波搜索中，从单个源上限推断并合率上限依赖于经验探测效率，未直接将群体模型嵌入似然框架中，且并合信号数量由探测阈值而非数据自动决定。该方法旨在通过与随机引力波背景一致的统计框架中联合推断并合率密度群体参数，提高对SMBHB群体推断的精度。
AI.method: 论文开发了一种将SMBHB并合率密度模型直接放入PTA似然的层级贝叶斯框架。未知的单个SMBHB并合信号目录被建模为源参数空间上的泊松点过程（Poisson point process），使并合信号数量由数据推断而非预设。文中提出两种计算路线：基于固定候选源数量的目录边际似然（catalog-marginal likelihood），以及显式跨维采样（transdimensional sampling）方法，后者联合采样群体超参数、潜在并合信号与噪声。
AI.result: 方法首先通过玩具并合群体模型验证，随后应用于一个同时预测SGWB振幅和预期并合目录大小（catalog size）的天体物理SMBHB并合率密度模型。模拟结果表明，单个并合信号为SGWB提供互补信息，并能收紧对并合率群体的约束。
AI.conclusion: 将目录信息直接纳入群体级似然框架中，可以突破经验探测效率方法的局限，使单个源信号与随机背景数据在统一的统计模型下联合推断SMBHB并合率密度，为未来PTA数据对SMBHB群体的约束提供更精确的途径。

title: On average stress within sub-regions of granular media
summary: The paper concerns computation of average stress within small sub-regions of a larger static granular assembly, where the sub-region's boundary is allowed to pass through the assembly's particles. An exact average is computed for certain stress components and for certain categories of sub-regions. The paper also identifies those choices of sub-regions for which exact stress components may be exactly computed, but when these conditions are not met, provides reasonable bounds on the error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了静态颗粒材料（granular assembly）中任意小子区域内平均应力的计算方法，子区域边界可穿过颗粒体。作者对特定应力分量和特定类别的子区域给出了精确平均值计算，并界定了可精确计算的条件；当条件不满足时，提供误差的合理上界。
AI.motivation: 在大尺度静态颗粒集合体中，对小尺度子区域内的平均应力进行计算具有实际需求，而子区域边界可能穿过颗粒，这使得精确计算面临困难；本文旨在厘清哪些情况下可以实现精确计算，并在无法精确时对误差给出约束。
AI.method: 针对子区域边界穿过颗粒的情形，对特定应力分量（stress components）和特定类别的子区域（categories of sub-regions）进行解析推导，给出精确的平均应力表达式；随后识别满足精确计算条件，并对不满足条件的情况推导误差的合理界限。
AI.result: 文中指出，部分应力分量与部分子区域类别可实现精确的平均应力计算；当精确计算的条件无法满足时，论文提供了误差边界的合理估值。
AI.conclusion: 本文明确划分了可精确求解与仅能近似求解的情形，为颗粒材料局部应力的子区域平均计算提供了理论准则与误差控制手段。

title: Stochastic Processes as Non-Metric Geodesics in Information Geometry
summary: We establish a one-to-one correspondence between geodesics associated with the one-parameter family of $α$-connections on the Gaussian statistical manifold and a class of continuous stochastic processes characterized by a time-independent noise intensity. We demonstrate that geodesics in expectation parameters naturally classify into three distinct geometric categories, among which the Boundary-connecting class allows us to construct an explicit linear stochastic realization with constant diffusion, representing a generalized bridge process. This result demonstrates how continuous stochastic processes within this Gaussian class can be extended along geometric curves. Under appropriate operational limits, this generalized bridge process reduces to fundamental stochastic dynamics, either Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) relaxation or free Brownian diffusion. Crucially, the physical restoring force governing the resulting OU relaxation directly determines the underlying connection parameter $α$, providing a concrete physical observable to constrain the manifold geometry. Depending on the chosen affine connection representation, this restoring force can be attributed either to scalar curvature or purely to non-metricity, establishing a direct conceptual analogy with the Geometrical Trinity of Gravity. Furthermore, applying this framework to driven stochastic thermodynamics, we show that the work-minimizing optimal protocol in the slow-driving limit coincides precisely with an expectation geodesic of the statistical manifold with non-metricity equipped with $(g, {}^{(1/2)}Γ, {}^{(-1/2)}Γ)$, highlighting the active physical role of non-metricity in information geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了高斯统计流形上α-连接族的测地线与非时变噪声强度连续随机过程之间的一一对应关系，并发现期望参数空间中的测地线可分为三类几何类别，其中边界连接类可构造恒定扩散的广义桥过程。在适当极限下该过程还原为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck弛豫或自由布朗扩散，且恢复力直接决定连接参数α，与引力几何三位一体形成直接概念类比。
AI.motivation: 旨在弥合信息几何（information geometry）与随机过程理论之间的鸿沟，探索统计流形上的几何结构如何物理地嵌入并解释连续随机过程的动力学性质。
AI.method: 通过在高斯统计流形上建立α-连接族测地线与时间无关噪声强度连续随机过程之间的一一对应关系，将期望参数空间中的测地线分类为三类几何类别，选取边界连接类构造具有恒定扩散的广义桥过程，并进一步将此框架应用于慢驱动极限下的随机热力学最优协议分析。
AI.result: 表明广义桥过程在适当操作极限下可还原为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck弛豫或自由布朗扩散；控制OU弛豫的物理恢复力直接决定连接参数α，且该恢复力依仿射连接表示的不同可归因于标量曲率或纯非度量性；在慢驱动极限下功最小化最优协议恰好与配备(g, ⁡(1/2)Γ, (-1/2)Γ)的非度量性统计流形的期望测地线精确重合。
AI.conclusion: 非度量性（non-metricity）在信息几何中扮演了积极的物理角色，该框架既提供了约束流形几何的物理可观测量（恢复力），也建立了与引力几何三位一体（Geometrical Trinity of Gravity）之间的概念性类比。

title: Human-agent discovery of reconfigurable in-plane ferroelectric superdomain control
summary: Automated experimentation is most effective when the observables, available actions, and objective are defined before the experiment starts, as is the case for Bayesian optimization. However, in many exploratory experiments, the variables that describe the sample must be extracted from the data, new operations emerge during the experiments, and the instrument budget is too small to learn the problem by trials. Here we introduce the Scanning Probe Agentic Research Cycle (SPARC) framework, in which a coding agent and a human operator share one microscope, one notebook, and two persistent memory files. FINDINGS.md stores graded conclusions about the experiment, whereas PITFALLS.md records learned failure modes of analysis and instrument. We apply SPARC to reconfigure the in-plane superdomain direction of a (111)-oriented PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 film. In an operator-supervised campaign, the agent reanalyzed earlier manual measurements and developed an oriented lattice of stationary bias pulses with alternating polarity to reconfigure the superdomain direction. In a subsequent agent-controlled campaign, PITFALLS.md entries were compiled into checks that validate a design before any write. The experiments showed that spatial polarity alternation, instead of the exact matching between the lattice and lamellar periods, determines directional selection. Combining a raster scan with a masked pulse lattice printed the letters UTK into the superdomain orientation. The campaign also identified practical requirements for agentic experimentation where physical verification of instrument execution, the conditions under which stored findings remain valid, validation of new observables on instrument data, and robust control protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文提出扫描探针智能体研究循环（SPARC）框架，将编码智能体与人类操作员共享显微镜、笔记本及两个持久化记忆文件，应用于(111)取向PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3薄膜面内超畴方向重构实验，验证了空间极性交替（而非晶格与层状周期精确匹配）决定方向选择，并通过掩膜脉冲点阵在超畴取向中打印出UTK字母。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization）等传统自动化实验要求实验前定义好的可观测量、可用操作与目标，但许多探索性实验中变量需从数据中提取、新操作随实验涌现，且仪器预算过小无法通过试错学习问题，亟需适应此类场景的自动化实验框架。
AI.method: 提出SPARC框架，由一个编码智能体（coding agent）与人类操作员共享一台显微镜、一个笔记本和两个持久记忆文件构成：FINDINGS.md存储关于实验的分级结论，PITFALLS.md记录已学到的分析与仪器失败模式。后一个由智能体控制的实验中，PITFALLS.md条目被编译为写入前校验（validation checks）。
AI.result: 在操作员监督实验中，智能体重新分析了早期手动测量，开发了极性交替的静态偏压脉冲定向点阵以重构超畴方向。实验表明空间极性交替而非点阵与层状周期精确匹配决定方向选择；结合光栅扫描（raster scan）与掩膜脉冲点阵（masked pulse lattice）可在超畴取向中打印出UTK字母。
AI.conclusion: 智能体化实验还需满足多项实用要求：对仪器执行进行物理验证、明确存储发现成立的条件、在仪器数据上验证新可观测量，以及建立稳健的控制协议。

title: Spin--orbit-enhanced correlation sensitivity and anomalous magnetic response in non-dimerized $4d^4$ ilmenite CdRuO$_3$
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, accepted in Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter
summary: We report the synthesis and physical properties of CdRuO$_3$, a nominal Ru$^{4+}$ $4d^4$ ilmenite with edge-sharing RuO$_6$ honeycomb layers. Powder X-ray diffraction establishes a crystallographically non-dimerized $R\bar{3}$ structure with equivalent Ru-Ru bonds and a strongly distorted RuO$_6$ environment. The compacted-pellet resistivity is nonmetallic but non-Arrhenius, while the heat capacity contains a finite residual linear term. Matched nonmagnetic calculations show that PBE+$U$ without spin-orbit coupling remains metallic or semimetallic up to $U_{\mathrm{eff}} = 3$ eV, whereas PBE+SOC+$U$ exhibits a strong $U_{\mathrm{eff}}$ dependence and opens a direct gap of approximately 55 meV at $Γ$ for $U_{\mathrm{eff}} = 2.5$ eV. Spin-orbit coupling therefore markedly enhances the correlation sensitivity of the non-cubic Ru $t_{2g}$ manifold. After subtraction of a dilute Curie-Weiss defect contribution, the susceptibility remains weakly nonmonotonic and is inconsistent with both an ordinary Pauli response and independent spin-only $S = 1$ moments. CdRuO$_3$ thus realizes the non-dimerized structural branch predicted for ruthenium ilmenites, but not a simple robust multiorbital metal.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了CdRuO₃（一种名义上为Ru⁴⁺ 4d⁴的钛铁矿结构化合物，具有边共享的RuO₆蜂巢层）的合成与物理性质研究。实验与理论计算共同表明，该材料实现了理论上预测的钌钛铁矿非二聚化结构分支，但并非简单的强健多轨道金属。
AI.motivation: 探索4d电子体系中自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit coupling, SOC）与电子关联效应如何共同影响钛铁矿结构钌氧化物的电子基态，并检验理论预言的非二聚化结构分支是否能在CdRuO₃中得到实验实现。
AI.method: 通过粉末X射线衍射确定晶体结构；采用紧凑颗粒电阻率测量研究输运性质；通过比热测量考察低能激发特征。理论部分采用无SOC的PBE+U计算以及包含SOC的PBE+SOC+U计算，扫描一系列U_eff值以比较二者对电子结构的差异影响；并对磁化率进行缺陷贡献扣除分析。
AI.result: 晶体结构为无二聚化的R-3对称结构，Ru-Ru键等价但RuO₆八面体强畸变；电阻率为非金属且非Arrhenius行为，比热存在有限的残余线性项。理论计算显示：无SOC的PBE+U在U_eff高达3 eV时仍保持金属或半金属，而加入SOC后出现强U_eff依赖，在U_eff=2.5 eV时于Γ点打开约55 meV的直接带隙。扣除稀薄居里-外斯缺陷贡献后，磁化率呈弱非单调行为，与普通泡利响应及独立自旋S=1磁矩均不相符。
AI.conclusion: 自旋轨道耦合显著增强了非立方Ru t₂g流形中电子关联的敏感性。CdRuO₃实现了理论预言的钌钛铁矿非二聚化结构分支，但其电子基态既不是简单的强健多轨道金属，也不符合常规的金属或局域磁矩图像，暗示该体系中关联与SOC竞争导致的复杂电子行为。

title: Phase transition for strongly correlated percolation models on supercritical Bernoulli clusters
summary: We consider the level sets of the Gaussian free field and the vacant set of random interlacements, both defined on a typical realization of the infinite cluster of supercritical Bernoulli bond percolation on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, $d \geq 3$. We prove that in the entire supercritical regime of Bernoulli bond percolation, both the level sets of the Gaussian free field and the vacant set of random interlacements undergo non-trivial percolation phase transitions at deterministic critical levels. A key aspect of the proof is the development of certain quenched controls over tree embeddings, permitting the application of a static renormalization scheme in the presence of spatial irregularities, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了定义在超临界伯努利键渗流（supercritical Bernoulli bond percolation）无限簇典型实现上的高斯自由场水平集与随机交错（random interlacements）空置集，证明了在 $\mathbb{Z}^d$（$d \geq 3$）的整个超临界区域中，两者均在确定性临界水平处经历非平凡的渗流相变。
AI.motivation: 将渗流相变研究从均匀空间推广到具有空间不规则性的随机环境（渗流簇），探索高斯自由场水平集和随机交错空置集在无序背景下是否仍保持相变行为。
AI.method: 核心方法是在树嵌入（tree embeddings）上发展淬火控制（quenched controls），从而可在存在空间不规则性时应用静态重整化方案（static renormalization scheme）；该控制方法可能具有独立的研究价值。
AI.result: 在超临界伯努利键渗流的整个参数区域内，高斯自由场水平集与随机交错空置集均在确定性临界水平处发生非平凡的渗流相变。
AI.conclusion: 即使在渗流簇形成的空间不规则背景下，高斯自由场水平集与随机交错空置集的关键相变性质仍得以保持，为无序环境中临界行为的研究提供了新工具。

title: Scalable machine learning framework for multiphase identification from powder X-ray diffraction
summary: X-ray diffraction (XRD) is the primary tool for identifying crystalline phases following synthesis, but automated phase identification remains challenging, particularly for multiphase samples with overlapping peaks and experimental artifacts. While deep-learning methods have been proposed to improve upon classical search-match algorithms, most formulate phase identification as a single closed-set classification problem, requiring one shared model to discriminate among all candidate phases. Here we introduce GALAXI, which instead decouples the identification task into independent one-versus-all binary classifiers that each specialize in recognizing a single phase. These pre-trained classifiers first narrow the search space to a small set of plausible phases, which are then evaluated through Rietveld refinement to identify the combination of phases that best explains the full diffraction pattern. On a curated set of experimental patterns, GALAXI identifies the correct phases with a micro-F1 score of 0.935, outperforming classical search-match and prior deep-learning models. The method remains robust to common experimental artifacts, including low impurity phase fractions, small crystallite size, peak shifts, sample displacement, and texture, and performs well when applied to time-resolved in-situ XRD data from solid-state reactions. Moreover, because the phase-specific models are independent, GALAXI can expand to large reference libraries without retraining existing models. This modular architecture enables us to train classifiers for 64,594 structures from the Crystallography Open Database and deploy them through a public web interface at https://galaxi-xrd.com.

AI.tldr: GALAXI是一种用于X射线衍射（XRD）自动物相鉴定的模块化深度学习方法，将鉴定任务分解为独立的"一对多"（one-versus-all）二分类器，每个分类器专门识别单一物相，随后通过Rietveld精修筛选最优物相组合，在实验图谱上达到0.935的micro-F1分数，并可在无需重新训练的情况下扩展至大规模参考文库（64,594种结构）。
AI.motivation: XRD是合成后鉴定晶相的的主要工具，但自动化物相鉴定仍具挑战性，尤其是面对重叠峰和实验伪影的多相样品。现有深度学习方法大多将物相鉴定构建为单一闭集（closed-set）分类问题，需用一个共享模型区分所有候选物相，难以应对开放物相空间和实验复杂性。
AI.method: GALAXI将物相鉴定解耦为多个独立的"一对多"二分类器，每个分类器专门识别一种物相。预训练分类器先将搜索空间缩小至少量可能的物相，再通过Rietveld精修评估候选组合，以确定最能解释完整衍射图谱的物相集合。
AI.result: 在精选的实验图谱集合上，GALAXI以0.935的micro-F1分数正确识别物相，优于经典搜索匹配（search-match）方法和先前的深度学习模型。该方法对低杂质相分数、小晶粒尺寸、峰位偏移、样品位移和织构等常见实验伪影保持鲁棒，并在固态反应的时间分辨原位XRD数据上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 由于物相专属模型相互独立，GALAXI可以在不重新训练既有模型的情况下扩展至大型参考文库。其模块化架构使研究者能够为Crystallography Open Database中的64,594种结构训练分类器，并通过公开网页界面提供部署。

title: The Ding-Song-Sun inequality for a class of even ferromagnets
summary: Ding-Song-Sun proved the remarkable correlation inequality that the truncated two-point correlation function of ferromagnetic Ising models with arbitrary mixed-sign external field is largest when the field vanishes. This inequality has various important consequences such as log-Sobolev inequalities for Ising and $\varphi^4$ models up to and at the critical point. We extend the DSS inequality to the class of single spin measures satisfying the GHS condition. This is an important ingredient in our proof of the log-Sobolev inequality for the massless sinh-Gordon model on $\mathbb{R}^2$ in a forthcoming article.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Ding-Song-Sun（DSS）不等式从铁磁伊辛模型推广到满足 GHS 条件的单自旋测度类，证明截断两点关联函数在零外场时最大。该推广是后续证明二维无质量 sinh-Gordon 模型对数 Sobolev 不等式（log-Sobolev inequality）的关键工具。
AI.motivation: Ding-Song-Sun 证明了铁磁伊辛模型中截断两点关联函数的不等式，该不等式在临界点及以下区域的对数 Sobolev 不等式证明中具有重要应用。作者希望将该不等式推广到更广泛的满足 GHS 条件的单自旋测度类，以服务后续对 sinh-Gordon 模型的分析。
AI.method: 本文采用分析证明方法，将 DSS 不等式从带任意混合符号外场的铁磁伊辛模型推广至满足 GHS 条件（Griffiths-Hurst-Sherman condition）的单自旋测度类，即证明截断两点关联函数在零外场时达到最大值。
AI.result: 成功建立了满足 GHS 条件下单自旋测度版本的 DSS 不等式推广。该结果作为关键要素，支撑了作者在另一篇文章中对 R² 上无质量 sinh-Gordon 模型对数 Sobolev 不等式的证明。
AI.conclusion: DSS 不等式的适用范围得到拓展，不再局限于伊辛模型，而是覆盖更一般的满足 GHS 条件的自旋系统。这一推广为非线性场论模型（如 sinh-Gordon）的临界区计算提供了新的分析工具。

title: Restoring the Surface Magnetic Gap in MnBi$_2$Te$_4$
summary: A widespread experimental realization of quantized anomalous transport in the intrinsic magnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ is hindered by its elusive surface magnetic gap. Uncovering the origin of the gapless states is essential for accessing its topological properties. Here we show that surface defects lower the electrostatic potential, drive topological surface states into subsurface layers, suppress exchange interactions, thereby closing the gap. Tuning the surface electrostatic potential via external electric fields or interfacial fields in van der Waals heterostructures restores the expected gap and enables control of its topology. This is confirmed by model calculations and validated in defective MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ films interfaced with polar insulators, explaining the enhanced quantum anomalous Hall effect under AlO$_x$ capping observed in recent experiments. Our theory identifies electrostatically driven surface-state delocalization as a competitive origin of gap suppression and proposes displacement-field engineering for robust quantized transport.

AI.tldr: 本论文揭示了本征磁性拓扑绝缘体（magnetic topological insulator）MnBi₂Te₄中表面无间隙态（gapless states）的起源：表面缺陷降低静电势，迫使拓扑表面态（topological surface states）向亚表面层迁移、抑制交换相互作用（exchange interactions），从而关闭表面磁能隙；通过外电场或范德华异质结构中的界面场调控表面静电势可恢复能隙并控制拓扑性质，研究还解释了AlOₓ封盖增强量子反常霍尔效应（quantum anomalous Hall effect）的实验观察。
AI.motivation: 本征磁性拓扑绝缘体MnBi₂Te₄中量子化反常输运（quantized anomalous transport）的实验实现受阻于其难以捉摸的表面磁能隙（surface magnetic gap），因此揭示无间隙态的起源是获取其拓扑性质的关键前提。
AI.method: 通过理论分析与模型计算相结合的方法，研究表面缺陷如何改变表面静电势并影响拓扑表面态的空间分布与交换相互作用；同时通过与极性绝缘体（polar insulators）界面构筑的缺陷型MnBi₂Te₄薄膜实验对理论预测进行验证。
AI.result: 研究确认表面缺陷会降低静电势、推动表面态向亚表面层去局域化（delocalization）并抑制交换作用，从而关闭能隙；利用外部电场或范德华异质结构的界面场可以恢复预期的能隙并调控拓扑性，该机制解释了AlOₓ封盖下量子反常霍尔效应增强的实验现象。
AI.conclusion: 理论将静电驱动表面态去局域化识别为能隙抑制的一个竞争性起源，并提出位移场工程（displacement-field engineering）作为实现稳健量子化输运的策略。

title: Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory with Coulomb Interactions
summary: We provide the first fully rigorous justification of time-dependent density functional theory in the continuum: Given a time-dependent density, we prove that there exists an external potential, unique up to a time-dependent constant, such that the corresponding Schrödinger equation reproduces the given density. This potential can be obtained with an iteration scheme. Our argument covers Coulomb interactions and does not need any Taylor expansion in time. It instead requires analyticity in space for the density and potential, which is compatible with extended nuclei.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在连续介质中提供了含时密度泛函理论（time-dependent density functional theory）的完整严格证明：给定一个含时密度，证明存在一个外部势（external potential），在含时常数意义下唯一，使得对应的薛定谔方程（Schrödinger equation）能够复现该密度，且该势可通过迭代方案获得。
AI.motivation: 含时密度泛函理论在物理化学等领域被广泛使用，但其在连续介质中的严格数学基础此前一直缺失。
AI.method: 证明不依赖时间方向的泰勒展开（Taylor expansion），而是要求密度和势在空间上具有解析性（analyticity），该方法能够涵盖库仑相互作用（Coulomb interactions），并与扩展原子核（extended nuclei）情形兼容。
AI.result: 证明了给定含时密度时外部势的存在性与唯一性（唯一至含时常数），并提供了一种迭代方案来构造该势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为连续介质中含时密度泛函理论提供了第一个完全严格的数学基础，扩展了其适用范围到包含库仑相互作用的一般场景。

title: Self-Trapping Enabled Highly Bright Momentum-Indirect Interlayer Excitons
summary: Interlayer excitons in two dimensional material heterostructures exhibit large exciton binding energies and long lifetimes, making them ideal platforms for studying excitonic devices and many body quantum phenomena. However, the spatially separated electron and hole nature of IXs reduces their oscillator strength by two orders of magnitude compared to intralayer excitons. Achieving high efficiency IX emission remains challenging and requires optimal material selection with appropriate momentum matching and meticulous device fabrication. Here we demonstrate a highly bright momentum indirect IX emission within heterostructures formed between 2D perovskites and monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. The quantum yield of IX emission reaches 35.2% on average, over 50 times higher than that of the corresponding constituent TMD monolayer, with the highest value exceeding 60%. Notably, the radiative recombination efficiency of this momentum indirect IX exceeds that of momentum direct IXs in monolayer TMD-based heterostructures by two orders of magnitude. We suggest that the remarkably bright IX emission in our heterostructure originates from IX self trapping, induced by strong exciton phonon coupling arising from the soft lattice nature of the 2D perovskite. Our findings provide new insights into achieving high IX emission efficiency and open new avenues for exploring long lifetime excitonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本研究展示了二维钙钛矿与单层过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）构成的异质结构中，具有高亮度的动量间接层间激子（interlayer exciton, IX）发射。平均量子产率达到35.2%，最高超过60%，比单个TMD单层高出50倍以上，且其辐射复合效率较动量直接IX高二个数量级，亮度源于强激子-声子耦合导致的激子自俘获（self trapping）效应。
AI.motivation: 二维材料异质结构中的层间激子（IX）具有大激子结合能和长寿命，是研究激子器件和多体量子现象的理想平台。但是，电子和空穴空间分离使得IX的振荡强度比层内激子低约两个数量级，实现高效率IX发射仍具挑战，因此需要合适的动量匹配材料选择和精细器件制备。
AI.method: 将软晶格的二维钙钛矿（2D perovskite）与单层过渡金属二硫族化物（transition metal dichalcogenide, TMD）构筑范德华异质结构，通过动量间接（momentum indirect）的激子复合路径实现层间激子发射，并测量其量子产率和辐射复合效率。
AI.result: 该体系中IX发射的平均量子产率达35.2%，是相应TMD单层本身的50倍以上，最高值超过60%。动量间接IX的辐射复合效率比单层TMD基异质结构中的动量直接IX高出两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 极亮的IX发射归因于二维钙钛矿软晶格性质所诱导的强激子-声子耦合引起的激子自俘获效应。该工作为实现高IX发射效率提供了新认识，为探索长寿命激子器件开辟了新途径。

title: No information transmission through quantum channels above capacity
summary: We show that the capacity of a quantum channel demarcates a phase transition: while reliable transmission below capacity is always possible, any attempt to transmit information above it fails catastrophically. Specifically, we prove exponential strong converse theorems for unassisted quantum and classical communication over arbitrary finite-dimensional memoryless quantum channels. At rates beyond the respective capacity, the entanglement-generation fidelity and the success probability for classical communication decay exponentially with the number of channel uses. This rules out transmission above capacity even when one tolerates arbitrarily large errors. Our proof follows the classical Arimoto strategy, augmented by a crucial new ingredient: integral representations of Rényi information measures that lead to asymptotic continuity bounds for Rényi capacities.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了量子信道容量界定了相变行为：信道容量以下的可靠传输总是可行的，而超出容量（capacity）的任何传输尝试都会灾难性失败。作者针对任意有限维无记忆量子信道，证明了无辅助量子通信和经典通信的指数强逆定理（exponential strong converse theorem）。
AI.motivation: 经典的强逆定理保证了信道容量作为可靠通信的精确准则，但已有的证明可能不适用于一般的量子信道场景，或缺乏指数衰减的严格界定。作者希望填补这一空白，为无辅助量子通信和经典通信建立完备的强逆结果。
AI.method: 证明遵循经典的Arimoto策略（Arimoto strategy），并引入一个关键的新要素：Rényi信息度量（Rényi information measures）的积分表示，该表示可导出Rényi容量的渐近连续性界（asymptotic continuity bounds）。
AI.result: 在超过相应容量的传输速率下，纠缠生成保真度（entanglement-generation fidelity）和经典通信的成功概率均随信道使用次数呈现指数衰减。这意味着即使容忍任意大的误差，超出容量的传输也不可能实现。
AI.conclusion: 量子信道容量界定了通信可靠性的严格相变点，位于容量之下的可靠传输总是可能的，而容量之上则由指数强逆定理保证必然失效。该结果适用于任意有限维无记忆量子信道的无辅助量子通信和经典通信。

title: Metastable polar order and phase competition in Carpy-Galy LaTaO4
summary: Carpy-Galy LaTaO4 undergoes a structural sequence linking the antipolar monoclinic P21/c ground state and the polar orthorhombic Cmc21 phase through an incommensurately modulated regime. First-principles calculations identify a metastable polar monoclinic P21 phase as a commensurate intermediate in the phase-transition landscape. As a common subgroup of P21/c and Cmc21, P21 provides a symmetry-connected route between the established polymorphs. Mode-resolved energy surfaces for these symmetry-breaking pathways show that coupling between the respective primary order parameters and an isosymmetric Gamma_1+ relaxation stabilizes the P21 minimum along both pathways. Consequently, the P21/c -> P21 transformation has a finite energy barrier, while a restricted soft-mode model retains competing P21 and Cmc21 basins over an illustrative range of harmonic stiffness. Lattice-metric and neutron-diffraction comparisons indicate a shared S_2+-dominated displacement character between the calculated commensurate state and the experimental IC-o modulation, supporting the use of P21 as a commensurate structural reference for IC-o. Finally, composition-dependent energetics suggest chemical routes for tuning polar-antipolar competition.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，确定了LaTaO4在反极性单斜P21/c基态与极性正交Cmc21相之间相变路径中存在一个亚稳的极性单斜P21相作为共度中间态，为理解体系中非共度调制相（IC-o）提供了共度结构参照，并提出通过化学掺杂调控极性-反极性竞争的可行途径。
AI.motivation: Carpy-Galy LaTaO4存在从反极性单斜P21/c基态到极性正交Cmc21相的复杂结构相变序列，其中涉及非共度调制区间，需要阐明该相变路径的结构演化机制及中间态的对称性关系。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理（first-principles）计算，结合对称性分析（对称子群关系识别）、模式分辨能量面计算（mode-resolved energy surfaces）以及晶格度量和中子衍射数据对比，检验P21相作为共度中间态的稳定性与合理性。
AI.result: P21相是P21/c和Cmc21的共同子群，提供了一条对称性连接两条已有多形体间的通路；主序参量与同对称性Gamma_1+弛豫模式的耦合稳定了P21能量极小值。P21/c→P21转变具有有限能垒，受限软模模型保留了P21与Cmc21的竞争性盆地。晶格度量与中子衍射对比表明计算得到的共度态与实验IC-o调制共享S_2+主导的位移特征，支持P21作为IC-o的共度结构参照。
AI.conclusion: 极性单斜P21相可作为LaTaO4非共度调制相IC-o的共度结构参照；组分化学计量能学的分析进一步表明，可通过化学掺杂调控极性-反极性竞争，为材料设计提供思路。

title: Reduction Based Dynamical Systems Analysis of Nonlinear Wave Equations: A Review
summary: Nonlinear wave equations exhibit rich interplay among dispersion, nonlinearity, coupling, dissipation, and external forcing, producing diverse coherent and complex wave structures. Although exact travelling-wave solutions provide analytical benchmarks, their construction alone does not reveal underlying phase-space, bifurcations, stability, or responses to perturbations. This review presents a reduction-based methodological framework connecting nonlinear partial differential equations(PDEs) to reduced dynamical systems, invariant phase-space structures, exact waveform reconstruction, stability analysis, and verification in PDEs. Its applicability and limitations are examined across Schr{ö}dinger-type, coupled, nonparaxial, dissipative, magnetic, shallow-water, and fractional wave equations. Particular emphasis is placed on correspondence between analytical waveforms and invariant orbits. Equilibria, periodic trajectories, homoclinic orbits, and heteroclinic connections geometrically represent constant, periodic, localized, and front-like structures, respectively. This review distinguishes existence and stability of invariant structures from onset of chaos, emphasizing complementary diagnostics rather than reliance on phase-portraits or finite-time indicators alone. Major methodological gaps include incomplete parameter-space characterization, weak correspondence between reduced models and full-PDE dynamics, ambiguities in generalized and fractional formulations, limited robustness analysis, inadequate numerical reproducibility, and insufficient links to experimental observables. The framework prioritizes physical admissibility, stability, robustness, and predictive relevance over generation of additional formal solutions. It supports reliable nonlinear wave prediction, stability assessment, control, and system design in fluid, optical, plasma, and other nonlinear physical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于约化的方法论框架，将非线性偏微分方程（PDE）连接到约化动力系统、不变相空间结构、精确波形重构及稳定性分析，并在薛定谔型、耦合、非近轴、耗散、磁学、浅水和分数阶波动方程中检验其适用性与局限。
AI.motivation: 非线性波动方程中色散、非线性、耦合、耗散与外强迫之间存在丰富相互作用，产生多样的相干及复杂波结构。虽然精确行波解提供了解析基准，但仅构造这些解并不能揭示背后的相空间结构、分岔、稳定性或对扰动的响应，因此需要一种系统性框架来弥补这一分析缺口。
AI.method: 提出一种基于约化（reduction）的方法论框架，将非线性PDE约化为低维动力系统，并通过不变相空间结构（平衡点、周期轨道、同宿轨道与异宿连接）几何地对应常定、周期、局域化及前沿类波形；同时结合稳定性分析与PDE验证，强调对解析波形与不变轨道之间对应关系的关注。
AI.result: 该框架在多种波动方程类型中展示了适用性，并将不变结构的存在性与稳定性同混沌 onset 显著区分，强调采用互补诊断手段而非仅依赖相图或有限时间指标。同时识别出若干方法缺口，包括参数空间表征不完整、约化模型与全PDE动力学对应薄弱、广义与分数阶公式歧义、鲁棒性分析有限、数值可复现性不足以及缺乏与实验可观测量之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架优先考虑物理可允性、稳定性、鲁棒性与预测相关性，而非生成更多形式解，旨在为流体、光学、等离子体及其他非线性物理系统中的可靠波动预测、稳定性评估、控制与系统设计提供支持。

title: Quantum hot carrier spectra in plasmonic catalysis
summary: Vibrational activation of admolecules on metal nanoparticles is an elementary step in plasmonic catalysis, yet the underlying dynamics driven by hot carriers is not fully understood in the quantum regime. Using an atomistic description of plasmonic hot carrier generation, we investigate vibrational excitation and dissociation of oxygen on silver nanoparticles as a function of diameter D. As D reduces from the classical to quantum-sized regime, quantized distribution of hot carriers emerges with increasing population in the high-energy regions. These highly energetic hot carriers deliver more efficient vibrational coupling and dissociation. The rate of vibrational excitation shows a linear 1/D scaling, which results from Landau damping. It turns nonlinear at elevated light intensities due to vibrational heating generated by multiple electron scattering. The finding of quantized distribution of hot carrier in plasmonic catalysis opens new avenues for selective control and nonthermal energy conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对等离激元（plasmonic）热载流子（hot carrier）生成的原子级描述，研究了银纳米颗粒上氧分子的振动激发与解离随颗粒直径的变化行为，发现当颗粒从经典尺寸缩小到量子尺寸区间时，热载流子的分布出现量子化特征，高能区域载流子数增多，从而更高效地促进振动耦合与解离，并揭示了振动激发速率随粒径呈1/D线性缩放的规律及其在强光下的非线性行为。
AI.motivation: 金属纳米颗粒上吸附分子（admolecule）的振动激活是等离激元催化（plasmonic catalysis）的基本步骤，但由热载流子驱动的微观动力学在量子区间内尚未被充分理解，因此亟需在原子尺度上阐明其机制。
AI.method: 采用等离激元热载流子生成的原子级（atomistic）描述方法，系统研究银纳米颗粒上氧气分子的振动激发与解离过程，并考察颗粒直径从经典尺寸进入量子尺寸（quantum-sized regime）区间时各关键物理量的变化规律。
AI.result: 研究发现，当直径缩小时，热载流子分布呈现量子化特征且高能区载流子占比增加，这些高能热载流子能更有效地驱动振动耦合与解离；振动激发速率随粒径呈线性1/D标度关系，源于朗道阻尼（Landau damping）；在增强光强条件下该速率因多电子散射导致的振动加热（vibrational heating）而转变为非线性行为。
AI.conclusion: 等离激元催化中热载流子的量子化分布为选择性调控（selective control）与非热能量转换（nonthermal energy conversion）开辟了新途径。

title: Renormalization of One-Dimensional Semirelativistic Bosons with Contact Interactions
summary: We study one-dimensional spinless bosons with semirelativistic spinless-Salpeter dispersion and attractive pairwise contact interactions. Because the dispersion becomes linear at large momentum, the contact interaction is marginal by power counting and produces a logarithmic ultraviolet divergence. We construct the renormalized many-body theory using an enlarged Fock space and a Schur-complement representation of the resolvent, eliminating the bare coupling in favor of the physical zero-total-momentum two-body bound-state energy. The resulting cutoff-independent resolvent defines a self-adjoint Hamiltonian in each fixed particle-number sector. We treat the two-body problem explicitly and show, in the norm-resolvent sense, that the nonrelativistic limit reproduces the attractive Lieb--Liniger Hamiltonian. We also formulate a mean-field approximation directly within the renormalized theory. In the massless and deeply bound large-particle-number regimes, it predicts an exponentially increasing binding scale whose exponent is determined by a one-dimensional variational problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有半相对论自旋无力—萨尔彼得色散关系（semirelativistic spinless-Salpeter dispersion）和吸引接触相互作用的一维无自旋玻色子，通过扩大福克空间和Schur补表示的预解式方法构建重整化的多体理论，并以物理的两体束缚态能消除裸耦合常数，进而分析两体问题和平均场近似下的大束缚标度行为。
AI.motivation: 在色散关系于大动量下呈线性的系统中，接触相互作用在幂次计数（power counting）意义下是边缘性的，会产生对数型紫外发散（ultraviolet divergence），因此需要发展一个重整化的多体理论框架来正确处理这一问题。
AI.method: 作者采用扩大福克空间（enlarged Fock space）以及预解式（resolvent）的Schur补（Schur complement）表示来构建重整化理论，通过物理的总动量零两体束缚态能量（zero-total-momentum two-body bound-state energy）替代裸耦合常数，从而得到与截断无关的预解式，并在每个固定粒子数扇区内定义自伴哈密顿量。此外，还直接在重整化理论内构建了平均场近似。
AI.result: 两体问题被显式处理，并在范数—预解式（norm-resolvent）意义上证明了非相对论极限能够复现吸引的李—林尼格尔哈密顿量（Lieb-Liniger Hamiltonian）。在无质量和大束缚的大粒子数区域，平均场近似预言束缚标度（binding scale）呈指数增长，其指数由一维变分问题决定。
AI.conclusion: 该重整化框架提供了截断无关且自伴的多体描述，既能在非相对论极限下与已知的李—林尼格尔模型无缝衔接，又能在相对论性的深束缚区域给出新的指数型束缚标度行为。

title: Relaxation of Sliding Friction from a Statistical Model of Aging Contacts
summary: Frictional relaxation after a sudden velocity change underlies the phenomenological laws that describe the stability of steady sliding and of seismic faults. To connect this relaxation with measurable statistics of microscopic contacts, we introduce a minimal model incorporating logarithmic aging of contact forces and a power-law contact-size distribution reflecting fractal interface roughness, and derive the relaxation function analytically. Depending on the power-law exponent $α$, the intermediate-time response exhibits a plateau, logarithmic decay, or power-law decay, in contrast to the exponential decay assumed in the phenomenological laws. The theory provides experimentally testable links between microscopic contact statistics and macroscopic frictional relaxation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个最小模型，将接触力的对数老化（logarithmic aging）与反映分形界面粗糙度的幂律接触尺寸分布相结合，解析推导出速度突变后摩擦松弛（frictional relaxation）函数，发现中间时间响应依赖幂律指数表现为平台、对数衰减或幂律衰减，而非现象学定律假设的指数衰减。
AI.motivation: 稳态滑动与地震断层的稳定性由现象学定律描述，而这些定律基于速度突变后的摩擦松弛行为；但该松弛行为与微观接触可测统计量之间的联系尚不清楚，亟需建立微观到宏观的桥梁。
AI.method: 引入一个最小模型，将接触力的对数老化与表征分形界面粗糙度的幂律接触尺寸分布相结合，并解析推导出松弛函数的表达式。
AI.result: 依据幂律指数α的不同取值，中间时间尺度下的响应分别呈现平台、对数衰减或幂律衰减，与现象学定律中所假设的指数衰减形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 该理论提供了连接微观接触统计与宏观摩擦松弛的可实验检验关系，为理解稳态滑动与地震不稳定性提供了新的微观基础。

title: Quasi-algebraic quantization for the B-twist Langlands TQFT
summary: This is the first part of a program to construct hyperholomorphic families of boundary conditions for the Kapustin--Witten B-twist of the Langlands QFT, otherwise known as \textit{(BBB)-branes}. We define the category of quasi-algebraic sheaves over the Deligne moduli stack, which serves as an analog of the twistor space of Hitchin's moduli stack. This allow us to construct a representation of a simplified version of the Moore--Tachikawa category which is motivated by the relative Langlands program in the sense of Ben-Zvi--Sakellaridis--Venkatesh.

AI.tldr: 本文是一个研究计划的第一部分，旨在为Kapustin–Witten B-扭曲的Langlands量子场论构建超全纯边界条件族（即(BBB)-branes）。作者在Deligne模叠上定义了拟代数层范畴，作为Hitchin模叠的扭量空间类比物，并据此构造了Moore–Tachikawa范畴简化版本的一个表示。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机来源于相对Langlands纲领（relative Langlands program），具体是在Ben-Zvi–Sakellaridis–Venkatesh意义下，希望为Kapustin–Witten B-扭曲构建超全纯（hyperholomorphic）边界条件族，即(BBB)-branes。这类构造有助于深化对Langlands量子场论（Langlands QFT）的数学理解。
AI.method: 方法上，作者首先在Deligne模叠（Deligne moduli stack）上定义拟代数层（quasi-algebraic sheaves）范畴，将其视为Hitchin模叠（Hitchin's moduli stack）的扭量空间（twistor space）的类比物。随后利用该范畴构造Moore–Tachikawa范畴简化版本的一个表示。
AI.result: 论文成功给出了拟代数层范畴的定义，并基于此建立了对简化版Moore–Tachikawa范畴（Moore–Tachikawa category）的表示，这一表示的结构与相对Langlands纲领的框架相契合。
AI.conclusion: 本文是该系列研究计划的第一部分，搭建了构建(BBB)-branes超全纯边界条件族所需的范畴论基础框架，为后续在该纲领下进一步展开完整构造提供了出发点。

title: Irreversibility of many-body harmonic oscillators characterized by generalized Husimi's adiabaticity parameter
summary: In a classical paper [K. Husimi, Prog. Theor. Phys. 9, 381 (1953)], Husimi showed that, for a single harmonic oscillator with a time-dependent angular frequency and initial conditions sampled from an equilibrium distribution, the averaged energy cannot decrease after a cyclic operation. This irreversibility is quantified by Husimi's adiabaticity parameter constituted with adiabatic invariants. In this work, we generalize Husimi's framework to a many-body system of one-dimensional harmonic oscillators coupled on an arbitrary connected network, with all spring constants sharing a common time dependence. For a system attached to a fixed wall, the dynamics can be decomposed into independent normal modes by transforming to mass-weighted coordinates and diagonalizing the resulting positive definite matrix, with each mode characterized by its own Husimi's adiabaticity parameter. By defining the generalized Husimi's adiabaticity parameter as their arithmetic mean, we derive the exact time evolution of the averaged energy and establish its non-decrease under cyclic operations. Numerical simulations confirm these results for both a uniform nearest-neighbor chain and a heterogeneous network.

AI.tldr: 本文（paper）将Husimi关于单谐振子循环操作下平均能量不可减少的经典框架推广到任意连通网络上耦合的多个一维谐振子系统，其中所有弹簧常数共享共同的时间依赖性。通过定义广义Husimi绝热参数（adiabaticity parameter）为其算术平均，导出平均能量的精确时间演化，并证明其在循环操作下不减少，数值模拟验证了均匀链和异构网络两种情形。
AI.motivation: Husimi在1953年的经典工作中证明，对于具有时间依赖角频率且初始条件采自平衡分布的单谐振子，循环操作（cyclic operation）后平均能量不可减少。作者希望将该不可逆性结果推广到多体系统，即耦合在任意连通网络上的多个一维谐振子，以探索更一般的多体场景中的能量演化规律。
AI.method: 通过质量加权坐标变换（mass-weighted coordinates）并对角化所得正定矩阵，将附着于固定壁上系统的动力学分解为独立的简正模式（normal modes），每个模式具有各自的Husimi绝热参数。将广义Husimi绝热参数定义为其算术平均（arithmetic mean），从而推导平均能量的精确时间演化。
AI.result: 导出了平均能量的精确时间演化公式，并建立了循环操作下该能量不减少的性质。数值模拟确认了这一结果，适用于均匀最近邻链和异质网络两类拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功将Husimi框架从单谐振子推广到任意连通网络上的耦合多谐振子系统，表明在这种多体系统中循环操作下的能量不可减少性依然成立，为理解多体动力学的不可逆性提供了新的理论工具。

title: Theory of staggered damping-like spin-orbit torque on synthetic antiferromagnetic domain walls
summary: The Néel, or staggered, spin-orbit torque (SOT) enables an efficient electrical manipulation of antiferromagnetic order. However, it has been tied to special crystal structures, and only its field-like component is established. We develop a theory of staggered damping-like SOT, which arises generically in synthetic antiferromagnets sandwiched by the same heavy metal on both sides. Deriving a Néel-vector Lagrangian, we obtain the domain-wall (DW) velocity in closed form: bilinear in current and in-plane field, opposite in sign for Néel and Bloch walls, and tunable through the interlayer exchange coupling. DW structure thus becomes a control knob for DW motion, while the DW motion, in turn, offers an electrical readout of its structure. Micromagnetic simulations confirm the theory. The predicted sign reversals and scaling laws of the DW velocity, together with the thresholds for the Néel-Bloch transition, give immediate experimental targets.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一类奈尔（Néel）或交错（staggered）阻尼类自旋轨道力矩（SOT）的通用理论，该力矩天然出现在由两侧相同重金属夹持的合成反铁磁（synthetic antiferromagnet）结构中，并通过奈尔矢量拉格朗日量推导出畴壁速度的闭式表达式，可为畴壁运动的结构控制和电学读出提供新路径。
AI.motivation: 此前奈尔（交错）自旋轨道力矩虽能有效实现反铁磁序的电学操控，但局限于特殊晶体结构，且仅确立了类场分量；本文旨在发展一种在通用结构中产生的阻尼类交错SOT理论及其物理后果。
AI.method: 作者推导了奈尔矢量拉格朗日量（Néel-vector Lagrangian），由此获得畴壁（domain wall, DW）速度的闭式解；该速度对电流和面内磁场均为双线性，对奈尔和布洛赫（Bloch）壁方向相反，并可通过层间交换耦合（interlayer exchange coupling）进行调控。随后利用微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）验证理论结果。
AI.result: 理论预测的畴壁速度符号反转与标度律、以及奈尔-布洛赫（Néel-Bloch）转变的阈值，为实验提供了可直接检验的目标；微磁模拟与理论相一致，确认了交错阻尼类SOT在对称金属/反铁磁/金属夹层结构中的普遍存在性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将畴壁结构作为控制畴壁运动的手段（control knob），同时畴壁运动本身可提供结构信息的电学读出，为反铁磁自旋电子学器件提供了新的设计自由度与实验检验方向。

title: Excitons probe intrinsic flat band Mottness in a van der Waals heterostructure
summary: Excitons provide a sensitive optical probe of electronic correlations in nearby two-dimensional materials, yet their coupling to intrinsic flat-band Mott systems remains largely unexplored. Here we combine gate-tunable optical spectroscopy with first-principles calculations to study monolayer WSe$_2$ in direct contact with the van der Waals Mott insulator Nb$_3$Cl$_8$. The gate evolution of WSe$_2$ excitonic resonances reveals signatures of a correlation-reconstructed Mott gap in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ that is absent from the single-particle band picture. In the electron-doped regime, the WSe$_2$ 2s Rydberg exciton undergoes a multistage evolution and develops into interlayer attractive and repulsive polaron branches, showing that a Rydberg exciton can be dressed by strongly correlated flat-band electrons in an adjacent Mott layer. Under an out-of-plane magnetic field, spin-polarized Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ states further induce valley-selective exciton coupling, producing a strongly enhanced circular polarization of the WSe$_2$ exciton emission. These results extend exciton-based sensing and exciton-polaron physics to intrinsic flat-band Mott materials, providing an optical route to probe and engineer correlation-driven interfacial quasiparticles.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过门压可调光学光谱（gate-tunable optical spectroscopy）与第一性原理计算结合，研究了单层WSe₂与范德华莫特绝缘体（van der Waals Mott insulator）Nb₃Cl₈直接接触形成的界面体系，发现WSe₂激子（exciton）共振的门电压演化揭示了Nb₃Cl₈中关联重构的莫特能隙（correlation-reconstructed Mott gap），并观测到里德伯激子（Rydberg exciton）被相邻莫特层中强关联平带电子修饰形成的层间极化子（interlayer polaron）及磁场下的谷选择性激子耦合增强圆偏振发射等现象，将激子探测与激子-极化子物理拓展至本征平带莫特材料。
AI.motivation: 激子是探测邻近二维材料中电子关联（electronic correlations）的灵敏光学探针，但其与本征平带莫特体系（flat-band Mott systems）的耦合此前几乎未被探索。研究者希望通过界面激子光谱探究激子与强关联莫特绝缘体之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 该论文结合门压可调光学光谱与第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），对与Nb₃Cl₈直接接触的单层WSe₂体系进行系统性研究，并通过外加垂直磁场考察自旋极化态对激子发射的影响。
AI.result: 门电压调控下WSe₂激子共振的演化揭示了Nb₃Cl₈中单粒子能带图像（single-particle band picture）无法解释的关联重构莫特能隙特征；在电子掺杂区域，WSe₂的2s里德伯激子经历多阶段演化并形成层间吸引子与排斥子极化子分支；外加面外磁场下，自旋极化的Nb₃Cl₈态诱导谷选择性激子耦合，显著增强WSe₂激子发射的圆偏振度。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将基于激子的感应探测技术与激子-极化子物理推广至本征平带莫特材料，为探测和操控关联驱动的界面准粒子（correlation-driven interfacial quasiparticles）提供了光学途径。

title: Coupled structural and electronic evolution under pressure in CuIr2Se4, CuRh2S4, and CuRh2Se4
summary: Spinel chalcogenides provide a platform for investigating the interplay among metallic, superconducting, and pressure-induced insulating states. Here, we combine synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction and electrical-resistivity measurements to investigate the pressure evolution of CuIr2Se4, CuRh2S4, and CuRh2Se4 over pressure ranges extending beyond those previously explored. High-pressure diffraction reveals closely related monoclinic supercells in all three compounds. For CuIr2Se4 and CuRh2S4, constrained profile fits based on structural models relaxed using density functional theory are compatible with Phase-IV-type bond-disproportionated structures, whereas the data for CuRh2Se4 establish a compatible monoclinic unit cell without resolving its atomic-scale ordering pattern. Insulating-like transport develops abruptly over a narrow pressure range in CuIr2Se4 but more gradually over broader pressure ranges in the Rh-based compounds, in close correspondence with their respective structural transformations. We also establish previously unreported bulk superconductivity in CuIr2Se4 at ambient pressure: zero resistance is attained at 0.29 K, and the accompanying ac diamagnetic response is consistent with nearly complete superconducting shielding. These results establish a close relationship between the formation of the high-pressure monoclinic phases and the evolution toward insulating transport, and demonstrate that transition-metal and chalcogen substitutions tune the characteristic pressure scales and the competition with superconductivity within a closely related structural framework.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过高能量同步辐射粉末X射线衍射与电阻率测量相结合，系统研究了压力作用下CuIr2Se4、CuRh2S4和CuRh2Se4三种尖晶石硫族化合物（spinel chalcogenides）的结构与电输运演化，揭示三者均出现单斜超胞，其中Ir与Rh基化合物的绝缘化转变与结构相变紧密对应，并首次报道了CuIr2Se4在常压下的体超导电性（零电阻温度0.29 K）。
AI.motivation: 尖晶石硫族化合物为探索金属态、超导态与压力诱导绝缘态之间的相互关联提供了理想平台，而此前对这些材料在更高压力范围内的结构与电输运演化尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 将同步辐射粉末X射线衍射（synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction）与电阻率（electrical-resistivity）测量相结合，对三种化合物在超出以往探索范围的压力区间进行表征；衍射数据采用基于密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）弛豫结构模型的约束轮廓拟合进行分析。
AI.result: 三种化合物均形成高度相关的单斜超胞；CuIr2Se4与CuRh2S4的高压结构与Phase-IV型键不均匀化（bond-disproportionated）结构相符，而CuRh2Se4仅建立相容的单斜晶胞而未能分辨原子尺度有序模式。CuIr2Se4在窄压力范围内经历突变式绝缘化，Rh基化合物则在更宽压力范围内渐进转变，且这一演化与各自结构相变紧密对应。此外，首次报道了CuIr2Se4在常压下的体超导电性，零电阻在0.29 K达到，交流抗磁响应与近乎完全的超导屏蔽一致。
AI.conclusion: 高压单斜相的形成与向绝缘性输运的演化之间存在紧密关联；通过过渡金属与硫族元素的替换可调控特征压力尺度以及超导电性与绝缘相之间的竞争，且这一调控发生在一个结构框架高度相近的体系中。

title: Probing magnetic correlations in space and time within predefined topological sectors of a macroscopic spin liquid
summary: The triangular Ising antiferromagnet, with its residual entropy density and critical correlations at absolute zero, is the archetype of a two-dimensional spin liquid. Its ground state is partitioned into topological sectors connected by global spin flip events that wrap the lattice boundaries, and become statistically irrelevant in the thermodynamic limit where magnetic fluctuations are restricted to the dominant sector. Thus far, these properties have been mainly investigated from a theoretical perspective, and one might wonder to what extent they can be transposed to real materials. Here, we present experimental observations obtained in an artificial, macroscopic realisation of the seminal triangular Ising antiferromagnet that consists of a lattice of millimeter-sized NdFeB cylinders put into motion by a mechanical shaker. Specifically, we demonstrate that the very-low-energy physics and the true ground state of this model can be reached experimentally. Besides, we are able to probe, in space and time, the magnetic properties within manually preselected pockets of the ground-state manifold that emulate, to a good approximation, the behaviour in distinct topological sectors. Our approach opens new avenues for naked-eye visualisation and hand manipulation of many-body phenomena associated to frustrated magnetism and models of statistical physics.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过由毫米级钕铁硼圆柱体构成的宏观人工晶格，在实验中实现了三角伊辛反铁磁模型（triangular Ising antiferromagnet）的基态和极低能物理，并首次在空间和时间上探测了不同拓扑扇区（topological sector）内的磁学性质。
AI.motivation: 三角伊辛反铁磁体是二维自旋液体（spin liquid）的典型模型，其残差熵密度和临界关联（critical correlations）等性质此前主要停留在理论研究层面，作者希望探索这些性质能否在真实材料中实现和验证。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个由毫米级钕铁硼（NdFeB）圆柱体排列成晶格、并由机械振荡器驱动运动的宏观人工实现；通过手动预选基态流形（ground-state manifold）中的不同区域，模拟不同拓扑扇区的行为，并对其磁性进行时空探测。
AI.result: 实验成功达到了该模型的极低能物理和真实基态；作者还能够在空间和时间上探测基态流形中预先选定的局域区域的磁学性质，这些区域可以近似模拟不同拓扑扇区中的行为。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为以裸眼可视化和手动操控的方式研究阻挫磁性（frustrated magnetism）及相关统计物理模型中的多体现象开辟了新途径。

title: Nonequilibrium full counting statistics of multicomponent strongly-interacting quantum gases with defects
summary: We investigate the full counting statistics of a one-dimensional multicomponent impenetrable gas released from a bipartite state in the presence of a local defect. Spin--charge separation reduces the multivariate generating function to an exact Fredholm determinant whose kernel is built from time-evolved single-particle orbitals. Expressing these orbitals in terms of scattering data gives access to both transient dynamics and the nonequilibrium steady state. We derive the leading long-time asymptotics and identify persistent oscillations in densities and currents caused by multiple bound states at the junction. We argue that interactions between components lead to a linear low-temperature correction to the current, in contrast to the quadratic correction in the single-component case. At equilibrium, we obtain the M-Wright distribution of spin transfer with $t^{1/4}$ scaling.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了一维多分量不可穿透气体在局域缺陷与二分态初态下的全计数统计（full counting statistics）。通过自旋-电荷分离将多元生成函数约化为精确的Fredholm行列式，推导出长时渐近行为，识别出由结处多重束缚态引起的密度与电流持续振荡，并发现多分量相互作用导致电流的线性低温修正（区别于单分量情形的二次修正），同时平衡态下自旋转移呈现t^{1/4}标度的M-Wright分布。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解多分量不可穿透气体在存在局域缺陷时从二分态释放的输运性质与涨落统计，尤其是自旋与电荷自由度耦合下的非平衡稳态及低温行为。
AI.method: 利用自旋-电荷分离（spin-charge separation）将多变量生成函数约化为核函数由时间演化单粒子轨道构建的精确Fredholm行列式（Fredholm determinant）；将这些轨道用散射数据表达，以同时获取瞬态动力学与非平衡稳态。
AI.result: 推导出长时主导渐近行为，发现由结处多重束缚态导致的密度与电流中持续振荡；分量间相互作用导致电流呈线性低温修正，而非单分量情形中的二次修正；平衡态下自旋转移统计遵循t^{1/4}标度的M-Wright分布。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多分量量子气体在局域缺陷下的非平衡输运提供了精确解析框架，揭示了自旋-电荷分离在涨落统计中的核心作用，并展示了多分量体系在低温修正与涨落标度上区别于单分量情形的独特行为。

title: Reverse engineering of mechano-kinetic parameters from stochastic force profiles in heterogeneous ensembles of molecular motors and tracks
summary: Heterogeneity in contractile systems of molecular motors interacting with their tracks plays a key role in numerous cellular physiological and pathological processes. However, its effects cannot be captured by theoretical models assuming identical mechano-kinetic properties for all motors. We developed a stochastic framework to describe heterogeneous ensembles of myosin motors comprising two populations with distinct mechano-kinetic properties. Assuming that motors interact with the actin filament (their track) as independent force generators, we derived the probability distribution of the isometric force and characterised the statistics of finite-size force fluctuations. The proposed framework includes an estimation procedure that simultaneously infers the mechano-kinetic parameters and the size of the motor ensemble, eliminating the need to prescribe it a priori. Validation against synthetic and experimental data shows the model accurately captures force fluctuations and provides realistic estimates of the ensemble size. Furthermore, the framework enables a quantitative assessment of ensemble heterogeneity and the inference of an unknown motor species properties. This approach provides a quantitative tool for characterising heterogeneous actin-myosin systems, such as those arising from the co-presence of different protein isoforms in cardiac and skeletal muscle, or from the partial replacement of native proteins with mutation-derived or engineered variants.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一个描述肌球蛋白（myosin）马达异质集合的随机框架，其中包含了两种具有不同力学-动力学特性的群体。该框架可推导等距力概率分布、表征有限尺寸力波动统计，并能同时推断集合参数与规模。通过合成数据与实验数据的验证，该模型能准确捕捉力波动并估计集合规模，为定量表征肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白异质系统提供了工具。
AI.motivation: 分子马达与其轨道相互作用的收缩系统异质性在众多细胞生理和病理过程中起关键作用，但假设所有马达具有相同力学-动力学特性的理论模型无法捕捉这种效应，因此需要一种能够描述这一异质性的建模框架。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个随机框架（stochastic framework），描述由两种不同力学-动力学特性的群体组成的肌球蛋白马达异质集合。在假设马达作为独立力发生器与肌动蛋白丝相互作用的前提下，推导了等距力（isometric force）的概率分布，并刻画了有限尺寸力波动的统计特征。框架还包含估计流程，可同时推断力学-动力学参数和马达集合规模，无需预先假定集合大小。
AI.result: 通过合成数据和实验数据的验证，该模型能准确捕捉力的波动，并对集合规模提供合理估计。此外，该框架还能对集合异质性进行定量评估，并推断未知马达物种的特性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为表征异质肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白系统提供了定量工具，适用于心脏和骨骼肌中不同蛋白异构体共存的情形，以及天然蛋白被突变衍生或工程化变体部分替换的情形。

title: Precision tests of nonlinear and stochastic modifications of quantum mechanics with a 1D quantum gas
summary: We propose a cold-atom platform for precision tests of nonlinear and stochastic modifications to the Schrödinger equation, utilizing strongly correlated ultracold $^{133}$Cs in a uniform array of one-dimensional tubes formed by a two-dimensional optical lattice. Objective collapse models can be tested using the metastable super-Tonks-Girardeau gas. Based on a calibration test performed on our existing experimental setup, we project a sensitivity to the Continuous Spontaneous Localization collapse rate of $λ_c \simeq 1.8\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$ at a correlation length of $r_c = 10^{-7}\,$m. This would establish a new bound an order of magnitude below the strongest existing constraint that remains robust against a cutoff in the collapse noise spectrum. Additionally, we can test deterministic nonlinear modifications by probing the symmetry-protected breathing mode frequency of the Tonks-Girardeau gas in harmonic traps. Crucial to both measurement schemes is the capability to independently tune the atom number and the linear density. By exploiting the different scaling laws associated with these parameters, we can cleanly distinguish genuine new physics signals from technical systematics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于冷原子（cold atom）平台的高精度实验方案，用于检验薛定谔方程（Schrödinger equation）的非线性和随机性修正。通过利用一维管阵列中强关联的超冷铯-133原子气体，作者预测对连续自发局域化（CSL）坍缩率λ_c的灵敏度可达约1.8×10⁻¹¹ s⁻¹，该结果比现有最强约束低一个数量级，同时还可探测确定性非线性修正对Tonks-Girardeau气体呼吸模式频率的影响。
AI.motivation: 量子力学（quantum mechanics）的波函数坍缩问题至今尚未解决，客观坍缩模型（objective collapse models）和确定性非线性修正均为可能的理论延伸。然而，现有实验对这些修正的约束仍不够强，尤其是在坍缩噪声谱具有截止时鲁棒性不足，需要新的精密实验平台来建立更严格的界限。
AI.method: 实验平台采用二维光晶格形成的均匀一维管阵列，装载强关联的超冷铯-133原子。针对客观坍缩模型，利用亚稳态的超汤克斯-盖拉德气体（super-Tonks-Girardeau gas）进行测试；针对确定性非线性修正，则通过探测谐振阱中汤克斯-盖拉德气体（Tonks-Girardeau gas）的对称性保护呼吸模式（breathing mode）频率来实现。两个测量方案的关键在于能够独立调节原子数和线性密度，利用二者不同的标度律（scaling laws）区分真实新物理信号与技术系统误差。
AI.result: 基于现有实验装置的校准测试，作者预测对连续自发局域化坍缩速率λ_c的灵敏度约为1.8×10⁻¹¹ s⁻¹（关联长度r_c = 10⁻⁷ m），可比现有最强约束低一个数量级，且该界限对坍缩噪声谱的截止保持鲁棒性。此外，该平台还能对确定性非线性修正提出新的约束。
AI.conclusion: 该冷原子平台有望为量子力学基础的精密检验提供新手段，在客观坍缩模型和确定性非线性修正两方面均可获得超越现有水平的灵敏度，且通过参数标度律的差异能够干净地区分新物理信号与技术系统误差。

title: Groove-shaped defects in as-grown (001)-oriented $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ epilayers prepared by halide vapor phase epitaxy
summary: Groove-shaped defects (GSDs) degrade the surface flatness of as-grown (001)-oriented $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ epilayers and necessitate chemical mechanical polishing before device fabrication, increasing processing costs and the risk of damage. We investigated the morphology, subsurface structure, and formation mechanism of GSDs in a homoepitaxial layer grown by halide vapor phase epitaxy using synchrotron X-ray topography and electron microscopy. The GSDs extended several millimeters along [010] and consisted predominantly of (-102) basal facets bounded by steep (100) sidewalls. Their wafer-scale distribution showed a spatial correspondence with variations in wafer curvature, suggesting that local surface orientation influences GSD formation. Careful alignment of surface images with transmission X-ray topographs revealed no one-to-one correspondence between GSDs and substrate defects, providing no evidence that substrate dislocations serve as their nucleation sites.
