Instead, transmission electron microscopy revealed planar defects localized near the terminal boundaries where the faceted GSD sectors met the surrounding (001) growth region; no such defects were observed in specimens extracted from the middle of GSDs. These defects exhibited α-fringe contrast characteristic of inclined translational planar defects, with the dominant segments assigned to the (1-21) plane. The observations suggest that variations in local surface orientation and step supply may promote three-dimensional faceted growth, producing persistent (-102)/(100) sectors. The localized planar defects are therefore interpreted as consequences of growth-sector coalescence rather than the origins of GSD nucleation. These findings provide insight into the roles of wafer curvature and surface step supply in GSD formation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用同步辐射X射线形貌术和电子显微镜，对卤化物气相外延生长的同质外延β-Ga₂O₃层中沟槽状缺陷（GSDs）的形貌、亚表面结构和形成机制进行了系统研究，发现其形成受局部表面取向和台阶供应调控，而非衬底位错成核。
AI.motivation: 沟槽状缺陷（groove-shaped defects, GSDs）破坏(001)取向β-Ga₂O₃外延层的表面平整度，器件制造前须经化学机械抛光，增加加工成本和损伤风险。厘清GSDs的形成机制是降低缺陷密度、优化外延工艺的前提。
AI.method: 采用卤化物气相外延（halide vapor phase epitaxy）生长同质外延层，利用同步辐射X射线形貌术（synchrotron X-ray topography）和电子显微镜（electron microscopy）表征GSDs的形貌与亚表面结构，并将表面图像与透射X射线形貌图精确配准，比较晶圆曲率变化与缺陷分布的空间对应关系。
AI.result: GSDs沿[010]方向延伸数毫米，主要由(-102)基底小面及其陡峭(100)侧壁构成；其晶圆尺度分布与晶圆曲率变化存在空间对应。透射X射线形貌图未显示GSDs与衬底缺陷的一一对应关系，否定了位错成核假说。透射电子显微镜在GSDs端部边界附近发现以(1-21)面为主的倾斜平移型面缺陷，呈现α条纹衬度，而GSDs中部样品无此类缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 局部表面取向变化和台阶供应波动可能促进三维小面生长，产生持久的(-102)/(100)生长扇区；端部观察到的小面缺陷是生长扇区汇聚的结果而非GSDs成核的原因。该工作揭示晶圆曲率和表面台阶供应在GSDs形成中的关键作用。

title: Atomistic origin and strain control of the finite-temperature dielectric response in BaTiO3
summary: The dielectric response of BaTiO3 (BTO) varies strongly with temperature, yet its local atomic origin remains unclear. Using electric-field-coupled molecular dynamics with a machine-learning force field, we show that the permittivity tracks the field-induced angular redistribution of local Ti-O off-centering rather than its magnitude or mean polar angle. Temperature and biaxial strain modify the local structure differently, but both responses follow a common relation with the same orientational descriptor, providing a real-space counterpart to soft-mode behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用电场耦合的机器学习力场分子动力学模拟，揭示BaTiO3的介电响应与局部Ti-O偏心距的场致角度重分布直接相关，而非其大小或平均极角；温度和双轴应变通过不同方式改变局部结构，但两者均遵循同一取向描述符的统一关系，为软模行为提供了实空间对应。
AI.motivation: BaTiO3（钛酸钡）的介电响应（dielectric response）随温度剧烈变化，但其局域原子起源尚不明确。该研究旨在从原子层面揭示介电响应与局部结构之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 采用电场耦合的分子动力学（electric-field-coupled molecular dynamics）模拟，并结合机器学习力场（machine-learning force field）来精确描述原子间相互作用；通过系统分析Ti-O离中心的角分布变化，建立了介电常数与取向描述符之间的关联。
AI.result: 研究发现介电常数（permittivity）追踪的是场诱导的局域Ti-O离中心的角度重分布（angular redistribution），而非其幅度或平均极角。温度和双轴应变（biaxial strain）对局部结构的修饰方式不同，但两者的介电响应均遵循与同一取向描述符的普适关系。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为软模行为（soft-mode behavior）提供了实空间对应物（real-space counterpart），表明取向无序的重分布是理解BaTiO3介电响应的关键物理机制。

title: Lindbladian Phase Geometry and Hall Transport in Open Bloch Systems
summary: Quantum geometry underlies a wide range of transport phenomena in Bloch systems. How quantum-geometric transport is modified when Bloch electrons are coupled to an environment, however, remains largely unexplored, even though the environment can alter both the electronic state and the physical current operator. Here we formulate dc linear response within a trace-preserving Lindblad kinetic theory by defining the physical velocity as the Liouvillian time derivative of the position operator. This construction reveals an environment-induced contribution to the current vertex whose momentum-space curl generates new Hall responses governed by the gauge-invariant phase geometry encoded by Lindblad jump amplitudes, which characterize electron-environment coupling. To leading order in the dissipative coupling, this geometry gives rise to interband shift-vector and diagonal-vorticity Hall responses arising from off-diagonal and diagonal jump amplitudes, respectively. Remarkably, both mechanisms can produce a finite Hall conductivity even when the conventional Berry-curvature anomalous Hall effect vanishes identically. Our work establishes Lindbladian phase geometry as an independent geometric origin of transverse transport in open quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Lindblad动力学理论框架下重新定义了准粒子的速度算符，发现环境耦合会在电流顶点中引入新的贡献，其动量空间旋度产生由Lindblad跳变振幅编码的规范不变相位几何所主导的全新霍尔响应，即使在传统贝利曲率异常霍尔效应为零时，这些机制仍可产生有限的霍尔电导率。
AI.motivation: 布洛赫系统中的量子几何支撑了广泛的输运现象，但当布洛赫电子与环境耦合时，量子几何输运如何被修正这一问题尚未被充分探索，尽管环境既能改变电子态也能改变物理电流算符。
AI.method: 在保持轨迹的Lindblad运动学理论（trace-preserving Lindblad kinetic theory）中构建直流线性响应，将物理速度定义为位置算符的Liouvillian时间导数，从而揭示电流顶点中的环境诱导贡献。
AI.result: 环境诱导的电流贡献的动量空间旋度产生由Lindblad跳变振幅（Lindblad jump amplitudes）编码的规范不变相位几何主导的霍尔响应；在耗散耦合的最低阶，带间偏移矢量和实部涡度霍尔响应分别由离对角和对角跳变振幅产生，两种机制在贝利曲率异常霍尔效应完全消失时仍能产生有限霍尔电导率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了Lindblad相位几何作为开放量子物质中横向输运的独立几何起源。

title: Metallic-Phase-Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ Enabled Interface Engineering for Self-Powered and High-Gain WS$_2$ Photodetectors
summary: Two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides offer strong light-matter interaction but suffer from inefficient carrier separation and contact-related losses in photodetectors. Here, we demonstrate a high-gain WS$_2$/Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure photodetector, where metallic Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ serves as an active interfacial contact. The work-function mismatch, together with interfacial charge redistribution and asymmetric contact geometry, contributes to a built-in field that supports self-powered photodetection at zero bias. Under 450 nm illumination, the device delivers a zero-bias responsivity of 23.5 A/W and an apparent external quantum efficiency of 6.4 x 10$^3$%. At -1 V biasing, the heterostructure exhibits photoresponse at 450, 520 and 633 nm, achieving a responsivity of 9.7 x 10$^3$ A/W and a noise derived specific detectivity of 2.3 x 10$^13$ Jones at 100 Hz under 450 nm illumination. The high photoresponse is attributed to interfacial carrier separation, efficient extraction, and a likely contribution from trap-assisted photogating in multilayer WS$_2$. These results establish Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$-enabled interface engineering as an effective route for self-powered, highly sensitive 2D photodetectors.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种基于WS₂/Fe₃GaTe₂范德华异质结构的高增益光电探测器，利用金属性Fe₃GaTe₂作为活性界面接触，通过功函数失配、界面电荷重分布和不对称接触几何构型构建内建电场，实现了零偏压下自供电的高灵敏光电探测。
AI.motivation: 二维过渡金属硫族化合物（transition-metal dichalcogenides）具有强光-物质相互作用，但在光电探测器中存在载流子分离效率低和接触相关损耗等问题，需要探索有效的界面工程策略以提升器件性能。
AI.method: 构建WS₂/Fe₃GaTe₂范德华异质结构光电探测器，其中金属性Fe₃GaTe₂作为活性界面接触；利用功函数失配引起的界面电荷重分布与不对称接触几何构型共同形成内建电场，实现零偏压下的自供电光电探测。
AI.result: 在450 nm光照下，器件在零偏压时实现了23.5 A/W的响应度和6.4 × 10³%的表观外量子效率（external quantum efficiency）；在-1 V偏压下，器件对450、520和633 nm均有光响应，其中450 nm照明下实现9.7 × 10³ A/W的响应度和100 Hz下2.3 × 10¹³ Jones的噪声推导比探测率（specific detectivity）。
AI.conclusion: 高光响应归因于界面载流子分离、高效提取以及多层WS₂中可能存在的陷阱辅助光栅效应（trap-assisted photogating）；Fe₃GaTe₂所实现的界面工程被证明是构建自供电、高灵敏二维光电探测器的有效途径。

title: Modular and Cost-effective Scanning Photocurrent Microscopy System for Sub-micron characterization of 2D optoelectronic devices
summary: Scanning photocurrent microscopy (SPCM) is a powerful technique for probing local optoelectronic phenomena in 2D semiconducting devices. However, commercial setups remain costly, complex and often lack flexibility and adaptability. In this work, we present a home-built SPCM platform built around the retrofitting of a conventional metallographic microscope by coupling it with different light sources (single-mode fiber-coupled lasers and multimode fiber-coupled high-power LEDs), a motorized XY stage, a digital camera and an electronic readout module. This system enables simultaneous acquisition of photocurrent and reflection intensity maps, requiring minimal modifications of the microscope. We reached sub-micron spatial resolution and high imaging fidelity by correlating photocurrent maps with reflection maps, optical micrographs and AFM topography data on different devices fabricated with different materials (InSe, MoS2, WSe2, Gr), on different substrates (Si/SiO2, compact disk). This work provides a reliable, accessible and reproducible high-performance SPCM platform that can be easily implemented in most laboratories for microscale optoelectronic characterization of 2D devices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种基于改装传统金相显微镜构建的自制扫描光电流显微镜（SPCM）平台，通过耦合多种光源、电动XY平移台、数字相机及电子读出模块，实现了光电流与反射强度图的同步采集，以最小改动达到亚微米空间分辨率，并已在多种二维材料和不同基底上验证其成像保真度。
AI.motivation: 商业化的SPCM系统成本高昂、结构复杂且缺乏灵活性与适应性，限制了其在二维半导体器件局域光电表征中的广泛使用。作者旨在构建一种低成本、可靠、可复现且易于在大多数实验室实现的自制SPCM平台。
AI.method: 该方法通过改造传统金相显微镜（metallographic microscope）来搭建SPCM平台，耦合不同光源（单模光纤耦合激光器与多模光纤耦合高功率LED）、电动XY平移台、数字相机及电子读出模块，实现光电流图和反射强度图的同时采集。
AI.result: 该系统达到亚微米空间分辨率，并通过将光电流图与反射图、光学显微图和原子力显微镜（atomic force microscopy, AFM）形貌数据关联，在不同材料（InSe、MoS2、WSe2、石墨烯Gr）和不同基底（Si/SiO2、光盘CD）上制备的多种器件中验证了高成像保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可靠、易获取且可复现的高性能SPCM平台，可简便地在大多数实验室中搭建，用于二维器件的微米尺度光电表征。

title: Unveiling the Scaling Potential of Drain Merge through Active (DMtA) in CFETs: Breaking the Super-Via Bottlenecks and Unlocking New PPA Boosters
summary: Drain merge (DM), a super via vertically connecting the common S/D terminals of stacked n/pFETs in Complementary FETs (CFETs), blocks further parasitic optimization and cell scaling. For the first time, this work systematically investigates the state-of-the-art Drain Merge through Active (DMtA), a revolutionary technology reported recently with the DM embedded in the active region, through a comprehensive DTCO framework spanning process integration, contact-configuration-dependent (CTCD) compact modeling, standardcell design, RO evaluation and block-level PPA benchmark on a 32-bit RISC-V Ibex core. By reducing DM parasitics and enabling DM-width optimization, DMtA improves RO frequency by 11.7% over its conventional Drain Merge through field (DMtF) counterpart. Active widening and Area Borrowing, the latter first reported in [8] and exploiting spatial slack in adjacent cells to further enlarge the nanosheet width (WNS), increase the maximum Ibex-core frequency by up to 34.8%. More importantly, DMtA also enables the once GAA-exclusive Hyper-cells on CFETs by merging the active regions across adjacent cell rows, providing a further 8.7% frequency gain. A post-routing floating-output-pin-aware optimization further removes redundant S/D contacts (CTs) and reduces power by 5.3%. Finally, DMtA facilitates more area-efficient 2.5T cell scaling by preserving single-row cell compatibility, reducing post-PR core area by 25.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文首次通过综合DTCO框架系统研究了互补场效应晶体管（Complementary FETs, CFETs）中的有源区嵌入式漏极合并（Drain Merge through Active, DMtA）技术，该技术通过降低寄生效应、优化漏极合并宽度、实现有源区加宽与面积借用，在RISC-V Ibex核上实现了最高34.8%的频率提升、5.3%的功耗降低和25.7%的面积缩减。
AI.motivation: 在CFET中，垂直连接堆叠n/pFET共用源漏端子的超级通孔——漏极合并（Drain Merge, DM）会阻碍寄生参数优化和单元尺寸微缩，因此需要探索新的器件集成方案以突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 本文构建了完整的DTCO（design-technology co-optimization）框架，涵盖工艺集成、接触配置相关（contact-configuration-dependent, CTCD）紧凑建模、标准单元设计、环形振荡器（ring oscillator, RO）评估以及32位RISC-V Ibex核上的块级PPA基准测试，系统研究了将有源区内的漏极合并嵌入有源区内部的DMtA技术。
AI.result: DMtA较传统的有源区外漏极合并（DMtF）方案将RO频率提升11.7%；结合有源区加宽和面积借用（Area Borrowing）技术，最大将Ibex核频率提升34.8%；通过跨行合并有源区实现的Hyper-cells带来额外8.7%频率增益；后路由浮空输出引脚感知优化去除冗余S/D接触（contacts, CTs）降低5.3%功耗；同时通过保持单行单元兼容性实现更紧凑的2.5T单元微缩，使布线后（post-PR）核心面积减少25.7%。
AI.conclusion: DMtA作为一种将有源区嵌入式漏极合并的革新性技术，能够在多个维度上显著提升CFET器件的频率性能、降低功耗并缩减面积，为突破CFET架构中漏极合并带来的寄生与尺寸瓶颈提供了系统性的解决方案。

title: Emergent Equilibrium Structure Along a Critical Cluster Recursion
summary: Critical universality does not determine the microscopic conditional structure of a probability measure. We study a bicolored cluster recursion constrained to remain critical at every generation, with no equilibrium spin measure or fixed coupling imposed. In both two and three dimensions, the resulting history-dependent sequence develops a common Ising/Fortuin--Kasteleyn (FK) compatibility structure: the second-shell dependence of a one-site conditional law is strongly suppressed, nearest-neighbor effective couplings move progressively toward one another near the critical Ising value, and cluster and interface observables organize around the corresponding FK geometry. An exact cluster-coloring factorization singles out $q=2$ as the point where the residual connectivity weight disappears from the two-color spin marginal. Thus equilibrium-compatible conditional structure can emerge along a trajectory that remains critical throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种在每一代都保持临界约束的双色团簇递归（bicolored cluster recursion），发现即使在无平衡自旋测度或固定耦合的条件下，其在二维和三维中均演化出与伊辛/福图因–卡斯泰莱因（Ising/Fortuin–Kasteleyn, FK）相容的微观条件结构，表明临界过程中平衡相容的条件结构可以自发涌现。
AI.motivation: 临界普适性（critical universality）并不决定概率测度的微观条件结构，因此作者希望探究一个仅受临界性约束的动力学过程中能否自然涌现出具有平衡体系特征的条件结构，而不预先施加平衡自旋测度或固定耦合。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个双色团簇递归过程，严格约束其在每一代生成中保持在临界点，并在二维和三维空间中分析该历史依赖序列的条件概率结构；同时通过精确的团簇着色因子分解（cluster-coloring factorization）考察双色自旋边缘分布中残余连通权重消失的条件。
AI.result: 该临界递归序列在二维与三维中均发展出共同的伊辛/FK兼容结构：单位点条件分布的次近邻（second-shell）依赖性被强烈抑制，最近邻有效耦合逐渐相互趋近于临界伊辛值，团簇与界面观测量围绕相应FK几何组织。精确因子分解表明q=2是残余连通权重从双色自旋边缘分布中消失的临界点。
AI.conclusion: 平衡相容的条件结构可以在一条全程保持临界的轨迹上涌现，表明微观条件组织并非临界普适性所唯一决定，却可在特定临界约束动力学下天然收敛至平衡兼容形态。

title: Storing Infinite Dynamical Attractors in Nonreciprocal Associative Neural Networks
summary: We develop a dynamical mean-field theory for nonreciprocal associative networks that store an extensive number of dynamical attractors, from limit cycles to strange attractors. Using a path integral calculation under quenched disorder, we derive self-consistent dynamical mean-field equations for pattern overlaps, autocorrelations and response functions. Memory retrieval capacity is governed by the spectral structure of the coupling matrices encoding stored patterns. When their eigenvalues are coherently aligned, retarded self-interactions and quenched noise feed back destructively: at zero eigenphase (fixed point attractors) the classical equilibrium capacity bound is recovered, while for limit cycles retrieval collapses far below it. In contrast, for uniformly distributed eigenphases, retarded self-interactions and much of the quenched noise cancels, reducing the dynamics to an effective single-spin process and amplifying capacity substantially. We validate the theory against microscopic simulations for limit-cycle and chaotic attractors, identifying eigenvalue decoherence as the mechanism enabling enhanced storage of dynamical memories.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种针对非互易关联网络（nonreciprocal associative networks）的动力学平均场理论（dynamical mean-field theory），用以描述存储大量动力学吸引子（从极限环到奇异吸引子）的网络的记忆检索能力。研究发现耦合矩阵的特征值相位对齐程度决定了记忆检索能力：零特征相位恢复经典平衡容量界限，而特征相位均匀分布时，动力学退化为有效单自旋过程，存储容量被大幅放大。
AI.motivation: 现有联想记忆网络理论主要针对静态（定点）吸引子，对能编码极限环和混沌吸引子等动态记忆的非互易网络的存储容量和检索机制缺乏系统的理论刻画。作者希望建立一种统一的动力学平均场框架，从微观耦合矩阵的谱结构出发揭示动态记忆存储能力的关键决定因素。
AI.method: 采用淬火无序（quenched disorder）下的路径积分（path integral）计算，推导出模式重叠（pattern overlaps）、自相关函数（autocorrelations）和响应函数（response functions）的自洽动力学平均场方程。通过分析存储模式编码的耦合矩阵特征值谱结构，考察不同特征相位分布（零相位对齐vs均匀分布）对推迟自相互作用（retarded self-interactions）和淬火噪声反馈的影响。
AI.result: 当特征值相干对齐时：零特征相位（定点吸引子）情形下恢复经典平衡容量界限，而极限环情形下检索容量远低于该界限。当特征相位均匀分布时，推迟自相互作用和大部分淬火噪声相互抵消，动力学退化为有效单自旋过程，存储容量显著放大。微观模拟验证了极限环和混沌吸引子情形下的理论预测，确认特征值退相干（eigenvalue decoherence）是动态记忆增强存储的机制。
AI.conclusion: 特征值退相干是非互易关联网络实现动态记忆高容量存储的关键机制，为理解和设计能够存储极限环及混沌等复杂动力学吸引子的神经网络提供了理论基础。

title: Trion-mediated quantum operations on a double-dot charge qubit
summary: A scheme for controlling a charge qubit on a semiconductor asymmetric double quantum dot with suppressed tunnel coupling between individual quantum dots is proposed. Laser pulses convert the logical single-electron states of the qubit into auxiliary trion states, for which the resonant tunneling condition is restored due to the compensation of structural asymmetry by the Coulomb interaction of the particles. The conditions for performing orthogonal single-qubit rotations are formulated. For a two-dimensional structure, the parameters of the qubit are calculated, and the dependence of the fidelity of the inversion operation on the parameters of the laser field and the rates of dissipative processes is obtained. It is shown that the considered algorithm is characterized by high speed and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在半导体非对称双量子点中控制电荷量子比特（charge qubit）的方案，通过激光脉冲将逻辑单电子态转化为辅助三重子态（trion state），在抑制单个量子点间隧穿耦合的同时利用库仑相互作用补偿结构不对称性，实现高速可靠的单比特正交旋转操作。
AI.motivation: 传统半导体量子点电荷量子比特受到量子点间隧穿耦合的制约，限制了可控性与相干时间。作者旨在通过一种新型控制方案，在抑制隧穿耦合的条件下仍能实现快速、可靠的量子比特操作。
AI.method: 方案核心是使用激光脉冲将量子比特的逻辑单电子态转换为辅助三重子态。在这些三重子态中，由于粒子间库仑相互作用（Coulomb interaction）补偿了结构不对称性，共振隧穿条件得以恢复。作者继而推导了实现正交单比特旋转（single-qubit rotation）的充要条件，并针对二维结构计算了量子比特参数。
AI.result: 针对二维结构，作者计算了量子比特的各项参数，获得了反转操作（inversion operation）保真度（fidelity）随激光场参数和耗散过程速率变化的依赖关系，并证明该算法具有高速度与高可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于激光控制三重子中间态的方案能够在抑制隧穿耦合的同时保持量子操作的保真度，兼具高速与可靠性，为半导体电荷量子比特的实现提供了一条可行路径。

title: Static-Dynamic Correlations and Complex Spin-Wave Eigenmodes in Single- and Multilayer Diamond-Shaped Nanomagnets Without Bias Field
summary: Diamond-shaped nanomagnets provide a suitable platform for developing microwave devices with reconfigurable characteristics. In this study, the static and dynamic magnetic behaviour of single layer and multilayer diamond-shaped nanomagnets was systematically investigated using micromagnetic simulations. Two distinct remanent magnetic configurations were obtained through a simple magnetic field initialization process. These configurations exhibited different magnetization patterns and dynamic responses. Their resonance characteristics could be modified by applying a nanosecond-scale magnetic field pulse, enabling reconfigurable microwave operation. A clear resonance frequency shift in the sub-GHz (0.9 GHz) range was observed for the single-layer structure, while the multilayer structure exhibited a significantly larger frequency shift in the GHz range (3 GHz). The larger frequency tunability observed in the multilayer configuration arises primarily from the enhanced dipolar coupling between the vertically coupled magnetic layers, which modifies the local effective magnetic field and consequently influences the magnetization dynamics. These findings demonstrate that diamond-shaped nanomagnets can provide a simple and effective route toward reconfigurable microwave functionality, with potential applications in ultralow-power, ultrafast, and frequency tunable microwave devices.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulation）系统研究了单层和多层菱形纳米磁体（diamond-shaped nanomagnet）的静态与动态磁行为，发现通过简单磁场初始化可获得两种不同的剩余磁构型，并可通过纳秒级磁场脉冲实现频率可调的重构式微波操作。多层结构因增强的偶极耦合（dipolar coupling）表现出更大的共振频移，为超低功耗、超快且频率可调的微波器件提供了可行途径。
AI.motivation: 菱形纳米磁体为开发具有可重构特性的微波器件提供了合适的平台，但对其静态和动态磁行为的系统理解仍有限。理解其磁构型与微波响应之间的关系是实现频率可调微波功能的基础。
AI.method: 采用微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulation）方法，对单层和多层菱形纳米磁体进行系统性研究；通过简单磁场初始化过程获得磁构型，并施加纳秒级磁场脉冲以改变其共振特性，进而评估共振频率偏移（resonance frequency shift）。
AI.result: 研究中获得了两种具有不同磁化模式和动态响应的剩余磁构型；单层结构观察到亚GHz（0.9 GHz）范围内的清晰共振频移，而多层结构则表现出显著更大的GHz范围（3 GHz）频移。多层结构更大的频率可调性主要源于垂直耦合磁层间的增强偶极耦合，它改变了局部有效磁场并影响磁化动力学。
AI.conclusion: 菱形纳米磁体为实现可重构微波功能提供了一条简单有效的路径，在超低功耗、超快及频率可调的微波器件中具有潜在应用前景。

title: Fragility from Enthalpy Fluctuations and Fictive-Temperature Dynamics
summary: Fragility and fictive temperature are two central measures of glass formation, but their connection is usually expressed indirectly through structural relaxation times or cooling-rate dependence. Here we formulate this connection in terms of configurational enthalpy fluctuations. The time evolution of the fictive temperature during cooling or aging is controlled by the enthalpy--enthalpy correlation function that also determines the frequency-dependent configurational heat capacity. Fragility enters through the strong temperature dependence of the structural relaxation time and therefore controls how rapidly the corresponding enthalpy-relaxation spectrum shifts to long times near the glass transition. This leads to a direct time-domain description of the onset and growth of the fictive-temperature lag, including the Debye limit, and connects calorimetric relaxation, fragility, and nonequilibrium structural arrest within a common framework.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构型焓涨落将玻璃形成的两个核心量——脆度（fragility）与假想温度（fictive temperature）直接联系起来，形成一个统一的理论框架，涵盖量热弛豫、脆度及非平衡结构阻抑。
AI.motivation: 脆度与假想温度是玻璃形成的两个核心度量，但二者之间的关联通常仅通过结构弛豫时间或冷却速率依赖被间接表达，缺乏直接的理论联系。
AI.method: 作者以构型焓涨落（configurational enthalpy fluctuations）为纽带进行理论构建，指出冷却或老化过程中假想温度的时间演化由焓–焓相关函数控制，该函数同时决定频率依赖的构型热容。脆度通过结构弛豫时间的强温度依赖性进入框架，从而控制焓弛豫谱向长时区间移动的速度。文中推导了假想温度滞后的时间域描述，包括德拜极限情形。
AI.result: 该框架建立了从量热弛豫、脆度到非平衡结构阻抑（structural arrest）的直接时间域联系，给出了假想温度滞后产生与增长的直接描述，并涵盖了德拜极限（Debye limit）。
AI.conclusion: 研究将玻璃转变附近的量热弛豫、脆度与非平衡结构阻抑纳入一个统一框架，为理解玻璃形成的核心动力学性质提供了直接的理论关联途径。

title: How to enhance the applicability of Murnaghan equation of state
summary: The paper presents the brief overview of known isothermal equations of state for solids and of theoretical background to construct them, focusing on widely used Murnaghan equation. Since the latter has a limited range of application, failing to reproduce reliably both near-equilibrium and high-pressure regions simultaneously, the paper proposes simple, but rather efficient way to improve it. The suggested modification favors its applicability at high pressures, allowing to expand considerably the region of reliable reproducing of experimental or computational data. The proposed improved equation has been tested in fitting of U(V) data, obtained within ab initio computations, as well as of experimental V-P data for a representative selection of solids. In comparison with ordinary Murnaghan equation, it has found significant advantages, extending the range, where the computational data may be reproduced trustworthy (from the equilibrium state to the pressures, appreciably higher, the ordinary equation could). As for the fitting of experimental data, the proposed improved Murnaghan equation reproduces them, in the presented examples, at least not worse than other well-known equations (Vinet, Birch-Murnaghan, Mao) do. Some aspects of fitting process, as well as some alternative approaches to obtain the proposed equation of state in various forms are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文简要回顾了固体的等温状态方程（isothermal equation of state）及其理论构建背景，重点聚焦广泛使用的Murnaghan方程。由于该方程适用域有限，无法同时可靠复现近平衡态与高压区域的数据，论文提出了一种简单而有效的改进方案，显著扩展了其在高压下的可靠适用范围。改进后的方程在对第一性原理计算数据及代表性固体的实验V-P数据的拟合中均优于原Murnaghan方程，并在实验拟合方面不逊于Vinet、Birch-Murnaghan和Mao等已知方程。
AI.motivation: Murnaghan方程虽是固体状态方程中最常用的形式之一，但其适用范围有限，难以同时可靠描述近平衡态与高压区域的行为。因此，需要提出一种简单而高效的改进方案，以扩展该方程在高压下的可靠适用域，从而更准确地复现实验或计算数据。
AI.method: 论文提出对标准Murnaghan方程进行简单改进，使其在高压区域的适用性得到增强。改进后的状态方程通过对第一性原理（ab initio）计算获得的U(V)数据，以及实验V-P数据（针对一组代表性固体样品）进行拟合测试加以验证；同时与Vinet、Birch-Murnaghan和Mao等已知状态方程进行比较。
AI.result: 与原Murnaghan方程相比，改进后的方程在从平衡态到显著更高压力的范围内，均能可靠复现计算数据；在拟合实验数据方面，改进方程在所展示的例子中至少不逊于Vinet、Birch-Murnaghan和Mao等其他已知方程。
AI.conclusion: 提出的改进Murnaghan方程是一种简单有效的手段，可显著扩展原方程在高压下的可靠应用域，为固体状态方程的实用拟合提供了更优选择。文中还讨论了拟合过程的若干方面以及以不同形式推导该状态方程的替代方法。

title: Spontaneous counterflow in rotating supersolids
summary: Rotating supersolids challenge the conventional notion of superfluid flow: quantized vortices coexist with crystalline order arising from the system's intrinsic density modulation. Drawing on concepts developed in the context of superfluid helium, this seemingly paradoxical state is often described phenomenologically in terms of a dual response, combining superfluid flow with rigid-body-like motion. Here we show that these apparently distinct behaviors emerge from a single microscopic velocity field, globally constrained by irrotationality. By applying a Helmholtz decomposition, we disentangle a divergence-free incompressible component, which carries vortex circulation, from a curl-free compressible component generated by the intrinsic density modulation. In absence of vortices, the response is entirely encoded in the compressible field: the droplets co-rotate with the external drive, while the interstitial fluid develops an oppositely directed counterflow that preserves vanishing circulation. Above the vortex nucleation threshold, the incompressible component carries the usual quantized circulation, whereas the compressible field counteracts the vortex-induced angular momentum, reducing the total jump with respect to an unmodulated condensate. Our results recast supersolid rotation in terms of a flow-counterflow response, providing a microscopic interpretation of the phenomenological rigid/superfluid partitioning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过亥姆霍兹分解（Helmholtz decomposition），证明旋转超固体（rotating supersolid）中看似矛盾的超流与刚体式运动源自同一微观速度场，并由此将唯象的刚性/超流双重响应重新表述为流动-逆流（flow-counterflow）机制。
AI.motivation: 旋转超固体中量子涡旋与固有密度调制产生的晶格序共存，挑战了传统超流体流动的常规概念。已有研究常借鉴超流氦中的概念，从现象学上将这种看似矛盾的状态描述为超流流动与刚体式运动的双重响应，但缺乏统一的微观解释。
AI.method: 作者证明这些看似不同的行为源于一个全局受不可旋性（irrotationality）约束的单一微观速度场。通过应用亥姆霍兹分解，将系统分解为携带涡旋环流的无散不可压缩（incompressible）分量，以及由固有密度调制产生的无旋可压缩（compressible）分量。
AI.result: 在无涡旋时，响应完全体现在可压缩场中：液滴与外部驱动同向旋转，而间隙流体形成反向逆流以保持环流为零。在涡旋成核阈值之上，不可压缩分量携带常规量子化环流，而可压缩场则抵消涡旋引起的角动量，使总跳变小于无调制凝聚体的情形。
AI.conclusion: 研究将超固体旋转重新表述为流动-逆流响应，为唯象的刚性/超流划分提供了微观解释，表明量子化的环流涡旋与固体的类刚体运动并非互不相容，而是统一微观速度场在不同分量上的体现。

title: Quantifying thermal and driven magnon populations with femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy
summary: Precise knowledge of the total number of magnons, including both coherent and incoherent (e.g. thermal) excitations, is imperative for the advancement of fundamental spin-wave physics and the development of next-generation magnonic devices. In particular, quantifying magnons is key to understanding magnon transport phenomena, the nonlinear regime, or ultrafast magnetization dynamics. Typically, incoherent magnons are accessed by frequency-domain techniques, which lack the temporal resolution required for ultrafast processes, while ultrafast time-domain methods are generally sensitive only to the coherent dynamics. In this work, we demonstrate that femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy enables a fully quantitative, time-domain measurement of both thermal and coherently excited magnon modes in bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet driven by a free-running microwave. We model the experimental data and extract the magnon number by simulating the magnon band structure of the sample, the magneto-optical response function, and the optical spot size used in the experiment. Our analysis establishes a connection between magnon mode calculations and experimentally accessible magnetic properties and fiducially reproduces the waveform and amplitude of the magneto-optical correlation signal for different experimental conditions. These results open a new pathway towards the optical tomography of magnon modes in non-linear or non-equilibrium conditions and can be readily extended to study ultrafast incoherent dynamics in other condensed matter systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明飞秒噪声相关光谱学（femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy）能够对自由运行微波驱动下铋取代钇铁石榴石（bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet）样品中热激发和相干激发的磁振子（magnon）模式进行完全定量的时域测量，并通过模拟磁振子能带结构、磁光响应函数和光斑尺寸来提取磁振子数量。
AI.motivation: 精确知道磁振子总数（包括相干和非相干/热激发）对基础自旋波物理和下一代磁振子器件的发展至关重要，但现有频域技术缺乏超快时间分辨率，而超快时域方法通常只对相干动力学敏感，缺乏一种能够同时在时域量化非相干磁振子的手段。
AI.method: 采用飞秒噪声相关光谱学对磁振子系统进行时域测量，同时获取热激发和相干激发磁振子的信号；通过模拟样品的磁振子能带结构、磁光响应函数以及实验中使用的光学光斑尺寸来建模实验数据，从中提取磁振子数量。
AI.result: 该分析建立了磁振子模式计算与实验可测量磁性质之间的连接，并在不同实验条件下可靠再现了磁光相关信号的波形和振幅，实现了对磁振子数目的定量提取。
AI.conclusion: 本工作开辟了在非线性或非平衡条件下对磁振子模式进行光学断层成像的新途径，该方法可轻松推广至其他凝聚态系统中超快非相干动力学的研究。

title: Layer-Dependent Phonons, Excitons, and Magneto-Optical Phenomena in CrSBr: A Mini Review
summary: Two-dimensional layered magnetic materials offer a versatile platform for exploring low-dimensional magnetism and coupled many-body interactions in these materials. Chromium sulfur bromide (CrSBr) is a promising candidate for advanced spintronic and optoelectronic applications because of its intrinsic air stability, semiconducting nature, strong in-plane anisotropy, and A-type antiferromagnetic ordering. This review summarizes recent advances in the understanding of the layer-dependent vibrational and excitonic properties of CrSBr, as well as its magneto-optical response, from bulk crystals to the monolayer limit. We examined its crystal structure, magnetic anisotropy, and interlayer spin reorientation, followed by insights into vibrational dynamics and spin-phonon coupling. Particular emphasis is placed on the excitonic landscape, including magnetic-field-sensitive photoluminescence, localized excitonic states, and the coexistence of Frenkel- and Wannier-Mott excitons in the bandgap. Finally, we discuss the challenges and prospects of harnessing the unique layer-dependent properties of CrSBr in spintronic, magneto-optical, and quantum photonic technologies.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统梳理了二维层状磁性材料CrSBr从体材料到单层极限的层数依赖振动与激子性质及磁光响应研究进展，涵盖晶体结构、磁各向异性、层间自旋重取向、自旋-声子耦合以及激子光致发光等核心议题，并展望了其在自旋电子学、磁光学和量子光子技术中的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 二维层状磁性材料为探索低维磁性及相关多体相互作用提供了通用平台。CrSBr因具备本征空气稳定性、半导体特性、强面内各向异性和A型反铁磁有序等优势，是推动先进自旋电子学（spintronics）和光电子（optoelectronic）应用的潜力候选材料，系统评估其层数依赖属性对理性设计具有重要意义。
AI.method: 本文采用文献综述的研究方法，对CrSBr研究中的晶体结构与磁各向异性、层间自旋重取向（interlayer spin reorientation）、振动动力学与自旋-声子耦合（spin-phonon coupling）实验结果进行归纳整理，并重点围绕激子景观展开分析，包括磁场敏感的光致发光（photoluminescence）、局域激子态以及带隙中Frenkel与Wannier-Mott激子的共存现象。
AI.result: 综述发现CrSBr在从体材料到单层极限的过程中展现出显著层数依赖的振动和激子行为，其磁光响应涵盖磁灵敏发光与多类型激子共存等丰富物理现象。这一系列发现揭示了层数调控对CrSBr激发态物理的深层影响。
AI.conclusion: 利用CrSBr独特的层数依赖属性，有望在自旋电子学、磁光学（magneto-optics）和量子光子（quantum photonic）技术领域实现突破；同时这些应用方向的落地仍面临诸多挑战，需进一步探索。

title: Charge-spin conversion in altermagnets: electronic anisotropy versus magnon-mediated spin drag
summary:
Altermagnets acquire a momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization or spin-orbit coupling.
  This raises the question of whether the transport anisotropy originates in the electrons or the magnons, and whether the magnon-mediated channel distinguishes an altermagnet from a conventional antiferromagnet.
  We compute the spin-resolved conductivity of a metallic ferromagnet, antiferromagnet, and altermagnet within a common model, treating the spin-diagonal channel with the magnon self-energy and the spin-flip channel to leading order in the electron-magnon coupling.
  The anisotropy of the charge-spin conversion is dominated by the electronic spin splitting, the magnon branches contributing only marginally.
  The magnon-mediated spin-flip channel is even under $C_{4}$, so it carries no signature at first order in the anisotropy and cannot on its own distinguish an altermagnet from a conventional antiferromagnet.
  It does, however, respond linearly to a sublattice-selective perturbation that lowers the bulk $B_{1g}$ symmetry.
  The resulting susceptibility vanishes identically in the antiferromagnet, is small in the ferromagnet, and is finite in the altermagnet, where the electronic anisotropy ties spin and sublattice together, so that among magnets with no net magnetization it is unique to altermagnetic order.
  Being even in the magnetic domain index, this response can be measured without preparing a single magnetic-domain sample.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个统一模型中计算了金属铁磁体（ferromagnet）、反铁磁体（antiferromagnet）和交错磁体（altermagnet）的自旋分辨电导率，发现电荷-自旋转换的各向异性主要由电子自旋劈裂主导，而磁振子介导的自旋翻转通道本身无法区分交错磁体与传统反铁磁体，但该通道对降低体B1g对称性的亚晶格选择性微扰产生线性响应，其磁化率在交错磁体中有限且为唯一的净磁化无序磁体中独有特征，且该响应在磁畴指标下为偶函数，无需制备单畴样品即可测量。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体在无净磁化和自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit coupling）的情况下具有动量依赖的自旋劈裂。作者旨在探究这种输运各向异性究竟来源于电子还是磁振子（magnon），以及磁振子介导通道能否将交错磁体与传统反铁磁体区分开来。
AI.method: 作者在统一的微观模型框架下计算了金属铁磁体、反铁磁体和交错磁体的自旋分辨电导率。其中，自旋对角通道采用磁振子自能（magnon self-energy）来处理，自旋翻转（spin-flip）通道则计至电子-磁振子耦合的首阶。
AI.result: 电荷-自旋转换（charge-spin conversion）的各向异性主要由电子自旋劈裂主导，磁振子分支贡献很小。磁振子介导的自旋翻转通道在C4对称操作下为偶，因此在一阶各向异性中不携带信号，无法单独区分交错磁体与传统反铁磁体。然而，该通道对降低体B1g对称性的亚晶格选择性微扰呈线性响应：该磁化率在反铁磁体中恒为零、在铁磁体中很小、在交错磁体中为有限值。
AI.conclusion: 由于电子各向异性在交错磁体中将自旋与亚晶格耦合在一起，该回应的磁化率在无净磁化的磁体中为交错磁序所独有。该响应在磁畴指标（magnetic domain index）下为偶函数，因此无需制备单磁畴样品即可实验测量。

title: Direct Realization of Near-Ideal Carbyne in Ultrathin Boron Nitride Nanotubes
summary: Carbyne, the sp-hybridized one-dimensional allotrope of carbon, is predicted to be the stiffest known material, with electronic and optical properties set by a single structural parameter, the bond length alternation. However, its intrinsic properties have never been measured: chains synthesized through molecular chemistry carry endgroup and finite-length perturbations that persist even in the longest molecules available, while chains grown inside carbon nanotubes strongly couple to the host, which renormalizes their vibrational frequency by up to 110 cm$^{-1}$ in a diameter-dependent manner. Here, we show that encapsulating and thermally converting hydrogen-capped polyynes inside ultrathin boron nitride nanotubes, structural analogues of carbon nanotubes but electrically insulating, yields carbyne chains in a near-ideal regime, where endgroup, finite length, and host-guest perturbations are reduced to secondary effects. Statistical Raman spectroscopy across 245 locations returns a vibrational frequency distribution an order of magnitude narrower than in carbon nanotubes, an anharmonicity consistent with the universal law for carbyne-like materials, and a bond length alternation matching correlated calculations for the free chain. No photoluminescence is detected, despite the transparent host, as expected for the dipole-forbidden emission of an unperturbed carbyne chain. Boron nitride nanotubes give experimental access to carbyne in its near-ideal form.

AI.tldr: 通过在超薄氮化硼纳米管（boron nitride nanotube, BNNT）内封装并热转化氢封端多炔（hydrogen-capped polyyne），首次在近理想（near-ideal）状态下制备并表征了卡拜（carbyne）链，消除了此前碳纳米管宿主及端基、有限长度等扰动因素，并通过统计拉曼光谱（statistical Raman spectroscopy）验证了其振动频率、非谐性和键长交替（bond length alternation）与自由链理论预测一致。
AI.motivation: 卡拜是sp杂化的一维碳同素异形体，理论上预测为最刚性的已知材料，但其本征性质从未被直接测量。先前通过分子化学合成的链受端基和有限长度扰动影响，而在碳纳米管内生长的链又与宿主强烈耦合，使振动频率发生高达110 cm⁻¹的直径依赖的重整化（renormalization），因而无法获得无扰动的本征测量。
AI.method: 将氢封端多炔封装进超薄氮化硼纳米管中并进行热转化生成卡拜链，利用氮化硼管的电绝缘性消除了宿主电子耦合扰动。随后在245个位置进行统计拉曼光谱测量，分析振动频率分布、非谐性（anharmonicity）和键长交替参数，并与相关计算方法（correlated calculations）的自由链预测进行对比检验。
AI.result: 统计拉曼光谱结果表明：振动频率分布宽度比碳纳米管宿主体系窄一个数量级；测量得到的非谐性与卡拜类材料的普适定律（universal law）一致；键长交替结果与自由链的相关计算预测吻合。此外，尽管宿主是透明的，仍未探测到光致发光（photoluminescence），符合未扰动的卡拜链偶极禁戒（dipole-forbidden）发射的预期。
AI.conclusion: 氮化硼纳米管内实现了卡拜的近理想形态实验观测，使端基、有限长度和宿主-客体扰动均降为次要效应，为系统研究这一一维材料的本征电子和光学性质提供了可行的实验平台。

title: Graph neural networks and the energetic cavity method for combinatorial optimization
summary: We study the use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for finding approximate ground states of Ising models. Efficiently finding these ground states is of broad significance because many combinatorial optimization problems can be formulated as an Ising model with the appropriate choice of couplings and fields. Exactly solving these problems is hard but there are many good heuristic methods. A lineage of these heuristics build from mean-field approximations: one approach uses the leading eigenvector of an appropriately defined matrix, another is the min-sum algorithm, also known as the energetic cavity method. Without modification, GNNs perform worse than both of these methods. We consider small modifications to the GNN to incorporate these heuristics and find that this considerably improves performance. While the modified approach is competitive against other deep-learning approaches, we still find that simulated annealing is reliably at least as good as deep learning methods for the same computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图神经网络（graph neural networks, GNNs）在Ising模型近似基态求解中的应用，发现未经改进的GNN性能劣于传统均值场启发式方法，但通过融入这些启发式算法的小幅修改可显著提升性能；尽管如此，模拟退火（simulated annealing）在同等计算成本下仍至少与深度学习方法相当。
AI.motivation: Ising模型基态的有效求解具有广泛意义，因为许多组合优化问题都可以通过适当选择耦合与场（couplings and fields）转化为Ising模型形式；精确求解是NP难的，因而需要研究更优的启发式方法，包括基于深度学习的方法。
AI.method: 首先评估标准GNN在Ising模型基态求解上的表现，并与两类基于均值场（mean-field）的启发式方法——即利用合适矩阵的主导特征向量方法以及min-sum算法（又称能量空穴方法，energetic cavity method）——进行对比；随后对GNN架构进行小幅修改以整合这些启发式信息，并比较改进后的深度学习方法与模拟退火（simulated annealing）在同等计算成本下的表现。
AI.result: 未修改的GNN性能劣于上述两种均值场启发式方法；将启发式方法融入GNN的小幅修改可显著提升性能，使改进方法与其他深度学习方法具有竞争力；然而，模拟退火在相同计算成本下被证实至少与深度学习方法同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 将启发式算法整合进GNN架构可以改善其求解Ising模型基态的能力，但在当前设置下，深度学习方法的性能并未超越模拟退火这一经典启发式方法。

title: Benchmarking Universal Machine Learning Force Fields for Crystal Structure Prediction of High-Energy Molecular Systems
summary: Recent developments of universal machine learning interatomic potentials (UMLIPs) offer a fast route for screening molecular crystals based on geometry relaxation and energy ranking, but their reliability across chemically diverse energetic materials remains elusive. In particular, it is unclear whether or not these UMLIPs are over-sensitive to break the desired molecular connectivity for relaxing the periodic crystals. Herein we tested the hypothesis that classical force-field pre-relaxation can provide a more suitable starting geometry for subsequent UMLIP relaxation on a large database of high energy molecular crystals. Three models (MACE, MACE-OFF and UMA) in conjunction with the General Amber Force Field (GAFF) were applied to test this hypothesis. Among them, direct MACE-OFF and UMA showed very high relaxation success and preserved the reference geometries most closely, but they still exhibit failures for some rare cases. Using GAFF pre-relaxation can systematically reduce the number of failed relaxations with lower computational costs. Our comparative failure and robustness analyses revealed distinct trade-offs among the evaluated models. Among them, MACE-OFF achieves a better compromise between potential energy surface smoothness, structural fidelity, and stress convergence, serving as a good choice to provide a reliable foundation for automated structural optimization.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了"经典力场预弛豫可为通用机器学习原子间势（UMLIP）提供更合适初始几何构型"的假设，在大型高能分子晶体数据库上系统比较了MACE、MACE-OFF和UMA三种模型与GAFF力场预弛豫的组合效果，发现GAFF预弛豫可系统性地减少弛豫失败案例并降低计算成本，其中MACE-OFF在势能面平滑性、结构保真度和应力收敛之间取得了最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine learning interatomic potentials, UMLIP）虽为分子晶体的几何弛豫和能量排序提供了快速筛选途径，但其在化学多样性能材料中的可靠性尚不明确，特别是这些UMLIP在周期性晶体弛豫过程中是否过度敏感而破坏目标分子连接性仍有待验证。
AI.method: 在大规模高能分子晶体数据库上检验"经典力场预弛豫可为后续UMLIP弛豫提供更合适起始几何构型"的假设，结合通用琥珀力场（General Amber Force Field, GAFF）分别测试了MACE、MACE-OFF和UMA三种UMLIP模型的弛豫表现，并对失败案例与鲁棒性进行了比较分析。
AI.result: 直接使用MACE-OFF和UMA虽表现出极高的弛豫成功率并与参考几何保持高度一致，但在少数罕见案例中仍存在失败；采用GAFF预弛豫可在较低计算成本下系统性地减少弛豫失败次数。MACE-OFF在势能面平滑性、结构保真度与应力收敛之间实现了更好的折衷。
AI.conclusion: GAFF预弛豫策略能有效增强UMLIP在含能分子晶体弛豫中的可靠性，其中MACE-OFF因在多个评价维度上表现均衡，可作为自动化结构优化的可靠基础模型。

title: Exact Hamiltonian Dynamics of Rare Events in Active Matter
summary: Active systems navigate complex environments through non-equilibrium fluctuations, rendering standard equilibrium transition-rate theories inadequate. Moreover, transition rates provide only partial information on how non-equilibrium dynamics explore metastable states, whereas knowledge of the optimal paths offers deeper physical insight. Using an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle as a paradigmatic model, i.e., a stochastic dynamics driven by exponentially correlated noise, we establish an exact mapping of the non-Markovian optimal path onto a higher-dimensional Hamiltonian dynamical system so that, for arbitrary force fields, optimal paths can be computed systematically by solving the corresponding Hamilton equations. Tuning the conserved energy allows us to explore diverse dynamical regimes: ranging from classical instanton trajectories strictly confined to the zero-energy surface, to closed periodic orbits that emerge only at non-zero energies, representing a distinct signature of the non-Markovian active dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文以活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子为范例，将非马尔可夫最优路径精确映射为高维哈密顿动力系统，从而通过求解哈密顿方程系统性地计算任意力场下的最优路径，并揭示了不同能量面所对应的多样化动力学行为。
AI.motivation: 活性系统通过非平衡涨落（non-equilibrium fluctuations）导航复杂环境，使得标准平衡态跃迁速率理论不再适用；此外，跃迁速率仅能提供部分信息，无法揭示非平衡动力学如何探索亚稳态的全貌，而最优路径信息能提供更深刻的物理洞察。
AI.method: 以活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子（active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle）作为范式模型，该模型由指数相关噪声驱动的随机动力学描述；作者建立了非马尔可夫最优路径到高维哈密顿动力系统的精确映射，将最优路径计算转化为求解哈密顿正则方程的问题。
AI.result: 该方法适用于任意力场，能够系统性地计算最优路径；通过调节守恒能量，可探索多种动力学区域，涵盖严格限制在零能面上的经典瞬子轨迹（instanton trajectories），以及仅在非零能量下出现的闭合周期轨道，后者是非马尔可夫活性动力学的独特标志。
AI.conclusion: 哈密顿动力学框架为理解活性系统的最优路径提供了一个统一且可计算的理论工具，能量调控则揭示了非马尔可夫活性动力学中超越经典瞬子图像的丰富行为。

title: Nearly Isotropic Vortex Solid in $\mathbf{(La,Pr)_{3}Ni_{2}O_{7}}$ Thin Films
summary: The discovery of superconductivity in bulk bilayer nickelates has established a new platform for exploring high-$T_c$ superconductivity beyond the cuprates. The role of the Ni $3d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band in the superconductivity of bilayer nickelates remains unresolved. By performing simultaneous resistance and diamagnetism measurements on (La,Pr)$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ thin films, we map the vortex melting phase diagram for both in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields. For $H\parallel c$, the geometric confinement effect gives rise to pancake vortices. Remarkably, the anisotropy parameter of the vortex melting field $γ_{H_m} \equiv H_m^{ab}/H_m^c$ decreases monotonically with decreasing temperature and approaches unity at low temperatures. Within the anisotropic Ginzburg--Landau scaling, $H_m^{ab}/H_m^c = \sqrt{ρ_s^{ab}/ρ_s^c}$ tracks the superfluid-density anisotropy. Such a vortex solid implies a nearly isotropic superfluid density, which is irreconcilable with the strictly two-dimensional $3d_{x^2-y^2}$-derived bands, but naturally explained by a substantial interlayer superfluid contribution from the $3d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band. Our results provide thermodynamic evidence for a substantial contribution of the $γ$ band to superconductivity in bilayer nickelate thin films.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对(L a,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜同时测量电阻与抗磁信号，绘制了面内及面外磁场下的涡旋熔化相图（vortex melting phase diagram）。研究发现涡旋熔化场各向异性参数γ_Hm随温度降低而单调减小并趋近于1，表明超流密度近乎各向同性，为γ带（由Ni 3dz²轨道衍生）对双层镍酸盐超导性存在实质性贡献提供了热力学证据。
AI.motivation: 块体双层镍酸盐中超导性的发现建立了一个超越铜氧化物（cuprates）的高温超导新平台，然而由Ni 3d_{z^2}轨道衍生的γ带在双层镍酸盐超导性中扮演的角色仍不清楚，亟需实验证据予以解析。
AI.method: 作者在(L a,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜上同时进行电阻（resistance）与抗磁性（diamagnetism）测量，针对面内（in-plane）与面外（out-of-plane）磁场分别映射涡旋熔化相图，并利用各向异性Ginzburg–Landau标度关系将涡旋熔化场各向异性与超流密度各向异性相关联。
AI.result: 对于H∥c方向磁场，几何限制效应产生饼状涡旋（pancake vortices）；涡旋熔化场各向异性参数γ_Hm随温度降低单调减小并在低温下趋近于1，即H_m^{ab}/H_m^c = √(ρ_s^{ab}/ρ_s^c)反映超流密度各向异性近乎各向同性。这一结果与严格二维的3d_{x²-y²}衍生能带预期不相容。
AI.conclusion: 各向同性的涡旋固态表明3d_{z²}衍生γ带提供了可观的层间超流贡献，从而自然解释了实验结果。该研究为γ带在双层镍酸盐薄膜超导性中的实质性作用提供了热力学层面的直接证据。

title: Doping-controlled topological superconducting transition in misfit layer compounds
summary: Achieving topological superconductivity is a key goal in quantum physics, offering a path to fault-tolerant quantum computers. A central challenge in this field is to continuously drive a material through a topological quantum phase transition to directly observe the evolution from trivial to topological superconductivity. However, finding a robust platform that allows such extreme and precise tuning remains a challenge. Here, we demonstrate a doping-controlled phase transition from a conventional to a topological superconducting state in the bulk misfit layer compound (LaxPb1-xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2. We reveal a non-monotonic phase diagram characterized by two distinct superconducting regimes separated by a non-superconducting phase at a precise doping. In the highly doped regime, the superconducting phase becomes remarkably sensitive to non-magnetic disorder, and orientation-selective in-gap modes emerge at atomic step edges. Supported by Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations, these emergent spatial signatures are consistent with a time-reversal-symmetric crystalline-topological order parameter. Our results establish misfit compounds as a platform to engineering topological superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究在块体失配层状化合物（LaxPb1-xSe）1.14（NbSe2）2中，通过掺杂控制实现了从常规超导态到拓扑超导态（topological superconductivity）的相变，并在高掺杂区间观测到与时间反演对称晶体拓扑序参量一致的空间特征。
AI.motivation: 实现拓扑超导是量子物理中的关键目标，其可为容错量子计算机提供实现路径。领域内的核心挑战在于如何持续驱动材料穿越拓扑量子相变（topological quantum phase transition），直接观察从常规到拓扑超导态的演化过程，但当前缺乏能够实现这种极端且精确调控的稳健平台。
AI.method: 通过在块体失配层状化合物（LaxPb1-xSe）1.14（NbSe2）2中进行掺杂控制来驱动相变；结合非磁性无序敏感性测试、原子台阶边缘的取向选择性隙内模观测，以及Bogoliubov-de Gennes计算进行数值验证。
AI.result: 揭示了非单调相图，表现出两个截然不同的超导区域，并被一个在精确掺杂下的非超导相所分隔。在高掺杂区域，超导相对非磁性无序极为敏感，且在原子台阶边缘出现了取向选择性的隙内模；Bogoliubov-de Gennes计算结果支持这些空间特征与时间反演对称晶体拓扑序参量（time-reversal-symmetric crystalline-topological order parameter）一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果确立了失配层状化合物作为工程化拓扑超导的平台，为连续调控并直接观察从常规到拓扑超导态的量子相变提供了可行途径。

title: Interference-controlled magnetic bound states and subgap transport in a Square--octagon superconductor
summary: The square--octagon lattice provides a useful setting for studying magnetic adatoms because its multisublattice structure allows different adsorption geometries to probe distinct combinations of the host electronic states. We study magnetic adatoms in an $s$-wave superconducting square--octagon lattice, focusing on the interplay between adsorption geometry, narrow and flat-band states, and subgap transport. We find that the large spectral weight associated with a flat band does not necessarily imply strong impurity--host coupling. For symmetric square-hollow adsorption, destructive interference strongly suppresses the overlap with the flat-band manifold, whereas top and octagon-hollow adsorption retain substantial overlap. This selectivity is reflected in the magnetic bound states, with the square-hollow channel supporting a predominantly atomic state, while the top and octagon-hollow states are strongly hybridized with the superconducting host. The effect develops continuously as the relevant band becomes flatter and remains pronounced in a material-motivated parameter regime. In a normal--superconductor--normal geometry, these differences are also reflected in the nonlocal subgap conductance. At a representative exchange splitting, square-hollow adsorption suppresses the low-bias conductance relative to the clean device, whereas octagon-hollow adsorption enhances it, with the square-hollow response showing a much sharper dependence on exchange splitting. Our results show that the magnetic-adatom response in narrow and flat-band superconductors is governed by the available spectral weight and by the symmetry and wave-function structure of the impurity--host hybridization.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨s波超导方八角晶格中磁性吸附原子（magnetic adatom）的吸附几何、窄带/平带态与间隙下输运之间的相互作用，发现平带大谱重并不必然导致强杂质-宿主耦合，对称方孔吸附因相消干涉抑制与平带流形的重叠，而顶点和八角孔吸附保留显著重叠，这种选择性在磁束缚态和非局域间隙电导中均有体现。
AI.motivation: 方八角晶格的多子格结构使不同吸附几何能够探测宿主电子态的不同组合，为研究磁性吸附原子提供了有效平台；理解平带态中杂质-宿主耦合的机制对于窄带及平带超导体中的磁性响应具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在s波超导方八角晶格（square-octagon lattice）中数值研究磁性吸附原子的不同吸附位点（方孔、顶点、八角孔），分析其谱重叠、磁束缚态性质以及正常-超导-正常（normal-superconductor-normal）结中的非局域间隙电导。
AI.result: 平带所伴随的大谱重并不必然导致强杂质-宿主耦合：方孔吸附因相消干涉被强烈抑制与平带流形的重叠，而顶点和八角孔吸附保持显著重叠。方孔通道支持以原子态为主的磁束缚态，后两者则与超导宿主强杂化。该效应随相关能带变平而连续发展，并在类材料参数区依然显著；在输运中，方孔吸附抑制低偏压电导而八角孔吸附增强之，且方孔响应对交换劈裂的依赖更尖锐。
AI.conclusion: 窄带和平带超导体中磁性吸附原子的响应由可获得的谱重以及杂质-宿主杂化的对称性与波函数结构共同决定。

title: Switchable Altermagnetism in a Layered van der Waals Metal-Organic Framework Driven by Spin-Crossover
summary: Dynamical control of altermagnetism is a key requirement for translating its unique spin-dependent functionalities into practical spintronic devices, yet effective switching mechanisms remain largely unexplored. Here, we open an unprecedented, versatile and programmable route based on spin-crossover to switch altermagnetism on demand in molecular materials. Using density functional calculations, we demonstrate an altermagnetic ground state in the layered van der Waals MOFs MnX$_2$(tdz)$_2$ (X = Cl, Br; tdz = thiadiazole), stabilized by anisotropic interlayer exchange interactions, which gives rise to a characteristic d-wave momentum-space spin splitting and an associated spin-splitter transport response. Our findings reveal that under hydrostatic pressure, a high-spin to low-spin transition reconfigures the Mn d-orbital occupation, thus modifying the magnetic exchange network, and stabilizing a different antiferromagnetic ground state whose symmetry suppresses the nonrelativistic spin splitting. Crucially, spin-crossover switches altermagnetism not by directly altering the electronic structure, but by changing the symmetry of the magnetic ground state. These results establish molecular spin-crossover altermagnets as a platform for externally reconfigurable spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于密度泛函计算，提出一种通过自旋交叉（spin-crossover）机制动态调控交错磁性（altermagnetism）的新策略，在层状范德华MOF材料MnX₂(tdz)₂（X=Cl, Br）中实现交错磁性开关，为可重构自旋电子器件开辟了新平台。
AI.motivation: 交错磁性向实际自旋电子器件（spintronic devices）转化需要有效的动态调控手段，但目前的开关机制研究仍严重缺乏。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函计算（density functional calculations），系统研究了层状范德华金属有机框架（van der Waals MOF）MnX₂(tdz)₂（X = Cl, Br；tdz = 噻二唑）的电子结构与磁性；通过计算静水压作用下高自旋（high-spin）到低自旋（low-spin）转变过程中Mn d轨道占据数的重构，分析磁性交换网络的改变及其对基态对称性的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现该材料存在稳定的交错磁基态，由各向异性层间交换相互作用（anisotropic interlayer exchange interactions）稳定，并伴随特征性的d波动量空间自旋劈裂（d-wave momentum-space spin splitting）及相应的自旋劈裂输运响应；静水压下高自旋到低自旋转变能够将交错磁基态重构为另一种反铁磁（antiferromagnetic）基态，该基态的对称性抑制了非相对论自旋劈裂（nonrelativistic spin splitting）。
AI.conclusion: 自旋交叉并非通过直接改变电子结构来开关交错磁性，而是通过改变磁性基态的对称性实现调控；这一机制将分子自旋交叉交错磁体（molecular spin-crossover altermagnets）确立为外部可重构自旋电子器件的平台。

title: Raman signatures of a non-reciprocal magnetic phase transition in Ca$_2$RuO$_4$
summary: The magnetic behavior of Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ represents a unique puzzle due to the interplay of strong electronic correlations, magneto-elastic interactions, and large spin-orbit coupling. At low temperatures, an anomalous Mott insulating state emerges, characterized by a complex antiferromagnetic order with a collective amplitude excitation of the magnetic moment which has been discussed in analogy with the Higgs mode. We report here evidence of a magnetic first-order phase transition driven by an out-of-plane magnetic field along the crystallographic $c$-axis of Ca$_2$RuO$_4$. Raman measurements in magnetic field reveal the emergence of mode of magnetic origin and a concomitant modification of the coupling between a phonon and the Higgs amplitude mode. Both the Raman features are characterized by a non-reciprocal hysteresis in magnetic field. Surprisingly, the observed phase transition does not affect the Raman scattering from the in-plane magnons, indicating that the dipolar antiferromagnetic order is preserved. This is consistent with the onset of a new quadrupolar field-controlled state, whose fluctuations structure can trigger an hybridization between the lattice and the magnetic Higgs mode resulting in the observed Raman features.

AI.tldr: 本研究报告了Ca₂RuO₄中由沿晶体c轴的外场磁场驱动的磁性一级相变，通过拉曼（Raman）测量揭示了磁起源模式的出现以及声子与Higgs振幅模式耦合的改变，两者均表现出非互易磁滞特征，表明一个新的四极子场控态的形成。
AI.motivation: Ca₂RuO₄的磁性行为因其强电子关联、磁弹性相互作用与大自旋轨道耦合的交织而构成独特难题；低温下其反常Mott绝缘态具有复杂反铁磁序及与Higgs模式类比讨论的集体振幅激发，需要深入理解其在外磁场下的相变行为。
AI.method: 采用拉曼散射（Raman scattering）光谱测量，在沿晶体学c轴方向施加的面外磁场下，对Ca₂RuO₄样品进行系统的光谱表征，观察磁场扫描过程中的模式演化与耦合变化。
AI.result: 磁场下拉曼测量揭示了磁起源模式的出现以及声子与Higgs振幅模式耦合的伴随性改变；两种拉曼特征均表现出非互易磁滞现象。值得注意的是，该相变不影响面内磁振子的拉曼散射，表明偶极反铁磁序得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的相变与一个新型四极子场控态的建立相一致，该态的涨落结构可触发晶格与磁Higgs模式之间的杂化，从而产生所观察到的拉曼特征。

title: Aggressive Phase Separation in Dense Mixtures of Passive and Active Particles
summary: Using Vicsek-like self-propulsion rule, we study kinetics of liquid-liquid phase separation in mixtures of passive and active particles. For evolutions following temperature quenches of homogeneous configurations to the immiscible region of the phase diagram, we identify a remarkably strong dependence of the domain growth exponent on the choice of final state point. The singular dependence is indicative of the possibility of even an exponentially fast growth for suitable choices of system parameters. This striking observation, supported by finite-size scaling and other advanced analyses, is despite the fact that the overall mixture density is quite high that risks congestion with the prospect of slowing down particle transport. From flocking in pure biological systems to robotic swarming, these results are of much practical relevance. Theoretical pictures suitable for interpreting such high growth rates are discussed. In this regard, we discuss coarsening in the velocity field as well that describes how the density field coarsening follows the latter.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用类似Vicsek的自推进（self-propulsion）规则，数值研究了被动与活性粒子混合物中的液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）动力学，发现畴增长指数（domain growth exponent）对终态相图点的选取表现出极其强烈的依赖，甚至在适当条件下可能出现指数级快速增长。
AI.motivation: 活性物质（active matter）中相分离的粗化动力学（coarsening dynamics）在生物和人工系统中具有重要意义，但高密度条件下的相分离过程及其与粒子输运的关系尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 采用类似Vicsek的自推进规则，对由被动和活性粒子组成的混合物体系进行温度淬火（temperature quench）数值模拟，将均匀初始构型淬火到相图的不混溶区域，并结合有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）及其他高级分析方法探究畴增长行为。
AI.result: 发现畴增长指数对最终状态点的选取呈现显著依赖，在合适的系统参数下甚至可能出现指数级快速增长；尽管整体混合密度很高且存在粒子输运减缓的风险，这一现象仍被有限尺寸标度等分析所支持。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明高增长率在被动-活性混合系统中可以出现，对从纯生物系统中的群聚行为（flocking）到机器人集群（robotic swarming）等场景具有实际意义；研究还讨论了速度场的粗化过程及其与密度场粗化的演进关系，为解释此类高增长速率提供了理论图景。

title: Encapsulated macroscopic WS$_2$ monolayers enable room-temperature exciton-polariton lattices
summary: Large-area, optically homogeneous monolayer semiconductors are a critical prerequisite for scalable room-temperature polaritonics and for realizing polariton lattices extending across many unit cells. Yet, the small size, optical inhomogeneity, and device-to-device variability of conventional exfoliated flakes have remained major obstacles. Here, we overcome these limitations using 1-dodecanol-encapsulated WS$_2$ monolayers that combine millimeter-scale coverage with remarkably uniform optical properties over lateral distances approaching $300\,$$μ\mathrm{m}$. Integrated into a tunable open microcavity, these monolayers exhibit robust room-temperature exciton-photon strong coupling, evidenced by a pronounced anti-crossing and a Rabi splitting of $\hbar Ω_{\mathrm{R}} \approx 31\,\mathrm{meV}$. Leveraging the exceptional uniformity of this platform, we realize a two-dimensional polaritonic kagome lattice and directly resolve its characteristic band structure. Angle-resolved spectroscopy reveals Dirac dispersive bands together with a weakly dispersive flat-band-like branch within the $s$-band, in good agreement with a linear non-interacting model. Complementary momentum- and real-space imaging further identifies the associated bond-centered and site-centered mode profiles. These results establish large-area WS$_2$ monolayers in open microcavities as a scalable platform for engineering polariton band structures and exploring synthetic quantum materials under ambient conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用1-十二醇包裹的WS₂单层材料实现了毫米级均匀光学特性，并将其集成到可调开放微腔中，在室温下实现了激子-光子强耦合（Rabi劈裂约31 meV），进一步构建二维极化激元kagome晶格并解析其能带结构，为可扩展的室温极化激元器件和多体物理研究提供了平台。
AI.motivation: 大面积、光学均匀的单层半导体是实现可扩展室温极化激元学（polaritonics）及跨多单元极化激元晶格的必要前提。然而，传统机械剥离薄片受限于尺寸小、光学不均匀和设备间差异大等障碍，亟需新的平台突破这些限制。
AI.method: 采用1-十二醇包裹的WS₂单层（1-dodecanol-encapsulated WS₂ monolayers），实现毫米级覆盖和横向距离近300 μm的均匀光学特性；将该材料集成到可调开放微腔（tunable open microcavity）中实现强耦合，并构建二维极化激元kagome晶格，通过角分辨光谱、动量空间与实空间成像等手段表征能带结构和模式分布。
AI.result: 单层材料在室温下展现出明显的反交叉行为与Rabi劈裂ħΩ_R≈31 meV；kagome晶格能带结构中观测到Dirac色散带和s带内弱色散的类平带分支，与线性无相互作用模型高度吻合；互补的动量和实空间成像确认了相应的键中心与格点中心模式分布。
AI.conclusion: 大面积WS₂单层集成于开放微腔中，可作为在环境条件下工程化极化激元能带结构以及探索合成量子材料（synthetic quantum materials）的可扩展平台。

title: Topological Edge States and Collective Radiation in a One-Dimensional Atomic Chain
summary: We investigate the topological and collective radiative properties of a one-dimensional diatomic chain of identical quantum emitters with alternating spacing, coupled to the electromagnetic vacuum. The system realizes an extended, non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-type model with vacuum-mediated long-range interactions and collective dissipation. We focus on the single-excitation manifold, where the dynamics are described by an effective Hamiltonian. For an infinite chain, the complex band structure reveals subradiant modes associated with wave vectors outside the light line, as well as parameter regimes where real-part band crossings occur. The bulk topology is characterized by a complex Berry phase, which remains quantized in the presence of inversion symmetry and a spectral gap. For finite chains, using exact diagonalization, we identify superradiant, subradiant, and edge states with distinct decay rates and spatial profiles. Edge states emerge in the topologically nontrivial regime when a bulk gap in the real part of the energy spectrum is present, while subradiant states exhibit strongly suppressed decay with system-size dependence. Finally, we analyze the far-field radiation patterns associated with different classes of eigenstates and show that the emission characteristics reflect the decay properties, spatial localization, and the parity of the unit-cell amplitudes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一维具有交替间距的双原子链量子发射体与电磁真空耦合的体系，揭示了非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger型模型的复数能带结构、拓扑性质和不同特征态（超辐射态、亚辐射态和边缘态）的辐射特性。
AI.motivation: 为了探索由量子发射体构成的光子结构中拓扑效应与集体辐射现象的结合，本文旨在理解真空介导的长程相互作用和集体耗散如何在非厄米体系中产生非平凡的拓扑性质，以及这些性质如何体现在远场辐射中。
AI.method: 作者将交替间距的双原子链发射体耦合到电磁真空的系统映射为具有真空介导长程相互作用和集体耗散的非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger型扩展模型，在单激发流形下构造等效哈密顿量，对无限链采用复数能带结构分析并结合复数Berry相位刻画体态拓扑，对有限链采用精确对角化方法识别不同类别的本征态。
AI.result: 无限链的复数能带中发现了与光锥外波矢相关的亚辐射模式以及实部能带交叉的参数区域；复数Berry相位在存在反演对称性和谱隙时保持量子化。有限链中识别出具有不同衰减率和空间轮廓的超辐射态、亚辐射态和边缘态；边缘态在实的体带隙存在时出现于拓扑非平凡区域，亚辐射态的抑制随系统尺寸增强。远场辐射图案反映各本征态的衰变、空间局域性和单胞振幅的宇称。
AI.conclusion: 该非厄米拓扑系统能够在单激发流形中实现受拓扑保护的边缘态和与尺寸相关的强抑制亚辐射态，且各本征态的远场辐射特征可作为区分其衰变性质和空间对称性的可观测探针。

title: Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and the Helmholtz Theorem
summary: The recently proposed Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm has not yet been studied in detail from a thermodynamic point of view; this work aims to fill that gap. We demonstrate how thermodynamical state variables and potentials can be derived and thereby demonstrate that the construction of the algorithm formally represents a microcanonical thermodynamic ensemble. In particular, we demonstrate (analytically and numerically) that the algorithm fulfils the Helmholtz theorem, an alternative formulation of the first law of thermodynamics. Furthermore, we construct a new sampling algorithm that extends the original to lower-dimensional inference problems. Finally, we argue that canonical Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithms are more natural than Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo from the thermodynamic and information-theoretic point of view.

AI.tldr: 本文从热力学角度对最近提出的微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛（Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo）算法进行了系统分析，证明了该算法形式上构成一个微正则热力学系综，并验证其满足亥姆霍兹定理；同时构造了适用于低维推断问题的拓展采样算法，并论证了从热力学与信息论角度看，正则马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov Chain Monte Carlo）方法比微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛更为自然。
AI.motivation: 微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛算法在提出后尚未从热力学视角被深入研究，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 通过解析与数值两种途径推导热力学状态变量与势函数，验证算法是否构成微正则热力学系综并满足亥姆霍兹定理；在此基础上构造一种新的采样算法，将原方法拓展至低维推断问题。
AI.result: 解析与数值结果均表明，该算法的构造在形式上表征了一个微正则热力学系综，并满足亥姆霍兹定理（Helmholtz theorem，即热力学第一定律的替代表述）；新构造的采样算法可有效处理低维推断问题。
AI.conclusion: 从热力学与信息论观点来看，正则马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法相较于微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛更具自然性与合理性。

title: General solution of the Dirac equation for electrons bound by a charged atomic chain
summary: The system of electrons bound by a charged atom chain is studied within the Dirac theory. The general analytical solution of the Dirac equation is obtained. Analytical expression for electron energy is derived from which it follows that the principal quantum number can be introduced for electron states in such a system, similar to the case of a hydrogen atom. We prove that electrons bound by the atomic chain, are fully collectivized and the energy can be calculated as a function of the occupation number. The spectral band with the principal quantum number $n$ is shown to be split into $n$ subbands forming the fine structure. The scale of the fine structure splitting is calculated.

AI.tldr: 本文在狄拉克理论（Dirac theory）框架下研究了带电原子链束缚的电子系统，获得了狄拉克方程的解析解和电子能量表达式，证明电子被完全集体化，并揭示了能带按主量子数n分裂为n个精细结构子带的现象。
AI.motivation: 研究带电原子链束缚电子系统的量子性质，探索该系统中是否存在类似于氢原子那样的主量子数结构，以及电子集体化行为对其能谱和精细结构的影响。
AI.method: 采用相对论性狄拉克理论描述电子在带电原子链中的束缚态，通过求解狄拉克方程获得一般解析解，进而推导电子能量的解析表达式并分析其能谱结构。
AI.result: 获得了狄拉克方程的通用解析解；推导了电子能量的解析表达式，表明该系统中可引入与氢原子情形类似的主量子数；证明束缚于原子链的电子被完全集体化，能量可表示为占据数的函数；发现主量子数为n的能带分裂为n个子带，形成精细结构（fine structure），并计算了精细结构分裂的标度。
AI.conclusion: 带电原子链束缚的电子系统在狄拉克理论框架下具有明确的量子化能级结构，其集体化特性与精细结构分裂揭示了该系统独特的物理行为，为后续相关体系的研究提供了理论基础。

title: Metal-Insulator Coexistence and Gap-Crossing Domain-Wall Modes in an Aubry-André Model with Nonlocal Hopping
summary: Nonequilibrium transport remains a central theme in modern physics, spanning from condensed matter to synthetic systems. Here, we investigate particle transport in an extended Aubry-André model with system-scale hopping, namely nonlocal hopping with a range proportional to the system size, and uncover a metal-insulator coexistence regime in real space, where metallic and insulating spatial domains coexist within the same system and are separated by sharp spatial boundaries. In the insulating region, particles exhibit flat-band-like localization in the absence of quasiperiodic potentials, while a quasiperiodic potential induces distinct multi-point localization, different from conventional exponential localization. Meanwhile, particles can freely propagate and tunnel across spatially disconnected metallic domains separated by the insulating region. Beyond this coexistence phase, we identify unconventional gap-crossing domain-wall modes with comb-like spatial profiles that mediate nonlocal, multi-point transport across separated metallic domains. Our findings reveal a rich interplay between localization, nonlocality, and transport in systems with nonlocal hopping.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有系统尺度跳跃（范围与系统大小成比例的跳跃）的扩展Aubry-André模型中的粒子输运，发现实空间中存在金属-绝缘体共存区，并提出具有梳状空间轮廓的非常规跨能隙畴壁模式可介导分离金属域之间的非局域多点输运。
AI.motivation: 非平衡输运是现代物理学（从凝聚态到合成系统）的核心主题，理解具有非局域跳跃的系统中局域化、非局域性与输运之间的相互作用具有基础意义。
AI.method: 通过扩展Aubry-André模型引入系统尺度跳跃（即范围与系统大小成比例的非局域跳跃），在实空间中分析其金属-绝缘体共存、粒子的局域化行为以及畴壁模式的空间结构。
AI.result: 发现了实空间中的金属-绝缘体共存区域（二者被尖锐空间边界分隔）。绝缘区域在无准周期势时呈现类平带局域化，在准周期势下则表现出不同于传统指数局域化的多点局域化；金属域可被绝缘区分隔但粒子仍能自由传播与隧穿。共存相之外还存在具有梳状空间轮廓的跨能隙畴壁模。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了非局域跳跃系统中局域化、非局域性与输运之间丰富的相互作用，并提出了跨域畴壁模式作为介导分离金属域间非局域多点输运的新机制。

title: Exciton Coherence in CsPbBr3 Nanocrystals is Bounded by Phonon-Mediated Bright-Triplet Relaxation
comment: 45 pages including Supplementary information. 4 main text figures, 10 supporting figures, and 2 supporting tables
summary: Scalable sources of indistinguishable single photons or entangled photon pairs are fundamental to many quantum photonic technologies. Colloidal lead halide perovskite nanocrystals are promising such sources, but their exciton coherent properties are not fully understood. We show that in single CsPbBr3 nanocrystals at 4 K, acoustic phonon-mediated exciton fine structure relaxation (EFSR) drives leakage of population between the bright exciton triplet states, competing with the radiative lifetime. The leakage pathway reaches 0.64 $\pm$ 0.04 of the radiative rate, bounding state coherence to 0.81 times the transform limit at 4 K. This pathway is intrinsic to the nanocrystal, not its environment, making it a tractable target for materials and device design. We identify fine structure and acoustic phonon engineering as effective intrinsic routes to higher coherence in perovskite quantum light sources.

AI.tldr: 本文在4 K温度下于单个CsPbBr3胶体钙钛矿纳米晶中揭示了声学声子介导的激子精细结构弛豫（EFSR）机制，该机制驱动亮激子三重态之间的布居泄漏，竞争辐射寿命，并将态相干性限制在变换极限（transform limit）的0.81倍。
AI.motivation: 胶体卤化铅钙钛矿纳米晶是可扩展的不可区分单光子或纠缠光子对光源的有力候选，但其激子相干性质尚未被充分理解，理解这些性质对于量子光子技术至关重要。
AI.method: 在4 K低温下对单个CsPbBr3纳米晶进行实验研究，测量激子精细结构弛豫（EFSR）引发的布居泄漏路径，并将其与辐射寿命进行定量比较。
AI.result: 声学声子介导的精细结构弛豫泄漏路径达到辐射速率的0.64 ± 0.04，将4 K下的态相干性限制为变换极限的0.81倍；该路径为纳米晶内在属性，不依赖于其环境。
AI.conclusion: 该EFSR机制是纳米晶的内在特性而非环境效应，因此可作为材料与器件设计中可操作的优化靶标；精细结构和声学声子工程被识别为提升钙钛矿量子光源相干性的有效内在途径。

title: Where Is the \(p\)-Wave Superfluid? Correlated Phase Diagram of Microwave-Shielded Polar Molecules
summary: Chiral $p_x\!\pm\! i p_y$ superfluidity in fermionic polar molecules offers a direct route to topological quantum matter with non-Abelian excitations, yet the parameter regime in which pairing survives strong correlations and competing instabilities has remained unresolved. Here we determine this regime for microwave-shielded polar molecules. Under tight confinement along the \(z\) direction, the microscopic molecular interaction collapses onto a universal quasi-two-dimensional form specified by an interaction length $σ$, defined as the position of its attractive minimum, and a single dimensionless coupling. We combine Fermi-hypernetted-chain Euler--Lagrange theory with correlated-basis pairing theory, thereby treating the correlation hole, density response, stability of the homogeneous fluid, and $p$-wave pairing within one framework. The largest pairing gap occurs immediately on the stable side of a long-wavelength spinodal instability at a two-dimensional density $4\times10^{-2}/σ^2$. Mapping this universal regime onto microscopic shielding schemes exposes an intrinsic limitation of single-microwave dressing: weakening the attraction to the optimal pairing range simultaneously weakens collisional shielding. Dual-microwave dressing removes this constraint by compensating the long-range attraction while retaining a large repulsive core. Imposing explicit requirements on collisional loss, confinement, and microwave-amplitude stability, we identify the regime of molecular mass and dipole moment favorable for \(p\)-wave superfluidity and determine experimentally realistic microwave and confinement conditions for its realization. These results turn the search for molecular $p$-wave superfluidity into a quantitative optimization problem and define a route toward the topological weak-pairing phase.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了费米极性分子中手性p波（$p_x \pm i p_y$）超流态可存活的参数区间。通过结合费米超网链Euler–Lagrange理论与关联基配对理论，作者发现最大配对能隙出现在长波自旋odal不稳定性的稳定侧，密度约为$4\times10^{-2}/\sigma^2$。单微波缀饰方案存在固有局限，而双微波缀饰可消除此约束，最终将分子p波超流的搜索转化为定量的优化问题，并确定了可行的实验条件。
AI.motivation: 费米极性分子的手性p波超流可实现具有非阿贝尔激发（non-Abelian excitations）的拓扑量子物质，但其配对在强关联和竞争性不稳定性下存活的参数区间此前尚未确定。本文旨在精确划定这一参数区间，并识别实现该超流态的实验条件。
AI.method: 作者将费米超网链Euler–Lagrange理论（Fermi-hypernetted-chain Euler–Lagrange theory）与关联基配对理论（correlated-basis pairing theory）相结合，在统一框架内处理关联空穴、密度响应、均匀流体的稳定性以及p波配对。微观分子相互作用在z方向紧束缚下被约化为仅由相互作用长度$\sigma$和单一无量纲耦合参数指定的普适准二维形式。
AI.result: 最大配对能隙出现在长波长自旋odal不稳定性稳定侧，对应的二维密度为$4\times10^{-2}/\sigma^2$。将普适区间映射至微观屏蔽方案后发现，单微波缀饰（single-microwave dressing）在削弱吸引力至最优配对范围时也同时削弱碰撞屏蔽，存在固有局限性；双微波缀饰（dual-microwave dressing）通过补偿长程吸引力同时保留大排斥芯而消除此约束。作者进一步确定了有利于p波超流的分子质量与偶极矩区间及可行实验条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将分子p波超流的搜寻转化为定量优化问题，并为实现拓扑弱配对相（topological weak-pairing phase）提供了明确路线。基于对碰撞损耗、束缚和微波幅度稳定性的显式要求，确定了实验上可实现的双微波缀饰条件。

title: A Bifurcation Theory for the Equilibria of Modern Hopfield Networks
summary: Modern Hopfield networks provide a unifying framework for associative memory, transformer attention, diffusion-based generative models, and biological attractor dynamics, linking these systems through a common energy-based dynamics in which states are updated toward weighted combinations of stored patterns. Across these settings, network dynamics is determined by the organization of the energy landscape and the bifurcations of its fixed points. Despite their central role, a general theory of these bifurcations has remained unavailable beyond specific architectures and idealized pattern ensembles. Here we derive stability and bifurcation criteria for the fixed points of general convex-dual Modern Hopfield networks for a general statistics of the stored patterns. Applying this framework to random, block-correlated, and infinitely hierarchical pattern ensembles, we show how memory correlations systematically organize the emergence of hierarchical attractors through successive bifurcations. We further demonstrate that these predictions quantitatively describe retrieval bifurcations in MHNs storing patterns sampled from MNIST, and recapitulate the hierarchical organization of hematopoietic cell identities. Our results establish a general bifurcation theory for Modern Hopfield networks and identify the organization of fixed points as a unifying principle underlying their computational and biological behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文为一般凸对偶现代霍普菲尔德网络（convex-dual Modern Hopfield network）推导了不动点的稳定性与分岔判据，适用于任意存储模式统计分布，并应用于随机、块相关与无限层次模式系综，展示了记忆相关性如何通过逐次分岔组织层次吸引子的涌现，且预测在 MNIST 与造血细胞身份数据上得到定量验证。
AI.motivation: 现代霍普菲尔德网络（Modern Hopfield networks）为联想记忆、变换器注意力（transformer attention）、扩散生成模型与生物吸引子动力学提供了统一框架，其动力学由能量景观结构及不动点分岔决定，但缺乏涵盖一般架构与模式系综的分岔理论。
AI.method: 针对一般凸对偶现代霍普菲尔德网络，在一般存储模式统计分布下推导不动点稳定性与分岔判据；将该框架应用于随机、块相关与无限层次模式系综，分析记忆相关性对层次吸引子形成的影响。
AI.result: 推导出通用稳定性与分岔判据，表明记忆相关性可系统性地驱动层次吸引子（hierarchical attractors）通过逐次分岔涌现；预测定量描述了存储 MNIST 样本的网络检索分岔，并复现了造血细胞身份（hematopoietic cell identities）的层次组织。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了现代霍普菲尔德网络的一般分岔理论，并将不动点的组织识别为其计算与生物行为背后的统一原理。

title: Topographic Disorder, Wind Coupling, and Directional Fire Spread: Critical Behavior in a Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model
summary: We introduce the Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model (TFFM), a lattice model in which fire spreads on a spatially correlated Gaussian height field with the asymmetric bond probability $p_{i\to j}=\mathrm{clip}[e^{-β+γ(h_j-h_i)},0,1]$, plus an additive wind bias. Simulations up to $L=8192$ reveal a sharp active-to-inactive transition whose critical suppression threshold $β_c$ is even in $γ$, decreases with $|γ|$, and decreases as the terrain correlation length $σ_h$ is reduced: slope asymmetry acts as a suppressant because downhill bonds are penalized and fire stalls at local elevation maxima. For rough terrain and low tree density, the fire fails to percolate even at zero suppression. Finite-size scaling gives a front-velocity exponent $δ=0.34\pm0.02$, identical for smooth and rough terrain and matching neither directed percolation ($ν_\parallel-ν_\perp\approx0.56$) nor isotropic percolation ($\approx0.18$). The single-seed survival probability at $β_c$ is independent of $L$ and decays extremely slowly, with a running exponent falling from $\approx0.09$ to $\approx0.04$, excluding directed percolation and suggesting a survival probability that remains finite at criticality, consistent with the $L$-independent value $P^*\approx0.5$ at which $P_{\rm surv}$ drops to zero. The correlation-length exponent cannot be resolved at these sizes, consistent with slow crossover corrections from quenched correlated disorder. Wind raises $β_c$ by a factor of 2--4, produces a sharp onset of downwind fire-scar drift at weak coupling, and, at high terrain coupling, decreases the burned fraction at boundary crossing---a terrain-wind competition effect absent from isotropic bond-disorder models. The model yields fire-risk thresholds and fire-scar signatures comparable to satellite burn-scar data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出地形加权森林火灾模型（Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model, TFFM），在L=8192尺度的模拟中发现了从活跃到非活跃状态的尖锐相变，其临界抑制阈值对地形斜率不对称性有系统性依赖；模型的传播动力学既不属于有向渗流（directed percolation）也不属于各向同性渗流（isotropic percolation），临界存活概率有限且与系统尺寸无关，并在地形-风相互作用下表现出独特的火灾演化行为。
AI.motivation: 传统森林火灾模型多采用各向同性键无序或随机分布假设，忽略了地形坡度对火传播的非对称性影响及地形与风的竞争效应，难以解释真实卫星烧伤痕迹的统计特征。
AI.method: 将火灾置于具有空间相关的高斯高度场（Gaussian height field）上，定义非对称键传播概率p_{i→j}=clip[e^{-β+γ(h_j-h_i)},0,1]，并叠加附加的风向偏差（additive wind bias）；通过大规模晶格模拟（L=8192）与有限尺寸标度分析研究相变行为。
AI.result: 发现临界抑制阈值β_c对γ为偶函数，随|γ|增大而减小，随地形相关长度σ_h减小而减小；前沿速度指数δ=0.34±0.02，既不匹配有向渗流（≈0.56）也不匹配各向同性渗流（≈0.18）；单种子存活概率在临界点与L无关且极缓慢衰减，运行指数从≈0.09降至≈0.04；风使β_c提高2-4倍并在高地形耦合下产生地形-风竞争效应。
AI.conclusion: 地形斜率不对称性作为抑制因子阻碍火灾在局部极大值处的渗透，模型产生的火灾风险阈值和烧伤痕迹统计与卫星烧伤数据（satellite burn-scar data）可比，其临界行为可能由淬灭有序无序引起的慢交叉修正（slow crossover corrections）主导。

title: Directional memory of early spectral selection during spinodal decomposition in finite systems
summary: Cahn-Hilliard phase separation turns small composition fluctuations into coarsening domains. In Fourier space, the pattern forms a ring whose angular intensity favors an axis. We ask whether the axis favored early in an evolution remains related to the axis favored later in the same evolution. We analyze two-dimensional simulations with isotropic initial fluctuations and no imposed direction. We introduce $Q_2$, a normalized angular average over the Fourier spectrum, as a measure of the strength and direction of spectral anisotropy. Linear growth amplifies different wave numbers at different rates, selecting an early axis from the angular imbalances in the initial spectrum. This axis remains correlated with the late axis during coarsening. At a fixed time, shallow quenches show stronger early-late alignment. This advantage disappears when the quenches are compared at similar stages of domain growth. Adding the early $Q_2$ to a prediction based on quench depth, mean composition, and box size reduces the mean absolute error for late $Q_2$ by $3.53\%$. This reduction disappears when only the magnitude of the early $Q_2$ is retained, or when its direction is replaced by the direction from another evolution. The early Fourier intensity therefore carries information about the later state of the same evolving field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维 Cahn-Hilliard 相分离模拟中，早期傅里叶（Fourier）谱的各向异性主轴是否与后期粗化过程中的主轴存在关联。通过引入归一化角平均值 Q₂ 衡量谱各向异性的强度与方向，发现早期线性增长从初始谱的角向不平衡中选择的主轴，与后期粗化阶段的主轴保持相关性。
AI.motivation: Cahn-Hilliard（卡恩-希利亚德）相分离将小的组分涨落演化为粗化畴（coarsening domains），在傅里叶（Fourier）空间中形成环形图案，其角向强度偏好某一轴。作者试图回答：演化早期所偏好的轴是否与同一演化中后期所偏好的轴保持关联。
AI.method: 分析无外加方向的各向同性初始涨落下的二维模拟；引入 Q₂（对傅里叶谱进行归一化角向平均的量）作为谱各向异性强度与方向的度量；通过线性阶段不同波数增长速率的选择提取早期轴，并将其与后期轴的预测模型结合，评估基于淬火深度、平均组分和盒子尺寸的预测中引入早期 Q₂ 的效果。
AI.result: 早期轴与粗化期间的后期轴保持相关；同一时间点，浅淬火（shallow quenches）表现出更强的早期-后期对齐，但按相似畴生长阶段比较时该优势消失；将早期 Q₂ 加入预测可将后期 Q₂ 的平均绝对误差降低 3.53%，但仅保留幅值或替换方向后该改善消失。
AI.conclusion: 早期傅里叶强度携带关于同一演化场后期状态的信息，其方向分量对预测后期各向异性主轴具有实质贡献。

title: High-Field Electron Transport in AlGaN alloys: A Full-Band Monte Carlo Study Based on Ab Initio Supercell Calculations
summary: AlGaN alloys are promising wide and ultra-wide-bandgap semiconductors for next-generation power and RF electronics applications. To realize the full potential of AlGaN based devices, it is important to understand the electron transport to accurately predict device performance and identify material limits under various operating conditions. In this work, the high-field electron transport properties of AlxGa1-xN are investigated using a supercell based full band Monte Carlo method. The supercell approach is employed to explicitly capture the true disorder of the alloy system, enabling a more realistic description of carrier transport. The velocity field characteristics are calculated across a range of Al compositions to evaluate key transport metrics, including peak velocity, saturation velocity, and critical electric field. The role of different scattering mechanisms is studied in detail to understand the high field transport mechanism in the AlGaN alloy system. In addition to steady state transport, transient electron dynamics are examined for various Al fractions to study velocity-overshoot behavior, which is especially important for improving the performance of scaled RF devices. Finally, the temperature dependence of the velocity field characteristics in ultra-wide-bandgap Al0.75Ga0.25N is investigated to assess its transport performance under high temperature conditions. These results provide a detailed understanding of high-field transport in AlGaN alloys and offer guidance for the design of AlGaN-based RF and power electronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用基于超胞（supercell）的全带蒙特卡洛（full band Monte Carlo）方法，系统地研究了AlxGa1-xN合金在直流与瞬态条件下的高场电子输运特性，涵盖不同Al组分下的速率-电场曲线、各散射机制的作用、速度过冲（velocity overshoot）行为以及超宽禁带Al0.75Ga0.25N的温度依赖特性，为AlGaN基射频与电力电子器件设计提供指导。
AI.motivation: AlGaN合金是面向下一代功率与射频（RF）电子的前景宽带隙和超宽带隙半导体材料。为充分发挥其器件潜力，需要深入理解其电子输运机制，以在不同工作条件下准确预测器件性能并识别材料极限。
AI.method: 采用超胞基全带蒙特卡洛方法研究AlxGa1-xN的高场电子输运。超胞法用于显式捕获合金系统的真实无序性（disorder），从而实现更接近实际的载流子输运描述。研究中计算了不同Al组分下的速率-电场特性，详细分析了各散射机制的作用，并考察了稳态和瞬态输运行为。
AI.result: 获得了多种Al组分下的速度-电场（velocity-field）曲线，评估了峰值速度、饱和速度和临界电场（critical electric field）等关键输运指标；揭示了不同散射机制对高场输运的贡献；考察了不同Al组分下的速度过冲瞬态动力学；并在超宽禁带Al0.75Ga0.25N中研究了温度对速度-电场特性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AlGaN合金的高场输运提供了系统的深入理解，为AlGaN基射频和功率电子器件的设计提供了有价值的指导。

title: Simple invariants for band topology
summary: Despite the exhaustive understanding gathered around non-interacting topological states of matter, there is no single method capable of systematically delivering simple, numerically efficient topological invariants that is applicable to all crystalline and non-crystalline systems alike. Here we revisit the spectral localizer operator, constructed from the Hamiltonian and position operators, and show how it can be treated it as an auxiliary zero-dimensional Hamiltonian whose topology encodes the higher dimensional phases of the parent Hamiltonian. Its classification reduces every topological invariant to a matrix signature or the sign of a Pfaffian for an appropriate localizer, both of which are simple to interpret and efficient to compute in real space. We validate this approach by deriving simple real-space invariants for weak and rotationally invariant crystalline phases that were previously beyond the grasp of the spectral localizer formalism, atomic limits that escape scattering invariants, phases that evade symmetry-based indicator methods, as well as phases that had no previously known invariant. Our work provides a systematic way to construct any non-interacting topological invariant for a crystalline or non-crystalline systems, opening avenues to classify and predict the topology of previously unexplored classes of materials.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视谱局域化算子（spectral localizer），将其视为一个辅助的零维哈密顿量，其拓扑结构编码母哈密顿量的高维拓扑相，从而将所有拓扑不变量（topological invariant）简化为矩阵签名（matrix signature）或 Pfaffian 的符号，为晶体和非晶体无相互作用体系的拓扑分类提供了一种系统化的实空间方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管对无相互作用拓扑物质态已有深入理解，但目前尚缺乏一种能够系统性地为所有晶体和非晶体体系给出简单且数值高效的拓扑不变量的统一方法。现有方法各自存在局限性，例如谱局域化形式难以处理某些弱拓扑与旋转不变晶体相，散射不变量无法捕捉原子极限，而对称性指标方法也覆盖不全某些相。
AI.method: 作者将谱局域化算子重构为辅助零维哈密顿量，通过其拓扑性质分类对应母哈密顿量的拓扑相。所有拓扑不变量被归约为所适局域化算子的矩阵签名或 Pfaffian 的符号，两者均可直接在实空间（real space）中解释与数值计算。
AI.result: 该方法成功推导出此前无法通过谱局域化形式处理的弱拓扑和旋转不变晶体相的简单实空间不变量，同时覆盖了能逃避散射不变量（scattering invariants）的原子极限、能规避对称性指标（symmetry-based indicator）方法的相，以及此前完全缺乏已知不变量的相。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种系统性地构造任何非相互作用拓扑不变量的方法，适用于晶体和非晶体体系，开辟了分类并预测此前未探索材料类别拓扑性质的途径。

title: Temperature-Dependent nonlinear optics from first-principles: Second-Harmonic Generation in few-layers MoS$_2$
summary: We present a first-principles real-time approach to study non-linear response of solids at finite temperature. Finite temperature effects are included as renormalization of the quasiparticle energies and a dephasing term proportional to the quasiparticle lifetimes. We evaluate electron-phonon matrix elements from Density-Functional Perturbation Theory for lattice dynamics and then calculate quasiparticles renormalization and lifetime from the Fan and Debye-Waller terms of the electron self-energy. Electron excitations are treated at the independent particle level of approximation. We apply the approach to the second-harmonic generation (SHG) in monolayer and trilayer MoS$_2$. We observe a nontrivial temperature-dependence of the SHG due to a strong crystal-momentum dependent quasiparticle renormalization. From the phonon-mode analysis we find that the coupling with acoustic and shear modes determines the overall crystal-momentum dependence respectively in monolayer and trilayer MoS$_2$. The nontrivial temperature-dependence of the SHG can help rationalize the increase of SHG intensity with increasing temperature observed in monolayer MoS$_2$ at a given laser energy [Adv. Optical Mater. 8, 2000441 (2020)].

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种第一性原理实时方法，用于研究固体在有限温度下的非线性响应。温度效应通过准粒子能量重整化和与准粒子寿命成正比的退相干项引入，并将该方法应用于单层和三层MoS₂的第二谐波产生（SHG）计算，揭示了晶格动量相关的准粒子重整化所引起的非平凡温度依赖性。
AI.motivation: 固体非线性光学响应在有限温度下的第一性原理研究此前缺乏系统框架，而实验观察到单层MoS₂的SHG强度随温度升高而增强的现象缺乏理论解释，需要发展包含温度效应的计算方法来阐明其微观机理。
AI.method: 该方法从第一性原理出发，在实时域内研究固体的非线性响应。温度效应被包含为准粒子能量重整化项以及与准粒子寿命成正比的退相干项。电子-声子耦合矩阵元由密度泛函微扰理论（Density-Functional Perturbation Theory, DFPT）计算晶格动力学获得，准粒子重整化与寿命则从电子自能的Fan项和Debye-Waller项导出。电子激发采用独立粒子近似（independent particle approximation）处理。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于单层和三层MoS₂的SHG计算，发现SHG呈现非平凡的温度依赖性，其根源在于强烈的晶体动量依赖的准粒子重整化。声子模式分析表明，单层和三层MoS₂中分别是声学模和剪切模的耦合决定了整体的晶体动量依赖性。该结果有助于合理解释单层MoS₂在给定激光能量下SHG强度随温度升高而增加 [Adv. Optical Mater. 8, 2000441 (2020)]的实验现象。
AI.conclusion: 发展了一套适用于有限温度固体非线性响应计算的第一性原理实时方法，并在MoS₂体系中成功复现并阐释了SHG随温度变化的非平凡行为，为理解温度效应对非线性光学过程的影响提供了新的理论工具。

title: Creation and characterization of leviton excitations in tight-binding chains
summary: Levitons are minimal-excitation electronic wave packets generated by Lorentzian voltage pulses and constitute a central resource for electron quantum optics.
