In this work, we find that in non-Hermitian settings, Hilbert space connectivity has an even more universal and fundamental influence, tightly controlling the nature of spectral amplification and state localization. Far more complicated than real-space lattices, non-Hermitian many-body Hilbert space graphs not only possess intricate competing amplification channels, but also global feedback loops connecting remote Fock states related by particle symmetry. These features lead to amplification behavior with unconventional scaling and localization properties. Particle occupation constraints can furthermore remove selected Hilbert space pathways, leading to robust unipolar and asymmetric bipolar skin localization in otherwise reciprocal processes. These results extend beyond simple interacting bosonic models and establish Hilbert space connectivity as a versatile control knob for many-body non-Hermitian critical transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在非厄米（non-Hermitian）多体系统中，希尔伯特空间（Hilbert space）连通性对谱放大（spectral amplification）和态局域化（state localization）的性质具有根本性控制作用，远超过实空间格点的影响，并可成为调控多体非厄米临界转变的多功能手段。
AI.motivation: 量子疤痕（quantum scars）和分形子（fractons）等多种奇异多体现象此前已被与希尔伯特空间碎裂（Hilbert space fragmentation）建立联系，但非厄米背景下希尔伯特空间连通性的作用尚未被系统探究。
AI.method: 作者在非厄米多体框架下分析了希尔伯特空间图（Hilbert space graphs）的拓扑结构，考察了竞争性放大通道（competing amplification channels）和连接由粒子对称性关联的远端福克态（Fock states）的全局反馈回路（feedback loops），并结合粒子占据约束对路径删除效应的分析，研究了相互作用的玻色子模型。
AI.result: 研究表明，非厄米多体希尔伯特空间图具有远复杂于实空间格点的结构，包含竞争放大通道与全局反馈回路，导致具有非常规标度（scaling）和局域化特征的放大行为。粒子占据约束可移除特定希尔伯特空间路径，进而在原本互易（reciprocal）的进程中产生稳健的单极性（unipolar）和不对称双极性（asymmetric bipolar）皮肤局域化（skin localization）。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现超越了简单相互作用玻色子模型的范畴，确立希尔伯特空间连通性作为多体非厄米临界转变（critical transitions）的可调控制旋钮。

title: Discretization strategies for colloidal particles in multiparticle collision dynamics simulations
summary: Discrete models are frequently used in multiparticle dynamics simulations to capture hydrodynamic interactions between colloidal particles and the solvent as well as to represent anisotropic pairwise interactions between colloidal particles; however, there is currently limited guidance on how to reliably parameterize these models. Here, we first compare strategies for selecting the density and mass of discrete surface sites used to couple colloidal particles to the solvent, finding that using a minimum of 2 sites per unit area with a scheme that matches the total mass and moment of inertia for a neutrally buoyant solid particle produces reliable and accurate results for the transport properties of colloidal particles at both infinite dilution and in suspension. We then compare strategies for representing the excluded volume of nearly-hard shape-anisotropic colloidal particles using a collection of discrete interaction sites with isotropic repulsion, finding that having a discrepancy between the nominal volume and the excluded volume of the particle can significantly affect suspension transport properties. This discrepancy can be mitigated by placing the interaction sites inside and tangent to the surface of the colloidal particle. We expect these findings to help construct discrete models for colloidal particles with less sensitivity to parameterization.

AI.tldr: 本论文为多粒子离散模型（discrete model）的参数化提供了系统指导。研究发现，在将胶体颗粒与溶剂耦合时，采用每单位面积至少2个表面位点（surface site）并匹配中性浮力固体颗粒的总质量与转动惯量的方案，可准确描述无限稀释及悬浮态下的输运性质；同时，将近硬球形各向异性颗粒的相互作用位点放置在颗粒内部并与表面相切，可消除名义体积与排除体积（excluded volume）之间的差异，从而降低悬浮运输性质模拟对参数化的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 离散模型广泛用于模拟胶体颗粒与溶剂间的流体动力学相互作用（hydrodynamic interaction）以及各向异性成对相互作用，但目前缺乏可靠的模型参数化指导，这限制了此类模拟的准确性和可重现性。
AI.method: 论文采用对比研究策略，分别评估了两类参数化方案：其一，比较离散表面位点的密度与质量选取策略，以匹配胶体颗粒与溶剂的耦合；其二，比较用具有各向同性排斥的离散相互作用位点集合来表征近硬、形状各向异性（shape-anisotropic）胶体颗粒排除体积的多种方案。
AI.result: 结果表明，每单位面积至少使用2个位点并匹配中性浮力固体颗粒的总质量与转动惯量（moment of inertia）时，输运性质在无限稀释和悬浮条件下均准确可靠。此外，若颗粒的名义体积与排除体积之间出现偏差，将显著影响悬浮输运性质，而将相互作用位点置于颗粒内部并与表面相切可以有效消除该偏差。
AI.conclusion: 上述发现为构建对参数化不敏感的胶体颗粒离散模型提供了实用指导，预期可帮助研究者更可靠地设置离散模型中的位点布局与质量参数。

title: Divergent Orbital Diamagnetism from Chiral Edge States in Chern Insulators
summary: Two-dimensional massless Dirac systems, exemplified by graphene, are known to exhibit a divergent orbital diamagnetic susceptibility that scales linearly with system size. Motivated by viewing a chiral edge state as one half of an enlarged analogue of a benzene ring, we study Chern insulators under open boundary conditions and find the same divergent scaling. This giant diamagnetism is robust against disorder, revealing its topological nature. Our results further suggest a profound connection to the divergent diamagnetism of massless Dirac systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过开放边界条件下的Chern绝缘体（Chern insulator）研究，发现其轨道抗磁性（orbital diamagnetic susceptibility）随体系尺寸线性发散，与无质量狄拉克系统（massless Dirac system）中的行为一致，且对无序具有鲁棒性，揭示了该现象的拓扑本质。
AI.motivation: 二维石墨烯等无质量狄拉克系统已知表现出随体系尺寸线性发散的抗磁磁化率，作者希望探讨拓扑材料是否也存在类似的发散抗磁行为，并将手性边缘态（chiral edge state）类比为苯环（benzene ring）扩大的半结构以建立直观动机。
AI.method: 作者在开放边界条件（open boundary conditions）下研究Chern绝缘体，计算其轨道抗磁磁化率随体系尺寸的标度行为，并引入手性边缘态的苯环类比作为分析框架；同时考察体系在无序（disorder）存在下的响应以检验其鲁棒性。
AI.result: 研究发现Chern绝缘体在开放边界条件下同样展现出随尺寸线性发散的抗磁磁化率，且该巨大抗磁性（giant diamagnetism）对无序具有鲁棒性，表明其源于拓扑性质而非杂质效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了Chern绝缘体与无质量狄拉克系统在发散抗磁性上的深度联系，暗示这两种看似不同的体系可能共享共同的拓扑起源。

title: On spectral properties of Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz
summary: The Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz with mean-field propagators is increasingly used to simulate non-equilibrium quantum fermionic and bosonic systems. Compared with the full Kadanoff--Baym equations, its mean-field propagators substantially reduce computational cost, enabling simulations with computational effort that scales linearly with propagation time. However, the time-diagonal structure of the Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz obscures spectral properties within the collision integral of the transport equation. Here, we recover and investigate these hidden spectral properties using the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz. For a Hubbard cluster, we compare ground-state spectral functions obtained with the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz against those from standard Kadanoff--Baym equations. At moderate interaction strengths, the spectral functions show good agreement. At large interaction strengths, however, significant deviations emerge, and the spectral function obtained with the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz becomes negative. These results demonstrate that, despite its computational advantages, the Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz has important limitations in strongly interacting regimes and may produce unphysical spectral properties when interactions become sufficiently large.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过扩展广义Kadanoff-Baym近似（Generalized Kadanoff-Baym Ansatz）恢复了其碰撞积分中隐藏的谱性质，对Hubbard团簇进行基态谱函数比较后发现：中等相互作用强度下与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程结果吻合良好，但在强相互作用区域出现显著偏差并产生非物理的负谱函数，表明该近似方法在强关联体系中存在重要局限性。
AI.motivation: 广义Kadanoff-Baym近似（GKBA）以其平均场传播子大幅降低计算成本、计算量随演化时间线性增长，但其时间对角结构掩盖了输运方程碰撞积分中的谱性质，需要对这一隐藏的谱特性进行恢复与研究，以便评估该近似方法的适用范围。
AI.method: 采用扩展的广义Kadanoff-Baym近似（extended Generalized Kadanoff-Baym Ansatz，eGKBA）来恢复被标准GKBA遮蔽的谱信息，并以Hubbard团簇为模型体系，将eGKBA获得的基态谱函数与完整Kadanoff-Baym方程的结果进行对比。
AI.result: 在中等相互作用强度下，eGKBA得到的谱函数与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程结果表现出良好一致性；然而在强相互作用条件下，两者出现显著偏差，且eGKBA所得谱函数出现负值，即产生非物理结果。
AI.conclusion: 尽管广义Kadanoff-Baym近似具有计算效率上的优势，但在强相互作用区域存在重要局限性，当相互作用足够强时可能产生非物理的谱性质，因此其适用性需谨慎评估。

title: Effects of Interaction Range on Fluid Multicriticality: A Computational Study of an Interconverting Lattice Model
comment: Submitted to Journal of Chemical Physics
summary: The range of intermolecular interactions plays a central role in determining the nature of phase behavior and critical phenomena. It is well established through studies of the Ising model that as interaction range increases, Monte Carlo simulations progressively approach meanfield predictions as the effects of critical fluctuations are suppressed. In this work, we investigate how varying interaction range influences fluid multicriticality using an interconverting lattice model that exhibits both Ising-like liquid-gas criticality and symmetric fluid tricriticality (similar to that in the superfluid $^4$He-$^3$He mixture). This minimal model serves as a representative system for exploring the evolution of competing critical points within a generic framework. We analyze the model using both meanfield theory and three-dimensional Monte Carlo simulations while systematically varying the number of interacting neighbors, $Z_n$, from 6 to 388. We find that the system with nearest-neighbor interactions ($Z_n=6$) reveals only two types of multicritical behavior, while for larger interaction ranges, four distinct archetypes emerge. We demonstrate the convergence of the simulation results to those of the meanfield theory as the number of interacting neighbors tends to infinity, and we discuss the results within the framework of crossover critical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个兼有Ising型液-气临界性和对称流体三临界性的互变异构晶格模型（interconverting lattice model），系统研究分子间相互作用范围对流体多临界行为（fluid multicriticality）的影响。作者利用平均场理论（meanfield theory）与三维蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）模拟，将相互作用邻居数从6变化到388，发现近邻体系仅展现两种多临界行为类型，而大作用范围体系则出现四种不同原型，且模拟结果随作用范围增大趋近平均场理论预言。
AI.motivation: 分子间相互作用的范围在决定相行为与临界现象（critical phenomena）性质中起核心作用。已有Ising模型研究证实，随着相互作用范围增大，临界涨落被抑制，蒙特卡洛模拟逐步趋近平均场预言；但相互作用范围如何影响流体多临界性这一问题尚缺乏系统研究，本文旨在填补该空白。
AI.method: 采用一个可同时展现Ising型液-气临界性与对称流体三临界性（tricriticality，类似超流氦3-氦4混合物体系）的互变异构最小晶格模型，作为研究竞争临界点演化的代表性框架。分别使用平均场理论与三维蒙特卡洛模拟，系统改变相互作用邻居数（从6到388）来分析模型的临界与多临界行为。
AI.result: 研究发现，近邻相互作用体系（Zn=6）仅表现出两种多临界行为类型；而当相互作用范围扩大后，出现了四种不同的多临界行为原型。随着相互作用邻居数趋于无穷大，蒙特卡洛模拟结果向平均场理论预言收敛，验证了二者的渐近一致性。
AI.conclusion: 模拟结果与平均场理论的收敛关系为理解交叉临界现象（crossover critical phenomena）提供了统一框架，表明相互作用范围是调控多临界行为多样性及其向平均场行为过渡的关键控制参数。

title: Junction-free polarity-tunable superconducting diode effect enables XNOR logic operation
summary: The realization of the superconducting diode effect (SDE), characterized by non-reciprocal supercurrent, is a major step towards dissipationless logic circuits. A polarity-tunable superconducting diode with high diode efficiency primarily consists of Josephson-junction architectures that couple two superconducting regions via a weak link. Realizing an SDE without a weak-link junction would reduce fabrication complexity, lower electrical noise, and minimize dependence on junction quality. Here, we report an all-vdW, highly efficient, junction-free SDE in NbSe2, enabled by proximity-induced symmetry breaking from a strong uniaxial ferromagnet Fe3GeTe2 (F3GT). Superconducting diode efficiency of up to 30% is achieved at a small magnetic field of 50 mT. A field-free diode rectification effect is realized with diode polarity that is tunable by the F3GT spin polarization. Furthermore, by employing the active-field dependence of the SDE, a two-input exclusive-NOR (XNOR) logic gate operation is demonstrated. The findings highlight the potential utilization of magnetic proximity effect towards realizing junction-free superconducting diodes for high-performance, energy-efficient logic circuits.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了在NbSe2/Fe3GeTe2全范德华异质结构中实现无结超导二极管效应（superconducting diode effect, SDE），利用强单轴铁磁体的邻近效应诱导对称性破缺，实现了最高30%的超导二极管效率，并演示了无磁场整流及XNOR逻辑门操作。
AI.motivation: 超导二极管效应（SDE）是实现无耗散逻辑电路的关键，但现有器件大多依赖约瑟夫森结（Josephson junction）架构中的弱连接，这增加了制备复杂度、引入电噪声并依赖结质量。作者旨在探索无需弱连接结的无结SDE实现途径。
AI.method: 采用全范德华（all-vdW）异质结构NbSe2/Fe3GeTe2（F3GT），通过强力单轴铁磁体F3GT的邻近效应（proximity effect）诱导NbSe2中超导态发生对称性破缺，从而实现无结条件下的非互易超导电流。实验中通过调节F3GT的自旋极化方向控制二极管极性，并利用SDE对活性场的依赖性演示两输入同或（XNOR）逻辑门运算。
AI.result: 在仅50 mT的小磁场下实现了高达30%的超导二极管效率；在无外加磁场条件下实现了二极管整流效应，且二极管极性能通过F3GT自旋极化方向进行调控；成功演示了基于SDE活性场依赖性的两输入XNOR逻辑门操作。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明磁邻近效应（magnetic proximity effect）可用于实现无结超导二极管，为高性能、高能效的逻辑电路提供了新的设计路径，有助于降低制备复杂性、减少电噪声并降低对弱连接结质量的依赖。

title: Topological Impurity Bands
summary: The effects of disorder on topological phases of matter are typically either preservation of topology or its destruction. For example, the quantum Hall effect's quantization and chiral edge mode remain robust until a strong-disorder percolation transition exits the topological phase. Disorder can also enlarge a preexisting topological phase, yielding a topological Anderson insulator (TAI). However, the reliance of TAI and other theoretical treatments on perturbatively averaging out long-wavelength randomness suggests that additional effects might appear when the disorder involves localized defects. Here we show that a finite density of randomly distributed defects can generate various new topological phase transitions. This route to disorder-induced topology can be viewed as the formation of topological impurity bands (TIB) and is applicable even if the initial clean model is a trivial band insulator. The theory relies on an orbital-dependent vorticity of impurity bound states, which we derive analytically near a generic Dirac cone phase transition as well as using the Chern insulator lattice models of Qi-Wu-Zhang and Haldane. Their numerically computed phase diagrams at 3% defect density show robust topological transitions in distinct TIB and TAI regimes, suggesting a local route to topological phases.

AI.tldr: 本篇论文研究表明，当无序来自有限密度的局域缺陷（localized defects）而非长波长随机扰动时，无序可以生成多种新的拓扑相变，称为拓扑杂质带（topological impurity band, TIB）机制，即使初始无杂质体系是平庸的带绝缘体（band insulator），也能诱导拓扑相的出现。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示无序对拓扑相（topological phases）的影响要么保持拓扑性要么破坏拓扑性，例如整数量子霍尔效应直至强无序渗流相变前保持稳健；无序也可扩大拓扑相形成拓扑安德森绝缘体（topological Anderson insulator, TAI）。然而，TAI及现有理论方法依赖对长波长随机性进行微扰平均化处理，暗示当无序涉及局域缺陷时可能产生额外效应，需要进一步探究。
AI.method: 作者从理论推导出发，在通用狄拉克锥相变附近解析地推导了依赖于轨道角动量的杂质束缚态涡量（orbital-dependent vorticity of impurity bound states）；随后使用Qi-Wu-Zhang和Haldane的陈绝缘体（Chern insulator）晶格模型进行数值验证计算，在3%缺陷密度下绘制相图。
AI.result: 研究发现有限密度的随机分布缺陷能生成多种新的拓扑相变；该无序诱导拓扑的路径可视为拓扑杂质带的形成，并在初始无杂质体系为平庸带绝缘体时仍适用。数值计算在3%缺陷密度下显示拓扑相变在TIB和TAI区域均稳健存在。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一种由局域缺陷驱动的局部路径（local route）通向拓扑相的机制，这与传统无序通过长波长微扰平均化的全局路径（TAI）不同，拓宽了无序诱导拓扑现象的理论框架。

title: Few-body bound states in the anyon-Hubbard model
summary: Quantum statistics in low-dimensional systems predicts anyonic particles with fractional exchange statistics which are neither that of bosons nor fermions. While anyons are typically found in two dimensions as excitations of topologically-ordered states of matter, anyon-like exchange statistics has also been discussed in one dimension, for instance, in the context of the anyon-Hubbard model (AHM), the physics of which has recently been observed in experiment [Kwan et al., arXiv:2306.01737; Dhar et al., arXiv:2412.21131; and Bakkali-Hassani et al., arXiv:2602.20421]. The AHM can be formulated in terms of bosons featuring density-dependent Peierls phases, described by a statistical phase angle $θ$, which controls asymmetric transport and the formation of dynamically bound pairs at finite momentum. Here, we show theoretically that the AHM also hosts exact two-body bound states in the continuum (BICs) for arbitrary $θ\neq 0$, and genuine three- and four-body bound states. Unlike conventional bound states stabilized by attractive (or repulsive) interactions, which are energetically localized with a large effective mass, these clusters here are bound by a purely kinematic mechanism endowing them with fast chiral transport properties. We provide a simple variational approximation to the three-body bound states and explain their binding mechanism. Moreover, we show that the signatures of three-body bound states in the AHM can be directly probed experimentally from the expansion dynamics starting from three localized particles.

AI.tldr: 本文理论上证明了任意子-哈伯德模型（anyon-Hubbard model, AHM）在任意θ≠0时均存在精确的二体连续谱束缚态（bound states in the continuum, BICs），以及真正的三体和四体位点束缚态。与由吸引或排斥相互作用稳定的常规束缚态不同，这些团簇由纯粹的运动学机制束缚，具有快速手性输运性质。作者还提供了三体束缚态的简单变分近似，并展示可通过三个局域粒子的膨胀动力学在实验中直接探测三体束缚态的特征。
AI.motivation: 低维系统中的量子统计预言了具有分数交换统计的任意子（anyon），而当前在实验上已观测到任意子-哈伯德模型（AHM）的物理行为。此前AHM的研究关注于密度依赖的Peierls相位所控制的非对称输运和有限动量动力学束缚对，但对该模型中超越二体的束缚态及其拓扑特性尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 理论上对AHM进行解析和数值分析。作者证明了任意θ≠0时二体BIC的精确存在，推导了三体和四体束缚态的存在条件；对三体束缚态发展了变分近似（variational approximation）方法，并计算了由三个局域粒子起始的膨胀动力学以预言可观测的实验信号。
AI.result: AHM在任意θ≠0下均支持精确的二体BIC以及真正的三体和四体束缚态。这些束缚态与传统束缚态的本质区别在于，它们不以吸引力（或排斥力）为基础，而是由纯粹的运动学机制结合，从而赋予团簇快速手性输运（chiral transport）的特征，而非传统束缚态的大有效质量行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过该研究模型，多体任意子束缚态在AHM中被确立为一类由运动学而非相互作用能决定的量子物态，而三体束缚态可以通过三个局域粒子的膨胀动力学特征在实验中直接观测验证。

title: Anderson orthogonality scaling in the Rabi-driven heavy Fermi polaron
summary: The Anderson orthogonality catastrophe (AOC) is a paradigmatic many-body phenomenon in which a local perturbation induces a macroscopic response of a Fermi sea. We probe signatures of the AOC by coherently driving heavy Fermi polarons in an ultracold $^6$Li-$^{133}$Cs mixture. We observe a power-law dependence of the measured Rabi frequency on the drive strength, with exponents consistent with AOC predictions. Finite-temperature simulations quantitatively reproduce the observed scaling, indicating that AOC signatures persist beyond the idealized zero-temperature, infinite-mass limit. The damping of the Rabi oscillations provides access to polaron dephasing and reveals a nonmonotonic drive dependence, qualitatively consistent with current theories. Our results establish coherently driven impurities as a versatile probe of quantum many-body dynamics through local coherent control.

AI.tldr: 本研究在超冷⁶Li-¹³³Cs混合物中通过相干驱动重费米极化子（heavy Fermi polaron）来探测安德森正交性灾难（AOC），观测到拉比频率对驱动强度呈幂律依赖，其指数与AOC预言一致，并确认AOC特征在有限温度及非无限质量极限下仍然存在。
AI.motivation: 安德森正交性灾难（Anderson orthogonality catastrophe, AOC）是费米海中局域扰动引发宏观响应的典型多体现象，然而其AOC特征在超越理想化零温与无限质量极限的实验中是否依然成立缺乏直接验证，需要一种可控的实验手段对其进行探测。
AI.method: 作者在超冷⁶Li-¹³³Cs混合物中相干驱动重费米极化子，通过测量拉比振荡（Rabi oscillation）来提取拉比频率与驱动强度之间的标度关系，并结合有限温度数值模拟定量复现实验观测的标度行为；同时利用拉比振荡的阻尼来考察极化子的退相干（dephasing）特性。
AI.result: 实验观测到拉比频率对驱动强度呈幂律依赖，所得指数与AOC理论预言一致；有限温度模拟定量复现了观测标度，表明AOC特征在超越零温与无限质量理想极限后依然存活。此外，拉比振荡阻尼反映的极化子退相干呈现非单调的驱动强度依赖，与现有理论定性相符。
AI.conclusion: 该项工作确立了相干驱动的杂质作为通过局域相干控制探测量子多体动力学的通用探针，为在实验层面进一步研究AOC及其他多体现象提供了新的途径。

title: Large-scale dynamics of integrable quenches
summary: The Ballistic Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (BMFT) is a path-integral based approach to treat large-scale correlations in interacting integrable systems which, so far, has only been applied to quasi-equilibrium settings. In this paper we extend this approach to integrable quench problems and, to illustrate it, we compute the time evolution of the full-counting-statistics (FCS) of a conserved charge. We identify the relevant path integral, solve it via saddle-point, and obtain a set of partial differential equations describing the dynamics of the FCS. We solve these equations explicitly for free fermionic systems and for the interacting cellular automaton Rule 54. In both cases, we recover the known exact results. For Rule 54, our construction moreover completes the solution across the entire ballistic window.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了弹道宏观涨落理论（Ballistic Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory, BMFT）在可积淬火（integrabale quench）问题中的扩展方案，通过路径积分、鞍点求解方法推导出守恒荷完全计数统计（full-counting-statistics, FCS）的偏微分方程，并分别在自由费米系统和相互作用元胞自动机Rule 54中验证了已知精确结果。
AI.motivation: BMFT作为基于路径积分的方法此前仅应用于准平衡（quasi-equilibrium）情形，尚缺乏对非平衡可积淬火问题的处理能力，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将BMFT框架推广到可积淬火问题，识别相关路径积分并通过鞍点（saddle-point）方法求解，进而导出一组描述FCS动力学的偏微分方程；在自由费米系统和Rule 54模型中分别显式求解这些方程，并与已知结果进行对照验证。
AI.result: 在自由费米系统与相互作用元胞自动机Rule 54两种情形中，所获得的FCS动力学方程均精确复现了已知结果；对Rule 54而言，该构造额外补全了整个弹道窗口（ballistic window）内的解。
AI.conclusion: BMFT作为基础框架可有效推广至可积淬火问题，为计算远离均衡态的可积系统中大尺度关联与守恒荷的涨落统计提供了统一且有效的理论工具。

title: Green's Functions from Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization: An Impurity Solver for Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
summary: We generalize the sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization (SKQD) method from ground-state calculations to the evaluation of single-particle Green's functions. By constructing and sampling unitary Krylov subspaces in the N +/- 1 particle-number sectors and evaluating all sector-connecting overlaps classically, the approach reconstructs the Green's function via a Lanczos continued fraction while retaining the shallow-circuit, ancilla-free character of SKQD. The quantum device is required only to prepare and sample short-time evolutions. Applied to the particle-hole-symmetric single-impurity Anderson model in chain geometry, with the discrete bath representation used in dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), the method recovers the spectral function using a relatively small fraction of the full Hilbert space. Across a range of interaction strengths that spans the metal-insulator transition, the main spectral features are reproduced. These results suggest that SKQD-based Green's-function calculations may allow DMFT impurity solvers with a larger number of bath sites on near-term quantum hardware than is currently practical.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于样本的Krylov量子对角化（sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization, SKQD）方法从基态计算推广到单粒子格林函数（single-particle Green's function）的评估。通过在N±1粒子数扇区构造和采样幺正Krylov子空间，并经典地评估所有扇区连接的重叠，该方法通过Lanczos连分数重建格林函数，同时保留SKQD的浅电路、无辅助比特特性。在粒子-空穴对称的单杂质Anderson模型上，该方法仅用完整希尔伯特空间的一小部分即可恢复谱函数，跨金属-绝缘体转变的相互作用强度范围内重现主要谱特征，表明SKQD基的格林函数计算可能允许在近端量子硬件上使用比当前更多浴位的DMFT杂质求解器。
AI.motivation: 扩展SKQD方法的应用范围，将其从基态能量计算推广到动力学关联量（单粒子格林函数）的评估，以满足动力平均场理论（DMFT）对量子杂质求解器近端量子硬件适用性的需求，并寻求克服当前可处理浴位数量的限制。
AI.method: 方法在N+1和N−1粒子数扇区中构造并采样幺正Krylov子空间，经典评估所有扇区连接的重叠矩阵元，从而通过Lanczos连分数技术重建格林函数。量子设备仅需执行短时间演化的制备与采样，保持SKQD原有的浅电路深度和无辅助量子比特（ancilla-free）结构。
AI.result: 在链式几何的粒子-空穴对称单杂质Anderson模型上，使用DMFT中离散浴表示，该方法以相对较小的希尔伯特空间占比恢复谱函数；在跨越金属-绝缘体转变的多种相互作用强度下，主要谱特征均被成功重现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于SKQD的格林函数计算方法有望使DMFT杂质求解器在近端量子硬件上支持比目前更多的浴位点，为量子硬件上的强关联电子体系模拟提供可行的技术路径。

title: Kinematics of erosion-induced landslide mobility
summary: Erosion-induced landslide mobility is a prominent phenomenon in nature. However, this topic remains poorly understood, even though erosion greatly alters nearly every aspect of landslide mechanics, dynamics, run-out, mobility, deposition structure and the enormous destructive power carried by such catastrophic events. Here, I present a simple, elegant, and exact analytical model describing the kinematics of erosion-induced landslide mobility in terms of a newly constructed mobility controller containing essential forcing mechanisms in erosion. In contrast to the classical perspective, I formally prove that, irrespective of how large the erosion rate is, the erosion rate alone is not sufficient to determine enhanced or reduced mobility; mobility is also greatly regulated by the volume bulking rate, erosion drag or thrust, and flow depth. With this mechanical mobility controller, it is now possible to explain precisely when the mobility of an erodible landslide is enhanced or reduced. I demonstrate that, a mechanically valid, physically founded erosion model must be able to explain both the enhanced and reduced mobility of erosive landslides.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个简单、精确且解析的模型，用于描述侵蚀诱导的滑坡流动性（landslide mobility），并构建了一个新的流动性控制器（mobility controller），该控制器包含侵蚀中的关键力机制。作者严格证明了仅靠侵蚀速率（erosion rate）不足以判定流动性的增强或减弱，流动性还受体积膨胀速率（volume bulking rate）、侵蚀阻力或推力（erosion drag or thrust）及流深（flow depth）的显著调控。
AI.motivation: 侵蚀诱导的滑坡流动性虽是自然界的显著现象，但其机制尚未被充分理解，尽管侵蚀几乎改变了滑坡力学、动力学、运行距离、流动性、沉积结构及破坏力的所有方面。现有理论缺乏一个能够准确解释侵蚀如何调控滑坡流动性的解析框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个简单、优雅且精确的解析模型（analytical model），通过引入一个新的流动性控制器来刻画侵蚀诱导滑坡的运动学，该控制器整合了侵蚀过程中的基本力机制，包括侵蚀速率、体积膨胀速率、侵蚀阻力或推力以及流深等变量。
AI.result: 与传统观点不同，作者形式化地证明了无论侵蚀速率多大，侵蚀速率本身不足以单独决定流动性的增强或减弱；流动性同时还受体积膨胀速率、侵蚀阻力或推力以及流深的显著调控。基于该力学流动性控制器，可以精确解释可侵蚀滑坡的流动性何时增强、何时减弱。
AI.conclusion: 一个力学上有效且物理上有依据的侵蚀模型必须能够同时解释侵蚀性滑坡流动性的增强与减弱两种情形，这为后续侵蚀-滑坡耦合模型的验证提供了理论判据。

title: Slow dynamics in concrete: Effects of temperature, strength variation, and microcracking damage
comment: This manuscript is under review at the Journal of Nondestructive Evaluation
summary: In this study, we investigated the slow dynamic behavior of concrete with varying compressive strengths ($f'_c = 32\sim56$ MPa) and alkali-silica reaction (ASR) damage. Concrete prisms were conditioned by compressive loading and recovery was monitored by coda wave interferometry (CWI). A self-referencing temperature correction technique was used to minimize the effect of ambient temperature changes, demonstrating the importance of careful temperature control and correction. For intact specimens, both the recovery rate, $m_v$, and velocity drop magnitude, $|c|$, generally increased with compressive strength. Recovery times were calculated from the fit parameters, and higher strength specimens were found to recover faster (9.9 h for $f'_c = 32$ MPa, 6.6 h for $f'_c = 56$ MPa). When the same stress was applied, ASR-damaged specimens had increased softening and faster recovery rates, but longer recovery times (up to 458 h). These findings demonstrate the potential of slow dynamics in concrete characterization, through its ability to evaluate the strength of intact samples and its sensitivity to microcracking in damaged samples.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过尾波干涉测量（coda wave interferometry, CWI）监测了不同抗压强度（$f'_c = 32\sim56$ MPa）及碱-硅酸反应（alkali-silica reaction, ASR）损伤的混凝土在压缩加载后的慢动态恢复行为，发现完整试件的恢复速率与速度降幅随强度增大而增大，而ASR损伤试件则表现出更长的恢复时间和更高的软化和恢复速率。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究慢动力学（slow dynamics）在混凝土表征中的应用潜力，即通过恢复行为评估完整试件的强度以及检测损伤试件中的微裂纹敏感度。同时强调了温度控制与修正对慢动态测量可靠性的重要性。
AI.method: 对不同抗压强度（32、40、48、56 MPa）及存在ASR损伤的混凝土棱柱体试件施加压缩加载，随后利用尾波干涉测量（CWI）监测其恢复过程；采用自参考温度校正技术以最小化环境温度变化带来的影响，并从拟合参数中计算恢复时间。
AI.result: 完整试件的恢复速率$m_v$与速度降幅$|c|$随抗压强度增加而增大；高强试件恢复更快（56 MPa为6.6小时，32 MPa为9.9小时）；施加相同应力时，ASR损伤试件表现出更显著的软化和更快恢复速率，但恢复时间显著延长（最长可达458小时）。
AI.conclusion: 慢动力学特性可有效用于混凝土表征：既能评估完整试件的强度水平，又对损伤试件中的微裂纹状态具有敏感性，展现了其作为无损评估工具的潜力。

title: Lee-Yang zeros of modulated XY spin chains with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction: zero-contour topology and quantum phase-diagram reconstruction
summary: We investigate the Lee--Yang zeros (LYZ) of inhomogeneous anisotropic XY spin chains with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interactions in the complex transverse-field plane, focusing on their fundamental connection to quantum phase transitions. We systematically study uniform chains, period-2 and period-3 modulated chains, and Fibonacci quasiperiodic chains of lengths 5 and 8. As the DM coupling strength $D$ increases, the LYZ exhibit qualitatively distinct topological evolutions on the complex plane: the complex zeros of the uniform chain collapse toward the real axis; periodic chains feature either bifurcation of closed zero contours before all zeros become real or a single re-emergence of complex zeros; quasiperiodic chains exhibit repeated annihilation and revival of complex zeros. Analytical derivations demonstrate that this diverse behavior originates from DM-induced shifts of folded bands and the modulation of zero positions by anisotropic pairing at particle--hole band crossings. Our results establish a direct correspondence between LYZ topology and band deformation: isolated contact points of zeros with the real axis correspond to discrete quantum critical fields, while continuous real-zero intervals directly identify gapless chiral phases. Accordingly, beyond locating phase boundaries, LYZ can distinguish characteristic phases and serve as an intuitive probe for band folding and phase diagram restructuring.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了含Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya（DM）相互作用的不均匀各向异性XY自旋链在复横场平面上的Lee–Yang零点（LYZ），发现不同调制类型（均匀、周期、准周期）链的LYZ拓扑演化各异，并建立了LYZ拓扑与能带变形之间的直接对应关系，使LYZ不仅能定位相边界，还能区分特征相。
AI.motivation: 量子相变与Lee–Yang零点的关联是统计力学的根本问题，但LYZ在含DM相互作用的不均匀各向异性XY自旋链中的拓扑行为尚不清楚，作者旨在揭示其与量子相变的深层联系。
AI.method: 系统研究了均匀链、周期2和周期3调制链以及斐波那契（Fibonacci）准周期链（长度为5和8）的LYZ在复横场平面上的行为，并结合解析推导分析了DM耦合强度变化下LYZ的拓扑演化及其与能带折叠和粒子–空穴能带交叉处各向异性配对的关系。
AI.result: 随着DM耦合强度增加，均匀链的复零点向实轴坍缩；周期链出现闭零环分叉或复零点单次重现；准周期链则呈现复零点的反复湮灭与复活。解析推导表明这些多样性源于DM引起的折叠能带位移及各向异性配对对零点位置的调制。
AI.conclusion: LYZ与实轴的孤立接触点对应分立的量子临界场，连续实零点区间则直接标示无能隙手性相；因此LYZ可用于区分特征相，并作为能带折叠与相图重构的直观探针。

title: Matrix Product Belief Propagation
summary: We introduce "matrix product belief propagation" (MP-BP) as a controlled method for the approximate contraction of two-dimensional tensor networks and graphical models, which generically leads to a quadratic reduction of errors relative to existing methods: at similar computational effort, the number of accurate digits is asymptotically doubled. For infinite systems, MP-BP can be understood as a practical implementation of Baxter's corner-transfer-matrix method; for reflection-symmetric networks, it further coincides with the boundary matrix-product-state and corner-transfer-matrix renormalization group algorithms as conventionally implemented. In the limit of unit matrix-product rank, MP-BP is equivalent to belief propagation, and more generally, can be understood as a generalization of BP in which the "messages" live on surfaces and are assumed to have a matrix-product factorization. We further extend the quadratic improvement to the computation of expectation values, and numerically demonstrate the qualitatively improved convergence for a variety of classical and quantum 2D tensor network problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"矩阵乘积信念传播"（matrix product belief propagation, MP-BP），作为一种可控的二维张量网络与图模型近似收缩方法，在相近计算开销下将误差相对现有方法二次方级降低，使有效位数渐近翻倍。该方法可视为Baxter角传递矩阵法（corner-transfer-matrix method）的实用实现，并在特定情形下退化为现有的边界矩阵乘积态与角传递矩阵重整化群算法。
AI.motivation: 二维张量网络与图模型的精确收缩在一般情况下不可行，需要发展近似收缩方法；现有的信念传播（belief propagation）等近似方法存在系统性误差，作者旨在引入一种可控方案，以在相同计算开销下显著提升精度。
AI.method: 作者提出MP-BP方法，将传统信念传播中的"消息"（message）推广为定义在曲面上并假设具有矩阵乘积分解的对象；当矩阵乘积秩（matrix-product rank）为1时，MP-BP退化为标准信念传播。该方法还扩展应用于期望值（expectation value）的计算。
AI.result: 与现有方法相比，MP-BP在相近计算成本下将误差二次方级降低，即精确位数渐近加倍；在反射对称网络中，该方法等同于边界矩阵乘积态（boundary matrix-product-state）与角传递矩阵重整化群（corner-transfer-matrix renormalization group）算法的常规实现。数值实验表明，该方法在多种经典与量子二维张量网络问题中展现出定性改善的收敛行为。
AI.conclusion: MP-BP为二维张量网络与图模型的近似收缩提供了一种兼具理论统一性与实际高效性的框架，将信念传播、Baxter角传递矩阵法和张量网络重整化群等多条研究路线纳入统一视野，并通过二次方级误差降低证明了其精度优势。

title: Hawking Radiation in non-Hermitian Microscopic Analogues
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures and 3 figures in appendices
summary: Non-Hermitian systems have recently emerged as a convenient platform to realize black-hole physics. Here, we propose a microscopic open quantum system, namely a fermionic tight-binding chain coupled to Markovian reservoirs, which emulates black-hole properties. The resulting quadratic Lindbladian admits an effective non-Hermitian limit that produces a gain and loss lattice model with a non-reciprocal next-nearest-neighbor hopping. The rapidity spectrum of the full Lindbladian forms tilted exceptional cones that define an effective Painlevé-Gullstrand geometry and separates into black-hole and white-hole sectors, while steady-state particle densities and currents retain clear signatures at the horizon positions. We then analyze the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian that arise from the microscopic quantum system. The biorthogonal flux identifies the outgoing exterior and interior channels. Finally, we introduce a fermionic Gaussian Nambu extension and formulate Hawking-pair witnesses through frequency-resolved scattering, nonlocal density-density correlations, and anomalous Hawking-partner amplitudes. The resulting correlations display analogue Hawking radiation signatures, while the frequency-resolved Hawking-partner correlations satisfy the fermionic covariance-positivity constraint. These results establish a connection between microscopic open-system dynamics, emergent non-Hermitian geometry, and fermionic many-body probes of analogue Hawking radiation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个微观开放量子系统（费米子紧束缚链耦合马尔可夫储层），该系统在有效非厄米极限下模拟黑洞性质，产生倾祝奇异锥和类比霍金辐射的费米子多体信号。
AI.motivation: 非厄米系统为实验实现黑洞物理提供了一个便捷平台，但缺乏从微观开放量子动力学出发建立该联系的明确机制。
AI.method: 作者提出一个费米子紧束缚链与马尔可夫储层耦合的开放量子系统，其二次型Lindbladian存在有效非厄米极限，产生具有非互易次近邻跳跃的增益损耗格子模型；随后通过rapidity谱构造倾祝奇异锥和Painlevé-Gullstrand几何，并引入费米子高斯Nambu扩展来构建霍金对验证方案。
AI.result: rapidity谱形成倾祝奇异锥并划分为黑洞与白洞区域；稳态粒子密度和电流在事件视界位置保留明显信号；双正交通量标识出外向外部与内部通道；频率分辨散射、非局域密度-密度关联和反常霍金伴子振幅展现类比霍金辐射特征，且满足费米子协方差正定性约束。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了微观开放系统动力学、涌现非厄米几何与费米子多体类比霍金辐射探针之间的联系。

title: The convergent laboratory: when AI reasoning, autonomous experiments, high performance and quantum computing reshape chemistry
summary: This Comment emerges from TPC26 (https://tpc26.org), a conference convening leaders from academia, national laboratories, and industry who are reshaping materials science discovery. The meeting explored how AI, autonomous agents, self-driving labs, higher performance and quantum computing converge to amplify their individual impact on materials science discovery. The perspectives here reflect the firsthand experiences of researchers at these frontiers and capture the essence of this global endeavor. As AI-driven reasoning, autonomous agentic frameworks, self-driving laboratories, and fault-tolerant quantum processors mature simultaneously, we offer this Comment as a reference at what we believe is a tipping point of transformative advances and productive disruption in the chemical sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文是基于TPC26会议（https://tpc26.org）的评论性文章，该会议汇聚了来自学术界、国家实验室和工业界的领导者，共同探讨人工智能（AI）、自主智能体（autonomous agents）、自驱动实验室（self-driving labs）、高性能计算和量子计算如何汇聚并放大其对材料科学发现的影响。作者认为化学科学正处于颠覆性变革的临界点。
AI.motivation: 在AI驱动推理、自主智能体框架、自驱动实验室和容错量子处理器（fault-tolerant quantum processors）同步成熟的背景下，为处于变革临界点的材料科学发现提供一份参考性评论，捕捉这一全球化努力的实质。
AI.method: 基于TPC26会议中来自学术界、国家实验室和工业界研究者的第一手经验，以评述（Comment）形式呈现多领域技术交汇如何重塑材料科学发现的观点。
AI.result: 文章认为人工智能、自主智能体、自驱动实验室、更高性能计算与量子计算的协同汇聚能够放大各自对材料科学发现的个体影响，构成化学科学中变革性进展与生产性颠覆的转折点。
AI.conclusion: 作者将此评论定位为处于化学科学转型关键节点的参考文献，强调AI与自驱动性技术体系的联合成熟正推动材料发现范式的根本性变革。

title: Differentiable Solvation Shell Model for Rational Electrolyte Design
summary: Tailoring Li+ solvation structures has emerged as a promising design principle across multiple Li metal battery (LMB) electrolytes, with localized high concentration electrolytes (LHCE) emerging as a leading candidate. However, rational design of these electrolytes remains limited by a poor quantitative understanding of how molecular properties govern Li+ solvation shell composition. Here we introduce a mean field modeling framework, built on an Ising model, that predicts solvation shell composition from donor number (DN), acceptor number (AN), molar ratio, and molecular size. This framework is end-to-end differentiable, which enables parameterization directly from molecular dynamics (MD) solvation structures via gradient-based optimization. Focusing on LHCE, the model achieves 10.7% RMSE and R2=0.87 for shell composition, 2.3% RMSE on free solvent ratio, and further reproduces solvation trends in real LHCE electrolytes, at a fraction of MD's cost. Our model also shows good generalizability on other electrolyte systems in addition to LHCE. Analysis of its interaction terms shows that DN dominates Li+ solvation energetics, providing a thermodynamic basis for empirical DN-based design rules. We further demonstrate the model's design utility on the LiTFSI/tetraglyme (G4) system absent from training. The model identifies fluorobenzene (FB) as a promising diluent and predicts a salt-concentration window with anion-rich solvation shells and low free solvent, favorable for stable anion-derived SEIs and high oxidative stability, respectively. This prediction is validated by higher-fidelity MD. This work establishes an interpretable differentiable framework for predicting Li+ solvation shell composition, with potential to extend to other electrolyte classes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于伊辛模型（Ising model）的平均场建模框架，用于从给体数（donor number, DN）、受体数（acceptor number, AN）、摩尔比和分子尺寸预测锂离子（Li+）溶剂化壳层组成。该框架支持端到端微分，可通过梯度优化直接从分子动力学（MD）模拟中参数化，在局部高浓度电解液（LHCE）上取得了良好精度，并展示了在真实体系和未见体系上的设计实用性与可推广性。
AI.motivation: 锂金属电池（Li metal battery, LMB）电解液中调控Li+溶剂化结构已成为重要的设计原则，但对分子性质如何决定溶剂化壳层组成的定量理解仍然不足，制约了如局部高浓度电解液（LHCE）等体系的理性设计。
AI.method: 构建了一个以伊辛模型为基础的平均场建模框架，输入特征包括给体数（DN）、受体数（AN）、摩尔比与分子尺寸，输出为Li+溶剂化壳层组成。模型为端到端可微分，可通过基于梯度的优化直接拟合分子动力学（MD）模拟得到的溶剂化结构数据。
AI.result: 在LHCE体系中，模型对壳层组成预测的均方根误差（RMSE）为10.7%，决定系数R²=0.87；对自由溶剂比例的RMSE为2.3%。模型还成功复现了真实LHCE电解液的溶剂化趋势，并在LHCE以外的其他电解液体系中展示了良好的泛化能力。交互项分析表明DN主导Li+溶剂化热力学，为经验性DN设计规则提供了热力学基础。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在训练中未包含的LiTFSI/四甘醇二甲醚（tetraglyme, G4）体系中展示了设计实用性，识别出氟苯（fluorobenzene, FB）为有前景的稀释剂，并预测了对稳定阴离子衍生SEI和高氧化稳定性有利的盐浓度区间，该预测已通过更高保真度的MD验证。该工作建立了可解释的可微分框架，有望推广至其他电解液类别。

title: Physical policy gradient theorem for in situ stochastic-adjoint training
summary: In situ adjoint training extracts parameter gradients directly from measurement, but has so far been limited to reciprocal or restricted systems. Here, we introduce the physical counterpart of the policy gradient theorem: a stochastic-adjoint gradient estimator that lifts these constraints by trading reciprocity for nondegenerate diffusion. As validation, we train a nonlinear resonator network, whose own dynamics supply the policy, against antagonistic temporal modulations with gradients from measured stochastic trajectories alone, without finite differences or a separate adjoint experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种随机伴随（stochastic-adjoint）梯度估计方法，即策略梯度定理（policy gradient theorem）的物理对应物，通过引入非简并扩散（nondegenerate diffusion）替代互易性（reciprocity）约束，使原位伴随训练（in situ adjoint training）得以推广到非互易或非受限系统，并仅依据实测随机轨迹即可计算参数梯度。
AI.motivation: 原位伴随训练可直接从测量中提取参数梯度，但此前仅适用于互易系统或受限制的系统，这一约束严重限制了其适用范围。作者希望解除这些限制，使梯度估计方法能够应用于更一般的物理系统。
AI.method: 作者提出策略梯度定理的物理对应物——一种随机伴随梯度估计器，其核心思路是放弃互易性要求，转而利用非简并扩散（nondegenerate diffusion）来实现梯度的无偏估计。该方法无需有限差分（finite differences），也无需单独的伴随实验，仅从实测随机轨迹即可获得梯度。
AI.result: 作为验证，作者在一个非线性谐振子网络（nonlinear resonator network）上训练系统对抗拮抗性时间调制（antagonistic temporal modulations），系统的自身动力学充当策略（policy），梯度完全由实测随机轨迹（measured stochastic trajectories）提取。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将原位伴随训练的适用范围从互易/受限系统拓展至更一般的系统，证明了仅凭测量数据即可实现端到端的物理系统参数优化，无需额外的数值或实验辅助。

title: Fluidization in Growth-Induced Morphogenesis
summary: Elastic buckling has explained shape formation in growing tissues, yet the role of tissue fluidity remains elusive. We derive a minimal fluidized growth-elasticity model as a nonlinear analogue of Maxwell rheology. Analysis of a growing strip shows that fluidity promotes symmetry breaking under compression while regulating stress accumulation, so morphogenesis develops continuously before the elastic buckling threshold. Fluidity further controls the flow pattern, from smooth sinusoidal undulations to widened crests and localized indentations, with low fluidity favoring stronger localization.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个最小流化生长-弹性模型（minimal fluidized growth-elasticity model），作为麦克斯韦流变学（Maxwell rheology）的非线性类比，揭示了组织流体性（tissue fluidity）在形态发生（morphogenesis）中促进对称性破缺、调控应力积累并决定形变模式的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 弹性屈曲（elastic buckling）已被用于解释生长组织中形状的形成，但组织流体性在其中的作用尚不明确。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索流体性如何影响生长组织的形态发生过程。
AI.method: 作者推导出一个最小化流化生长-弹性模型，将其作为麦克斯韦流变学的非线性类比，并以此为基础对生长条带（growing strip）进行理论分析。
AI.result: 分析表明，流体性在压缩条件下促进对称性破缺（symmetry breaking），同时调控应力积累，使形态发生在弹性屈曲阈值之前就连续展开。流体性还控制流动模式，从平滑的正弦波动到加宽的波峰和局部的凹陷不等，低流体性更有利于更强的局域化（localization）。
AI.conclusion: 流体性是影响生长组织形态发生的核心机制之一，它不仅决定了对称性破缺发生的方式和时机，还塑造了形变的空间模式，为理解生物组织形态生成提供了新的理论框架。

title: Boundary-Cancelled Score-Hamiltonian Sampling
summary: Diffusion sampling can be viewed as imaginary-time annealing of probability densities. From a forward/backward Euclidean Schrödinger pair, we show that fixing the noising drift forces the reverse score term, and that the same logarithmic force is the one-sided imaginary-time counterdiabatic connection of a supersymmetric Score Hamiltonian. The correspondence turns score-learning error into a Hamiltonian perturbation and yields a schedule principle: if the first $r$ terminal derivatives vanish, Morita--Nishimori boundary cancellation suppresses the residual Hellinger error from $T^{-2}$ to $T^{-2r-2}$ until score or sampling floors are reached. Reverse-SDE benchmarks, including two-dimensional learned-score tests, confirm the predicted improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种理论框架，将扩散采样（diffusion sampling）视为概率密度的虚时间退火（imaginary-time annealing），借助欧几里得薛定谔对（Euclidean Schrödinger pair）与超对称得分哈密顿量（supersymmetric Score Hamiltonian）的等价性，将得分学习误差映射为哈密顿量微扰，并由此推导出噪声调度原则，可将残差Hellinger误差从T⁻²阶降至T⁻²ʳ⁻²阶。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的采样过程与得分学习误差之间的关系缺乏系统的理论刻画，限制了调度策略的设计与误差上界的精确控制。
AI.method: 利用前向/后向欧几里得薛定谔对，证明固定噪声漂移即可确定反向得分项，并将其对应的对数力识别为超对称Score哈密顿量的单边虚时反绝热连接（one-sided imaginary-time counterdiabatic connection）。在此基础上将得分学习误差转化为哈密顿量微扰，并提出调度原则：当前r个终端导数消失时，借助Morita–Nishimori边界抵消可将残差Hellinger误差从T⁻²提升至T⁻²ʳ⁻²的收敛率。
AI.result: 理论预测的误差改进在反向随机微分方程（reverse-SDE）基准测试中获得验证，包括二维学习得分（learned-score）测试在内的实验均确认了所预期的收敛率提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明扩散采样与虚时间反绝热过程在数学上深度同构，得分学习误差可被严格量化为哈密顿量扰动，由此导出的调度原则可系统性地抑制边界误差直至得分或采样精度下限。

title: Unraveling-Dependent Metastability in Monitored Quantum Systems and Associative Memories
summary: Metastability in open quantum systems is usually inferred from spectral separation in the Liouvillian, which governs unconditional, ensemble-averaged dynamics. We show that this diagnosis is incomplete at the level of individual quantum trajectories: conditioned realizations of the same unconditional dynamics can bypass, transiently access, or operationally preserve a metastable memory, depending on the monitored channel and the observed record. We demonstrate these mechanisms in a driven-dissipative nonlinear oscillator realizing a quantum associative memory, by comparing spectra, target fidelities, and phase-space distributions. The non-Hermitian dynamics obtained by post-selecting on the absence of detected events supports metastable retrieval, but with a distinct long-time fate: normalization selects the least-decaying mode of the non-Hermitian spectrum rather than the addressed memory branch. In contrast, stochastic jump trajectories can preserve retrieval over extended times when the post-measurement update remains compatible with the coherent memory structure. Thus trajectory-level metastability is not determined by the averaged generator alone; it requires compatibility between the monitored channel, the measurement record, and the metastable manifold.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，开放量子系统（open quantum systems）中基于Liouvillian谱分离推断亚稳态（metastability）的诊断方法在单量子轨迹层面是不完整的，并提出轨迹级亚稳态取决于监测通道（monitored channel）、观测记录（observed record）与亚稳态流形（metastable manifold）之间的兼容性，而非仅由平均生成元决定。
AI.motivation: 传统上，开放量子系统的亚稳态通常通过Liouvillian的谱分离来推断，但这一诊断仅适用于无条件、系综平均（ensemble-averaged）的动力学子，无法刻画条件化单量子轨迹层面的行为差异，因此该诊断在轨迹层级是不完整的。
AI.method: 在一个实现量子联想记忆（quantum associative memory）的驱动-耗散非线性振子中，研究者通过比较谱（spectra）、目标保真度（target fidelities）和相空间分布（phase-space distributions），考察三种不同机制下的轨迹行为：无条件动力学、基于无检测事件后选择（post-selection）的非厄米动力学，以及随机跳变轨迹（stochastic jump trajectories）。
AI.result: 条件化实现的同一无条件动力学可以根据监测通道和观测记录的不同，绕开、短暂访问或操作性地保持亚稳态记忆。后选择非厄米动力学虽支持亚稳态提取，但其长期命运由非厄米谱（non-Hermitian spectrum）中最弱衰减模决定而非目标记忆分支；随机跳变轨迹在测量后更新与相干记忆结构兼容时可长时间保持提取。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级亚稳态不能仅由平均生成元决定，而需要监测通道、测量记录与亚稳态流形之间的兼容性来共同确定，这为开放量子系统中亚稳态的表征提供了更精细的判据。

title: Helicity-engineered nonlinear optical responses in photo-excited topological semimetals
summary: Topological materials provide a transformative arena for light-driven control of electronic motion; yet, direct manipulation of electron dynamics on sub-cycle timescale remains a significant challenge. We demonstrate that the strong-field-driven high-harmonic generation of a Weyl semimetal can be controlled and manipulated through bicircular pump-probe driving fields. While a lone probe pulse generates exclusively odd-order harmonics, the addition of a pump pulse triggers a series of sidebands arising from nonlinear frequency mixing of pump and probe photons. Our results reveal that the sideband intensities are highly sensitive to the relative helicity of the pulses and the orientation of the polarization plane. This sensitivity stems from the chiral nature of the Weyl nodes, which couples efficiently to the light's helicity only when the node-separation axis is perpendicular to the polarization plane. Furthermore, the significant suppression of sideband intensity with increasing pump-probe delay identifies these features as a potential clock for electron-hole decoherence. These findings establish frequency-mixed high-harmonic generation as a sensitive probe of chiral quantum dynamics and suggest a robust framework for manipulating topological currents via structured light, with implications for lightwave electronics and ultrafast quantum information processing.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了通过双圆偏振泵浦-探测驱动场对Weyl半金属中的强场高次谐波产生进行控制与操纵。实验发现，泵浦脉冲的加入会触发由泵浦与探测光子非线性频率混合产生的边带，其强度对脉冲的相对螺旋度和偏振平面取向高度敏感，源于Weyl节点的手征特性。边带强度随泵浦-探测延迟增大而显著抑制，可作为一种电子-空穴退相干时钟。
AI.motivation: 拓扑材料为光驱动电子运动控制提供了变革性的平台，但在亚周期时间尺度上直接操纵电子动力学仍是重大挑战，需要探索新的控制与探测手段。
AI.method: 采用强场驱动的双圆偏振（bicircular）泵浦-探测方案，对Weyl半金属进行高次谐波产生（high-harmonic generation）实验，通过改变泵浦与探测脉冲的相对螺旋度和偏振平面取向来研究边带（sideband）产物的行为特征。
AI.result: 单独探测脉冲仅产生奇次谐波，而加入泵浦脉冲后产生由泵浦与探测光子非线性频率混合引发的系列边带；边带强度对脉冲相对螺旋度及偏振平面取向高度敏感，且当节点分离轴垂直于偏振平面时，Weyl节点的手征性才能与光的螺旋度有效耦合；增加泵浦-探测延迟会显著抑制边带强度。
AI.conclusion: 频率混合高次谐波产生可作为一种对手征量子动力学敏感的探测手段，并提供了通过结构化光（structured light）操纵拓扑电流的鲁棒框架，对光波电子学和无超快量子信息处理具有潜在意义。

title: Wigner Time: a data-oriented approach to experimental timeline creation for quantum science and technology
summary: Precisely timed, multi-device control in atomic, molecular and optical physics is provided by specialized real-time systems, which impose their own terms on the description of the experiment: a program over a global clock, in which every stage boundary is an absolute time computed from everything preceding it. Such descriptions are tightly coupled -- changing one stage affects all later ones -- and are correspondingly hard to reuse, inspect, or move elsewhere. We introduce Wigner Time, a Python package in which the experimental procedure is instead represented as data: a table of timed updates, assembled by composing functions and referred to named points in the experiment rather than to absolute instants. Hardware enters only at a final conversion step, leaving the description readable and back-end agnostic. Wigner Time has run two cold-atom setups for more than two years, where replacing a hand-written real-time program improved the achievable temporal resolution five-fold; the design applies to any domain requiring precise multi-device timing.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Wigner Time，一个Python包，将原子、分子与光学物理实验中的时序控制描述从"全局时钟上的程序"重构为"数据表"——即通过组合函数组装的定时更新集合，并引用命名时间点而非绝对时刻。该包已在两套冷原子装置上运行超过两年，将时间分辨率提升了五倍，且设计适用于任何需要精确多设备定时的领域。
AI.motivation: 传统实时控制系统基于全局时钟程序来描述实验，其中每阶段的边界都是根据之前所有内容计算的绝对时间，导致描述之间紧密耦合——更改一个阶段会影响所有后续阶段，使得实验程序难以复用、检查或迁移到其他平台。
AI.method: 作者提出将实验流程表示为数据而非程序：构造一个由组合函数组装、引用实验中命名点而非绝对时刻的定时更新表。硬件仅在最终转换步骤介入，从而使描述保持可读且与后端无关（back-end agnostic）。该实现以Python包形式发布，命名为Wigner Time。
AI.result: Wigner Time已在两套冷原子装置（cold-atom setups）上运行超过两年，替换手写实时程序后，可实现的时间分辨率（temporal resolution）提升了五倍。
AI.conclusion: 该设计通过解耦实验描述与硬件实现，解决了传统时序控制系统中耦合性与不可移植性的问题，其方法适用范围不限于原子、分子与光学物理，可用于任何需要精确多设备定时的领域。

title: Effects of Trotter Error, Digitization Error, and Initial State Overlap on Tapered Quantum Phase Estimation for Minimum Eigenvalue Computation
summary: We numerically implement full quantum circuits of optimal tapered Quantum Phase Estimation (in the form of an implementable approximate bandwidth-limited DPSS taper) for the purpose of minimum eigenvalue computation, where the Hamiltonian time-evolution unitary is implemented using standard Trotterization, and the taper state is constructed using an optimized bandwidth-limited taper. We illustrate, on representative quantum Hamiltonians, with tractable exact classical numerical quantum circuit simulations, how tapered QPE performs with respect to optimal phase sampling rate, absolute error, Shannon entropy of the optimal phase distribution, when the tQPE algorithm parameters are changed. Those algorithm parameters are Trotter error, finite sampling, imperfect initial states, total evolution time, and digitization error (number of phase qubits). The reported numerical experiments include up to $\ell=10$ phase qubits of precision with $m=3$ additional phase-register error suppression qubits, on a $4$-qubit Heisenberg quantum magnet model Hamiltonian, using up to 12th-order Trotterization. We numerically show i) the steady-state optimal phase sampling rate is determined by the initial state overlap with the ground-state, ii) with respect to phase sampling probability, or overall eigenvalue sampling error rate, there is no strong evolution time dependence for tQPE unless there is high Trotter error, iii) the approximated time-evolution unitaries in tQPE, like in standard QPE, can result in substantial ringing, which leads to non-physical eigenvalue estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值模拟实现了最优锥形量子相位估计（tapered Quantum Phase Estimation, tQPE）的完整量子电路，并在4量子比特海森堡量子磁体哈密顿量模型上系统研究了Trotter误差、有限采样、不完备初始态、总演化时间及相位数（digitization error）等参数对tQPE性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 量子相位估计（QPE）是求解最小特征值的关键量子算法，但其标准形式依赖于完美的初始本征态假设并在实现上存在瓶颈。本文旨在通过引入带宽受限的DPSS锥形窗（bandwidth-limited DPSS taper）构造可实现的近似最优tQPE，并对其在实际参数条件下的性能与行为进行系统的数值刻画。
AI.method: 作者数值实现了完整量子电路的最优锥形量子相位估计，其中哈密顿量时间演化酉算子采用标准Trotter化实现，锥形态由优化的带宽受限锥形构造。通过精确的经典数值量子电路模拟，系统扫描tQPE算法参数，包括Trotter误差、有限采样、不完备初始态、总演化时间及相位量子位数。实验使用了最多ℓ=10个相位量子位与m=3个额外相位寄存器误差抑制量子位，作用于4-量子比特海森堡量子磁体模型哈密顿量，并采用最高12阶Trotter化。
AI.result: 数值结果表明：(i) 稳态最优相位采样率由初始态与基态的重叠度决定；(ii) 除非存在高Trotter误差，否则tQPE的相位采样概率和总体特征值采样误差率对演化时间无强依赖性；(iii) tQPE中的近似时间演化酉算子（与标准QPE类似）可能产生显著的振铃效应（ringing），导致出现非物理的特征值估计。
AI.conclusion: tQPE在实际实现中具有良好的参数鲁棒性，但在高Trotter误差下会失去时间无关性，且近似时间演化可能引入非物理的特征值估计伪像。这为tQPE在容错量子计算前期（pre-fault-tolerant era）的实用化提供了重要的数值参考。

title: Turbulence Decay Intensifies Clustering of Bubbles and Particles
summary: Our understanding of inertial particle dynamics in turbulence is mostly based on flows held in a statistically stationary state, a particular regime that differs from many natural flows where energy input can often be intermittent or cyclic, or may abruptly cease. Here we investigate inertial particle and bubble dynamics in freely decaying turbulence through complementary experiments and direct numerical simulations. While particle accelerations decay monotonically in time, we find evidence that the clustering can exhibit a non-monotonic evolution, intensifying sharply before subsequently weakening. We demonstrate that both the acceleration and clustering behaviors can be mapped onto their counterparts in stationary turbulence using a dynamic rescaling of the evolving length and time scales of the turbulence. Validity conditions for the dynamic rescaling, satisfied by both the experimental and numerical datasets, are derived. The proposed mappings remain applicable across a broad range of density ratios, from light to heavy particles, and particle sizes spanning two orders of magnitude in Stokes number.

AI.tldr: 本文通过互补实验与直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulation, DNS），研究了自由衰减湍流中惯性粒子和气泡的动力学行为，发现粒子团簇（clustering）呈非单调演化——先急剧增强后减弱。研究表明，粒子的加速度与团簇行为均可通过动态重标度（dynamic rescaling）映射到稳态湍流中的对应结果，且该映射在宽密度比和跨两个数量级斯托克斯数（Stokes number）范围内均适用。
AI.motivation: 湍流中惯性粒子动力学的现有理解大多基于统计稳态（statistically stationary state）流动，而许多自然流动的能量输入往往是间歇性、周期性或会突然停止的，因此需要探索非稳态湍流条件下的粒子行为。
AI.method: 研究者通过互补的实验与直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulation, DNS）手段，研究了自由衰减湍流中惯性粒子与气泡的加速度和团簇动力学，并提出基于湍流演化长度与时间尺度的动态重标度方法来关联稳态湍流中的对应行为。
AI.result: 研究发现粒子加速度随时间的衰减呈单调趋势，而团簇演化呈非单调特征——先急剧增强随后减弱；同时推导出动态重标度的有效性条件，且实验与数值数据均满足该条件。该映射在从轻粒子到重粒子的宽密度比范围以及跨两个数量级的斯托克斯数范围内均保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 动态重标度方法为自由衰减湍流中的粒子动力学提供了普适描述框架，有望将现有稳态湍流理论推广至更贴近实际自然流动条件的场景。

title: Blind directions of physical learning networks: where to measure and what to measure
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code, results and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22537350
summary: A physical learning network is read at a few accessible nodes. Every task and learning rule that uses only the steady voltages and currents there, at a fixed operating point, acts through the boundary response map. Parameter changes in the kernel of its Jacobian are blind to first order. A walk along one fiber of that map had not terminated at a 600-step cap, one edge then at 15.2 times its start. A decomposition theorem splits the response Jacobian over the hidden components. The blind dimension adds over components whose surviving slots are disjoint. A boundary-to-boundary edge adds one parameter and deletes one slot. Exposing a hidden node changes only its component. For one hidden node the component's contribution counts the bipartite components of the non-adjacency graph of its neighbors. For a pocket of h hidden nodes a factor-analysis bound caps what outside electrodes can expose. It is attained when every pocket node meets every neighbor and no edge joins two of those neighbors, so past a threshold further electrodes outside such a pocket expose nothing. An electrode inside such a pocket, when its hidden nodes form a clique, is worth h-1 directions where one outside is worth none. Reading the accessible nodes as vector displacements rather than potentials left no deficit beyond counting in all 90 spring networks tested, each a pocket fully joined to five or more accessible nodes, and nothing blind at all in 88. What limits the reading is the quantity measured as much as the number of contacts. Maximum-weight spanning forests give a proved upper bound on the blind dimension. The matching equality is proved for one hidden node and conjectured beyond. The forest count matched the numerical blind dimension in 1,451 of 1,500 held-out networks, and no shortfall separates an incomplete search from a false equality. A self-learning circuit shows the split on hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文研究物理学习网络在少量可及节点处读取时的盲维数（blind dimension）问题。参数变化中位于响应雅可比（response Jacobian）核内的部分对读取不可见；作者推导了将响应雅可比按隐藏组件分解的定理，提出了基于最大权重生成森林（maximum-weight spanning forests）的盲维数上界，并通过数值实验、硬件自学习电路验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 在物理学习网络中，读取仅发生在少数可及节点，而参数调整的效果并非全部可观测——落于边界响应映射雅可比核中的参数变化对读取而言是盲的。理解这种盲维数的结构和上界，是弄清"哪些学习规则在实际中有效、可读取性受何限制"的关键。
AI.method: 作者将网络在固定工作点通过稳态电压与电流的读取过程形式化为边界响应映射（boundary response map），并分解其响应雅可比到隐藏组件上。文中提出分解定理以加和盲维数，并借助最大权重生成森林给出盲维数的可证明上界；同时分析了隐藏节点暴露、边界到边界边加入等操作对槽位（slot）结构的改变，并用最大因子分析（factor-analysis）界刻画电极的暴露能力。
AI.result: 数值实验中，在90个弹簧网络中，把可及节点读作矢量位移的方式在88个网络中完全无盲维；生成森林对盲维数的计数在1,500个留出网络中有1,451个匹配。对单个隐藏节点证明了匹配等式，对多个隐藏节点仅提出猜想。硬件上的自制学习电路验证了该分解分裂（split）在实物上的成立。
AI.conclusion: 限制物理网络可读取性的不仅是接点数量，更取决于所测量的物理量类型。盲维数可通过最大化权重生成森林结构加以界定，且其预测与数值结果高度吻合。

title: Solution-phase fluorination of nanodiamond: near-surface NV$^-$ activation and spin relaxation
summary: Nanodiamonds hosting luminescent point defects, known as fluorescent nanodiamonds (FND), are a leading platform for quantum technology. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre is the most intensively studied of these; its negatively charged state (NV$^-$) can serve as a qubit at room temperature, and its stability is governed by surface functional groups. We present two solution-phase fluorination routes for stabilising NV$^-$: direct C-F bond formation by decarboxylation with xenon difluoride via a radical mechanism, and the Balz-Schiemann reaction, which replaces surface amino groups with fluorine. The two routes were compared by infrared, X-ray photoelectron, energy-dispersive X-ray, Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy. Both gave a high NV$^-$ fraction, up to $\sim$90% on average and approaching 100% in fluorine-rich regions, which to our knowledge is among the highest reported for surface-terminated nanodiamonds of this size and, in particular, for fluorine termination. Frequency-domain relaxometry shows that the fluorinated particles retain a long spin-lattice relaxation time, $733\pm56$ and $712\pm20$ $μ$s for the XeF$_2$ and Balz-Schiemann routes, several times the values reported for commercial HPHT nanodiamonds, although shorter than the $1173\pm123$ $μ$s of the as-received material. Charge-state stability and spin lifetime therefore do not improve together: fluorination activates near-surface NV$^-$ centres, which are the most exposed to surface noise but also the ones that dominate relaxometric sensing.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出两条溶液相氟化路径——通过二氟化氙脱羧产生自由基形成C-F键，以及Balz-Schiemann反应将表面氨基替换为氟——来稳定荧光纳米金刚石的NV⁻电荷态。两种方法均实现高达约90%（平均）乃至接近100%（富氟区域）的NV⁻比例，同时保留较长的自旋晶格弛豫时间，尽管略短于未处理原料。
AI.motivation: 荧光纳米金刚石的NV⁻中心可作为室温量子比特（qubit），但其稳定性取决于表面官能团。现有手段难以在保持自旋相干性的同时高效稳定NV⁻电荷态，因此需要开发新的表面功能化路线。
AI.method: 采用两条溶液相氟化路径：其一为通过二氟化氙（XeF₂）介导的脱羧反应，经自由基机制直接形成C-F键；其二为Balz-Schiemann反应，将表面氨基替换为氟原子。通过红外光谱、X射线光电子能谱、能量色散X射线能谱、拉曼光谱和光致发光光谱对两种路线进行比较，并用频域弛豫测量评估自旋晶格弛豫时间。
AI.result: 两种氟化路线均获得高NV⁻比例，平均约90%，在富氟区域接近100%，据作者所知这在该尺寸和特别是氟端基纳米金刚石中属最高报道值之一。氟化后颗粒保留长自旋晶格弛豫时间，XeF₂路线为733±56 μs，Balz-Schiemann路线为712±20 μs，数倍于商用HPHT纳米金刚石报道值，但短于未处理原料的1173±123 μs。
AI.conclusion: 电荷态稳定性与自旋寿命不能同时改善：氟化激活了近表面NV⁻中心，这些中心虽最暴露于表面噪声，但同时也是主导弛豫传感信号的部分。两种溶液相氟化路线为稳定NV⁻提供了可行策略，但需根据应用目标在电荷稳定性与自旋相干性之间权衡。

title: Entanglement Growth as Transport Across Schmidt Scales
comment: 4.5 pages, 3 figures, with references and supplemental materials
summary: Quantum entanglement growth is commonly summarized by a single entropy, obscuring where correlations reside in the exponentially large Schmidt spectrum and how they form. Here, we introduce Schmidt-scale concentration and dominant Schmidt scale, two coordinates that locate the probability maximum across logarithmic windows in ordered Schmidt-rank space. Applied to quenches of a random-field spin chain, these coordinates distinguish rapid transport of the dominant scale to higher Schmidt rank at weak disorder from strongly suppressed transport despite continued logarithmic entropy growth at strong disorder. The disorder-averaged dynamics exhibit an ordered hierarchy: entropy production peaks first, spectral roughness and exact nonlocal magic peak next, and dominant-Schmidt-scale transport becomes typical only after a substantial delay. Moreover, a solvable head--tail model and controlled numerical experiments reveal the physical origin of this hierarchy: the spectral path determines the order of events, local dynamics on active exchange bonds set their early timing, and intra-subsystem many-body dressing further delays dominant-Schmidt-scale transport. These results establish the Schmidt-scale coordinates as powerful dynamical probes for uncovering fine-grained entanglement structures distinguishing entanglement production, entanglement-spectrum reorganization, and dominant-Schmidt-scale transport beyond entropy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文引入两个新坐标——Schmidt尺度集中度（Schmidt-scale concentration）与主导Schmidt尺度（dominant Schmidt scale）——用于在Schmidt秩空间中定位概率最大值的细粒度位置，超越单一熵指标对量子纠缠生长的粗粒度描述。应用于随机场自旋链的淬火动力学后，这些坐标揭示了纠缠熵增长、谱重组与主导Schmidt尺度输运之间存在有序的等级时序，并通过可解的头—尾模型与数值实验阐明了其物理起源。
AI.motivation: 量子纠缠增长通常仅由一个标量熵加以概括，这掩盖了关联在指数大的Schmidt谱（Schmidt spectrum）中位于何处以及如何形成的关键信息。因此需要引入能够分辨纠缠产生、谱重组与主导尺度输运的细粒度动力学探针。
AI.method: 引入Schmidt尺度集中度与主导Schmidt尺度两坐标，在有序的Schmidt秩空间的对数窗口中定位概率最大值。分别应用于随机场自旋链的弱与强无序淬火，并结合一个可解的"头—尾"（head–tail）模型与受控数值实验以验证物理机制。
AI.result: 弱无序下主导Schmidt尺度快速向高Schmidt秩输运，而强无序下该输运被强烈抑制，尽管对数熵增长仍在持续。无序平均动力学呈现有序等级：熵产生最先达到峰值，随后是谱粗糙度与精确非局域魔术（nonlocal magic），而主导Schmidt尺度输运须经显著延迟后才成为典型行为。
AI.conclusion: Schmidt尺度坐标是强有力的精细纠缠结构动力学探针，能区分熵产生、纠缠谱重组与主导Schmidt尺度输运这三种在超越单一熵指标之上的不同动力学过程。

title: Efficient Representation of multicategorical local Hilbert spaces: nonlinear Restricted Boltzmann Machines to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Neural network quantum states (NQS) for representing spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ systems are typically built from Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with binary visible variables, in which the input spins are first combined through linear affine maps before more expressive nonlinear transformations are applied. The standard way for representing multi-categorical systems, namely spin-1 and spin-2, or the q-state quantum Potts systems with more than two local degrees of freedom, is a unary or one-hot encoded MLP architecture. Following a few similar studies, I observe that while the one-hot construction is the mathematically faithful encoding for systems with more than two local states such as spin-$S$ models with $S > 1/2$ or $q$-state Potts models, its parameter count grows with the number of local states, and the resulting optimization landscape can hinder convergence. I find numerically that allowing $\log Ψ$ to be a nonlinear function of the raw multi-valued spin variable is a natural categorical generalization: it preserves the labelling freedom of the local basis and reproduces the one-hot model with strictly fewer parameters, often with improved trainability. I first benchmark this idea on shallow Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), equipping them with several distinct nonlinear connections, for spin-1, 2, and 3 Heisenberg chains. I then turn to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), where each edge carries a learnable univariate nonlinearity, and show that they provide a strictly more expressive realization of the same principle. Finally, I demonstrate that this framework captures the critical behaviour of the quantum Potts Hamiltonian, recovering its phase transition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将神经网络量子态（NQS）的log Ψ直接作为原始多值自旋变量的非线性函数进行建模，替代传统单热（one-hot）编码，以更少的参数实现等价甚至更优的表达，并在多类别自旋系统和量子Potts模型中验证了其可训练性与临界行为捕捉能力。
AI.motivation: 标准单热编码的多层感知机（MLP）在表征自旋S>1/2或q态Potts模型等多局部自由度系统时，参数数量随局部态数增长且优化景观可能阻碍收敛。因此需要一种自然的范畴化推广方案，既能保留局部基的标记自由度，又能减少参数并改善可训练性。
AI.method: 允许log Ψ成为原始多值自旋变量的非线性函数，替代单热编码输入。先在浅层受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）上配合多种非线性连接进行自旋1、2、3的海森堡链基准测试；再转向Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），其中每条边携带可学习的单变量非线性，以实现同一原理的更具表达力的版本。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，该框架以严格更少的参数再现单热模型且通常具有更好的可训练性；RBM与KAN变体均有效，且KAN提供更强的表达能力。该框架成功捕捉了量子Potts哈密頓量的临界行为，恢复其相变。
AI.conclusion: 将log Ψ构造为原始多值自旋变量的非线性函数是单热编码的一种自然的、参数高效的替代方案，在多态自旋系统中保持表达性优势，并能准确刻画量子临界现象。

title: Geometric Phases in Two-Level Mixing: From Neutral Mesons to Holonomic Qubits and Topological Majorana Modes
summary: We investigate the geometric structure of a Hermitian two-level mixing Hamiltonian motivated by neutral meson oscillations and its connections with qubit, fermionic, and topological descriptions. Mapping the Hamiltonian to an effective qubit representation, we analyze the geometric phase associated with cyclic parameter evolution on the Bloch sphere. Without identifying the complex mixing phase with a physical CP-violation observable, we interpret it as a CP-like geometric parameter controlling the azimuthal orientation of the Hamiltonian vector and its reversal under phase conjugation. Third-order Bargmann invariants constructed from the eigenstates yield an associated discrete phase whose dependence on the mixing parameters is examined alongside the continuous geometric construction. The cyclic evolution is also represented as a single-qubit $R_z$ phase operation and expressed through Majorana bilinears. Extending the construction to the momentum-dependent Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian of the Kitaev chain, we relate momentum-space winding to the topological regimes and the quantized Berry (Zak) phase in the real-parameter model, while the corresponding Bargmann construction approaches the global phase in the continuum limit. Together, these results provide a geometric perspective connecting phase structure, qubit operations, fermionic representations, and momentum-space topology within related two-level Hamiltonians.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个受中性介子振荡启发的厄米二能级混合哈密顿量的几何结构，将其映射为量子比特表示后，在布洛赫球上分析循环参数演化对应的几何相位，并将其与费米子表示、量子比特操作及动量空间拓扑性质（如Kitaev链中的Berry/Zak相位和绕数）联系起来。
AI.motivation: Motivated by neutral meson oscillations, the authors aim to uncover geometric and topological structures embedded in a Hermitian two-level mixing Hamiltonian, seeking unifying connections across qubit, fermionic, and topological frameworks.
AI.method: 将哈密顿量映射为有效量子比特表示并在布洛赫球（Bloch sphere）上分析循环演化的几何相位；利用本征态构造三阶Bargmann不变量（Bargmann invariant）获得离散相位；将循环演化表示为单量子比特的Rz相位操作，并通过Majorana双线性（Majorana bilinears）表达；进一步将构造推广到动量依赖的Kitaev链Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量。
AI.result: 混合相位被解释为类CP几何参数，控制哈密顿量矢量的方位角取向及其在相位共轭下的反转；三阶Bargmann不变量的离散相位依赖混合参数；Kitaev链中的动量空间绕数与拓扑区域及量子化Berry（Zak）相位相关联，Bargmann构造在连续极限下趋近全局相位。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了连接相位结构、量子比特操作、费米子表示与动量空间拓扑的统一几何视角，适用于相关的二能级哈密顿量系统。

title: Core-Level Spectroscopy Decodes Bond-Alternation Dynamics of Cyclo[18]Carbon
summary: The advent of X-ray free-electron lasers and high-harmonic generation has made time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy a powerful tool for probing local atomic environments, yet whether localized core excitations can report on global collective distortions remains open. Cyclo[18]carbon (C$_{18}$), with its polyynic ground state (D$_\text{9h}$) and cumulenic transition state (D$_\text{18h}$), provides an ideal model to address this long-standing issue in bond-length alternation (BLA) dynamics. Mapping two-dimensional potential energy surfaces by first-principles simulations, we find that core ionization symmetrizes the ground-state double-well potential along the BLA coordinate. Our calculated X-ray spectra reveal remarkable sensitivity to bond-length variations: C1s ionization potentials vary by up to 2.4~eV across the BLA coordinate (1.1--1.4~Å), with a 0.9~eV variation for minima predicted by different functionals, while NEXAFS $π^*$ peaks shift by up to 4~eV across the same coordinate. These predicted signatures provide a quantitative spectroscopy--structure dictionary for decoding transient structures in future ultrafast X-ray experiments and monitoring bond-alternation dynamics in real time.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理模拟映射二维势能面，发现环[18]碳（cyclo[18]carbon）的核电离（core ionization）会沿键长交替（BLA）坐标对称化基态双阱势，其X射线光谱对键长变化表现出显著敏感性（C1s电离势和NEXAFS π*峰分别有高达2.4 eV和4 eV的位移），为未来超快X射线实验中解码瞬态结构提供了定量的光谱-结构词典。
AI.motivation: 时间分辨X射线光谱虽然已成为探测局域原子环境的强大工具，但局域核激发是否能反映全局集体畸变这一问题仍然悬而未决。环[18]碳因其具有多炔基态和累积烯过渡态的独特结构，为研究键长交替动力学中的这一长期问题提供了理想模型。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理模拟（first-principles simulations）沿BLA坐标映射二维势能面，分析核电离对基态双阱势的影响，并计算X射线光谱（包括C1s电离势和NEXAFS谱）对键长变化的响应。
AI.result: 核电离使基态双阱势沿BLA坐标对称化；C1s电离势在同坐标上变化达2.4 eV，不同泛函预测的最小值间差异为0.9 eV，NEXAFS π*峰位移可达4 eV。
AI.conclusion: 所预测的光谱特征为未来超快X射线实验中解码瞬态结构提供了定量的光谱-结构词典，可用于实时监测键长交替动力学。

title: Formation of grain boundaries in ductile single crystals under plane-strain simple shear: a block-coordinate finite element method
summary: Large plastic deformation can drive an initially uniform single crystal to spontaneously subdivide into misoriented grains separated by thin dislocation walls -- a pattern-forming instability rooted in the loss of convexity of the crystal's elastic energy at large strain. We study this phenomenon for a ductile crystal in plane-strain simple shear within continuum dislocation theory, using a polyconvex (Ciarlet--Geymonat) elastic energy that guarantees existence of minimizers for the coupled deformation--slip problem. Minimizing over the plastic slip yields a condensed energy of double-well form whose non-quasiconvexity favours a lamellar microstructure; the gradient of the geometrically necessary dislocation density regularizes it, giving the grain boundaries a finite thickness and energy as functions of the misorientation angle. A block-coordinate finite element scheme -- alternating a convex non-smooth solve for the slip with a Levenberg-regularized Newton solve for the deformation -- resolves this microstructure numerically and detects its spontaneous onset, reproducing the lamellar grain structure in agreement with the closed-form analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文在连续位错理论（continuum dislocation theory）框架下，利用多凸（polyconvex）弹性能量研究延性晶体在平面应变简单剪切下因大塑性变形产生的自发晶粒细化与层状微结构（lamellar microstructure）模式失稳，并通过块坐标有限元数值方法验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 大塑性变形可使初始均匀的单晶自发细分为由薄位错墙分隔的取向错排晶粒，这是一种源于晶体弹性能量在大应变下失去凸性（convexity）的模式形成不稳定性。理解这一现象的物理机制并将其形式化描述是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 采用多凸的Ciarlet–Geymonat弹性能量以保证耦合变形-滑移问题极小元的存在性；通过对塑性滑移求极小化得到双阱（double-well）形式的凝聚能量，其非拟凸性（non-quasiconvexity）偏好层状微结构；由几何必需位错（geometrically necessary dislocation）密度的梯度提供正则化，使晶界具有依赖于错配角（misorientation angle）的有限厚度与能量。数值上采用块坐标有限元方案，交替进行凸非光滑滑移求解与Levenberg正则化牛顿变形求解。
AI.result: 数值方案成功解析了该微结构并检测到其自发出现，再现了层状晶粒结构，与闭式解析（closed-form）分析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 多凸弹性能量结合连续位错理论能够定量描述大应变下晶粒细化的位错墙形成模式失稳，且理论预测与数值模拟相互印证，验证了该框架的完备性。

title: Self-Organized Dynamic Reactors: Product-Condensate Feedback Accelerates Reactions
summary: Condensates can accelerate reactions by concentrating reactants, yet product accumulation can eliminate this advantage. We show that product-induced suppression of condensation generates rotating, deforming, and propagating condensate domains through spontaneous symmetry breaking. Their reorganization shifts reaction sites away from accumulated products while retaining reactant enrichment, yielding rates above those of static condensates and homogeneous states. Reaction flows can thus self-organize condensates into dynamic reactors, with implications for biological and synthetic systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了凝聚体（condensates）可通过产物诱导的凝聚抑制效应，在自发对称破缺（spontaneous symmetry breaking）作用下形成旋转、变形和传播的动态凝聚域，从而在保留反应物富集优势的同时避开产物积累，实现超越静态凝聚体与均相体系的反应速率。
AI.motivation: 凝聚体通过富集（concentrating）反应物来加速反应，但产物积累会消除这一优势，因此需要探究凝聚体如何应对产物积累对催化效率的负面影响。
AI.method: 通过揭示产物诱导的凝聚抑制（product-induced suppression of condensation）机制，分析凝聚域如何通过自发对称破缺实现旋转、变形和传播等动态行为。
AI.result: 动态凝聚域的重组将反应位点从积聚的产物处移开，同时保留反应物富集，使反应速率高于静态凝聚体和均相状态。
AI.conclusion: 反应流能够将凝聚体自组织（self-organize）为动态反应器（dynamic reactors），这为生物系统与合成系统提供了重要的潜在应用启示。

title: Electron beam driven collective self hybridized exciton polaritons
summary: Self-hybridized exciton polaritons in layered semiconductors emerge from the hybridization of excitonic resonances with confined photonic modes in films and provide a versatile platform for controlling light--matter interactions at the nanoscale. Yet, the nature of exciton--photon interactions and the collective and synchronous strong coupling of multiple excitons to the same photonic mode remain largely unexplored. Here, we use complementary momentum-resolved photoluminescence and cathodoluminescence spectroscopy to compare self-hybridized exciton polaritons in Ruddlesden--Popper perovskite flakes under optical and electron-beam excitation. We find that cathodoluminescence exhibits remarkably larger polaritonic level repulsion than photoluminescence, revealing an enhanced effective coupling strength under electron-beam excitation. We attribute this enhancement to the collective coherent excitation of multiple excitons by fast electrons, which couple to the same photonic mode and increase the interaction strength according to a $g_N=g_1\sqrt{N}$ scaling, with an effective number of up to $N\approx23$ coherently coupled excitonic oscillators. By reducing the electron kinetic energy, we further uncover a crossover to a partially incoherent excitation regime in which higher-order Fabry--Pérot exciton-polariton resonances disappear, leaving only the lowest polariton branches while coherent transition radiation persists. This transition arises because low-energy electrons excite excitons over extended spatial volumes, washing out the phase coherence required to sustain collective coupling and form polaritonic resonances. Our work shows that electron beams can actively modify collective light--matter coupling in layered semiconductors and establishes cathodoluminescence as a route to access excitation regimes beyond all-optical excitation schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用动量分辨光致发光（photoluminescence）和阴极发光（cathodoluminescence）光谱，系统研究了Ruddlesden–Popper钙钛矿薄片中自杂化激子极化激元（self-hybridized exciton polaritons）在不同激发方式下的强耦合行为，揭示了电子束激发可实现对多个激子集体相干耦合的主动增强，并发现低能电子激发下系统从集体相干耦合过渡到部分非相干激发的新奇物理现象。
AI.motivation: 分层半导体中的自杂化激子极化激元为纳米尺度光–物质相互作用调控提供了重要平台，但激子–光子相互作用的本质性质以及多个激子对同一光子模式的集体同步强耦合仍未得到充分探索。本文旨在利用互补的激发手段澄清这些问题。
AI.method: 采用动量分辨光致发光光谱（momentum-resolved photoluminescence）与阴极发光光谱（cathodoluminescence）这两类互补表征手段，分别对Ruddlesden–Popper钙钛矿薄片在光激发和电子束激发下的自杂化激子极化激元进行对比研究，并通过调控电子动能来探测不同激发能量制度下的系统响应。
AI.result: 研究发现阴极发光比光致发光表现出显著更大的极化激元能级排斥（level repulsion），表明电子束激发下有效耦合强度增强；这种增强源于快速电子对多个激子的集体相干激发，其耦合强度遵循g_N=g_1√N的标度关系，相干耦合的激子振子有效数量可达N≈23。当降低电子动能时，系统出现向部分非相干激发制度的转变，高阶F–P（Fabry–Pérot）激子极化激元共振消失，仅剩最低极化激元分支，而相干渡越辐射仍持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明电子束能够主动调控层状半导体中的集体光–物质耦合，确立了阴极发光作为探索超越全光学激发方案的新激发制度的手段，为理解并操纵多激子集体强耦合提供了实验基础和理论框架。

title: Mixed quantum-classical evolution in open molecular systems
summary: We consider a mixed quantum-classical formulation for open nonequilibrium molecular systems. We employ the pseudoparticle nonequilibrium Green's function (PP-NEGF) method as a fully quantum description and a starting point for introducing classical nuclear dynamics for an open system. We use this formulation to derive a density-matrix equation of motion describing the quantum-classical evolution. We compare our results with previous formulations and highlight important differences related to the nonequilibrium and open character of the molecular system. We also analyze the approximations needed to reduce full quantum-classical dynamics to the fewest-switches surface hopping (FSSH) method and show that these approximations are unreasonable when adiabatic surfaces come close to each other.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于开放非平衡分子系统的混合量子-经典（quantum-classical）表述方法，基于赝粒子非平衡格林函数（pseudoparticle nonequilibrium Green's function, PP-NEGF）方法推导了密度矩阵运动方程，并与先前的表述进行了比较，同时分析了将其简化至最少切换面跃迁（fewest-switches surface hopping, FSSH）方法所需近似的局限性。
AI.motivation: 开放非平衡分子系统的准确描述需要对核动力学进行量子-经典混合处理，但现有方法在开放性和非平衡性方面的处理存在不足，需要一种以完全量子描述为起点来系统地引入经典核动力学的框架。
AI.method: 以赝粒子非平衡格林函数（PP-NEGF）方法作为完全量子描述的基础，在此之上引入经典核动力学，从而推导出描述系统量子-经典演化的密度矩阵运动方程。
AI.result: 推导了开放系统的密度矩阵运动方程，通过与先前表述的对比突出了与分子系统非平衡和开放特性相关的重要差异；同时分析表明，当绝热面（adiabatic surfaces）彼此接近时，将全量子-经典动力学简化至最少切换面跃迁（FSSH）方法所需的近似是不合理的。
AI.conclusion: 新的量子-经典表述为开放非平衡分子系统提供了更严格的描述基础，同时揭示了FSSH方法在绝热能面接近时近似失效的根本原因。

title: Noninvasive Anisotropic Identification of Magnetic Properties in Toroidal Shaped Magnetic Steel
summary: This research proposes a model-free inverse approach for identifying the nonlinear anisotropic single-valued magnetic constitutive characteristics of soft magnetic materials from boundary measurements. Using the harmonic approximation, the internal magnetic flux density B and magnetic field strength H are independently reconstructed from the measured boundary data, thus avoiding the limitation of using a predefined parametric B--H mapping function. Subsequently, the reconstructed fields are spatially averaged along selected collection lines to recover the B--H characteristics of the principal directions. Numerical results demonstrate high reconstruction accuracy for unperturbed data and good robustness against Gaussian perturbations of the boundary measurements, with the overall mean error remaining below 5% for a 10% noise level. These results indicate that under the harmonic-field assumptions, the field-based reconstruction provides a simple and computationally efficient framework for non-invasive identification of nonlinear anisotropic magnetic constitutive characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种免模型（model-free）逆方法，利用边界测量数据辨识软磁材料非线性各向异性的单值磁本构特性（B–H关系）。通过谐波近似独立重建内部磁通密度B和磁场强度H，避免了预设参数化映射函数的局限，并在数值实验中展示了高精度与较好的噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 软磁材料的非线性各向异性磁本构特性的辨识通常依赖预定义的参数化B–H映射函数，这限制了模型的适用范围和辨识精度。本文旨在发展一种无需先验模型假设、可直接从边界测量中重建内部磁场并恢复材料本构关系的方法。
AI.method: 采用谐波近似（harmonic approximation）从边界测量数据独立重建内部磁通密度（magnetic flux density）B和磁场强度（magnetic field strength）H；随后将重建的场沿选定收集线（collection lines）进行空间平均，以恢复主方向上非线性的B–H特性曲线。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，对于无扰动数据，重建精度较高；在边界测量施加10%高斯噪声（Gaussian perturbation）扰动时，整体平均误差保持在5%以下，体现了良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 在谐波场假设下，基于场的重建方法提供了一种简单且计算高效的框架，可用于软磁材料非线性各向异性磁本构特性的非侵入式（non-invasive）辨识。

title: Human mutation field reveals an equilibrium-like structure with irreversible circulation
summary: The evolution of DNA sequences can be viewed as stochastic dynamics on a high-dimensional discrete space, but it is unclear when empirical transition biases reduce to an effective energy landscape versus retain irreducible non-equilibrium circulation. Human context-dependent mutation probabilities offer a direct test: every single-nucleotide substitution in a local context has a reverse substitution, so the logarithm of the forward-to-reverse probability ratio defines an antisymmetric field-the human mutation field. We show this field has a dominant gradient component and a smaller but reproducible curl component. Using seven-base human germline substitution probabilities, we infer an effective mutational landscape with a Siamese neural network constrained to predict only energy differences. This model predicts forward-to-reverse log-ratios for held-out mutations with a correlation of about 0.93, close to both an unconstrained predictive reference (0.948) and the empirical reversible ceiling from Hodge projection (about 0.96). Although trained only on mutation probabilities, the inferred landscape largely recovers short-word genomic composition and Chargaff reverse-complement symmetry for sequences up to length four. Deviations from equilibrium structure reveal a small but detectable nonequilibrium component: a residual irreversible circulation violating the Kolmogorov cycle condition for detailed balance, reproducible across African, Asian, and European populations, and strongest in CpG-linked cycles and CpG-transition edges, consistent with methylcytosine deamination. These results give a thermodynamic decomposition of the human mutation field: most mutation bias is organized by a local equilibrium-like energy landscape aligned with genome composition, while the residual circulation points to specific directional mutational mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究将DNA序列进化视为高维离散空间上的随机动力学，利用人类七碱基胚系置换概率检验突变偏向是否可还原为有效能量景观。研究发现人类突变场以梯度（梯度）成分为主，并伴随较小但可复现的旋量（curl）成分；通过约束为仅预测能量差异的孪生神经网络推断的有效突变景观，在保留数据上预测相关性约0.93，且能恢复短序列基因组组成和Chargaff反互补对称性。残差不可逆环流违反细致平衡的Kolmogorov循环条件，在不同人群中可复现，并与甲基胞嘧啶脱氨作用一致。
AI.motivation: DNA序列进化的经验转移偏向（empirical transition biases）何时能简化为有效能量景观（effective energy landscape）抑或保留不可约的非平衡环流，尚不明确；人类环境依赖突变概率为直接检验这一核心问题提供了数据基础。
AI.method: 利用正向与反向置换概率比值的对数定义反对称的人类突变场（human mutation field），通过赫奇分解（Hodge projection）分离梯度与旋量成分；使用孪生神经网络（Siamese neural network）约束仅预测能量差来推断有效突变景观，并将其与无约束预测基准及经验可逆上限进行比较。
AI.result: 人类突变场的优势成为梯度成分，辅以较小但可复现的旋量成分；推断景观对保留突变的预测相关性约0.93，接近无约束预测参考（0.948）与赫奇投影经验可逆上限（约0.96）。尽管仅以突变概率训练，景观大致恢复了长度至四的短寡核苷酸基因组组成及Chargaff反互补对称性；残留不可逆环流在非洲、亚洲和欧洲人群中均可复现，在CpG相关循环和CpG转换边上最强，与甲基胞嘧啶脱氨作用一致。
AI.conclusion: 人类突变场存在热力学分解：大部分突变偏向由与基因组组成对齐的局部类平衡能量景观组织，而残留环流指向如CpG脱氨等具体的定向突变机制。

title: Geometry Dependence of Error Thresholds in Two-Dimensional Toric Codes
summary: We investigate how the lattice geometry influences the error thresholds of two-dimensional toric codes. In the presence of bit- or phase-flip errors, the toric code maps onto the two-dimensional random-bond Ising model (RBIM). We determine the critical behaviour of the RBIM using replica-exchange Monte Carlo simulations. While previous studies have explored thresholds for general lattice geometries under suboptimal decoders such as minimum-weight perfect matching, the rapid development of near-optimal decoders makes resolving the ultimate, maximum-likelihood code capacity relevant. We compute these optimal error thresholds on the Nishimori line for the square, honeycomb, triangular, dice, and kagome lattices. Owing to lattice duality, the phase-flip threshold on a given lattice is equivalent to the bit-flip threshold on its dual. We find that the optimal thresholds of dual-lattice pairs display a characteristic duality-driven splitting around the self-dual square-lattice, mirroring the qualitative behaviour observed for suboptimal decoders. While the average coordination number has the strongest impact on the error threshold, our results demonstrate that the detailed arrangement of vertices and plaquettes also plays a significant role in determining its precise value.

AI.tldr: 本文通过复本交换蒙特卡洛（replica-exchange Monte Carlo）模拟，研究了二维环形码在不同晶格几何（方形、蜂巢、三角、骰子、kagome）上的最大似然最优错误阈值。研究发现对偶晶格对在阈值上呈现围绕自对偶方形晶格的典型分裂模式，且晶格的平均配位数对阈值影响最大，但顶点和胞的具体排列也显著影响精确阈值。
AI.motivation: 随着近最优解码器（near-optimal decoders）的快速发展，解析环形码在最大似然码容量（maximum-likelihood code capacity）定义下的极限错误阈值变得愈发重要。此前研究仅在次最优解码器（如最小权重完美匹配）框架下探讨了不同晶格几何的阈值，缺少对最优阈值的系统解析。
AI.method: 在比特翻转或相位翻转错误存在下，将环形码映射为二维随机键伊辛模型（random-bond Ising model, RBIM），并在Nishimori线上利用复本交换蒙特卡洛（replica-exchange Monte Carlo）模拟确定其临界行为。对square、honeycomb、triangular、dice和kagome五种晶格计算最优错误阈值，并利用晶格对偶性将某晶格的相位翻转阈值与其对偶晶格的比特翻转阈值相关联。
AI.result: 对偶晶格对的阈值呈现围绕自对偶方形晶格的特征性分裂行为，与次最优解码器下观察到的定性趋势一致。平均配位数（average coordination number）对错误阈值影响最强，但晶格中顶点与胞的具体排列方式对阈值的精确数值也起重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 不同二维晶格的拓扑错误纠正能力不仅取决于粗粒度的平均配位数，还对晶格微观排列细节敏感；对偶性提供了系统化理解各晶格最优阈值关系的框架。

title: Microwave-Free $^{13}$C Hyperpolarization of Diamond Particles Enabled by Magic Angle Spinning and NV Centers
comment: 64 pages (38 main text + 26 SI), 26 figures (9 main text + 17 SI)
summary: Nuclear hyperpolarization from optically pumped color centers in solids offers an alternative to conventional microwave-driven dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP). Diamond can host the nitrogen vacancy (NV) center, whose ground spin state can be readily polarized by light at room temperature, making diamond a candidate platform for nuclear hyperpolarization.
