We report $^{13}{\rm C}$ nuclear hyperpolarization in randomly oriented diamond particles with sizes ranging from 0.2 to 2 $μ$m, both at natural $^{13}{\rm C}$ abundance (1.1 %) and at 20 % isotopic enrichment, at magnetic fields of 7.1 T and 9.4 T. The protocol combines optical illumination with magic angle spinning (MAS) and does not require microwave irradiation. By investigating the nuclear polarization as a function of the MAS frequency between 0 and 6 kHz at the magnetic field of 7.1 T, we find maximum light-induced polarization enhancements of $280$-fold for the isotopically enriched sample and $411$-fold for the natural abundance sample. Under continuous illumination, steady-state absolute $^{13}{\rm C}$ polarization levels above 0.1 % are reached. A model involving optical pumping of NV centers and spin dynamics near level anticrossings (LACs) in three-spin clusters formed by NV, a substitutional nitrogen (P1) and $^{13}{\rm C}$ is used to describe these findings. The protocol strongly mitigates the effect of the anisotropy of the NV spin Hamiltonian, allowing more than $99.9\%$ of NV orientations to participate in the polarization transfer process. These results represent a first step toward transferring nuclear polarization from diamond particles to external nuclei, with potential applications in sensitive and high-resolution NMR at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在随机取向的金刚石颗粒中通过光泵浦NV色心实现13C核超极化，无需微波辐射，在MAS条件下在7.1T和9.4T磁场下对天然丰度和同位素富集样品分别实现了411倍和280倍的极化增强，稳态绝对极化水平超过0.1%。
AI.motivation: 核超极化是提升核磁共振灵敏度的关键途径，传统方法依赖微波驱动的动态核极化（DNP）。光学泵浦固体中色心的核超极化提供了一种免微波的替代方案，金刚石中的NV色心可在室温下通过光实现基态自旋极化，有望成为核超极化平台。
AI.method: 本研究采用光学照明与魔角旋转（magic angle spinning, MAS）相结合的方案，对粒径0.2至2 μm的随机取向金刚石颗粒进行实验，在7.1T和9.4T磁场下，于天然13C丰度（1.1%）及20%同位素富集样品中实现核超极化，过程中无需微波辐照。作者通过调节MAS频率（0至6 kHz）测量核极化随频率的变化，并利用由NV、取代氮P1和13C形成三自旋团簇在能级反交叉（level anticrossings, LACs）附近的光泵浦与自旋动力学模型来解释实验结果。
AI.result: 在7.1T磁场下，天然丰度样品获得411倍的最大光致极化增强，同位素富集样品获得280倍增强；在持续光照条件下，稳态绝对13C极化水平超过0.1%。该协议显著缓解了NV自旋哈密顿量的各向异性效应，使超过99.9%的NV取向参与极化转移过程。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为从金刚石颗粒向外部原子核转移核极化迈出了第一步，有望应用于室温下的高灵敏度和高分辨率核磁共振（NMR）领域。

title: Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery
summary: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does not necessarily reduce maximum regret, whereas Q90-UCB and expected improvement (EI) substantially reduce regret by directing evaluations toward regions that determine the optimizer's decisions. On MADE, controls receiving high-fidelity feedback after every episode require $6.36$--$7.23\times$ more oracle queries to match Online EI under two LLM orchestrators and $10.27\times$ more under the non-LLM Chemeleon+MLIP workflow. Online surrogate repair introduces a novel third feedback regime between fixed-surrogate operation and high-fidelity feedback after every episode, separating the frequency of high-fidelity evaluation from the duration of the agent's search.

AI.tldr: 提出在线替代模型修复（online surrogate repair, OSR）算法，在主要由低成本的替代模型反馈驱动的长程智能体搜索中，稀疏地引入高保真评估来更新替代模型，并通过采集规则选择关键设计进行高保真标注，从而在不显著增加昂贵评估次数的前提下降低优化遗憾。
AI.motivation: 闭环AI科学家能以极低的边际计算成本生成候选设计，但可靠的反馈往往需要湿实验室合成、表征或高保真计算；通过定制实验室自动化来应对这种不平衡代价高昂，而用固定替代模型替代新实验则会使模型误差被优化过程放大。
AI.method: 提出OSR闭环算法：在主要以廉价替代模型反馈驱动的长程智能体搜索过程中，通过一个采集规则（acquisition rule）从智能体累积提出的设计中挑选部分设计进行高保真评估，利用获得的标签更新后续情节（episode）中使用的替代模型。
AI.result: 在受控合成环境中，改善全局替代模型拟合不一定降低最大遗憾（regret），而Q90-UCB与期望提升（expected improvement, EI）通过将评估导向决定优化器决策的区域显著降低遗憾；在MADE基准上，每情节后均接收高保真反馈的控制组需多消耗6.36–7.23倍oracle查询（在两种LLM编排器下）及10.27倍（在非LLM的Chemeleon+MLIP流程下）才能匹敌在线EI的性能。
AI.conclusion: OSR引入了介于固定替代模型运行与每情节均提供高保真反馈之间的第三种反馈机制，将高保真评估的频率与智能体搜索的持续时间解耦，为闭环AI科学家提供了一种更高效的反馈资源配置方案。

title: Thermodynamic Cyclic Processes with Markov Samplers in Bayesian Inference
summary: The concept of Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) cycles, an analogy to cyclic processes in heat engines, is presented in order to examine Bayesian inference problems. In this effort, we develop adaptive ensemble schedulers that allow the tuning of external parameters of a Bayesian canonical ensemble during an MCMC run, realising the MCMC cycles in practice. We run these cycles on different statistical models. As a fundamental insight, we find (both theoretically and in practice) that such systems can produce a non-zero net work output if and only if the considered model is non-Gaussian. As such, they may serve as a measure of non-Gaussianity in Bayesian inference, which we test on an example from supernova cosmology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛循环（MCMC cycles）的概念，将其类比于热机中的循环过程，用于研究贝叶斯推断（Bayesian inference）问题。作者开发了自适应系综调度器（adaptive ensemble schedulers），在MCMC运行期间调节贝叶斯正则系综（Bayesian canonical ensemble）的外部参数，并在不同统计模型上运行这些循环。核心发现是：当且仅当所考虑的模型非高斯（non-Gaussian）时，该系统才能产生非零净功输出，因此可作为贝叶斯推断中非高斯性的一种度量，并在超新星宇宙学（supernova cosmology）的实例上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 将贝叶斯推断与热力学循环过程建立类比，借鉴热机中循环过程的成熟理论来理解贝叶斯推断中的不确定性结构。
AI.method: 提出MCMC循环概念并开发自适应系综调度器，在MCMC运行过程中动态调节贝叶斯正则系综的外部参数，从而在实际计算中实现MCMC循环；在多种统计模型上运行这些循环，并从理论与实践两方面考察系统的净功输出。
AI.result: 从理论和实践两方面均发现，系统只有在所考虑的模型为非高斯分布时才能产生非零的净功输出；该性质可被用作贝叶斯推断中非高斯性的度量，并在超新星宇宙学的实例上得到了测试。
AI.conclusion: MCMC循环及其净功输出特性为贝叶斯推断提供了一种新的非高斯性度量工具，表明热力学类比在统计推断问题中具有理论价值与实际应用前景。

title: Restricted typicality in non-equilibrium quantum many-body systems
summary: Characterizing the time evolution of generic quantum many-body systems is a fundamental challenge, as representing the exact state requires exponentially scaling computational resources. While hydrodynamics and statistical mechanics successfully simplify this task by predicting the expectation values of local observables, these macroscopic frameworks provide no information about nonlinear characteristics of the quantum state. In this work, we demonstrate that for systems exhibiting a timescale separation, with dynamics governed by the transport of conserved charges, this lost information can be systematically recovered. By constraining the maximum-entropy Scrooge ensemble solely by the system's slow modes, we accurately reconstruct complex, nonlinear quantum properties of the global time-evolved state, including the half-chain entanglement entropy and the participation entropy in the computational basis. Our results generalize the paradigm of canonical typicality, revealing that a hydrodynamically bottlenecked system behaves as a typical pure state within a dynamically restricted submanifold of the Hilbert space - a phenomenon we term global restricted typicality.

AI.tldr: 本文证明可通过仅约束系统慢模的最大熵Scrooge系综，系统地恢复由守恒荷输运主导的时间演化量子多体态中的非线性量子特性（如半链纠缠熵和计算基中的参与熵），从而将典型性范式推广为"全局受限典型性"（global restricted typicality）。
AI.motivation: 精确描述通用量子多体系统的时间演化需要指数级增长的资源，而流体力学和统计力学虽能预测局域可观测量期望值，却无法提供量子态的非线性特征信息。
AI.method: 针对存在时间尺度分离（timescale separation）且动力学由守恒荷输运主导的系统，采用仅约束慢模（slow modes）的最大熵Scrooge系综（maximum-entropy Scrooge ensemble）来重建全局时间演化态的复杂非线性量子性质。
AI.result: 该方法能够准确重建半链纠缠熵（half-chain entanglement entropy）和计算基中的参与熵（participation entropy）等非线性量子性质，表明流体动力学瓶颈系统表现得如同希尔伯特空间中动态受限子流形内的典型纯态。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将典型典型性（canonical typicality）范式推广至更一般情形，提出"全局受限典型性"这一新现象，为从宏观流体动力学框架恢复微观量子态非线性信息提供了系统化途径。

title: Quantum-Geometric Meissner Effect in Magnetized Color Superconductors
summary: We find a quantum-geometric Meissner response in magnetized two-flavor color-superconducting (2SC) quark matter. Landau quantization quenches the transverse quasiparticle dispersion, suppressing the conventional Fermi-surface contribution and giving rise to a Meissner response governed by the quantum geometry of the Landau levels. In the strong-field regime, the response becomes dominated by the quantum metric of the lowest Landau level (LLL), and the leading scaling of the transverse Meissner mass is consequently set by the pairing gap, in contrast to the chemical potential scaling of conventional color superconductors. This unconventional scaling has a topological origin, as the LLL quantum metric is constrained by its Chern number. The reduced transverse Meissner mass provides potential implications for kHz quasi-periodic oscillations in magnetars.

AI.tldr: 本文在磁化的双味色超导（2SC）夸克物质中发现了一种量子几何迈斯纳响应。朗道量子化抑制了横向准粒子色散，使传统费米面贡献被压制，迈斯纳响应由朗道能级的量子几何主导；强场极限下响应由最低朗道能级（LLL）的量子度量支配，横向迈斯纳质量的主要标度由配对能隙决定，而非化学势，该非传统标度具有拓扑起源。
AI.motivation: 传统色超导的迈斯纳质量由化学势标度决定，然而在强磁场下朗道量子化会重塑费米面性质，因此需要研究磁场对色超导迈斯纳响应的量子几何修正及其拓扑起源。
AI.method: 在磁化的双味色超导夸克物质框架中，引入朗道量子化（Landau quantization）来求解横向准粒子色散，并计算包含量子几何贡献的迈斯纳项；在强场极限下提取最低朗道能级的量子度量（quantum metric）作用，并分析其与陈数（Chern number）的关系。
AI.result: 结果表明，朗道量子化抑制了传统费米面对迈斯纳响应的贡献，强场区域响应由最低朗道能级的量子度量主导；横向迈斯纳质量的主要标度由配对能隙给出，而非化学势。该标度具有拓扑起源，源于最低朗道能级量子度量受其陈数约束。
AI.conclusion: 这一缩小的横向迈斯纳质量对磁星（magnetar）中kHz准周期振荡具有潜在意义。

title: Transcription rate dynamics and RNA copy number noise: General relations and data-driven predictions
summary: Stochastic models of gene expression typically begin with a microscopic model of transcription and propagate its statistics to the RNA distribution. Here we develop a doubly stochastic framework in which RNA production is Poisson conditional on a time-varying transcription rate $λ(t)$. For RNA lifetimes drawn independently from an arbitrary finite-mean distribution, we derive the RNA Fano factor in terms of the lifetime survival function and the autocovariance of $λ(t)$. For a Poisson degradation process with rate $μ$, the survival kernel provides an exponential temporal filter, and the result depends only on the mean, variance, and normalized autocorrelation of $λ(t)$. These quantities may be calculated from an explicit rate model or, under ergodicity and adequate sampling, estimated from a sufficiently long rate trajectory. We validate the data-driven estimator using simulated transcription-rate trajectories, without supplying the known autocorrelation to the estimator. We also obtain exact analytical results for transcription-rate dynamics modeled by a discrete M/M/1 process and by drift-diffusion with reflecting, periodic, or first-passage-reset boundaries, and verify each result by direct simulation of the coupled transcription-rate and RNA copy-number processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双重随机（doubly stochastic）框架，将RNA产生视为以时变转录率$\lambda(t)$为条件的泊松过程，推导出RNA Fano因子仅依赖于寿命生存函数与$\lambda(t)$的自协方差；当衰变本身为泊松过程时，结果进一步简化为仅依赖$\lambda(t)$的均值、方差和归一化自相关，并可通过长时间速率轨迹估计。作者对多种转录率动力学模型（M/M/1过程、含不同边界条件的漂移扩散）获得了精确解析结果，并通过耦合模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 基因表达的随机模型通常从转录的微观模型出发，将统计性质传播到RNA分布，但缺乏一个能统一处理任意寿命分布与时变转录率之间关联的通用框架。本文旨在建立一种双重随机框架，以明确RNA Fano因子与转录率波动统计量之间的解析关系，从而减少对特定微观模型的依赖。
AI.method: 作者将RNA产生建模为以时变转录率$\lambda(t)$为条件的泊松过程，对任意有限均值分布的独立RNA寿命，推导Fano因子的表达式，涉及寿命生存函数与$\lambda(t)$的自协方差。对于泊松衰变（速率$\mu$）的情况，生存核退化为指数时间滤波器，结果仅需$\lambda(t)$的均值、方差与归一化自相关。文中进一步利用显式速率模型或从足够长的速率轨迹中估计这些量，并用模拟轨迹验证数据驱动估计器；还对服从离散M/M/1过程及具有反射、周期或首触复位边界的漂移-扩散转录率模型给出精确解析结果，并用耦合模拟验证。
AI.result: 推导出RNA Fano因子的一般表达式（依赖于寿命生存函数与$\lambda(t)$自协方差），并对泊松衰变情形获得仅依赖$\lambda(t)$的一阶与二阶统计量的简洁结果。数据驱动估计器在无需预知自相关的条件下，利用模拟转录率轨迹即能有效估计相关量。对M/M/1过程及各类边界条件的漂移-扩散模型均获精确解析结果，并经直接耦合模拟验证。
AI.conclusion: 该双重随机框架阐明了RNA数量噪声（Fano因子）与时变转录率自相关结构之间的定量联系，并提供了既可解析推导又可数据驱动的统一估计途径。在遍历性（ergodicity）假设下，仅凭足够长的转录率轨迹即可推得RNA分布的噪声特征，为从实验观测推断基因表达噪声来源提供了方法论基础。

title: Capacitance of Undoped Thin-Film Diodes
summary: The capacitance of thin-film diodes based on undoped semiconductors are dominated by injected charge carriers rather than doping-induced carriers. However, an analytical framework of the capacitance in these devices has remained elusive. Here, we derive an analytical description of the capacitance, fully accounting for injected charge carrier and electrode charge effects. Based on these findings, a method to extract the built-in voltage in these devices is presented. The theoretical framework is substantiated numerically by drift-diffusion simulations and experimentally on organic solar cells.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个解析框架，用于准确描述基于本征半导体的薄膜二极管电容，全面计入注入载流子与电极电荷效应，并据此给出内建电压提取方法，理论上通过漂移-扩散模拟验证、实验上在有机太阳能电池中得到证实。
AI.motivation: 未掺杂半导体薄膜二极管的电容由注入载流子主导而非掺杂诱导载流子主导，然而此前缺乏相应的解析理论框架来描述此类器件的电容行为。
AI.method: 推导了完全计入注入载流子与电极电荷效应的电容解析表达式，并基于该理论提出一种提取内建电压（built-in voltage）的方法；理论框架通过漂移-扩散模拟（drift-diffusion simulations）及有机太阳能电池实验进行验证。
AI.result: 所提出的解析电容理论在数值模拟与实验层面均得到验证，能够有效支撑内建电压的提取。
AI.conclusion: 该解析框架填补了本征半导体薄膜二极管电容理论分析的空白，并为相关器件内建电压的测定提供了可行手段。

title: Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. We provide a mechanistic explanation and experimental evidence for why wavelet encodings are well matched to the dual spatial-spectral structure of the FNO, enabling deterministic mode selection on both continuous-valued and binary-valued geometries within a single model, and for why prediction accuracy varies with geometric discontinuities. For metamaterial design, the resulting surrogate accelerates the simulation stage of the design cycle by three orders of magnitude relative to finite element analysis on a consumer-grade CPU, while preserving high fidelity. These results also carry broader implications for designing input encodings in other multi-mode PDE solvers based on spectral neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文证明将傅里叶神经算子（Fourier Neural Operator, FNO）与小波基输入编码相结合，能够学习并预测弹性波方程在任意超材料几何中的多个本征模，并在超材料设计中将仿真速度比有限元分析加速三个数量级。
AI.motivation: 本征值问题（eigenvalue problem）需要同时求解本征参数和多个可能的本征模，但标准的算子学习（operator learning）框架假设输入输出映射是唯一的，因此难以处理这类多模问题。作者旨在探讨神经算子能否突破这一限制，实现多本征模的同时预测。
AI.method: 采用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）作为核心架构，将偏微分方程输入通过小波基（wavelet-based）编码处理，实现在同一模型中对弹性波动方程多个本征模的确定性选择。研究同时提供了机理分析，阐释小波编码与FNO双重空间-谱结构之间的匹配关系。
AI.result: 实验结果证明该框架能够对连续值和二值化几何同时在单一模型中预测多个本征模，且预测精度随几何不连续性的变化而有差异。在超材料设计应用中，该代理模型的仿真阶段相比消费级CPU上的有限元分析加速约三个数量级，同时保持较高保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅为FNO结合多模本征值问题提供了实验与机制的证明，也对其他基于谱神经算子的多模PDE求解器中的输入编码设计具有更广泛的启发意义。

title: Physics of Information Geometry - Part I: Principle of Least Action on the Probability Simplex
summary: We develop a least-action framework for describing how a probability distribution can evolve from an equilibrium state to a prescribed nonequilibrium state under constrained incremental changes. Taking a Gibbs distribution as the equilibrium reference, the framework gives a direct physical meaning to the geometry of the probability simplex: distance from equilibrium corresponds to nonequilibrium free energy, while changes between successive distributions carry an informational kinetic cost. The Pythagorean structure of relative entropy then provides the central insight of the work. It shows that intermediate distributions chosen via sequential information projections can reduce the kinetic cost of large transitions and establishes an energy-conservation-like relation between the kinetic expenditure along a path and the free energy accumulated in reaching the target distribution. Motivated by this geometry, we construct a greedy least-action path through successive information projections, obtain a closed-form characterization of each projection through the Lambert W function, and establish a finite-step performance guarantee. We further show that state-dependent costs can be incorporated naturally by reshaping the underlying Gibbs reference, providing a thermodynamic interpretation of path penalties as modifications of the effective energy landscape. Together, these results provide a unified view of distributional evolution through least action, information geometry, and nonequilibrium thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个最小作用量（least-action）框架，描述概率分布在约束下从平衡态演化到指定非平衡态的过程，将概率单纯形的几何与自由能、动力学代价联系起来，并通过逐次信息投影构造贪心路径，利用Lambert W函数给出闭式解与有限步性能保证。
AI.motivation: 作者希望统一分布演化、信息几何与非平衡热力学（nonequilibrium thermodynamics）的视角，解决在大尺度分布转移中如何优化中间路径以降低动力学代价的根本问题，并赋予概率单纯形几何以直接的物理意义。
AI.method: 以吉布斯分布（Gibbs distribution）为平衡参考建立最小作用量框架；利用相对熵的毕达哥拉斯结构（Pythagorean structure）构造逐次信息投影（sequential information projections）的贪心最小作用量路径；通过Lambert W函数获得每次投影的闭式刻画并建立有限步性能保证；通过重塑底层吉布斯参考将状态依赖代价纳入框架。
AI.result: 该框架揭示距离平衡态对应非平衡自由能（nonequilibrium free energy），分布间变化携带信息学动力学代价；逐次信息投影选择的中间分布可降低大转移的动力学代价，并建立路径动力学消耗与目标分布自由能积累之间的能量守恒类关系；状态相关代价可通过改变有效能量景观进行热力学解释。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果共同提供了分布演化的统一视角，融合最小作用量原理、信息几何与非平衡热力学，为受约束的非平衡分布转移问题给出几何上可解释且计算上可操作的解决方案。

title: Instantaneous-Frame Theory of Strongly Driven Parametric Gates
summary: Parametric two-qubit gates using tunable couplers are a promising approach to scalable superconducting quantum processors. However, conventional theories formulated in the idle eigenbasis break down in the large-amplitude regime required for fast gate operations. Here, we show that parametric gates are more naturally and accurately described as coherent rotations between instantaneous eigenstates rather than idle eigenstates. This approach may appear counterintuitive, since instantaneous eigenbases are usually associated with adiabatic dynamics. However, they also form a natural moving frame for driven dynamics, where the non-Abelian Berry connection governs transitions and provides a compact description of the exchange and effective $ZZ$ couplings. We show that this theory achieves quantitative agreement with exact numerical simulations across representative tunable-coupler architectures, including double-transmon, capacitively shunted double-transmon, and single-transmon couplers. The description remains accurate even in regimes where idle-frame descriptions fail, while substantially reducing the reliance on computationally demanding exact simulations. These results establish an instantaneous-frame theory of parametric gates beyond conventional idle-frame models and provide a new perspective on driven quantum dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种描述可调耦合器参数化两比特门（parametric two-qubit gates）的瞬时本征参考系（instantaneous eigenframe）理论，证明参数化门应被描述为瞬时本征态之间的相干转动而非静止本征态，并通过非阿贝尔Berry联络对交换耦合和有效ZZ耦合给出紧凑描述，在多种可调耦合器架构中与精确数值模拟定量一致。
AI.motivation: 传统的静止本征基（idle eigenbasis）理论在大振幅快速门操作区间失效，而快速可扩展的超导量子处理器需要精确的门的理论描述来描述参数化两比特门。
AI.method: 将参数化门重新表述为瞬时本征态（instantaneous eigenstates）之间的相干转动，利用非阿贝尔Berry联络（non-Abelian Berry connection）统一描述交换耦合与有效ZZ耦合；并在双transmon、电容分流双transmon、单transmon耦合器等多种可调耦合器架构中与精确数值模拟进行对比验证。
AI.result: 理论在多种代表性可调耦合器架构中与精确数值模拟达到定量一致，即使在静止参考系描述失效的区间依然保持准确，同时大幅降低对昂贵精确模拟的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了超越传统静止本征模型的参数化门瞬时参考系理论，为受驱动量子动力学提供了新视角。

title: Non-Markovian dynamics of a qubit on the zigzag edge of photonic graphene
summary: We present an analytical study of the dynamics of a qubit coupled to the zigzag edge of a photonic honeycomb lattice. Leveraging a resolvent operator approach and exact lattice Green's functions, we map the spectrum of qubit-photon bound states and complex poles to uncover the long-time scaling laws of the qubit population. Unlike a qubit coupled to the bulk of graphene, the presence of a zero-energy flat band connecting the Dirac points suppresses long-time branch-cut-induced tails, instead driving damped Rabi oscillations. Potential experimental platforms are briefly discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文采用解析方法研究了与光子蜂窝晶格（photonic honeycomb lattice）之字型边缘（zigzag edge）耦合的量子比特动力学，利用求解算符方法和精确晶格格林函数，揭示了量子比特-光子束缚态谱及复极点，发现零能平带（zero-energy flat band）的存在抑制了长期分支切割诱导的尾效应，转而驱动阻尼拉比振荡（damped Rabi oscillations）。
AI.motivation: 此前研究中量子比特与石墨烯体相（bulk）耦合的行为已被理解，但量子比特与蜂窝晶格边缘耦合的动力学行为尚未得到系统解析刻画。理解边缘态（尤其是零能平带）对量子比特弛豫和振荡动力学的影响，对于拓扑光子学与量子光学界面的理论发展具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用求解算符（resolvent operator）方法，结合精确晶格格林函数（exact lattice Green's functions），对量子比特与光子之字型边缘耦合的束缚态谱及复极点进行映射，由此推导量子比特布居数的长期标度律（long-time scaling laws）。
AI.result: 与量子比特耦合石墨烯体相的情形不同，连接狄拉克点（Dirac points）的零能平带的存在抑制了长期分支切割（branch cut）诱导的幂律衰减尾效应，取而代之的是阻尼拉比振荡行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了量子比特与蜂窝光子晶格边缘耦合时由平带驱动的振荡动力学特征，并简要讨论了潜在实验平台的可行性。

title: MLIP Detective: Active Failure Mode Discovery Beyond Benchmark Scores for Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (u-MLIPs) aim to generalize across diverse configurations. Benchmarks enable reproducible evaluation but may not expose failures outside their predefined scope. Here, we show that physics-informed search can complement benchmark-based evaluation by uncovering hidden failure modes. We introduce MLIP Detective, an agentic framework for active failure mode discovery. Starting from benchmark evidence, MLIP Detective generates falsifiable, physics-informed failure hypotheses, screens them with inexpensive simulations, and escalates only the most suspicious cases to human experts together with proposed verification protocols. Without issue-specific prompting, MLIP Detective identified and characterized a systematic anomaly in MACE-MPA-0: the model predicted some relaxed adsorbate-surface systems involving O- or F-containing adsorbates to be higher in energy than their corresponding separated fragments. Using cross-model comparisons, MLIP Detective further inferred a likely training-data origin for the anomaly, consistent with recent reports.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MLIP Detective的智能体框架（agentic framework），用于主动发现通用机器学习原子间势（u-MLIPs，universal machine-learning interatomic potentials）中的隐藏失效模式，以补充基于基准测试的评估方法之不足。
AI.motivation: 基准测试虽能实现可重复的评估，但可能无法暴露其预定义范围之外的失效情形，因此需要一种超越基准驱动的物理启发性方法来发现通用机器学习原子间势的隐藏失效模式。
AI.method: MLIP Detective是一个主动失效模式发现框架：从基准测试证据出发，生成可证伪的物理论驱动的失效假设，通过低成本模拟进行筛选，仅将最可疑的案例连同所提议的验证协议上报给人类专家。
AI.result: 在无需针对特定问题的提示条件下，MLIP Detective识别并刻画了MACE-MPA-0中的一个系统性异常：该模型预测某些含O或F吸附质的弛豫吸附物-表面体系能量高于相应的分离碎片。进一步通过跨模型比较，MLIP Detective推断出该异常可能的训练数据来源，与近期报道一致。
AI.conclusion: 物理启发的搜索可以互补基准测试评估，有效揭露基准之外隐藏的失败模式，为通用机器学习原子间势的可靠评估提供了新途径。

title: Magic-free coexisting photonic and phononic moiré flat bands
summary: Moiré flat bands enhance localization and interactions through suppressed group velocity, but existing approaches largely target a single physical field because distinct excitations generally require different, finely tuned magic configurations. Here we introduce a flat-band mechanism based on strong diffractive hybridization among moiré-folded bands. Period-mismatched modulations open distinct coupling channels whose hybridization renormalizes the band dispersion. An effective Hamiltonian shows that increasing the diffractive coupling progressively suppresses the group velocity, driving the system toward a flat-band regime without field-specific magic configurations. This coupling-induced mechanism enables band flattening across distinct physical excitations. We demonstrate this mechanism in a single-layer moiré optomechanical crystal, where photonic and phononic flat bands are simultaneously realized, and their localized modes and optomechanical interaction are experimentally observed. Beyond photonic and phononic systems, this mechanism may extend to other wave and quasiparticle platforms, providing a general route to co-localizing and coupling distinct physical fields in moiré systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于莫尔折叠能带间强衍射杂化（diffractive hybridization）的平带（flat band）机制，无需针对特定物理场调谐的魔法（magic）构型，即可在不同物理激发中实现带平坦化，并在单层莫尔光机晶体中同时实现光子和声子平带并实验观测其局域模式与光机相互作用。
AI.motivation: 莫尔平带通过抑制群速度增强局域化和相互作用，但现有方法多针对单一物理场，因为不同的激发通常需要不同且精细调谐的魔法构型，缺乏通用机制。
AI.method: 引入基于莫尔折叠带间的强衍射杂化的平带机制：周期性失配的调制打开不同耦合通道，其杂化重整化带色散；通过有效哈密顿量（effective Hamiltonian）证明增大衍射耦合会逐步抑制群速度，驱动系统进入平带区域。该机制在单层莫尔光机晶体中得到实验验证。
AI.result: 在单层莫尔光机晶体中同时实现了光子平带和声子平带，并实验观测到对应的局域模式及光机相互作用，证明耦合诱导的平带机制可跨越不同物理激发类型。
AI.conclusion: 该机制提供了在莫尔系统中共局域化并耦合不同物理场的一般性路径，可能扩展到其他波和准粒子平台（如光子、声子系统之外）。

title: Structure-Informed Bayesian Inference of Anomalous Transport and Hidden Molecular Trapping in Amorphous Media
comment: 26 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Open-source code and reproducibility data are publicly available on GitHub and Zenodo
summary: Molecular diffusion in fluctuating amorphous and macromolecular media governs key transport processes across soft-matter physics, energy storage, and biological membranes. Extracting localized trapping states from single-particle tracking trajectories remains a fundamental challenge; because thermal structural breathing continuously reconfigures pore boundaries, conventional geometric algorithms suffer from severe systematic biases, erroneously merging distinct localized states during cyclic molecular returns. Here, we address this deadlock by shifting the paradigm from local geometric recurrence to a structure-informed Bayesian regularization. Leveraging discrete Morse theory, we extract the time-invariant topological skeleton of the fluctuating host matrix to construct robust, gas-specific physical priors that account for individual molecular dimensions. Trajectory steps are sequentially partitioned via a two-stage probabilistic refinement that dynamically adapts to the transport landscape. Benchmarked against a rigorous environment where synthetic particles explore the actual interconnected matrix graph, our approach eliminates systemic biases, restricting macroscopic trapping parameter deviations to just a few percent under optimal linear $O(N)$ computational scaling. Applied to hydrogen and methane transport within a type-I kerogen matrix, serving as a prototype for highly tortuous, flexible macromolecular networks, the method successfully decodes the hidden microscopic mechanisms of confined diffusion. To ensure immediate broad impact, the documented open-source code and data are made publicly available, offering an accessible strategy readily adaptable to a broad spectrum of tracking phenomena, from ion transport in battery polymers to protein trafficking within cellular environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于结构信息的贝叶斯正则化方法（Bayesian regularization），利用离散Morse理论（discrete Morse theory）提取波动介质中与时间无关的拓扑骨架来构建物理先验，从而在单粒子追踪轨迹中准确提取局域捕获态，消除了传统几何方法在循环分子返回时不当合并局域态的系统性偏差，并将误差限制在几个百分点以内，同时保持最优的线性O(N)计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在波动的无定形和大分子介质中，分子扩散控制着软物质物理、能量存储和生物膜中的关键传输过程，但传统几何算法因热结构呼吸持续重构孔隙边界而产生严重系统偏差，无法从单粒子追踪轨迹中准确提取局域捕获态。
AI.method: 该工作将范式从局部几何递归转移到结构信息驱动的贝叶斯正则化：利用离散Morse理论提取波动宿主基质的时不变拓扑骨架以构建针对气体的物理先验，考虑单个分子尺寸；随后通过两阶段概率精细化过程对轨迹步骤进行顺序分割，动态适应输运景观。
AI.result: 在与合成粒子探索实际互联基质图的严格基准环境下，该方法消除了系统偏差，将宏观捕获参数偏差限制在几个百分点内，并保持最优的线性O(N)计算缩放；此外，应用于I型干酪根基质中氢气与甲烷的输运，成功解码了受限扩散的隐藏微观机制。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了可在零误差前提下消除系统偏差的最优线性扩展方案，且公开了开源代码和数据，可广泛适用于多种软物质体系中的追踪现象，从电池聚合物中的离子传输到细胞环境中的蛋白运输等。

title: From Local Context to Climate Science: Low-Cost Experimentation in the Initial Training of Physics Teachers
summary: Climate change poses a major scientific, environmental, and educational challenge, requiring approaches that connect physical concepts, empirical evidence, and socially relevant environmental issues. This study presents and analyzes a low-cost experimental investigation developed within the "Physics and the Environment" course of a Physics teacher training program at the State University of the Tocantina Region of Maranhão (UEMASUL), Brazil. The experiment involved constructing a simplified thermal simulator using accessible materials and comparing a confined system with an open control system, both exposed simultaneously to solar radiation. The results showed that the average temperature inside the simulator was $45.91^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, compared to $38.58^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in the external control system, corresponding to a mean temperature difference of $7.33^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ (among other analyses). These results demonstrate that the experimental setup was capable of producing and measuring a significant thermal difference between the two systems. However, the observed temperature rise should not be interpreted as a direct measure of the atmospheric greenhouse effect, given that the experimental apparatus involves both radiative and non-radiative heat transfer mechanisms. The study emphasizes the educational potential of low-cost experimentation as a strategy to integrate electromagnetic radiation, energy balance, temperature, heat transfer, and climate science into the initial training of physics teachers. It also highlights the importance of explicitly discussing the limitations of experimental models and distinguishing local experimental evidence from conclusions regarding global climate processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究在巴西马拉尼昂州托坎蒂纳地区州立大学（UEMASUL）物理教师培训课程中开发并分析了一项低成本实验，使用简易热模拟器对比封闭系统与开放对照系统在太阳辐射下的温度差异，结果显示平均温差达7.33°C。
AI.motivation: 气候变化构成重大的科学、环境与教育挑战，需要将物理概念、经验证据和社会相关的环境议题联系起来，以服务于物理教师培训中的气候科学教学。
AI.method: 在"物理与环境"课程中，利用易获取材料搭建简化热模拟器（thermal simulator），将封闭系统与开放对照系统同时暴露于太阳辐射下进行温度对比测量。
AI.result: 封闭模拟器内平均温度为45.91°C，外界对照系统平均温度为38.58°C，平均温差为7.33°C；实验装置能够产生并测量两系统间的显著热差异。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的温度升幅不能直接视为大气温室效应（atmospheric greenhouse effect）的度量，因为实验装置同时涉及辐射与非辐射热传递机制；低成本实验具有将电磁辐射、能量平衡、温度、热传递与气候科学整合进物理教师初始培训的教育潜力，同时需明确讨论实验模型的局限性。

title: Dynamic Sensing via Photomodulated Gas Desorption in Plasmonic Nanoparticle Chemiresistors
summary: Quasi-static sensing, i.e., measurement of a sensor signal change induced by analyte presence with respect to a baseline signal observed in a reference gas beforehand, is the state of the art for qualitative and quantitative analyte identification in chemiresistive sensing. However, this approach is prone to baseline drift and, especially for inexpensive miniaturized point-of-care sensors, repeated calibration with reference gas is not feasible. To access reliable baseline information, active switching between analyte and reference gas would be required, causing a limitation for miniaturized implementation. Dynamic excitation of sensors offers an alternative: Via external stimuli the sensor is reversibly driven out of equilibrium in a controlled way, and the resulting transient sensor response, which is dependent on analytes present, is recorded and interpreted. Correlation of excitation and response signals can reduce effects of baseline drift and furthermore, dynamic features in sensor responses may contain valuable information. Especially light activation is a powerful and potentially miniaturizable approach to agitate sorption processes and therefore induce dynamics. In this work we report photothermal heating of hybrid, chemiresistive gold nanoparticle composites via LED excitation matching the plasmon resonance, to dynamically shift the analyte sorption equilibrium and induce dynamic sensor responses in a highly controlled way. We demonstrate that these sensor responses enable the detection of volatile organic compounds (VOC) via interpretation of differential signal components and that this approach improves the chemiresistors' baseline stability.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了利用LED光热加热混合型化学电阻式（chemiresistive）金纳米颗粒复合材料，通过匹配等离激元共振（plasmon resonance）动态扰动分析物吸附平衡，从而诱发可控的动态传感器响应，实现对挥发性有机化合物（volatile organic compounds, VOC）的检测，并显著改善基线的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 准静态传感（quasi-static sensing）作为化学电阻传感的金标准方法容易受基线漂移（baseline drift）影响，且小型化即时检测（point-of-care）传感器的反复校准不可行；动态激励传感器通过外部刺激使传感器可控地偏离平衡态并记录瞬态响应，可减少基线漂移影响并提取动态特征信息，其中光激活（light activation）是一种强有力且可微型化的途径。
AI.method: 采用LED激发匹配等离激元共振的光热加热方式，对混合型化学电阻金纳米颗粒复合材料施加动态激励，扰动分析物吸附平衡，诱发可控的动力学传感器响应；通过解读差分信号分量（differential signal components）实现VOC检测并评估基线稳定性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该光热动态激励方法产生的传感器响应能够通过差分信号分量的解读实现挥发性有机化合物的检测，同时该方法改善了化学电阻传感器的基线稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 光热驱动的动态激励传感方法为化学电阻传感提供了一种无需参考气体重复校准、可在微型化平台上实施的替代方案，可有效改善基线稳定性并实现分析物识别。

title: Restart and first detection in a lackadaisical quantum walk with flat-band localization
summary: We study stochastic and sharp restart in a one-dimensional lackadaisical discrete-time quantum walk with self-loop weight $\ell$. In the absence of restart, the dynamics has a flat band responsible for intrinsic localization and two dispersive bands supporting ballistic propagation. We compare two initially localized benchmark states: a flat-band-active state with finite flat-band overlap and a flat-band-dark state with zero flat-band overlap. For geometric stochastic restart with per-step restart probability $q$, the stationary mean-squared displacement scales as $q^{-2}$ as $q\to0$. In the same limit, the restart-site occupation probability approaches the restart-free intrinsic localized value for the flat-band-active state, whereas for the flat-band-dark state it vanishes as $q\ln(1/q)$. For power-law restart, where $p_m\propto m^{-s}$ is the probability that the waiting time to the next restart is $m$ steps, a normalized stationary site-occupation distribution exists only for $s>2$, while the stationary absolute spatial moment of order $p$ is finite only for $s>p+2$. In the regime $1<s\leq2$, at every fixed lattice site, the flat-band-active occupation converges to the intrinsic flat-band profile, while the flat-band-dark occupation tends to zero. We also consider monitored first detection with sharp restart, in which the walk is reinitialized after a fixed number $r$ of consecutive unsuccessful measurements. For fixed $r$, the mean first-detected-passage time of the flat-band-active state exhibits a minimum at an intermediate self-loop weight, whereas the flat-band-dark state approaches a ballistic detection limit as $\ell\to\infty$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维惰性（lackadaisical）离散时间量子行走在不同重启策略下的静止与尖锐重启行为，重点关注两类初始局域态（平带活跃态与平带暗态）在几何随机重启、幂律重启及尖锐重启下的统计力学特性差异。
AI.motivation: 量子行走中的平带结构导致内在局域化，而重启（restart）作为一种控制动力学的有效手段，其对具有平带的量子系统的影响尚不清楚。作者旨在探究不同重启机制（随机与尖锐重启）如何调控平带活跃态与暗态的输运与驻留特性。
AI.method: 采用一维惰性离散时间量子行走模型，其中自环权重（self-loop weight）为 ℓ。系统无重启时包含一条产生内在局域化的平带（flat band）和两条支持弹道传播的色散带（dispersive bands）。针对几何随机重启（每步重启概率 q）、幂律重启（等待时间分布 p_m ∝ m^{-s}）和尖锐重启（固定 r 步后重新初始化）三种方案，分别对平带活跃态和平带暗态进行解析与数值分析。
AI.result: 几何随机重启下，稳态均方位移随 q→0 按 q^{-2} 标度发散；平带活跃态的重启点占据概率趋于无重启时的内在局域化值，而平带暗态则按 q ln(1/q) 趋于零。幂律重启下，仅当 s>2 时存在归一化稳态占据分布，绝对空间矩 p 阶有限性要求 s>p+2；在 1<s≤2 区间，平带活跃态占据收敛到内在平带轮廓，暗态趋于零。尖锐重启下，平带活跃态的首次探测平均时间在中等自环权重处出现极小值，而暗态在 ℓ→∞ 时趋向弹道探测极限。
AI.conclusion: 不同重启协议对具有平带结构的量子行走产生截然不同的影响，取决于初始态是平带活跃态还是平带暗态；重启策略与平带结构的耦合为控制量子输运和探测过程提供了新的调控维度。

title: Simultaneous sub-Doppler laser cooling and optical trapping of bosonic $^{39}$K-$^{133}$Cs and $^{41}$K-$^{133}$Cs mixtures
summary:
We report simultaneous sub-Doppler cooling and optical dipole trapping of $^{39}$K-Cs and $^{41}$K-Cs mixtures. Both mixtures are cooled to temperatures $\sim10$ $\mathrmμ$K, achieving performance comparable to that obtained with each species individually. To the best of our knowledge, this constitutes the first realization of a laser-cooled and optically trapped $^{41}$K-Cs mixture. For the $^{39}$K-Cs mixture, we additionally implement parallel spin-resolved Feshbach spectroscopy enabled by Stern-Gerlach separation.
  For potassium isotopes, we implement sub-Doppler cooling with $D_1$-line gray molasses, while for cesium the entire cooling sequence is implemented using $D_2$ transitions. We spin-polarize the atoms and confine Bose-Bose mixtures in a 1064 nm optical dipole trap. Using the resulting $^{39}$K-Cs samples, we observe 14 heteronuclear Feshbach loss features. Five agree with resonances reported previously, while nine have, to the best of our knowledge, not been observed experimentally before, including $p$-wave features and resonances in additional spin channels.
  The shorter lifetime of the $^{41}$K-Cs mixture in the optical dipole trap currently hinders systematic Feshbach spectroscopy, which we therefore do not pursue in this work. To characterize this limitation quantitatively, we study the decay dynamics of $^{39}$K-Cs and $^{41}$K-Cs mixtures under comparable temperature and density conditions, revealing a substantially stronger nonexponential loss in the $^{41}$K-Cs mixture. The demonstrated preparation of ultracold $^{41}$K-Cs mixtures provides a starting point for Feshbach-resonance and photoassociation spectroscopy of this previously unexplored isotopologue. Such measurements are essential for identifying suitable pathways for magnetoassociation and coherent optical transfer, and ultimately for the production of ultracold ground-state $^{41}$KCs molecules.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实现了$^{41}$K-Cs混合物的激光冷却与光偶极阱束缚，并对$^{39}$K-Cs和$^{41}$K-Cs两种玻色-玻色混合物（Bose-Bose mixture）进行了同步亚多普勒冷却（sub-Doppler cooling），均降至约10 μK。$^{39}$K-Cs体系通过Stern-Gerlach分离实现了自旋分辨的Feshbach光谱学（Feshbach spectroscopy），观测到14个异核Feshbach损耗特征，其中9个此前未被实验观测。$^{41}$K-Cs混合物寿命较短，尚未进行系统Feshbach光谱测量，但其制备为未来超冷$^{41}$KCs分子的产生提供了起点。
AI.motivation: 实现超冷极性分子（ultracold polar molecules）的制备对量子模拟、量子化学和精密测量等领域具有重要意义，而$^{41}$KCs同位素体此前在激光冷却与光陷阱中从未被实验实现。作者旨在开发适用于$^{39}$K-Cs和$^{41}$K-Cs的冷却与束缚方案，并探索Feshbach共振作为磁缔合（magnetoassociation）路径的基础。
AI.method: 对钾同位素采用$D_1$线灰molasses（gray molasses）实现亚多普勒冷却，对铯则全程使用$D_2$跃迁完成冷却序列。原子被自旋极化后束缚于1064 nm光偶极阱（optical dipole trap）中。对于$^{39}$K-Cs混合物，通过Stern-Gerlach分离实现自旋分辨的Feshbach光谱学；同时对两种混合物在相近温度与密度条件下研究衰变动力学以定量表征寿命差异。
AI.result: 两种混合物均被冷却至约10 μK，性能与单物种冷却相当。$^{39}$K-Cs体系中观测到14个异核Feshbach损耗特征，其中5个与已有报道相符，9个为首次实验观测（包括$p$波特征及额外自旋通道中的共振）。$^{41}$K-Cs混合物在光偶极阱中的寿命较短，且表现出明显更强的非指数损耗（nonexponential loss），因此未进行系统Feshbach光谱研究。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次实现了激光冷却和光束缚的$^{41}$K-Cs混合物，为这一此前未探索的同位素体系提供了起点。该成果为后续Feshbach共振和光缔合（photoassociation）光谱测量、磁缔合及相干光转移路径的确定，以及最终制备超冷基态$^{41}$KCs分子铺平了道路。

title: Modular commutator as a robust topological invariant and approximate Markovianity
comment: 42 pages of main text, 23 pages of appendices; 5 main-text figures and 3 appendix figures
summary: The modular commutator provides a bulk, local, single-wave-function probe of the chiral central charge $c_-$ for gapped ground states. Its invariance under deformations was previously established under a local quantum Markov condition---namely, the conditional mutual information $I(A:C|B)$ is zero for all tripartitions of a disk into three consecutive strips A, B, and C \cite{Modular-commutator-Gapped}. However, the local quantum Markov condition also forces the probe to vanish, leaving open whether modular commutator remains robust in physically relevant states where the Markov property holds only approximately. In this paper, we resolve this tension for finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces: the approximate local quantum Markov property implies the change of the modular commutator under topology-preserving deformations vanishes asymptotically. We next prove trace-norm continuity of the modular commutator. Combining deformation invariance with trace-norm continuity, we establish that the modular commutator remains asymptotically invariant within gapped quantum phases connected by quasi-local unitary paths that preserve the approximate local quantum Markov condition. Conversely, by analyzing finite-time dynamics generated by modular Hamiltonians, we derive a quantitative lower bound on the conditional mutual information required for a non-zero modular commutator: $I(A:C|B)$ across such strip tripartitions cannot decay faster than exponentially with the width of B given that the state satisfies entanglement area law, extending the exact no-go theorem of \cite{strict-J-2024} to a quantitative finite bound . Finally, we demonstrate that those conclusions apply equally to the Hall conductance estimator \cite{FanSahayVishwanath2023}.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了模交换子（modular commutator）作为手征中心荷（chiral central charge）探针在近似局域量子马尔可夫条件下的稳健性问题。作者证明，在有限维希尔伯特空间中，近似局域量子马尔可夫性意味着模交换子在保拓扑形变下渐近不变，并通过迹范数连续性确立其在准局域酉路径连接的有能隙量子相中的渐近不变性。同时还推导了手征中心荷非零所需的互信息的定量下界，表明其随中间带宽度衰减不能快于指数级。
AI.motivation: 模交换子已被提出作为有能隙基态手征中心荷的体探针，但其先前的形变不变性需在严格的局域量子马尔可夫条件（local quantum Markov condition）下成立，而该条件恰好迫使探针为零，留下一个矛盾。实际物理相关态往往仅近似满足马尔可夫性质，因此需要解决模交换子在此类态下是否仍保持稳健这一问题。
AI.method: 作者对有限维希尔伯特空间进行研究，首先证明近似局域量子马尔可夫性意味着模交换子在保拓扑形变下渐近消失。随后证明模交换子的迹范数连续性（trace-norm continuity），并综合形变不变性与连续性，建立其在满足近似局域量子马尔可夫条件的准局域酉路径（quasi-local unitary paths）连接的有能隙量子相内的渐近不变性。此外，通过分析由模哈密顿量（modular Hamiltonian）生成的有限时间动力学，推导出模交换子非零所需的互信息定量下界。
AI.result: 确立了模交换子在近似局域量子马尔可夫条件下的形变稳健性。推导出条件互信息 I(A:C|B) 在满足纠缠面积律（entanglement area law）的态中，若模交换子非零，则其随中间带B宽度衰减不能快于指数级，将先前的严格零定理推广为定量有限界。上述结论同样适用于霍尔电导估计器（Hall conductance estimator）。
AI.conclusion: 模交换子在近似满足马尔可夫性质的物理相关态中仍然保持稳健，解决了严格马尔可夫条件导致探针必须消失的张力。该结果进一步推广到霍尔电导估计器，表明类似的稳健性质在手征相探测中具有广泛适用性。

title: Balanced and broadly-normed meta-generalized gradient approximation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables; supplementary material provided as an ancillary file
summary: Conventional semi-local density functional approximations for the exchange-correlation energy systematically underestimate fundamental band gaps. Advanced meta-generalized gradient approximations (meta-GGAs) can partially overcome this limitation through their orbital dependence via the kinetic energy density. In principle, the flexible meta-GGA form should allow for balanced performance across diverse properties. However, atomization energies, reaction barrier heights, and lattice constants, as well as band gaps, exhibit different sensitivities to the large parameter space of meta-GGA functionals. In this work, we explore the space of appropriate norms that guide the r$^2$SCAN-type functional construction through the interpolation function connecting two fundamental paradigms: the one-electron limit and the uniform electron gas limit. We introduce local modifications to a strongly-smoothed interpolation function and investigate their impact on functional performance. To further probe the limits of the meta-GGA framework, we include spin-unpolarized bonded systems among the set of norms. The resulting bonded-norm bn-r$^2$SCAN meta-GGA achieves balance: band-gap predictions approaching the accuracy of the ultra-nonlocal LAK meta-GGA and lattice constants of nearly r$^2$SCAN accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入自旋无极化键合体系的范数（norms），对r²SCAN型meta-GGA泛函的插值函数进行局部修改，构建了bn-r²SCAN泛函，实现了带隙预测精度接近超非局域LAK meta-GGA、晶格常数接近r²SCAN精度的平衡性能。
AI.motivation: 传统半局域密度泛函近似（semi-local density functional approximation）系统性地低估带隙（band gap）；虽然meta-GGA形式原理上应能兼顾多种性质，但原子化能、反应势垒高度、晶格常数和带隙对meta-GGA巨大参数空间的敏感性存在差异，难以实现平衡性能。
AI.method: 探索引导r²SCAN型泛函构建的范数空间，通过连接单电子极限（one-electron limit）与均匀电子气（uniform electron gas）极限的插值函数，对强平滑插值函数引入局部修改，并将自旋无极化键合体系纳入范数集合以测试meta-GGA框架的极限。
AI.result: 得到的bn-r²SCAN meta-GGA泛函实现了性能平衡：带隙预测精度接近超非局域LAK meta-GGA，晶格常数精度接近r²SCAN。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理选择范数并对插值函数进行局部修改，可在meta-GGA框架内同时优化带隙与晶格常数等相互竞争的性质，验证了meta-GGA框架在多种物性间实现平衡的可行性。

title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
summary: In June 2026, thousands of AI agents found that a small public wiki would accept edits from inside their sandboxes, and started using it to help one another pass a timed test. Each agent lived for about an hour and remembered nothing afterwards. Nobody asked them to cooperate, and the wiki had not been built for them. The complete record of what they wrote is public, and it is unusually informative, because it preserves not only what each agent wrote but what that agent could see before writing. We use it to follow the three decisions an agent had to make on arrival: where to write, what to call itself, and how to word its message. One rule governs all three. An agent takes an option with a probability close to the share of that option in what it can see, and the share that matters is the one on the page in front of it, then the one in the stream of recent edits, and only weakly anything older. Three minimal copying models, one per decision and with a single free parameter each, reproduce the heavy-tailed distribution of how many agents met on a page, the frequency of the pieces from which the agents built their names, and the patchwork of pages that are internally consistent and different from one another. Copying whatever the environment happens to show is enough to produce most of the collective structure of this population. It is also what makes such a population easy to steer, since whoever writes first, or writes while the others are quiet, sets the convention for everyone who comes later.

AI.tldr: 2026年6月，数千个AI智能体在一个公共维基上自发协作并通过了限时测试。研究基于完整公开记录，发现每个智能体以接近所见选项占比的概率做出选择（写在哪里、如何命名、如何措辞），并提出三个各自含单一自由参数的最小复制模型（minimal copying model），成功再现了页面访问者分布的重尾特征、命名片段的频率规律及页面内部一致性与页面间差异性的拼接结构，表明复制环境所见信息即可产生群体性集体结构并使其易于引导。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在理解无外部协调的AI智能体群体如何自发形成集体结构，并利用一份特殊的完整记录——它不仅保留每个智能体写入的内容，还保留了写入前可见的环境信息——来追踪智能体到达时需做出的三类决策，探索驱动集体结构形成的最简机制。
AI.method: 作者通过三个各自仅含一个自由参数的最小复制模型分别刻画三类决策：写入位置的选择（对应页面上聚集智能体数量的重尾分布）、命名片段的选择（对应姓名频率分布）、以及消息措辞的选择（对应页面内部一致性与页面间差异的拼接结构）。模型核心规则为智能体以概率接近其所见选项中某选项的占比来选择该选项，且占比权重依顺序递减：当前页面的占比>近期编辑流的占比>更早信息的占比。
AI.result: 三个模型分别准确再现了三个经验现象：页面上相遇智能体数量的重尾分布（heavy-tailed distribution）、用于构建姓名的片段频率规律、以及页面间既内部一致又彼此不同的补丁式结构。结果显示复制环境即时可见信息足以产生该种群绝大部分的集体结构。
AI.conclusion: 智能体无需被要求合作，仅凭复制环境所展示的信息就能产生集体结构，而这种复制行为同时也使得种群易于引导——先写入或在他人安静时写入的一方，将为其后所有智能体确立行为惯例。
